`````python
"""
scripts/test_workbench_controls_e2e.py

Automated End-to-End Control and Behavior Audit for ReactAgent SLM Workbench UI (Issue #29).
Tests every visible button, dropdown, input, toggle, and panel across all 8 UI areas:
1. Project / Navigation
2. Top Bar
3. Composer
4. Workspace Panel
5. Code Tab
6. Diff Tab
7. Logs Tab
8. Shell Tab & Inspector Drawer
"""

import sys
import time

if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
if hasattr(sys.stderr, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"


def run_control_audit():
    print(f"Starting Workbench Button and Control Audit against {BASE_URL}...")
    errors = []
    console_errors = []

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = browser.new_context(
            viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900},
            permissions=["clipboard-read", "clipboard-write"]
        )
        page = context.new_page()

        def on_console(msg):
            if msg.type == "error":
                # Filter out intentional 404s for empty projects/diffs if any
                text = msg.text
                print(f"  [Console Error] {text}")
                if "favicon" not in text:
                    console_errors.append(text)

        page.on("console", on_console)
        page.on("pageerror", lambda exc: errors.append(f"Page uncaught exception: {exc}"))

        print("\n--- 1. Page Load & Initial Render ---")
        page.goto(BASE_URL, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=15000)
        title = page.title()
        print(f"Page title: {title}")
        assert "ReactAgent" in title or "SLM" in title or len(title) > 0, "Invalid title"

        # Check main containers
        assert page.is_visible("#root"), "Root container missing"

        print("\n--- 2. Project / Navigation Controls ---")
        # New Project button
        new_proj_btn = page.locator("#sidebar-new-project-btn")
        assert new_proj_btn.is_visible(), "New Project button not visible"
        new_proj_btn.click()
        time.sleep(0.3)
        print("  [OK] New Project button clicked successfully")

        # Project Selection from Sidebar
        first_proj = page.locator("[id^='sidebar-project-item-']").first
        if first_proj.is_visible():
            first_proj.click()
            time.sleep(0.5)
            print("  ✓ Selected existing project from sidebar")

        # Sidebar Search Input
        search_input = page.locator("#sidebar-search-input")
        assert search_input.is_visible(), "Sidebar search input not visible"
        search_input.fill("test query")
        time.sleep(0.2)
        search_input.fill("")
        print("  ✓ Sidebar search input interactive")

        # Sidebar Toggle
        sidebar_toggle = page.locator("#topbar-sidebar-toggle")
        assert sidebar_toggle.is_visible(), "Sidebar toggle button not visible"
        # Toggle closed
        sidebar_toggle.click()
        time.sleep(0.3)
        # Toggle open
        sidebar_toggle.click()
        time.sleep(0.3)
        print("  ✓ Sidebar toggle opens and closes sidebar")

        # Clear History button
        clear_hist_btn = page.locator("#sidebar-clear-history-btn")
        if clear_hist_btn.is_visible():
            clear_hist_btn.click()
            time.sleep(0.3)
            # Should open confirm dialog
            cancel_btn = page.locator("#confirm-dialog-cancel-btn")
            if cancel_btn.is_visible():
                cancel_btn.click()
                print("  ✓ Clear history triggers confirm dialog and dismisses cleanly")
            else:
                print("  ✓ Clear history clicked")

        print("\n--- 3. Top Bar Controls ---")
        # Theme toggle
        theme_btn = page.locator("#topbar-theme-toggle")
        assert theme_btn.is_visible(), "Theme toggle not visible"
        theme_btn.click()
        time.sleep(0.2)
        theme_btn.click()
        print("  ✓ Theme toggle functional")

        # Workspace Toggle
        ws_toggle = page.locator("#topbar-workspace-toggle")
        assert ws_toggle.is_visible(), "Workspace toggle button not visible"
        ws_toggle.click()
        time.sleep(0.3)
        # Ensure workspace panel is open for subsequent tab verification
        if not page.is_visible("#workspace-tab-preview"):
            ws_toggle.click()
            time.sleep(0.3)
        print("  ✓ Workspace toggle opens and closes workspace panel")

        # Inspector Toggle & Drawer
        inspector_toggle = page.locator("#topbar-inspector-toggle")
        assert inspector_toggle.is_visible(), "Inspector toggle button not visible"
        inspector_toggle.click()
        time.sleep(0.3)
        assert page.is_visible("#inspector-drawer"), "Inspector drawer did not open"
        print("  ✓ Inspector drawer opened")

        # Close Inspector from inside drawer
        inspector_close = page.locator("#inspector-close-btn")
        assert inspector_close.is_visible(), "Inspector close button not visible"
`````

`````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
CLI tool to audit any dataset against the sealed final benchmark or dev benchmark.
Enforces the 6 evaluation leakage checks:
1. Exact prompt matching
2. Normalized matching
3. Symbol overlap
4. Token similarity (Jaccard)
5. Family-level holdout
6. Semantic similarity checks

Usage:
  python scripts/verify_benchmark_leakage.py --dataset data/training_data.jsonl
  python scripts/verify_benchmark_leakage.py --dataset data/eval/dev_benchmark.jsonl
"""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

from training.leakage_guard import (
    audit_dataset_against_benchmark,
    verify_sealed_benchmark_manifest,
    SEALED_BENCHMARK_PATH,
    SEALED_MANIFEST_PATH,
)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Verify evaluation benchmark leakage protection."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dataset",
        type=str,
        required=True,
        help="Path to dataset to audit (training, validation, or dev set).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--benchmark",
        type=str,
        default=str(SEALED_BENCHMARK_PATH),
        help="Path to benchmark JSONL (default: sealed final benchmark).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--manifest",
        type=str,
        default=str(SEALED_MANIFEST_PATH),
        help="Path to manifest JSON (default: sealed benchmark manifest).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--report",
        type=str,
        default="runs/sealed_benchmark_leakage_report.json",
        help="Path to output report JSON.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--token-threshold",
        type=float,
        default=0.50,
        help="Token Jaccard similarity threshold (default: 0.50).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--semantic-threshold",
        type=float,
        default=0.65,
        help="Semantic similarity threshold (default: 0.65).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--symbol-threshold",
        type=float,
        default=0.35,
        help="Symbol-conditioned token similarity threshold (default: 0.35).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--no-manifest-check",
        action="store_true",
        help="Skip cryptographic manifest integrity check.",
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    print("=" * 70)
    print("SiteAgent Benchmark Leakage Verification")
    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"Dataset to audit:    {args.dataset}")
    print(f"Held-out benchmark:  {args.benchmark}")
    if not args.no_manifest_check:
        print(f"Benchmark manifest:  {args.manifest}")
    print(f"Token threshold:     {args.token_threshold:.2f}")
    print(f"Semantic threshold:  {args.semantic_threshold:.2f}")
    print("-" * 70)

    try:
        report = audit_dataset_against_benchmark(
            dataset_path=args.dataset,
            benchmark_path=args.benchmark,
            manifest_path=None if args.no_manifest_check else args.manifest,
            token_similarity_threshold=args.token_threshold,
            semantic_similarity_threshold=args.semantic_threshold,
            symbol_overlap_threshold=args.symbol_threshold,
            verify_manifest=not args.no_manifest_check,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n[AUDIT ABORTED - INTEGRITY ERROR]: {e}")
        sys.exit(2)

    # Save report
    report_path = Path(args.report)
    if not report_path.is_absolute():
        report_path = BASE_DIR / report_path
    report_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(report_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(report.to_dict(), f, indent=2)

    print(f"Audited candidate samples: {report.total_candidate_samples}")
    print(f"Benchmark tasks:           {report.total_benchmark_tasks}")
    print(f"Peak token similarity:     {report.peak_token_similarity:.4f}")
    print(f"Peak semantic similarity:  {report.peak_semantic_similarity:.4f}")
    print(f"Manifest verified:         {report.manifest_verified}")
    print("-" * 70)

    if report.is_clean:
        print("RESULT: PASSED (0 Leaks Detected)")
        print(f"Report saved to: {report_path}")
        print("=" * 70)
        sys.exit(0)
    else:
        print(f"RESULT: FAILED ({report.leak_count} Leaks Detected!)")
        print("Leak Breakdown:")
        for k, count in report.breakdown.items():
            print(f"  - {k}: {count}")
        print("\nTop Violations:")
        for v in report.violations[:5]:
            print(f"  [{v.check_type}] {v.candidate_identifier} -> {v.benchmark_task_id}")
            print(f"    Message: {v.message}")
            print(f"    Candidate: {v.candidate_snippet}")
            print(f"    Benchmark: {v.benchmark_snippet}")
        print(f"\nFull report saved to: {report_path}")
        print("=" * 70)
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
`````

`````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
scripts/mix_training_data.py - Curriculum Mixing & Rebalancing Utility

Implements Item 15 from Section 9 and Section 3 of SITEAGENT_MOTION_TRAINING_GUIDE.md:
Mixes the professional motion curriculum (siteagent_motion_sft_v1.jsonl) into core
replay data at a controlled ratio (10%–15% motion), ensuring anti-template collapse,
strict target formatting (<tool_call name="write_site">, zero <think>/<thought> tags),
and no unverified motion package hallucinations.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import random
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DEFAULT_MOTION_PATH = ROOT_DIR / "data" / "siteagent_motion_sft_v1.jsonl"
DEFAULT_REPLAY_PATH = ROOT_DIR / "data" / "training_data.jsonl"
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_PATH = ROOT_DIR / "data" / "mixed_motion_training_curriculum.jsonl"

# Archetype detection keywords
ARCHETYPE_PATTERNS = {
    "split_hero": [r"split", r"two-column", r"side-by-side", r"column layout"],
    "editorial_asymmetric": [r"editorial", r"asymmetric", r"magazine", r"monograph", r"folio"],
    "immersive_visual": [r"full-bleed", r"immersive", r"hero visual", r"cinematic", r"background image"],
    "bento_grid": [r"bento", r"card grid", r"feature grid", r"mosaic"],
    "product_stage": [r"product", r"showcase", r"stage", r"hardware", r"device"],
    "restrained_centered": [r"centered", r"minimal", r"clean typography", r"text-only"],
}


def load_jsonl(path: Path) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Loads records from a JSONL file."""
    if not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Input file not found: {path}")
    records: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for idx, line in enumerate(f, start=1):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                records.append(json.loads(line))
            except json.JSONDecodeError as err:
                print(f"[Warning] Skipped invalid JSON line {idx} in {path.name}: {err}", file=sys.stderr)
    return records


def save_jsonl(records: List[Dict[str, Any]], path: Path) -> None:
    """Saves records to a JSONL file."""
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for rec in records:
            f.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    """Rough estimate of token count (char_len // 3.8)."""
    return max(1, int(len(text) / 3.8))


def extract_full_text(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Combines all messages or turn contents in a trajectory."""
    parts: List[str] = []
    if "messages" in record and isinstance(record["messages"], list):
        for msg in record["messages"]:
            if isinstance(msg, dict):
                parts.append(str(msg.get("content", "")))
    elif "turns" in record and isinstance(record["turns"], list):
        for turn in record["turns"]:
            if isinstance(turn, dict):
                parts.append(str(turn.get("content", "")))
                parts.append(str(turn.get("code", "")))
    elif "files" in record and isinstance(record["files"], dict):
        parts.extend(str(v) for v in record["files"].values())
    return " ".join(parts)


def validate_trajectory_cleanliness(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]:
    """
    Verifies that a trajectory adheres to production contracts:
    - Zero <think> or <thought> tags in assistant targets
    - No unverified package imports (e.g. unverified gsap/framer-motion)
    """
    violations: List[str] = []
    messages = record.get("messages", [])
    for msg in messages:
        if msg.get("role") == "assistant":
            content = msg.get("content", "")
            if "<think>" in content or "<thought>" in content:
                violations.append("Assistant response contains forbidden <think>/<thought> reasoning tags.")
            if "import { gsap }" in content and 'implementation="gsap"' not in content:
                violations.append("Assistant response contains unverified GSAP import without explicit declaration.")
            if "from 'framer-motion'" in content and 'implementation="framer-motion"' not in content:
                violations.append("Assistant response contains unverified Framer Motion import without explicit declaration.")

    return len(violations) == 0, violations


def detect_archetype(text: str) -> str:
    """Classifies trajectory archetype from prompt and content text."""
    lower_text = text.lower()
    for arch, patterns in ARCHETYPE_PATTERNS.items():
        if any(re.search(pat, lower_text) for pat in patterns):
            return arch
    return "general_standard"


def mix_datasets(
    motion_records: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    replay_records: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    motion_ratio: float = 0.15,
    total_samples: Optional[int] = None,
    seed: int = 42,
) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Mixes motion and replay records to achieve the target motion ratio.
    If total_samples is not specified, uses all motion records and calculates
    the required replay records: N_replay = int(N_motion * (1 - ratio) / ratio).
    """
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n_motion = len(motion_records)

    if total_samples is not None:
        target_motion_count = min(n_motion, max(1, int(total_samples * motion_ratio)))
        target_replay_count = max(1, total_samples - target_motion_count)
    else:
        # Scale replay data around all available unique motion records
        target_motion_count = n_motion
        target_replay_count = int(math.ceil(n_motion * (1.0 - motion_ratio) / motion_ratio))

    # Sample unique motion records
    sampled_motion = list(motion_records[:target_motion_count])
    motion_seen = {json.dumps(r.get("messages"), sort_keys=True) for r in sampled_motion}

    # Filter replay records to ensure no duplicate conversations and no overlap with motion records
    unique_replays: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen = set(motion_seen)
    for r in replay_records:
        fp = json.dumps(r.get("messages"), sort_keys=True)
        if fp not in seen:
            seen.add(fp)
            unique_replays.append(r)

    # Sample unique replay records
    target_replay_count = min(len(unique_replays), target_replay_count)
    sampled_replay = rng.sample(unique_replays, target_replay_count)

    # Combine and shuffle
    combined = sampled_motion + sampled_replay
    rng.shuffle(combined)

    actual_motion_count = sum(
        1 for r in combined
        if r.get("category", "").startswith("motion_")
        or "motion_" in r.get("task_id", "")
    )
    actual_ratio = actual_motion_count / max(1, len(combined))

    # Compute archetype distribution
    archetype_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
    total_tokens = 0
    clean_count = 0
    dirty_count = 0

    for rec in combined:
        txt = extract_full_text(rec)
        total_tokens += estimate_tokens(txt)
        arch = detect_archetype(txt)
        archetype_counts[arch] = archetype_counts.get(arch, 0) + 1

        is_clean, _ = validate_trajectory_cleanliness(rec)
        if is_clean:
            clean_count += 1
        else:
            dirty_count += 1

    stats = {
        "total_records": len(combined),
        "motion_records": actual_motion_count,
        "replay_records": len(combined) - actual_motion_count,
        "target_ratio": round(motion_ratio, 4),
        "actual_motion_ratio": round(actual_ratio, 4),
        "avg_tokens_per_record": int(total_tokens / max(1, len(combined))),
        "clean_records": clean_count,
        "dirty_records": dirty_count,
        "archetype_distribution": {
            k: f"{v} ({round(v / len(combined) * 100, 1)}%)"
            for k, v in sorted(archetype_counts.items(), key=lambda item: item[1], reverse=True)
        },
    }

    return combined, stats


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Mix professional motion curriculum into core replay training data at a controlled ratio."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--motion-file",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_MOTION_PATH,
        help=f"Path to motion SFT JSONL dataset (default: {DEFAULT_MOTION_PATH.name})",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--replay-file",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_REPLAY_PATH,
        help=f"Path to core replay JSONL dataset (default: {DEFAULT_REPLAY_PATH.name})",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-file",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT_PATH,
        help=f"Path to output mixed JSONL file (default: {DEFAULT_OUTPUT_PATH.name})",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--motion-ratio",
        type=float,
        default=0.15,
        help="Target motion dataset fraction (default: 0.15 for 15%% motion)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--max-samples",
        type=int,
        default=None,
        help="Optional total number of records in output dataset",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--seed",
        type=int,
        default=42,
        help="Random seed for reproducible dataset mixing (default: 42)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="Compute and display mixing statistics without writing output file",
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    print(f"[Curriculum Mixer] Loading motion dataset: {args.motion_file}")
    motion_records = load_jsonl(args.motion_file)
    print(f"[Curriculum Mixer] Loaded {len(motion_records)} motion trajectories.")

    # Fallback to secondary replay path if primary does not exist
    replay_path = args.replay_file
    if not replay_path.is_file():
        alt_paths = [
            ROOT_DIR / "data" / "step2_gated_survivors.jsonl",
            ROOT_DIR / "data" / "site_trajectories_batch4.jsonl",
            ROOT_DIR / "site_trajectories_batch4.jsonl",
        ]
        for alt in alt_paths:
            if alt.is_file():
                replay_path = alt
                print(f"[Curriculum Mixer] Default replay file not found; falling back to: {alt.name}")
                break

    print(f"[Curriculum Mixer] Loading replay dataset: {replay_path}")
    replay_records = load_jsonl(replay_path)
    print(f"[Curriculum Mixer] Loaded {len(replay_records)} replay trajectories.")

    print(f"[Curriculum Mixer] Blending datasets at target ratio: {args.motion_ratio * 100:.1f}% motion...")
    mixed, stats = mix_datasets(
        motion_records=motion_records,
        replay_records=replay_records,
        motion_ratio=args.motion_ratio,
        total_samples=args.max_samples,
        seed=args.seed,
    )

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("           CURRICULUM MIXING SUMMARY")
    print("=" * 60)
    print(f"Total Trajectories:       {stats['total_records']}")
    print(f"Motion Trajectories:      {stats['motion_records']} ({stats['actual_motion_ratio'] * 100:.1f}%)")
    print(f"Replay Trajectories:      {stats['replay_records']}")
    print(f"Target Motion Ratio:      {stats['target_ratio'] * 100:.1f}%")
    print(f"Avg Tokens per Record:    ~{stats['avg_tokens_per_record']} tokens")
    print(f"Clean Contract Records:   {stats['clean_records']} / {stats['total_records']}")
    print("\nArchetype Distribution:")
    for arch, val in stats["archetype_distribution"].items():
        print(f"  - {arch:<24}: {val}")
    print("=" * 60 + "\n")

    if args.dry_run:
        print("[Curriculum Mixer] Dry-run enabled. No output file written.")
    else:
        print(f"[Curriculum Mixer] Saving mixed curriculum to: {args.output_file}")
        save_jsonl(mixed, args.output_file)
        print(f"[Curriculum Mixer] Successfully saved {len(mixed)} records to {args.output_file.name}.")

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
`````

`````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
slm.py - Unified CLI for the React Agentic SLM Project
Provides a streamlined entry point for training, evaluation, generation, and dataset management.
"""

import argparse
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

SCRIPT_PATHS = {
    "train": BASE_DIR / "training" / "train_sft.py",
    "train-dpo": BASE_DIR / "training" / "train_dpo.py",
    "evaluate": BASE_DIR / "training" / "evaluate.py",
    "serve": BASE_DIR / "server" / "app.py",
    "agent": BASE_DIR / "agent" / "agent.py",
    "build_dataset": BASE_DIR / "data_pipeline" / "build_dataset.py",
    "curate_dataset": BASE_DIR / "data_pipeline" / "curate_dataset.py",
    "generate_trajectories": BASE_DIR / "data_pipeline" / "generate_trajectories.py",
    "star": BASE_DIR / "generate_star.py",
    "setup": BASE_DIR / "scripts" / "install.py",
    "doctor": BASE_DIR / "scripts" / "doctor.py",
    "download": BASE_DIR / "scripts" / "download_models.py",
}


def run_script(script_path: Path, args: list):
    if not script_path.exists():
        print(f"Error: {script_path} not found.")
        sys.exit(1)

    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script_path)] + args
    try:
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, cwd=BASE_DIR)
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        sys.exit(e.returncode)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Unified CLI for the React Agent SLM Pipeline",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawTextHelpFormatter
    )
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", help="Available commands")

    # 1. Pipeline (End-to-End One-Command: Merge -> Validate -> Train)
    parser_pipe = subparsers.add_parser(
        "pipeline",
        help="One-command end-to-end pipeline: merge -> validate -> train SFT"
    )
    parser_pipe.add_argument(
        "--data", default=str(BASE_DIR / "data" / "training_data.jsonl"),
        help="Target training data path"
    )
    parser_pipe.add_argument(
        "--skip-validate", action="store_true",
        help="Skip the live Vitest/TSC validation step"
    )

    # 2. Train SFT
    subparsers.add_parser("train", help="Fine-tune the model with QLoRA SFT")

    # 3. Train DPO
    subparsers.add_parser("train-dpo", help="Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) fine-tuning")

    # 4. Evaluate
    subparsers.add_parser("evaluate", help="Run the test suite on the model")

    # 5. Generate
    parser_generate = subparsers.add_parser("generate", help="Generate or mine trajectories")
    parser_generate.add_argument(
        "mode",
        choices=["site", "teacher", "star", "typescript-instruct", "curate-sources", "stack"],
        help="Generation mode (site trajectories, teacher LLM, STaR, typescript-instruct, curate-sources, or stack)"
    )

    # 6. Dataset
    parser_dataset = subparsers.add_parser("dataset", help="Dataset tools")
    parser_dataset.add_argument(
        "action",
        choices=["merge", "validate", "build-star", "build-expanded", "merge-trajectories"],
        help="Dataset action"
    )

    # 7. Serve (Web UI)
    subparsers.add_parser("serve", help="Run the Flask Web UI workbench on localhost:5000")

    # 8. Agent
    subparsers.add_parser("agent", help="Run the autonomous agent loop manually")

    # 9. Setup, health check and model download (work on any hardware)
    subparsers.add_parser("setup", help="Install everything for this machine (see scripts/install.py --help)")
    subparsers.add_parser("doctor", help="Check this machine can run the workbench and how to fix what can't")
    subparsers.add_parser("download", help="Download Qwen3-4B (and optionally a native adapter)")

    # If no args, print help
    if len(sys.argv) == 1:
        parser.print_help()
        sys.exit(1)

    args, unknown_args = parser.parse_known_args()

    if args.command == "pipeline":
        data_path = Path(args.data)
        print("=" * 70)
        print("   REACTAGENT SLM: FULL AUTOMATED TRAINING PIPELINE           ")
        print("=" * 70)

        # Step 1: Merge all trajectory sources into master training dataset
        print("\n[Step 1/3] Merging all trajectory datasets into:", data_path)
        run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["build_dataset"], ["merge", "--out", str(data_path)])

        # Step 2: Validate trajectories
        if not args.skip_validate:
            print("\n[Step 2/3] Validating trajectories with live tsc + Vitest...")
            run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["build_dataset"], ["validate", str(data_path), "--verify-only"])
        else:
            print("\n[Step 2/3] Skipping validation as requested.")

        # Step 3: Train model
        print("\n[Step 3/3] Launching QLoRA SFT training...")
        train_args = ["--data", str(data_path)] + unknown_args
        run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["train"], train_args)

    elif args.command == "train":
        run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["train"], unknown_args)

    elif args.command == "train-dpo":
        run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["train-dpo"], unknown_args)

    elif args.command == "evaluate":
        run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["evaluate"], unknown_args)

    elif args.command == "generate":
        if args.mode == "site":
            run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["generate_trajectories"], unknown_args)
        elif args.mode == "teacher":
            run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["curate_dataset"], ["teacher"] + unknown_args)
        elif args.mode == "star":
            run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["star"], unknown_args)
        elif args.mode == "typescript-instruct":
            run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["curate_dataset"], ["typescript-instruct"] + unknown_args)
        elif args.mode == "curate-sources":
            run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["curate_dataset"], ["curate-sources"] + unknown_args)
        elif args.mode == "stack":
            run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["curate_dataset"], ["stack"] + unknown_args)

    elif args.command == "dataset":
        action = "merge" if args.action == "merge-trajectories" else args.action
        run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["build_dataset"], [action] + unknown_args)

    elif args.command == "serve":
        run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["serve"], unknown_args)

    elif args.command == "agent":
        run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS["agent"], unknown_args)

    elif args.command in ("setup", "doctor", "download"):
        run_script(SCRIPT_PATHS[args.command], unknown_args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
`````

`````python
"""
agent/config.py - Single Source of Truth for Model Runtime Configuration

Provides ModelRuntimeConfig which centralizes context length and model runtime
parameters across:
- training (training/train_sft.py, training/preflight.py)
- inference (agent/agent.py, server/app.py)
- ContextBuilder (agent/context_builder.py)
- Inspector (server/app.py, frontend/src/state/agent-store.ts)
- benchmark script (scripts/benchmark_qwen3.py)
- generation max-token clamp (agent/agent.py)

Precedence order for max_seq_length:
1. Explicit runtime override: ModelRuntimeConfig.set_max_seq_length(...)
2. Environment variable: SLM_CONTEXT_LENGTH
3. Benchmark recommendation: runs/qwen3_context_benchmark.json
4. Default fallback: 8192
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Tuple

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DEFAULT_BENCHMARK_REPORT = BASE_DIR / "runs" / "qwen3_context_benchmark.json"


class _ModelRuntimeConfigMeta(type):
    """Metaclass allowing ModelRuntimeConfig.max_seq_length to be read and set directly."""

    @property
    def max_seq_length(cls) -> int:
        return cls.get_max_seq_length()

    @max_seq_length.setter
    def max_seq_length(cls, value: Optional[int]) -> None:
        cls.set_max_seq_length(value)


class ModelRuntimeConfig(metaclass=_ModelRuntimeConfigMeta):
    """Single source of truth for model runtime parameters."""

    _explicit_max_seq_length: Optional[int] = None
    _default_max_new_tokens: int = 4096
    _cpu_tokenizer: Any = None

    @classmethod
    def set_max_seq_length(cls, value: Optional[int]) -> None:
        """Explicitly override the active context length."""
        cls._explicit_max_seq_length = int(value) if value is not None else None

    @classmethod
    def reset(cls) -> None:
        """Reset any explicit overrides back to environment / benchmark resolution."""
        cls._explicit_max_seq_length = None

    @classmethod
    def register_tokenizer(cls, tokenizer: Any) -> None:
        """Register model tokenizer in agent_protocol."""
        from agent.agent_protocol import set_default_tokenizer
        set_default_tokenizer(tokenizer)

    @classmethod
    def get_tokenizer(cls) -> Any:
        """Retrieve the registered default tokenizer, if any."""
        from agent.agent_protocol import get_default_tokenizer
        return get_default_tokenizer()

    @classmethod
    def format_chatml(
        cls,
        messages: Any,
        add_generation_prompt: bool = True,
        tokenizer: Any = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Format messages using the Qwen3 native chat template when tokenizer is registered."""
        from agent.agent_protocol import format_chatml
        return format_chatml(messages, add_generation_prompt=add_generation_prompt, tokenizer=tokenizer)

    @classmethod
    def scrub_think_blocks(cls, text: str) -> str:
        """Strip accidental <think> blocks from model output."""
        from agent.agent_protocol import scrub_think_blocks
        return scrub_think_blocks(text)

    @classmethod
    def get_max_seq_length(cls) -> int:
        """
        Resolve the authoritative context length according to precedence:
        1. Explicit override
        2. SLM_CONTEXT_LENGTH env var
        3. Benchmark report recommendation
        4. Fallback 8192
        """
        # 1. Explicit override
        if cls._explicit_max_seq_length is not None:
            return cls._explicit_max_seq_length

        # 2. Environment variable SLM_CONTEXT_LENGTH
        env_val = os.environ.get("SLM_CONTEXT_LENGTH")
        if env_val:
            try:
                parsed = int(env_val)
                if 256 <= parsed <= 32768:
                    return parsed
            except ValueError:
                pass

        # 3. Benchmark report recommendation
        if DEFAULT_BENCHMARK_REPORT.exists():
            try:
                data = json.loads(DEFAULT_BENCHMARK_REPORT.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                selected = data.get("recommendation", {}).get("selected_context_length")
                if selected and isinstance(selected, int) and 256 <= selected <= 32768:
                    return selected
            except Exception:
                pass

        # 4. What fits this machine (agent/hardware.py); 8192 if detection fails.
        if os.environ.get("SLM_HARDWARE_CONTEXT", "1") != "0":
            try:
                from agent.hardware import get_profile
                return get_profile().context_length
            except Exception:
                pass
        return 8192

    @classmethod
    def get_default_max_new_tokens(cls) -> int:
        """Return the default max_new_tokens setting."""
        env_val = os.environ.get("SLM_MAX_NEW_TOKENS")
        if env_val:
            try:
                return int(env_val)
            except ValueError:
                pass
        return cls._default_max_new_tokens

    @classmethod
    def clamp_max_new_tokens(
        cls,
        prompt_tokens: int,
        requested_max_new_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> int:
        """
        Enforce: prompt_tokens + max_new_tokens <= max_seq_length.
        Raises ValueError if prompt_tokens >= max_seq_length.
        Clamps max_new_tokens to fit strictly within the context window.
        """
        max_seq = cls.get_max_seq_length()
        if prompt_tokens >= max_seq:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Prompt length ({prompt_tokens} tokens) exceeds or equals maximum sequence length ({max_seq} tokens)"
            )
        available = max_seq - prompt_tokens
        requested = requested_max_new_tokens if requested_max_new_tokens is not None else cls.get_default_max_new_tokens()
        return max(1, min(requested, available))

    @classmethod
    def estimate_output_budget(
        cls,
        factors: Any,
        prompt_tokens: int = 0,
    ) -> Any:
        """Estimate dynamic output token budget using task complexity signals."""
        from agent.output_budget import estimate_output_budget
        return estimate_output_budget(
            factors=factors,
            prompt_tokens=prompt_tokens,
            max_seq_length=cls.get_max_seq_length(),
        )

    @classmethod
    def get_dynamic_max_new_tokens(
        cls,
        factors: Any,
        prompt_tokens: int = 0,
    ) -> int:
        """Compute the recommended clamped max_new_tokens for a task."""
        budget = cls.estimate_output_budget(factors=factors, prompt_tokens=prompt_tokens)
        return budget.clamped_tokens


    @classmethod
    def count_tokens(cls, text: str) -> int:
        """
        Accurately count tokens using the real Qwen3 / model tokenizer
        (HuggingFace PreTrainedTokenizer or fast CPU tokenizer.json).
        Falls back to character/word heuristics only if no tokenizer is present.
        """
        if not text:
            return 0

        # 1. Check registered default tokenizer in agent_protocol
        try:
            from agent.agent_protocol import _DEFAULT_TOKENIZER
            if _DEFAULT_TOKENIZER is not None:
                if hasattr(_DEFAULT_TOKENIZER, "encode"):
                    return len(_DEFAULT_TOKENIZER.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False))
                elif callable(_DEFAULT_TOKENIZER):
                    return len(_DEFAULT_TOKENIZER(text, add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"])
        except Exception:
            pass

        # 2. Check fast CPU Tokenizer from base-model/tokenizer.json
        tok_file = BASE_DIR / "base-model" / "tokenizer.json"
        if tok_file.exists():
            try:
                if cls._cpu_tokenizer is None:
                    from tokenizers import Tokenizer
                    cls._cpu_tokenizer = Tokenizer.from_file(str(tok_file))
                    cls._cpu_tokenizer.no_truncation()
                    cls._cpu_tokenizer.no_padding()
                return len(cls._cpu_tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False).ids)
            except Exception:
                pass

        # 3. Fallback heuristic estimation
        from agent.context_builder import estimate_tokens
        return estimate_tokens(text)

    @classmethod
    def get_token_budget(cls, total: Optional[int] = None) -> Any:
        """Create a proportional TokenBudget matching the active max_seq_length."""
        from agent.context_builder import TokenBudget
        target_total = total if total is not None else cls.get_max_seq_length()
        scale = target_total / 8192.0
        sys_contracts = int(round(1000 * scale))
        cur_instruction = int(round(300 * scale))
        proj_metadata = int(round(300 * scale))
        sel_files = int(round(3000 * scale))
        rel_files = int(round(1600 * scale))
        recent_conv = int(round(900 * scale))
        build_diag = int(round(700 * scale))
        reserve = target_total - (
            sys_contracts + cur_instruction + proj_metadata + sel_files + rel_files + recent_conv + build_diag
        )
        return TokenBudget(
            total=target_total,
            system_contracts=sys_contracts,
            current_instruction=cur_instruction,
            project_metadata=proj_metadata,
            selected_files=sel_files,
            related_files=rel_files,
            recent_conversation=recent_conv,
            build_diagnostics=build_diag,
            reserve=reserve,
        )
`````

`````python
"""
agent/base_model_fingerprint.py - Authoritative Base Model Architecture & Fingerprint Verifier

Guarantees authentic model identity before training, startup, or promotion:
- Architecture class (Qwen3ForCausalLM vs relabeled Qwen2ForCausalLM)
- model_type ('qwen3' vs relabeled 'qwen2')
- Hidden size, intermediate size, attention heads, KV heads, layer count
- Tensor shapes in model shards (reading safetensors file headers directly)
- Tokenizer / config compatibility (vocabulary size and special tokens)
- Model repository revision / commit hash and cryptographic SHA-256 file checksums
- Immutable model fingerprint stored in manifest.json
"""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple


class IncompatibleBaseModelError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when base model architecture does not match authentic Qwen3 identity."""
    pass


def verify_lora_adapter_compatibility(adapter_dir: Path, base_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Check LoRA tensor dimensions against the local base before loading weights.

    Adapter metadata can retain a plausible base path after weights have been
    copied from a different model, so config names alone are insufficient.
    This inspects safetensors metadata without allocating the tensors.

    If the adapter directory contains a promotion_manifest.json, the stricter
    verify_adapter_promotion_manifest() check is also applied (P1-05).
    """
    from safetensors import safe_open

    adapter_dir = Path(adapter_dir).resolve()
    base_dir = Path(base_dir).resolve()
    adapter_cfg = json.loads((adapter_dir / "adapter_config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    raw_base = str(adapter_cfg.get("base_model_name_or_path", ""))
    claimed_base = Path(raw_base).resolve()
    # Portable references to the same base are accepted (the tensor shapes below are
    # the real check): this repo's base-model folder on any machine, or the hub id the
    # base was downloaded from. Any other model name or path is refused.
    portable = (Path(raw_base.replace("\\", "/")).name == base_dir.name == "base-model"
                or re.fullmatch(r"(?:qwen|unsloth)/qwen3-4b(?:-instruct-2507)?", raw_base.strip().lower()) is not None)
    if claimed_base != base_dir and not portable:
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(f"Adapter base {claimed_base} differs from {base_dir}")
    cfg = json.loads((base_dir / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if cfg.get("model_type") != "qwen3" or "Qwen3ForCausalLM" not in cfg.get("architectures", []):
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError("Adapter target is not the verified Qwen3 base")
    hidden = int(cfg["hidden_size"])
    intermediate = int(cfg["intermediate_size"])
    attention = int(cfg["num_attention_heads"]) * int(cfg["head_dim"])
    kv = int(cfg["num_key_value_heads"]) * int(cfg["head_dim"])
    modules = {
        "q_proj": (hidden, attention), "k_proj": (hidden, kv),
        "v_proj": (hidden, kv), "o_proj": (attention, hidden),
        "gate_proj": (hidden, intermediate), "up_proj": (hidden, intermediate),
        "down_proj": (intermediate, hidden),
    }
    weights = adapter_dir / "adapter_model.safetensors"
    if not weights.is_file():
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(f"Adapter weights missing: {weights}")
    checked = 0
    with safe_open(str(weights), framework="pt", device="cpu") as tensors:
        for key in tensors.keys():
            match = re.search(r"\.(q_proj|k_proj|v_proj|o_proj|gate_proj|up_proj|down_proj)\.lora_([AB])(?:\.default)?\.weight$", key)
            if not match:
                continue
            module, side = match.groups()
            in_features, out_features = modules[module]
            shape = tensors.get_slice(key).get_shape()
            expected_feature = in_features if side == "A" else out_features
            feature = (shape[1] if side == "A" else shape[0]) if len(shape) == 2 else None
            if feature != expected_feature:
                raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(
                    f"Adapter tensor {key} has shape {shape}; Qwen3 expects {expected_feature} {side}-side features"
                )
            checked += 1
    if checked == 0:
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError("Adapter contains no recognized LoRA projection tensors")

    # P1-05: If a promotion manifest exists, perform the stricter identity check.
    promo_manifest_path = adapter_dir / "promotion_manifest.json"
    if promo_manifest_path.is_file():
        verify_adapter_promotion_manifest(adapter_dir, base_dir, strict=True)


# ── P1-05: Adapter Promotion Manifest ────────────────────────────────────────

# Authoritative Qwen3-4B dimensional identity for this project.
# These values must never be changed without a controlled migration.
QWEN3_4B_IDENTITY = {
    "base_model": "Qwen/Qwen3-4B",
    "hidden_size": 2560,
    "intermediate_size": 9728,
    "num_hidden_layers": 36,
    "num_attention_heads": 32,
    "num_key_value_heads": 8,
}

EXPECTED_QWEN3_4B = {
    "architectures": ["Qwen3ForCausalLM"],
    "model_type": "qwen3",
    "head_dim": 128,
    "vocab_size": 151936,
    "hidden_size": 2560,
    "intermediate_size": 9728,
    "num_hidden_layers": 36,
    "num_attention_heads": 32,
    "num_key_value_heads": 8,
}


def assert_qwen3_4b(config: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """Fail closed unless the config is the exact supported Qwen3-4B shape."""
    problems = []
    for key, expected in EXPECTED_QWEN3_4B.items():
        actual = config.get(key)
        if actual != expected:
            problems.append(f"{key}: expected {expected!r}, got {actual!r}")
    if problems:
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError("Wrong foundation architecture:\n" + "\n".join(problems))


def generate_adapter_promotion_manifest(
    adapter_dir: Path,
    base_dir: Path,
    lora_rank: int,
    target_modules: List[str],
    base_revision: str = "unknown",
    *, strict: bool = False,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Write promotion_manifest.json into *adapter_dir*.

    The manifest records the immutable identity of the exact base-model build
    this adapter was trained against (P1-05 remediation).  At promotion time,
    verify_adapter_promotion_manifest() compares the live base-model files
    against these hashes and rejects any adapter whose provenance does not
    match exactly.

    Fields recorded
    ---------------
    base_model          : HuggingFace model ID
    base_revision       : git commit / revision (if known)
    config_sha256       : SHA-256 of base-model/config.json
    tokenizer_sha256    : SHA-256 of base-model/tokenizer.json
    tokenizer_cfg_sha256: SHA-256 of base-model/tokenizer_config.json
    chat_template_sha256: SHA-256 of the chat_template string in tokenizer_config
    hidden_size, intermediate_size, num_hidden_layers,
    num_attention_heads, num_key_value_heads  : exact dimensions from config
    lora_rank           : LoRA rank used during training
    target_modules      : list of projection names trained
    """
    adapter_dir = Path(adapter_dir).resolve()
    base_dir = Path(base_dir).resolve()

    cfg_path = base_dir / "config.json"
    tok_path = base_dir / "tokenizer.json"
    tok_cfg_path = base_dir / "tokenizer_config.json"

    cfg = json.loads(cfg_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert_qwen3_4b(cfg)

    # Derive chat_template SHA from tokenizer_config if present
    chat_template_sha = ""
    if tok_cfg_path.is_file():
        try:
            tc = json.loads(tok_cfg_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            tmpl = tc.get("chat_template", "")
            if tmpl:
                chat_template_sha = hashlib.sha256(tmpl.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        except Exception:
            pass

    manifest: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "base_model": cfg.get("_name_or_path", QWEN3_4B_IDENTITY["base_model"]),
        "base_revision": base_revision,
        "config_sha256": compute_sha256(cfg_path) if cfg_path.is_file() else "",
        "tokenizer_sha256": compute_sha256(tok_path) if tok_path.is_file() else "",
        "tokenizer_cfg_sha256": compute_sha256(tok_cfg_path) if tok_cfg_path.is_file() else "",
        "chat_template_sha256": chat_template_sha,
        # Exact architectural dimensions
        "hidden_size": int(cfg.get("hidden_size", 0)),
        "intermediate_size": int(cfg.get("intermediate_size", 0)),
        "num_hidden_layers": int(cfg.get("num_hidden_layers", 0)),
        "num_attention_heads": int(cfg.get("num_attention_heads", 0)),
        "num_key_value_heads": int(cfg.get("num_key_value_heads", 0)),
        # LoRA metadata
        "lora_rank": lora_rank,
        "target_modules": sorted(target_modules),
        "generated_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
    }

    if strict:
        adapter_cfg = _verify_complete_adapter(adapter_dir, base_dir)
        if adapter_cfg['r'] != lora_rank or sorted(adapter_cfg['target_modules']) != sorted(target_modules):
            raise IncompatibleBaseModelError('Requested rank/modules differ from saved adapter config')
        for path in (tok_path, tok_cfg_path):
            if not path.is_file():
                raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(f'Required promotion evidence missing: {path}')
        if not chat_template_sha:
            raise IncompatibleBaseModelError('Required chat template evidence missing')
        shards = sorted(base_dir.glob('*.safetensors'))
        if not shards:
            raise IncompatibleBaseModelError('Required base shard evidence missing')
        manifest.update(
            schema_version=2,
            lora_alpha=adapter_cfg['lora_alpha'],
            adapter_config_sha256=compute_sha256(adapter_dir / 'adapter_config.json'),
            adapter_sha256=compute_sha256(adapter_dir / 'adapter_model.safetensors'),
            base_shard_sha256={path.name: compute_sha256(path) for path in shards},
        )

    dest = adapter_dir / "promotion_manifest.json"
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return manifest


def verify_adapter_promotion_manifest(adapter_dir: Path, base_dir: Path, *, strict: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Verify that the adapter's promotion_manifest.json matches the live base model.

    Fails closed (raises IncompatibleBaseModelError) on any of:
      - promotion_manifest.json absent from adapter_dir
      - Any dimensional field (hidden_size, intermediate_size, layers, heads, kv_heads)
        does not match the live config.json
      - config_sha256, tokenizer_sha256, or chat_template_sha256 does not match the
        corresponding live file in base_dir

    Returns the loaded manifest on success.
    """
    adapter_dir = Path(adapter_dir).resolve()
    base_dir = Path(base_dir).resolve()

    promo_path = adapter_dir / "promotion_manifest.json"
    if not promo_path.is_file():
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(
            f"promotion_manifest.json absent from {adapter_dir}. "
            "Adapter was not generated by the canonical training pipeline and cannot be promoted."
        )

    manifest = json.loads(promo_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    cfg_path = base_dir / "config.json"
    tok_path = base_dir / "tokenizer.json"
    tok_cfg_path = base_dir / "tokenizer_config.json"

    if not cfg_path.is_file():
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(f"Base model config.json not found at {base_dir}")
    cfg = json.loads(cfg_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert_qwen3_4b(cfg)

    errors: List[str] = []

    # 1. Dimensional identity checks
    dim_fields = [
        ("hidden_size", "hidden_size"),
        ("intermediate_size", "intermediate_size"),
        ("num_hidden_layers", "num_hidden_layers"),
        ("num_attention_heads", "num_attention_heads"),
        ("num_key_value_heads", "num_key_value_heads"),
    ]
    for manifest_key, cfg_key in dim_fields:
        expected = manifest.get(manifest_key)
        actual = cfg.get(cfg_key)
        if expected is None or actual is None:
            errors.append(f"Missing dimension '{manifest_key}' in manifest or config")
        elif int(expected) != int(actual):
            errors.append(
                f"Dimension mismatch '{manifest_key}': manifest={expected}, live config={actual}. "
                "This adapter was trained against a different base model."
            )

    # 2. Cryptographic file identity checks
    crypto_checks = [
        ("config_sha256", cfg_path),
        ("tokenizer_sha256", tok_path),
        ("tokenizer_cfg_sha256", tok_cfg_path),
    ]
    if strict:
        if manifest.get('schema_version') != 2:
            errors.append('Strict promotion requires schema_version 2 and complete adapter/shard evidence')
        crypto_checks.extend([
            ('adapter_config_sha256', adapter_dir / 'adapter_config.json'),
            ('adapter_sha256', adapter_dir / 'adapter_model.safetensors'),
        ])
        shard_hashes = manifest.get('base_shard_sha256')
        live_shards = {path.name: path for path in base_dir.glob('*.safetensors')}
        if not isinstance(shard_hashes, dict) or not shard_hashes or set(shard_hashes) != set(live_shards):
            errors.append('Missing or mismatched base shard SHA evidence')
        else:
            for name, path in live_shards.items():
                if not _valid_sha(shard_hashes[name]) or compute_sha256(path) != shard_hashes[name]:
                    errors.append(f'Hash mismatch for base shard {name}')
        try:
            adapter_cfg = _verify_complete_adapter(adapter_dir, base_dir)
            for field, key in [('lora_rank', 'r'), ('lora_alpha', 'lora_alpha')]:
                if manifest.get(field) != adapter_cfg[key]:
                    errors.append(f'Adapter {field} differs from promotion manifest')
            if sorted(manifest.get('target_modules') or []) != sorted(adapter_cfg['target_modules']):
                errors.append('Adapter target_modules differ from promotion manifest')
        except (IncompatibleBaseModelError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
            errors.append(str(exc))
    for field, path in crypto_checks:
        expected_hash = manifest.get(field, "")
        if strict and not _valid_sha(expected_hash):
            errors.append(f'Missing or invalid SHA-256 evidence: {field}')
            continue
        if not expected_hash:
            # Manifest predates this field; skip gracefully
            continue
        if not path.is_file():
            errors.append(f"Base file missing: {path} (needed to verify {field})")
            continue
        actual_hash = compute_sha256(path)
        if actual_hash != expected_hash:
            errors.append(
                f"Hash mismatch for {path.name}: manifest={expected_hash[:12]}…, "
                f"live={actual_hash[:12]}…. "
                "The base model files have changed since this adapter was trained."
            )

    # 3. Chat-template hash (derived from tokenizer_config.json content)
    expected_tmpl_sha = manifest.get("chat_template_sha256", "")
    if strict and not _valid_sha(expected_tmpl_sha):
        errors.append('Missing or invalid SHA-256 evidence: chat_template_sha256')
    if expected_tmpl_sha and tok_cfg_path.is_file():
        try:
            tc = json.loads(tok_cfg_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            live_tmpl = tc.get("chat_template", "")
            live_tmpl_sha = hashlib.sha256(live_tmpl.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() if live_tmpl else ""
            if live_tmpl_sha != expected_tmpl_sha:
                errors.append(
                    f"Chat-template hash mismatch: manifest={expected_tmpl_sha[:12]}…, "
                    f"live={live_tmpl_sha[:12]}…. "
                    "The tokenizer chat template has changed. Protocol corruption is possible."
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"Could not verify chat_template_sha256: {exc}")

    if errors:
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(
            f"Adapter promotion manifest verification FAILED for {adapter_dir}:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  ✗ {e}" for e in errors)
            + "\nThis adapter cannot be promoted to the served position."
        )

    return manifest


def _valid_sha(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', value) is not None


def _verify_complete_adapter(adapter_dir: Path, base_dir: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Validate every layer/module A/B pair, not just whichever tensors exist."""
    from safetensors import safe_open
    cfg = json.loads((base_dir / 'config.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert_qwen3_4b(cfg)
    acfg = json.loads((adapter_dir / 'adapter_config.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    if Path(acfg.get('base_model_name_or_path', '')).resolve() != base_dir.resolve():
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError('Adapter base path differs from verified base')
    rank, alpha = acfg.get('r'), acfg.get('lora_alpha')
    if type(rank) is not int or rank <= 0 or not isinstance(alpha, (int, float)) or not 0 < alpha < float('inf'):
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError('Invalid adapter rank/alpha')
    if acfg.get('peft_type') != 'LORA' or acfg.get('bias', 'none') != 'none':
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError('Only bias-free LORA adapters are supported')
    for field in ('rank_pattern', 'alpha_pattern', 'layers_to_transform', 'layers_pattern', 'modules_to_save', 'use_dora', 'use_rslora'):
        if acfg.get(field):
            raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(f'Unsupported adapter configuration: {field}')
    dimensions = {'q_proj': (2560, 4096), 'k_proj': (2560, 1024), 'v_proj': (2560, 1024),
                  'o_proj': (4096, 2560), 'gate_proj': (2560, 9728),
                  'up_proj': (2560, 9728), 'down_proj': (9728, 2560)}
    modules = acfg.get('target_modules')
    if not isinstance(modules, list) or not modules or any(not isinstance(m, str) for m in modules) or len(set(modules)) != len(modules) or not set(modules) <= dimensions.keys():
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError('Invalid adapter target_modules')
    expected = {(layer, module, side) for layer in range(cfg['num_hidden_layers']) for module in modules for side in ('A', 'B')}
    seen = set()
    with safe_open(str(adapter_dir / 'adapter_model.safetensors'), framework='pt', device='cpu') as tensors:
        for key in tensors.keys():
            match = re.fullmatch(r'base_model\.model\.model\.layers\.(\d+)\.(self_attn|mlp)\.([a-z_]+)\.lora_([AB])(?:\.default)?\.weight', key)
            if not match:
                raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(f'Unexpected adapter tensor: {key}')
            layer, block, module, side = match.groups()
            identity = (int(layer), module, side)
            if identity not in expected or identity in seen or block != ('self_attn' if module in ('q_proj', 'k_proj', 'v_proj', 'o_proj') else 'mlp'):
                raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(f'Unexpected or duplicate adapter pair: {key}')
            inputs, outputs = dimensions[module]
            shape = list(tensors.get_slice(key).get_shape())
            if shape != ([rank, inputs] if side == 'A' else [outputs, rank]):
                raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(f'Adapter rank/feature shape mismatch: {key}: {shape}')
            seen.add(identity)
    if seen != expected:
        raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(f'Incomplete adapter A/B pairs: missing {len(expected - seen)} tensors')
    return acfg


def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    """Computes SHA-256 checksum of a file in 64 KiB chunks."""
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def inspect_shard_tensor_shapes(base_dir: Path) -> Dict[str, List[int]]:
    """
    Directly inspects tensor shapes in base model safetensors shards without
    loading full weight tensors into memory.
    """
    tensor_shapes: Dict[str, List[int]] = {}
    safetensors_files = sorted(base_dir.glob("*.safetensors"))
    if not safetensors_files:
        return tensor_shapes

    try:
        from safetensors import safe_open
        for sf in safetensors_files:
            with safe_open(sf, framework="pt") as f:
                for key in f.keys():
                    # Retain key structural anchor tensors
                    if any(anchor in key for anchor in [
                        "embed_tokens",
                        "layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight",
                        "layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.bias",
                        "layers.0.self_attn.k_proj.weight",
                        "layers.0.self_attn.k_proj.bias",
                        "layers.0.self_attn.v_proj.weight",
                        "layers.0.self_attn.v_proj.bias",
                        "layers.0.self_attn.o_proj.weight",
                        "layers.0.self_attn.q_norm.weight",
                        "layers.0.self_attn.k_norm.weight",
                        "layers.0.mlp.gate_proj.weight",
                        "layers.0.mlp.up_proj.weight",
                        "layers.0.mlp.down_proj.weight",
                        "layers.0.input_layernorm.weight",
                        "lm_head.weight",
                    ]):
                        tensor_shapes[key] = list(f.get_slice(key).get_shape())
    except Exception as exc:
        tensor_shapes["_error"] = [str(exc)]

    return tensor_shapes


def qwen3_tensor_shape_errors(config: Dict[str, Any], shapes: Dict[str, List[int]]) -> List[str]:
    """Detect a relabeled checkpoint using the actual layer-zero tensor shapes."""
    try:
        hidden = int(config["hidden_size"])
        intermediate = int(config["intermediate_size"])
        head_dim = int(config["head_dim"])
        attention = int(config["num_attention_heads"]) * head_dim
        kv = int(config["num_key_value_heads"]) * head_dim
        vocab = int(config["vocab_size"])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        return [f"Incomplete Qwen3 shape config: {exc}"]
    expected = {
        "model.embed_tokens.weight": [vocab, hidden],
        "model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight": [attention, hidden],
        "model.layers.0.self_attn.k_proj.weight": [kv, hidden],
        "model.layers.0.self_attn.v_proj.weight": [kv, hidden],
        "model.layers.0.self_attn.o_proj.weight": [hidden, attention],
        "model.layers.0.self_attn.q_norm.weight": [head_dim],
        "model.layers.0.self_attn.k_norm.weight": [head_dim],
        "model.layers.0.mlp.gate_proj.weight": [intermediate, hidden],
        "model.layers.0.mlp.up_proj.weight": [intermediate, hidden],
        "model.layers.0.mlp.down_proj.weight": [hidden, intermediate],
        "model.layers.0.input_layernorm.weight": [hidden],
    }
    errors = [
        f"{name}: expected {shape}, found {shapes.get(name)}"
        for name, shape in expected.items() if shapes.get(name) != shape
    ]
    for name in ("q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj"):
        bias = f"model.layers.0.self_attn.{name}.bias"
        if bias in shapes:
            errors.append(f"Unexpected Qwen2-style attention bias: {bias}")
    if "_error" in shapes:
        errors.append(f"Could not inspect model tensors: {shapes['_error']}")
    return errors


def compute_base_model_fingerprint(base_dir: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Computes a comprehensive, deterministic fingerprint of the base model
    spanning configuration, architecture, tokenizer, and shard shapes.
    """
    base_dir = Path(base_dir).resolve()
    config_path = base_dir / "config.json"
    if not config_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"config.json missing in base model directory: {base_dir}")

    config = json.loads(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    
    # 1. Architecture class and model_type
    architectures = config.get("architectures", [])
    architecture_class = architectures[0] if architectures else "Unknown"
    model_type = config.get("model_type", "")
    model_name = config.get("_name_or_path", "")

    # 2. Key dimensional hyperparameters
    hidden_size = config.get("hidden_size")
    intermediate_size = config.get("intermediate_size")
    num_attention_heads = config.get("num_attention_heads")
    num_key_value_heads = config.get("num_key_value_heads")
    num_hidden_layers = config.get("num_hidden_layers")
    vocab_size = config.get("vocab_size")

    # 3. Inspect shard tensor shapes
    tensor_shapes = inspect_shard_tensor_shapes(base_dir)
    tensor_shape_errors = qwen3_tensor_shape_errors(config, tensor_shapes)

    # 4. Tokenizer compatibility
    tok_json = base_dir / "tokenizer.json"
    tok_cfg = base_dir / "tokenizer_config.json"
    tokenizer_vocab_size = None
    tokenizer_type = None
    if tok_json.is_file():
        try:
            tok_data = json.loads(tok_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            tokenizer_vocab_size = len(tok_data.get("model", {}).get("vocab", {}))
            tokenizer_type = tok_data.get("model", {}).get("type")
        except Exception:
            pass

    # 5. File checksums
    core_files = [
        "config.json",
        "tokenizer.json",
        "tokenizer_config.json",
        "vocab.json",
        "merges.txt",
        "generation_config.json",
    ]
    st_files = sorted(p.name for p in base_dir.glob("*.safetensors"))
    if not st_files:
        st_files = ["model-00001-of-00002.safetensors", "model-00002-of-00002.safetensors"]
    required_files = core_files + st_files
    if (base_dir / "model.safetensors.index.json").is_file():
        required_files.append("model.safetensors.index.json")

    files_manifest: Dict[str, Any] = {}
    total_bytes = 0
    file_hashes_concat = []

    for rf in set(required_files):
        fpath = base_dir / rf
        if fpath.is_file():
            fsize = fpath.stat().st_size
            total_bytes += fsize
            sha = compute_sha256(fpath)
            files_manifest[rf] = {"size_bytes": fsize, "sha256": sha}
            file_hashes_concat.append(f"{rf}:{sha}")

    # Check for git revision / hash
    git_head_path = base_dir / ".git" / "HEAD"
    repo_revision = "unknown"
    if git_head_path.is_file():
        try:
            repo_revision = git_head_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Determine authenticity
    is_qwen3_arch = (
        architecture_class == "Qwen3ForCausalLM"
        and model_type == "qwen3"
    )
    is_relabeled_qwen2 = (
        "qwen2" in model_type.lower()
        or "Qwen2" in architecture_class
    )

    # Cryptographic immutable fingerprint
    fp_raw = f"{architecture_class}|{model_type}|{hidden_size}|{intermediate_size}|{num_attention_heads}|{num_key_value_heads}|{num_hidden_layers}|{vocab_size}|{'|'.join(sorted(file_hashes_concat))}"
    immutable_fingerprint_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(fp_raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    return {
        "model_name": model_name,
        "architecture_class": architecture_class,
        "model_type": model_type,
        "hidden_size": hidden_size,
        "intermediate_size": intermediate_size,
        "num_attention_heads": num_attention_heads,
        "num_key_value_heads": num_key_value_heads,
        "num_hidden_layers": num_hidden_layers,
        "vocab_size": vocab_size,
        "tokenizer_vocab_size": tokenizer_vocab_size,
        "tokenizer_type": tokenizer_type,
        "tokenizer_compatible": (tokenizer_vocab_size is None or vocab_size is None or vocab_size >= tokenizer_vocab_size),
        "tensor_shapes": tensor_shapes,
        "tensor_shape_errors": tensor_shape_errors,
        "total_size_gib": round(total_bytes / (1024**3), 3),
        "files": files_manifest,
        "repo_revision": repo_revision,
        "is_authentic_qwen3": is_qwen3_arch and not is_relabeled_qwen2 and not tensor_shape_errors,
        "is_relabeled_qwen2": is_relabeled_qwen2,
        "immutable_fingerprint_sha256": immutable_fingerprint_sha256,
        "verified_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    }


def verify_base_model_architecture(
    base_dir: Path,
    strict: bool = True,
    expected_arch: str = "Qwen3ForCausalLM",
    expected_model_type: str = "qwen3",
    require_4b: bool = False,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Verifies that the base model matches the expected authentic Qwen3 architecture.
    Fails closed: raises IncompatibleBaseModelError if relabeled older architecture is detected.
    """
    fingerprint = compute_base_model_fingerprint(base_dir)
    errors: List[str] = []
    if require_4b:
        # Production load gates request exact identity; the generic verifier also
        # supports deliberately tiny Qwen3 fixtures and diagnostic legacy reads.
        assert_qwen3_4b(json.loads((Path(base_dir) / 'config.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')))

    # 1. Architecture class check
    if fingerprint["architecture_class"] != expected_arch:
        errors.append(
            f"Architecture class mismatch: declared '{fingerprint['architecture_class']}', expected '{expected_arch}'."
        )

    # 2. model_type check
    if fingerprint["model_type"] != expected_model_type:
        errors.append(
            f"model_type mismatch: declared '{fingerprint['model_type']}', expected '{expected_model_type}'."
        )

    # 3. Detect relabeled Qwen2 disguised as Qwen3
    if fingerprint["is_relabeled_qwen2"]:
        errors.append(
            "Relabeled Qwen2 architecture detected: Model uses Qwen2ForCausalLM / model_type='qwen2'. "
            "Relabeling _name_or_path as 'Qwen3' does not confer authentic Qwen3 identity."
        )
    if fingerprint["tensor_shape_errors"]:
        errors.extend(fingerprint["tensor_shape_errors"])

    # 4. Tokenizer / config compatibility
    if not fingerprint["tokenizer_compatible"]:
        errors.append(
            f"Tokenizer incompatible with config: config vocab ({fingerprint['vocab_size']}) < tokenizer vocab ({fingerprint['tokenizer_vocab_size']})."
        )

    # 5. Shard files presence
    safetensors_present = any(f.endswith(".safetensors") for f in fingerprint["files"])
    if not safetensors_present:
        errors.append("Model weight shards (*.safetensors) missing from files manifest.")

    if errors:
        msg = (
            f"Base model architecture verification FAILED for {base_dir}:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {err}" for err in errors)
            + "\nStartup and training are rejected until authentic Qwen3-4B weights/config are installed."
        )
        allow_legacy = os.environ.get("ALLOW_LEGACY_BASE_MODEL", "").lower() in ("1", "true", "yes")
        if strict and (require_4b or not allow_legacy):
            raise IncompatibleBaseModelError(msg)
        else:
            fingerprint["verification_warnings"] = errors

    return fingerprint


def generate_and_save_manifest(base_dir: Path, manifest_path: Optional[Path] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Computes fingerprint and writes the immutable model fingerprint to manifest.json.
    """
    base_dir = Path(base_dir).resolve()
    manifest = compute_base_model_fingerprint(base_dir)
    dest = manifest_path or (base_dir / "manifest.json")
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return manifest


def get_model_fingerprint_info(model_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Extracts loaded model, base fingerprint, and adapter fingerprint for runtime telemetry and /api/status.
    """
    p = Path(model_path).resolve()
    info: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "model_name": p.name,
        "model_path": str(p),
        "base_model": "base-model",
        "base_fingerprint": None,
        "adapter_fingerprint": None,
        "is_qwen3_architecture": False,
        "is_mock": False,
    }

    # If adapter directory
    adapter_config = p / "adapter_config.json"
    if adapter_config.is_file():
        try:
            acfg = json.loads(adapter_config.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            info["base_model"] = acfg.get("base_model_name_or_path", "base-model")
        except Exception:
            pass

    adapter_weights = p / "adapter_model.safetensors"
    if adapter_weights.is_file():
        info["adapter_fingerprint"] = compute_sha256(adapter_weights)
    elif (p / "training_manifest.json").is_file():
        try:
            tm = json.loads((p / "training_manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            info["adapter_fingerprint"] = tm.get("adapter_sha256") or tm.get("sha256")
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Inspect base model
    base_dir = Path(info["base_model"])
    if not base_dir.is_absolute():
        base_dir = (p.parent / base_dir).resolve()
        if not base_dir.exists():
            base_dir = (Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "base-model").resolve()

    manifest_path = base_dir / "manifest.json"
    if manifest_path.is_file():
        try:
            m = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if "tensor_shape_errors" not in m:
                m = compute_base_model_fingerprint(base_dir)
            info["base_fingerprint"] = m.get("immutable_fingerprint_sha256") or m.get("sha256")
            info["is_qwen3_architecture"] = m.get("is_authentic_qwen3", False)
        except Exception:
            pass
    elif (base_dir / "config.json").is_file():
        try:
            fp = compute_base_model_fingerprint(base_dir)
            info["base_fingerprint"] = fp.get("immutable_fingerprint_sha256")
            info["is_qwen3_architecture"] = fp.get("is_authentic_qwen3", False)
        except Exception:
            pass

    return info
`````

`````python
"""
agent/output_budget.py - Dynamic Output Token Budget Engine

Implements the authoritative policy for dynamic output token budgeting:
  small targeted patch          512–768    (tiny edits, single diagnostic repairs)
  normal component              1024–1536  (standard single components)
  complex interaction           1536–2048  (dnd, keyboard nav, forms, timers, undo/redo, data tables)
  simple site section           1600–2200  (basic multi-file sections: header, footer, about)
  interactive site section      2400–3200  (sliders, calculators, tabs, accordions, live-values)
  complex site section          2800–3600  (interactive + 3+ files or diagnostic complexity)
  3D site section               3000–4096  (Three.js, R3F, canvas, WebGL, shaders, animations)

Complexity is estimated using:
- task mode (component, site, patch, edit, 3d)
- requested files (single file vs multi-file section)
- current file length (short vs large existing code)
- interaction keywords (dnd, keyboard, cart, undo, table, etc.)
- site-specific interactive keywords (calculator, slider, chart, live, delta-v, etc.)
- 3D usage (three, r3f, canvas, shader, etc.)
- repair diagnostics (single localized fix vs complex assertion failures)

All budgets are clamped against the active context length (max_seq_length - prompt_tokens).

@dataclasses.dataclass
class TaskComplexityFactors:

@dataclasses.dataclass
class OutputTokenBudget:
    """Result of dynamic output token budget calculation."""
    tier: str
    min_tokens: int
    max_tokens: int
    recommended_tokens: int
    clamped_tokens: int
    factors: Dict[str, Any]

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {

            "min_tokens": self.min_tokens,
            "max_tokens": self.max_tokens,
            "recommended_tokens": self.recommended_tokens,

            "explanation": self.explanation,
            "factors": self.factors,
`````
