# 5. XML Serialization for Agent Prompting
# ==============================================================================

def brief_to_xml(brief: dict) -> str:
    """Formats a structured brief into XML tags consumed by the site agent."""
    lines = ["<content_brief>"]
    lines.append("  <content_integrity>Use illustrative demo data only when labeled illustrative demo data; do not invent business facts, prices, testimonials, or contact details.</content_integrity>")
    if brief.get("style_preset"):
        lines.append(f"  <style_preset>{brief['style_preset']}</style_preset>")
    lines.append(f"  <business_name>{brief.get('business_name', 'My Business')}</business_name>")
    lines.append(f"  <business_type>{brief.get('business_type', 'general')}</business_type>")
    lines.append(f"  <tagline>{brief.get('tagline', '')}</tagline>")
    layout_id = str(brief.get("layout_archetype", "editorial"))
    layout_guideline = _LAYOUT_ARCHETYPE_GUIDELINES.get(layout_id, "")
    lines.append(f'  <layout_archetype id="{html.escape(layout_id, quote=True)}">')
    lines.append(f"    <guidelines>{html.escape(layout_guideline)}</guidelines>")
    lines.append("  </layout_archetype>")
    images = brief.get("images") or {}
    if images.get("hero"):
        hero_photo = images["hero"]
        lines.append(f"  <hero_image url={json.dumps(hero_photo['url'])} alt={json.dumps(hero_photo['alt'])} credit={json.dumps(hero_photo['credit'])} />")
    if images.get("items"):
        lines.append("  <section_images>")
        for photo in images["items"]:
            lines.append(f"    <image url={json.dumps(photo['url'])} alt={json.dumps(photo['alt'])} credit={json.dumps(photo['credit'])} />")
        lines.append("  </section_images>")
    if brief.get("media_expectation"):
        lines.append(f'  <media_expectation decision="{html.escape(str(brief.get("media_decision", "none")), quote=True)}">{html.escape(brief["media_expectation"])}</media_expectation>')

    spec: Optional[StyleSpec] = brief.get("style_spec")
    if spec:
        lines.append(f'  <design_system style_name="{spec.name}" source="{spec.source}">')
        lines.append(f"    <primary_color>{spec.get_primary_color()}</primary_color>")
        lines.append(f"    <accent_color>{spec.get_accent_color()}</accent_color>")
        lines.append(f"    <font_heading>{spec.get_heading_font()}</font_heading>")
        lines.append(f"    <font_body>{spec.get_body_font()}</font_body>")
        lines.append("    <css_variables>")
        lines.append(spec.raw_css if spec.raw_css else spec_to_css_root(spec))
        lines.append("    </css_variables>")
        if spec.dos or spec.donts:
            lines.append("    <design_rules>")
            for d in spec.dos:
                lines.append(f'      <rule type="do">{d}</rule>')
            for d in spec.donts:
                lines.append(f'      <rule type="dont">{d}</rule>')
            lines.append("    </design_rules>")
        lines.append("  </design_system>")
    else:
        lines.append("  <design_system>")
        lines.append(f"    <primary_color>{brief.get('primary_color', '#0f172a')}</primary_color>")
        lines.append(f"    <accent_color>{brief.get('accent_color', '#38bdf8')}</accent_color>")
        if brief.get("background_color"):
            lines.append(f"    <background_color>{brief['background_color']}</background_color>")
        if brief.get("requested_palette"):
            lines.append(f"    <requested_palette>{html.escape(brief['requested_palette'])}</requested_palette>")
        if brief.get("accent_secondary"):
            lines.append(f"    <accent_secondary>{brief['accent_secondary']}</accent_secondary>")
        lines.append(f"    <font_heading>{brief.get('font_heading', 'Inter')}</font_heading>")
        lines.append(f"    <font_body>{brief.get('font_body', 'Inter')}</font_body>")
        lines.append("  </design_system>")

    lines.append("  <sections>")
    for sec in brief.get("sections", ["header", "hero", "about", "contact", "footer"]):
        lines.append(f"    <section>{sec}</section>")
    lines.append("  </sections>")
    manifest = brief.get("requirement_manifest") or {}
    if manifest:
        lines.append("  <requirement_manifest>")
        for fact in manifest.get("exact_facts", []):
            lines.append(f"    <exact_fact>{html.escape(str(fact))}</exact_fact>")
        for interaction in manifest.get("interactions", []):
            lines.append(f"    <required_interaction>{html.escape(str(interaction))}</required_interaction>")
        for contract in manifest.get("cross_section_contracts", []):
            lines.append(f"    <shared_state producer=\"{html.escape(contract['producer'], quote=True)}\" consumer=\"{html.escape(contract['consumer'], quote=True)}\">{html.escape(contract['state'])}</shared_state>")
        for requirement in manifest.get("three_d_constraints", []):
            lines.append(f'    <required_3d engine="{html.escape(requirement["engine"], quote=True)}">{html.escape(json.dumps(requirement, ensure_ascii=False))}</required_3d>')
        for requirement in manifest.get("motion_constraints", []):
            lines.append(f'    <required_motion>{html.escape(json.dumps(requirement, ensure_ascii=False))}</required_motion>')
        for requirement in manifest.get("interaction_constraints", []):
            lines.append(f'    <interaction_contract>{html.escape(json.dumps(requirement, ensure_ascii=False))}</interaction_contract>')
        lines.append("  </requirement_manifest>")

    motion_plan = brief.get("motion_plan")
    if motion_plan:
        if isinstance(motion_plan, list) and motion_plan:
            lines.append("  <motion_plan>")
            for m in motion_plan:
                if hasattr(m, "type"):
                    m_type = m.type.value if hasattr(m.type, "value") else str(m.type)
                    target = getattr(m, "target_section", "general")
                    intensity = getattr(m, "intensity", "subtle")
                    lines.append(f'    <motion type="{m_type}" section="{target}" intensity="{intensity}" />')
                elif isinstance(m, dict):
                    m_type = m.get("type", "scroll_reveal")
                    target = m.get("target_section", "general")
                    intensity = m.get("intensity", "subtle")
                    lines.append(f'    <motion type="{m_type}" section="{target}" intensity="{intensity}" />')
            lines.append("  </motion_plan>")
        elif isinstance(motion_plan, str) and "<motion" in motion_plan:
            lines.append(f"  {motion_plan.strip()}")

    if brief.get("products"):
        lines.append("  <products>")
        for product in brief["products"]:
            name = html.escape(product.get("name", ""), quote=True)
            price = html.escape(product.get("price", ""), quote=True)
            lines.append(f'    <product name="{name}" price="{price}" />')
        lines.append("  </products>")

    if "features" in brief and brief["features"]:

        lines.append("  <features>")
        for feat in brief["features"]:
            icon = feat.get('icon', 'bolt')
            title = feat.get('title', '')
            desc = feat.get('description', '')
            lines.append(f'    <feature icon="{icon}" title="{title}">{desc}</feature>')
        lines.append("  </features>")

    if "pricing_tiers" in brief and brief["pricing_tiers"]:
        lines.append("  <pricing_tiers>")
        for tier in brief["pricing_tiers"]:
            rec = ' recommended="true"' if tier.get('recommended') else ''
            t_name = tier.get('name', '')
            t_price = tier.get('price', '')
            t_period = tier.get('period', 'month')
            lines.append(f'    <tier name="{t_name}" price="{t_price}" period="{t_period}"{rec}>')
            for f in tier.get("features", []):
                lines.append(f"      <item>{f}</item>")
            lines.append("    </tier>")
        lines.append("  </pricing_tiers>")

    if "testimonials" in brief and brief["testimonials"]:
        lines.append("  <testimonials>")
        for t in brief["testimonials"]:
            author = t.get('author', 'Verified Client')
            role = t.get('role', '')
            quote = t.get('quote', '')
            rating = t.get('rating', 5)
            lines.append(f'    <testimonial author="{author}" role="{role}" rating="{rating}">')
            lines.append(f"      <quote>{quote}</quote>")
            lines.append("    </testimonial>")
        lines.append("  </testimonials>")

    if "menu_categories" in brief and brief["menu_categories"]:
        lines.append("  <menu>")
        for cat in brief["menu_categories"]:
            cat_name = cat.get('name', '')
            lines.append(f'    <category name="{cat_name}">')
            for item in cat.get("items", []):
                price = item.get('price', '')
                name = item.get('name', '')
                desc = item.get('description', '')
                lines.append(f'      <item name="{name}" price="{price}">{desc}</item>')
            lines.append("    </category>")
        lines.append("  </menu>")

    if "projects" in brief and brief["projects"]:
        lines.append("  <projects>")
        for proj in brief["projects"]:
            name = proj.get('name', '')
            desc = proj.get('description', '')
            tech = ", ".join(proj.get('tech', []))
            lines.append(f'    <project name="{name}" tech="{tech}">{desc}</project>')
        lines.append("  </projects>")

    if "skills" in brief and brief["skills"]:
        lines.append(f"  <skills>{', '.join(brief['skills'])}</skills>")

    if "contact" in brief and brief["contact"]:
        lines.append("  <contact>")
        for k, v in brief["contact"].items():
            lines.append(f"    <{k}>{v}</{k}>")
        lines.append("  </contact>")

    lines.append("</content_brief>")
    return "\n".join(lines)

"""
style_ingest.py - Design System Ingestion & Style Conformance Engine for ReactAgent SLM

Decouples visual aesthetic and design tokens from business domain heuristics.
Parses Refero-style design systems (e.g. styles.refero.design), custom :root CSS blocks,
and Tailwind @theme definitions into structured StyleSpec objects with zero LLM cost.
Enforces strict token compliance during multi-turn agent generation.
"""

import colorsys
import html
import re
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any, Set, Union


@dataclass
class StyleSpec:
    """Complete, machine-verifiable design system specification."""
    name: str
    colors: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)         # --color-* and --gradient-*
    fonts: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)          # --font-* families
    type_scale: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)     # --text-* and --leading-*
    spacing_scale: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)  # --spacing-*
    radius: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)         # --radius-*
    surfaces: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)       # --surface-*
    layout: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)         # --page-max-width, --section-gap, etc.
    other_tokens: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)   # Any other custom CSS properties
    semantic_tokens: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict) # semantic color/elevation aliases
    motion_tokens: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)   # duration/easing/stagger tokens
    icon_art_direction: str = "outline-round"
    raw_css: str = ""                                            # Complete verbatim :root block
    dos: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)                 # Positive design guidelines
    donts: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)               # Hard aesthetic constraints
    parse_warnings: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)      # Warnings about unparsed rules/sections
    source: str = "custom"                                       # "refero" | "preset" | "custom" | "heuristic"

    def get_primary_color(self) -> str:
        """Heuristically resolves a primary background or brand color for backwards compatibility."""
        for key in ["--surface-obsidian", "--color-obsidian", "--surface-primary", "--color-primary", "--color-background", "--surface-paper"]:
            if key in self.colors or key in self.surfaces:
                return self.colors.get(key) or self.surfaces.get(key)
        if self.colors:
            return next(iter(self.colors.values()))
        return "#090d16"

    def get_accent_color(self) -> str:
        """Heuristically resolves an accent color for CTAs and highlights."""
        for key in ["--color-iridescent-fade", "--color-accent", "--color-primary", "--color-brand", "--gradient-iridescent-fade"]:
            if key in self.colors:
                val = self.colors[key]
                if not val.startswith("linear-gradient"):
                    return val
        for key, val in self.colors.items():
            if "fade" in key or "accent" in key or "highlight" in key:
                if not val.startswith("linear-gradient"):
                    return val
        return "#38bdf8"

    def get_heading_font(self) -> str:
        for key in ["--font-heading", "--font-roobert", "--font-cinzel", "--font-space-grotesk", "--font-raleway"]:
            if key in self.fonts:
                return self.fonts[key].split(",")[0].strip("'\" ")
        if self.fonts:
            return next(iter(self.fonts.values())).split(",")[0].strip("'\" ")
        return "Inter"

    def get_body_font(self) -> str:
        for key in ["--font-body", "--font-raleway", "--font-inter", "--font-system-ui"]:
            if key in self.fonts:
                return self.fonts[key].split(",")[0].strip("'\" ")
        return "Inter"


# ==============================================================================
# 1. Zero-LLM CSS Custom Property Parser
# ==============================================================================

def parse_css_tokens(css_text: str, name: str = "Custom Design Tokens", source: str = "custom") -> StyleSpec:
    """
    Extracts CSS custom properties (--var-name: value;) from a raw :root { ... } or CSS block.
    Categorizes them deterministically into colors, fonts, scales, radii, and layout.
    Also extracts bulleted do's and don'ts if present in surrounding markdown.
    """
    spec = StyleSpec(name=name, source=source)
    spec.raw_css = css_text.strip()

    # Regex matches CSS custom property pairs: --name: value;
    prop_pattern = re.compile(r'(--[\w-]+)\s*:\s*([^;]+);')
    matches = prop_pattern.findall(css_text)

    for prop_name, prop_val in matches:
        prop_name = prop_name.strip()
        prop_val = prop_val.strip()

        # Categorize
        if prop_name.startswith(("--color-", "--gradient-")):
            spec.colors[prop_name] = prop_val
        elif prop_name.startswith("--font-"):
            spec.fonts[prop_name] = prop_val
        elif prop_name.startswith(("--text-", "--leading-", "--tracking-", "--step-")):
            spec.type_scale[prop_name] = prop_val
        elif prop_name.startswith("--spacing-"):
            spec.spacing_scale[prop_name] = prop_val
        elif prop_name.startswith("--radius-"):
            spec.radius[prop_name] = prop_val
        elif prop_name.startswith("--surface-"):
            spec.surfaces[prop_name] = prop_val
        elif prop_name.startswith(("--duration-", "--ease-", "--stagger")):
            spec.motion_tokens[prop_name] = prop_val
        elif prop_name.startswith(("--canvas", "--surface-", "--text-", "--border-", "--accent", "--on-accent", "--focus-ring", "--shadow-", "--glass-", "--noise-")):
            spec.semantic_tokens[prop_name] = prop_val
        elif prop_name in ("--page-max-width", "--section-gap", "--card-padding", "--element-gap", "--gutter", "--content-width", "--measure"):
            spec.layout[prop_name] = prop_val
        else:
            # Fallback categorization by name keywords
            if "color" in prop_name or prop_val.startswith(("#", "rgb", "hsl")):
                spec.colors[prop_name] = prop_val
            elif "radius" in prop_name:
                spec.radius[prop_name] = prop_val
            elif "font" in prop_name:
                spec.fonts[prop_name] = prop_val
            else:
                spec.other_tokens[prop_name] = prop_val

    # Parse Do's and Don'ts from markdown text if present
    do_pattern = re.compile(r'(?:Do\'?s?|Always|Required):\s*(.*?)(?=(?:Don\'?ts?|Never|Avoid|$))', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    dont_pattern = re.compile(r'(?:Don\'?ts?|Never|Avoid):\s*(.*?)(?=(?:Do\'?s?|Always|Required|$))', re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)

    do_match = do_pattern.search(css_text)
    if do_match:
        items = re.findall(r'[-*•]\s*([^\n\r]+)', do_match.group(1))
        spec.dos.extend([item.strip() for item in items if item.strip()])

    dont_match = dont_pattern.search(css_text)
    if dont_match:
        items = re.findall(r'[-*•]\s*([^\n\r]+)', dont_match.group(1))
        spec.donts.extend([item.strip() for item in items if item.strip()])

    # Detect unparsed instructional prose outside :root { ... }
    text_outside_root = re.sub(r'(:root|@theme)\s*\{[^}]*\}', '', css_text, flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
    text_outside_root = re.sub(r'[^{}]*\{[^{}]*\}', '', text_outside_root, flags=re.DOTALL)
    text_outside_root = re.sub(r'/\*\s*(?:colors|typography|fonts|spacing|radius|surfaces|layout|tokens)\s*\*/', '', text_outside_root, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    has_prose = bool(re.search(r'[A-Za-z]{3,}', text_outside_root))

    if has_prose and not spec.dos and not spec.donts:
        spec.parse_warnings.append(
            "Could not detect explicit Do's/Don'ts sections in the pasted design system — "
            "only the generic default constraint was applied. Consider using 'Do's:'/'Don'ts:' "
            "headers if you have specific rules."
        )

    # Default guardrail constraints if none explicitly parsed
    if not spec.donts:
        spec.donts.append("Never hardcode raw hex, rgb, or hsl values; use var(--color-*) or var(--surface-*) exclusively.")
    if "--radius-buttons" in spec.radius:
        spec.dos.append(f"Buttons must strictly use var(--radius-buttons) ({spec.radius['--radius-buttons']}).")
    if "--radius-cards" in spec.radius and spec.radius["--radius-cards"] in ("0", "0px"):
        spec.donts.append("Cards and imagery containers must strictly use 0px border-radius (sharp corners).")

    return spec


# ==============================================================================
# 2. Curated Design System Archetype Presets
# ==============================================================================
