    Authoritative multi-layer browser runtime accessibility evaluation:
    1. Computed-style contrast checking on live rendered text nodes (WCAG SC 1.4.3 AA / 1.4.6 AAA)
    2. Keyboard operability and visible focus indicator verification (WCAG SC 2.1.1 / 2.4.7)
    3. Target sizes verification (WCAG SC 2.5.8 minimum target size >= 24x24px)
    4. Reflow / 400% zoom emulation at 320px viewport (WCAG SC 1.4.10)
    5. Live accessibility tree snapshot verification (interactive nodes must have accessible names)
    6. Runtime DOM duplicate ID detection (WCAG SC 4.1.1)
    7. Reduced-motion runtime behavior verification (WCAG SC 2.3.3)
    Returns: (errors, warnings, evidence_dict)
    """
    errors: List[str] = []
    warnings: List[str] = []
    evidence: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "contrast_checks": [],
        "focus_checks": [],
        "target_size_checks": [],
        "reflow_320px": {},
        "duplicate_ids": [],
        "a11y_tree_checks": {},
        "reduced_motion": {},
    }

    try:
        # Layer 1: Computed-Style Color Contrast on live rendered text
        contrast_js = """() => {
            function parseColor(value) {
                if (value === 'transparent') return [0, 0, 0, 0];
                const m = value.match(/^rgba?\\(\\s*([\\d.]+)\\s*,\\s*([\\d.]+)\\s*,\\s*([\\d.]+)\\s*(?:,\\s*([\\d.]+)\\s*)?\\)$/i);
                if (!m) return null;
                const color = [Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]), Number(m[3]), m[4] === undefined ? 1 : Number(m[4])];
                return color.every(Number.isFinite) && color[3] >= 0 && color[3] <= 1 ? color : null;
            }
            function over(top, bottom) {
                return top.slice(0, 3).map((v, i) => v * top[3] + bottom[i] * (1 - top[3]));
            }
            function effectiveBackground(el) {
                const layers = [];
                for (let node = el; node; node = node.parentElement) {
                    const style = getComputedStyle(node);
                    if (style.backgroundImage !== 'none' || Number(style.opacity) !== 1 ||
                        style.mixBlendMode !== 'normal' || style.filter !== 'none' || style.backdropFilter !== 'none') {
                        return {reason: 'background image, blend mode, filter, or opacity'};
                    }
                    const layer = parseColor(style.backgroundColor);
                    if (!layer) return {reason: 'unsupported background color'};
                    layers.push(layer);
                }
                // The browser's default canvas is white. Composite from root to text.
                let bg = [255, 255, 255];
                for (const layer of layers.reverse()) bg = over(layer, bg);
                return {color: bg};
            }
            function lum([r, g, b]) {
                const a = [r, g, b].map(v => {
                    v /= 255;
                    return v <= 0.04045 ? v / 12.92 : Math.pow((v + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
                });
                return a[0] * 0.2126 + a[1] * 0.7152 + a[2] * 0.0722;
            }
            function contrastRatio(fg, bg) {
                const l1 = lum(fg);
                const l2 = lum(bg);
                const lighter = Math.max(l1, l2);
                const darker = Math.min(l1, l2);
                return (lighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05);
            }
            const items = [];
            const elements = document.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, p, span, a, button, label, input, li');
            for (const el of elements) {
                const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (r.width === 0 || r.height === 0 || window.getComputedStyle(el).display === 'none' || window.getComputedStyle(el).visibility === 'hidden') {
                    continue;
                }
                const text = el.innerText ? el.innerText.trim() : '';
                if (!text || text.length < 2) continue;

                const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
                const fg = style.color;
                const background = effectiveBackground(el);
                const foreground = parseColor(fg);
                const verified = Boolean(background.color && foreground);
                const bg = background.color ? `rgb(${background.color.map(v => Math.round(v)).join(', ')})` : 'unresolved';
                const ratio = verified ? contrastRatio(over(foreground, background.color), background.color) : null;

                const fontSize = parseFloat(style.fontSize);
                const fontWeight = parseInt(style.fontWeight) || 400;
                const isLarge = fontSize >= 24 || (fontSize >= 18.66 && fontWeight >= 700);
                const minRatio = isLarge ? 3.0 : 4.5;

                items.push({
                    tag: el.tagName.toLowerCase(),
                    text: text.slice(0, 30),
                    fg,
                    bg,
                    verified,
                    reason: verified ? null : (background.reason || 'unsupported foreground color'),
                    ratio: verified ? Math.round(ratio * 100) / 100 : null,
                    minRatio,
                    passesAA: verified ? ratio >= minRatio : null,
                    passesAAA: verified ? ratio >= (isLarge ? 4.5 : 7.0) : null,
                });
                if (items.length >= 25) break;
            }
            return items;
        }"""
        contrast_results = page.evaluate(contrast_js)
        evidence["contrast_checks"] = contrast_results
        for res in contrast_results:
            if res.get("verified") is False:
                warnings.append(f"[A11y Runtime Warning] Text contrast unverified on <{res['tag']}> \"{res['text']}\": {res['reason']}.")
            elif not res.get("passesAA"):
                errors.append(
                    f"[A11y Runtime Error] Low computed text contrast {res['ratio']}:1 (minimum required: {res['minRatio']}:1) "
                    f"on <{res['tag']}> \"{res['text']}\" (foreground {res['fg']}, background {res['bg']})."
                )
            elif not res.get("passesAAA"):
                warnings.append(
                    f"[A11y Runtime Warning] Computed text contrast {res['ratio']}:1 on <{res['tag']}> \"{res['text']}\" "
                    f"meets AA (4.5:1) but falls below AAA (7.0:1)."
                )

        # Layer 2: Keyboard Operability & Visible Focus Ring (WCAG SC 2.1.1 / 2.4.7)
        focus_js = """() => {
            const isInteractive = __VISIBLE_INTERACTIVE__;
            const focusables = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a[href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex="0"]'))
                .filter(isInteractive);
            const checks = [];
            for (const el of focusables.slice(0, 8)) {
                const prevBorder = window.getComputedStyle(el).borderColor;
                el.focus();
                const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
                const hasOutline = style.outlineStyle !== 'none' && parseFloat(style.outlineWidth) > 0;
                const hasBoxShadow = Boolean(style.boxShadow && style.boxShadow !== 'none');
                const hasBorderChange = style.borderColor !== prevBorder;
                const visibleFocus = hasOutline || hasBoxShadow || hasBorderChange;
                checks.push({
                    tag: el.tagName.toLowerCase(),
                    text: (el.innerText || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim().slice(0, 25),
                    visibleFocus,
                    outlineStyle: style.outlineStyle,
                    outlineWidth: style.outlineWidth,
                    hasBoxShadow,
                });
            }
            return checks;
        }""".replace("__VISIBLE_INTERACTIVE__", VISIBLE_INTERACTIVE_JS)
        # WCAG 2.4.7 is about keyboard focus. After earlier mouse checks a scripted
        # el.focus() would not match :focus-visible (the ring keyboard users see), so
        # put the page in keyboard modality first.
        try:
            page.keyboard.press("Shift")
        except Exception:
            pass
        focus_checks = page.evaluate(focus_js)
        evidence["focus_checks"] = focus_checks
        for fc in focus_checks:
            if not fc.get("visibleFocus"):
                errors.append(
                    f"[A11y Runtime Error] Interactive element <{fc['tag']}> \"{fc['text']}\" lacks visible focus indicator "
                    f"(outline is {fc['outlineStyle']} with no replacement box-shadow or focus ring, violating WCAG SC 2.4.7)."
                )

        # Test tab key navigation: ensure tab advances focus
        try:
            page.keyboard.press("Tab")
            active_tag = page.evaluate("() => document.activeElement ? document.activeElement.tagName.toLowerCase() : null")
            evidence["keyboard_active_after_tab"] = active_tag
        except Exception:
            pass

        # Layer 3: Minimum Target Size (WCAG SC 2.5.8 Target Size - Minimum 24x24px)
        target_size_js = """() => {
            const isInteractive = __VISIBLE_INTERACTIVE__;
            const targets = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"], input[type="button"], input[type="submit"]'))
                .filter(isInteractive);
            const checks = [];
            for (const el of targets.slice(0, 10)) {
                const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                const text = (el.innerText || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim().slice(0, 25);
                const passes = r.width >= 24 && r.height >= 24;
                checks.push({
                    tag: el.tagName.toLowerCase(),
                    text,
                    width: Math.round(r.width * 10) / 10,
                    height: Math.round(r.height * 10) / 10,
                    passes,
                });
            }
            return checks;
        }""".replace("__VISIBLE_INTERACTIVE__", VISIBLE_INTERACTIVE_JS)
        target_size_checks = page.evaluate(target_size_js)
        evidence["target_size_checks"] = target_size_checks
        for tc in target_size_checks:
            if not tc.get("passes"):
                errors.append(
                    f"[A11y Runtime Error] Interactive target <{tc['tag']}> \"{tc['text']}\" bounding box is "
                    f"{tc['width']}x{tc['height']}px, below WCAG SC 2.5.8 minimum target size of 24x24px."
                )

        # Layer 4: Reflow / 400% Zoom Emulation at 320px Viewport (WCAG SC 1.4.10)
        page.set_viewport_size({"width": 320, "height": 568})
        page.wait_for_timeout(200)
        has_320_overflow = bool(page.evaluate("() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth + 2"))
        evidence["reflow_320px"] = {
            "tested_viewport_width": 320,
            "has_horizontal_overflow": has_320_overflow,
            "passed": not has_320_overflow,
        }
        if has_320_overflow:
            errors.append(
                "[A11y Runtime Error] Page fails WCAG SC 1.4.10 Reflow: horizontal overflow detected at 320px viewport width (equivalent to 400% zoom)."
            )
        page.set_viewport_size({"width": 1280, "height": 900})

        # Layer 5: Live DOM Duplicate IDs (WCAG SC 4.1.1)
        dup_ids = page.evaluate("""() => {
            const allIds = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[id]')).map(el => el.id).filter(Boolean);
            const seen = new Set();
            const dups = [];
            for (const id of allIds) {
                if (seen.has(id)) dups.push(id);
                seen.add(id);
            }
            return Array.from(new Set(dups));
        }""")
        evidence["duplicate_ids"] = dup_ids
        for dup in dup_ids:
            errors.append(f"[A11y Runtime Error] Live DOM contains duplicate element id '{dup}' violating WCAG SC 4.1.1.")

        # Layer 6: Accessibility Tree Snapshot Verification
        try:
            snapshot = page.accessibility.snapshot()
            if snapshot:
                missing_names = []
                def traverse(node):
                    role = node.get("role", "")
                    name = node.get("name", "")
                    if role in ("button", "link", "checkbox", "radio", "textbox", "combobox"):
                        if not name or not name.strip():
                            missing_names.append(role)
                    for child in node.get("children", []):
                        traverse(child)
                traverse(snapshot)
                evidence["a11y_tree_checks"] = {
                    "missing_names_count": len(missing_names),
                    "missing_roles": missing_names[:5],
                    "passed": len(missing_names) == 0,
                }
                for mr in missing_names[:3]:
                    errors.append(f"[A11y Runtime Error] Accessibility tree node role=\"{mr}\" lacks an accessible name.")
        except Exception as snap_err:
            warnings.append(f"[A11y Runtime Warning] Accessibility snapshot inspection skipped: {snap_err}")

        # Layer 7: Reduced-Motion Runtime Verification (WCAG SC 2.3.3)
        try:
            reduced_page = browser.new_page(reduced_motion="reduce", viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900})
            try:
                reduced_page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=10000)
                reduced_page.wait_for_timeout(300)
                prefers_reduced = bool(reduced_page.evaluate("() => window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches"))
                evidence["reduced_motion"] = {
                    "media_query_matched": prefers_reduced,
                    "passed": prefers_reduced,
                }
                if not prefers_reduced:
                    errors.append("[A11y Runtime Error] Runtime prefers-reduced-motion emulation was not honored by the browser session.")
            finally:
                reduced_page.close()
        except Exception as rm_err:
            warnings.append(f"[A11y Runtime Warning] Reduced-motion runtime test note: {rm_err}")

    except Exception as exc:
        errors.append(f"[A11y Runtime Error] Browser accessibility runtime evaluation encountered an exception: {exc}")

    try:
        (workspace_dir / "accessibility_runtime_evidence.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(evidence, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return errors, warnings, evidence


class BrowserRuntimeCheckResult(tuple):
    """
    4-tuple backward compatible return type for run_browser_runtime_check.
    Unpacks as (runtime_passed, preview_running, errors, saved_screenshot)
    while carrying rich structured interaction and accessibility evidence attributes.
    """
    runtime_passed: bool
    preview_running: bool
    errors: List[str]
    saved_screenshot: Optional[Path]
    interactions_tested: int
    interactions_required: int
    interaction_evidence: List[InteractionEvidence]
    interaction_errors: List[str]

    def __new__(
        cls,
        runtime_passed: bool,
        preview_running: bool,
        errors: List[str],
        saved_screenshot: Optional[Path],
        interactions_tested: int = 0,
        interactions_required: int = 0,
        interaction_evidence: Optional[List[InteractionEvidence]] = None,
        interaction_errors: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    ):
        instance = super().__new__(cls, (runtime_passed, preview_running, errors, saved_screenshot))
        instance.runtime_passed = runtime_passed
        instance.preview_running = preview_running
        instance.errors = errors
        instance.saved_screenshot = saved_screenshot
        instance.interactions_tested = interactions_tested
        instance.interactions_required = interactions_required
        instance.interaction_evidence = interaction_evidence or []
        instance.interaction_errors = interaction_errors or []
        return instance


def _wait_for_scroll_settle(page, timeout_ms: int = 2000) -> None:
    """An in-page link may start a smooth scroll; wait until the page stops
    moving so the next control is stable enough to exercise."""
    try:
        page.wait_for_function(
            """() => new Promise(resolve => {
                let last = window.scrollY, still = 0;
                const tick = () => {
                    still = window.scrollY === last ? still + 1 : 0;
                    last = window.scrollY;
                    if (still >= 3) resolve(true); else requestAnimationFrame(tick);
                };
                requestAnimationFrame(tick);
            })""",
            timeout=timeout_ms,
        )
    except Exception:
        pass


def check_broken_rendered_images(page) -> List[str]:
    """A mounted page with failed product/hero images is not a valid preview."""
    broken = page.evaluate("""() => [...document.images].filter(image => {
        const r=image.getBoundingClientRect(),s=getComputedStyle(image);
        return image.complete && image.naturalWidth === 0 && r.width > 0 && r.height > 0
            && s.display !== 'none' && s.visibility !== 'hidden';
    }).map(image => ({src:(image.currentSrc || image.src).slice(0,200),alt:image.alt}))""")
    return [f"[Image Runtime Error] Failed image '{item['alt']}' at {item['src']}" for item in broken]


def run_browser_runtime_check(
    workspace_dir: Path,
    port: int = 0,
    timeout_s: int = 12,
    capture_screenshot: bool = True,
    screenshot_path: Optional[Path] = None,
) -> BrowserRuntimeCheckResult:
    """
    Authoritative gates 3 & 4 & 5 (Browser Runtime):
    - Starts/reuses Vite preview server (preview_running)
    - Loads page in Playwright headless Chromium
    - Monitors unhandled pageerror and console.error events
    - Evaluates #root DOM mount verification in live DOM
    - Tests brief-required interactions with explicit InteractionEvidence (tested == required AND passed == required)
    - Evaluates multi-layer runtime accessibility (contrast, visible focus, target size, reflow at 320px)
    - Captures screenshot.webp
    Returns: BrowserRuntimeCheckResult (unpacks as 4-tuple: runtime_passed, preview_running, errors, saved_screenshot_path)
    """
    _ensure_project_configs(workspace_dir)
    if port == 0:
        with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as probe:
            probe.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
            port = probe.getsockname()[1]
    errors: List[str] = []
    preview_running = False
    vite_proc = None
    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
    saved_ss = None
    interaction_evidence: List[InteractionEvidence] = []
    interactions_tested = 0
    interactions_required = 0

    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["PORT"] = str(port)

    try:
        has_dist = (workspace_dir / "dist" / "index.html").exists()
        cmd = [
            "npx", "vite", "preview", "--port", str(port), "--strictPort", "--host", "127.0.0.1"
        ] if has_dist else [
            "npx", "vite", "--port", str(port), "--strictPort", "--host", "127.0.0.1"
        ]

        vite_proc = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd,
            cwd=str(workspace_dir),
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            env=env,
            shell=(os.name == "nt"),
        )

        for _ in range(25):
            time.sleep(0.3)
            if vite_proc.poll() is not None:
                errors.append(f"[Runtime Error] Vite process exited prematurely (exit code {vite_proc.returncode}).")
                return BrowserRuntimeCheckResult(
                    runtime_passed=False,
                    preview_running=False,
                    errors=errors,
                    saved_screenshot=None,
                    interactions_tested=0,
                    interactions_required=0,
                    interaction_evidence=[],
                    interaction_errors=[],
                )
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=1):
                    preview_running = True
                    break
            except Exception:
                continue

        if not preview_running:
            errors.append(f"[Runtime Error] Vite server did not become responsive on port {port} within timeout.")
            return BrowserRuntimeCheckResult(
                runtime_passed=False,
                preview_running=False,
                errors=errors,
                saved_screenshot=None,
                interactions_tested=0,
                interactions_required=0,
                interaction_evidence=[],
                interaction_errors=[],
            )

        try:
            from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
            runtime_exceptions: List[str] = []

            with sync_playwright() as p:
                browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
                page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900})

                def on_page_error(err):
                    runtime_exceptions.append(f"[Browser Exception] {err}")

                def on_console(msg):
                    if msg.type == "error":
                        runtime_exceptions.append(f"[Console Error] {msg.text}")

                page.on("pageerror", on_page_error)
                page.on("console", on_console)

                try:
                    page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=timeout_s * 1000)
                    page.wait_for_timeout(400)
                except Exception as nav_err:
                    runtime_exceptions.append(f"[Navigation Error] {nav_err}")

                root_mounted = False
                try:
                    root_mounted = bool(page.evaluate("""() => {
                        const r = document.getElementById('root');
                        return !!(r && (r.children.length > 0 || (r.innerText && r.innerText.trim().length > 0)));
                    }"""))
                except Exception as eval_err:
                    runtime_exceptions.append(f"[DOM Evaluation Error] {eval_err}")

                if not root_mounted:
                    runtime_exceptions.append("[Runtime Error] Root container (#root) mounted 0 rendered child nodes.")
                runtime_exceptions.extend(check_broken_rendered_images(page))

                # Gate 4b & 5: Exercise controls requested in the saved content brief and evaluate a11y.
                try:
                    brief_text = ""
                    brief_path = workspace_dir / "content_brief.json"
                    if brief_path.is_file():
                        brief_text = brief_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").lower()

                    # 1. Brief-required interactive behaviors
                    brief_ev, brief_fails, brief_tested, brief_req = _check_brief_interactions(page, brief_text)
                    runtime_exceptions.extend(brief_fails)
                    interaction_evidence.extend(brief_ev)
                    interactions_tested += brief_tested
                    interactions_required += brief_req

                    # 2. Motion and 3D browser checks
                    runtime_exceptions.extend(_check_motion_browser(page, browser, url, workspace_dir, brief_text))
                    runtime_exceptions.extend(_check_three_d_browser(page, browser, url, workspace_dir, brief_text))

                    # 3. Multi-layer live browser accessibility evaluation (contrast, visible focus, target size, reflow at 320px)
                    a11y_errs, a11y_warns, a11y_ev = _run_runtime_accessibility_eval(page, browser, url, workspace_dir)
                    runtime_exceptions.extend(a11y_errs)

                    # 4. Icon-only buttons must have accessible name
                    for button in _visible_interactive_controls(page.locator("button")):
                        if (button.inner_text().strip() or button.get_attribute("aria-label")
                                or button.get_attribute("aria-labelledby") or button.get_attribute("title")):
                            continue
                        runtime_exceptions.append("[Interaction Error] Visible icon-only button has no accessible name.")
                        break

                    # 5. Mobile viewport overflow check
                    page.set_viewport_size({"width": 390, "height": 844})
                    if page.evaluate("() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth + 2"):
                        runtime_exceptions.append("[Interaction Error] Page has horizontal overflow on mobile.")
                    runtime_exceptions.extend(check_mobile_control_bounds(page))
                    page.set_viewport_size({"width": 1280, "height": 900})

                    # 6. Generic interactive controls - do NOT swallow exceptions
                    interactive_nodes = _visible_interactive_controls(page.locator("button, [role='button'], a[href^='#'], input:not([type='hidden'])"))
                    for idx, elem in enumerate(interactive_nodes[:4]):
                        tag = elem.evaluate("el => el.tagName.toLowerCase()")
                        role = elem.get_attribute("role") or tag
                        text = (elem.inner_text() or elem.get_attribute("aria-label") or f"control-{idx}").strip()[:30]
                        interactions_tested += 1
                        try:
                            elem.hover(timeout=500)
                            elem.click(timeout=500)
                            page.wait_for_timeout(100)
                            _wait_for_scroll_settle(page)
                            interaction_evidence.append(InteractionEvidence(
                                requirement_id=f"generic_control_{idx}",
                                locator=f"{tag}[role={role}]",
                                initial_state="visible in DOM",
                                action="hover and click",
                                expected_state="exercised cleanly without runtime exception",
                                observed_state="interaction cleanly executed",
                                passed=True,
                                error=None,
                            ))
                        except Exception as exc:
                            err_msg = f"Generic interaction with <{tag}> '{text}' failed: {exc}"
                            runtime_exceptions.append(f"[Interaction Error] {err_msg}")
                            interaction_evidence.append(InteractionEvidence(
                                requirement_id=f"generic_control_{idx}",
                                locator=f"{tag}[role={role}]",
                                initial_state="visible in DOM",
                                action="hover and click",
                                expected_state="exercised cleanly without runtime exception",
                                observed_state=f"threw {type(exc).__name__}",
                                passed=False,
                                error=err_msg,
                            ))
                except Exception as int_err:
                    runtime_exceptions.append(f"[Interaction Error] DOM interaction evaluation failed: {int_err}")

                if capture_screenshot and screenshot_path:
                    try:
                        screenshot_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                        page.screenshot(path=str(screenshot_path), type="webp")
                        saved_ss = screenshot_path
                    except Exception as ss_err:
                        print(f"[ProjectValidator] Screenshot capture note: {ss_err}")

                browser.close()

            int_errors = [e for e in runtime_exceptions if "[Interaction Error]" in e]
            if runtime_exceptions:
                errors.extend(runtime_exceptions)
                return BrowserRuntimeCheckResult(
                    runtime_passed=False,
                    preview_running=preview_running,
                    errors=errors,
                    saved_screenshot=saved_ss,
                    interactions_tested=interactions_tested,
                    interactions_required=interactions_required,
                    interaction_evidence=interaction_evidence,
                    interaction_errors=int_errors,
                )

            return BrowserRuntimeCheckResult(
                runtime_passed=True,
                preview_running=preview_running,
                errors=[],
                saved_screenshot=saved_ss,
                interactions_tested=interactions_tested,
                interactions_required=interactions_required,
                interaction_evidence=interaction_evidence,
                interaction_errors=[],
            )

        except ImportError:
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=2) as resp:
                    body = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                    if "<div id=\"root\">" in body:
                        errors.append(
                            "[Runtime Unverified] Playwright is not installed. Static container check found "
                            "<div id=\"root\">, but browser execution (React mount, console errors, page errors) "
                            "is UNVERIFIED. Static container check is reported as runtime_unverified, never passed."
                        )
                        return BrowserRuntimeCheckResult(
                            runtime_passed=False,
                            preview_running=preview_running,
                            errors=errors,
                            saved_screenshot=None,
                            interactions_tested=0,
                            interactions_required=0,
                            interaction_evidence=[],
                            interaction_errors=[],
                        )
                    else:
                        errors.append("[Runtime Error] HTML payload missing #root container.")
                        return BrowserRuntimeCheckResult(
                            runtime_passed=False,
                            preview_running=preview_running,
                            errors=errors,
                            saved_screenshot=None,
                            interactions_tested=0,
                            interactions_required=0,
                            interaction_evidence=[],
                            interaction_errors=[],
                        )
            except Exception as http_err:
                errors.append(f"[Runtime Error] Fallback HTTP verification failed: {http_err}")
                return BrowserRuntimeCheckResult(
                    runtime_passed=False,
                    preview_running=preview_running,
                    errors=errors,
                    saved_screenshot=None,
                    interactions_tested=0,
                    interactions_required=0,
                    interaction_evidence=[],
                    interaction_errors=[],
                )

    except Exception as exc:
        errors.append(f"[Runtime Error] Unexpected error during browser runtime check: {exc}")
        return BrowserRuntimeCheckResult(
            runtime_passed=False,
            preview_running=preview_running,
            errors=errors,
            saved_screenshot=None,
            interactions_tested=0,
            interactions_required=0,
            interaction_evidence=[],
            interaction_errors=[],
        )
    finally:
        if vite_proc:
            _stop_process_tree(vite_proc)


def find_fallback_components(workspace_dir: Path) -> List[str]:
    """Locate emergency section scaffolds that still need model repair."""
    components_dir = workspace_dir / "src" / "components"
    if not components_dir.is_dir():
        return []
    found = []
    for component in components_dir.rglob("*.tsx"):
        source = component.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        if re.search(r'data-fallback\s*=\s*["\']true["\']', source):
            found.append(component.relative_to(workspace_dir).as_posix())
    return sorted(found)


def find_unverified_contact_files(workspace_dir: Path, original_prompt: str) -> List[str]:
    """Flag generated contact details that were absent from the site request."""
    if not original_prompt:
        return []
    components_dir = workspace_dir / "src" / "components"
    if not components_dir.is_dir():
        return []
    prompt_emails = {match.lower() for match in re.findall(
        r'[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}', original_prompt
    )}
    prompt_phone_digits = {
        re.sub(r'\D', '', match) for match in re.findall(
            r'(?:\+?\d{1,3}[\s.-]*)?\(?\d{3}\)?[\s.-]*\d{3}[\s.-]*\d{4}', original_prompt
        )
    }
    found = []
    for component in components_dir.rglob("*.tsx"):
        source = component.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        emails = {match.lower() for match in re.findall(r'[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}', source)}
        # A phone number stands alone: digit runs inside URLs or ids (an
        # Unsplash "photo-1578749556568-…") are not contact details.
        phones = {
            re.sub(r'\D', '', match) for match in re.findall(
                r'(?<![\w/.=-])(?:\+?\d{1,3}[\s.-]*)?\(?\d{3}\)?[\s.-]*\d{3}[\s.-]*\d{4}(?![\w-])', source
            )
        }
        if emails - prompt_emails or phones - prompt_phone_digits:
            found.append(component.relative_to(workspace_dir).as_posix())
    return sorted(found)


def validate_project(
    workspace_dir: Path,
    port: int = 0,
    capture_screenshot: bool = True,
    screenshot_path: Optional[Path] = None,
    event_callback: Optional[Callable[[Dict[str, Any]], None]] = None,
) -> ValidationResult:
    """
    Executes the authoritative 9-gate project validation sequence.

    Gate registry (GATES order):
      Gate 1  — TypecheckGate    : npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit)
      Gate 2  — BuildGate        : npm run build (vite build)
      Gate 3  — LintGate         : Static CSS/token/import linting
      Gate 4  — ContractGate     : Structural integrity, section completeness, content provenance
      Gate 5  — AccessibilityGate: Static WCAG + runtime axe-core / contrast / keyboard / zoom
      Gate 6  — MotionGate       : Animation rule conformance + runtime motion benchmark
      Gate 7  — ThreeDGate       : 3-D performance contract (skipped when not requested)
      Gate 8  — RuntimeGate      : Preview server liveness + Playwright browser runtime check
      Gate 9  — InteractionGate  : Explicit DOM interaction evidence (tested == required)

    The UI renders whatever the backend ValidationResult schema reports; gate-count
    comments in logs must match this registry exactly.
    """
    all_errors: List[str] = []
    all_warnings: List[str] = []

    # Gate 3: Static Linting
    lint_passed, lint_errs, lint_warns = run_static_lint(workspace_dir)
    all_errors.extend(lint_errs)
    all_warnings.extend(lint_warns)

    # Gate 5: Contract & Accessibility
    contract_passed, contract_errs, contract_warns = run_contract_check(workspace_dir)
    all_errors.extend(contract_errs)
    all_warnings.extend(contract_warns)

    # A compilable emergency scaffold is still an unfinished section. Keep the
    # project repair loop active until it is replaced by generated content.
    for rel in find_fallback_components(workspace_dir):
        contract_passed = False
        all_errors.append(f"[Fallback Error] {rel}: Emergency scaffold must be replaced with a real section implementation.")

    brief_path = workspace_dir / "content_brief.json"
    if brief_path.is_file():
        try:
            original_prompt = str(json.loads(brief_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("original_prompt") or "")
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
            original_prompt = ""
        for rel in find_unverified_contact_files(workspace_dir, original_prompt):
            contract_passed = False
            all_errors.append(f"[Content Error] {rel}: Contact details were not supplied in the original request.")
        rendering_errors = run_rendering_contract_check(workspace_dir, original_prompt)
        if rendering_errors:
            contract_passed = False
            all_errors.extend(rendering_errors)

    accessibility_passed, a11y_errs, a11y_warns = run_accessibility_check(workspace_dir)
    all_errors.extend(a11y_errs)
    all_warnings.extend(a11y_warns)

    # Gate 5c: Motion Implementation Rules (Section 5)
    motion_passed, motion_errs, motion_warns = run_motion_rules_check(workspace_dir)
    all_errors.extend(motion_errs)
    all_warnings.extend(motion_warns)

    brief_path = workspace_dir / "content_brief.json"
    brief_text = brief_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") if brief_path.exists() else ""
    from evaluation.three_d_performance_validator import is_three_d_requested
    three_d_requested = is_three_d_requested(brief_text)
    three_d_passed = True
    three_d_status = "not_requested"
    if three_d_requested:
        from evaluation.three_d_performance_validator import validate_three_d_performance
        three_d_files = {
            p.relative_to(workspace_dir).as_posix(): p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            for p in (workspace_dir / "src").rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.suffix in (".tsx", ".ts", ".jsx", ".js", ".css")
        }
        perf = validate_three_d_performance(three_d_files)
        three_d_passed = bool(perf["all_passed"])
        for name in perf["failed_checks"]:
            check = perf["scene_contract"] if name == "scene_contract" else perf["checks"][name]
            all_errors.append(f"[3D Error] Static check failed: {name}: {check['reason']}")
        three_d_status = "passed" if three_d_passed else "failed"

    # Gate 1: TypecheckGate — TypeScript Compilation
    if event_callback:
        try:
            event_callback({"type": "status", "status": "Running TypeScript checks…"})
            event_callback({"type": "log", "text": "[VALIDATION] Gate 1/9 TypecheckGate — Running TypeScript checks (npm run typecheck)…"})
        except Exception:
            pass

    typecheck_passed, ts_errs = run_project_typecheck(workspace_dir)
    all_errors.extend(ts_errs)

    # Gate 2: BuildGate — Production Bundler
    build_passed = False
    if typecheck_passed:
        if event_callback:
            try:
                event_callback({"type": "status", "status": "Running production build…"})
                event_callback({"type": "log", "text": "[VALIDATION] Gate 2/9 BuildGate — Running production build (npm run build)…"})
            except Exception:
                pass
        build_passed, b_errs = run_project_build(workspace_dir)
        all_errors.extend(b_errs)
    else:
        all_errors.append("[Build Error] Build skipped because TypeScript checks failed.")

    # Gate 8: RuntimeGate — Preview Server & Browser Runtime
    runtime_passed = False
    preview_running = False
    browser_res = None
    if build_passed:
        if event_callback:
            try:
                event_callback({"type": "status", "status": "Checking browser runtime…"})
                event_callback({"type": "log", "text": "[VALIDATION] Gate 8/9 RuntimeGate — Launching preview & browser runtime check…"})
            except Exception:
                pass
        ss_dest = screenshot_path or (workspace_dir / "screenshot.webp")
        browser_res = run_browser_runtime_check(
            workspace_dir=workspace_dir,
            port=port,
            capture_screenshot=capture_screenshot,
            screenshot_path=ss_dest,
        )
        runtime_passed, preview_running, r_errs, _ = browser_res
        all_errors.extend(r_errs)
        if preview_running and event_callback:
            try:
                event_callback({"type": "status", "status": "Preview running…"})
            except Exception:
                pass
    else:
        all_errors.append("[Runtime Error] Runtime checks skipped because build was not successful.")

    runtime_unverified = browser_res is None or any("[Runtime Unverified]" in err for err in all_errors)
    runtime_status = "runtime_unverified" if runtime_unverified else ("passed" if runtime_passed else "failed")
    three_d_static_status = three_d_status
    three_d_runtime_status = "not_requested"
    if three_d_requested:
        three_d_runtime_status = "passed" if runtime_passed else ("runtime_unverified" if runtime_unverified else "failed")
        three_d_passed = three_d_passed and runtime_passed
        three_d_status = "passed" if three_d_passed else three_d_runtime_status if three_d_static_status == "passed" else "failed"
    typecheck_status = "passed" if typecheck_passed else "failed"
    build_status = "passed" if build_passed else "failed"
    lint_status = "passed" if lint_passed else "failed"
    contract_status = "passed" if contract_passed else "failed"
    accessibility_status = "passed" if accessibility_passed else "failed"
    motion_status = "passed" if motion_passed else "failed"
    try:
        brief_record_for_motion = json.loads(brief_text)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        brief_record_for_motion = {}
    explicit_motion_requested = _has_requested_motion(brief_record_for_motion)
    motion_runtime_status = "not_requested"
    if explicit_motion_requested:
        motion_runtime_status = "runtime_unverified" if runtime_unverified else (
            "failed" if any("[Motion Runtime Error]" in error for error in all_errors) or not runtime_passed else "passed"
        )
        motion_passed = motion_passed and motion_runtime_status == "passed"
        motion_status = "passed" if motion_passed else "failed"
    preview_status = "passed" if preview_running else "failed"

    # Gate 5: Accessibility Gate (Static checks passed AND no runtime accessibility errors)
    a11y_runtime_errors = [e for e in all_errors if "[A11y Runtime Error]" in e]
    if a11y_runtime_errors:
        accessibility_passed = False
        accessibility_status = "failed"

    trimmed_errors = all_errors[:40]
    if len(all_errors) > 40:
        trimmed_errors.append(f"... ({len(all_errors) - 40} more errors omitted)")

    motion_failures = [e for e in all_errors if "[Motion Rule Violation]" in e or "[Motion Benchmark Failure]" in e]
    motion_plan: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    cb_file = workspace_dir / "content_brief.json"
    if cb_file.is_file():
        try:
            cb_data = json.loads(cb_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            raw_mp = cb_data.get("motion_plan", [])
            for item in raw_mp:
                if hasattr(item, "to_dict"):
                    motion_plan.append(item.to_dict())
                elif isinstance(item, dict):
                    motion_plan.append(item)
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Gate 4b: DOM Interaction Evidence Gate
    interaction_errors = [e for e in all_errors if "[Interaction Error]" in e]
    int_evidence = getattr(browser_res, "interaction_evidence", []) if browser_res else []
    int_tested = getattr(browser_res, "interactions_tested", 0) if browser_res else 0
    declared_interactions = (brief_record_for_motion.get("requirement_manifest") or {}).get("interaction_constraints", [])
    int_required = max(getattr(browser_res, "interactions_required", 0) if browser_res else 0, len(declared_interactions))

    if runtime_unverified:
        interaction_passed = False
        interaction_status = "unverified"
    elif len(interaction_errors) > 0:
        interaction_passed = False
        interaction_status = "failed"
    elif int_required > 0:
        passed_ev_count = sum(
            1 for e in int_evidence
            if (e.passed if hasattr(e, "passed") else (e.get("passed", False) if isinstance(e, dict) else False))
        )
        if int_tested >= int_required and passed_ev_count >= int_required and len(interaction_errors) == 0:
            interaction_passed = True
            interaction_status = "passed"
        else:
            interaction_passed = False
            interaction_status = "failed"
    elif int_required == 0:
        interaction_passed = True
        interaction_status = "not_requested"
    else:
        interaction_passed = False
        interaction_status = "failed"

    return ValidationResult(
        typecheck_passed=typecheck_passed,
        build_passed=build_passed,
        lint_passed=lint_passed,
        contract_passed=contract_passed,
        accessibility_passed=accessibility_passed,
        motion_passed=motion_passed,
        three_d_passed=three_d_passed,
        three_d_status=three_d_status,
        three_d_static_status=three_d_static_status,
        three_d_runtime_status=three_d_runtime_status,
        runtime_passed=runtime_passed,
        runtime_unverified=runtime_unverified,
        interaction_passed=interaction_passed,
        interaction_status=interaction_status,
        interaction_errors=interaction_errors,
        interactions_tested=int_tested,
        interactions_required=int_required,
        interaction_evidence=int_evidence,
        typecheck_status=typecheck_status,
        build_status=build_status,
        lint_status=lint_status,
        contract_status=contract_status,
        accessibility_status=accessibility_status,
        motion_status=motion_status,
        motion_runtime_status=motion_runtime_status,
        runtime_status=runtime_status,
        preview_status=preview_status,
        preview_running=preview_running,
        errors=trimmed_errors,
        warnings=all_warnings,
        motion_plan=motion_plan,
        motion_failures=motion_failures,
    )

`````python
"""
agent/snapshot_manager.py - Scalable Checkpoint & Git Snapshot Engine

Implements the blueprint's snapshot architecture:
1. Content-Addressable Blob Store:
   - Stores file revisions once by SHA-256 hash in `workspace_dir/.snapshots/blobs/`.
   - Checkpoints store lightweight metadata and changed file hashes rather than
     duplicating the entire repository in session JSON.
2. Internal Git Repository:
   - Initializes an internal Git repository per workspace.
   - Uses `.gitignore` for dependencies and build artifacts.
   - Creates clean commits for pre-task snapshots and task completions.
   - Enables fast native diffs and rock-solid undo/rollback.
3. Pre-Task Snapshot Timing:
   - Captures workspace state BEFORE the model starts editing.
   - Provides safe rollback on repair failures or cancellation.
   - Commits successful edits on task completion.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple


# Default .gitignore contents for generated workspaces
DEFAULT_GITIGNORE = """# Node & Bundler artifacts
node_modules/
.vite/
dist/
dist-ssr/
*.local
npm-debug.log*
yarn-debug.log*
yarn-error.log*

# Snapshots & Media
.snapshots/
screenshot.webp
*.log
"""


# ── 1. Content-Addressable Blob Store ─────────────────────────────────────────

class BlobStore:
    """
    Stores immutable file blobs content-addressed by SHA-256.
    Avoids duplicate storage across multiple turns when files are unchanged.
    """

    def __init__(self, storage_dir: Path):
        self.storage_dir = storage_dir
        self.storage_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _blob_path(self, sha256_hash: str) -> Path:
        # Use two-character prefix subdirectory to avoid directory bloat
        prefix = sha256_hash[:2]
        rest = sha256_hash[2:]
        return self.storage_dir / prefix / rest

    def store_blob(self, content: str) -> str:
        """Stores text content if not already present; returns its SHA-256 hash."""
        raw_bytes = content.encode("utf-8")
        sha = hashlib.sha256(raw_bytes).hexdigest()
        dest = self._blob_path(sha)
        if not dest.exists():
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes(raw_bytes)
        return sha

    def get_blob(self, sha256_hash: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Reads content by SHA-256 hash."""
        dest = self._blob_path(sha256_hash)
        if dest.exists():
            return dest.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        # Legacy fallback if flat directory was used
        flat = self.storage_dir / sha256_hash
        if flat.exists():
            return flat.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        return None

    def has_blob(self, sha256_hash: str) -> bool:
        return self._blob_path(sha256_hash).exists() or (self.storage_dir / sha256_hash).exists()


# ── 2. Git Manager ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class GitManager:
    """
    Manages internal Git repository initialization, commits, and rollbacks
    for a project workspace.
    """

    @staticmethod
    def _run_git(workspace_dir: Path, args: List[str], timeout: int = 10) -> Tuple[int, str, str]:
        """Runs a git command inside workspace_dir."""
        cmd = ["git"] + args
        try:
            res = subprocess.run(
                cmd,
                cwd=str(workspace_dir),
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=timeout,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="replace",
            )
            return res.returncode, res.stdout.strip(), res.stderr.strip()
        except Exception as e:
            return -1, "", str(e)

    @classmethod
    def init_repo(cls, workspace_dir: Path) -> bool:
        """Ensures an internal Git repository is initialized with a .gitignore."""
        if not workspace_dir.exists():
            workspace_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        git_dir = workspace_dir / ".git"
        if not git_dir.exists():
            code, out, err = cls._run_git(workspace_dir, ["init"])
            if code != 0:
                return False
            # Set local committer identity
            cls._run_git(workspace_dir, ["config", "user.name", "SiteAgent"])
            cls._run_git(workspace_dir, ["config", "user.email", "agent@siteagent.local"])

        gitignore_path = workspace_dir / ".gitignore"
        if not gitignore_path.exists():
            gitignore_path.write_text(DEFAULT_GITIGNORE, encoding="utf-8")

        return True

    @classmethod
    def commit(cls, workspace_dir: Path, message: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Stages all tracked/untracked workspace files and creates a commit."""
        cls.init_repo(workspace_dir)

        # Stage files
        cls._run_git(workspace_dir, ["add", "-A"])

        # Check status
        code, out, _ = cls._run_git(workspace_dir, ["status", "--porcelain"])
        if not out:
            # Nothing to commit, get current HEAD
            code, head, _ = cls._run_git(workspace_dir, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
            return head if code == 0 else None

        code, out, err = cls._run_git(workspace_dir, ["commit", "-m", message])
        if code == 0:
            c_code, head, _ = cls._run_git(workspace_dir, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
            return head if c_code == 0 else None
        return None

    @classmethod
    def restore(cls, workspace_dir: Path, commit_hash: str) -> bool:
        """Restores workspace to the exact commit state."""
        if not (workspace_dir / ".git").exists():
            return False

        # Discard working tree changes and reset to commit_hash
        code, _, _ = cls._run_git(workspace_dir, ["reset", "--hard", commit_hash])
        if code != 0:
            return False
        # Clean any untracked files
        cls._run_git(workspace_dir, ["clean", "-fd"])
        return True

    @classmethod
    def get_diff(cls, workspace_dir: Path, from_commit: str, to_commit: str = "HEAD") -> str:
        """Returns the unified diff between two commits."""
        code, out, _ = cls._run_git(workspace_dir, ["diff", from_commit, to_commit])
        return out if code == 0 else ""


# ── 3. Snapshot Manager ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class SnapshotManager:
    """
    Orchestrates pre-task snapshots, task completion commits, and checkpoint
    restorations using content-addressable blobs and internal Git commits.
    """

    def __init__(self, workspace_dir: Path):
        self.workspace_dir = Path(workspace_dir)
        self.snapshots_dir = self.workspace_dir / ".snapshots"
        self.blob_store = BlobStore(self.snapshots_dir / "blobs")
        # Ensure Git is initialized if available
        GitManager.init_repo(self.workspace_dir)

    def scan_workspace_files(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        """Scans current workspace source files, ignoring dependencies and build dirs."""
        files: Dict[str, str] = {}
        if not self.workspace_dir.exists():
            return files

        for p in self.workspace_dir.rglob("*"):
            if p.is_file() and not any(part in p.parts for part in ["node_modules", ".git", "dist", ".vite", ".snapshots",
                                                                     ".workbench-preview", "raw_generation"]):
                rel_path = p.relative_to(self.workspace_dir).as_posix()
                try:
                    files[rel_path] = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return files

    def create_pre_task_snapshot(
        self,
        session: Any,
        summary: str,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Takes a snapshot BEFORE any agent modifications take place.
        Returns the created pre-task snapshot metadata dict.
        """
        current_files = self.scan_workspace_files()
        manifest: Dict[str, str] = {}

        for rel_path, content in current_files.items():
            sha = self.blob_store.store_blob(content)
            manifest[rel_path] = sha

        # Commit to Git
        git_commit = GitManager.commit(self.workspace_dir, f"snapshot: pre-task: {summary}")

        turn_num = len(session.checkpoints) + 1
        snapshot = {
            "turn_num": turn_num,
            "id": turn_num,
            "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
            "summary": summary,
            "manifest": manifest,
            "files": current_files,
            "changed_files": [],
            "changed_blobs": {},
            "diffs": {},
            "is_pre_task": True,
            "git_commit": git_commit,
        }

        session.checkpoints.append(snapshot)
        session.updated_at = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        session.save()
        return snapshot

    def commit_task_success(
        self,
        session: Any,
        summary: str,
        files_touched: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Commits a completed task with changed blobs and diffs.
        """
        current_files = self.scan_workspace_files()
        manifest: Dict[str, str] = {}
        changed_blobs: Dict[str, str] = {}
        diffs: Dict[str, str] = {}

        # Look up previous manifest to detect changed blobs
        prev_checkpoint = session.checkpoints[-1] if session.checkpoints else None
        prev_manifest = prev_checkpoint.get("manifest", {}) if prev_checkpoint else {}

        for rel_path, content in current_files.items():
            sha = self.blob_store.store_blob(content)
            manifest[rel_path] = sha

            old_sha = prev_manifest.get(rel_path)
            if old_sha != sha:
                changed_blobs[rel_path] = sha
                # Compute diff
                old_content = self.blob_store.get_blob(old_sha) if old_sha else ""
                diff = "".join(difflib.unified_diff(
                    old_content.splitlines(keepends=True) if old_content else [],
                    content.splitlines(keepends=True),
                    fromfile=f"a/{rel_path}",
                    tofile=f"b/{rel_path}",
                    lineterm="\n",
                ))
                diffs[rel_path] = diff

        # If files_touched was not supplied, infer from changed_blobs
        actual_touched = files_touched or list(changed_blobs.keys())

        # Commit to Git
        git_commit = GitManager.commit(self.workspace_dir, f"task: {summary}")

        turn_num = len(session.checkpoints) + 1
        checkpoint = {
            "turn_num": turn_num,
            "id": turn_num,
            "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
            "summary": summary,
            "manifest": manifest,
            "files": current_files,
            "changed_files": actual_touched,
            "changed_blobs": changed_blobs,
            "diffs": diffs,
            "is_pre_task": False,
            "git_commit": git_commit,
        }

        session.checkpoints.append(checkpoint)
        session.updated_at = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        session.save()
        return checkpoint

    def get_checkpoint_files(self, checkpoint: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, str]:
        """
        Hydrates the complete file contents for a checkpoint:
        1. If checkpoint has legacy inline 'files', returns them directly.
        2. Otherwise reconstructs files from 'manifest' using BlobStore.
        """
        if "files" in checkpoint and checkpoint["files"]:
            return checkpoint["files"]

        manifest = checkpoint.get("manifest") or {}
        files: Dict[str, str] = {}
        for path, sha in manifest.items():
            content = self.blob_store.get_blob(sha)
            if content is not None:
                files[path] = content
        return files

    def revert_to_checkpoint(
        self,
        session: Any,
        target_num_or_id: int,
        resolve_path_func: Any,
    ) -> bool:
        """
        Reverts the workspace to the state saved at target_num_or_id:
        1. If git_commit is available, resets git tree.
        2. Otherwise, cleanly restores files from manifest + BlobStore.
        3. Enforces canonical path containment through resolve_path_func.
        """
        target = next(
            (c for c in session.checkpoints if c.get("turn_num") == target_num_or_id or c.get("id") == target_num_or_id),
            None
        )
        if not target:
            return False

        # Try Git restore first if git_commit is present
        git_commit = target.get("git_commit")
        git_success = False
        if git_commit and (self.workspace_dir / ".git").exists():
            git_success = GitManager.restore(self.workspace_dir, git_commit)

        if not git_success:
            # Fallback to BlobStore manifest restoration
            files = self.get_checkpoint_files(target)

            # Clear existing workspace files except node_modules and .git
            for p in self.workspace_dir.iterdir():
                if p.name not in ["node_modules", ".git", ".snapshots"]:
                    if p.is_dir():
                        shutil.rmtree(p)
                    else:
                        p.unlink()

            # Write snapshot files with security checks
            for rel_path, content in files.items():
                try:
                    dest = resolve_path_func(self.workspace_dir, rel_path, allow_package_json=True)
                except PermissionError as _err:
                    print(f"[SnapshotManager] Security: blocked restore write: {_err}")
                    continue
                dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                dest.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

        # Record rollback event in session history
        session.history.append({
            "turn_id": len(session.history) + 1,
            "role": "system",
            "content": f"Reverted workspace to checkpoint #{target_num_or_id}: {target.get('summary', '')}",
            "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
            "summary": f"Reverted to checkpoint #{target_num_or_id}",
            "files_touched": list((target.get("manifest") or target.get("files", {})).keys()),
            "diffs": target.get("diffs", {}),
        })
        session.updated_at = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        session.save()
        return True
`````

export type GateTruthState = 'passed' | 'failed' | 'unverified' | 'not_requested' | 'unknown';

export function toGateTruthState(val: boolean | string | undefined | null): GateTruthState {
  if (val === true || val === 'passed') return 'passed';
  if (val === false || val === 'failed') return 'failed';
  if (val === 'unverified') return 'unverified';
  if (val === 'not_requested') return 'not_requested';
  return 'unknown';
}

export type TriState = GateTruthState;
export const toTriState = toGateTruthState;

export interface ValidationGate {

  motion_plan?: MotionPlanItem[];
  motion_failures?: string[];
  errors: string[];
  warnings: string[];
  repair_attempts: number;
}

export type GateStatus = 'passed' | 'failed' | 'unverified' | 'not_requested';

export interface GateEvidence {
  status: GateStatus;
  checks_run: number;
  errors: string[];
  warnings: string[];
  evidence?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

const REQUIRED_GATES: (keyof Pick<ValidationResult,
  'typecheck' | 'build' | 'lint' | 'contract' | 'accessibility' |
  'motion' | 'three_d' | 'runtime' | 'interaction' | 'preview'>)[] = [
  'typecheck', 'build', 'lint', 'contract', 'accessibility',
  'motion', 'three_d', 'runtime', 'interaction', 'preview',
];

export function validationPassed(result: ValidationResult): boolean {
  return REQUIRED_GATES.every((name) => {
    const status = result[name]?.status;
    return status === 'passed' || status === 'not_requested';
  });
}

  repairAttempts: number;
  maxRepairAttempts: number;
  turnCount: number;
  visualScore?: number;
  hasMotion?: boolean;
  motionVerified?: boolean;
}

- **Description**: TypeScript type definitions for project-scoped logs and log filters.

`````tsx
export type LogLevel = 'info' | 'warn' | 'error' | 'debug';
export type LogCategory = 'agent' | 'build' | 'compiler' | 'shell' | 'network' | 'motion' | 'all';

export interface LogEntry {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  timeStr: string;
  level: LogLevel;
  category: LogCategory;
  message: string;
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
  /** Server event sequence number, used to drop duplicate deliveries. */
  seq?: number;
}

/** Map a server event into a log entry (server timestamps are in seconds). */
export function logEntryFromEvent(event: { type?: string; timestamp?: number; log?: string; seq?: number }): Omit<LogEntry, 'id' | 'timeStr'> | null {
  if (!event.log) return null;
  const type = event.type || '';
  const raw = event.timestamp || Date.now();
  const level: LogLevel = /error|fail/.test(type) ? 'error' : /warn/.test(type) ? 'warn' : 'info';
  const category: LogCategory = type.startsWith('command') ? 'shell'
    : type.startsWith('build') ? 'build'
    : type.includes('motion') ? 'motion'
    : type.includes('compile') || type.includes('typecheck') ? 'compiler'
    : 'agent';
  // Server log lines start with their own HH:MM:SS stamp; the Logs tab shows the time separately.
  const message = event.log.replace(/^\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\s+/, '');
  return { timestamp: raw < 1e12 ? raw * 1000 : raw, level, category, message, seq: event.seq };
}
`````

`````tsx
import { create } from 'zustand';
import {
  AgentEvent,
  AgentEventType,
  AgentMetrics,
  AgentStatus,
  ActivityStep,
  ValidationResult,
  TriState,
  toTriState,
  GateTruthState,
  toGateTruthState,
} from '../types/agent';

interface AgentStoreState {
  activeTaskId: string | null;
  status: AgentStatus;
  statusMessage: string;
  queueDepth: number;
  startTime: number | null;
  elapsedSeconds: number;
  currentActivities: ActivityStep[];
  validationResult: ValidationResult | null;
  metrics: AgentMetrics;

  // Global system readiness state (preserved across project resets)
  modelLoaded: boolean;
  gpuReady: boolean;
  serverConnected: boolean;
  /** Server-reported model state: loading | ready | busy | error (unknown until the first poll). */
  modelStatus: string;

  setActiveTaskId: (id: string | null) => void;
  setStatus: (status: AgentStatus, message?: string) => void;
  setSystemStatus: (status: {
    modelLoaded?: boolean;
    gpuReady?: boolean;
    serverConnected?: boolean;
    modelStatus?: string;
    maxContextTokens?: number;
    max_context_tokens?: number;
    contextTokens?: number;
    context_tokens?: number;
    modelName?: string;
    model_name?: string;
    baseFingerprint?: string;
    base_fingerprint?: string;
    adapterFingerprint?: string;
    adapter_fingerprint?: string;
  }) => void;
  setQueueDepth: (depth: number) => void;
  startTimer: () => void;
  stopTimer: () => void;
  tickTimer: () => void;
  applyEvent: (event: AgentEvent) => void;
  setValidationResult: (res: ValidationResult | null) => void;
  resetAgent: () => void;
}

const defaultMetrics: AgentMetrics = {
  modelName: 'Connecting...',
  baseFingerprint: undefined,
  adapterFingerprint: undefined,
  contextTokens: 0,
  maxContextTokens: 8192,
  generationTokens: 0,
  toolCallsCount: 0,
  repairAttempts: 0,
  maxRepairAttempts: 3,
  turnCount: 0,
  visualScore: undefined,
};

export const useAgentStore = create<AgentStoreState>((set, get) => ({
  activeTaskId: null,
  status: 'idle',
  statusMessage: 'Ready',
  queueDepth: 0,
  startTime: null,
  elapsedSeconds: 0,
  currentActivities: [],
  validationResult: null,
  metrics: defaultMetrics,
  modelLoaded: false,
  gpuReady: false,
  serverConnected: false,
  modelStatus: 'unknown',

  setActiveTaskId: (id) => set({ activeTaskId: id }),
  setSystemStatus: (status) => set((state) => ({
    ...state,
    ...(status.modelLoaded !== undefined ? { modelLoaded: status.modelLoaded } : {}),
    ...(status.gpuReady !== undefined ? { gpuReady: status.gpuReady } : {}),
    ...(status.serverConnected !== undefined ? { serverConnected: status.serverConnected } : {}),
    ...(status.modelStatus !== undefined ? { modelStatus: status.modelStatus } : {}),
    metrics: {
      ...state.metrics,
      ...(status.maxContextTokens ? { maxContextTokens: status.maxContextTokens } : {}),
      ...(status.max_context_tokens ? { maxContextTokens: status.max_context_tokens } : {}),
      ...(status.contextTokens !== undefined ? { contextTokens: status.contextTokens } : {}),
      ...(status.context_tokens !== undefined ? { contextTokens: status.context_tokens } : {}),
      ...(status.model_name ? { modelName: status.model_name } : status.modelName ? { modelName: status.modelName } : {}),
      ...(status.base_fingerprint ? { baseFingerprint: status.base_fingerprint } : status.baseFingerprint ? { baseFingerprint: status.baseFingerprint } : {}),
      ...(status.adapter_fingerprint ? { adapterFingerprint: status.adapter_fingerprint } : status.adapterFingerprint ? { adapterFingerprint: status.adapterFingerprint } : {}),
    },
  })),
  setStatus: (status, message) => set({
    status,
    statusMessage: message || (
      status === 'idle' ? 'Ready' :
      status === 'generating' ? 'Generating...' :
      status === 'typechecking' ? 'Validating TypeScript...' :
      status === 'repairing' ? 'Applying visual repair...' :
      status === 'completed' ? 'Completed' :
      status === 'failed' ? 'Failed' :
      status === 'cancelled' ? 'Cancelled' : status
    )
  }),
  setQueueDepth: (depth) => set({ queueDepth: Math.max(0, depth) }),

  startTimer: () => set({ startTime: Date.now(), elapsedSeconds: 0 }),
  stopTimer: () => set({ startTime: null }),
  tickTimer: () => {
    const { startTime } = get();
    if (startTime) {
      set({ elapsedSeconds: Math.floor((Date.now() - startTime) / 100) / 10 });
    }
  },

  applyEvent: (event) => {
    const t = event.type;
    const d = { ...event, ...(event.data || {}) } as Record<string, any>;

    set((state) => {
      let nextStatus = state.status;
      let nextMsg = state.statusMessage;
      let nextActivities = [...state.currentActivities];
      let nextMetrics = { ...state.metrics };
      let nextValidation = state.validationResult;

      const anyEvt = event as any;
      const incomingMax = d.max_context_tokens || d.maxContextTokens || anyEvt.max_context_tokens || anyEvt.maxContextTokens;
      if (incomingMax) {
        nextMetrics.maxContextTokens = Number(incomingMax);
      }
      const incomingCtx = d.context_tokens || d.contextTokens || anyEvt.context_tokens || anyEvt.contextTokens;
      if (incomingCtx) {
        nextMetrics.contextTokens = Number(incomingCtx);
      }

      if (t === 'transport.status') {
        nextMsg = d.message || nextMsg;
      } else if (t === 'agent.status') {
        const rawStatus = (d.status || d.text || '').toLowerCase();
        if (rawStatus.includes('repair')) nextStatus = 'repairing';
        else if (rawStatus.includes('check') || rawStatus.includes('build') || rawStatus.includes('tsc')) nextStatus = 'typechecking';
        else if (rawStatus.includes('plan')) nextStatus = 'planning';
        else if (rawStatus.includes('complet')) nextStatus = 'completed';
        else if (rawStatus.includes('fail')) nextStatus = 'failed';
        else if (rawStatus.includes('cancel')) nextStatus = 'cancelled';
        else nextStatus = 'generating';
        nextMsg = d.status || d.text || state.statusMessage;
      } else if (t === 'activity.started') {
        const title = d.activity || d.title || 'Task Step';
        const stepId = d.id || `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
        nextActivities.push({
          id: stepId,
          title,
          status: 'running',
          startedAt: Date.now(),
          description: d.description,
          details: d,
        });
        nextMetrics.toolCallsCount += 1;
      } else if (t === 'activity.updated') {
        const lastIdx = nextActivities.length - 1;
        if (lastIdx >= 0) {
          nextActivities[lastIdx] = {
            ...nextActivities[lastIdx],
            description: d.step || d.status || nextActivities[lastIdx].description,
          };
        }
      } else if (t === 'activity.completed') {
        const lastIdx = nextActivities.length - 1;
        if (lastIdx >= 0) {
          nextActivities[lastIdx] = {
            ...nextActivities[lastIdx],
            status: 'completed',
            finishedAt: Date.now(),
            durationMs: d.duration_ms,
          };
        }
      } else if (t === 'file.created' || t === 'file.modified') {
        nextActivities.push({
          id: `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
          title: t === 'file.created' ? `Created ${d.path || d.file || d.filename || 'file'}` : `Updated ${d.path || d.file || d.filename || 'file'}`,
          status: 'completed',
          startedAt: Date.now(),
          finishedAt: Date.now(),
          description: d.diff_summary || `${d.chars || 0} characters`,
          details: d,
        });
        nextMetrics.toolCallsCount += 1;
      } else if (t === 'build.result') {
        const rawTc = d.typecheck_passed ?? d.typecheckPassed;
        const rawBuild = d.build_passed ?? d.buildPassed;
        const rawLint = d.lint_passed ?? d.lintPassed;
        const rawContract = d.contract_passed ?? d.contractPassed;
        const rawA11y = d.accessibility_passed ?? d.accessibilityPassed;
        const rawRuntime = d.runtime_passed ?? d.runtimePassed;
        const rawPreview = d.preview_running ?? d.previewRunning;
        const rawInteraction = d.interaction_passed ?? d.interactionPassed;
        const rawCode = d.code_passed ?? d.codePassed;
        const rawUnverified = Boolean(d.runtime_unverified ?? d.runtimeUnverified ?? false);
        const rawMotion = d.motion_passed ?? d.motionPassed;
        const rawThreeD = d.three_d_passed ?? d.threeDPassed;

        const typecheckStatus: GateTruthState = toGateTruthState(d.typecheck_status ?? rawTc);
        const buildStatus: GateTruthState = toGateTruthState(d.build_status ?? rawBuild);
        const lintStatus: GateTruthState = toGateTruthState(d.lint_status ?? rawLint);
        const contractStatus: GateTruthState = toGateTruthState(d.contract_status ?? rawContract);
        const accessibilityStatus: GateTruthState = toGateTruthState(d.accessibility_status ?? rawA11y);
        const motionStatus: GateTruthState = toGateTruthState(d.motion_status ?? rawMotion);
        const threeDStatus: GateTruthState = toGateTruthState(d.three_d_status ?? rawThreeD);
        const runtimeStatus: GateTruthState = rawUnverified ? 'unverified' : toGateTruthState(d.runtime_status ?? rawRuntime);
        const previewStatus: GateTruthState = toGateTruthState(d.preview_status ?? rawPreview);
        const interactionStatus: GateTruthState = rawUnverified ? 'unverified' : toGateTruthState(d.interaction_status ?? rawInteraction);

        const motionPlan = d.motion_plan ?? d.motionPlan ?? [];
        const motionFailures = d.motion_failures ?? d.motionFailures ?? [];
        const interactionErrors = d.interaction_errors ?? d.interactionErrors ?? [];
        const interactionsTested = Number(d.interactions_tested ?? d.interactionsTested ?? 0);
        const interactionsRequired = Number(d.interactions_required ?? d.interactionsRequired ?? 0);
        const interactionEvidence = d.interaction_evidence ?? d.interactionEvidence ?? [];

        // Derive code status strictly across all static checks
        let codeStatus: GateTruthState = toGateTruthState(rawCode);
        if (rawCode === undefined || rawCode === null) {
          const staticChecks = [typecheckStatus, buildStatus, lintStatus, contractStatus, accessibilityStatus, motionStatus];
          if (staticChecks.some((s) => s === 'failed')) {
            codeStatus = 'failed';
          } else if (staticChecks.every((s) => s === 'passed')) {
            codeStatus = 'passed';
          } else {
            codeStatus = 'unknown';
          }
        }

        // Derive overall passed strictly: only true if all gates passed, not unverified, and interaction passed
        const allGatesPassed = (
          d.passed !== false && d.all_gates_passed !== false &&
          typecheckStatus === 'passed' &&
          buildStatus === 'passed' &&
          lintStatus === 'passed' &&
          contractStatus === 'passed' &&
          accessibilityStatus === 'passed' &&
          motionStatus === 'passed' &&
          (threeDStatus === 'passed' || threeDStatus === 'not_requested') &&
          runtimeStatus === 'passed' &&
          !rawUnverified &&
          previewStatus === 'passed' &&
          (interactionStatus === 'passed' || interactionStatus === 'not_requested')
        );

        nextValidation = {
          ...d,
          typecheck_passed: typecheckStatus === 'passed',
          build_passed: buildStatus === 'passed',
          lint_passed: lintStatus === 'passed',
          contract_passed: contractStatus === 'passed',
          accessibility_passed: accessibilityStatus === 'passed',
          motion_passed: motionStatus === 'passed',
          three_d_passed: threeDStatus === 'passed' || threeDStatus === 'not_requested',
          three_d_status: threeDStatus,
          runtime_passed: runtimeStatus === 'passed' && !rawUnverified,
          preview_running: previewStatus === 'passed',
          interaction_passed: interactionStatus === 'passed',
          interactions_tested: interactionsTested,
          interactions_required: interactionsRequired,
          interaction_evidence: interactionEvidence,
          interaction_errors: interactionErrors,
          runtime_unverified: rawUnverified,
          typecheck_status: typecheckStatus,
          build_status: buildStatus,
          lint_status: lintStatus,
          contract_status: contractStatus,
          accessibility_status: accessibilityStatus,
          motion_status: motionStatus,
          runtime_status: runtimeStatus,
          preview_status: previewStatus,
          interaction_status: interactionStatus,
          code_status: codeStatus,
          code_passed: codeStatus === 'passed',
          passed: allGatesPassed,
          all_gates_passed: allGatesPassed,
          motion_plan: motionPlan,
          motion_failures: motionFailures,
          errors: d.errors || [],
          warnings: d.warnings || [],
          repair_attempts: d.repair_attempts || 0,
        };
        nextMetrics.repairAttempts = d.repair_attempts || nextMetrics.repairAttempts;
        nextMetrics.hasMotion = motionPlan.length > 0;
        nextMetrics.motionVerified = motionStatus === 'passed' && motionPlan.length > 0;
      } else if (t === 'task.completed') {
        nextStatus = 'completed';
        nextMsg = 'Generation completed successfully';
      } else if (t === 'task.failed') {
        nextStatus = 'failed';
        nextMsg = d.error || 'Generation failed';
      }

      return {
        status: nextStatus,
        statusMessage: nextMsg,
        currentActivities: nextActivities,
        metrics: nextMetrics,
        validationResult: nextValidation,
      };
    });
  },

  setValidationResult: (res) => set({ validationResult: res }),

  resetAgent: () => set({
    activeTaskId: null,
    status: 'idle',
    statusMessage: 'Ready',
    currentActivities: [],
    validationResult: null,
    startTime: null,
    elapsedSeconds: 0,
    metrics: { ...defaultMetrics },
  }),
}));

import { create } from 'zustand';

export type ConfirmVariant = 'danger' | 'warning' | 'default';

export interface ConfirmOptions {
  title: string;
  message: React.ReactNode;
  confirmText?: string;
  cancelText?: string;
  variant?: ConfirmVariant;
  destructive?: boolean;
}

interface ConfirmStoreState {
  isOpen: boolean;
  options: ConfirmOptions | null;
  resolveCallback: ((value: boolean) => void) | null;
  show: (options: ConfirmOptions) => Promise<boolean>;
  confirm: () => void;
  cancel: () => void;
}

export const useConfirmStore = create<ConfirmStoreState>((set, get) => ({
  isOpen: false,
  options: null,
  resolveCallback: null,

  show: (options) => {
    return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
      set({
        isOpen: true,
        options: {
          ...options,
          variant: options.variant ?? (options.destructive ? 'danger' : 'default'),
          confirmText: options.confirmText ?? (options.variant === 'danger' || options.destructive ? 'Confirm' : 'OK'),
          cancelText: options.cancelText ?? 'Cancel',
        },
        resolveCallback: resolve,
      });
    });
  },

  confirm: () => {
    const { resolveCallback } = get();
    if (resolveCallback) {
      resolveCallback(true);
    }
    set({ isOpen: false, options: null, resolveCallback: null });
  },

  cancel: () => {
    const { resolveCallback } = get();
    if (resolveCallback) {
      resolveCallback(false);
    }
    set({ isOpen: false, options: null, resolveCallback: null });
  },
}));

/**
 * Convenient React hook to request confirmation dialogs asynchronously.
 */
export function useConfirm() {
  const show = useConfirmStore((s) => s.show);
  return show;
}
`````
