`````tsx
import { create } from 'zustand';

export type ToastType = 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';

export interface ToastItem {
  id: string;
  type: ToastType;
  title: string;
  message?: string;
  duration?: number;
}

interface ToastStoreState {
  toasts: ToastItem[];
  addToast: (toast: Omit<ToastItem, 'id'>) => string;
  removeToast: (id: string) => void;
  clearToasts: () => void;
}

export const useToastStore = create<ToastStoreState>((set) => ({
  toasts: [],

  addToast: (toast) => {
    const id = `toast-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
    const newItem: ToastItem = {
      ...toast,
      id,
      duration: toast.duration ?? (toast.type === 'error' ? 6000 : 4000),
    };

    set((state) => ({
      toasts: [...state.toasts, newItem],
    }));

    if (newItem.duration && newItem.duration > 0) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        set((state) => ({
          toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== id),
        }));
      }, newItem.duration);
    }

    return id;
  },

  removeToast: (id) =>
    set((state) => ({
      toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== id),
    })),

  clearToasts: () => set({ toasts: [] }),
}));

/**
 * Convenient imperative helper for triggering toasts anywhere in the codebase.
 */
export const toast = {
  success(title: string, message?: string, duration?: number) {
    return useToastStore.getState().addToast({ type: 'success', title, message, duration });
  },
  error(title: string, message?: string, duration?: number) {
    return useToastStore.getState().addToast({ type: 'error', title, message, duration });
  },
  warning(title: string, message?: string, duration?: number) {
    return useToastStore.getState().addToast({ type: 'warning', title, message, duration });
  },
  info(title: string, message?: string, duration?: number) {
    return useToastStore.getState().addToast({ type: 'info', title, message, duration });
  },
};
`````

`````tsx
/**
 * Typed client API service for the ReactAgent SLM server endpoints.
 */

import { CanonicalTurnDiff } from '../types/chat';

export interface GenerateParams {
  prompt: string;
  session_id?: string;
  mode?: 'component' | 'site';
  max_turns?: number;
  stylePreset?: string;
  style_preset?: string;
  max_tokens?: number;
  /** Site writer: 'kit' (model writes copy, kit writes code) or 'native' (model writes code too). */
  strategy?: 'kit' | 'native';
}

export interface StylePresetItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  isDefault?: boolean;
}

export interface StylePresetsResponse {
  presets: StylePresetItem[];
  default: string;
}

export interface GenerateResponse {
  task_id: string;
  session_id: string;
  status: 'queued' | 'running' | 'completed';
  queue_position: number;
  stream_url: string;
  deduplicated?: boolean;
}

export interface PreviewStatus {
  status: 'ready' | 'error' | 'empty';
  url?: string;
  error?: string;
  message?: string;
}

export interface TaskStatusResponse {
  task_id: string;
  status: 'completed' | 'blocked' | 'failed' | 'running' | 'queued' | 'cancelled' | 'not_found';
  data?: any;
  position?: number;
}

export const api = {
  async getStatus(): Promise<{
    model_status: string;
    model_loaded: boolean;
    adapter_compatible: boolean | null;
    gpu_ready: boolean;
    loaded_model_path?: string | null;
    configured_model_path?: string;
    promotion_gate_status?: string;
    queue_depth: number;
    max_context_tokens?: number;
    model_name?: string;
    model_path?: string;
    base_model?: string;
    base_fingerprint?: string;
    adapter_fingerprint?: string;
    is_qwen3_architecture?: boolean;
    mock?: boolean;
    project_websocket_url?: string;
    project_websocket_ready?: boolean;
  }> {
    const res = await fetch('/api/status');
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to fetch status: ${res.statusText}`);
    return res.json();
  },

  async getStylePresets(): Promise<StylePresetsResponse> {
    const res = await fetch('/api/style-presets');
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch style presets');
    return res.json();
  },

  async getProjects(): Promise<any[]> {
    const res = await fetch('/api/projects');
    if (!res.ok) {
      // Fallback to sessions endpoint
      const fallback = await fetch('/api/sessions');
      if (!fallback.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch projects');
      const fallbackData = await fallback.json();
      return Array.isArray(fallbackData) ? fallbackData : (fallbackData.projects || fallbackData.sessions || []);
    }
    const data = await res.json();
    return Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.projects || data.sessions || []);
  },

  async getProject(id: string): Promise<any> {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
    if (!res.ok) {
      const fallback = await fetch(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
      if (!fallback.ok) throw new Error(`Project ${id} not found`);
      return fallback.json();
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async generate(params: GenerateParams): Promise<GenerateResponse> {
    const res = await fetch('/api/generate', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(params),
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: res.statusText }));
      throw new Error(err.error || 'Generation request failed');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async getTaskStatus(taskId: string): Promise<TaskStatusResponse> {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/generation/${encodeURIComponent(taskId)}/status`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Task status failed: ${res.statusText}`);
    return res.json();
  },

  async cancelTask(taskId: string, options?: { clear_queue?: boolean }): Promise<void> {
    const clear_queue = options?.clear_queue ?? false;
    const res = await fetch(`/api/cancel/${encodeURIComponent(taskId)}?clear_queue=${clear_queue}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ clear_queue }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Cancellation failed');
  },

  async cancelAll(): Promise<void> {
    const res = await fetch('/api/cancel/all', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ clear_queue: true }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to cancel all tasks');
  },

  async getDiff(sessionId: string, turnId: number): Promise<CanonicalTurnDiff> {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}/diff/${turnId}`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch diff');
    return res.json();
  },

  async revertTurn(sessionId: string, turnId: number): Promise<any> {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}/revert/${turnId}`, {
      method: 'POST',
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Revert failed');
    return res.json();
  },

  async deleteProject(id: string): Promise<void> {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/history/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to delete project');
  },

  async clearAllHistory(): Promise<void> {
    const res = await fetch('/api/history', { method: 'DELETE' });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to clear history');
  },

  async getShellToken(): Promise<{ ticket: string; host: string; port: number }> {
    const res = await fetch('/api/shell-token');
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to mint shell token');
    const data = await res.json();
    return {
      ticket: data.ticket || data.token || '',
      host: data.host || (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.hostname : '127.0.0.1') || '127.0.0.1',
      port: data.port || 5001,
    };
  },

  /** Build (or reuse) the isolated preview. `rebuild` forces a fresh production build. */
  async getPreview(projectId: string, rebuild = false): Promise<PreviewStatus> {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/preview`, { method: rebuild ? 'POST' : 'GET' });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Preview request failed (HTTP ${res.status})`);
    return res.json();
  },

  async getProjectLogs(projectId: string): Promise<{ timestamp?: number; type?: string; log?: string; task_id?: string }[]> {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/logs`);
    if (!res.ok) return [];
    const data = await res.json();
    return Array.isArray(data.logs) ? data.logs : [];
  },

  getProjectExportUrl(projectId: string): string {
    return `/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/export`;
  },

  async saveProjectFile(
    projectId: string,
    file: string,
    content: string
  ): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    file: string;
    turnId: number;
    validation?: any;
    build_state?: any;
    files: Record<string, string>;
    preview?: any;
  }> {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/file`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ file, content }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'Failed to save file' }));
      throw new Error(err.error || 'Failed to save file');
    }
    return res.json();
  },

  async deleteProjectFile(
    projectId: string,
    file: string
  ): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    file: string;
    turnId: number;
    validation?: any;
    build_state?: any;
    files: Record<string, string>;
    preview?: any;
  }> {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${encodeURIComponent(projectId)}/file`, {
      method: 'DELETE',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ file }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'Failed to delete file' }));
      throw new Error(err.error || 'Failed to delete file');
    }
    return res.json();
  },
};
`````

`````tsx
/**
 * frontend/src/services/project-ws.ts
 * Authoritative Project WebSocket Client (/ws/projects/:projectId).
 * 
 * Features:
 * - Monotonically increasing sequence numbers (seq / eventId)
 * - Missed event replay on reconnect (?lastEventId=N and subscribe.events)
 * - Bidirectional messaging:
 *     Client -> task.start, task.cancel, prompt.queue, preview.selection, subscribe.events
 *     Server -> connection.ready, agent.status, activity.*, file.*, command.*,
 *               build.result, preview.ready, task.started, task.completed, task.failed, task.cancelled
 * - Automatic exponential backoff reconnect
 * - Graceful fallback to SSE when WebSocket is unavailable
 */

import { AgentEvent, ClientMessageType } from '../types/agent';
import { api } from './api';

export interface ProjectStreamCallbacks {
  onEvent: (event: AgentEvent) => void;
  onResult?: (result: any) => void;
  onDone?: () => void;
  onError?: (err: Error) => void;
}

export class ProjectWebSocketClient {
  private socket: WebSocket | null = null;
  private projectId: string | null = null;
  private activeTaskId: string | null = null;
  private callbacks: ProjectStreamCallbacks | null = null;
  private lastEventId: number = 0;
  private reconnectAttempts = 0;
  private maxReconnectAttempts = 5;
  private reconnectTimeout: any = null;
  private stableConnectionTimeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private isClosed = false;
  private endpoint: string | null = null;
  private fallbackSSE: any = null;

  /**
   * Connects to the authoritative project WebSocket channel: /ws/projects/:projectId
   */
  public connect(projectId: string, callbacks: ProjectStreamCallbacks, taskId?: string) {
    const isSameProject = this.projectId === projectId;
    // Project selection effects must not replace an in-flight task's callbacks.
    if (isSameProject && this.activeTaskId && !taskId && !this.isClosed) return;
    if (!isSameProject) {
      this.disconnect();
      this.lastEventId = 0;
    } else {
      // Reconnecting to same project, close socket but preserve lastEventId for replay
      if (this.socket) {
        this.socket.onclose = null;
        try {
          this.socket.close();
        } catch (_) {}
        this.socket = null;
      }
      this.clearStableConnectionTimer();
      this.fallbackSSE?.disconnect();
      this.fallbackSSE = null;
      if (this.reconnectTimeout) {
        clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimeout);
        this.reconnectTimeout = null;
      }
    }
    this.projectId = projectId;
    this.activeTaskId = taskId || null;
    this.callbacks = callbacks;
    this.reconnectAttempts = 0;
    this.isClosed = false;

    this.initWebSocket();
  }

  public getProjectId(): string | null {
    return this.projectId;
  }

  public getLastEventId(): number {
    return this.lastEventId;
  }

  public getActiveTaskId(): string | null {
    return this.activeTaskId;
  }

  public setActiveTaskId(taskId: string | null) {
    this.activeTaskId = taskId;
  }

  public setEndpoint(endpoint: string | null) {
    this.endpoint = endpoint;
  }

  public setCallbacks(callbacks: ProjectStreamCallbacks | null) {
    this.callbacks = callbacks;
  }

  public getCallbacks(): ProjectStreamCallbacks | null {
    return this.callbacks;
  }

  /**
   * Connects to authoritative project channel for task streaming.
   * If projectId is provided, connects directly over WebSocket;
   * falls back to SSE only if WebSocket is unavailable.
   */
  public streamTask(taskId: string, callbacks: ProjectStreamCallbacks, projectId?: string) {
    if (projectId) {
      this.connect(projectId, callbacks, taskId);
    } else {
      this.callbacks = callbacks;
      this.activeTaskId = taskId;
      this.startSSEFallback();
    }
  }

  public isConnected(): boolean {
    return Boolean(this.socket && this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN);
  }

  private initWebSocket() {
    if (this.isClosed || !this.projectId) return;

    try {
      const protocol = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location?.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
      const host = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location?.host ? window.location.host : '127.0.0.1:5173';
      const queryParam = `?lastEventId=${this.lastEventId}`;
      const wsUrl = `${this.endpoint || `${protocol}//${host}/ws/projects`}/${encodeURIComponent(this.projectId)}${queryParam}`;

      const socket = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
      this.socket = socket;

      this.socket.onopen = () => {
        if (socket !== this.socket || this.isClosed) return;
        // An open handshake is insufficient: malformed frames may close immediately.
        this.stableConnectionTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
          if (socket === this.socket && socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) this.reconnectAttempts = 0;
          this.stableConnectionTimeout = null;
        }, 10000);
        // If reconnecting with previous sequence position, request replayed events
        if (this.lastEventId > 0) {
          this.sendSubscribeEvents(this.lastEventId);
        }
      };

      this.socket.onmessage = (messageEvent) => {
        if (socket !== this.socket || this.isClosed) return;
        if (!messageEvent.data) return;
        try {
          const payload = typeof messageEvent.data === 'string' ? JSON.parse(messageEvent.data) : messageEvent.data;
          this.handleServerMessage(payload);
        } catch (parseErr) {
          console.warn('[Project WS] JSON parse error:', parseErr, messageEvent.data);
        }
      };

      this.socket.onerror = (errEvent) => {
        console.warn('[Project WS] Socket error:', errEvent);
      };

      this.socket.onclose = (closeEvent) => {
        if (socket !== this.socket) return;
        this.clearStableConnectionTimer();
        this.socket = null;
        if (!this.isClosed) {
          if (this.reconnectAttempts < this.maxReconnectAttempts) {
            this.reconnectAttempts += 1;
            this.reportTransport(`Live connection interrupted. Reconnecting (${this.reconnectAttempts}/${this.maxReconnectAttempts})...`);
            const delay = Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(1.5, this.reconnectAttempts), 5000);
            this.reconnectTimeout = setTimeout(() => this.initWebSocket(), delay);
          } else {
            console.warn('[Project WS] Max reconnect attempts reached, falling back to SSE for task:', this.activeTaskId);
            this.reportTransport('Live connection unavailable. Switching to backup event stream.');
            this.startSSEFallback();
          }
        }
      };
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.warn('[Project WS] Failed to initialize WebSocket:', e);
      this.startSSEFallback();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Processes inbound server messages matching target architecture taxonomy.
   */
  private handleServerMessage(payload: any) {
    if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return;

    // Track monotonic sequence counter
    const seq = payload.seq ?? payload.eventId;
    if (typeof seq === 'number' && seq <= this.lastEventId) return;
    if (typeof seq === 'number' && seq > this.lastEventId) {
      this.lastEventId = seq;
    }

    const type = payload.type || 'agent.status';

    // Heartbeats and greetings
    if (type === 'heartbeat' || type === 'pong') {
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'connection.ready') {
      if (typeof payload.latest_seq === 'number' && payload.latest_seq > this.lastEventId) {
        // Initial sync point
      }
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'task.acknowledged' || type === 'task.started') {
      const ackTaskId = payload.task_id || payload.taskId || payload.data?.task_id || payload.data?.taskId;
      if (ackTaskId) {
        this.activeTaskId = ackTaskId;
      }
    }

    // Done / finalization signals
    if (type === 'done' || type === 'task.completed') {
      if (payload.data?.files || payload.data?.result) {
        this.callbacks?.onResult?.(payload.data.result || payload.data);
      }
      this.callbacks?.onDone?.();
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'task.failed' && payload.data?.cancelled) {
      this.callbacks?.onDone?.();
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'task.cancelled') {
      this.callbacks?.onDone?.();
      return;
    }

    // Build structured AgentEvent
    const agentEvent: AgentEvent = {
      type: type,
      timestamp: payload.timestamp ? (payload.timestamp > 1e11 ? payload.timestamp : payload.timestamp * 1000) : Date.now(),
      data: { ...payload, ...(payload.data || {}) },
      task_id: payload.task_id || this.activeTaskId || undefined,
      project_id: payload.project_id || this.projectId || undefined,
      seq: typeof seq === 'number' ? seq : undefined,
      eventId: typeof seq === 'number' ? seq : undefined,
      chat: payload.chat,
      log: payload.log,
    };

    this.callbacks?.onEvent(agentEvent);

    if (type === 'task.failed') {
      if (payload.data?.result) this.callbacks?.onResult?.(payload.data.result);
      this.callbacks?.onDone?.();
      return;
    }

    // If result payload is attached directly
    if (payload.type === 'result' && payload.data) {
      this.callbacks?.onResult?.(payload.data);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Sends a typed message to the backend over WebSocket.
   */
  public send(message: { type: ClientMessageType | string; [key: string]: any }): boolean {
    if (this.socket && this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      this.socket.send(JSON.stringify(message));
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * Client -> task.start
   */
  public sendTaskStart(prompt: string, mode?: string, options?: Record<string, any>): boolean {
    return this.send({
      type: 'task.start',
      prompt,
      mode,
      options: options || {},
    });
  }

  /**
   * Client -> task.cancel (Bidirectional cancellation)
   */
  public sendTaskCancel(reason: string = 'user_cancelled'): boolean {
    return this.send({
      type: 'task.cancel',
      reason,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Client -> prompt.queue
   */
  public sendPromptQueue(prompt: string, options?: Record<string, any>): boolean {
    return this.send({
      type: 'prompt.queue',
      prompt,
      options: options || {},
    });
  }

  /**
   * Client -> preview.selection
   */
  public sendPreviewSelection(selection: Record<string, any>): boolean {
    return this.send({
      type: 'preview.selection',
      selection,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Client -> subscribe.events (replays missed events after lastEventId)
   */
  public sendSubscribeEvents(lastEventId: number): boolean {
    return this.send({
      type: 'subscribe.events',
      lastEventId,
    });
  }

  private fallbackFactory: ((taskId: string, callbacks: ProjectStreamCallbacks) => { disconnect: () => void }) | null = null;

  public setFallbackFactory(factory: (taskId: string, callbacks: ProjectStreamCallbacks) => { disconnect: () => void }) {
    this.fallbackFactory = factory;
  }

  /**
   * Temporary SSE fallback if WebSocket is rejected or unavailable.
   */
  private startSSEFallback() {
    if (!this.activeTaskId || this.isClosed || this.fallbackSSE) return;
    if (this.fallbackFactory && this.callbacks) {
      try {
        this.fallbackSSE = this.fallbackFactory(this.activeTaskId, this.callbacks);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[Project WS] Fallback factory error:', e);
      }
    }
  }

  private clearStableConnectionTimer() {
    if (this.stableConnectionTimeout) clearTimeout(this.stableConnectionTimeout);
    this.stableConnectionTimeout = null;
  }

  private reportTransport(message: string) {
    this.callbacks?.onEvent({type:'transport.status', timestamp:Date.now(), data:{message}});
  }

  /**
   * Disconnects the WebSocket channel and cancels pending reconnects.
   */
  public disconnect() {
    this.isClosed = true;
    this.clearStableConnectionTimer();
    if (this.reconnectTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimeout);
      this.reconnectTimeout = null;
    }
    if (this.socket) {
      try {
        this.socket.close();
      } catch (_) {}
      this.socket = null;
    }
    if (this.fallbackSSE) {
      try {
        this.fallbackSSE.disconnect();
      } catch (_) {}
      this.fallbackSSE = null;
    }
    this.projectId = null;
    this.activeTaskId = null;
    this.callbacks = null;
    this.lastEventId = 0;
  }
}

export const projectWsClient = new ProjectWebSocketClient();
`````

`````tsx
import { api } from './api';

export interface ShellSessionCallbacks {
  onData: (data: string) => void;
  onOpen?: () => void;
  onClose?: (code: number, reason: string) => void;
  onError?: (err: Event) => void;
}

export class ShellClient {
  private socket: WebSocket | null = null;
  private callbacks: ShellSessionCallbacks | null = null;

  /** `cwd` is the project folder to open the shell in (the server only allows generated projects). */
  public async connect(callbacks: ShellSessionCallbacks, cwd?: string) {
    this.disconnect();
    this.callbacks = callbacks;

    try {
      const { ticket, host, port } = await api.getShellToken();
      // If we are in dev with Vite proxy or direct host:
      const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
      // shell_server.py authenticates the handshake from the `token` query parameter.
      const wsUrl = `${protocol}//${host || window.location.hostname}:${port || 5001}/?token=${encodeURIComponent(ticket)}${cwd ? `&cwd=${encodeURIComponent(cwd)}` : ''}`;

      this.socket = new WebSocket(wsUrl);

      this.socket.onopen = () => {
        this.callbacks?.onOpen?.();
      };

      this.socket.onmessage = (event) => {
        this.callbacks?.onData(event.data);
      };

      this.socket.onclose = (e) => {
        this.callbacks?.onClose?.(e.code, e.reason);
        this.socket = null;
      };

      this.socket.onerror = (e) => {
        this.callbacks?.onError?.(e);
      };
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('[Shell] Failed to connect to terminal socket:', err);
      callbacks.onData(`\r\n\x1b[31m[Shell Connection Error]\x1b[0m ${err.message}\r\n`);
    }
  }

  public send(data: string) {
    if (this.socket && this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      this.socket.send(data);
    }
  }

  public resize(cols: number, rows: number) {
    if (this.socket && this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      this.socket.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'resize', cols, rows }));
    }
  }

  public disconnect() {
    if (this.socket) {
      try {
        this.socket.close();
      } catch (_) {}
      this.socket = null;
    }
    this.callbacks = null;
  }
}

export const shellClient = new ShellClient();
`````

`````tsx
/**
 * frontend/src/services/sse.ts
 * 
 * COMPATIBILITY FALLBACK ONLY — SSE Transport Shim.
 * Authoritative primary transport is ProjectWebSocketClient (/ws/projects/:projectId)
 * in frontend/src/services/project-ws.ts.
 * 
 * SSE (/api/stream/:taskId) is retained strictly as a compatibility fallback
 * when WebSocket connection is rejected or unavailable.
 */

import { AgentEvent } from '../types/agent';
import { api } from './api';
import { projectWsClient } from './project-ws';

export interface SSEListenerCallbacks {
  onEvent: (event: AgentEvent) => void;
  onResult?: (result: any) => void;
  onDone?: () => void;
  onError?: (err: Error) => void;
}

export class TaskStreamManager {
  private eventSource: EventSource | null = null;
  private taskId: string | null = null;
  private projectId: string | null = null;
  private callbacks: SSEListenerCallbacks | null = null;
  private reconnectAttempts = 0;
  private maxReconnectAttempts = 5;
  private reconnectTimeout: any = null;
  private pollingInterval: any = null;
  private isClosed = false;

  /**
   * Connects to the authoritative real-time stream.
   * Prefers WebSocket (/ws/projects/:projectId) and falls back to SSE (/api/stream/:taskId).
   */
  public connect(taskId: string, callbacks: SSEListenerCallbacks, projectId?: string) {
    this.disconnect();
    this.taskId = taskId;
    this.projectId = projectId || null;
    this.callbacks = callbacks;
    this.reconnectAttempts = 0;
    this.isClosed = false;

    if (this.projectId) {
      projectWsClient.connect(this.projectId, callbacks, taskId);
    } else {
      this.startSSE();
    }
  }

  public sendTaskCancel(reason: string = 'user_cancelled') {
    projectWsClient.sendTaskCancel(reason);
  }

  private startSSE() {
    if (this.isClosed || !this.taskId) return;

    const streamUrl = `/api/stream/${encodeURIComponent(this.taskId)}`;
    try {
      this.eventSource = new EventSource(streamUrl);

      this.eventSource.onmessage = (event) => {
        if (!event.data) return;
        try {
          const payload = JSON.parse(event.data);

          if (payload.type === 'heartbeat') {
            return;
          }

          if (payload.type === 'result') {
            this.callbacks?.onResult?.(payload.data);
            return;
          }

          if (payload.type === 'done') {
            this.callbacks?.onDone?.();
            this.disconnect();
            return;
          }

          // Structured event
          const agentEvent: AgentEvent = {
            type: payload.type || 'agent.status',
            timestamp: payload.timestamp ? payload.timestamp * 1000 : Date.now(),
            data: { ...payload, ...(payload.data || {}) },
            task_id: payload.task_id || this.taskId || undefined,
            chat: payload.chat,
            log: payload.log,
          };
          this.callbacks?.onEvent(agentEvent);
          if (payload.type === 'task.failed' || payload.type === 'task.completed') {
            if (payload.data?.result) this.callbacks?.onResult?.(payload.data.result);
            this.callbacks?.onDone?.();
            this.disconnect();
          }
        } catch (parseErr) {
          console.warn('[SSE] Parse error:', parseErr, event.data);
        }
      };

      this.eventSource.onerror = (err) => {
        console.warn('[SSE] Error on stream:', err);
        this.eventSource?.close();
        this.eventSource = null;

        if (this.reconnectAttempts < this.maxReconnectAttempts) {
          this.reconnectAttempts += 1;
          const delay = Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(1.5, this.reconnectAttempts), 5000);
          this.reconnectTimeout = setTimeout(() => this.startSSE(), delay);
        } else {
          // Fall back to polling status endpoint
          console.warn('[SSE] Falling back to polling status for task:', this.taskId);
          this.startPollingFallback();
        }
      };
    } catch (e: any) {
      this.callbacks?.onError?.(e);
      this.startPollingFallback();
    }
  }

  private startPollingFallback() {
    if (this.pollingInterval || this.isClosed || !this.taskId) return;

    this.pollingInterval = setInterval(async () => {
      if (!this.taskId || this.isClosed) {
        this.stopPollingFallback();
        return;
      }
      try {
        const res = await api.getTaskStatus(this.taskId);
        if ((res.status === 'completed' || res.status === 'blocked' || res.status === 'failed') && res.data) {
          this.callbacks?.onResult?.(res.data);
          this.callbacks?.onDone?.();
          this.disconnect();
        } else if (res.status === 'cancelled' || res.status === 'not_found') {
          this.callbacks?.onDone?.();
          this.disconnect();
        }
      } catch (pollErr) {
        console.warn('[SSE Polling Error]:', pollErr);
      }
    }, 2000);
  }

  private stopPollingFallback() {
    if (this.pollingInterval) {
      clearInterval(this.pollingInterval);
      this.pollingInterval = null;
    }
  }

  public disconnect() {
    this.isClosed = true;
    try {
      // A task-only fallback does not own the project WebSocket lifecycle.
      if (this.projectId && projectWsClient.getProjectId() === this.projectId) projectWsClient.disconnect();
    } catch (_) {}
    if (this.eventSource) {
      try {
        this.eventSource.close();
      } catch (_) {}
      this.eventSource = null;
    }
    if (this.reconnectTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimeout);
      this.reconnectTimeout = null;
    }
    this.stopPollingFallback();
    this.taskId = null;
    this.projectId = null;
    this.callbacks = null;
  }
}

export const streamManager = new TaskStreamManager();

projectWsClient.setFallbackFactory((taskId, callbacks) => {
  const fallback = new TaskStreamManager();
  fallback.connect(taskId, callbacks);
  return fallback;
});
`````

`````tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

}

export const MessageList: React.FC<MessageListProps> = ({ onSelectPrompt }) => {

  const { currentActivities, status } = useAgentStore();
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [siteDetails, setSiteDetails] = useState({ topic: '', audience: '', pages: '', content: '', style: '', effects: '', assets: '' });

  const selectStructuredPrompt = () => {
    const fields: Array<[string, string]> = [
      ['Topic', siteDetails.topic], ['Audience', siteDetails.audience], ['Pages or sections', siteDetails.pages],
      ['Required content and interactions', siteDetails.content], ['Visual style', siteDetails.style],
      ['3D and motion', siteDetails.effects], ['Available assets', siteDetails.assets],
    ];
    const details = fields.filter(([, value]) => value.trim()).map(([label, value]) => `${label}: ${value.trim()}`);
    if (details.length) onSelectPrompt?.(`Build a complete, responsive website.\n${details.join('\n')}`);

      scrollRef.current.scrollTop = scrollRef.current.scrollHeight;

  }, [messages, currentActivities, isWorking]);

  const suggestionChips = [

    { label: 'Create a 3D site', prompt: 'Create a 3D interactive landing page with a rotating globe using Three.js' },
    { label: 'SaaS landing page', prompt: 'Build a sleek SaaS landing page with hero, feature grid, pricing tiers, and testimonials' },
    { label: 'Interactive dashboard', prompt: 'Build an interactive analytics dashboard with KPI cards and chart placeholders' },
  ];

  return (

      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto w-full space-y-4">
        {messages.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="min-h-[58vh] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center gap-5 select-none">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white">
                What do you want to build?
              </h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Describe the site you have in mind, or start with a few details below.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Prompt suggestion chips */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 max-w-lg">
              {suggestionChips.map((item) => (
                <button
                  key={item.label}
                  onClick={() => onSelectPrompt?.(item.prompt)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/[0.04] hover:bg-white/[0.08] text-slate-300 hover:text-white border border-white/[0.06] text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {item.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <details className="w-full max-w-xl rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-white/[0.03] text-left group">
              <summary className="cursor-pointer list-none px-4 py-3 text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-400">
                Help me describe my website <span aria-hidden="true" className="float-right text-slate-500 group-open:rotate-180">⌄</span>
              </summary>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 px-4 pb-4">
                {([
                  ['topic', 'Topic or business', 'e.g. ceramics studio'],
                  ['audience', 'Audience', 'e.g. local shoppers'],
                  ['pages', 'Pages or sections', 'e.g. home, catalog, about'],
                  ['content', 'Content and interactions', 'e.g. prices, filters, booking'],
                  ['style', 'Visual style', 'e.g. warm editorial'],
                  ['effects', '3D and motion', 'e.g. subtle scroll reveals'],
                  ['assets', 'Assets you have', 'e.g. logo and product photos'],
                ] as const).map(([key, label, placeholder]) => (
                  <label key={key} className="block text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                    {label}
                    <input
                      value={siteDetails[key]}
                      onChange={(event) => setSiteDetails((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: event.target.value }))}
                      placeholder={placeholder}
                      className="mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border border-white/[0.1] bg-slate-950/60 px-2.5 py-2 text-xs text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-sky-400"
                    />
                  </label>
                ))}
                <div className="flex items-end">
                  <button type="button" onClick={selectStructuredPrompt} disabled={!Object.values(siteDetails).some((value) => value.trim())}
                    className="w-full rounded-md bg-sky-500 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-950 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-400">
                    Add details to prompt
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </details>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {messages.map((msg) => {
              if (msg.role === 'user') {
                return <UserMessage key={msg.id} message={msg} />;
              }
              if (msg.role === 'assistant') {
                return <AssistantMessage key={msg.id} message={msg} />;
              }
              if (msg.role === 'summary' && msg.summary) {
                return <ChangeSummary key={msg.id} summary={msg.summary} />;
              }
              if (msg.role === 'error') {
                return (
                  <div
                    key={msg.id}
                    className="my-2 p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 text-xs font-mono"
                  >
                    [Error] {msg.content}
                  </div>
                );
              }
              return null;
            })}

            {/* Live Activity Card for the currently active task */}
            {isWorking && currentActivities.length > 0 && (
              <ActivityMessage steps={currentActivities} isActive={true} />
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
`````

`````tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { ActivityStep as IActivityStep } from '../../types/agent';
import { ActivityStep } from './ActivityStep';
import { useAgentStore } from '../../state/agent-store';

interface ActivityMessageProps {
  steps: IActivityStep[];
  isActive?: boolean;
}

export const ActivityMessage: React.FC<ActivityMessageProps> = ({ steps, isActive }) => {
  const [isCollapsed, setIsCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const { statusMessage } = useAgentStore();

  if (!steps || steps.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="flex items-start gap-3 my-3 select-text">
      <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-md bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/25 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
        <Sparkles size={13} />
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 max-w-xl rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm border border-white/[0.06] bg-[#191919] overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
        <div
          onClick={() => setIsCollapsed(!isCollapsed)}
          className="px-3.5 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer hover:bg-white/[0.02] transition-colors select-none"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-200">
            {isActive ? (
              <Loader2 size={13} className="animate-spin text-emerald-400" />
            ) : (
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" />
            )}
            <span className="font-semibold">{statusMessage || 'Building website...'}</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-400">
              {steps.length} {steps.length === 1 ? 'step' : 'steps'}
            </span>
          </div>

          <button className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200">
            {isCollapsed ? <ChevronRight size={13} /> : <ChevronDown size={13} />}
          </button>
        </div>

        {!isCollapsed && (
          <div className="p-2 pt-0 space-y-0.5 border-t border-white/[0.04]">
            {steps.map((step) => (
              <ActivityStep key={step.id} step={step} />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
`````

`````tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  CheckCircle2, 
  XCircle, 
  Loader2, 
  ChevronDown, 
  ChevronRight, 
  FileCode, 
  Terminal, 
  Package, 
  Sparkles 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ActivityStep as IActivityStep } from '../../types/agent';

interface ActivityStepProps {
  step: IActivityStep;
}

export const ActivityStep: React.FC<ActivityStepProps> = ({ step }) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const getStepIcon = () => {
    if (step.title.includes('Created') || step.title.includes('Updated') || step.title.includes('write')) {
      return <FileCode size={13} className="text-teal-400" />;
    }
    if (step.title.includes('npm') || step.title.includes('install')) {
      return <Package size={13} className="text-amber-400" />;
    }
    if (step.title.includes('command') || step.title.includes('Running')) {
      return <Terminal size={13} className="text-indigo-400" />;
    }
    return <Sparkles size={13} className="text-emerald-400" />;
  };

  const hasDetails = Boolean(step.description || step.details || step.args || step.output);

  return (
    <div className="border-b border-white/[0.04] last:border-b-0 py-2 font-mono text-xs">
      <div
        onClick={() => hasDetails && setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-2 py-1 rounded transition-colors ${
          hasDetails ? 'cursor-pointer hover:bg-white/[0.03]' : ''
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
          {step.status === 'running' ? (
            <Loader2 size={13} className="animate-spin text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          ) : step.status === 'completed' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 size={13} className="text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <XCircle size={13} className="text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
          )}

          {getStepIcon()}

          <span className="truncate text-slate-200 font-sans font-medium text-xs">
            {step.title}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
          {step.durationMs !== undefined && (
            <span className="text-slate-500">{step.durationMs}ms</span>
          )}
          {hasDetails && (
            <span className="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-300">
              {isOpen ? <ChevronDown size={13} /> : <ChevronRight size={13} />}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {isOpen && hasDetails && (
        <div className="mt-1.5 ml-6 mr-2 p-2 rounded bg-black/40 border border-white/[0.04] space-y-1 text-[11px] text-slate-300 select-text overflow-x-auto">
          {step.description && (
            <div className="text-slate-400">{step.description}</div>
          )}
          {step.args && (
            <pre className="text-slate-300 whitespace-pre-wrap">
              {JSON.stringify(step.args, null, 2)}
            </pre>
          )}
          {step.output && (
            <pre className="text-slate-400 whitespace-pre-wrap">
              {step.output}
            </pre>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
`````

`````tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Check, CheckCircle2, Copy, Eye, FileDiff, Folder, HelpCircle, Sparkles, XCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { ChangeSummaryData } from '../../types/chat';
import { TriState, toTriState } from '../../types/agent';
import { useWorkspaceStore } from '../../state/workspace-store';
import { useProjectStore } from '../../state/project-store';

interface ChangeSummaryProps {
  summary: ChangeSummaryData;
}

export const ChangeSummary: React.FC<ChangeSummaryProps> = ({ summary }) => {
  const { setActiveTab, setWorkspaceOpen } = useWorkspaceStore();
  const { currentProject } = useProjectStore();
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const handleOpenPreview = () => {
    setActiveTab('preview');
    setWorkspaceOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenDiff = () => {
    setActiveTab('diff');
    setWorkspaceOpen(true);
  };

  const isNoFileChange = (summary.filesModified?.length || 0) === 0 && (summary.filesCreated?.length || 0) === 0;
  const blocked = summary.completionStatus === 'BLOCKED' || Boolean(summary.blockedSections?.length);
  const isUnchanged = !blocked && (summary.validationStatus === 'unchanged' || isNoFileChange);

  const validation = summary.validation;
  // The "TypeScript" badge reports the typecheck gate, not the combined code verdict
  // (which also folds in accessibility and runtime results).
  const codeStatus: TriState = (validation as any)?.typecheck_status
    ?? ((validation as any)?.typecheck_passed !== undefined ? toTriState((validation as any).typecheck_passed) : undefined)
    ?? summary.codeStatus
    ?? validation?.code_status
    ?? (summary.code_passed !== undefined ? toTriState(summary.code_passed) : (validation?.code_passed !== undefined ? toTriState(validation.code_passed) : 'unknown'));

  const buildStatus: TriState = summary.buildStatus
    ?? validation?.build_status
    ?? (summary.build_passed !== undefined ? toTriState(summary.build_passed) : (validation?.build_passed !== undefined ? toTriState(validation.build_passed) : 'unknown'));

  const contractStatus: TriState = summary.contractStatus
    ?? validation?.contract_status
    ?? (summary.contract_passed !== undefined ? toTriState(summary.contract_passed) : (validation?.contract_passed !== undefined ? toTriState(validation.contract_passed) : 'unknown'));

  const accessibilityStatus: TriState = summary.accessibilityStatus
    ?? validation?.accessibility_status
    ?? (summary.accessibility_passed !== undefined ? toTriState(summary.accessibility_passed) : (validation?.accessibility_passed !== undefined ? toTriState(validation.accessibility_passed) : 'unknown'));

  const motionStatus: TriState = (summary as any).motionStatus
    ?? validation?.motion_status
    ?? ((summary as any).motion_passed !== undefined ? toTriState((summary as any).motion_passed) : (validation?.motion_passed !== undefined ? toTriState(validation.motion_passed) : 'unknown'));

  const previewStatus: TriState = summary.previewStatus
    ?? validation?.preview_status
    ?? (summary.preview_running !== undefined ? toTriState(summary.preview_running) : (validation?.preview_running !== undefined ? toTriState(validation.preview_running) : 'unknown'));

  const renderGateBadge = (label: string, status: TriState) => {
    if (status === 'passed') {
      return (
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-400/90 font-mono">
          <CheckCircle2 size={12} className="text-emerald-400" />
          <span>{label}</span>
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (status === 'failed') {
      return (
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-rose-400 font-mono">
          <XCircle size={12} className="text-rose-400" />
          <span>{label}</span>
        </span>
      );
    }
    return (
      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-400 font-mono" title={`${label} status unknown / unverified`}>
        <HelpCircle size={12} className="text-slate-400" />
        <span>{label} (unverified)</span>
      </span>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full my-2 rounded-xl bg-[#141414] border border-white/[0.08] shadow-lg overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2 bg-white/[0.02] border-b border-white/[0.06]">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center w-5 h-5 rounded-md bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400">
            <Sparkles size={12} />
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200">
            {isNoFileChange
              ? (blocked ? 'Generation blocked' : 'Task completed')
              : blocked ? 'Generation blocked — partial files saved'
              : (summary.filesModified?.length || 0) > 0
              ? 'Changes Applied'
              : 'Project Ready'}
          </span>
        </div>

      </div>

      <div className="p-3.5 space-y-3">
        {blocked && (
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 text-[11px] space-y-1" role="alert">
            <div className="font-semibold">Generation blocked{summary.sectionCompletion ? ` · ${summary.sectionCompletion} sections complete` : ''}. Accepted files were preserved; the site is not complete.</div>
            <ul className="list-disc pl-4">
              {(summary.blockedSections || []).map((item, i) => (
                <li key={i}>{typeof item === 'string' ? item : `${item.section || item.name || 'Section'}: ${item.reason || item.error || 'Generation blocked'}`}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        )}
        {/* Metric Pills */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1 rounded-md bg-white/[0.04] text-[11px] text-slate-300 font-mono">
            <span>
              {isNoFileChange
                ? 'No files changed'
                : (summary.filesModified?.length || 0) > 0
                ? `${summary.filesModified.length} file${summary.filesModified.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} modified`
                : `${summary.filesCreated?.length || 0} files created`}
            </span>
            {summary.visualScore !== undefined && summary.visualScore !== null && (
              <span className="text-amber-400/90 ml-1">
                · Visual Score {summary.visualScore}/5
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Export Folder Location */}
        {(summary.filePath || summary.fullPath || summary.folderName || (currentProject as any)?.filePath || (currentProject as any)?.folderName) && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-cyan-950/30 border border-cyan-500/25 text-[11px] font-mono text-cyan-200">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden mr-2">
              <Folder size={13} className="text-cyan-400 shrink-0" />
              <span className="text-slate-400 shrink-0">Saved to:</span>
              <span className="text-cyan-300 font-semibold truncate select-all" title={summary.fullPath || summary.filePath || (currentProject as any)?.fullPath || (currentProject as any)?.filePath}>
                {summary.folderName || summary.filePath || (currentProject as any)?.folderName || (currentProject as any)?.filePath}
              </span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                const textToCopy = summary.fullPath || summary.filePath || (currentProject as any)?.fullPath || (currentProject as any)?.filePath || '';
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(textToCopy);
                setCopied(true);
                setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-cyan-500/15 hover:bg-cyan-500/25 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30 cursor-pointer shrink-0 transition-colors text-[10px]"
              title="Copy folder path to clipboard"
            >
              {copied ? <Check size={11} className="text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy size={11} />}
              <span>{copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy Path'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Multi-Gate Validation Outcome */}
        <div className="space-y-1 text-slate-300">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
            Validation
          </div>
          {isUnchanged ? (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-500" />
              <span>Validation status unchanged</span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-[11px] font-mono">
              {renderGateBadge('TypeScript', codeStatus)}
              {renderGateBadge('Production build', buildStatus)}
              {renderGateBadge('Contract check', contractStatus)}
              {renderGateBadge('Accessibility', accessibilityStatus)}
              {renderGateBadge('Motion policy', motionStatus)}
              {renderGateBadge('Preview runtime', previewStatus)}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {summary.strategy === 'native' && (
          <div id="summary-native-code" className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 space-y-1">
            <div>
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-300">Section code: </span>
              {(summary.nativeCodeSections || []).length} written by the model
              {Object.keys(summary.nativeCodeFallbacks || {}).length > 0 &&
                `, ${Object.keys(summary.nativeCodeFallbacks || {}).length} by the design kit (model code rejected)`}
            </div>
            {Object.entries(summary.nativeCodeFallbacks || {}).slice(0, 4).map(([section, reasons]) => (
              <div key={section} className="text-slate-500 font-mono">{section}: {(reasons || [])[0]}</div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {summary.generationScorecards && (
          <div className="space-y-2 text-[11px]">
            <div className="font-semibold text-slate-400">Generation evidence · {summary.generationScorecards.provenance.mode || 'unknown'} run</div>
            <table className="w-full text-left">
              <thead><tr className="text-slate-500"><th>Stage</th><th>Result</th><th>Evidence</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{summary.generationScorecards.stages.map(stage => (
                <tr key={stage.id} className="border-t border-white/5" title={stage.note}>
                  <td className="py-1.5">{stage.label}</td>
                  <td className={stage.status === 'failed' ? 'text-rose-400' : stage.status === 'passed' ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-slate-400'}>{stage.status.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</td>
                  <td className="text-slate-400">{stage.id === 'native' ? `${stage.first_attempt_sections}/${stage.required_sections} first attempts` : stage.id === 'model_repair' ? `${stage.section_retries} section retries · ${stage.project_attempts} project attempts` : stage.files ? `${stage.files.length} files changed` : 'Project gates'}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}</tbody>
            </table>
            <p className="text-slate-500">Section acceptance does not establish model-native visual or browser quality.</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Motion Failures / Runtime Warnings if any */}
        {validation?.motion_failures && validation.motion_failures.length > 0 && (
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 text-[11px] font-mono space-y-1">
            <div className="font-semibold text-rose-400 flex items-center gap-1">
              <XCircle size={13} />
              <span>Motion Runtime Violations Detected:</span>
            </div>
            <ul className="list-disc pl-4 space-y-0.5 text-[10px]">
              {validation.motion_failures.map((fail, i) => (
                <li key={i}>{fail}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Actions: View Preview / Review Changes */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/[0.06]">
          <button
            onClick={handleOpenPreview}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-black font-semibold text-xs transition-colors shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Eye size={13} />
            <span>View preview</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={handleOpenDiff}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.10] text-slate-200 font-medium text-xs border border-white/[0.06] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <FileDiff size={13} />
            <span>Review changes</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
`````

`````tsx
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  RefreshCw,
  ExternalLink,
  Monitor,
  Tablet,
  Smartphone,
  Crosshair,
  Box,
  Loader2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Hammer,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useWorkspaceStore, PreviewDevice } from '../../state/workspace-store';
import { useProjectStore } from '../../state/project-store';
import { useSelectionStore } from '../../state/selection-store';
import { useAgentStore } from '../../state/agent-store';
import { api, PreviewStatus } from '../../services/api';
import { projectWsClient } from '../../services/project-ws';

// Logical viewport for each device. The site renders at this width and the frame
// is scaled down to fit the panel, so "Desktop" shows the desktop layout even in
// a narrow workspace.
const DEVICES: Record<PreviewDevice, { width: number; label: string }> = {
  desktop: { width: 1280, label: 'Desktop' },
  tablet: { width: 768, label: 'Tablet' },
  mobile: { width: 390, label: 'Mobile' },
};

type Phase = 'idle' | 'building' | 'ready' | 'error' | 'empty';

// Scroll position per project survives rebuilds and tab switches.
const scrollPositions = new Map<string, { x: number; y: number }>();

/** Dispatched by the inspector to outline the selected element inside the preview. */
export const PREVIEW_HIGHLIGHT_EVENT = 'workbench:preview-highlight';

export const PreviewTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { previewDevice, setPreviewDevice, previewKey, reloadPreview, setInspectorOpen } = useWorkspaceStore();
  const { currentProjectId, currentProject } = useProjectStore();
  const { validationResult, status } = useAgentStore();
  const { inspectMode, setInspectMode, setSelectedElement, setSelected3DObject } = useSelectionStore();
  const iframeRef = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement>(null);
  const stageRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [stage, setStage] = useState({ width: 0, height: 0 });
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('idle');
  const [url, setUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>('');
  const [emptyMessage, setEmptyMessage] = useState<string>('');
  const [runtimeErrors, setRuntimeErrors] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [frameLoading, setFrameLoading] = useState(false);
  const requestRef = useRef(0);
  const isWorking = status === 'generating' || status === 'planning' || status === 'typechecking' || status === 'repairing';

  const loadPreview = useCallback(async (rebuild: boolean) => {
    if (!currentProjectId) {
      setPhase('idle');
      setUrl(null);
      return;
    }
    const request = ++requestRef.current;
    setPhase('building');
    setError('');
    let result: PreviewStatus;
    try {
      result = await api.getPreview(currentProjectId, rebuild);
    } catch (err: any) {
      result = { status: 'error', error: err?.message || String(err) };
    }
    if (request !== requestRef.current) return; // a newer request superseded this one
    if (result.status === 'ready' && result.url) {
      setRuntimeErrors([]);
      setFrameLoading(true);
      setUrl(`${result.url}?_k=${Date.now()}`);
      setPhase('ready');
    } else if (result.status === 'empty') {
      setUrl(null);
      setEmptyMessage(result.message || 'No site files yet.');
      setPhase('empty');
    } else {
      setError(result.error || 'The preview could not be built.');
      setPhase('error');
    }
  }, [currentProjectId]);

  // Rebuild when the project changes or anything asks for a reload (generation
  // result, file save, revert, reload button).
  useEffect(() => {
    loadPreview(false);
  }, [loadPreview, previewKey]);

  // Track the stage size so the device frame can be scaled to fit.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const node = stageRef.current;
    if (!node) return;
    const update = () => setStage({ width: node.clientWidth, height: node.clientHeight });
    update();
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(update);
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const post = useCallback((message: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    try {
      iframeRef.current?.contentWindow?.postMessage(message, '*');
    } catch (_) {}
  }, []);

  // Keep the picker inside the preview in sync with the toolbar toggle.
  useEffect(() => {
    post({ type: 'workbench:inspect_mode', mode: inspectMode });
  }, [inspectMode, post, url]);

  // Leave inspect mode when the preview goes away.
  useEffect(() => () => setInspectMode('none'), [setInspectMode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onHighlight = (event: Event) => post({ type: 'workbench:highlight', selector: (event as CustomEvent).detail });
    window.addEventListener(PREVIEW_HIGHLIGHT_EVENT, onHighlight);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(PREVIEW_HIGHLIGHT_EVENT, onHighlight);
  }, [post]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMessage = (event: MessageEvent) => {
      if (event.source !== iframeRef.current?.contentWindow) return;
      const data = event.data;
      if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || typeof data.type !== 'string') return;
      if (data.type === 'workbench:ready') {
        setFrameLoading(false);
        const saved = currentProjectId ? scrollPositions.get(currentProjectId) : undefined;
        if (saved && (saved.x || saved.y)) post({ type: 'workbench:restore_scroll', ...saved });
        post({ type: 'workbench:inspect_mode', mode: useSelectionStore.getState().inspectMode });
      } else if (data.type === 'workbench:scroll_update') {
        if (currentProjectId) scrollPositions.set(currentProjectId, { x: data.scrollX || 0, y: data.scrollY || 0 });
      } else if (data.type === 'workbench:runtime_error') {
        setRuntimeErrors((prev) => (prev.includes(data.message) ? prev : [...prev, String(data.message)].slice(-20)));
      } else if (data.type === 'workbench:inspect_exit') {
        setInspectMode('none');
      } else if (data.type === 'workbench:dom_select') {
        setSelectedElement({
          type: 'dom',
          tagName: data.tagName || 'DIV',
          id: data.id,
          className: data.className,
          componentHint: data.componentHint,
          selector: data.selector || '',
          textContent: data.textContent,
          href: data.href,
          src: data.src,
          alt: data.alt,
          ariaLabel: data.ariaLabel,
          size: data.size,
          styles: data.styles,
        });
        // Tell the agent which section the next edit targets.
        projectWsClient.sendPreviewSelection({
          component: data.componentHint || undefined,
          selector: data.selector,
          tag: String(data.tagName || '').toLowerCase(),
          text: data.textContent,
        });
        setInspectorOpen(true);
      } else if (data.type === 'workbench:3d_select') {
        setSelected3DObject({
          type: '3d',
          name: data.name || 'Mesh',
          uuid: data.uuid || '',
          position: data.position || { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
          rotation: data.rotation || { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
          materialName: data.materialName,
        });
        setInspectorOpen(true);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('message', handleMessage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handleMessage);
  }, [currentProjectId, post, setInspectMode, setSelectedElement, setSelected3DObject, setInspectorOpen]);

  const device = DEVICES[previewDevice];
  const padding = 16;
  const availableWidth = Math.max(0, stage.width - padding);
  const availableHeight = Math.max(0, stage.height - padding);
  const logicalWidth = previewDevice === 'desktop' ? Math.max(device.width, availableWidth) : device.width;
  const scale = availableWidth > 0 ? Math.min(1, availableWidth / logicalWidth) : 1;
  const logicalHeight = scale > 0 ? availableHeight / scale : availableHeight;
  const zoomLabel = `${logicalWidth} px · ${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`;
  const validationErrors = validationResult?.errors || [];
  const externalUrl = currentProjectId ? `/preview/${encodeURIComponent(currentProjectId)}/` : null;

  const deviceButton = (id: PreviewDevice, icon: React.ReactNode) => (
    <button
      id={`preview-viewport-${id}`}
      onClick={() => setPreviewDevice(id)}
      aria-pressed={previewDevice === id}
      className={`p-1 rounded cursor-pointer ${previewDevice === id ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-black' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'}`}
      title={`${DEVICES[id].label} (${DEVICES[id].width}px)`}
    >
      {icon}
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col h-full bg-[#0a0c10] overflow-hidden select-none">
      {/* Preview toolbar */}
      <div className="h-10 border-b border-white/[0.06] bg-[#141619] px-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#191c20] p-0.5 rounded-md border border-white/[0.04]">
            {deviceButton('desktop', <Monitor size={14} />)}
            {deviceButton('tablet', <Tablet size={14} />)}
            {deviceButton('mobile', <Smartphone size={14} />)}
          </div>
          <span id="preview-zoom-label" className="hidden md:inline text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 truncate">{zoomLabel}</span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <button
            id="preview-inspect-dom-btn"
            onClick={() => setInspectMode(inspectMode === 'dom' ? 'none' : 'dom')}
            disabled={phase !== 'ready'}
            aria-pressed={inspectMode === 'dom'}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs border transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed ${
              inspectMode === 'dom'
                ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300'
                : 'border-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.04] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
            }`}
            title="Pick an element in the preview to inspect it (Esc to stop)"
          >
            <Crosshair size={13} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Inspect</span>
          </button>

          {currentProject?.uses3D && (
            <button
              id="preview-inspect-3d-btn"
              onClick={() => setInspectMode(inspectMode === '3d' ? 'none' : '3d')}
              disabled={phase !== 'ready'}
              aria-pressed={inspectMode === '3d'}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs border transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40 ${
                inspectMode === '3d'
                  ? 'bg-amber-500/15 border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300'
                  : 'border-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.04] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
              }`}
              title="Pick the 3D canvas or scene element"
            >
              <Box size={13} />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">3D</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            id="preview-reload-btn"
            onClick={reloadPreview}
            disabled={!currentProjectId}
            className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
            title="Reload preview (rebuilds if files changed)"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={13} className={phase === 'building' ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
          </button>

          {externalUrl && phase === 'ready' && (
            <a
              id="preview-open-external-btn"
              href={externalUrl}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
              className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
              title="Open in a new tab"
            >
              <ExternalLink size={13} />
            </a>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <details id="preview-status-bar" className="border-b border-white/[0.06] bg-[#101216] text-[11px] text-slate-400 px-3 py-1.5">
        <summary className="cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-emerald-400">
          <span>{device.label}</span><span>·</span>
          <span>{validationResult ? `Build ${validationResult.build_status || (validationResult.build_passed ? 'passed' : 'failed')}` : 'Build not checked'}</span>
          <span>·</span><span>{validationResult ? `${validationErrors.length} validation errors` : 'Validation not checked'}</span>
          {runtimeErrors.length > 0 && (
            <span id="preview-runtime-error-count" className="ml-auto text-rose-300">{runtimeErrors.length} runtime error{runtimeErrors.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>
          )}
        </summary>
        <div className="pt-2 pb-1 space-y-1 max-h-32 overflow-y-auto select-text">
          <div>Runtime: {validationResult?.runtime_status || 'unknown'} · Motion: {validationResult?.motion_runtime_status || 'not browser verified'} · 3D: {validationResult?.three_d_runtime_status || 'not checked'}</div>

          {validationErrors.length ? validationErrors.slice(0, 6).map((message, index) => <div key={index} className="text-rose-300">{message}</div>) : <div>{validationResult ? 'No reported compiler, runtime, or interaction errors.' : 'Validation has not run for this project.'}</div>}
        </div>
      </details>

      {/* Stage */}
      <div ref={stageRef} id="preview-stage" className="flex-1 relative overflow-hidden bg-[#07080c]">
        {url && (
          <div
            className="absolute rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-white/[0.08] shadow-2xl bg-white"
            style={{
              width: logicalWidth * scale,
              height: availableHeight,
              left: Math.max(padding / 2, (stage.width - logicalWidth * scale) / 2),
              top: padding / 2,

              <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin text-emerald-400" />
              <span>{phase === 'building' ? 'Building preview…' : 'Loading preview…'}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {isWorking && phase !== 'building' && (
          <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#141619]/95 border border-white/[0.08] text-[11px] text-slate-300 shadow-xl flex items-center gap-2">
            <Loader2 size={12} className="animate-spin text-emerald-400" />

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  id="preview-retry-btn"
                  onClick={() => loadPreview(true)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950 text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-emerald-400 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Hammer size={12} />
                  <span>Rebuild preview</span>
                </button>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">Fix the file in the Code tab, or ask the agent to repair it.</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {(phase === 'idle' || phase === 'empty') && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-8 text-slate-500 space-y-2">
            <Monitor size={32} className="text-slate-600" />

            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
`````

`````tsx
import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Terminal, 
  Trash2, 
  Search, 
  ArrowDown, 
  Filter 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useWorkspaceStore } from '../../state/workspace-store';
import { LogCategory, LogLevel } from '../../types/logs';

export const LogsTab: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    logs,
    logFilterLevel,
    logFilterCategory,
    logSearch,
    logAutoScroll,
    setLogFilterLevel,
    setLogFilterCategory,
    setLogSearch,
    setLogAutoScroll,
    clearLogs,
  } = useWorkspaceStore();

  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (logAutoScroll && scrollRef.current) {
      scrollRef.current.scrollTop = scrollRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [logs, logAutoScroll]);

  const filteredLogs = logs.filter((log) => {
    if (logFilterLevel !== 'all' && log.level !== logFilterLevel) return false;
    if (logFilterCategory !== 'all' && log.category !== logFilterCategory) return false;
    if (logSearch && !log.message.toLowerCase().includes(logSearch.toLowerCase())) return false;
    return true;
  });

  const levelColor = {
    info: 'text-slate-300',
    warn: 'text-amber-400',
    error: 'text-rose-400 font-semibold',
    debug: 'text-slate-500',
  };

  const categoryBadge = {
    agent: 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/20',
    build: 'bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 border-indigo-500/20',
    compiler: 'bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-400 border-teal-500/20',
    shell: 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/20',
    network: 'bg-violet-500/10 text-violet-400 border-violet-500/20',
    motion: 'bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/20',
    all: 'bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-400 border-slate-500/20',
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col h-full bg-[#0a0c10] overflow-hidden font-mono text-xs">
      {/* Logs Toolbar */}
      <div className="h-10 border-b border-white/[0.06] bg-[#141619] px-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        {/* Left: filters */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {/* Category Filter */}
          <select
            id="logs-category-filter"
            value={logFilterCategory}
            onChange={(e) => setLogFilterCategory(e.target.value as LogCategory)}
            className="bg-[#191c20] text-slate-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-white/[0.08] focus:outline-none text-[11px] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <option value="all">All Categories</option>
            <option value="agent">Agent</option>
            <option value="build">Build</option>
            <option value="compiler">Compiler</option>
            <option value="motion">Motion</option>
            <option value="shell">Shell</option>
          </select>

          {/* Severity Filter */}
          <select
            id="logs-level-filter"
            value={logFilterLevel}
            onChange={(e) => setLogFilterLevel(e.target.value as LogLevel)}
            className="bg-[#191c20] text-slate-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-white/[0.08] focus:outline-none text-[11px] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <option value="all">All Levels</option>
            <option value="info">Info</option>
            <option value="warn">Warnings</option>
            <option value="error">Errors</option>
          </select>

          {/* Search box */}
          <div className="relative">
            <Search size={11} className="absolute left-2 top-2 text-slate-500" />
            <input
              id="logs-search-input"
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search logs..."
              value={logSearch}
              onChange={(e) => setLogSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-[#191c20] text-slate-200 pl-6 pr-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-white/[0.08] text-[11px] focus:outline-none w-32 sm:w-44"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right: Auto-scroll & Clear */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <button
            id="logs-autoscroll-btn"
            onClick={() => setLogAutoScroll(!logAutoScroll)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] border transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              logAutoScroll
                ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400'
                : 'border-white/[0.06] text-slate-400'
            }`}
            title="Auto-scroll to latest log"
          >
            <ArrowDown size={11} />
            <span>Scroll</span>
          </button>

          <button
            id="logs-clear-btn"
            onClick={() => clearLogs()}
            className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
            title="Clear all logs"
          >
            <Trash2 size={13} />
          </button>
        </div>

      <div id="logs-list-container" ref={scrollRef} className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-1 select-text">
        {filteredLogs.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 text-xs">
            No logs to display
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredLogs.map((log) => (
            <div key={log.id} className="flex items-start gap-2 leading-relaxed">
              <span className="text-slate-600 shrink-0 select-none">{log.timeStr}</span>
              <span
                className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider shrink-0 border ${
                  categoryBadge[log.category] || categoryBadge.all

              >
                {log.category}
              </span>
              <span className={`break-all ${levelColor[log.level]}`}>
                {log.message}
              </span>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
`````
