import { useProjectStore } from '../state/project-store';
import { useWorkspaceStore } from '../state/workspace-store';
import { useAgentStore } from '../state/agent-store';
import { useChatStore } from '../state/chat-store';
import { useSelectionStore } from '../state/selection-store';
import { projectWsClient } from './project-ws';
import { api } from './api';
import { logEntryFromEvent } from '../types/logs';

/**
 * Safe entry point for requesting a new project.
 * If an active GPU generation or task is currently running, opens the conflict resolution modal.
 * If idle, executes startNewProject() immediately.
 */
export function requestNewProject() {
  const { status, activeTaskId } = useAgentStore.getState();
  const isWorking =
    status === 'generating' ||
    status === 'planning' ||
    status === 'typechecking' ||
    status === 'repairing' ||
    Boolean(activeTaskId);

  if (isWorking) {
    useWorkspaceStore.getState().openActiveTaskModal();
  } else {
    startNewProject();
  }
}

/**
 * First-class state transition for starting a new project / chat.
 * Completely resets project and task state while preserving global system state (model readiness, GPU).
 */
export function startNewProject() {
  // 1. Stop listening to previous task/session
  projectWsClient.disconnect();

  // 2. Clear project selection
  useProjectStore.getState().startNewProject();

  // 3. Reset workspace (files, drafts, preview, diffs, close workspace drawer)
  useWorkspaceStore.getState().clearWorkspace();
  useWorkspaceStore.getState().clearLogs();

  // 4. Reset task metrics, visual score, repair attempts, and activities
  useAgentStore.getState().resetAgent();

  // 5. Clear 2D DOM and 3D selection
  useSelectionStore.getState().clearSelection();

  // 6. Clear conversation view and queued prompts
  useChatStore.getState().clearMessages();
  useChatStore.getState().clearQueuedPrompts();
}

/**
 * Loads a project by ID, opening its tab and hydrating workspace files, conversation history, and preview.
 */
export async function loadProject(id: string) {
  // 1. Stop any active streaming
  projectWsClient.disconnect();

  // 2. Open / activate tab in store
  useProjectStore.getState().openProjectTab(id);

  // 3. Reset selection, agent state, and queued prompts for the new project context
  useSelectionStore.getState().clearSelection();
  useAgentStore.getState().resetAgent();
  useChatStore.getState().clearQueuedPrompts();

  // 4. Switch to project-scoped logs and reset diff selection
  useWorkspaceStore.getState().setLogsForProject(id);
  useWorkspaceStore.getState().setDiff('', '', 0, '');

  // Restore the persisted log history for this project (best effort).
  api.getProjectLogs(id).then((entries) => {
    const mapped = entries.map((e) => logEntryFromEvent(e)).filter((e): e is NonNullable<typeof e> => Boolean(e));
    if (mapped.length) useWorkspaceStore.getState().hydrateLogs(id, mapped);
  }).catch(() => {});

  try {
    const details = await api.getProject(id);
    const projData = details.project || details.session || details;
    if (projData.files) {
      useWorkspaceStore.getState().setFiles(projData.files);
    }
    useProjectStore.getState().updateProject(id, { uses3D: Boolean(projData.uses_3d ?? projData.uses3D) });
    const turns = Array.isArray(projData.turns) ? projData.turns : (Array.isArray(projData.history) ? projData.history : []);
    if (turns.length) {
      const restored: any[] = [];
      turns.forEach((entry: any, index: number) => {
        const turn = {
          ...entry,
          user_prompt: entry.user_prompt || entry.prompt || (entry.role === 'user' ? entry.content : undefined),
          files_modified: entry.files_modified || entry.files_touched,
        };
        if (turn.user_prompt || turn.prompt) {
          restored.push({
            id: `user-${turn.turn_id || index}`,
            role: 'user',
            content: turn.user_prompt || turn.prompt,
            timestamp: Date.now() - (turns.length - index) * 60000,
            turnId: turn.turn_id || index + 1,
          });
        }
        if (turn.summary || turn.files_modified) {
          restored.push({
            id: `summary-${turn.turn_id || index}`,
            role: 'summary',
            timestamp: Date.now() - (turns.length - index) * 60000 + 1000,
            summary: {
              validation: turn.validation,
              filesCreated: turn.files_created || [],
              completionStatus: turn.completion_status,
              blockedSections: turn.blocked_diagnostics || turn.blocked_sections,
              sectionCompletion: turn.section_completion,
              finalPassed: turn.final_passed,
              generationScorecards: turn.generation_scorecards,
              strategy: turn.strategy,
              nativeCodeSections: turn.native_code_sections,
              nativeCodeFallbacks: turn.native_code_fallbacks,
              filesModified: turn.files_modified || [],
              filePath: turn.file_path || projData.file_path,
              folderName: turn.folder_name || projData.folder_name || (turn.file_path || projData.file_path ? (turn.file_path || projData.file_path).replace(/^generated_components\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '') : undefined),
              fullPath: turn.full_path || projData.full_path,
              visualScore: turn.visual_score,
              code_passed: turn.validation?.code_passed ?? turn.validation?.codePassed,
              build_passed: turn.validation?.build_passed ?? turn.validation?.buildPassed,
              contract_passed: turn.validation?.contract_passed ?? turn.validation?.contractPassed,
              accessibility_passed: turn.validation?.accessibility_passed ?? turn.validation?.accessibilityPassed,
              contractStatus: turn.validation?.contract_status,
              accessibilityStatus: turn.validation?.accessibility_status,
              runtime_passed: turn.validation?.runtime_passed ?? turn.validation?.runtimePassed,
              preview_running: turn.validation?.preview_running ?? turn.validation?.previewRunning,
              passed: turn.final_passed ?? turn.validation?.passed,
              validationStatus: turn.validation_status ?? turn.validationStatus ?? turn.validation?.validationStatus,
            },
          });
        }
      });
      useChatStore.getState().setMessages(restored);
    } else {
      useChatStore.getState().clearMessages();
    }

    const lastResult = [...turns].reverse().find((turn: any) => turn.validation);
    const validation = projData.last_validation || lastResult?.validation;
    if (validation) useAgentStore.getState().applyEvent({ type: 'build.result', timestamp: Date.now(), data: validation });
    if (lastResult?.completion_status === 'BLOCKED' || lastResult?.blocked_sections?.length) {
      useAgentStore.getState().setStatus('failed', 'Generation blocked; inspect the saved result for section details.');
    }

    // Hydrate context tokens & max context tokens
    const ctxTokens = projData.context_tokens ?? projData.contextTokens ?? 0;
    const maxCtxTokens = projData.max_context_tokens ?? projData.maxContextTokens ?? 8192;
    useAgentStore.getState().setSystemStatus({
      contextTokens: ctxTokens,
      maxContextTokens: maxCtxTokens,
    });

    // Hydrate backend-authoritative queued prompts on load/refresh
    const queuedPrompts = projData.queued_prompts || [];
    if (Array.isArray(queuedPrompts) && queuedPrompts.length > 0) {
      queuedPrompts.forEach((qp: any, idx: number) => {
        const text = typeof qp === 'string' ? qp : (qp.prompt || qp.content || '');
        const taskId = typeof qp === 'object' ? (qp.taskId || qp.task_id) : undefined;
        const position = typeof qp === 'object' ? (qp.position || qp.queue_position || idx + 1) : idx + 1;
        const qId = taskId || `queued-${id}-${idx}-${Date.now()}`;
        useChatStore.getState().addQueuedPrompt({
          id: qId,
          projectId: id,
          content: text,
          createdAt: Date.now(),
          status: 'queued',
          taskId,
          queuePosition: position,
        });
      });
      useAgentStore.getState().setQueueDepth(queuedPrompts.length);
    }

    // Reconnect to authoritative project channel so events stream to UI after refresh/tab switch
    projectWsClient.connect(
      id,
      {
        onEvent: (event) => {
          useAgentStore.getState().applyEvent(event);
          const logEntry = logEntryFromEvent(event as any);
          if (logEntry) useWorkspaceStore.getState().addLog(logEntry, id);
          if (event.type === 'task.queued' || event.type === 'prompt.queued') {
            const qTaskId = (event as any).task_id || event.data?.taskId || event.data?.task_id || (event as any).taskId;
            const qPos = event.data?.position ?? event.data?.queue_position;
            const queue = useChatStore.getState().queuedPrompts;
            const match = (qTaskId ? queue.find((q) => q.taskId === qTaskId) : null) || queue.find((q) => !q.taskId);
            if (match) {
              useChatStore.getState().updateQueuedPrompt(match.id, {
                taskId: qTaskId || match.taskId,
                queuePosition: typeof qPos === 'number' ? qPos : match.queuePosition,
              });
            }
            if (typeof qPos === 'number') {
              useAgentStore.getState().setQueueDepth(qPos);
            }
          } else if (event.type === 'task.started') {
            const startedTaskId = (event as any).task_id || event.data?.taskId || event.data?.task_id || (event as any).taskId;
            const queue = useChatStore.getState().queuedPrompts;
            const match = (startedTaskId ? queue.find((q) => q.taskId === startedTaskId) : null) || queue[0];
            if (match) {
              useChatStore.getState().promoteQueuedPrompt(match.id, startedTaskId || match.taskId || `task-${Date.now()}`);
            }
            if (startedTaskId) {
              useAgentStore.getState().setActiveTaskId(startedTaskId);
            }
            useAgentStore.getState().setStatus('generating');
            useAgentStore.getState().startTimer();
            useAgentStore.getState().setQueueDepth(Math.max(0, queue.length - 1));
          } else if (event.type === 'task.cancelled') {
            useAgentStore.getState().stopTimer();
            useAgentStore.getState().setStatus('idle');
            useChatStore.getState().clearQueuedPrompts();
          }
        },
        onResult: (result) => {
          if (result.validation) useAgentStore.getState().applyEvent({ type: 'build.result', timestamp: Date.now(), data: result.validation });
          if (result.files) {
            api.getProject(id).then((fresh) => {
              const data = fresh.project || fresh.session || fresh;
              useWorkspaceStore.getState().setFiles(data.files || result.files);
            }).catch(() => useWorkspaceStore.getState().setFiles(result.files));
          }
          if (result.status === 'blocked' || result.blocked_sections?.length) {
            useAgentStore.getState().setStatus('failed');
          }
          useWorkspaceStore.getState().reloadPreview();
        },
        onDone: () => {
          useAgentStore.getState().stopTimer();
          if (useChatStore.getState().queuedPrompts.length === 0) {
            if (useAgentStore.getState().status !== 'failed') useAgentStore.getState().setStatus('idle');
          }
        },
        onError: (err) => {
          console.warn('[Project WS Stream Error]:', err);
        },
      },
      projData.active_task_id || undefined
    );

    useWorkspaceStore.getState().reloadPreview();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to load project details:', err);
  }
}

/**
 * Closes a project tab. If the closed tab was active, switches to the next adjacent open tab
 * or cleanly resets into startNewProject if no tabs remain open.
 */
export async function closeProjectTabAndSwitch(id: string) {
  const { openProjectIds, currentProjectId } = useProjectStore.getState();
  const currentIndex = openProjectIds.indexOf(id);
  const remaining = openProjectIds.filter((oid) => oid !== id);

  // Close the tab in store
  useProjectStore.getState().closeProjectTab(id);

  // If the closed tab was currently active, switch to adjacent or new project
  if (currentProjectId === id) {
    if (remaining.length > 0) {
      const nextIndex = Math.min(Math.max(0, currentIndex), remaining.length - 1);
      const nextId = remaining[nextIndex];
      await loadProject(nextId);
    } else {
      startNewProject();
    }
  }
}
`````

import React from 'react';
import { 
  PanelLeft, 
  Square, 
  Info, 
  Sun, 
  Moon, 
  Sparkles,
  Layout,
  Inbox
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useAgentStore } from '../../state/agent-store';
import { useWorkspaceStore } from '../../state/workspace-store';
import { useProjectStore } from '../../state/project-store';
import { api } from '../../services/api';
import { projectWsClient } from '../../services/project-ws';
import { useConfirm } from '../../state/confirm-store';
import { toast } from '../../state/toast-store';

export const TopBar: React.FC = () => {
  const { status, statusMessage, activeTaskId, elapsedSeconds, queueDepth, resetAgent, validationResult, metrics,
          serverConnected, modelLoaded, modelStatus } = useAgentStore();
  const { 
    toggleSidebar, 
    sidebarOpen,
    theme, 
    toggleTheme, 
    inspectorOpen, 
    toggleInspector,
    workspaceOpen,
    toggleWorkspace,
    files
  } = useWorkspaceStore();
  const { currentProject } = useProjectStore();
  const confirm = useConfirm();

  const isWorking = status === 'generating' || status === 'planning' || status === 'typechecking' || status === 'repairing';
  // The dot reflects the real model state, not just that the page loaded.
  const modelState = !serverConnected
    ? { dot: 'bg-rose-500', label: 'Offline', title: 'The workbench server is not responding.' }
    : modelStatus === 'error'
    ? { dot: 'bg-rose-500', label: 'Model error', title: 'The model failed to load; check the server log.' }
    : modelStatus === 'loading' || modelStatus === 'unknown' || !modelLoaded
    ? { dot: 'bg-amber-400 animate-pulse', label: 'Loading model', title: 'The model is still loading onto the GPU.' }
    : modelStatus === 'busy' || isWorking
    ? { dot: 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse', label: 'Working', title: `${metrics.modelName} is generating.` }
    : { dot: 'bg-emerald-400', label: 'Ready', title: `${metrics.modelName} is loaded and ready.` };
  const fileCount = Object.keys(files).length;

  const handleStop = async () => {
    const ok = await confirm({
      title: 'Cancel All Tasks',
      message: 'Stop the active generation and clear any queued work?',
      confirmText: 'Cancel All',
      cancelText: 'Keep Running',
      variant: 'danger',
    });
    if (!ok) return;

    try {
      projectWsClient.sendTaskCancel('user_stopped');
      if (activeTaskId) {
        await api.cancelTask(activeTaskId, { clear_queue: true });
      } else {
        await api.cancelAll();
      }
      resetAgent();
      toast.info('Cancelled', 'Active task and queued operations have been stopped.');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to cancel task:', err);
      toast.error('Cancel Failed', err.message || 'Could not cancel tasks.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <header className="h-12 min-h-[48px] border-b border-white/[0.06] bg-[#141414] px-3.5 flex items-center justify-between select-none z-30">
      {/* Left section: sidebar toggle, logo, active project */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          id="topbar-sidebar-toggle"
          onClick={toggleSidebar}
          aria-label="Toggle project sidebar"
          aria-expanded={sidebarOpen}
          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          title="Toggle Sidebar"
        >
          <PanelLeft size={16} />
        </button>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="font-semibold text-sm tracking-tight text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
            SiteAgent
            <span className="text-slate-500 font-normal">·</span>
            <span className="font-normal text-slate-300">
              {currentProject ? currentProject.title : 'New chat'}
            </span>
          </span>

          {/* Model readiness */}
          <span
            id="topbar-model-status"
            data-state={modelState.label.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')}
            role="status"
            title={modelState.title}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 ml-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-mono"
          >
            <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${modelState.dot}`} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">{modelState.label}</span>
          </span>

          {/* Motion Capability Badge (Item 22) */}
          {(validationResult?.motion_status === 'passed' && (Boolean(validationResult?.motion_plan?.length) || Boolean(metrics?.hasMotion))) && (
            <span
              id="topbar-motion-badge"
              className="hidden lg:inline-flex items-center gap-1 ml-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono bg-violet-500/15 text-violet-300 border border-violet-500/30"
              title="Source-level motion checks passed; browser motion behavior may still need review"
            >
              <Sparkles size={10} className="text-violet-400" />
              <span>Motion checks passed</span>
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Middle section: ONLY shown during generation or queuing */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        {isWorking && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-300">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
            <span className="max-w-[18rem] truncate" title={statusMessage}>{statusMessage || 'Building website'}</span>
            <span className="font-mono text-emerald-400/90 pl-1 border-l border-white/[0.08]">
              {elapsedSeconds.toFixed(1)}s
            </span>

            <button
              id="topbar-stop-btn"
              onClick={handleStop}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 ml-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-500/25 border border-rose-500/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer text-[11px]"
              title="Stop generation"
            >
              <Square size={10} className="fill-rose-400" />
              <span>Stop</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {!isWorking && (
          queueDepth > 0 ? (
            <div
              id="topbar-queue-status"
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20"
            >
              <Inbox size={11} />
              <span>Queue: {queueDepth}</span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div
              id="topbar-queue-status"
              className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-400"
              title="Queue empty"
            >
              <Inbox size={11} />
              <span>Idle</span>
            </div>
          )
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Right section: Workspace Drawer toggle, Inspector toggle, Theme toggle */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <button
          id="topbar-workspace-toggle"
          onClick={toggleWorkspace}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
            workspaceOpen
              ? 'bg-white/[0.12] text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
          }`}
          title="Toggle Workspace Panel"
        >
          <Layout size={14} />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Workspace</span>
          {fileCount > 0 && (
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1 rounded bg-white/[0.08] text-slate-300">
              {fileCount}
            </span>
          )}
        </button>

        <button
          id="topbar-inspector-toggle"
          onClick={toggleInspector}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
            inspectorOpen
              ? 'bg-white/[0.12] text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
          }`}
          title="Toggle Inspector"
        >
          <Info size={14} />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Inspector</span>
        </button>

        <button
          id="topbar-theme-toggle"
          type="button"
          onClick={toggleTheme}
          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          title={theme === 'dark' ? 'Switch to Light theme' : 'Switch to Dark theme'}
        >
          {theme === 'dark' ? <Sun size={15} /> : <Moon size={15} />}
        </button>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
};
`````

interface ChatComposerProps {

export const ChatComposer: React.FC<ChatComposerProps> = ({ initialPrompt }) => {
  const [promptText, setPromptText] = useState(initialPrompt || '');

    const singleLineHeight = 24;

      const quote = selectedElement.textContent ? ` with text "${selectedElement.textContent.slice(0, 120)}"` : '';
      text = `[Context: <${selectedElement.tagName.toLowerCase()}>${where}${quote}]\n${text}`;

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {

              <X size={13} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 font-mono text-[11px]">

                    className="w-full bg-[#141414] text-slate-200 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-white/[0.04] focus:outline-none text-xs font-mono"

`````tsx
import React, { useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useWorkspaceStore } from '../../state/workspace-store';
import { maxWorkspaceWidth, MIN_WORKSPACE_WIDTH } from '../../hooks/useViewportWidth';

export const WorkspaceResizer: React.FC = () => {
  const { workspaceWidth, setWorkspaceWidth, isResizing, setIsResizing, workspaceOpen } =
    useWorkspaceStore();

  const startXRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const startWidthRef = useRef<number>(workspaceWidth);
  const resizerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Bounds
  const minWidth = MIN_WORKSPACE_WIDTH;
  const getBounds = useCallback(() => {
    const windowWidth = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerWidth : 1280;
    const { sidebarOpen, inspectorOpen } = useWorkspaceStore.getState();
    return { minWidth, maxWidth: maxWorkspaceWidth(windowWidth, sidebarOpen, inspectorOpen) };
  }, []);

  // Clamp correctly on window resize
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleWindowResize = () => {
      const { maxWidth } = getBounds();
      const current = useWorkspaceStore.getState().workspaceWidth;
      if (current > maxWidth) {
        setWorkspaceWidth(maxWidth);
      } else if (current < minWidth) {
        setWorkspaceWidth(minWidth);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleWindowResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleWindowResize);
  }, [getBounds, setWorkspaceWidth]);

  // Window fail-safe: ensures resize never gets stuck if pointer drops outside or window blurs
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isResizing) return;

    const stopResizing = () => {
      setIsResizing(false);
    };

    window.addEventListener('pointerup', stopResizing);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', stopResizing);
    window.addEventListener('blur', stopResizing);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', stopResizing);
      window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', stopResizing);
      window.removeEventListener('blur', stopResizing);
    };
  }, [isResizing, setIsResizing]);

  if (!workspaceOpen) return null;

  const handlePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch (_) {}

    startXRef.current = e.clientX;
    // Start from the rendered width, which may be clamped below the saved preference.
    startWidthRef.current = Math.min(workspaceWidth, getBounds().maxWidth);
    setIsResizing(true);
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!isResizing) return;
    e.preventDefault();

    // Dragging left increases workspace width (anchored on right)
    const delta = startXRef.current - e.clientX;
    const { maxWidth } = getBounds();
    const newWidth = Math.min(Math.max(startWidthRef.current + delta, minWidth), maxWidth);
    setWorkspaceWidth(newWidth);
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!isResizing) return;
    try {
      if (e.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId)) {
        e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    setIsResizing(false);
  };

  const handlePointerCancel = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    try {
      if (e.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId)) {
        e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    setIsResizing(false);
  };

  const handleLostPointerCapture = () => {
    setIsResizing(false);
  };

  const handleDoubleClick = () => {
    // Double-click reset to 50% of viewport width
    const targetWidth = Math.round((typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerWidth : 1280) * 0.5);
    const { maxWidth } = getBounds();
    setWorkspaceWidth(Math.min(Math.max(targetWidth, minWidth), maxWidth));
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const step = e.shiftKey ? 60 : 20;
    const { maxWidth } = getBounds();

    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setWorkspaceWidth(Math.min(maxWidth, workspaceWidth + step));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setWorkspaceWidth(Math.max(minWidth, workspaceWidth - step));
    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setWorkspaceWidth(minWidth);
    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setWorkspaceWidth(maxWidth);
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleDoubleClick();
    }
  };

  const { maxWidth } = getBounds();

  return (
    <>
      {/* Invisible full-screen backdrop during drag so iframes don't steal pointer events */}
      {isResizing && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 cursor-col-resize select-none pointer-events-auto" />
      )}

      {/* Accessible, Touch-Ready Draggable Divider Splitter */}
      <div
        ref={resizerRef}
        id="workspace-resizer-handle"
        role="separator"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-orientation="vertical"
        aria-label="Workspace resizer"
        aria-valuenow={workspaceWidth}
        aria-valuemin={minWidth}
        aria-valuemax={maxWidth}
        onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
        onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
        onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
        onPointerCancel={handlePointerCancel}
        onLostPointerCapture={handleLostPointerCapture}
        onDoubleClick={handleDoubleClick}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        style={{ touchAction: 'none' }}
        className={`relative w-2 hover:w-2 -mx-1 cursor-col-resize select-none hidden md:flex items-center justify-center group z-40 transition-colors focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-emerald-400 ${
          isResizing ? 'bg-emerald-500/20' : 'hover:bg-white/[0.04]'
        }`}
        title="Drag to resize workspace (double-click to reset 50%, arrow keys to adjust)"
      >
        <div
          className={`w-[1px] h-full transition-colors pointer-events-none ${
            isResizing ? 'bg-emerald-400 w-[2px]' : 'bg-white/[0.08] group-hover:bg-emerald-400/80 group-focus-visible:bg-emerald-400'
          }`}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );
};
`````

import React, { Suspense } from 'react';
import { 
  Eye, 
  Code2, 
  FileDiff, 
  Terminal, 
  SquareTerminal,
  X,
  Layers,
  ArrowLeft
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useWorkspaceStore, WorkspaceTab } from '../../state/workspace-store';
import { useProjectStore } from '../../state/project-store';
import { useAgentStore } from '../../state/agent-store';
import { PreviewTab } from './PreviewTab';
import { useViewportWidth, maxWorkspaceWidth } from '../../hooks/useViewportWidth';
import { LogsTab } from './LogsTab';
const CodeTab = React.lazy(() => import('./CodeTab').then(module => ({ default: module.CodeTab })));
const DiffTab = React.lazy(() => import('./DiffTab').then(module => ({ default: module.DiffTab })));
const ShellTab = React.lazy(() => import('./ShellTab').then(module => ({ default: module.ShellTab })));

export const WorkspacePanel: React.FC = () => {
  const { 
    activeTab, 
    setActiveTab, 
    files, 
    setWorkspaceOpen, 
    workspaceOpen, 
    workspaceWidth, 
    isResizing,
    sidebarOpen,
    inspectorOpen,
  } = useWorkspaceStore();
  const viewport = useViewportWidth();
  const { currentProjectId } = useProjectStore();
  const { status } = useAgentStore();

  if (!workspaceOpen) return null;

  // The stored width is a preference; never let it crowd out the chat.
  const width = viewport < 768 ? undefined : Math.min(workspaceWidth, maxWorkspaceWidth(viewport, sidebarOpen, inspectorOpen));

  const isWorking = status === 'generating' || status === 'planning' || status === 'typechecking' || status === 'repairing';
  const fileCount = Object.keys(files).length;

  const tabs: { id: WorkspaceTab; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode; hasActivity?: boolean }[] = [
    { id: 'preview', label: 'Live Preview', icon: <Eye size={13} />, hasActivity: isWorking },
    { id: 'code', label: `Code${fileCount > 0 ? ` (${fileCount})` : ''}`, icon: <Code2 size={13} /> },
    { id: 'diff', label: 'Diff', icon: <FileDiff size={13} /> },
    { id: 'logs', label: 'Logs', icon: <Terminal size={13} />, hasActivity: isWorking },
    { id: 'shell', label: 'Shell', icon: <SquareTerminal size={13} /> },
  ];

  return (
    <div
      id="workspace-panel"
      style={width ? { width: `${width}px` } : undefined}
      className="fixed inset-0 md:relative md:inset-auto h-full bg-[#141414] border-l border-white/[0.06] flex flex-col overflow-hidden z-50 md:z-20 shrink-0 max-w-full"
    >
      {/* Workspace Tabs Header */}
      <div className="h-11 border-b border-white/[0.06] px-3 flex items-center justify-between bg-[#141414] shrink-0 select-none">
        {/* Mobile back button */}
        <button
          id="workspace-mobile-back-btn"
          onClick={() => setWorkspaceOpen(false)}
          className="md:hidden flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-white mr-2"
        >
          <ArrowLeft size={14} />
          <span>Chat</span>
        </button>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-1">
          {tabs.map((tab) => {
            const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                id={`workspace-tab-${tab.id}`}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-white/[0.10] text-white shadow-sm'
                    : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-white/[0.04]'
                }`}
              >
                {tab.icon}
                <span>{tab.label}</span>
                {tab.hasActivity && (
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <button
          id="workspace-close-btn"
          onClick={() => setWorkspaceOpen(false)}
          className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 ml-2 cursor-pointer"
          title="Close Workspace"
        >
          <X size={15} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Active Tab View (disabled pointer events during resizer drag) */}
      <div className={`flex-1 overflow-hidden ${isResizing ? 'pointer-events-none select-none' : ''}`}>
        <Suspense fallback={<div className="p-4 text-xs text-slate-400">Loading workspace tool…</div>}>
          {activeTab === 'preview' && <PreviewTab />}
          {activeTab === 'code' && <CodeTab />}
          {activeTab === 'diff' && <DiffTab />}
          {activeTab === 'logs' && <LogsTab />}
          {activeTab === 'shell' && <ShellTab />}
        </Suspense>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import { api } from '../../services/api';
import { FileTree } from './FileTree';

export const CodeTab: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    files,
    codeDrafts,
    setCodeDraft,
    clearCodeDraft,
    activeFile,
    setActiveFile,
    setFiles,
    theme,
    reloadPreview,
  } = useWorkspaceStore();
  const { currentProjectId } = useProjectStore();
  const confirm = useConfirm();

  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);
  const [saveSuccess, setSaveSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [explorerOpen, setExplorerOpen] = useState(true);
  const [narrow, setNarrow] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Collapse labels (and start with the explorer hidden) in a narrow workspace.
  useEffect(() => {
    const node = containerRef.current;
    if (!node) return;
    let first = true;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      const isNarrow = node.clientWidth < 640;
      setNarrow(isNarrow);
      if (first && node.clientWidth < 480) setExplorerOpen(false);
      first = false;
    });
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const fileList = Object.keys(files);

  // Reset editor status notifications when switching project
  useEffect(() => {
    setSaveError(null);
    setSaveSuccess(false);
  }, [currentProjectId]);

  // Derive current file content (draft takes precedence over persisted file)
  const activeContent = activeFile
    ? codeDrafts[activeFile] !== undefined
      ? codeDrafts[activeFile]
      : files[activeFile] || ''
    : '// Select a file from the explorer';

  // Dirty state checks
  const isCurrentDirty = Boolean(
    activeFile &&
      codeDrafts[activeFile] !== undefined &&
      codeDrafts[activeFile] !== (files[activeFile] || '')
  );

  const isFileDirty = useCallback(
    (path: string) => {
      return (
        codeDrafts[path] !== undefined &&
        codeDrafts[path] !== (files[path] || '')
      );
    },
    [codeDrafts, files]
  );

  // Warn on page unload if any drafts are dirty
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforeUnload = (e: BeforeUnloadEvent) => {
      const hasDirty = Object.keys(codeDrafts).some(
        (p) => codeDrafts[p] !== undefined && codeDrafts[p] !== (files[p] || '')
      );
      if (hasDirty) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.returnValue = '';
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
  }, [codeDrafts, files]);

  const handleFileSelect = async (file: string) => {
    if (file === activeFile) return;
    if (isCurrentDirty) {
      const ok = await confirm({
        title: 'Unsaved Changes',
        message: `"${activeFile}" has unsaved changes. Do you want to keep your draft and switch to "${file}"?`,
        confirmText: 'Keep Draft & Switch',
        cancelText: 'Stay on Current File',
        variant: 'warning',
      });
      if (!ok) return;
    }
    setActiveFile(file);
  };

  const getLanguage = (path: string) => {
    if (path.endsWith('.tsx') || path.endsWith('.ts')) return 'typescript';
    if (path.endsWith('.jsx') || path.endsWith('.js')) return 'javascript';
    if (path.endsWith('.css')) return 'css';
    if (path.endsWith('.json')) return 'json';
    if (path.endsWith('.html')) return 'html';
    if (path.endsWith('.md')) return 'markdown';
    return 'plaintext';
  };

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    try {
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(activeContent);
      } else {
        const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textArea.value = activeContent;
        document.body.appendChild(textArea);
        textArea.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(textArea);
      }
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch {
      try {
        const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textArea.value = activeContent;
        document.body.appendChild(textArea);
        textArea.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(textArea);
        setCopied(true);
        setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
      } catch {
        toast.error('Copy Failed', 'Clipboard access denied.');
      }
    }
  };

  const handleEditorChange = (value?: string) => {
    if (!activeFile) return;
    const val = value ?? '';
    setCodeDraft(activeFile, val);
  };

  const handleDiscard = () => {
    if (!activeFile) return;
    clearCodeDraft(activeFile);
    setSaveError(null);
  };

  const handleSave = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!currentProjectId || !activeFile || !isCurrentDirty || isSaving) return;

    const ok = await confirm({
      title: 'Overwrite File',
      message: `Are you sure you want to overwrite "${activeFile}" on disk? This will save your editor changes and run workspace verification.`,
      confirmText: 'Overwrite File',
      variant: 'warning',
    });
    if (!ok) return;

    setIsSaving(true);
    setSaveError(null);
    try {
      const res = await api.saveProjectFile(currentProjectId, activeFile, activeContent);
      if (res.files) {
        setFiles(res.files);
      }
      // Remove draft on successful persist
      clearCodeDraft(activeFile);
      reloadPreview();
      setSaveSuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSaveSuccess(false), 2000);

      // Check validation result from save
      if (res.validation && (!res.validation.build_passed || !res.validation.typecheck_passed)) {
        const errDetails = Array.isArray(res.validation.errors) && res.validation.errors.length > 0
          ? res.validation.errors.join('\n')
          : 'Workspace verification failed after save.';
        toast.error('Build Failure', errDetails);
      } else {
        toast.success('File Saved', `Successfully updated "${activeFile}".`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to save file:', err);
      setSaveError(err.message || 'Failed to save file');
      toast.error('Build Failure', err.message || 'Failed to save and verify project file.');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  }, [currentProjectId, activeFile, isCurrentDirty, isSaving, activeContent, setFiles, reloadPreview, confirm]);

  const handleDeleteFile = async (fileToDelete: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!currentProjectId) return;

    const ok = await confirm({
      title: 'Delete File',
      message: `Are you sure you want to delete "${fileToDelete}"? This action cannot be undone.`,
      confirmText: 'Delete File',
      variant: 'danger',
    });
    if (!ok) return;

    try {
      const res = await api.deleteProjectFile(currentProjectId, fileToDelete);
      if (res.files) {
        setFiles(res.files);
      } else {
        const nextFiles = { ...files };
        delete nextFiles[fileToDelete];
        setFiles(nextFiles);
      }
      clearCodeDraft(fileToDelete);
      if (activeFile === fileToDelete) {
        const remaining = fileList.filter((f) => f !== fileToDelete);
        setActiveFile(remaining.length > 0 ? remaining[0] : '');
      }
      toast.success('File Deleted', `Deleted "${fileToDelete}".`);
      reloadPreview();
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to delete file:', err);
      toast.error('Delete Failed', err.message || 'Could not delete file.');
    }
  };

  const handleExportZip = async () => {
    if (!currentProjectId || isExporting) return;
    setIsExporting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(api.getProjectExportUrl(currentProjectId));
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: res.statusText }));
        throw new Error(errData.error || `Export failed with HTTP ${res.status}`);
      }
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const downloadUrl = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = downloadUrl;
      a.download = `${currentProjectId}.zip`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(downloadUrl);
      toast.success('Export Ready', 'Project ZIP downloaded successfully.');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Export error:', err);
      toast.error('Export Failure', err.message || 'Could not export project ZIP.');
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  // Keep a ref to handleSave for Monaco command handler
  const saveRef = useRef(handleSave);
  useEffect(() => {
    saveRef.current = handleSave;
  }, [handleSave]);

  // Global Ctrl+S / Cmd+S shortcut
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 's') {
        e.preventDefault();
        saveRef.current();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  const handleEditorWillMount = (monaco: any) => {
    const ts = monaco.languages?.typescript || monaco.typescript;
    if (!ts) return;
    for (const defaults of [ts.typescriptDefaults, ts.javascriptDefaults]) {
      defaults?.setDiagnosticsOptions?.({ noSemanticValidation: true, noSyntaxValidation: false });
      defaults?.setCompilerOptions?.({
        jsx: ts.JsxEmit?.ReactJSX ?? 4,
        target: ts.ScriptTarget?.ES2020 ?? 7,
        allowNonTsExtensions: true,
        esModuleInterop: true,
      });
    }
  };

  const handleEditorDidMount = (editor: any, monaco: any) => {
    editor.addCommand(monaco.KeyMod.CtrlCmd | monaco.KeyCode.KeyS, () => {
      saveRef.current();
    });
  };

  return (
    <div
      id="code-tab-container"
      ref={containerRef}
      className="flex-1 flex h-full bg-[#0a0c10] overflow-hidden"
    >
      {/* Left File Explorer */}
      {explorerOpen && (
        <div
          id="code-file-explorer"
          className="w-52 shrink-0 border-r border-white/[0.08] bg-[#141619] flex flex-col h-full"
        >
          <div className="h-11 px-3 border-b border-white/[0.06] text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <FolderCode size={14} className="text-emerald-400" />
              <span>Files</span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-400 font-mono">{fileList.length}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-1 font-mono text-xs">
            <FileTree files={fileList} activeFile={activeFile} isDirty={isFileDirty} onSelect={handleFileSelect} onDelete={handleDeleteFile} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Right Monaco Editor Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden">
        {/* Editor Toolbar */}
        <div
          id="code-editor-toolbar"
          className="h-11 border-b border-white/[0.08] bg-[#141619] px-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-slate-300 min-w-0">
            <button
              id="code-explorer-toggle-btn"
              onClick={() => setExplorerOpen(!explorerOpen)}
              className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              title={explorerOpen ? 'Hide file explorer' : 'Show file explorer'}
              aria-label={explorerOpen ? 'Hide file explorer' : 'Show file explorer'}
            >
              {explorerOpen ? <PanelLeftClose size={14} /> : <PanelLeftOpen size={14} />}
            </button>
            <FileText size={14} className="text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-medium truncate" title={activeFile}>{activeFile || 'No file selected'}</span>

            {/* Unsaved changes indicator badge */}
            {isCurrentDirty && (
              <span
                id="code-unsaved-badge"
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 font-sans font-medium"
                title="File has unsaved modifications (Ctrl+S to save)"
              >
                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-pulse" />
                <span className={narrow ? 'sr-only' : ''}>Unsaved</span>
              </span>
            )}

            {saveError && (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/30 font-sans">
                <AlertCircle size={12} />
                <span>{saveError}</span>
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
            {/* Discard changes button */}
            {isCurrentDirty && (
              <button
                id="code-discard-btn"
                onClick={handleDiscard}
                disabled={isSaving}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-white/[0.04] hover:bg-rose-500/15 hover:text-rose-300 hover:border-rose-500/30 text-slate-400 text-xs border border-white/[0.08] transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                title="Discard unsaved changes and revert to disk version"
              >
                <Undo2 size={12} />
                <span className={narrow ? 'sr-only' : ''}>Discard</span>
              </button>
            )}

            {/* Save file button */}
            {isCurrentDirty && (
              <button
                id="code-save-btn"
                onClick={handleSave}
                disabled={isSaving}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50"
                title="Save changes to disk and trigger verification (Ctrl+S)"
              >
                {saveSuccess ? (
                  <>
                    <Check size={12} className="text-emerald-400" />
                    <span>Saved!</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Save size={12} className={isSaving ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
                    <span>{isSaving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save'}</span>
                    {!narrow && <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400/60 font-mono">Ctrl+S</span>}
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            )}

            {/* Copy button */}
            <button
              id="code-copy-btn"
              onClick={handleCopy}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-white/[0.04] hover:bg-white/[0.08] text-slate-300 text-xs border border-white/[0.06] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Copy current code to clipboard"
            >
              {copied ? (
                <>
                  <Check size={12} className="text-emerald-400" />
                  <span className="text-emerald-400 font-medium">Copied</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Copy size={12} />
                  <span className={narrow ? 'sr-only' : ''}>Copy</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>

            {/* Download ZIP button */}
            <button
              id="code-download-zip-btn"
              onClick={handleExportZip}
              disabled={!currentProjectId || isExporting}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-white/[0.04] hover:bg-emerald-500/15 hover:text-emerald-300 hover:border-emerald-500/30 text-slate-300 text-xs border border-white/[0.06] transition-all cursor-pointer font-medium disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              title={currentProjectId ? "Download complete runnable project as ZIP" : "Select or generate a project to download ZIP"}
            >
              <Download size={12} className={`text-emerald-400 ${isExporting ? 'animate-bounce' : ''}`} />
              <span className={narrow ? 'sr-only' : ''}>{isExporting ? 'Exporting...' : 'ZIP'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Monaco Editor */}
        <div id="monaco-code-editor-container" className="flex-1 overflow-hidden">
          <Editor
            height="100%"
            path={activeFile || 'untitled.tsx'}
            language={getLanguage(activeFile)}
            value={activeContent}
            onChange={handleEditorChange}
            beforeMount={handleEditorWillMount}
            onMount={handleEditorDidMount}
            theme={theme === 'dark' ? 'vs-dark' : 'light'}
            options={{
              readOnly: !activeFile || !currentProjectId,
              minimap: { enabled: !narrow },
              fontSize: 13,
              fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace",
              scrollBeyondLastLine: false,
              automaticLayout: true,
              tabSize: 2,
              wordWrap: 'on',
              lineNumbers: 'on',
            }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import { CanonicalTurnDiff, FileDiffEntry } from '../../types/chat';
import { useConfirm } from '../../state/confirm-store';
import { toast } from '../../state/toast-store';

function getLanguageForFile(filePath: string): string {
  const ext = filePath.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase();
  switch (ext) {
    case 'ts':
    case 'tsx':
      return 'typescript';
    case 'js':
    case 'jsx':
      return 'javascript';
    case 'css':
      return 'css';
    case 'html':
      return 'html';
    case 'json':
      return 'json';
    case 'md':
      return 'markdown';
    default:
      return 'plaintext';
  }
}

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [reverting, setReverting] = useState(false);
  const [revertSuccess, setRevertSuccess] = useState(false);
  const confirm = useConfirm();
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [narrow, setNarrow] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {

    if (!node) return;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => setNarrow(node.clientWidth < 680));
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const turnCount = currentProject?.turnCount || 1;
  // Reverting to the latest turn would change nothing.
  const isLatestTurn = selectedTurn >= turnCount;

  // Derive file entries map and list
  const filesMap: Record<string, FileDiffEntry> = useMemo(() => {
    return turnDiff?.files || {};
  }, [turnDiff]);

  const fileList = useMemo(() => {
    return Object.keys(filesMap);
  }, [filesMap]);

  const currentFileEntry = useMemo(() => {
    return selectedFile && filesMap[selectedFile] ? filesMap[selectedFile] : null;
  }, [selectedFile, filesMap]);

  // Load canonical turn diff
  const loadDiff = useCallback(

      try {

        setTurnDiff(data);

        const loadedFiles = Object.keys(data.files || {});
        // Select first changed file by default, or preserve selectedFile if still present
        const targetFile =
          selectedFile && loadedFiles.includes(selectedFile)
            ? selectedFile
            : loadedFiles[0] || '';

        setSelectedFile(targetFile);

        if (targetFile && data.files && data.files[targetFile]) {
          const entry = data.files[targetFile];
          setDiff(entry.before || '', entry.after || '', turn, targetFile);
        } else {
          setDiff('', '', turn, targetFile);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load turn diff:', err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [currentProjectId, selectedFile, setDiff]
  );

  // Sync turn count changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (diffTurn && diffTurn !== selectedTurn) {
      setSelectedTurn(diffTurn);
    }
  }, [diffTurn]);

  // Reset diff state if no project is active
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentProjectId) {
      setTurnDiff(null);
      setSelectedFile('');
      setSelectedTurn(1);

  }, [currentProjectId]);

  // Fetch diff on project or turn change

      message: `Revert project back to Checkpoint Turn ${selectedTurn}? Any unsaved edits or later turns will be rolled back.`,
      confirmText: `Revert to Turn ${selectedTurn}`,
      variant: 'danger',
    });
    if (!ok) return;

      if (result.files) {

      setRevertSuccess(true);

    } catch (err: any) {

      toast.error('Revert Failed', err.message || String(err));
    } finally {

  return (
    <div
      id="diff-tab-container"
      ref={containerRef}
      className="flex-1 flex flex-col h-full bg-[#0a0c10] overflow-hidden"
    >
      {/* Diff Toolbar */}
      <div
        id="diff-toolbar"

      >

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-slate-400">

              Turn:
            </span>
            <select
              id="diff-turn-select"
              value={selectedTurn}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedTurn(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="bg-[#1a1d22] text-slate-200 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-white/[0.1] focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500/50 transition-colors text-xs font-medium cursor-pointer"
            >
              {Array.from({ length: turnCount }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((t) => (
                <option key={t} value={t}>
                  Turn {t}{t === 1 ? ' (first)' : ` vs ${t - 1}`}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          {/* View Mode Toggle (Split Diff vs Unified Patch) */}
          <div

              const isNew = !entry?.before && Boolean(entry?.after);
              const isDeleted = Boolean(entry?.before) && !entry?.after;

              return (
                <button
                  key={file}
                  id={`diff-file-btn-${file.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_')}`}
                  onClick={() => handleFileSelect(file)}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer border ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-200 shadow-sm'

                  title={file}
                >
                  <File size={12} className={isSelected ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-slate-500'} />
                  <span className="truncate max-w-[200px]">{file.split('/').pop()}</span>

                      -
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden relative">
        {isLoading ? (

        ) : fileList.length === 0 ? (
          <div
            id="diff-empty-turn-state"
            className="h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-6"
          >
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-slate-800/80 border border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-center mb-3">
              <CheckCircle2 size={24} className="text-emerald-400" />

            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-md mb-2 leading-relaxed">
              This turn completed without modifying project files (e.g. read-only dependency query
              or validation status check).
            </p>
            {turnDiff?.summary && (
              <div className="mt-2 p-3 bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.06] rounded max-w-lg text-left text-xs font-mono text-slate-300">

                  Turn Summary

              key={`${selectedTurn}:${selectedFile}`}
              keepCurrentOriginalModel

              modifiedModelPath={`diff-modified/${selectedTurn}/${selectedFile}`}

"""
shell_server.py — Dedicated WebSocket PowerShell Server (Port 5001)
Runs as an isolated OS process with its own Python interpreter and GIL.
Completely eliminates GIL contention with PyTorch/Unsloth model inference.
Features a dedicated persistent writer thread with queue batching for zero-latency keystrokes.
"""

import asyncio
import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import os
import queue
import re
import socket
import sys
import threading
import time
import urllib.parse
from pathlib import Path

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.resolve()
REPO_ROOT = BASE_DIR.parent
PROJECTS_ROOT = (REPO_ROOT / "generated_components").resolve()


def _shell_cwd(requested: str) -> Path:
    """Open the shell in the requested project folder, if it is a generated project."""
    if requested:
        try:
            candidate = Path(requested).resolve()
            if candidate.is_dir() and PROJECTS_ROOT in candidate.parents:
                return candidate
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            pass
    return REPO_ROOT
DEBUG = os.environ.get("SHELL_DEBUG", "").lower() in ("1", "true", "yes")
HOST = os.environ.get("SHELL_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
AUTH_TOKEN = os.environ.get("SHELL_AUTH_TOKEN", "").strip()

# Cross-platform PTY support: WinPTY on Windows, ptyprocess on POSIX
_HAS_WINPTY = False
_HAS_POSIX_PTY = False

if os.name == "nt":
    try:
        from winpty import PtyProcess
        from winpty.enums import Backend
        _HAS_WINPTY = True
    except ImportError:
        print("[Shell Server] Error: pywinpty is not installed; Windows shell unavailable.")
        sys.exit(1)
else:
    try:
        from ptyprocess import PtyProcessUnicode as PtyProcess
        _HAS_POSIX_PTY = True
    except ImportError:
        print("[Shell Server] Error: ptyprocess is not installed; POSIX shell unavailable.")
        sys.exit(1)

import websockets

ALLOWED_ORIGIN_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r"^https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:\d+)?$"),
    re.compile(rf"^https?://{re.escape(HOST)}(:\d+)?$"),
    None,  # Allow non-browser direct clients (curl, node tools, local scripts)
]

# Track seen nonces for short-lived HMAC tickets to prevent replay attacks
_SEEN_NONCES: dict[str, float] = {}

def _clean_stale_nonces():
    now = time.time()
    stale = [n for n, exp in _SEEN_NONCES.items() if exp < now]
    for n in stale:
        _SEEN_NONCES.pop(n, None)

def _verify_shell_token(token: str) -> bool:
    """Verifies either raw AUTH_TOKEN or single-use HMAC ticket (timestamp.nonce.sig)."""
    if not AUTH_TOKEN:
        return False
    if not isinstance(token, str) or not token:
        return False
    if hmac.compare_digest(token.encode("utf-8"), AUTH_TOKEN.encode("utf-8")):
        return True

    # Check if single-use HMAC ticket: {timestamp}.{nonce}.{sig}
    parts = token.split(".")
    if len(parts) == 3:
        ts_str, nonce, sig = parts
        try:
            ts = int(ts_str)
            now = time.time()
            if abs(now - ts) > 30.0:
                if DEBUG:
                    print(f"[Shell WS] Ticket expired (age: {now - ts:.1f}s)")
                return False
            _clean_stale_nonces()
            if nonce in _SEEN_NONCES:
                if DEBUG:
                    print("[Shell WS] Nonce replay attack prevented")
                return False
            payload = f"{ts}:{nonce}"
            expected_sig = hmac.new(AUTH_TOKEN.encode("utf-8"), payload.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
            if hmac.compare_digest(sig, expected_sig):
                _SEEN_NONCES[nonce] = now + 60.0  # cache nonce for 60s
                return True
        except Exception as e:
            if DEBUG:
                print(f"[Shell WS] Error validating ticket: {e}")
            return False
    return False


def process_request(connection, request):
    """Rejects cross-origin requests or invalid tokens before handshake completes."""
    # 1. Origin check against allowed patterns
    origin = request.headers.get("Origin")
    if origin:
        allowed = False
        for pat in ALLOWED_ORIGIN_PATTERNS:
            if pat and pat.match(origin):
                allowed = True
                break
        if not allowed:
            if DEBUG:
                print(f"[Shell Server] Rejected WebSocket from disallowed origin: {origin}")
            return connection.respond(403, "Forbidden: Cross-origin WebSocket blocked\n")

    # 2. Token check if query param supplied
    if not AUTH_TOKEN:
        return connection.respond(503, "Shell authentication is not configured\n")
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(request.path)
    qs = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query)
    token = qs.get("token", [""])[0]
    if token:
        if not _verify_shell_token(token):
            return connection.respond(401, "Unauthorized: Invalid shell token\n")
        connection._shell_authenticated = True
    connection._shell_cwd = _shell_cwd(qs.get("cwd", [""])[0])
    return None


async def shell_handler(ws):
    cols, rows = 120, 30
    if DEBUG:
        print("[Shell WS] New client connected to port 5001")

    # If not already authenticated via query param, require initial auth message within 5s
    if not AUTH_TOKEN:
        await ws.close(code=4401, reason="Shell authentication is not configured")
        return
    if not getattr(ws, "_shell_authenticated", False):
        try:
            raw_msg = await asyncio.wait_for(ws.recv(), timeout=5.0)
            if isinstance(raw_msg, bytes):
                raw_msg = raw_msg.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
            auth_data = json.loads(raw_msg) if raw_msg.startswith("{") else {}
            token = auth_data.get("token", "")
            if not _verify_shell_token(token):
                await ws.send("\r\n[Server] Unauthorized: Invalid session token.\r\n")
                await ws.close(code=4401, reason="Unauthorized")
                return
        except Exception:
            try:
                await ws.send("\r\n[Server] Unauthorized: Authentication timed out or failed.\r\n")
                await ws.close(code=4401, reason="Unauthorized")
            except Exception as _close_err:
                if DEBUG:
                    print(f"[Shell WS] Error closing unauthorized ws: {_close_err}")
            return

    try:
        if os.name == "nt":
            pty = PtyProcess.spawn(
                [
                    "powershell.exe",
                    "-NoLogo",
                    "-NoExit",
                    "-Command",
                    "Remove-Module PSReadLine -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue",
                ],
                dimensions=(rows, cols),
                cwd=str(getattr(ws, "_shell_cwd", REPO_ROOT)),
                backend=Backend.WinPTY,
            )
            try:
                pty.fileobj.settimeout(0.3)
            except Exception as e:
                if DEBUG:
                    print(f"[Shell WS] Note: socket settimeout not applicable to pty handle: {e}")
        else:
            shell_bin = os.environ.get("SHELL", "/bin/bash")
            pty = PtyProcess.spawn(
                [shell_bin, "-i"],
                dimensions=(rows, cols),
                cwd=str(getattr(ws, "_shell_cwd", REPO_ROOT)),
            )
    except Exception as exc:
        if DEBUG:
            print(f"[Shell WS] Failed to spawn PTY: {exc}")
        try:
            await ws.send(f"\r\n[Server] Failed to spawn shell: {exc}\r\n")
            await ws.close()
        except Exception as _close_err:
            if DEBUG:
                print(f"[Shell WS] Error closing ws: {_close_err}")
        return

    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    stop_event = threading.Event()
    current_cols, current_rows = cols, rows

    # ── Reader Thread ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def pty_reader():
        if DEBUG:
            print("[Shell WS] pty_reader thread started")
        try:
            while not stop_event.is_set():
                try:
                    data = pty.read(4096)
                except (TimeoutError, socket.timeout):
                    continue
                except EOFError:
                    if DEBUG:
                        print("[Shell WS] pty_reader EOF reached")
                    break
                except Exception as e:
                    if "timed out" in str(e).lower():
                        continue
                    if DEBUG:
                        print(f"[Shell WS] pty_reader error: {e}")
                    break
                if data:
                    if DEBUG:
                        print(f"[Shell WS] pty_reader read {len(data)} chars: {repr(data[:60])}")
                    asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(ws.send(data), loop)
        except Exception as e:
            if DEBUG:
                print(f"[Shell WS] pty_reader loop error: {e}")
        finally:
            stop_event.set()
            if DEBUG:
                print("[Shell WS] pty_reader thread exited")

    # ── Dedicated Persistent Writer Thread (Non-blocking queue batching) ───────
    write_queue = queue.Queue()

    def pty_writer():
        if DEBUG:
            print("[Shell WS] pty_writer thread started")
        while not stop_event.is_set():
            try:
                item = write_queue.get(timeout=0.1)
            except queue.Empty:
                continue

            if item is None:
                break

            # Coalesce any queued keystrokes into a single batch for instantaneous throughput
            chunks = [item]
            while not write_queue.empty():
                try:
                    chunks.append(write_queue.get_nowait())
                except queue.Empty:
                    break

            combined = "".join(chunks)
            if DEBUG:
                print(f"[Shell WS] pty_writer dequeued {len(chunks)} chunks, combined len {len(combined)}: {repr(combined)}")
            try:
                if pty.isalive():
                    pty.write(combined)
                    if DEBUG:
                        print("[Shell WS] pty_writer write completed successfully")
                else:
                    if DEBUG:
                        print("[Shell WS] pty_writer: pty is not alive!")
            except Exception as e:
                if DEBUG:
                    print(f"[Shell WS] pty_writer write error: {e}")
                break

        if DEBUG:
            print("[Shell WS] pty_writer thread exited")

    reader_thread = threading.Thread(target=pty_reader, daemon=True)
    reader_thread.start()

    writer_thread = threading.Thread(target=pty_writer, daemon=True)
    writer_thread.start()

    try:
        async for msg in ws:
            if isinstance(msg, bytes):
                msg = msg.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")

            # Check for JSON control messages (e.g. resize)
            if isinstance(msg, str) and msg.startswith("{"):
                try:
                    ctrl = json.loads(msg)
                    if isinstance(ctrl, dict) and ctrl.get("type") == "resize":
                        c = int(ctrl.get("cols", current_cols))
                        r = int(ctrl.get("rows", current_rows))
                        if (c != current_cols or r != current_rows) and c >= 20 and r >= 5:
                            current_cols, current_rows = c, r
                            if pty.isalive():

            if pty.isalive():

    except Exception as e:
        if DEBUG:
            print(f"[Shell WS] Connection exception: {e}")
    finally:
        stop_event.set()
        write_queue.put(None)  # Wake up writer thread to exit
        try:
            pty.terminate(force=True)
        except Exception as _term_err:
            if DEBUG:
                print(f"[Shell WS] Note: PTY termination error: {_term_err}")
        if DEBUG:
            print("[Shell WS] Connection closed, PTY terminated.")


async def main():
    if not AUTH_TOKEN:
        raise RuntimeError("SHELL_AUTH_TOKEN must be set; refusing to start an unauthenticated shell")
    print(f"[Shell Server] Dedicated PowerShell WebSocket server running on ws://{HOST}:5001")
    server = await websockets.serve(
        shell_handler,
        HOST,
        5001,
        process_request=process_request,
        ping_interval=20,
        ping_timeout=15,
    )
    await server.wait_closed()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        asyncio.run(main())
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
