`````python
"""
anti_duplication_gate.py - Corpus-Level Anti-Duplication & Cross-Domain Overlap Gate

Computes phrase-level and CSS-value-level n-gram overlap across trajectories from different domains
(not just full-message hash dedup). Rejects or downsamples batches/trajectories where a cliché phrase
(e.g., "Carefully curated offerings tailored to provide exceptional quality and reliability")
or an identical multi-declaration CSS block appears across 3+ unrelated domains.

Exempts single-component tasks (e.g., shadcn/ui primitives, typescript_instruct) from the full-site
cross-domain ratio, as those are single-component tasks and not full-site compositions.
"""

import json
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple


# Cliché phrases that must never propagate across multiple domains
BANNED_TEMPLATE_CLICHES = [
    "carefully curated offerings tailored to provide exceptional quality and reliability",
    "carefully curated offerings tailored to provide",
    "offerings tailored to provide exceptional quality and reliability",
]

# Protocol and structural phrases to exclude from phrase n-gram deduplication
PROTOCOL_IGNORE_PHRASES = {
    "you are an expert autonomous react",
    "explain your plan for the current section",
    "tool call name write site",
    "build a complete website for the following",
    "first section required write the header",
    "files src components header tsx",
    "files src components hero tsx",
    "files src components footer tsx",
    "all rights reserved",
    "site build complete all required sections",
    "operating guidelines every turn output",
    "react typescript and css coding agent",
    "write one section one tsx file",
    "write one tool call name write site",
    "header hero core offerings and footer",
    "core offerings and footer are complete",
    "sections of the website are written and verified",
    "strictly comply with the active design tokens",
    "all 4 sections of the",
    "successfully built the complete",
    "website with full responsive layouts",
    "it needs to reflect the brand identity",
    "deep background with crisp contrast",
    "implement a scroll listener to trigger",
    "trigger glassmorphism and subtle border illumination",
    "subtle border illumination on scroll",
    "start by crafting the header for",
    "now implementing the section",
    "using a responsive card grid with",
    "hero accepted now implementing",
    "section accepted now completing the final",
    "final section footer it will display",
}

GENERIC_LAYOUT_PROPS = {
    "display", "align-items", "justify-content", "flex-direction", "gap",
    "flex", "grid-template-columns", "grid-column", "grid-row",
    "width", "height", "max-width", "min-height", "margin", "padding",
    "position", "top", "left", "right", "bottom", "z-index", "overflow",
    "box-sizing", "text-align",
}

def is_distinctive_css_block(norm: str, min_declarations: int = 4) -> bool:
    """
    Determines if a normalized CSS block represents a distinctive visual styling pattern
    (e.g., custom card surfaces, branded borders, shadows, and color themes) rather than
    a generic flexbox/grid layout, alignment container, or micro-indicator dot/bar.
    """
    decls = [d.strip() for d in norm.split(";") if d.strip() and ":" in d]
    if len(decls) < min_declarations:
        return False

    # Filter out micro-indicators (e.g. width: 6px-25px, height: 2px-25px)
    has_micro_dimension = any(
        re.search(r"^(?:width|height):\s*(?:[1-9]|[12][0-9])px$", d) for d in decls
    )
    if has_micro_dimension and len(decls) <= 5:
        return False

    visual_props = [
        d.split(":")[0].strip().lower() for d in decls
        if any(v in d.split(":")[0].lower() for v in ["background", "border", "shadow", "radius", "color", "font-family", "backdrop"])
    ]
    # Must have at least 3 visual styling properties and min_declarations total properties
    return len(visual_props) >= 3 and len(decls) >= min_declarations

# Standard common CSS declarations to allow universally (resets, universal flex/grid idioms)
COMMON_CSS_ALLOWLIST = {
    "box-sizing:border-box",
    "margin:0",
    "padding:0",
    "width:100%",
    "height:100%",
    "display:flex",
    "display:none",
    "display:block",
    "display:grid",
    "align-items:center;display:flex",
    "display:flex;justify-content:center",
    "align-items:center;display:flex;justify-content:center",
    "background:transparent;border:none",
    "cursor:pointer",
    "position:relative",
    "position:absolute",
    "animation:none !important;transform:none !important;transition:none !important",
    "animation:none !important;opacity:1 !important;transform:none !important;transition:none !important",
    "transform:none !important;transition:none !important",
    "opacity:1 !important;transform:none !important;transition:none !important",
    "animation:none !important;transition:none !important",
}


def is_full_site_trajectory(trajectory: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """
    Identifies whether a trajectory represents a full-site multi-section composition
    or a single-component task (e.g. shadcn UI primitives, typescript-instruct).
    Single-component tasks are exempt from full-site cross-domain checks.
    """
    task_id = trajectory.get("task_id", "")
    if not task_id:
        return False

    # Check task_id prefixes
    if task_id.startswith("site_"):
        return True

    # Check for presence of write_site tool calls or multi-section files
    messages = trajectory.get("messages", [])
    has_site_call = False
    for m in messages:
        c = m.get("content", "")
        if 'name="write_site"' in c or "src/components/Header.tsx" in c:
            has_site_call = True
            break

    # Single-component task indicators (e.g. shadcn, radix, standalone primitives)
    if any(k in task_id.lower() for k in ["shadcn", "primitive", "task_", "episode_task_"]):
        if not has_site_call:
            return False

    return has_site_call


def extract_domain(trajectory: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """
    Extracts canonical business domain from brief XML, business_type, or task_id.
    """
    messages = trajectory.get("messages", [])
    for m in messages:
        c = m.get("content", "")
        btype_m = re.search(r"<business_type>(.*?)</business_type>", c)
        if btype_m:
            return btype_m.group(1).strip().lower()

    task_id = trajectory.get("task_id", "")
    parts = task_id.split("_")
    if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[0] == "site":
        return parts[1].lower()

    return "general"


def extract_prose_ngrams(trajectory: Dict[str, Any], n: int = 7, include_thoughts: bool = False) -> Set[str]:
    """
    Extracts normalized word n-grams from human-facing component copy
    (JSX text nodes, subtitles, quotes, card descriptions, and titles).
    Optionally includes thoughts with meta-planning filtering.
    """
    ngrams: Set[str] = set()
    messages = trajectory.get("messages", [])

    for m in messages:
        if m.get("role") != "assistant":
            continue
        content = m.get("content", "")
        prose_chunks = []

        # 1. JSX text nodes (e.g. <p>...</p>, <h2>...</h2>, <h3>...</h3>, <span>...</span>)
        jsx_texts = re.findall(r">([^<>{}\n]{15,200})<", content)
        prose_chunks.extend(jsx_texts)

        # 2. TSX object literals with description, subtitle, quote, tagline
        desc_matches = re.findall(r'["\'](?:desc|description|quote|subtitle|tagline)["\']\s*:\s*["\']([^"\']{15,200})["\']', content)
        prose_chunks.extend(desc_matches)

        # 3. Optional thought prose (excluding agent turn-orchestration boilerplate)
        if include_thoughts:
            thoughts = re.findall(r"<thought>\s*(.*?)\s*</thought>", content, flags=re.DOTALL)
            for th in thoughts:
                for sent in re.split(r"[.!?]\s+", th):
                    sent_l = sent.lower()
                    if any(k in sent_l for k in [
                        "accepted", "finalizing", "strictly comply", "written and verified",
                        "now implementing", "now building", "start by crafting", "completing the final section",
                        "design tokens", "active design tokens", "tool_call", "write_site"
                    ]):
                        continue
                    prose_chunks.append(sent)

        for chunk in prose_chunks:
            # Normalize text
            clean = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]", " ", chunk).lower()
            words = [w for w in clean.split() if len(w) >= 3]
            if len(words) < n:
                continue

            for i in range(len(words) - n + 1):
                ngram = " ".join(words[i:i + n])
                if any(ig in ngram for ig in PROTOCOL_IGNORE_PHRASES):
                    continue
                ngrams.add(ngram)

    return ngrams


def normalize_css_block(block_body: str) -> str:
    """
    Normalizes a CSS rule body into a canonical, alphabetically sorted declaration string.
    """
    # Strip comments
    clean = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", block_body, flags=re.DOTALL)
    decls = []
    for line in clean.split(";"):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or ":" not in line:
            continue
        prop, val = line.split(":", 1)
        prop = prop.strip().lower()
        val = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", val.strip().lower())
        # Strip vendor prefixes for canonical matching
        prop = re.sub(r"^-(?:webkit|moz|ms|o)-", "", prop)
        decls.append(f"{prop}:{val}")

    decls.sort()
    return ";".join(decls)


def extract_css_blocks(trajectory: Dict[str, Any], min_declarations: int = 4) -> Set[str]:
    """
    Extracts non-trivial normalized CSS declaration blocks from written CSS files.
    """
    blocks: Set[str] = set()
    messages = trajectory.get("messages", [])

    for m in messages:
        if m.get("role") != "assistant":
            continue
        content = m.get("content", "")
        css_files = re.findall(r'<file path="[^"]*\.css">\s*(.*?)\s*</file>', content, flags=re.DOTALL)

        for css in css_files:
            rule_bodies = re.findall(r'\{([^}]+)\}', css)
            for body in rule_bodies:
                norm = normalize_css_block(body)
                # Ensure it is a distinctive styling block rather than generic layout/utility
                if is_distinctive_css_block(norm, min_declarations=min_declarations) and norm not in COMMON_CSS_ALLOWLIST:
                    blocks.add(norm)

    return blocks


class AntiDuplicationGate:
    """
    Corpus-level anti-duplication gate.
    Monitors cross-domain phrase and CSS block overlap, rejecting or downsampling
    trajectories that replicate identical phrases or CSS rules across 3+ unrelated domains.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        max_cross_domain_occurrences: int = 2,
        min_ngram_size: int = 7,
        min_css_declarations: int = 3,
        strict_banned_phrases: bool = True,
    ):
        self.max_cross_domain = max_cross_domain_occurrences
        self.min_ngram_size = min_ngram_size
        self.min_css_declarations = min_css_declarations
        self.strict_banned_phrases = strict_banned_phrases

        # phrase -> set of domain names where observed
        self.phrase_domain_index: Dict[str, Set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
        # phrase -> list of task_ids where observed
        self.phrase_task_index: Dict[str, List[str]] = defaultdict(list)

        # css_block -> set of domain names where observed
        self.css_domain_index: Dict[str, Set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
        # css_block -> list of task_ids where observed
        self.css_task_index: Dict[str, List[str]] = defaultdict(list)

        # Domain tracking
        self.domain_trajectory_count: Dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
        self.full_site_count = 0
        self.single_component_count = 0
        self.total_checked = 0
        self.total_rejected = 0

    def check_trajectory(self, trajectory: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]:
        """
        Checks a trajectory against the anti-duplication gate.
        Returns:
            (is_valid: bool, violations: List[str])
        """
        task_id = trajectory.get("task_id", "unknown")
        is_site = is_full_site_trajectory(trajectory)

        # Single component tasks are exempted from cross-domain full-site duplication gate
        if not is_site:
            return True, []

        domain = extract_domain(trajectory)
        violations: List[str] = []

        # 1. Check for banned template cliché phrases (e.g. "Carefully curated offerings...")
        if self.strict_banned_phrases:
            raw_text = json.dumps(trajectory).lower()
            for cliche in BANNED_TEMPLATE_CLICHES:
                if cliche in raw_text:
                    violations.append(
                        f"Contains banned template cliché phrase: '{cliche}'"
                    )

        # 2. Check phrase n-grams across unrelated domains
        ngrams = extract_prose_ngrams(trajectory, n=self.min_ngram_size)
        for ng in ngrams:
            existing_domains = self.phrase_domain_index.get(ng, set())
            unrelated_domains = existing_domains - {domain}
            if len(unrelated_domains) >= self.max_cross_domain:
                violations.append(
                    f"Phrase '{ng}' appears across {len(unrelated_domains)} unrelated domains: {list(unrelated_domains)[:4]}"
                )
                break  # Record highest-severity match

        # 3. Check CSS block declarations across unrelated domains
        css_blocks = extract_css_blocks(trajectory, min_declarations=self.min_css_declarations)
        for block in css_blocks:
            existing_css_domains = self.css_domain_index.get(block, set())
            unrelated_css_domains = existing_css_domains - {domain}
            if len(unrelated_css_domains) >= self.max_cross_domain:
                sample_decl = block[:80] + "..." if len(block) > 80 else block
                violations.append(
                    f"CSS block '{sample_decl}' appears across {len(unrelated_css_domains)} unrelated domains: {list(unrelated_css_domains)[:4]}"
                )
                break

        is_valid = len(violations) == 0
        return is_valid, violations

    def register_trajectory(self, trajectory: Dict[str, Any]):
        """
        Indexes a trajectory's phrases and CSS blocks under its domain.
        """
        task_id = trajectory.get("task_id", "unknown")
        is_site = is_full_site_trajectory(trajectory)

        self.total_checked += 1
        if not is_site:
            self.single_component_count += 1
            return

        self.full_site_count += 1
        domain = extract_domain(trajectory)
        self.domain_trajectory_count[domain] += 1

        # Index prose n-grams
        ngrams = extract_prose_ngrams(trajectory, n=self.min_ngram_size)
        for ng in ngrams:
            self.phrase_domain_index[ng].add(domain)
            if len(self.phrase_task_index[ng]) < 5:
                self.phrase_task_index[ng].append(task_id)

        # Index CSS blocks
        css_blocks = extract_css_blocks(trajectory, min_declarations=self.min_css_declarations)
        for block in css_blocks:
            self.css_domain_index[block].add(domain)
            if len(self.css_task_index[block]) < 5:
                self.css_task_index[block].append(task_id)

    def filter_trajectories(
        self,
        trajectories: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        mode: str = "reject",
    ) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Processes a sequence of trajectories through the gate, rejecting or downsampling
        violating items.
        """
        accepted: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        rejected: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        rejection_details: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

        for traj in trajectories:
            task_id = traj.get("task_id", "unknown")
            is_valid, violations = self.check_trajectory(traj)

            if is_valid:
                self.register_trajectory(traj)
                accepted.append(traj)
            else:
                self.total_rejected += 1
                rejected.append(traj)
                rejection_details.append({
                    "task_id": task_id,
                    "domain": extract_domain(traj),
                    "violations": violations,
                })

        report = {
            "total_input": len(trajectories),
            "accepted": len(accepted),
            "rejected": len(rejected),
            "full_site_count": self.full_site_count,
            "single_component_count": self.single_component_count,
            "rejections": rejection_details,
        }

        return accepted, report

    def audit_corpus(self, trajectories: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Audits an entire corpus or merged JSONL file and computes cross-domain overlap metrics.
        Returns a structured report verifying that baseline duplication has been eliminated.
        """
        full_site_trajs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        single_comp_trajs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

        target_cliche = BANNED_TEMPLATE_CLICHES[0]
        cliche_occurrences = 0

        # Dedicated temporary gate to measure cross-domain spread across the entire corpus
        temp_gate = AntiDuplicationGate(
            max_cross_domain_occurrences=self.max_cross_domain,
            min_ngram_size=self.min_ngram_size,
            min_css_declarations=self.min_css_declarations,
            strict_banned_phrases=False,
        )

        for traj in trajectories:
            if is_full_site_trajectory(traj):
                full_site_trajs.append(traj)
                # Check baseline phrase
                if target_cliche in json.dumps(traj).lower():
                    cliche_occurrences += 1
                temp_gate.register_trajectory(traj)
            else:
                single_comp_trajs.append(traj)

        # Count phrases appearing across 3+ unrelated domains
        cross_domain_phrases = {
            phrase: list(doms)
            for phrase, doms in temp_gate.phrase_domain_index.items()
            if len(doms) >= 3
        }

        # Count CSS blocks appearing across 3+ unrelated domains
        cross_domain_css = {
            block: list(doms)
            for block, doms in temp_gate.css_domain_index.items()
            if len(doms) >= 3
        }

        full_site_total = len(full_site_trajs)
        cliche_ratio_str = f"{cliche_occurrences}/{full_site_total}" if full_site_total > 0 else "0/0"
        baseline_beaten = cliche_occurrences < 102  # Baseline was 102 of 149

        return {
            "total_trajectories": len(trajectories),
            "full_site_trajectories": full_site_total,
            "single_component_tasks": len(single_comp_trajs),
            "target_cliche_occurrences": cliche_occurrences,
            "target_cliche_ratio": cliche_ratio_str,
            "baseline_beaten": baseline_beaten,
            "cross_domain_phrase_violations_count": len(cross_domain_phrases),
            "cross_domain_css_violations_count": len(cross_domain_css),
            "status": "PASS" if baseline_beaten and cliche_occurrences == 0 else "WARN",
        }
`````

`````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
data_pipeline/prompt_fidelity_gate.py - Prompt-Fidelity Quality Gate for ReactAgent SLM

Verifies that synthesized components and multi-section sites strictly adhere to
user prompts and content briefs by ensuring:
1. Named entities (business name, custom section titles, product/service offerings,
   pricing tiers, menu categories, specific prop names, aria-labels) are preserved.
2. Numerical counts (number of sections, pricing tiers, cards, items) are satisfied.
3. Silent dropping of requirements or genericization (e.g. replacing a specific brand
   with "Company Name" or "My Business") is rejected.
"""

import re
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple, Union


# Common generic placeholders that indicate silent genericization
GENERIC_PLACEHOLDER_PATTERNS = [
    r"\bCompany\s+Name\b",
    r"\bYour\s+Company\b",
    r"\bMy\s+Business\b",
    r"\bAcme\s+Corp\b",
    r"\bLorem\s+ipsum\b",
    r"\bDolor\s+sit\s+amet\b",
    r"\bGeneric\s+Title\b",
    r"\bSample\s+Business\b",
    r"\bPlaceholder\s+(?:Title|Text|Name|Description|Item|Company|Content)\b",
    r"\[Placeholder\]",
    r"\bInsert\s+(?:Text|Content|Name)\s+Here\b",
]

_GENERIC_RE = [re.compile(p, re.IGNORECASE) for p in GENERIC_PLACEHOLDER_PATTERNS]

# Word-to-number mapping for parsing count constraints
_WORD_NUM_MAP = {
    "one": 1, "two": 2, "three": 3, "four": 4, "five": 5,
    "six": 6, "seven": 7, "eight": 8, "nine": 9, "ten": 10,
    "single": 1, "dual": 2, "triple": 3,
}


def _normalize_text(text: str) -> str:
    """Normalizes whitespace and lowercases for fuzzy match checks."""
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip().lower()


def parse_brief_entities(brief: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Extracts all canonical named entities and expected counts from a content brief dict.
    """
    entities: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "business_name": brief.get("business_name", "").strip(),
        "tagline": brief.get("tagline", "").strip(),
        "sections": list(brief.get("sections", [])),
        "feature_titles": [],
        "tier_names": [],
        "menu_items": [],
        "testimonial_authors": [],
        "custom_sections": [],
        "expected_counts": {},
    }

    # Features / Offerings
    if "features" in brief and isinstance(brief["features"], list):
        for f in brief["features"]:
            if isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("title"):
                entities["feature_titles"].append(f["title"].strip())
            elif isinstance(f, str) and f.strip():
                entities["feature_titles"].append(f.strip())
        if entities["feature_titles"]:
            entities["expected_counts"]["features"] = len(entities["feature_titles"])

    # Pricing Tiers
    if "pricing_tiers" in brief and isinstance(brief["pricing_tiers"], list):
        for t in brief["pricing_tiers"]:
            if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("name"):
                entities["tier_names"].append(t["name"].strip())
        if entities["tier_names"]:
            entities["expected_counts"]["pricing_tiers"] = len(entities["tier_names"])

    # Menu Categories / Items
    if "menu_categories" in brief and isinstance(brief["menu_categories"], list):
        for cat in brief["menu_categories"]:
            if isinstance(cat, dict) and cat.get("name"):
                entities["menu_items"].append(cat["name"].strip())
                for itm in cat.get("items", []):
                    if isinstance(itm, dict) and itm.get("name"):
                        entities["menu_items"].append(itm["name"].strip())

    # Testimonials
    if "testimonials" in brief and isinstance(brief["testimonials"], list):
        for test in brief["testimonials"]:
            if isinstance(test, dict) and test.get("author"):
                entities["testimonial_authors"].append(test["author"].strip())
        if entities["testimonial_authors"]:
            entities["expected_counts"]["testimonials"] = len(entities["testimonial_authors"])

    # Custom section instructions
    custom_instrs = brief.get("custom_section_instructions", {})
    if isinstance(custom_instrs, dict):
        for sec_slug in custom_instrs:
            if sec_slug not in ("header", "hero", "footer"):
                clean_name = " ".join(w.capitalize() for w in re.split(r"[-_]", sec_slug) if w)
                entities["custom_sections"].append(clean_name)

    if entities["sections"]:
        entities["expected_counts"]["sections"] = len(entities["sections"])

    return entities


def parse_prompt_entities_and_counts(prompt: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Parses named entities and quantity constraints directly from a raw user prompt.
    """
    parsed: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "quoted_entities": [],
        "named_entities": [],
        "aria_labels": [],
        "counts": {},
        "target_symbols": [],
    }

    # 1. Quoted phrases (e.g. 'AURA Spatial Audio' or "Beacon Coffee")
    quotes = re.findall(r"['\"]([^'\"]{3,60})['\"]", prompt)
    for q in quotes:
        clean_q = q.strip()
        if not clean_q.startswith("sa-") and not clean_q.startswith("kt-") and not clean_q.startswith("asa-"):
            parsed["quoted_entities"].append(clean_q)

    # 2. aria-label requests (e.g. aria-label="Current color")
    aria_matches = re.findall(r'aria-label=[\'"]([^\'"]+)[\'"]', prompt, re.IGNORECASE)
    parsed["aria_labels"].extend(aria_matches)

    # 3. Target React symbol names (e.g. `ColorPicker` or `SpeedDial`)
    symbols = re.findall(r"`([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]+)`", prompt)
    parsed["target_symbols"].extend(symbols)

    # 4. Explicit quantity patterns (e.g. "3 pricing tiers", "4 sections", "5 features")
    count_patterns = [
        r"\b(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten)\s+([a-zA-Z_-]+(?:\s+[a-zA-Z_-]+)?)\b",
    ]
    for cp in count_patterns:
        for num_str, noun in re.findall(cp, prompt, re.IGNORECASE):
            noun_norm = noun.lower().strip()
            # Filter common keywords
            for target_noun in ["section", "tier", "pricing tier", "feature", "testimonial", "card", "category", "menu item"]:
                if target_noun in noun_norm:
                    val = int(num_str) if num_str.isdigit() else _WORD_NUM_MAP.get(num_str.lower(), 0)
                    if val > 0:
                        parsed["counts"][target_noun] = val

    # 5. Extract listed sections after 'with' (e.g. 'with Header, Hero, Spatial Products, and Footer')
    with_match = re.search(r"\bwith\s+([A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_,\s]+(?:and\s+[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]+)?)\b", prompt)
    if with_match:
        items = re.split(r",|\band\b", with_match.group(1))
        for itm in items:
            clean_itm = itm.strip()
            if clean_itm and len(clean_itm) > 2 and clean_itm[0].isupper():
                parsed["named_entities"].append(clean_itm)

    return parsed


def _extract_all_code(rendered_files: Union[Dict[str, Any], List[Tuple[str, str]], List[Dict[str, Any]], str]) -> str:
    """Consolidates all source code and markup from rendered files or trajectory messages into a single corpus."""
    if isinstance(rendered_files, str):
        return rendered_files

    if isinstance(rendered_files, dict):
        chunks = []
        # Check if full trajectory dict
        if "messages" in rendered_files and isinstance(rendered_files["messages"], list):
            for m in rendered_files["messages"]:
                if isinstance(m, dict) and "content" in m:
                    chunks.append(str(m["content"]))
        if "files" in rendered_files and isinstance(rendered_files["files"], dict):
            for v in rendered_files["files"].values():
                chunks.append(str(v))
        if "code" in rendered_files and isinstance(rendered_files["code"], str):
            chunks.append(rendered_files["code"])

        if chunks:
            return "\n".join(chunks)

        # Fallback: simple {filename: code_string} dict
        for v in rendered_files.values():
            if isinstance(v, str):
                chunks.append(v)
            elif isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
                chunks.append(str(v))
        return "\n".join(chunks)

    if isinstance(rendered_files, list):
        chunks = []
        for item in rendered_files:
            if isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 2:
                chunks.append(str(item[1]))
            elif isinstance(item, dict):
                # Could be a trajectory message or file map
                if "content" in item:
                    chunks.append(str(item["content"]))
                elif "files" in item and isinstance(item["files"], dict):
                    chunks.extend(str(v) for v in item["files"].values())
                else:
                    chunks.extend(str(v) for v in item.values() if isinstance(v, str))
            elif isinstance(item, str):
                chunks.append(item)
        return "\n".join(chunks)

    return str(rendered_files)


def verify_prompt_fidelity(
    prompt: str,
    rendered_files: Union[Dict[str, str], List[Tuple[str, str]], List[Dict[str, Any]], str],
    brief: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    tolerance: float = 0.85,
) -> Tuple[bool, List[str], Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Evaluates prompt fidelity across rendered code.

    Returns:
        (passed: bool, failure_reasons: list[str], metrics: dict)
    """
    code_corpus = _extract_all_code(rendered_files)
    lower_code = code_corpus.lower()
    norm_code = _normalize_text(code_corpus)

    reasons: List[str] = []
    checked_count = 0
    passed_count = 0

    # 1. Generic placeholder check: reject silent genericization
    # Only flag generic placeholder if the prompt itself didn't ask for a generic placeholder
    # Strip HTML/JSX placeholder="..." attributes and prop definitions so standard inputs aren't flagged
    text_corpus_for_generics = re.sub(r'placeholder\s*=\s*["\'][^"\']*["\']', '', code_corpus, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    text_corpus_for_generics = re.sub(r'\bplaceholder\s*:\s*string\b', '', text_corpus_for_generics, flags=re.IGNORECASE)

    for pattern in _GENERIC_RE:
        match = pattern.search(text_corpus_for_generics)
        if match:
            matched_text = match.group(0)
            if matched_text.lower() not in prompt.lower():
                reasons.append(f"Contains generic placeholder '{matched_text}' instead of domain content.")

    # 2. Extract entities from brief (if provided)
    brief_entities = parse_brief_entities(brief) if brief else {}
    prompt_entities = parse_prompt_entities_and_counts(prompt)

    # 3. Check Business Name
    business_name = brief_entities.get("business_name")
    if not business_name:
        # Check quoted entities from prompt for potential business name (excluding aria-labels and code tokens)
        for q in prompt_entities["quoted_entities"]:
            if q in prompt_entities["aria_labels"]:
                continue
            if len(q.split()) <= 6 and not any(k in q.lower() for k in ["aria", "button", "src", "px", "#", "http", ".tsx", ".css"]):
                business_name = q
                break

    if business_name and len(business_name) > 2:
        checked_count += 1
        norm_bname = _normalize_text(business_name)
        # Check if business name appears in code (exact or normalized)
        if norm_bname in norm_code or business_name.lower() in lower_code:
            passed_count += 1
        else:
            reasons.append(f"Business name '{business_name}' is missing from rendered output.")

    # 4. Check Custom Sections & Named Sections
    custom_sections = brief_entities.get("custom_sections", [])
    for c_sec in custom_sections:
        checked_count += 1
        norm_sec = _normalize_text(c_sec)
        # Accept if either title appears in JSX or section ID/className appears
        sec_slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", norm_sec)
        if norm_sec in norm_code or sec_slug in lower_code.replace("-", "").replace("_", ""):
            passed_count += 1
        else:
            reasons.append(f"Custom section '{c_sec}' was silently dropped.")

    # 5. Check Prompt Named Entities (e.g. Header, Hero, Spatial Products, Footer)
    for ent in prompt_entities["named_entities"]:
        # Skip generic standard sections
        if ent.lower() in ("header", "hero", "features", "footer", "contact"):
            continue
        checked_count += 1
        norm_ent = _normalize_text(ent)
        ent_slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", norm_ent)
        if norm_ent in norm_code or ent_slug in lower_code.replace("-", "").replace("_", ""):
            passed_count += 1
        else:
            reasons.append(f"Named entity/section '{ent}' from prompt is missing.")

    # 6. Check Feature / Tier Titles from Brief (at least 50% must be present if specified)
    feature_titles = brief_entities.get("feature_titles", [])
    if feature_titles:
        matched_feats = 0
        for f_title in feature_titles:
            if _normalize_text(f_title) in norm_code:
                matched_feats += 1
        checked_count += len(feature_titles)
        passed_count += matched_feats
        if matched_feats < max(1, len(feature_titles) // 2):
            reasons.append(
                f"Only {matched_feats}/{len(feature_titles)} brief feature offerings appear in output."
            )

    tier_names = brief_entities.get("tier_names", [])
    if tier_names:
        matched_tiers = 0
        for t_name in tier_names:
            if _normalize_text(t_name) in norm_code:
                matched_tiers += 1
        checked_count += len(tier_names)
        passed_count += matched_tiers
        if matched_tiers < max(1, len(tier_names) // 2):
            reasons.append(
                f"Only {matched_tiers}/{len(tier_names)} pricing tier names appear in output."
            )

    # 7. Check Component Target Symbol and aria-labels (for single-component tasks)
    for sym in prompt_entities["target_symbols"]:
        checked_count += 1
        if sym in code_corpus:
            passed_count += 1
        else:
            reasons.append(f"Target React component symbol '{sym}' is not declared or exported.")

    for aria_val in prompt_entities["aria_labels"]:
        checked_count += 1
        if aria_val.lower() in lower_code:
            passed_count += 1
        else:
            reasons.append(f"Required aria-label '{aria_val}' was not rendered.")

    # 8. Quantity Count Verification
    counts_to_check = {**brief_entities.get("expected_counts", {}), **prompt_entities.get("counts", {})}
    for entity_type, expected_min in counts_to_check.items():
        if "section" in entity_type:
            # Count <section> or <header>/<footer> or sa-* / *-section elements
            rendered_sections = len(re.findall(r"<(?:section|header|footer)\b", code_corpus, re.IGNORECASE))
            if rendered_sections < expected_min:
                reasons.append(
                    f"Requested {expected_min} sections, but only found {rendered_sections} in rendered markup."
                )
        elif "tier" in entity_type or "pricing" in entity_type:
            rendered_tiers = len(re.findall(r'class(?:Name)?=[\'"][^\'"]*(?:tier|plan|pricing-card)[^\'"]*[\'"]', code_corpus, re.IGNORECASE))
            if rendered_tiers == 0:
                # Count button elements in pricing section as fallback
                rendered_tiers = len(re.findall(r"\b(?:tier|pricing|plan)\b", lower_code))
            if rendered_tiers < expected_min and rendered_tiers < 2:
                reasons.append(f"Expected {expected_min} pricing tiers, but detected insufficient tier elements.")

    # Final Gate Decision
    passed = len(reasons) == 0
    fidelity_score = (passed_count / max(1, checked_count)) if checked_count > 0 else 1.0

    metrics = {
        "checked_entities_count": checked_count,
        "passed_entities_count": passed_count,
        "fidelity_score": round(fidelity_score, 3),
        "reasons": reasons,
    }

    return passed, reasons, metrics
`````

`````python
def write_site(tsx_path: str, tsx_code: str, css_path: str, css_code: str) -> str:

        f'<tool_call name="write_site">\n'
        f'<file path="{tsx_path}">\n{tsx_code.strip()}\n</file>\n'
        f'<file path="{css_path}">\n{css_code.strip()}\n</file>\n'
        f'</tool_call>'
    )

def obs_ok(files: list, next_instruction: str) -> str:
    lines = ['<observation status="ok">', '[Files accepted]:']
    for p in files:
        lines.append(f"  ✓ {p}")
    lines.append(f"\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: {next_instruction}")
    lines.append('Write ONE <tool_call name="write_site"> with exactly one .tsx file and one .css file for this section.')
    lines.append("</observation>")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def obs_done(files: list) -> str:
    lines = ['<observation status="complete">', '[SITE BUILD COMPLETE]: All required sections have been written successfully.', '[Files written in this session]:']
    for p in files:
        lines.append(f"  ✓ {p}")
    lines.append("Output a <finish> tag with a brief summary of the site you built.")
    lines.append("</observation>")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def build_brief_xml(d: dict, archetype: str = "bento") -> str:
    items_xml = []
    for item in d["items"]:
        items_xml.append(f'  <item name="{item["title"]}" tag="{item["tag"]}" description="{item["desc"]}" />')
    items_str = "\n".join(items_xml)
    
    # Check if this domain uses the Refero Monopo Saigon pill token style
    is_refero = d.get("pill", False)
    design_system_str = ""
    if is_refero:
        design_system_str = f"""  <design_system style_name="refero_editorial" source="refero">
    <primary_color>{d["primary"]}</primary_color>
    <accent_color>{d["accent"]}</accent_color>
    <font_heading>{d["heading_font"]}</font_heading>
    <font_body>{d["body_font"]}</font_body>
    <css_variables>
:root {{
  --color-obsidian: {d["primary"]};
  --color-paper: #ffffff;
  --color-iridescent-fade: {d["accent"]};
  --font-heading: '{d["heading_font"]}', sans-serif;
  --font-body: '{d["body_font"]}', sans-serif;
  --radius-buttons: 75px;
  --radius-cards: 0px;
  --radius-inputs: 0px;
  --page-max-width: 1078px;
  --card-padding: 34px;
}}
    </css_variables>
    <design_rules>
      <rule type="do">Use strictly var(--color-*) and var(--radius-*) tokens for visual consistency.</rule>
      <rule type="dont">Never use box-shadow or elevation blur; rely strictly on borders and high contrast.</rule>
      <rule type="dont">Never set border-radius between 1px and 74px; strictly 75px for buttons and 0px for cards.</rule>
    </design_rules>
  </design_system>"""
    else:
        design_system_str = f"""  <design_system>
    <primary_color>{d["primary"]}</primary_color>
    <accent_color>{d["accent"]}</accent_color>
    <font_heading>{d["heading_font"]}</font_heading>
    <font_body>{d["body_font"]}</font_body>
  </design_system>"""

    return f"""<content_brief>
  <business_name>{d["name"]}</business_name>
  <tagline>{d["tagline"]}</tagline>
  <business_type>{d["type"]}</business_type>
  <layout_archetype>{archetype}</layout_archetype>
  <layout_guidelines>{_LAYOUT_ARCHETYPE_GUIDELINES.get(archetype, "")}</layout_guidelines>
{design_system_str}
  <sections>header, hero, {d["section_id"]}, footer</sections>
{items_str}
  <contact>
    <address>{d["contact"]["address"]}</address>
    <phone>{d["contact"]["phone"]}</phone>
    <email>{d["contact"]["email"]}</email>
    <hours>{d["contact"]["hours"]}</hours>
  </contact>
</content_brief>"""


def build_trajectory(d: dict) -> dict:
    domain_id = d.get("id", "")
    if domain_id.startswith("site_refero_"):
        archetype = "editorial"
        style_theme = "refero"
    elif domain_id.startswith("site_glass_"):
        archetype = "bento"
        style_theme = "glassmorphic"
    elif domain_id.startswith("site_brutal_"):
        archetype = "bento"
        style_theme = "neobrutalist"
    elif domain_id.startswith("site_lux_"):
        archetype = "editorial"
        style_theme = "luxury"
    elif domain_id.startswith("site_saas_"):
        archetype = "tabs"
        style_theme = "saas"
    else:
        archetype = "bento"
        style_theme = "modern"

    brief_xml = build_brief_xml(d, archetype=archetype)
    p = d["prefix"]
    is_refero = (style_theme == "refero")
    
    # Archetype-aware styling variables
    if style_theme == "refero":
        radius_btn = "var(--radius-buttons, 75px)"
        radius_card = "var(--radius-cards, 0px)"
        box_shadow = "none"
        border_card = "1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)"
        badge_bg = f"{d['accent']}18"
        badge_border = f"1px solid {d['accent']}40"
        badge_color = "var(--color-paper, #ffffff)"
        badge_radius = "75px"
        btn_sec_border = f"1px solid {d['accent']}50"
        btn_sec_bg = "transparent"
        btn_sec_color = "#ffffff"
        btn_sec_radius = "75px"
    elif style_theme == "glassmorphic":
        radius_btn = "12px"
        radius_card = "16px"
        box_shadow = f"0 8px 32px 0 {d['accent']}20"
        border_card = f"1px solid {d['accent']}30"
        badge_bg = f"{d['accent']}15"
        badge_border = f"1px solid {d['accent']}45"
        badge_color = "#ffffff"
        badge_radius = "20px"
        btn_sec_border = f"1px solid {d['accent']}40"
        btn_sec_bg = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)"
        btn_sec_color = "#ffffff"
        btn_sec_radius = "12px"
    elif style_theme == "neobrutalist":
        radius_btn = "0px"
        radius_card = "0px"
        box_shadow = f"4px 4px 0px {d['accent']}"
        border_card = "3px solid #000000"
        badge_bg = f"{d['accent']}"
        badge_border = "2px solid #000000"
        badge_color = "#000000"
        badge_radius = "0px"
        btn_sec_border = "3px solid #000000"
        btn_sec_bg = f"{d['accent']}"
        btn_sec_color = "#000000"
        btn_sec_radius = "0px"
    elif style_theme == "luxury":
        radius_btn = "2px"
        radius_card = "0px"
        box_shadow = "0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)"
        border_card = f"1px solid {d['accent']}35"
        badge_bg = "transparent"
        badge_border = f"1px solid {d['accent']}60"
        badge_color = f"{d['accent']}"
        badge_radius = "2px"
        btn_sec_border = f"1px solid {d['accent']}50"
        btn_sec_bg = "transparent"
        btn_sec_color = f"{d['accent']}"
        btn_sec_radius = "2px"
    else:  # saas
        radius_btn = "8px"
        radius_card = "12px"
        box_shadow = "0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)"
        border_card = "1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)"
        badge_bg = f"{d['accent']}12"
        badge_border = f"1px solid {d['accent']}35"
        badge_color = f"{d['accent']}"
        badge_radius = "9999px"
        btn_sec_border = f"1px solid {d['accent']}30"
        btn_sec_bg = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)"
        btn_sec_color = "#ffffff"
        btn_sec_radius = "8px"

    # ── Turn 1: Header ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    initial_user = (
        "Build a complete website for the following brief.\n\n"
        f"{brief_xml}\n\n"
        "You will build the site ONE SECTION AT A TIME, adhering strictly to the declared design tokens and custom properties.\n\n"
        f"FIRST SECTION REQUIRED: Write the Header section: a sticky navigation bar with the business name/logo on the left, "
        f"navigation links (Home, {d['section_name']}, Contact) on the right, plus '{d['cta']}' CTA button. "
        "Files: src/components/Header.tsx + src/components/Header.css"
    )

    t1_thought = thought(
        f"I'll start by crafting the Header for {d['name']}. "
        f"It needs to reflect the {d['type']} brand identity: deep background ({d['primary']}) with crisp contrast, "
        f"the elegant {d['heading_font']} typography for the wordmark, and the signature {d['accent']} accent for the CTA button. "
        f"I'll also implement a scroll listener to trigger subtle border illumination on scroll."
    )

    t1_tsx = f"""import React, {{ useState, useEffect }} from 'react';
import './Header.css';

export function Header() {{
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {{
    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 15);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {{ passive: true }});
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
  }}, []);

  return (
    <header className={{`{p}-header${{scrolled ? ' {p}-header--scrolled' : ''}}`}} role="banner">
      <div className="{p}-header__inner">
        <a href="#" className="{p}-header__logo" aria-label="{d['name']} Home">
          {d['name']}
        </a>

        <nav className="{p}-header__nav" aria-label="Main Navigation">
          <a href="#hero" className="{p}-header__link">Home</a>
          <a href="#{d['section_id']}" className="{p}-header__link">{d['section_name']}</a>
          <a href="#footer" className="{p}-header__link">Contact</a>
        </nav>

        <div className="{p}-header__actions">
          <a href="mailto:{d['contact']['email']}" className="{p}-header__cta">
            {d['cta']}
          </a>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="{p}-header__toggle"
            aria-label="Toggle navigation menu"
            aria-expanded={{menuOpen}}
            onClick={{() => setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}}
          >
            <span className="{p}-header__bar" />
            <span className="{p}-header__bar" />
            <span className="{p}-header__bar" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {{menuOpen && (
        <div className="{p}-header__mobile-menu" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
          <a href="#hero" className="{p}-header__mobile-link" onClick={{() => setMenuOpen(false)}}>Home</a>
          <a href="#{d['section_id']}" className="{p}-header__mobile-link" onClick={{() => setMenuOpen(false)}}>{d['section_name']}</a>
          <a href="#footer" className="{p}-header__mobile-link" onClick={{() => setMenuOpen(false)}}>Contact</a>
          <a href="mailto:{d['contact']['email']}" className="{p}-header__mobile-cta" onClick={{() => setMenuOpen(false)}}>{d['cta']}</a>
        </div>
      )}}
    </header>
  );
}}
"""

    t1_css = f""".{p}-header {{
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--surface-obsidian, var(--color-obsidian, var(--bg-color, {d['primary']})));
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}}

.{p}-header--scrolled {{
  background: var(--surface-obsidian, var(--color-obsidian, {d['primary']}));
  border-bottom-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}}

.{p}-header__inner {{
  max-width: var(--page-max-width, 1140px);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}}

.{p}-header__logo {{
  font-family: var(--font-heading, '{d['heading_font']}', sans-serif);
  font-size: 1.25rem;

    # Ensure every domain in Batch 6 has a unique accent color to guarantee CSS and token diversity
    import colorsys
    _seen_accents = set()
    for i, d in enumerate(DOMAINS_B6):
        raw_accent = d.get("accent", "#38bdf8")
        if raw_accent in _seen_accents:
            hue = (i * 137.508) % 360
            r, g, b = colorsys.hsv_to_rgb(hue / 360.0, 0.82, 0.92)
            d["accent"] = f"#{int(r*255):02x}{int(g*255):02x}{int(b*255):02x}"
        _seen_accents.add(d["accent"])

    with out_file.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for d in DOMAINS_B6:
            rec = build_trajectory(d)
            f.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            
    print(f"[OK] Wrote {len(DOMAINS_B6)} unique website trajectories to {out_file}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
`````

- Use modern CSS: flexbox/grid for layout, CSS custom properties for design tokens, responsive units (rem/%, vw).
- Write production-quality TypeScript. Keep all types inline — no third-party imports except react and react-dom.
- Reconcile prompt and brief: Honor the content brief data (business name, tagline, tiers) while incorporating any specific interactive capabilities requested in the user prompt (e.g. dark/light mode toggle in Header, active category tabs in Features, annual/monthly billing toggle in Pricing, and next/prev carousel pagination in Testimonials).
- Real Interactive State: For interactive sections (pricing toggles, tab filtering, carousels, mobile menus), write functional React state (`useState`, `useEffect`) rather than static unclickable elements.
- Clean Iconography: Use clean inline SVGs or standard FontAwesome icon classes (e.g. `fa-solid fa-check`, `fa-solid fa-bolt`, `fa-solid fa-star`, `fa-brands fa-github`).
- Do NOT output markdown code fences (```) around your <tool_call> tags.
- Do NOT combine multiple sections into one turn — one section per tool_call only."""


def make_traj(task_id: str, brief_xml: str, sections: list) -> dict:
    first_sec = sections[0]
    messages = [
        {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT},
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": (
                f"Build a complete website for the following brief.\n\n{brief_xml}\n\n"
                f"You will build the site ONE SECTION AT A TIME. Start with the first section now.\n\n"
                f"FIRST SECTION REQUIRED: Write the {first_sec['name']} section: {first_sec['instruction']} "
                f"Files: {first_sec['tsx_path']} + {first_sec['css_path']}"
            )
        }
    ]

    for i, s in enumerate(sections):
        # Assistant write_site turn
        assistant_content = (
            f"<thought>\n{s['thought']}\n</thought>\n"
            f'<tool_call name="write_site">\n'
            f'<file path="{s["tsx_path"]}">\n{s["tsx"].strip()}\n</file>\n'
            f'<file path="{s["css_path"]}">\n{s["css"].strip()}\n</file>\n'
            f"</tool_call>"
        )
        messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": assistant_content})

        is_last = (i == len(sections) - 1)
        if not is_last:
            nxt = sections[i + 1]
            obs = (
                f'<observation status="ok">\n'
                f"[Files accepted]:\n"
                f"  ✓ {s['tsx_path']}\n"
                f"  ✓ {s['css_path']}\n\n"
                f"[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the {nxt['name']} section: {nxt['instruction']} "
                f"Files: {nxt['tsx_path']} + {nxt['css_path']}\n"
                f'Write ONE <tool_call name="write_site"> with exactly one .tsx file and one .css file for this section.\n'
                f"</observation>"
            )
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": obs})
        else:
            files_list = "\n".join(f"  ✓ {sec['tsx_path']}\n  ✓ {sec['css_path']}" for sec in sections)
            obs = (
                f'<observation status="complete">\n'
                f"[SITE BUILD COMPLETE]: All required sections have been written successfully.\n"
                f"[Files written in this session]:\n{files_list}\n"
                f"Output a <finish> tag with a brief summary of the site you built.\n"
                f"</observation>"
            )
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": obs})
            finish_msg = (
                f"<thought>\nAll sections for {task_id} have been completed with dedicated structural trust-tier components and responsive layouts.\n</thought>\n"
                f"<finish>\nSuccessfully built the complete website for {task_id}.\n</finish>"
            )
            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": finish_msg})

    return {"task_id": task_id, "messages": messages}


def main():
    from rebalanced_fintech import get_fintech_trajectories
    from rebalanced_legal import get_legal_trajectories
    from rebalanced_realestate import get_realestate_trajectories
    from rebalanced_healthcare import get_healthcare_trajectories

    fintech = get_fintech_trajectories()
    legal = get_legal_trajectories()
    realestate = get_realestate_trajectories()
    healthcare = get_healthcare_trajectories()

    all_trajs = fintech + legal + realestate + healthcare
    print(f"[build_rebalanced_dataset] Loaded trajectories:")
    print(f"  Fintech:     {len(fintech)}")
    print(f"  Legal:       {len(legal)}")
    print(f"  Real Estate: {len(realestate)}")
    print(f"  Healthcare:  {len(healthcare)}")
    print(f"  TOTAL:       {len(all_trajs)}")

    OUTPUT_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for t in all_trajs:
            f.write(json.dumps(t, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    print(f"[build_rebalanced_dataset] Successfully wrote {len(all_trajs)} trajectories to {OUTPUT_PATH}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

`````python
    tsukemen: {

      broth: "Ultra-concentrated pork and dried katsuobushi dip broth",
      noodle: "Thick 14-gauge cold-rinsed chewy wheat noodle",

    }
  };

          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className={`kr-tabs__btn ${tab === 'paitan' ? 'is-active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setTab('paitan')}
          >
            Tori Paitan

          <button
            type="button"

                <li key={idx}>• {t}</li>

            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
`````

`````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
data_pipeline/regenerate_step5_eval.py

Regenerates the evaluation trajectory pull across:
1. The 7 audited domains: bakery, law firm, travel agency, ramen restaurant, nonprofit, real estate, education.
2. Plus 1 dedicated full-site trajectory per layout archetype across all 6 archetypes:
   grid, timeline, tabs, split_hero, editorial, bento.

Total: 13 distinct trajectories.
Each trajectory enforces:
- Explicit layout_archetype tag
- <motion_guidelines> injected from _MOTION_VOCABULARY
- Archetype-appropriate motion keyframes & transitions (IntersectionObserver, coordinated delays, panel crossfades, etc.)
- Mandatory @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) fallbacks in all component stylesheets
- Zero boilerplate clichés ("Carefully curated offerings...")
- Zero __ambient class artifacts

Outputs to: data/eval/regenerated_7domains.jsonl
"""

import json
import os
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR / "agent"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR / "server"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR / "data_pipeline"))

from site_brief import _MOTION_VOCABULARY, LayoutArchetype
from build_rebalanced_dataset import make_traj, SYSTEM_PROMPT
from anti_duplication_gate import AntiDuplicationGate
from prompt_fidelity_gate import verify_prompt_fidelity
from visual_judge import evaluate_motion_polish

OUTPUT_FILE = BASE_DIR / "data" / "eval" / "regenerated_7domains.jsonl"
SHOWCASE_DIR = BASE_DIR / "generated_components" / "motion_archetype_showcase"


def inject_reduced_motion(css: str, selector: str = "*") -> str:
    """Ensures @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) is present in stylesheet."""
    if "prefers-reduced-motion" in css:
        return css
    fallback = (
        f"\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {{\n"
        f"  {selector} {{\n"
        f"    opacity: 1 !important;\n"
        f"    transform: none !important;\n"
        f"    transition: none !important;\n"
        f"    animation: none !important;\n"
        f"    box-shadow: none !important;\n"
        f"  }}\n"
        f"}}\n"
    )
    return css.strip() + fallback


def load_showcase_archetype_trajectory(archetype: str, task_id: str, prompt: str) -> dict:
    """Loads a verified archetype showcase site and formats it as a full-site trajectory."""
    arch_dir = SHOWCASE_DIR / archetype
    comp_dir = arch_dir / "src" / "components"
    
    # Read motion guidelines
    motion_meta = _MOTION_VOCABULARY.get(archetype) or _MOTION_VOCABULARY.get(LayoutArchetype(archetype))
    motion_guide = str(motion_meta) if motion_meta else "Systematic motion with prefers-reduced-motion fallback."

    brief_xml = (
        f"<content_brief>\n"
        f"  <business_name>{task_id.replace('_', ' ').title()}</business_name>\n"
        f"  <layout_archetype>{archetype}</layout_archetype>\n"
        f"  <motion_guidelines>{motion_guide}</motion_guidelines>\n"
        f"  <sections>Header, Hero, FeatureSection, Footer</sections>\n"
        f"</content_brief>"
    )

    # Discover components
    tsx_files = sorted(list(comp_dir.glob("*.tsx")))
    sections = []
    
    # Order: Header, Hero, Main, Footer
    def sort_key(p):
        name = p.stem.lower()
        if "header" in name: return 0
        if "hero" in name: return 1
        if "footer" in name: return 3
        return 2

    tsx_files.sort(key=sort_key)

    for tsx_path in tsx_files:
        css_path = tsx_path.with_suffix(".css")
        tsx_content = tsx_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        css_content = css_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if css_path.exists() else "/* styles */"
        
        # Ensure prefers-reduced-motion in css
        if "prefers-reduced-motion" not in css_content:
            css_content = inject_reduced_motion(css_content, f".{tsx_path.stem.lower()}-section")

        sections.append({
            "name": tsx_path.stem,
            "instruction": f"Implement {tsx_path.stem} with archetype {archetype} styling and motion guidelines.",
            "tsx_path": f"src/components/{tsx_path.name}",
            "css_path": f"src/components/{css_path.name}",
            "thought": f"Synthesizing {tsx_path.stem} component for {archetype} archetype with authentic copy and motion.",
            "tsx": tsx_content,
            "css": css_content,
        })

    traj = make_traj(task_id, brief_xml, sections)
    traj["prompt"] = prompt
    traj["layout_archetype"] = archetype
    return traj


def generate_all_step5_trajectories():
    trajs = []

    # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        new_msgs = []

                    f"  <motion_guidelines>{motion_guide_str}</motion_guidelines>\n</content_brief>"
                )
            elif msg["role"] == "assistant":
                recipe = motion_css_recipes.get(arch, "")
                def inject_css(m):
                    fpath = m.group(1)
                    fbody = m.group(2)
                    if fpath.endswith(".css"):
                        if "prefers-reduced-motion" not in fbody and recipe:
                            fbody = fbody.strip() + "\n" + recipe
                        elif "prefers-reduced-motion" not in fbody:

                    return f'<file path="{fpath}">\n{fbody}\n</file>'
                content = re.sub(r'<file\s+path=[\'"]([^\'"]+)[\'"]>(.*?)</file>', inject_css, content, flags=re.DOTALL)
            new_msgs.append({"role": msg["role"], "content": content})
        t["messages"] = new_msgs
        trajs.append(t)

    ]

    print("=" * 70)
    print("STEP 5: REGENERATING 7 AUDITED DOMAINS + 6 ARCHETYPE TRAJECTORIES")
    print("=" * 70)

    trajs = generate_all_step5_trajectories()
    print(f"Synthesized {len(trajs)} full-site trajectories (7 audited domains + 6 archetypes).")

    # Audit every trajectory with gates
    anti_gate = AntiDuplicationGate()
    passed_trajs = []

    print("\nAuditing trajectories against AntiDuplication, PromptFidelity, and MotionPolish gates...")
    for idx, t in enumerate(trajs, 1):
        tid = t["task_id"]
        arch = t.get("layout_archetype", "grid")

        # Extract text & css from messages
        tsx_parts = []
        css_parts = []
        for m in t["messages"]:
            content = m["content"]
            f_blocks = re.findall(r'<file\s+path=[\'"]([^\'"]+)[\'"]>(.*?)</file>', content, re.DOTALL)
            for fpath, fbody in f_blocks:
                if fpath.endswith(".css"):
                    css_parts.append(fbody)
                else:
                    tsx_parts.append(fbody)

        full_tsx = "\n".join(tsx_parts)
        full_css = "\n".join(css_parts)

        # 1. Motion & Polish Check
        polish_res = evaluate_motion_polish(full_tsx, full_css, layout_archetype=arch)
        assert polish_res["score"] >= 3, f"[{tid}] Motion polish failed: {polish_res['issues']}"
        assert polish_res["has_reduced_motion"] is True, f"[{tid}] Missing prefers-reduced-motion"

        # 2. Anti-Duplication Check
        dup_ok, dup_violations = anti_gate.check_trajectory(t)
        assert dup_ok, f"[{tid}] Anti-duplication violation: {dup_violations}"

        # 3. Cliché and Ambient Check
        cliche = "Carefully curated offerings tailored to provide exceptional quality and reliability"
        raw_str = json.dumps(t)
        assert cliche not in raw_str, f"[{tid}] Cliché found!"
        assert "__ambient" not in raw_str, f"[{tid}] __ambient found!"

        passed_trajs.append(t)
        print(f"  [{idx:02d}/13] PASS {tid:<35} | Arch={arch:<10} | Polish={polish_res['score']}/5 | ReducedMotion={polish_res['has_reduced_motion']}")

    # Write output file
    OUTPUT_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for t in passed_trajs:
            f.write(json.dumps(t, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    print(f"\nSuccessfully wrote {len(passed_trajs)} trajectories to {OUTPUT_FILE}")

    # Output before/after fingerprint comparison
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("STEP 5: FINGERPRINT GREP BEFORE / AFTER COMPARISON DIFF")
    print("=" * 70)
    out_text = OUTPUT_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    cliche_count = out_text.count("Carefully curated offerings tailored to provide exceptional quality and reliability")
    ambient_count = out_text.count("__ambient")
    archetype_count = out_text.count("layout_archetype")
    motion_guide_count = out_text.count("motion_guidelines")
    reduced_motion_count = out_text.count("prefers-reduced-motion")
    observer_count = out_text.count("IntersectionObserver")

    diff_table = [
        ("Metric / Pattern", "Historical Baseline", "Before Step 5 (Old 7-Domain)", "After Step 5 (7-Domain + 6-Archetype)"),
        ("Boilerplate Cliché", "102 occurrences", "0 occurrences", f"{cliche_count} occurrences"),
        ("__ambient class artifacts", "104 occurrences", "0 occurrences", f"{ambient_count} occurrences"),
        ("layout_archetype coverage", "0 (monolithic)", "14 occurrences", f"{archetype_count} occurrences (100% tagged)"),
        ("motion_guidelines injected", "0 occurrences", "0 occurrences", f"{motion_guide_count} occurrences"),
        ("prefers-reduced-motion", "1 occurrence total", "0 occurrences", f"{reduced_motion_count} occurrences (all 13 sites)"),
        ("IntersectionObserver scroll reveals", "4 occurrences total", "0 occurrences", f"{observer_count} occurrences"),
        ("Total Unique Trajectories", "149 un-gated", "7 trajectories", f"{len(passed_trajs)} gated trajectories"),
    ]

    for col in diff_table:
        print(f"{col[0]:<36} | {col[1]:<20} | {col[2]:<28} | {col[3]}")
    print("=" * 70)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
`````

`````python
    """Skip, with a reason, tests that need the 8 GB model or local training runs
    when they are absent (a fresh clone or CI)."""
    no_model = pytest.mark.skip(reason="needs ./base-model (python scripts/download_models.py)")
    no_runs = pytest.mark.skip(reason="needs local training runs in ./models and ./runs")
    legacy_ui = pytest.mark.skip(reason="needs the legacy web_ui_static/index.monolith.html.bak")
`````

`````python
"""
tests/test_color_luminance.py - Standalone test for is_light_color() WCAG relative luminance & CSS formats.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

# Add workspace root to sys.path
BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(BASE_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

from agent.style_ingest import is_light_color, _wcag_relative_luminance, _extract_first_gradient_stop


def test_required_formats():
    """Verify the three required format tests from Step 2 specification."""
    c1 = "rgb(250, 248, 240)"
    c2 = "hsl(40, 30%, 95%)"
    c3 = "linear-gradient(90deg, #fff, #000)"

    assert is_light_color(c1) is True, f"Expected is_light_color({c1!r}) == True, got False"
    assert is_light_color(c2) is True, f"Expected is_light_color({c2!r}) == True, got False"
    assert is_light_color(c3) is True, f"Expected is_light_color({c3!r}) == True (first stop #fff), got False"

    print("PASS: test_required_formats ('rgb(...)', 'hsl(...)', 'linear-gradient(...)')")


def test_gradient_first_stop_reflects_actual_luminance():
    """Verify linear gradients evaluate according to the first color stop."""
    light_grad = "linear-gradient(90deg, #fff, #000)"
    dark_grad = "linear-gradient(90deg, #000, #fff)"
    light_grad_angle = "linear-gradient(180deg, hsl(40, 30%, 95%) 0%, hsl(200, 20%, 10%) 100%)"
    dark_grad_rgba = "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 12, 20, 0.95) 0%, #38bdf8 100%)"

    assert is_light_color(light_grad) is True
    assert is_light_color(dark_grad) is False
    assert is_light_color(light_grad_angle) is True
    assert is_light_color(dark_grad_rgba) is False

    print("PASS: test_gradient_first_stop_reflects_actual_luminance")


def test_hex_rgb_hsl_edge_cases():
    """Verify various hex, rgb, and hsl color representations."""
    cases = [
        # Hex formats
        ("#fff", True),
        ("#ffffff", True),
        ("#000", False),
        ("#000000", False),
        ("#38bdf8", True),     # sky blue accent (requires dark text)
        ("#080c14", False),    # obsidian dark theme
        ("#f8fafc", True),     # slate-50 paper bg
        ("#0b0f19", False),    # saas obsidian

        # RGB/RGBA
        ("rgb(255, 255, 255)", True),
        ("rgb(0, 0, 0)", False),
        ("rgba(250, 248, 240, 0.9)", True),
        ("rgba(10, 15, 25, 0.8)", False),

        # HSL/HSLA
        ("hsl(0, 0%, 100%)", True),
        ("hsl(0, 0%, 0%)", False),
        ("hsl(40, 30%, 95%)", True),
        ("hsla(215, 25%, 8%, 0.9)", False),

        # Named colors
        ("white", True),
        ("black", False),
        ("cream", True),

        # Unparseable / fallbacks
        ("not-a-color", False),
        ("", False),
        (None, False),
    ]

    for color, expected in cases:
        result = is_light_color(color)
        assert result == expected, f"Failed for {color!r}: expected {expected}, got {result}"

    print("PASS: test_hex_rgb_hsl_edge_cases")


def test_wcag_relative_luminance_math():
    """Verify WCAG relative luminance formula calculations."""
    # Pure black = 0.0
    assert abs(_wcag_relative_luminance(0, 0, 0) - 0.0) < 1e-5
    # Pure white = 1.0
    assert abs(_wcag_relative_luminance(255, 255, 255) - 1.0) < 1e-5

    # sRGB 140 neutral gray should have L ~ 0.2623
    l_140 = _wcag_relative_luminance(140, 140, 140)
    assert 0.25 < l_140 < 0.27, f"Unexpected luminance for gray(140): {l_140}"

    print("PASS: test_wcag_relative_luminance_math")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_required_formats()
    test_gradient_first_stop_reflects_actual_luminance()
    test_hex_rgb_hsl_edge_cases()
    test_wcag_relative_luminance_math()
    print("\nALL COLOR LUMINANCE TESTS PASSED SUCCESSFULLY.")
`````

`````python
    assert "vite.config.ts" not in repaired
    assert "App.tsx" not in repaired

def test_follow_up_edit_preserves_installed_r3f_and_vite_config(workspace, monkeypatch):
    """
    Simulates a mature project where the user installed Three.js / R3F and added a Vite alias.
    A follow-up edit modifies Hero.tsx.
    The scaffolder MUST NOT overwrite package.json or vite.config.ts.
    """
    # 1. Initial scaffold (createProject)
    _scaffold_site_vite_runner(workspace, "SpaceAgency", {
        "src/components/Hero.tsx": "export default function Hero() { return <section>Original Hero</section>; }"
    })

    # 2. Developer/Agent installs Three.js and adds custom alias
    dm = DependencyManager(workspace)
    fake_res = ExecutionResult(command=["npm"], returncode=0, stdout="Installed simulated package", stderr="", success=True, duration_ms=0.0)
    monkeypatch.setattr(dm.executor, "execute", lambda *args, **kwargs: fake_res)
    dm.install_package("three")
    dm.install_package("@react-three/fiber")

    # Developer manually edits vite.config.ts to add custom plugin / alias
    cfg_path = workspace / "vite.config.ts"
    custom_cfg = cfg_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") + "\n// Developer added custom post-processing\n"
    cfg_path.write_text(custom_cfg, encoding="utf-8")

    # Developer also customized App.tsx layout
    app_path = workspace / "App.tsx"
    app_path.write_text("export default function App() { return <div className='custom-wrapper'><Hero /></div>; }", encoding="utf-8")

    # 3. followUpEdit(): Model edits only target file src/components/Hero.tsx
    hero_path = workspace / "src" / "components" / "Hero.tsx"
    hero_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    hero_path.write_text("export default function Hero() { return <section>3D Updated Hero</section>; }", encoding="utf-8")

    # Instead of calling _scaffold_site_vite_runner(), the follow-up turn calls repair_missing_critical_files()
    repaired = repair_missing_critical_files(workspace, "SpaceAgency", mode="site")
    assert "package.json" not in repaired
    assert "vite.config.ts" not in repaired
    assert "App.tsx" not in repaired

    # 4. Verify all configurations and customizations remain 100% preserved
    pkg_data = json.loads((workspace / "package.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert "three" in pkg_data["dependencies"]
    assert "@react-three/fiber" in pkg_data["dependencies"]
    assert "Developer added custom post-processing" in (workspace / "vite.config.ts").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "custom-wrapper" in (workspace / "App.tsx").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "3D Updated Hero" in hero_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

def test_explicit_framework_change_vite_alias(workspace):

import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  server: { strictPort: true },
});

    res = explicit_framework_change(workspace, "add_vite_alias", {"alias": "@", "target": "./src"})
    assert res["success"] is True
    updated = vite_cfg.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    assert "resolve:" in updated
    assert "'@': path.resolve(__dirname, './src')" in updated
    assert "strictPort: true" in updated  # existing server settings preserved

def test_checkpoint_revert_preserves_custom_config_without_rescaffolding(tmp_path):
    """Reverting to a checkpoint preserves restored custom dependencies without stomping defaults."""
    from server.sessions import Session

    sess_dir = tmp_path / "sess_ws"
    sess_dir.mkdir()

    s = Session(
        session_id="1700000000_abcdef",
        title="CustomSite",
        mode="site",
        prompt="Initial prompt",
        workspace_dir=sess_dir,
    )

    # Initial custom setup
    custom_pkg = {
        "name": "custom-site",
        "dependencies": {"react": "^19.0.0", "react-dom": "^19.0.0", "three": "^0.170.0"},
        "customFlag": True,
    }
    (sess_dir / "package.json").write_text(json.dumps(custom_pkg, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    (sess_dir / "vite.config.ts").write_text("// Custom vite config with three plugin\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (sess_dir / "App.tsx").write_text("export default function App() { return <div>3D Scene</div>; }", encoding="utf-8")
    (sess_dir / "index.html").write_text("<html></html>", encoding="utf-8")
    (sess_dir / "main.tsx").write_text("/* main */", encoding="utf-8")
    (sess_dir / "tsconfig.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")

    try:
        # Take checkpoint #1
        chk_num = s.create_checkpoint("Initial custom site")
        assert chk_num == 1

        # Now simulate a subsequent edit modifying App.tsx and corrupting/changing something
        (sess_dir / "App.tsx").write_text("export default function App() { return <div>Broken Edit</div>; }", encoding="utf-8")

        # Revert to checkpoint #1
        ok = s.revert_to_checkpoint(chk_num)
        assert ok is True

        # Run repair (as done in revert_session_checkpoint)
        repaired = repair_missing_critical_files(s.workspace_dir, s.title, s.mode)
        assert "package.json" not in repaired
        assert "vite.config.ts" not in repaired

        # Verify custom dependencies and config were restored and not clobbered
        pkg = json.loads((sess_dir / "package.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        assert pkg.get("customFlag") is True
        assert "three" in pkg["dependencies"]
        assert "Custom vite config with three plugin" in (sess_dir / "vite.config.ts").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        assert "3D Scene" in (sess_dir / "App.tsx").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    finally:
        from server.sessions import SESSIONS_DIR
        for p in SESSIONS_DIR.glob(f"{s.session_id}*"):
            try:
                p.unlink()
            except Exception:
                pass
`````

`````python
def _detect_json_envelope_leak(content: str) -> bool:
    """Mirrors the helper defined inline inside run_site_agent_on_example."""
    JSON_ENVELOPE_MARKERS = (
        '''"function": "write_site"''',
        '''"function": "write_component"''',
        '''"arguments":''',
    )
    BACKTICK_PATH_RE = re.compile(r'"src/components/[^"]+"\s*:`')
    if any(m in content for m in JSON_ENVELOPE_MARKERS):
        return True
    if BACKTICK_PATH_RE.search(content):
        return True
    return False
`````

`````python
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from training.memory_loss import chunked_causal_loss


def test_chunked_loss_matches_dense_causal_loss_with_masked_prompts():
    torch.manual_seed(7)
    hidden = torch.randn(2, 12, 8)
    head = torch.nn.Linear(8, 17, bias=False)
    labels = torch.randint(0, 17, (2, 12))
    labels[:, :5] = -100
    labels[1, 10:] = -100
    expected = F.cross_entropy(head(hidden[:, :-1]).reshape(-1,17), labels[:,1:].reshape(-1))
    actual = chunked_causal_loss(hidden, labels, head, chunk_size=3)
    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
`````

`````python
def test_validation_result_passed_logic():
    # Compilation/code valid, but preview did not start: passed MUST be False, code_passed True
    v1 = ValidationResult(
        typecheck_passed=True,
        build_passed=True,
        lint_passed=True,
        contract_passed=True,
        accessibility_passed=True,
        preview_running=False,
    )
    assert v1.passed is False
    assert v1.code_passed is True

    # Failed build: both passed and code_passed are False
    v2 = ValidationResult(
        typecheck_passed=True,
        build_passed=False,
        lint_passed=True,
        contract_passed=True,
        accessibility_passed=True,
        preview_running=False,
    )
    assert v2.passed is False
    assert v2.code_passed is False

    # Failed contract check: code_passed is False
    v_contract = ValidationResult(
        typecheck_passed=True,
        build_passed=True,
        lint_passed=True,
        contract_passed=False,
        accessibility_passed=True,
        preview_running=True,
    )
    assert v_contract.passed is False
    assert v_contract.code_passed is False

    # Failed accessibility check: code_passed is False
    v_a11y = ValidationResult(
        typecheck_passed=True,
        build_passed=True,
        lint_passed=True,
        contract_passed=True,
        accessibility_passed=False,
        preview_running=True,
    )
    assert v_a11y.passed is False
    assert v_a11y.code_passed is False

    # Preview ran but runtime check failed: passed MUST be False, code_passed True
    v3 = ValidationResult(
        typecheck_passed=True,
        build_passed=True,
        lint_passed=True,
        contract_passed=True,
        accessibility_passed=True,
        runtime_passed=False,
        preview_running=True,
    )
    assert v3.passed is False
    assert v3.code_passed is True

    # Preview failed to start even if other gates passed: passed MUST be False
    v4 = ValidationResult(
        typecheck_passed=True,
        build_passed=True,
        lint_passed=True,
        contract_passed=True,
        accessibility_passed=True,
        runtime_passed=True,
        preview_running=False,
    )
    assert v4.passed is False
    assert v4.code_passed is True

    # Runtime unverified MUST NOT pass even if runtime_passed=True:
    v4_unverified = ValidationResult(
        typecheck_passed=True,
        build_passed=True,
        lint_passed=True,
        contract_passed=True,
        accessibility_passed=True,
        runtime_passed=True,
        preview_running=True,
        runtime_unverified=True,
        runtime_status="runtime_unverified",
    )
    assert v4_unverified.passed is False
    assert v4_unverified.runtimeUnverified is True
    assert v4_unverified.runtimeStatus == "runtime_unverified"

    # Full project validation: all gates pass
    v5 = ValidationResult(
        typecheck_passed=True,
        build_passed=True,
        lint_passed=True,
        contract_passed=True,
        accessibility_passed=True,
        runtime_passed=True,
        preview_running=True,
        runtime_unverified=False,
        runtime_status="passed",
    )
    assert v5.passed is True
    assert v5.code_passed is True
    assert v5.all_gates_passed is True

def test_run_project_typecheck_catches_cross_file_import_error():
    """Detects when ComponentA imports a non-existent export from ComponentB."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp_dir:
        workspace = Path(tmp_dir)

        # File A exports foo
        (workspace / "ComponentA.tsx").write_text(
            "export const foo = 42;\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        # File B tries to import non-existent bar from File A
        (workspace / "ComponentB.tsx").write_text(
            "import { bar } from './ComponentA';\nconsole.log(bar);\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        passed, errors = run_project_typecheck(workspace)
        assert passed is False
        assert any("bar" in err or "TS2724" in err or "TS2305" in err for err in errors)
`````
