      "src/components/Demo.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Demo.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"See it in action\",\n  \"intro\": \"Watch a real pipeline in action\",\n  \"labels\": [\n    \"Live\",\n    \"Pipeline\",\n    \"Demo\"\n  ],\n  \"points\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Real pipeline in action\",\n      \"text\": \"View a running pipeline with real code and results\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"See how it works\",\n      \"text\": \"Observe the workflow from code to deployment\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"No setup required\",\n      \"text\": \"Start watching immediately with no configuration\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Demo\",\n  \"mark\": \"S\",\n  \"bars\": [\n    42,\n    58,\n    50,\n    66,\n    61,\n    74,\n    69,\n    82\n  ]\n};\n\nfunction Media({ label, mark, priority, variant, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {label ? <p className=\"k-art__label\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{label}</p> : null}\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      <img alt={label || 'artwork'} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} className={'k-art__img' + (missing ? ' is-missing' : '')} />\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction useMagnet<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const el = ref.current;\n    if (!el) return;\n    const fine = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (!fine || reduce) return;\n    const move = (event: PointerEvent) => {\n      if (event.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;\n      const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n      const x = ((event.clientX - box.left) / box.width - 0.5) * 16;\n      const y = ((event.clientY - box.top) / box.height - 0.5) * 12;\n      el.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + x.toFixed(1) + 'px, ' + y.toFixed(1) + 'px, 0)';\n    };\n    const leave = () => {\n      el.style.transform = '';\n    };\n    el.addEventListener('pointermove', move);\n    el.addEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    return () => {\n      el.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);\n      el.removeEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    };\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Demo() {\n  const magnetRef = useMagnet<HTMLAnchorElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"demo\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-demo\" aria-labelledby=\"demo-title\" data-section=\"demo\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-demo-grid k-demo-grid--right k-stagger\">\n        <div className=\"k-demo-visual\">\n          <Media label={DATA.labels[1]} mark={DATA.mark} priority={true} variant={1} className=\"k-demo-media k-settle\" />\n          <Media label={DATA.labels[2]} priority={false} variant={2} className=\"k-demo-media k-settle\" />\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-demo-copy\">\n          <div className=\"k-head\">\n            <div>\n              <h2 id=\"demo-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n            </div>\n            {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <ul className=\"k-demo-points\">\n            {DATA.points.map((point: any, i: number) => (\n              <li key={i}>\n                <span className=\"k-demo-pointno\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n                <p className=\"k-h3\">{point.title}</p>\n                {point.text ?       "src/components/Pricing.tsx": "import './Pricing.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Pricing\",\n  \"intro\": \"Simple plans for every team size\",\n  \"tiers\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"1-3 words\",\n      \"description\": \"Perfect for small teams and startups\",\n      \"features\": [\n        \"Basic ci\",\n        \"Single repo\",\n        \"Limited concurrency\"\n      ],\n      \"price\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"4-6 words\",\n      \"description\": \"Ideal for growing teams and projects\",\n      \"features\": [\n        \"Advanced ci\",\n        \"Multi-repo\",\n        \"Unlimited concurrency\"\n      ],\n      \"price\": \"\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"S\",\n  \"featured\": -1,\n  \"quoteHref\": \"mailto:studio@stackwise.com\"\n};\n\nexport function Pricing() {\n  return (\n    <section id=\"pricing\" className=\"k-section k-pricing\" aria-labelledby=\"pricing-title\" data-section=\"pricing\">\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"pricing-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-pricing-grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.tiers.map((tier: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className={'k-pricing-tier' + (DATA.featured === i ? (\n                <ul className=\"k-pricing-features\">\n                  {tier.features.map((f: string, j: number) => <li key={j}>{f}</li>)}\n                </ul>\n              ) : null}\n              <a className={'k-btn ' + (DATA.featured === i ? 'k-btn--primary' : 'k-btn--ghost') + ' k-pricing-cta'} href={DATA.quoteHref}>Ask for a quote</a>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Pricing;\n",
      "src/components/Pricing.css": ".k-pricing .k-pricing-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 28px); align-items: stretch; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-tier { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--k-space-2); padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-tier--featured { background-color: var(--k-ink); color: var(--k-bg); border-color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-price { font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.2; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-desc { opacity: 0.86; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-features { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: var(--k-space-2); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-features li { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-features li::before { content: \"\"; flex: 0 0 12px; height: 2px; transform: translateY(-4px); background-color: var(--k-accent); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-cta { margin-top: auto; align-self: flex-start; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-tier--featured .k-btn--ghost { color: var(--k-bg); }\n",
      "src/components/Docs.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Docs.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Docs\",\n  \"intro\": \"Find everything you need to get started\",\n  \"paragraphs\": [\n    \"Our documentation covers all aspects of using Stackwise.\",\n    \"It's designed to be clear and easy to understand.\"\n  ],\n  \"bullets\": [\n    \"Setup guide\",\n    \"Integration docs\",\n    \"Api reference\",\n    \"Common issues\"\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"S\",\n  \"img\": null\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function Docs() {\n  return (\n    <section id=\"docs\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-docs\" aria-labelledby=\"docs-title\" data-section=\"docs\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-docs-grid k-docs-grid--right k-stagger\">\n        <div className=\"k-docs-visual\">\n          <Media img={DATA.img} variant={2} mark={DATA.mark} className=\"k-docs-media k-settle\" />\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-docs-copy\">\n          {DATA.eyebrow ? <p className=\"k-eyebrow\">{DATA.eyebrow}</p> : null}\n          <h2 id=\"docs-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.paragraphs.map((p: string, i: number) => (\n            <p key={i} className={i === 0 ? 'k-text k-docs-first' : 'k-text k-muted'}>{p}</p>\n          ))}\n          {DATA.bullets.length ? (\n            <ul className=\"k-docs-list\">\n              {DATA.bullets.map((b: string, i: number) => <li key={i}>{b}</li>)}\n            </ul>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Docs;\n",
      "src/components/Docs.css": ".k-docs .k-docs-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(32px, 7vw, 112px); align-items: center; }\n.k-docs .k-docs-grid--right .k-docs-visual { order: 2; }\n.k-docs .k-docs-media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; width: 100%; }\n.k-docs .k-docs-copy { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); justify-items: start; }\n.k-docs .k-docs-first { font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem); line-height: 1.55; }\n.k-docs .k-docs-list { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); margin-top: var(--k-space-1); }\n.k-docs .k-docs-list li { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: baseline; font-weight: 500; }\n.k-docs .k-docs-list li::before { content: \"\"; flex: 0 0 18px; height: 2px; transform: translateY(-4px); background-color: var(--k-accent); }\n@media (max-width: 860px) {\n  .k-docs .k-docs-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }\n  .k-docs .k-docs-grid--right .k-docs-visual { order: 0; }\n  .k-docs .k-docs-media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }\n}\n",
      "src/components/Features.tsx": "import './Features.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Features that work for you\",\n  \"intro\": \"Stackwise offers tools that fit your workflow\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Simple pipelines\",\n      \"text\": \"Create and manage CI pipelines with intuitive interfaces\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Fast builds\",\n      \"text\": \"Reduce build times with optimized execution engines\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Clear logs\",\n      \"text\": \"Access detailed build logs for troubleshooting and auditing\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Features\",\n  \"mark\": \"S\"\n};\n\nexport function Features() {\n  return (\n    <section id=\"features\" className=\"k-section k-features\" aria-labelledby=\"features-title\" data-section=\"features\">\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"features-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-features-list k-features-list--grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className=\"k-features-item\" key={i}>\n              <span className=\"k-features-index\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n              <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.title}</h3>\n              {item.text ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.text}</p> : null}\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Features;\n",
      "src/components/Features.css": ".k-features .k-features-list--grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px) clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px); }\n.k-features .k-features-list--grid .k-features-item { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; padding-top: var(--k-space-3); border-top: 2px solid var(--k-ink); }\n.k-features .k-features-list--rows { display: grid; border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-features .k-features-list--rows .k-features-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: var(--k-space-3) var(--k-space-6); align-items: baseline; padding-block: clamp(22px, 3vw, 36px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-features .k-features-index { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--k-accent-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-features .k-features-role { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-accent-text); }\n.k-features .k-features-item p { max-width: 52ch; }\n@media (max-width: 760px) {\n  .k-features .k-features-list--rows .k-features-item { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--k-space-1); }\n}\n",
      "src/components/Waitlist.tsx": "import './Waitlist.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Join the waitlist\",\n  \"text\": \"Sign up to get early access to Stackwise's CI pipeline service\",\n  \"button\": \"Join waitlist\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Waitlist\",\n  \"mark\": \"S\",\n  \"href\": \"mailto:studio@stackwise.com\"\n};\n\nexport function Waitlist() {\n  return (\n    <section id=\"waitlist\" className=\"k-section k-waitlist\" aria-labelledby=\"waitlist-title\" data-section=\"waitlist\">\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-waitlist-band\">\n          <h2 id=\"waitlist-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.text ? <p className=\"k-waitlist-text\">{DATA.text}</p> : null}\n          <a className=\"k-waitlist-btn\" href={DATA.href}>{DATA.button}</a>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Waitlist;\n",
      "src/components/Waitlist.css": ".k-waitlist .k-waitlist-band { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); justify-items: start; padding: clamp(32px, 6vw, 80px); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-accent); color: var(--k-accent-ink); }\n.k-waitlist .k-waitlist-band .k-h2 { max-width: 20ch; }\n.k-waitlist .k-waitlist-text { max-width: 52ch; font-size: 1.125rem; }\n.k-waitlist .k-waitlist-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: var(--k-radius-btn); background-color: var(--k-accent-ink); color: var(--k-accent); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 180ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-waitlist .k-waitlist-btn:hover, .k-waitlist .k-waitlist-btn:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-2px); }\n.k-waitlist .k-waitlist-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }\n.k-waitlist .k-waitlist-btn:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--k-accent-ink); }\n",
      "src/components/Footer.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Footer.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Stackwise\",\n  \"tagline\": \"CI pipeline service\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"changelog\",\n      \"href\": \"#changelog\",\n      \"label\": \"Changelog\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"demo\",\n      \"href\": \"#demo\",\n      \"label\": \"Demo\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"pricing\",\n      \"href\": \"#pricing\",\n      \"label\": \"Pricing\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"docs\",\n      \"href\": \"#docs\",\n      \"label\": \"Docs\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"features\",\n      \"href\": \"#features\",\n      \"label\": \"Features\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"waitlist\",\n      \"href\": \"#waitlist\",\n      \"label\": \"Waitlist\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"email\": \"studio@stackwise.com\",\n  \"location\": \"Seattle\",\n  \"contactHref\": \"\",\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"mailto:studio@stackwise.com\",\n    \"label\": \"Get in touch\"\n  },\n  \"privacy\": \"This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies. 'location' : undefined}>{link.label}</a>\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ul>\n        </nav>\n        {DATA.cta ? <a onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-header__drawer-cta\" href={DATA.cta.href}>{DATA.cta.label}</a> : null}\n        {DATA.email ? <a className=\"k-link k-header__drawer-mail\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a> : null}\n      </div>\n      {DATA.store ?       "src/components/Hero.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Hero.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"headline\": \"Recover stronger with Kinetic Health\",\n  \"lede\": \"Expert physiotherapy and rehabilitation in Dublin for all ages and activity levels\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Recovery made simple\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Hero\",\n  \"mark\": \"K\",\n  \"primary\": {\n    \"href\": \"#our-team\",\n    \"label\": \"Meet our team\"\n  },\n  \"secondary\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Contact us\"\n  },\n  \"fact\": \"Based in Dublin\",\n  \"style\": \"split\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1447933601403-0c6688de566e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"Freshly roasted coffee beans\",\n    \"w\": 1200,\n    \"h\": 1500\n  },\n  \"shader\": false,\n  \"window\": {\n    \"title\": \"Kinetic Health overview\",\n    \"labels\": [\n      \"Overview\",\n      \"Activity\",\n      \"Reports\"\n    ],\n    \"bars\": [\n      38,\n      52,\n      46,\n      64,\n      58,\n      72,\n      66,\n      84,\n      78,\n      90\n    ]\n  }\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction useMagnet<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const el = ref.current;\n    if (!el) return;\n    const fine = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (!fine || reduce) return;\n    const move = (event: PointerEvent) => {\n      if (event.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;\n      const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n      const x = ((event.clientX - box.left) / box.width - 0.5) * 16;\n      const y = ((event.clientY - box.top) / box.height - 0.5) * 12;\n      el.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + x.toFixed(1) + 'px, ' + y.toFixed(1) + 'px, 0)';\n    };\n    const leave = () => {\n      el.style.transform = '';\n    };\n    el.addEventListener('pointermove', move);\n    el.addEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    return () => {\n      el.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);\n      el.removeEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    };\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Hero() {\n  const magnetRef = useMagnet<HTMLAnchorElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"hero\" className=\"k-section k-hero k-hero--split\" aria-labelledby=\"hero-title\" data-section=\"hero\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-hero__inner\">\n        <div className=\"k-hero__copy\">\n          {DATA.tagline ? <p className=\"k-eyebrow k-hero__eyebrow k-rise-2\">{DATA.tagline}</p> : null}\n          <h1 id=\"hero-title\" className=\"k-display k-hero__title\" data-motion=\"text-in\">{DATA.headline}</h1>\n          <p className=\"k-lede k-hero__lede k-rise-2\">{DATA.lede}</p>\n          <div className=\"k-actions k-rise-3\">\n            <a ref={magnetRef} className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary\" href={DATA.primary.href}>{DATA.primary.label}</a>\n            <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-hero__ghost\" href={DATA.secondary.href}>{DATA.secondary.label}</a>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.fact ? <p className=\"k-hero__fact k-rise-3\">{DATA.fact}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-hero__visual k-depth-slow\">\n          <Media img={DATA.img} priority={true} variant={1} mark={DATA.mark} className=\"k-hero__media\" />\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Hero;\n",

background-color: var(--k-surface-2); overflow: hidden; }\n.k-hero .k-window__meter span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background-color: var(--k-accent); }\n.k-hero .k-window__chart { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; height: 140px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--k-line); border-radius: 10px; }\n.k-hero .k-window__chart span { flex: 1; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; background-image: linear-gradient(to top, var(--k-accent), var(--k-accent-2)); opacity: 0.85; }\n.k-hero .k-window__caption { padding: 10px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line); font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--k-muted); }\n@media (max-width: 640px) {\n  .k-hero .k-window__body { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }\n  .k-hero .k-window__side { display: none; }\n  .k-hero .k-window__tiles { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }\n}\n",
      "src/components/OurTeam.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './OurTeam.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Meet the experts\",\n  \"intro\": \"Our team combines expertise and compassion to support your recovery\",\n  \"members\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"\",\n      \"role\": \"Rehabilitation specialist\",\n      \"text\": \"Focuses on restoring mobility and function through targeted therapy\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"\",\n      \"role\": \"Clinical exercise physiologist\",\n      \"text\": \"Designs personalized exercise programs for all stages of recovery\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Our team\",\n  \"mark\": \"K\"\n};\n\nfunction useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const root = ref.current;\n    if (!root) return;\n    const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\"]'));\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (reduce || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {\n      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('is-visible'));\n      return;\n    }\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n          entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');\n          observer.unobserve(entry.target);\n        }\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.12 });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nfunction Media({ priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {priority ? (\n        <img alt=\"\" loading=\"eager\" fetchPriority=\"high\" onError={() => setMissing(true)} width={priority.width} height={priority.height} />\n      ) : missing ? (\n        <div className=\"k-art__placeholder\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n      ) : (\n        <img alt=\"\" loading=\"lazy\" fetchPriority=\"auto\" onError={() => setMissing(true)} width={priority.width} height={priority.height} />\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function OurTeam() {\n  const revealRef = useReveal<HTMLElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"our-team\" className=\"k-section k-our-team\" aria-labelledby=\"our-team-title\" data-section=\"our-team\" ref={revealRef}>\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"our-team-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-our-team-list k-our-team-list--grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.members.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className=\"k-our-team-item\" key={i} data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\">\n              <span className=\"k-our-team-index\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n              <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.name || item.role || item.title}</h3>\n              {item.name && item.role ? <p className=\"k-our-team-role\">{item.role}</p> : null}\n              {item.text ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.text}</p> : null}\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default OurTeam;\n",
      "src/components/OurTeam.css": ".k-our-team .k-our-team-list--grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px) clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px); }\n.k-our-team .k-our-team-list--grid .k-our-team-item { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; padding-top: var(--k-space-3); border-top: 2px solid var(--k-ink); }\n.k-our-team .k-our-team-list--rows { display: grid; border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-our-team .k-our-team-list--rows .k-our-team-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: var(--k-space-3) var(--k-space-6); align-items: baseline; padding-block: clamp(22px, 3vw, 36px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-our-team .k-our-team-index { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--k-accent-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-our-team .k-our-team-role { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-accent-text); }\n.k-our-team .k-our-team-item p { max-width: 52ch; }\n@media (max-width: 760px) {\n  .k-our-team .k-our-team-list--rows .k-our-team-item { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--k-space-1); }\n}\n",
      "src/components/Testimonials.tsx": "import './Testimonials.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"What our patients say\",\n  \"intro\": \"Real stories of recovery and progress\",\n  \"invite\": \"Share your experience with us\",\n  \"quotes\": [],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Testimonials\",\n  \"mark\": \"K\",\n  \"feedbackHref\": \"mailto:bookings@kinetichealth.com?subject=Feedback%20for%20Kinetic%20Health\"\n};\n\nexport function Testimonials() {\n  return (\n    <section id=\"testimonials\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-testimonials\" data-section=\"testimonials\">\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        {DATA.quotes.length ? (\n          <>\n            <div className=\"k-head\"><h2 id=\"testimonials-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2></div>\n            <ul className=\"k-testimonials-grid\">\n              {DATA.quotes.map((q: any, i: number) => (\n                <li key={i}>\n                  <figure className=\"k-testimonials-quote\">\n                    <blockquote><p>{q.quote}</p></blockquote>\n                    {q.author ? <figcaption>{q.author}</figcaption> : null}\n                  </figure>\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          </>\n        ) : (\n          <div className=\"k-testimonials-invite\">\n            <h2 id=\"testimonials-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n            {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n            <p className=\"k-text\">{DATA.invite}</p>\n            <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost\" href={DATA.feedbackHref}>Share your experience</a>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Testimonials;",
      "src/components/Testimonials.css": ".k-testimonials .k-testimonials-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 300px), 1fr)); gap: var(--k-space-4); }\n.k-testimonials .k-testimonials-quote { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); margin: 0; padding-top: var(--k-space-3); border-top: 2px solid var(--k-ink); }\n.k-testimonials .k-testimonials-quote blockquote { margin: 0; font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2vw, 1.6rem); line-height: 1.3; }\n.k-testimonials .k-testimonials-quote figcaption { color: var(--k-muted); font-size: 0.9375rem; }\n.k-testimonials .k-testimonials-invite { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); justify-items: start; max-width: 760px; }",
      "src/components/Faq.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Faq.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Frequently Asked Questions\",\n  \"intro\": \"Common questions about our services and approach\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Do you accept new patients?\",\n      \"a\": \"We welcome new patients who have a referral or have been referred by a GP.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"What types of treatments do you offer?\",\n      \"a\": \"We provide a range of treatments tailored to your specific needs and condition.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Do you offer online consultations?\",\n      \"a\": \"We offer virtual consultations for initial assessments and follow-up discussions.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"FAQ\",\n  \"mark\": \"K\"\n};\n\nexport function Faq() {\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(0);\n  return (\n    <section id=\"faq\" className=\"k-section k-faq\" aria-labelledby=\"faq-title\" data-section=\"faq\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-faq-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-head\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"faq-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-faq-list\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <div className=\"k-faq-item\" key={i}>\n              <h3 className=\"k-faq-q\">\n                <button onClick={() => setOpen(open === i ? -1 : i)} type=\"button\" id={'faq-q-' + i} aria-expanded={open === i} aria-controls={'faq-a-' + i} className=\"k-faq-trigger\">\n                  <span>{item.q}</span>\n                  <span className=\"k-faq-icon\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                </button>\n              </h3>\n              <div id={'faq-a-' + i} role=\"region\" aria-labelledby={'faq-q-' + i} className=\"k-faq-answer\" hidden={open !== i}>\n                <p>{item.a}</p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Faq;\n",
      "src/components/Faq.css": ".k-faq .k-faq-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-list { border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-q { font-size: inherit; font-weight: inherit; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--k-space-3); min-height: 64px; padding: var(--k-space-2) 0; border: 0; background-color: transparent; color: var(--k-ink); font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-weight: var(--k-display-weight); font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.6vw, 1.375rem); line-height: 1.3; text-align: left; transition: color 160ms ease; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger:hover, .k-faq .k-faq-trigger:focus-visible { color: var(--k-accent-text); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon { position: relative; flex: 0 0 18px; height: 18px; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon::before, .k-faq .k-faq-icon::after { content: \"\"; position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 0; width: 18px; height: 2px; background-color: currentColor; transition: transform 220ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon::after { transform: rotate(90deg); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger[aria-expanded=\"true\"] .k-faq-icon::after { transform: rotate(0deg); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer { padding-bottom: var(--k-space-3); color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer p { max-width: 60ch; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer:not([hidden]) { animation: k-faq-open 260ms var(--k-ease); }\n@keyframes k-faq-open { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }\n@media (max-width: 860px) { .k-faq .k-faq-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }\n",
      "src/components/Treatments.tsx": "import './Treatments.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Treatments\",\n  \"intro\": \"Our approach is tailored to your needs and recovery goals.\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Posture correction\",\n      \"text\": \"We assess and address alignment issues to improve movement and reduce strain.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Sports injury rehab\",\n      \"text\": \"Specialised care for injuries sustained from sports or physical activity.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Neuromuscular therapy\",\n      \"text\": \"Targeted treatment for muscle imbalances and movement disorders.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"K\"\n};\n\nexport function Treatments() {\n  return (\n    <section id=\"treatments\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-treatments\" aria-labelledby=\"treatments-title\" data-section=\"treatments\">\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"treatments-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-treatments-list k-treatments-list--grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className=\"k-treatments-item\" key={i}>\n              <span className=\"k-treatments-index\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n              <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.title}</h3>\n              {item.text ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.text}</p> : null}\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Treatments;\n",
      "src/components/Treatments.css": ".k-treatments .k-treatments-list--grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px) clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px); }\n.k-treatments .k-treatments-list--grid .k-treatments-item { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; padding-top: var(--k-space-3); border-top: 2px solid var(--k-ink); }\n.k-treatments .k-treatments-list--rows { display: grid; border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-treatments .k-treatments-list--rows .k-treatments-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: var(--k-space-3) var(--k-space-6); align-items: baseline; padding-block: clamp(22px, 3vw, 36px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-treatments .k-treatments-index { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--k-accent-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-treatments .k-treatments-role { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-accent-text); }\n.k-treatments .k-treatments-item p { max-width: 52ch; }\n@media (max-width: 760px) {\n  .k-treatments .k-treatments-list--rows .k-treatments-item { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--k-space-1); }\n}\n",
      "src/components/Pricing.tsx": "import './Pricing.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Pricing\",\n  \"intro\": \"Transparent and affordable care for all stages of recovery\",\n  \"tiers\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"1-3 words\",\n      \"description\": \"Basic sessions for initial assessment and short-term recovery\",\n      \"features\": [\n        \"First visit\",\n        \"Short-term care\",\n        \"Private room\"\n      ],\n      \"price\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"4-6 words\",\n      \"description\": \"Extended care for ongoing rehabilitation and long-term support\",\n      \"features\": [\n        \"Ongoing therapy\",\n        \"Progress tracking\",\n        \"Personalized plans\"\n      ],\n      \"price\": \"\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"K\",\n  \"featured\": -1,\n  \"quoteHref\": \"#contact\"\n};\n\nexport function Pricing() {\n  return (\n    <section id=\"pricing\" className=\"k-section k-pricing\" aria-labelledby=\"pricing-title\" data-section=\"pricing\">\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"pricing-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-pricing-grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.tiers.map((tier: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className={'k-pricing-tier' + (DATA.featured === i ? ' k-pricing-tier--featured' : '')} key={i}>\n              <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{tier.name}</h3>\n              <p className=\"k-pricing-price\">{tier.price || 'Pricing on request'}</p>\n              {tier.description ? <p className=\"k-pricing-desc\">{tier.description}</p> : null}\n              {tier.features.length ? (\n                <ul className=\"k-pricing-features\">\n                  {tier.features.map((f: string, j: number) => <li key={j}>{f}</li>)}\n                </ul>\n              ) : null}\n              <a className={'k-btn ' + (DATA.featured === i ? 'k-btn--primary' : 'k-btn--ghost') + ' k-pricing-cta'} href={DATA.quoteHref}>Ask for a quote</a>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Pricing;\n",
      "src/components/Pricing.css": ".k-pricing .k-pricing-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 28px); align-items: stretch; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-tier { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--k-space-2); padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-tier--featured { background-color: var(--k-ink); color: var(--k-bg); border-color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-price { font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.2; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-desc { opacity: 0.86; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-features { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: var(--k-space-2); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-features li { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-features li::before { content: \"\"; flex: 0 0 12px; height: 2px; transform: translateY(-4px); background-color: var(--k-accent); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-cta { margin-top: auto; align-self: flex-start; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-tier--featured .k-btn--ghost { color: var(--k-bg); }\n",
      "src/components/Contact.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport type { FormEvent as ReactFormEvent } from 'react';\nimport './Contact.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Get in touch\",\n  \"text\": \"Book an appointment or ask questions. We\u2019re here to help you move forward.\",\n  \"button\": \"Book now\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Contact\",\n  \"mark\": \"K\",\n  \"email\": \"bookings@kinetichealth.com\",\n  \"location\": \"Dublin\",\n  \"note\": \"Sending opens your email app with the message ready to go.\",\n  \"doneNote\": \"Your email app should now open with the message ready to send.\"\n};\n\nexport function Contact() {\n  const [values, setValues] = useState({ name: '', email: '', message: '' });\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [state, setState] = useState('idle');\n  const update = (field: string, value: string) => setValues((current: any) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));\n  const submit = (event: ReactFormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    const next: Record<string, string> = {};\n    if (!values.name.trim()) next.name = 'Please add your name.';\n    if (!/^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/.test(values.email)) next.email = 'Please add a valid email address.';\n    if (values.message.trim().length < 10) next.message = 'Please write a short message of at least ten characters.';\n    setErrors(next);\n    if (Object.keys(next).length) return;\n    setState('busy');\n    window.setTimeout(() => {\n      if (DATA.email) {\n        const body = values.message + '\\n\\n' + values.name + ' (' + values.email + ')';\n        window.location.href = 'mailto:' + DATA.email + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(`Message from ${values.name}`) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(body);\n      }\n      setState('done');\n    }, 400);\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"contact\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-contact\" aria-labelledby=\"contact-title\" data-section=\"contact\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-contact-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-contact-intro\">\n          <h2 id=\"contact-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.text ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.text}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.email || DATA.location ? (\n            <dl className=\"k-contact-details\">\n              {DATA.email ? (\n                <div><dt>Email</dt><dd><a className=\"k-link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n              {DATA.location ? (\n                <div><dt>Location</dt><dd>{DATA.location}</dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n            </dl>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n        <form className=\"k-contact-form\" noValidate onSubmit={submit} aria-describedby=\"contact-form-note\">\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-name\">Name</label>\n            <input id=\"contact-name\" name=\"name\" type=\"text\" autoComplete=\"name\" required value={values.name} aria-invalid={errors.name ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.name ? 'contact-name-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('name', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.name ? <p id=\"contact-name-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.name}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-email\">Email</label>\n            <input id=\"contact-email\" name=\"email\" type=\"email\" autoComplete=\"email\" required value={values.email} aria-invalid={errors.email ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'contact-email-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('email', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.email ? <p id=\"contact-email-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.email}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-message\">Message</label>\n            <textarea id=\"contact-message\" name=\"message\" rows={5} required value={values.message} aria-invalid={errors.message ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.message ? 'contact-message-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('message', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.message ? <p id=\"contact-message-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.message}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <button type=\"submit\" className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-contact-submit\" aria-busy={state === 'busy'} disabled={state === 'busy'}>{state === 'busy' ? 'Preparing\u2026' : DATA.button}</button>\n          <p id=\"contact-form-note\" className=\"k-contact-note\" aria-live=\"polite\">{state === 'done' ? DATA.doneNote : DATA.note}</p>\n        </form>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Contact;\n",
      "src/components/Contact.css": ".k-contact .k-contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-intro { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); margin: var(--k-space-2) 0 0; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details dt { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-form { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); border-radius: calc(var(--k-radius-btn) / 2 + 2px); background-color: var(--k-surface); color: var(--k-ink); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field textarea { resize: vertical; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input:hover, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea:hover { border-color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input:focus-visible, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--k-accent-text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--k-accent-soft); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field [aria-invalid=\"true\"] { border-color: #B42318; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-error { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-error::before { content: \"! \"; color: #D92D20; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-submit { justify-self: start; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-note { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--k-muted); }\n@media (max-width: 860px) { .k-contact .k-contact-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }\n",
      "src/components/Footer.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Footer.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Kinetic Health\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Recovery made simple\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"our-team\",\n      \"href\": \"#our-team\",\n      \"label\": \"Our team\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"testimonials\",\n      \"href\": \"#testimonials\",\n      \"label\": \"Testimonials\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"faq\",\n      \"href\": \"#faq\",\n      \"label\": \"FAQ\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"treatments\",\n      \"href\": \"#treatments\",\n      \"label\": \"Treatments\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"pricing\",\n      \"href\": \"#pricing\",\n      \"label\": \"Pricing\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"contact\",\n      \"href\": \"#contact\",\n      \"label\": \"Contact\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"email\": \"bookings@kinetichealth.com\",\n  \"location\": \"Dublin\",\n  \"contactHref\": \"#contact\",\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Get in touch\"\n  },\n  \"privacy\": \"This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies. Fonts load from Google Fonts and photos from Unsplash, which receive your IP address to deliver them. If you write to us, your message is used only to reply.\"\n};\n\nexport function Footer() {\n  const [privacy, setPrivacy] = useState(false);\n  const year = new Date().getFullYear();\n  return (\n    <footer id=\"site-footer\" className=\"k-footer\" data-section=\"footer\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-footer__grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-footer__brand\">\n          <a className=\"k-footer__wordmark\" href=\"#site-main\">{DATA.brand}</a>\n          {DATA.tagline ? <p className=\"k-footer__tagline\">{DATA.tagline}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.cta ? <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-footer__cta\" href={DATA.cta.href}>{DATA.cta.label}</a> : null}\n        </div>\n        {DATA.links.length ? (\n          <nav className=\"k-footer__col\" aria-label=\"Footer\">\n            <p className=\"k-footer__label\">Explore</p>\n            <ul className=\"k-footer__links\">\n              {DATA.links.map((link: any) => (\n                <li key={link.id}><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={link.href}>{link.label}</a></li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          </nav>\n        ) : null}\n        <div className=\"k-footer__col\">\n          <p className=\"k-footer__label\">Contact</p>\n          <ul className=\"k-footer__links\">\n            {DATA.email ? <li><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></li> : null}\n            {DATA.location ? <li><span className=\"k-footer__plain\">{DATA.location}</span></li> : null}\n            {!DATA.email && DATA.contactHref ? <li><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={DATA.contactHref}>Send a message</a></li> : null}\n            {!DATA.email && !DATA.contactHref ? <li><span className=\"k-footer__plain\">Contact details coming from {DATA.brand} directly.</span></li> : null}\n          </ul>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"k-container k-footer__base\">\n        <p>\u00a9 {year} {DATA.brand}</p>\n        <div className=\"k-footer__base-links\">\n          <button onClick={() => setPrivacy(!privacy)} type=\"button\" className=\"k-footer__privacy-toggle\" aria-expanded={privacy} aria-controls=\"footer-privacy\">Privacy</button>\n          <a className=\"k-footer__link\" href=\"#site-main\">Back to top</a>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div id=\"footer-privacy\" className=\"k-container k-footer__privacy\" hidden={!privacy}>\n        <p>{DATA.privacy}</p>\n      </div>\n    </footer>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Footer;\n",
      "src/components/Footer.css": ".k-footer { padding-block: clamp(56px, 8vw, 96px) 32px; background-color: var(--k-surface); color: var(--k-ink); border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line); }\n.k-footer .k-footer__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--k-space-6); }\n.k-footer .k-footer__brand { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; justify-items: start; }\n.k-footer .k-footer__wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--k-tap); font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-weight: var(--k-display-weight); font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); line-height: 1.05; text-transform: var(--k-display-case); text-decoration: none; }\n.k-footer .k-footer__tagline { max-width: 34ch; color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-footer .k-footer__cta { margin-top: var(--k-space-1); }\n.k-footer .k-footer__label { margin-bottom: var(--k-space-1); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-footer .k-footer__links { display: grid; }\n.k-footer .k-footer__link, .k-footer .k-footer__plain { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--k-tap); text-decoration: none; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.k-footer .k-footer__link { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; transition: text-decoration-color 160ms ease; }\n.k-footer .k-footer__link:hover, .k-footer .k-footer__link:focus-visible { text-decoration-color: currentColor; }\n.k-footer .k-footer__base { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--k-space-2); margin-top: var(--k-space-8); padding-top: var(--k-space-3); border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-footer .k-footer__base-links { display: flex; gap: var(--k-space-3); align-items: center; }\n.k-footer .k-footer__privacy-toggle { min-height: var(--k-tap); padding: 0; border: 0; background-color: transparent; color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; }\n.k-footer .k-footer__privacy-toggle:hover, .k-footer .k-footer__privacy-toggle:focus-visible { color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-footer .k-footer__privacy p { max-width: 70ch; margin-top: var(--k-space-2); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--k-muted); }\n@media (max-width: 760px) { .k-footer .k-footer__grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);     "code": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Larkspur Yoga\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"classes\",\n      \"href\": \"#classes\",\n      \"label\": \"Classes\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"teachers\",\n      \"href\": \"#teachers\",\n      \"label\": \"Teachers\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"pricing\",\n      \"href\": \"#pricing\",\n      \"label\": \"Pricing\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"faq\",\n      \"href\": \"#faq\",\n      \"label\": \"FAQ\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Get in touch\"\n  },\n  \"store\": false,\n  \"email\": \"hello@larkspuryoga.co.uk\",\n  \"currency\": \"\",\n  \"checkoutNote\": \"Checkout is handled by email for now: email hello@larkspuryoga.co.uk with your list and we'll confirm availability and payment.\"\n};\n\nfunction parsePrice(value: string): number {\n  const n = parseFloat(String(value || '').replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''));\n  return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;\n}\n\nfunction useCart() {\n  const [lines, setLines] = useState<any[]>([]);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onAdd = (event: Event) => {\n      const detail = (event as CustomEvent).detail || {};\n      if (!detail.name) return;\n      setLines((current: any[]) => {\n        if (current.some((line: any) => line.name === detail.name)) {\n          return current.map((line: any) => (line.name === detail.name ? { ...line, qty: line.qty + 1 } : line));\n        }\n        return [...current, { name: detail.name, price: detail.price || '', qty: 1 }];\n      });\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('kit-cart-add', onAdd);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('kit-cart-add', onAdd);\n  }, []);\n  const remove = (name: string) => setLines((current: any[]) => current.filter((line: any) => line.name !== name));\n  return { lines, remove };\n}\n\nfunction cartTotal(lines: any[]) {\n  return lines.reduce((sum: number, line: any) => sum + parsePrice(line.price) * line.qty, 0);\n}\n\nfunction orderBody(lines: any[], currency: string) {\n  return lines.map((line: any) => line.qty + ' x ' + line.name + (line.price ? '\\n\\nTotal: ' + currency + cartTotal(lines).toFixed(2) : '');\n}\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [tucked, setTucked] = useState(false);\n  const null>(null);\n  const firstLinkRef = useRef<HTMLAnchorElement | null>(null);\n  const navigatedAt = useRef(0);\n  const cart = useCart();\n  const count = cart.lines.reduce((sum: number, line: any) => sum + line.qty, 0);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');\n    let last = window.scrollY;\n    let pending = 0;\n    const settle = () => {\n      pending = 0;\n      const y = window.scrollY;\n      if (Date.now() - navigatedAt.current < 1500) {\n        // An in-page link is scrolling the page; keep the navigation in view.\n        setTucked(false);\n        last = y;\n        return;\n      }\n      if (y > last + 4 && y > 120 && !reduce.matches) setTucked(true);\n      else if (y < last - 4 || y <= 120) setTucked(false);\n      last = y;\n    };\n    const onScroll = () => {\n      if (!pending) pending = window.setTimeout(settle, 80);\n    };\n    const onAnchor = (event: MouseEvent) => {\n      const target = event.target Date.now();\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });\n    document.addEventListener('click', onAnchor, true);\n    window.addEventListener('hashchange', onHash);\n    return () => {\n      window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n      document.removeEventListener('click', onAnchor, true);\n      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onHash);\n      if (pending) window.clearTimeout(pending);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;\n    const targets = DATA.links\n      .map((link: any) => document.getElementById(link.id))\n      .filter((el: HTMLElement | null) => Boolean(el)) as HTMLElement[];\n    if (!targets.length) return;\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) setActive(entry.target.id);\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -50% 0px' });\n    targets.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!open && !cartOpen) return;\n    const previous = document.body.style.overflow;\n    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';\n    if (open) firstLinkRef.current?.focus();\n    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {\n      if (event.key !== cartButtonRef.current?.focus();\n      }\n    };\n    const desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 900px)');\n    const onWide = () => {\n      if (desktop.matches) setOpen(false);\n    };\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n    desktop.addEventListener('change', onWide);\n    return () => {\n      document.body.style.overflow = previous;\n      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n      desktop.removeEventListener('change', onWide);\n    };\n  }, [open, cartOpen]);\n\n  const closeMenu = () => {\n    setOpen(false);\n    toggleRef.current?.focus();\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      <header id=\"header\" className={'k-header' + (tucked && !open && !cartOpen ? 'location' : undefined}>{link.label}</a>\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ul>\n        </nav>\n        {DATA.cta ? <a onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-header__drawer-cta\" href={DATA.cta.href}>{DATA.cta.label}</a> : null}\n        {DATA.email ? <a className=\"k-link k-header__drawer-mail\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a> : null}\n      </div>\n      {DATA.store ? (\n            <ul className=\"k-header__lines\">\n              {cart.lines.map((line: any) => (\n                <li key={line.name} className=\"k-header__line\">\n                  <span>{line.qty} \u00d7 {line.name}</span>\n                  <span>{line.price}</span>\n                  <button onClick={() => cart.remove(line.name)} type=\"button\" className=\"k-header__remove\" aria-label={'Remove ' + line.name}>Remove</button>\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          ) : (\n            <p className=\"k-header__empty\">Your cart is empty. (\n            <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(`Order from ${DATA.brand}`) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(orderBody(cart.lines, DATA.currency))}>Email this order</a>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n      ) : null}\n    </>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Header;\n",

      "src/components/Hero.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Hero.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"headline\": \"Practice at Larkspur Yoga\",\n  \"lede\": \"Small studio in Leeds offering gentle yoga classes and a calm space to connect.\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Calm space for connection\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Hero\",\n  \"mark\": \"L\",\n  \"primary\": {\n    \"href\": \"#classes\",\n    \"label\": \"Explore Classes\"\n  },\n  \"secondary\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Contact Us\"\n  },\n  \"fact\": \"Based in Leeds\",\n  \"style\": \"fullbleed\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1599901860904-17e6ed7083a0?auto=format&fit=crop&w=2000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"A yoga class stretching together\",\n    \"w\": 2000,\n    \"h\": 1300\n  },\n  \"shader\": false,\n  \"window\": {\n    \"title\": \"Larkspur Yoga overview\",\n    \"labels\": [\n      \"Overview\",\n      \"Activity\",\n      \"Reports\"\n    ],\n    \"bars\": [\n      38,\n      52,\n      46,\n      64,\n      58,\n      72,\n      66,\n      84,\n      78,\n      90\n    ]\n  }\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction useMagnet<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const el = ref.current;\n    if (!el) return;\n    const fine = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (!fine || reduce) return;\n    const move = (event: PointerEvent) => {\n      if (event.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;\n      const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n      const x = ((event.clientX - box.left) / box.width - 0.5) * 16;\n      const y = ((event.clientY - box.top) / box.height - 0.5) * 12;\n      el.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + x.toFixed(1) + 'px, ' + y.toFixed(1) + 'px, 0)';\n    };\n    const leave = () => {\n      el.style.transform = '';\n    };\n    el.addEventListener('pointermove', move);\n    el.addEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    return () => {\n      el.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);\n      el.removeEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    };\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Hero() {\n  const magnetRef = useMagnet<HTMLAnchorElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"hero\" className=\"k-section k-hero k-hero--fullbleed\" aria-labelledby=\"hero-title\" data-section=\"hero\">\n      <div className=\"k-hero__bg\">\n        <Media img={DATA.img} priority={true} variant={1} className=\"k-hero__bgmedia\" />\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"k-hero__shade\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n      <div className=\"k-container k-hero__inner\">\n        <div className=\"k-hero__copy\">\n          {DATA.tagline ? <p className=\"k-eyebrow k-hero__eyebrow k-rise-2\">{DATA.tagline}</p> : null}\n          <h1 id=\"hero-title\" className=\"k-display k-hero__title\" data-motion=\"text-in\">{DATA.headline}</h1>\n          <p className=\"k-lede k-hero__lede k-rise-2\">{DATA.lede}</p>\n          <div className=\"k-actions k-rise-3\">\n            <a ref={magnetRef} className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary\" href={DATA.primary.href}>{DATA.primary.label}</a>\n            <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-hero__ghost\" href={DATA.secondary.href}>{DATA.secondary.label}</a>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.fact ? <p className=\"k-hero__fact k-rise-3\">{DATA.fact}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Hero;\n",

      "src/components/Classes.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport './Classes.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Classes\",\n  \"intro\": \"Explore a range of classes designed for all levels and styles.\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Morning Flow\",\n      \"text\": \"Begin your day with a gentle flow that balances strength and flexibility.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Restorative Yoga\",\n      \"text\": \"Experience deep relaxation with supported poses and mindful breathing.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Yin Yoga\",\n      \"text\": \"Focus on holding poses for extended periods to release tension and improve flexibility.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"L\"\n};\n\nfunction useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const root = ref.current;\n    if (!root) return;\n    const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\"]'));\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (reduce || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {\n      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('is-visible'));\n      return;\n    }\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n          entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');\n          observer.unobserve(entry.target);\n        }\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.12 });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Classes() {\n  const revealRef = useReveal<HTMLElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"classes\" className=\"k-section k-classes\" aria-labelledby=\"classes-title\" data-section=\"classes\" ref={revealRef}>\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"classes-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-classes-list k-classes-list--grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className=\"k-classes-item\" key={i} data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\">\n              <span className=\"k-classes-index\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n              <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.title}</h3>\n              {item.text ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.text}</p> : null}\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Classes;\n",

      "src/components/Teachers.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Teachers.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Teachers\",\n  \"intro\": \"Join a teacher who knows your practice\",\n  \"paragraphs\": [\n    \"Our teachers bring years of experience and a deep understanding of yoga to every class.\",\n    \"They create a space where you can move, breathe, and connect with yourself.\"\n  ],\n  \"bullets\": [\n    \"Years of experience\",\n    \"Deep understanding\",\n    \"Space to move\"\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"L\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544367567-0f2fcb009e0b?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"A person holding a yoga pose\",\n    \"w\": 1000,\n    \"h\": 1250\n  }\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ?
