      "src/components/Pricing.tsx": "import './Pricing.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Pricing\",\n  \"intro\": \"All classes are priced per session.\",\n  \"tiers\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"1-3 words\",\n      \"description\": \"Beginner-friendly sessions for 1-3 words.\",\n      \"features\": [\n        \"1-3 words\",\n        \"1-3 words\",\n        \"1-3 words\"\n      ],\n      \"price\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"4-6 words\",\n      \"description\": \"Intermediate sessions for 4-6 words.\",\n      \"features\": [\n        \"4-6 words\",\n        \"4-6 words\",\n        \"4-6 words\"\n      ],\n      \"price\": \"\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"L\",\n  \"featured\": -1,\n  \"quoteHref\": \"#contact\"\n};\n\nexport function Pricing() {\n  return (\n    <section id=\"pricing\" className=\"k-section k-pricing\" aria-labelledby=\"pricing-title\" data-section=\"pricing\">\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"pricing-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-pricing-grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.tiers.map((tier: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className={'k-pricing-tier' + (DATA.featured === i ? ' k-pricing-tier--featured' : '')} key={i}>\n              <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{tier.name}</h3>\n              <p className=\"k-pricing-price\">{tier.price || 'Pricing on request'}</p>\n              {tier.description ? <p className=\"k-pricing-desc\">{tier.description}</p> : null}\n              {tier.features.length ? (\n                <ul className=\"k-pricing-features\">\n                  {tier.features.map((f: string, j: number) => <li key={j}>{f}</li>)}\n                </ul>\n              ) : null}\n              <a className={'k-btn ' + (DATA.featured === i ? 'k-btn--primary' : 'k-btn--ghost') + ' k-pricing-cta'} href={DATA.quoteHref}>Ask for a quote</a>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Pricing;\n",
      "src/components/Pricing.css": ".k-pricing .k-pricing-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 28px); align-items: stretch; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-tier { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--k-space-2); padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-tier--featured { background-color: var(--k-ink); color: var(--k-bg); border-color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-price { font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.2; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-desc { opacity: 0.86; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-features { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: var(--k-space-2); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-features li { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-features li::before { content: \"\"; flex: 0 0 12px; height: 2px; transform: translateY(-4px); background-color: var(--k-accent); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-cta { margin-top: auto; align-self: flex-start; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-tier--featured .k-btn--ghost { color: var(--k-bg); }\n",
      "src/components/Faq.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Faq.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Frequently Asked Questions\",\n  \"intro\": \"Common questions about our studio and classes\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Are there different types of yoga classes?\",\n      \"a\": \"We offer Hatha, Vinyasa, Yin, and Restorative yoga classes.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Do you offer private lessons?\",\n      \"a\": \"Private lessons are available by appointment.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"What should I bring to a class?\",\n      \"a\": \"Bring a mat, water, and comfortable clothing.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"FAQ\",\n  \"mark\": \"L\"\n};\n\nexport function Faq() {\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(0);\n  return (\n    <section id=\"faq\" className=\"k-section k-faq\" aria-labelledby=\"faq-title\" data-section=\"faq\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-faq-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-head\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"faq-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-faq-list\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <div className=\"k-faq-item\" key={i}>\n              <h3 className=\"k-faq-q\">\n                <button onClick={() => setOpen(open === i ? -1 : i)} type=\"button\" id={'faq-q-' + i} aria-expanded={open === i} aria-controls={'faq-a-' + i} className=\"k-faq-trigger\">\n                  <span>{item.q}</span>\n                  <span className=\"k-faq-icon\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                </button>\n              </h3>\n              <div id={'faq-a-' + i} role=\"region\" aria-labelledby={'faq-q-' + i} className=\"k-faq-answer\" hidden={open !== i}>\n                <p>{item.a}</p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Faq;\n",
      "src/components/Faq.css": ".k-faq .k-faq-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-list { border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-q { font-size: inherit; font-weight: inherit; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--k-space-3); min-height: 64px; padding: var(--k-space-2) 0; border: 0; background-color: transparent; color: var(--k-ink); font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-weight: var(--k-display-weight); font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.6vw, 1.375rem); line-height: 1.3; text-align: left; transition: color 160ms ease; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger:hover, .k-faq .k-faq-trigger:focus-visible { color: var(--k-accent-text); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon { position: relative; flex: 0 0 18px; height: 18px; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon::before, .k-faq .k-faq-icon::after { content: \"\"; position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 0; width: 18px; height: 2px; background-color: currentColor; transition: transform 220ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon::after { transform: rotate(90deg); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger[aria-expanded=\"true\"] .k-faq-icon::after { transform: rotate(0deg); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer { padding-bottom: var(--k-space-3); color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer p { max-width: 60ch; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer:not([hidden]) { animation: k-faq-open 260ms var(--k-ease); }\n@keyframes k-faq-open { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }\n@media (max-width: 860px) { .k-faq .k-faq-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }\n",
      "src/components/Contact.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport type { FormEvent as ReactFormEvent } from 'react';\nimport './Contact.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Get in Touch\",\n  \"text\": \"Email us for more information or to book a class. We\u2019re here to help.\",\n  \"button\": \"Email Us\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Contact\",\n  \"mark\": \"L\",\n  \"email\": \"hello@larkspuryoga.co.uk\",\n  \"location\": \"Leeds\",\n  \"note\": \"Sending opens your email app with the message ready to go.\",\n  \"doneNote\": \"Your email app should now open with the message ready to send.\"\n};\n\nexport function Contact() {\n  const [values, setValues] = useState({ name: '', email: '', message: '' });\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [state, setState] = useState('idle');\n  const update = (field: string, value: string) => setValues((current: any) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));\n  const submit = (event: ReactFormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    const next: Record<string, string> = {};\n    if (!values.name.trim()) next.name = 'Please add your name.';\n    if (!/^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/.test(values.email)) next.email = 'Please add a valid email address.';\n    if (values.message.trim().length < 10) next.message = 'Please write a short message of at least ten characters.';\n    setErrors(next);\n    if (Object.keys(next).length) return;\n    setState('busy');\n    window.setTimeout(() => {\n      if (DATA.email) {\n        const body = values.message + '\\n\\n' + values.name + ' (' + values.email + ')';\n        window.location.href = 'mailto:' + DATA.email + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(`Message from ${values.name}`) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(body);\n      }\n      setState('done');\n    }, 400);\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"contact\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-contact\" aria-labelledby=\"contact-title\" data-section=\"contact\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-contact-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-contact-intro\">\n          <h2 id=\"contact-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.text ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.text}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.email || DATA.location ? (\n            <dl className=\"k-contact-details\">\n              {DATA.email ? (\n                <div><dt>Email</dt><dd><a className=\"k-link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n              {DATA.location ? (\n                <div><dt>Location</dt><dd>{DATA.location}</dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n            </dl>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n        <form className=\"k-contact-form\" noValidate onSubmit={submit} aria-describedby=\"contact-form-note\">\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-name\">Name</label>\n            <input id=\"contact-name\" name=\"name\" type=\"text\" autoComplete=\"name\" required value={values.name} aria-invalid={errors.name ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.name ? 'contact-name-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('name', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.name ? <p id=\"contact-name-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.name}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-email\">Email</label>\n            <input id=\"contact-email\" name=\"email\" type=\"email\" autoComplete=\"email\" required value={values.email} aria-invalid={errors.email ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'contact-email-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('email', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.email ? <p id=\"contact-email-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.email}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-message\">Message</label>\n            <textarea id=\"contact-message\" name=\"message\" rows={5} required value={values.message} aria-invalid={errors.message ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.message ? 'contact-message-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('message', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.message ? <p id=\"contact-message-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.message}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <button type=\"submit\" className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-contact-submit\" aria-busy={state === 'busy'} disabled={state === 'busy'}>{state === 'busy' ? 'Preparing\u2026' : DATA.button}</button>\n          <p id=\"contact-form-note\" className=\"k-contact-note\" aria-live=\"polite\">{state === 'done' ? DATA.doneNote : DATA.note}</p>\n        </form>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Contact;\n",
      "src/components/Contact.css": ".k-contact .k-contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-intro { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); margin: var(--k-space-2) 0 0; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details dt { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-form { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); border-radius: calc(var(--k-radius-btn) / 2 + 2px); background-color: var(--k-surface); color: var(--k-ink); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field textarea { resize: vertical; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input:hover, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea:hover { border-color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input:focus-visible, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--k-accent-text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--k-accent-soft); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field [aria-invalid=\"true\"] { border-color: #B42318; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-error { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-error::before { content: \"!       "src/components/Footer.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Footer.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Larkspur Yoga\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Calm space for connection\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"classes\",\n      \"href\": \"#classes\",\n      \"label\": \"Classes\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"teachers\",\n      \"href\": \"#teachers\",\n      \"label\": \"Teachers\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"pricing\",\n      \"href\": \"#pricing\",\n      \"label\": \"Pricing\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"faq\",\n      \"href\": \"#faq\",\n      \"label\": \"FAQ\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"contact\",\n      \"href\": \"#contact\",\n      \"label\": \"Contact\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"email\": \"hello@larkspuryoga.co.uk\",\n  \"location\": \"Leeds\",\n  \"contactHref\": \"#contact\",\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Get in touch\"\n  },\n  \"privacy\": \"This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies.       "src/components/Hero.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Hero.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"headline\": \"Practice at Larkspur Yoga\",\n  \"lede\": \"Small studio in Leeds offering gentle yoga classes and a calm space to connect.\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Calm space for connection\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Hero\",\n  \"mark\": \"L\",\n  \"primary\": {\n    \"href\": \"#classes\",\n    \"label\": \"Explore Classes\"\n  },\n  \"secondary\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Contact Us\"\n  },\n  \"fact\": \"Based in Leeds\",\n  \"style\": \"fullbleed\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1599901860904-17e6ed7083a0?auto=format&fit=crop&w=2000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"A yoga class stretching together\",\n    \"w\": 2000,\n    \"h\": 1300\n  },\n  \"shader\": false,\n  \"window\": {\n    \"title\": \"Larkspur Yoga overview\",\n    \"labels\": [\n      \"Overview\",\n      \"Activity\",\n      \"Reports\"\n    ],\n    \"bars\": [\n      38,\n      52,\n      46,\n      64,\n      58,\n      72,\n      66,\n      84,\n      78,\n      90\n    ]\n  }\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction useMagnet<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const el = ref.current;\n    if (!el) return;\n    const fine = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (!fine || reduce) return;\n    const move = (event: PointerEvent) => {\n      if (event.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;\n      const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n      const x = ((event.clientX - box.left) / box.width - 0.5) * 16;\n      const y = ((event.clientY - box.top) / box.height - 0.5) * 12;\n      el.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + x.toFixed(1) + 'px, ' + y.toFixed(1) + 'px, 0)';\n    };\n    const leave = () => {\n      el.style.transform = '';\n    };\n    el.addEventListener('pointermove', move);\n    el.addEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    return () => {\n      el.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);\n      el.removeEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    };\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Hero() {\n  const magnetRef = useMagnet<HTMLAnchorElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"hero\" className=\"k-section k-hero k-hero--fullbleed\" aria-labelledby=\"hero-title\" data-section=\"hero\">\n      <div className=\"k-hero__bg\">\n        <Media img={DATA.img} priority={true} variant={1} className=\"k-hero__bgmedia\" />\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"k-hero__shade\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n      <div className=\"k-container k-hero__inner\">\n        <div className=\"k-hero__copy\">\n          {DATA.tagline ? <p className=\"k-eyebrow k-hero__eyebrow k-rise-2\">{DATA.tagline}</p> : null}\n          <h1 id=\"hero-title\" className=\"k-display k-hero__title\" data-motion=\"text-in\">{DATA.headline}</h1>\n          <p className=\"k-lede k-hero__lede k-rise-2\">{DATA.lede}</p>\n          <div className=\"k-actions k-rise-3\">\n            <a ref={magnetRef} className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary\" href={DATA.primary.href}>{DATA.primary.label}</a>\n            <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-hero__ghost\" href={DATA.secondary.href}>{DATA.secondary.label}</a>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.fact ? <p className=\"k-hero__fact k-rise-3\">{DATA.fact}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Hero;\n",

      "src/components/Classes.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport './Classes.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Classes\",\n  \"intro\": \"Explore our schedule of yoga classes tailored to your level and goals.\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Morning Flow\",\n      \"text\": \"Begin your day with a flowing sequence designed to awaken your body and mind.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Restorative Yoga\",\n      \"text\": \"Experience deep relaxation with supported poses and guided breathwork.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Yin Yoga\",\n      \"text\": \"Focus on holding poses for extended periods to release tension and improve flexibility.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"L\"\n};\n\nfunction useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const root = ref.current;\n    if (!root) return;\n    const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\"]'));\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (reduce || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {\n      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('is-visible'));\n      return;\n    }\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n          entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');\n          observer.unobserve(entry.target);\n        }\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.12 });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Classes() {\n  const revealRef = useReveal<HTMLElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"classes\" className=\"k-section k-classes\" aria-labelledby=\"classes-title\" data-section=\"classes\" ref={revealRef}>\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"classes-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-classes-list k-classes-list--grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className=\"k-classes-item\" key={i} data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\">\n              <span className=\"k-classes-index\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n              <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.title}</h3>\n              {item.text ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.text}</p> : null}\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Classes;\n",
      "src/components/Classes.css": ".k-classes .k-classes-list--grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px) clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px); }\n.k-classes .k-classes-list--grid .k-classes-item { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; padding-top: var(--k-space-3); border-top: 2px solid var(--k-ink); }\n.k-classes .k-classes-list--rows { display: grid; border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-classes .k-classes-list--rows .k-classes-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: var(--k-space-3) var(--k-space-6); align-items: baseline; padding-block: clamp(22px, 3vw, 36px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-classes .k-classes-index { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--k-accent-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-classes .k-classes-role { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-accent-text); }\n.k-classes .k-classes-item p { max-width: 52ch; }\n@media (max-width: 760px) {\n  .k-classes .k-classes-list--rows .k-classes-item { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--k-space-1); }\n}\n",
      "src/components/Teachers.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Teachers.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Teachers\",\n  \"intro\": \"Learn from experienced instructors\",\n  \"paragraphs\": [\n    \"Our teachers bring years of practice and teaching experience to the studio.\",\n    \"They focus on creating a safe and supportive environment for all students.\"\n  ],\n  \"bullets\": [\n    \"Qualified instructors\",\n    \"Personalized guidance\",\n    \"Community focused\"\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"L\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544367567-0f2fcb009e0b?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"A person holding a yoga pose\",\n    \"w\": 1000,\n    \"h\": 1250\n  }\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? 'k-text k-teachers-first' : 'k-text k-muted'}>{p}</p>\n          ))}\n          {DATA.bullets.length ? (\n            <ul className=\"k-teachers-list\">\n              {DATA.bullets.map((b: string, i: number) => <li key={i}>{b}</li>)}\n            </ul>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Teachers;\n",
      "src/components/Teachers.css": ".k-teachers .k-teachers-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(32px, 7vw, 112px); align-items: center; }\n.k-teachers .k-teachers-grid--right .k-teachers-visual { order: 2; }\n.k-teachers .k-teachers-media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; width: 100%; }\n.k-teachers .k-teachers-copy { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); justify-items: start; }\n.k-teachers .k-teachers-first { font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem); line-height: 1.55; }\n.k-teachers .k-teachers-list { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); margin-top: var(--k-space-1); }\n.k-teachers .k-teachers-list li { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: baseline; font-weight: 500; }\n.k-teachers .k-teachers-list li::before { content: \"\"; flex: 0 0 18px; height: 2px; transform: translateY(-4px); background-color: var(--k-accent); }\n@media (max-width: 860px) {\n  .k-teachers .k-teachers-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }\n  .k-teachers .k-teachers-grid--right .k-teachers-visual { order: 0; }\n  .k-teachers .k-teachers-media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }\n}\n",
      "src/components/Pricing.tsx": "import './Pricing.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Pricing\",\n  \"intro\": \"Classes are priced based on session length and teacher availability\",\n  \"tiers\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"1-3 words\",\n      \"description\": \"Single session classes for 1-3 words\",\n      \"features\": [\n        \"1-3 words\",\n        \"Teacher availability\",\n        \"Session length\"\n      ],\n      \"price\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"4-6 words\",\n      \"description\": \"Group classes for 4-6 words\",\n      \"features\": [\n        \"Group session\",\n        \"Teacher availability\",\n        \"Session length\"\n      ],\n      \"price\": \"\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"L\",\n  \"featured\": -1,\n  \"quoteHref\": \"#contact\"\n};\n\nexport function Pricing() {\n  return (\n    <section id=\"pricing\" className=\"k-section k-pricing\" aria-labelledby=\"pricing-title\" data-section=\"pricing\">\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"pricing-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-pricing-grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.tiers.map((tier: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className={'k-pricing-tier' + (DATA.featured === i ? ' k-pricing-tier--featured' : '')} key={i}>\n              <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{tier.name}</h3>\n              <p className=\"k-pricing-price\">{tier.price || 'Pricing on request'}</p>\n              {tier.description ? <p className=\"k-pricing-desc\">{tier.description}</p> : null}\n              {tier.features.length ? (\n                <ul className=\"k-pricing-features\">\n                  {tier.features.map((f: string, j: number) => <li key={j}>{f}</li>)}\n                </ul>\n              ) : null}\n              <a className={'k-btn ' + (DATA.featured === i ? 'k-btn--primary' : 'k-btn--ghost') + ' k-pricing-cta'} href={DATA.quoteHref}>Ask for a quote</a>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Pricing;\n",
      "src/components/Pricing.css": ".k-pricing .k-pricing-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 28px); align-items: stretch; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-tier { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--k-space-2); padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-tier--featured { background-color: var(--k-ink); color: var(--k-bg); border-color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-price { font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.2; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-desc { opacity: 0.86; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-features { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: var(--k-space-2); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-features li { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-features li::before { content: \"\"; flex: 0 0 12px; height: 2px; transform: translateY(-4px); background-color: var(--k-accent); }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-cta { margin-top: auto; align-self: flex-start; }\n.k-pricing .k-pricing-tier--featured .k-btn--ghost { color: var(--k-bg); }\n",
      "src/components/Faq.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Faq.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Frequently Asked Questions\",\n  \"intro\": \"Common questions about our classes and studio\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Are there different types of yoga classes?\",\n      \"a\": \"We offer vinyasa, hatha, yin, and restorative yoga classes.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"What should I bring to a class?\",\n      \"a\": \"A mat, water, and comfortable clothing are all you need.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Can I bring a friend to a class?\",\n      \"a\": \"Yes, we welcome friends and family to join classes together.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"FAQ\",\n  \"mark\": \"L\"\n};\n\nexport function Faq() {\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(0);\n  return (\n    <section id=\"faq\" className=\"k-section k-faq\" aria-labelledby=\"faq-title\" data-section=\"faq\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-faq-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-head\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"faq-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-faq-list\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <div className=\"k-faq-item\" key={i}>\n              <h3 className=\"k-faq-q\">\n                <button onClick={() => setOpen(open === i ? -1 : i)} type=\"button\" id={'faq-q-' + i} aria-expanded={open === i} aria-controls={'faq-a-' + i} className=\"k-faq-trigger\">\n                  <span>{item.q}</span>\n                  <span className=\"k-faq-icon\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                </button>\n              </h3>\n              <div id={'faq-a-' + i} role=\"region\" aria-labelledby={'faq-q-' + i} className=\"k-faq-answer\" hidden={open !== i}>\n                <p>{item.a}</p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Faq;\n",
      "src/components/Faq.css": ".k-faq .k-faq-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-list { border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-q { font-size: inherit; font-weight: inherit; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--k-space-3); min-height: 64px; padding: var(--k-space-2) 0; border: 0; background-color: transparent; color: var(--k-ink); font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-weight: var(--k-display-weight); font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.6vw, 1.375rem); line-height: 1.3; text-align: left; transition: color 160ms ease; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger:hover, .k-faq .k-faq-trigger:focus-visible { color: var(--k-accent-text); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon { position: relative; flex: 0 0 18px; height: 18px; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon::before, .k-faq .k-faq-icon::after { content: \"\"; position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 0; width: 18px; height: 2px; background-color: currentColor; transition: transform 220ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon::after { transform: rotate(90deg); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger[aria-expanded=\"true\"] .k-faq-icon::after { transform: rotate(0deg); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer { padding-bottom: var(--k-space-3); color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer p { max-width: 60ch; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer:not([hidden]) { animation: k-faq-open 260ms var(--k-ease); }\n@keyframes k-faq-open { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }\n@media (max-width: 860px) { .k-faq .k-faq-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }\n",
      "src/components/Contact.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport type { FormEvent as ReactFormEvent } from 'react';\nimport './Contact.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Get in touch\",\n  \"text\": \"Email us for more details or to book a class\",\n  \"button\": \"Hello@larkspuryoga.co.uk\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Contact\",\n  \"mark\": \"L\",\n  \"email\": \"hello@larkspuryoga.co.uk\",\n  \"location\": \"Leeds\",\n  \"note\": \"Sending opens your email app with the message ready to go.\",\n  \"doneNote\": \"Your email app should now open with the message ready to send.\"\n};\n\nexport function Contact() {\n  const [values, setValues] = useState({ name: '', email: '', message: '' });\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [state, setState] = useState('idle');\n  const update = (field: string, value: string) => setValues((current: any) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));\n  const submit = (event: ReactFormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    const next: Record<string, string> = {};\n    if (!values.name.trim()) next.name = 'Please add your name.';\n    if (!/^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/.test(values.email)) next.email = 'Please add a valid email address.';\n    if (values.message.trim().length < 10) next.message = 'Please write a short message of at least ten characters.';\n    setErrors(next);\n    if (Object.keys(next).length) return;\n    setState('busy');\n    window.setTimeout(() => {\n      if (DATA.email) {\n        const body = values.message + '\\n\\n' + values.name + ' (' + values.email + ')';\n        window.location.href = 'mailto:' + DATA.email + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(`Message from ${values.name}`) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(body);\n      }\n      setState('done');\n    }, 400);\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"contact\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-contact\" aria-labelledby=\"contact-title\" data-section=\"contact\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-contact-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-contact-intro\">\n          <h2 id=\"contact-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.text ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.text}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.email || DATA.location ? (\n            <dl className=\"k-contact-details\">\n              {DATA.email ? (\n                <div><dt>Email</dt><dd><a className=\"k-link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n              {DATA.location ? (\n                <div><dt>Location</dt><dd>{DATA.location}</dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n            </dl>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n        <form className=\"k-contact-form\" noValidate onSubmit={submit} aria-describedby=\"contact-form-note\">\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-name\">Name</label>\n            <input id=\"contact-name\" name=\"name\" type=\"text\" autoComplete=\"name\" required value={values.name} aria-invalid={errors.name ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.name ? 'contact-name-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('name', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.name ? <p id=\"contact-name-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.name}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-email\">Email</label>\n            <input id=\"contact-email\" name=\"email\" type=\"email\" autoComplete=\"email\" required value={values.email} aria-invalid={errors.email ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'contact-email-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('email', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.email ? <p id=\"contact-email-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.email}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-message\">Message</label>\n            <textarea id=\"contact-message\" name=\"message\" rows={5} required value={values.message} aria-invalid={errors.message ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.message ? 'contact-message-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('message', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.message ? <p id=\"contact-message-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.message}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <button type=\"submit\" className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-contact-submit\" aria-busy={state === 'busy'} disabled={state === 'busy'}>{state === 'busy' ? 'Preparing\u2026' : DATA.button}</button>\n          <p id=\"contact-form-note\" className=\"k-contact-note\" aria-live=\"polite\">{state === 'done' ? DATA.doneNote : DATA.note}</p>\n        </form>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Contact;\n",
      "src/components/Contact.css": ".k-contact .k-contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-intro { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); margin: var(--k-space-2) 0 0; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details dt { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-form { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); border-radius: calc(var(--k-radius-btn) / 2 + 2px); background-color: var(--k-surface); color: var(--k-ink); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field textarea { resize: vertical; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input:hover, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea:hover { border-color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input:focus-visible, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--k-accent-text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--k-accent-soft); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field [aria-invalid=\"true\"] { border-color: #B42318; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-error { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-error::before { content: \"! \"; color: #D92D20; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-submit { justify-self: start; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-note { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--k-muted); }\n@media (max-width: 860px) { .k-contact .k-contact-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }\n",
      "src/components/Footer.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Footer.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Larkspur Yoga\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Calm space for connection\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"classes\",\n      \"href\": \"#classes\",\n      \"label\": \"Classes\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"teachers\",\n      \"href\": \"#teachers\",\n      \"label\": \"Teachers\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"pricing\",\n      \"href\": \"#pricing\",\n      \"label\": \"Pricing\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"faq\",\n      \"href\": \"#faq\",\n      \"label\": \"FAQ\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"contact\",\n      \"href\": \"#contact\",\n      \"label\": \"Contact\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"email\": \"hello@larkspuryoga.co.uk\",\n  \"location\": \"Leeds\",\n  \"contactHref\": \"#contact\",\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Get in touch\"\n  },\n  \"privacy\": \"This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies. Fonts load from Google Fonts and photos from Unsplash, which receive your IP address to deliver them. If you write to us, your message is used only to reply.\"\n};\n\nexport function Footer() {\n  const [privacy, setPrivacy] = useState(false);\n  const year = new Date().getFullYear();\n  return (\n    <footer id=\"site-footer\" className=\"k-footer\" data-section=\"footer\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-footer__grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-footer__brand\">\n          <a className=\"k-footer__wordmark\" href=\"#site-main\">{DATA.brand}</a>\n          {DATA.tagline ? <p className=\"k-footer__tagline\">{DATA.tagline}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.cta ? <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-footer__cta\" href={DATA.cta.href}>{DATA.cta.label}</a> : null}\n        </div>\n        {DATA.links.length ? (\n          <nav className=\"k-footer__col\" aria-label=\"Footer\">\n            <p className=\"k-footer__label\">Explore</p>\n            <ul className=\"k-footer__links\">\n              {DATA.links.map((link: any) => (\n                <li key={link.id}><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={link.href}>{link.label}</a></li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          </nav>\n        ) : null}\n        <div className=\"k-footer__col\">\n          <p className=\"k-footer__label\">Contact</p>\n          <ul className=\"k-footer__links\">\n            {DATA.email ? <li><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></li> : null}\n            {DATA.location ? <li><span className=\"k-footer__plain\">{DATA.location}</span></li> : null}\n            {!DATA.email && DATA.contactHref ? <li><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={DATA.contactHref}>Send a message</a></li> : null}\n            {!DATA.email && !DATA.contactHref ? <li><span className=\"k-footer__plain\">Contact details coming from {DATA.brand} directly.</span></li> : null}\n          </ul>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"k-container k-footer__base\">\n        <p>\u00a9 {year} {DATA.brand}</p>\n        <div className=\"k-footer__base-links\">\n          <button onClick={() => setPrivacy(!privacy)} type=\"button\" className=\"k-footer__privacy-toggle\" aria-expanded={privacy} aria-controls=\"footer-privacy\">Privacy</button>\n          <a className=\"k-footer__link\" href=\"#site-main\">Back to top</a>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div id=\"footer-privacy\" className=\"k-container k-footer__privacy\" hidden={!privacy}>\n        <p>{DATA.privacy}</p>\n      </div>\n    </footer>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Footer;\n",
      "src/components/Footer.css": ".k-footer { padding-block: clamp(56px, 8vw, 96px) 32px; background-color: var(--k-surface); color: var(--k-ink); border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line); }\n.k-footer .k-footer__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--k-space-6); }\n.k-footer .k-footer__brand { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; justify-items: start; }\n.k-footer .k-footer__privacy p { max-width: 70ch; margin-top: var(--k-space-2); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--k-muted); }\n@media (max-width: 760px) { .k-footer .k-footer__grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }\n",
      "src/components/Home.tsx": "import React from 'react';\nimport './Home.css';\nexport function Home() {\n  return (\n    <main className=\"home\">\n      <section id=\"home\" className=\"hero\">\n        <h1>Practice at Larkspur Yoga</h1>\n        <p>CALM SPACE FOR CONNECTION</p>\n        <p>Small studio in Leeds offering...</p>\n        <a href=\"#contact\">Contact Us</a>\n        <p>Based in Leeds</p>\n      </section>\n    </main>\n  );\n}\nexport default Home;",
      "src/components/Home.css": ".home {\n  padding: 48px 6vw;\n  background: #faf6ee;\n  color: #26362c;\n}\n\n.home h1 {\n  font: clamp(32px, 6vw, 72px)/1.05 Georgia, serif;\n  margin: 0 0 20px;\n  color: #26362c;\n}\n\n.home p {\n  font: 16px/1.7 Arial, sans-serif;\n  max-width: 42rem;\n  color: #26362c;\n}\n\n.home a {\n  font: 16px/1.7 Arial, sans-serif;\n  max-width: 42rem;\n  color: #26362c;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  margin-top: 16px;\n}\n\n.home a:hover {\n  text-decoration: underline;\n}"

    "code": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Crumb & Co\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"menu\",\n      \"href\": \"#menu\",\n      \"label\": \"Menu\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"our-process\",\n      \"href\": \"#our-process\",\n      \"label\": \"Our process\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"the-team\",\n      \"href\": \"#the-team\",\n      \"label\": \"The team\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"faq\",\n      \"href\": \"#faq\",\n      \"label\": \"FAQ\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"visit-us\",\n      \"href\": \"#visit-us\",\n      \"label\": \"Visit us\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"#shop\",\n    \"label\": \"Shop now\"\n  },\n  \"store\": true,\n  \"email\": \"orders@crumbandco.co.uk\",\n  \"currency\": \"\u00a3\",\n  \"checkoutNote\": \"Checkout is handled by email for now: email orders@crumbandco.co.uk with your list and we'll confirm availability and payment.\"\n};\n\nfunction parsePrice(value: string): number {\n  const n = parseFloat(String(value || '').replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''));\n  return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;\n}\n\nfunction useCart() {\n  const [lines, setLines] = useState<any[]>([]);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onAdd = (event: Event) => {\n      const detail = (event as CustomEvent).detail || {};\n      if (!detail.name) return;\n      setLines((current: any[]) => {\n        if (current.some((line: any) => line.name === detail.name)) {\n          return current.map((line: any) => (line.name === detail.name ? { ...line, qty: line.qty + 1 } : line));\n        }\n        return [...current, { name: detail.name, price: detail.price || '', qty: 1 }];\n      });\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('kit-cart-add', onAdd);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('kit-cart-add', onAdd);\n  }, []);\n  const remove = (name: string) => setLines((current: any[]) => current.filter((line: any) => line.name !== name));\n  return { lines, remove };\n}\n\nfunction cartTotal(lines: any[]) {\n  return lines.reduce((sum: number, line: any) => sum + parsePrice(line.price) * line.qty, 0);\n}\n\nfunction orderBody(lines: any[], currency: string) {\n  return lines.map((line: any) => line.qty + ' x ' + line.name + (line.price ? ' (' + line.price + ')' : '')).join('\\n')\n    + (currency ? '\\n\\nTotal: ' + currency + cartTotal(lines).toFixed(2) : '');\n}\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [tucked, setTucked] = useState(false);\n  const [active, setActive] = useState('');\n  const [cartOpen, setCartOpen] = useState(false);\n  const toggleRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);\n  const cartButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);\n  const firstLinkRef = useRef<HTMLAnchorElement | null>(null);\n  const navigatedAt = useRef(0);\n  const cart = useCart();\n  const count = cart.lines.reduce((sum: number, line: any) => sum + line.qty, 0);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');\n    let last = window.scrollY;\n    let pending = 0;\n    const settle = () => {\n      pending = 0;\n      const y = window.scrollY;\n      if (Date.now() - navigatedAt.current < 1500) {\n        // An in-page link is scrolling the page; keep the navigation in view.\n        setTucked(false);\n        last = y;\n        return;\n      }\n      if (y > last + 4 && y > 120 && !reduce.matches) setTucked(true);\n      else if (y < last - 4 || y <= 120) setTucked(false);\n      last = y;\n    };\n    const onScroll = () => {\n      if (!pending) pending = window.setTimeout(settle, 80);\n    };\n    const onAnchor = (event: MouseEvent) => {\n      const target = event.target as Element | null;\n      if (target && target.closest && target.closest('a[href^=\"#\"]')) navigatedAt.current = Date.now();\n    };\n    const onHash = () => {\n      navigatedAt.current = Date.now();\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });\n    document.addEventListener('click', onAnchor, true);\n    window.addEventListener('hashchange', onHash);\n    return () => {\n      window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n      document.removeEventListener('click', onAnchor, true);\n      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onHash);\n      if (pending) window.clearTimeout(pending);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;\n    const targets = DATA.links\n      .map((link: any) => document.getElementById(link.id))\n      .filter((el: HTMLElement | null) => Boolean(el)) as HTMLElement[];\n    if (!targets.length) return;\n    const observer = new targets.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!open && !cartOpen) return;\n    const previous = document.body.style.overflow;\n    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';\n    if (open) firstLinkRef.current?.focus();\n    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {\n      if (event.key !== cartButtonRef.current?.focus();\n      }\n    };\n    const desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 900px)');\n    const onWide = () => {\n      if (desktop.matches) setOpen(false);\n    };\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n    desktop.addEventListener('change', onWide);\n    return () => {\n      document.body.style.overflow = previous;\n      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n      desktop.removeEventListener('change', onWide);\n    };\n  }, [open, cartOpen]);\n\n  const closeMenu = () => {\n    setOpen(false);\n    toggleRef.current?.focus();\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      <header id=\"header\" className={'k-header' + (tucked && !open && !cartOpen ? {\n      pending = 0;\n      const y = window.scrollY;\n      if (Date.now() - navigatedAt.current < 1500) {\n        // An in-page link is scrolling the page; keep the navigation in view.\n        setTucked(false);\n        last = y;\n        return;\n      }\n      if (y > last + 4 && y > 120 && !reduce.matches) setTucked(true);\n      else if (y < last - 4 || y <= 120) setTucked(false);\n   return () => {\n      window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n      document.removeEventListener('click', onAnchor, true);\n      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', onHash);\n      if cartButtonRef.current?.focus();\n      }\n    };\n    const desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 900px)');\n    const onWide = () => {\n      if (desktop.matches) setOpen(false);\n    };\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n    desktop.addEventListener('change', onWide);\n    return () => {\n      document.body.style.overflow = previous;\n      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n      desktop.removeEventListener('change', onWide);\n    };\n  }, [open, cartOpen]);\n\n  const closeMenu = () => {\n    setOpen(false);\n    toggleRef.current?.focus();\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      <header id=\"header\" className={'k-header' + (tucked && !open && !cartOpen ? \"items\": [\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Sourdough Loaf\",\n          \"description\": \"A fresh, crusty loaf made with natural yeast.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function Menu() {\n  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);\n  const tabsRef = useRef<Array<HTMLButtonElement | null>>([]);\n  const select = (index: number, focus: boolean) => {\n    const count = DATA.categories.length;\n    const next = (index + count) % count;\n    const apply = () => setActive(next);\n    const doc: any = document;\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (doc.startViewTransition && !reduce) {\n      doc.startViewTransition(() => flushSync(apply));\n    } else {\n      apply();\n    }\n    if (focus) tabsRef.current[next]?.focus();\n  };\n  const onKey = (event: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, index: number) => {\n    const last = DATA.categories.length - 1;\n    const moves: Record<string, number> = { ArrowRight: index + 1, ArrowLeft: index - 1, Home: 0, End: last };\n    if (event.key in moves) {\n      event.preventDefault();\n      select(moves[event.key], true);\n    }\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"menu\" className=\"k-section k-menu\" aria-labelledby=\"menu-title\" data-section=\"menu\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-menu-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-menu-intro\">\n          <h2 id=\"menu-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.intro ?       "src/components/Menu.css": ".k-menu .k-menu-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.85fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-menu .k-menu-intro { display: grid; }\n::view-transition-old(k-panel-menu), ::view-transition-new(k-panel-menu) { animation-duration: 240ms; }\n@media (max-width: 860px) {\n  .k-menu .k-menu-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }\n  .k-menu .k-menu-intro { position: static; }\n}\n",
      "src/components/Shop.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Shop.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Shop\",\n  \"intro\": \"Find our best-selling items\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Sourdough loaf\",\n      \"description\": \"\u00a36 | A fresh, golden loaf with a tangy, crusty exterior\",\n      \"price\": \"\u00a36\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1486427944299-d1955d23e34d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"A cake on a stand\",\n        \"w\": 900,\n        \"h\": 1125\n      },\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:orders@crumbandco.co.uk?subject=Question%20about%20Sourdough%20loaf\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Cardamom bun\",\n      \"description\": \"\u00a33.50 | A sweet, spiced bun with a soft, fluffy interior\",\n      \"price\": \"\u00a33.50\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1509440159596-0249088772ff?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"Loaves of crusty bread\",\n        \"w\": 900,\n        \"h\": 1125\n      },\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:orders@crumbandco.co.uk?subject=Question%20about%20Cardamom%20bun\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"House coffee beans\",\n      \"description\": \"\u00a39 | Roasted in-house for a rich, bold coffee experience\",\n      \"price\": \"\u00a39\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1495474472287-4d71bcdd2085?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"A cup of coffee on a wooden table\",\n        \"w\": 900,\n        \"h\": 1125\n      },\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:orders@crumbandco.co.uk?subject=Question%20about%20House%20coffee%20beans\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\"\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function Shop() {\n  const [added, setAdded] = useState('');\n  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');\n  const add = (item: any) => {\n    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kit-cart-add', { detail: { name: item.name, price: item.price || '' } }));\n    setAdded(item.name);\n    setStatus(item.name + ' added to cart.');\n    window.setTimeout(() => setAdded(''), 1600);\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"shop\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-shop\" aria-labelledby=\"shop-title\" data-section=\"shop\">\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"shop-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-shop-grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className=\"k-shop-card\" key={i} data-product={item.name}>\n              <div className=\"k-shop-reveal\">\n                <Media img={item.img} variant={(i % 3) + 1} mark={item.name.charAt(0)} className=\"k-shop-media k-settle\" />\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"k-shop-body\">\n                <div className=\"k-shop-row\">\n                  <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.name}</h3>\n                  {item.price ? <p className=\"k-shop-price\">{item.price}</p> : null}\n                </div>\n                {item.description ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.description}</p> : null}\n                <button onClick={() => add(item)} type=\"button\" className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-shop-add\" aria-label={'Add ' + item.name + ' to cart'}>{added === item.name ? 'Added' : 'Add to cart'}</button>\n              </div>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n        <p className=\"k-sr\" aria-live=\"polite\">{status}</p>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Shop;\n",
      "src/components/Shop.css": ".k-shop .k-shop-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px) clamp(20px, 3vw, 32px); }\n.k-shop .k-shop-card { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-body { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); justify-items: start; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--k-space-2); width: 100%; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-price { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-add { margin-top: var(--k-space-1); min-height: var(--k-tap); }\n.k-shop .k-shop-ask { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--k-tap); font-weight: 600; }\n",
      "src/components/OurProcess.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './OurProcess.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Our Process\",\n  \"intro\": \"From grain to cup, we craft with care.\",\n  \"steps\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Fresh ingredients\",\n      \"text\": \"We source local, seasonal ingredients to ensure quality and freshness in every product.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Handmade bread\",\n      \"text\": \"Our sourdough and other breads are made using traditional methods and natural fermentation.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Roasted beans\",\n      \"text\": \"Our coffee beans are roasted in small batches to bring out their full flavor and aroma.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Customer focus\",\n      \"text\": \"We prioritize customer satisfaction by offering a warm, welcoming environment and expertly made drinks.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1558961363-fa8fdf82db35?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"Freshly baked cookies\",\n    \"w\": 1000,\n    \"h\": 1250\n  }\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function OurProcess() {\n  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);\n  const listRef = useRef<HTMLOListElement | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const list = listRef.current;\n    if (!list || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;\n    const items = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-step]'));\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) setCurrent(Number((entry.target as HTMLElement).dataset.step || 0));\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -45% 0px' });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  const total = DATA.steps.length;\n  const progress = total > 1 ? current / (total - 1) : 1;\n  return (\n    <section id=\"our-process\" className=\"k-section k-our-process\" aria-labelledby=\"our-process-title\" data-section=\"our-process\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-our-process-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-our-process-pin\" data-motion=\"sticky-story\">\n          <div className=\"k-our-process-visual\">\n            <Media img={DATA.img} variant={3} mark={DATA.mark} className=\"k-our-process-media\" />\n            <div className=\"k-our-process-meter\">\n              <p className=\"k-our-process-counter\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                <span className=\"k-our-process-now\">{String(current + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span> / {String(total).padStart(2, '0')}\n              </p>\n              <svg className=\"k-our-process-line\" viewBox=\"0 0 100 4\" preserveAspectRatio=\"none\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                <line x1=\"0\" y1=\"2\" x2=\"100\" y2=\"2\" pathLength={1} className=\"k-our-process-track\" />\n                <line x1=\"0\" y1=\"2\" x2=\"100\" y2=\"2\" pathLength={1} className=\"k-our-process-fill\" style={{ strokeDashoffset: 1 - progress }} />\n              </svg>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-our-process-copy\">\n          <div className=\"k-head\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"our-process-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n          <ol className=\"k-our-process-list\" ref={listRef}>\n            {DATA.steps.map((step: any, i: number) => (\n              <li key={i} data-step={i} className=\"k-our-process-step\" aria-current={current === i ? 'step' : undefined}>\n                <span className=\"k-our-process-num\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n                <div className=\"k-our-process-text\">\n                  <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{step.title}</h3>\n                  {step.text ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{step.text}</p> : null}\n                </div>\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ol>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default OurProcess;\n",
      "src/components/OurProcess.css": ".k-our-process .k-our-process-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-pin { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--k-header-h) + 32px); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-visual { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; max-height: 70vh; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-meter { display: grid; gap: 10px; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-counter { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--k-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-now { color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-line { width: 100%; height: 4px; overflow: visible; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-track, .k-our-process .k-our-process-fill { stroke-width: 4; fill: none; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-track { stroke: var(--k-line); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-fill { stroke: var(--k-accent); stroke-dasharray: 1; transition: stroke-dashoffset 420ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-list { display: grid; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--k-space-2); min-height: 38vh; padding-block: var(--k-space-4); border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line); opacity: 0.42; transition: opacity 300ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-step[aria-current=\"step\"] { opacity: 1; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-num { font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--k-accent-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-text { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); align-content: start; }\n@media (max-width: 860px) {\n  .k-our-process .k-our-process-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }\n  .k-our-process .k-our-process-pin { position: static; }\n  .k-our-process .k-our-process-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; }\n  .k-our-process .k-our-process-step { min-height: 0; opacity: 1; }\n}\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .k-our-process .k-our-process-step { opacity: 1; } }\n",
      "src/components/TheTeam.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport './TheTeam.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"The Team\",\n  \"intro\": \"Meet the people who make every bite and cup special.\",\n  \"members\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"\",\n      \"role\": \"Baker and Owner\",\n      \"text\": \"Sarah has been crafting bread since she was 16.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"\",\n      \"role\": \"Barista and Coffee Specialist\",\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"\",\n      \"role\": \"Shop Assistant and Pastry Chef\",\n      \"text\": \"Lena has been making pastries since she moved to Bristol.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\"\n};\n\nfunction useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const root = ref.current;\n    if (!root) return;\n    const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\"]'));\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (reduce || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {\n      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('is-visible'));\n      return;\n    }\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n          entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');\n          observer.unobserve(entry.target);\n        }\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.12 });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function TheTeam() {\n  const revealRef = useReveal<HTMLElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"the-team\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-the-team\" aria-labelledby=\"the-team-title\" data-section=\"the-team\" ref={revealRef}>\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"the-team-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-the-team-list k-the-team-list--grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.members.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className=\"k-the-team-item\" key={i} data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\">\n              <span className=\"k-the-team-index\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n              <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.name || item.role || item.title}</h3>\n              {item.name && item.role ? <p className=\"k-the-team-role\">{item.role}</p> : null}\n              {item.text ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.text}</p> : null}\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default TheTeam;\n",
      "src/components/TheTeam.css": ".k-the-team .k-the-team-list--grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px) clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px); }\n.k-the-team .k-the-team-list--grid .k-the-team-item { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; padding-top: var(--k-space-3); border-top: 2px solid var(--k-ink); }\n.k-the-team .k-the-team-list--rows { display: grid; border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-the-team .k-the-team-list--rows .k-the-team-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: var(--k-space-3) var(--k-space-6); align-items: baseline; padding-block: clamp(22px, 3vw, 36px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-the-team .k-the-team-index { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--k-accent-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-the-team .k-the-team-role { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-accent-text); }\n.k-the-team .k-the-team-item p { max-width: 52ch; }\n@media (max-width: 760px) {\n  .k-the-team .k-the-team-list--rows .k-the-team-item { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--k-space-1); }\n}\n",
      "src/components/Faq.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Faq.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Frequently Asked Questions\",\n  \"intro\": \"Here are answers to common questions about our bakery and coffee shop.\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Do you offer online ordering?\",\n      \"a\": \"We do not have an online checkout, but you can add items to your cart and confirm orders by email at orders@crumbandco.co.uk.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Can I bring my own cup?\",\n      \"a\": \"Yes, we have a reusable cup area where you can bring your own container.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Do you have any dietary restrictions?\",\n      \"a\": \"We offer a range of options, and our staff can accommodate most dietary needs upon request.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"FAQ\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\"\n};\n\nexport function Faq() {\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(0);\n  return (\n    <section id=\"faq\" className=\"k-section k-faq\" aria-labelledby=\"faq-title\" data-section=\"faq\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-faq-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-head\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"faq-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-faq-list\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <div className=\"k-faq-item\" key={i}>\n              <h3 className=\"k-faq-q\">\n                <button onClick={() => setOpen(open === i ? -1 : i)} type=\"button\" id={'faq-q-' + i} aria-expanded={open === i} aria-controls={'faq-a-' + i} className=\"k-faq-trigger\">\n                  <span>{item.q}</span>\n                  <span className=\"k-faq-icon\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                </button>\n              </h3>\n              <div id={'faq-a-' + i} role=\"region\" aria-labelledby={'faq-q-' + i} className=\"k-faq-answer\" hidden={open !== i}>\n                <p>{item.a}</p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Faq;\n",
      "src/components/Faq.css": ".k-faq .k-faq-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-list { border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-q { font-size: inherit; font-weight: inherit; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--k-space-3); min-height: 64px; padding: var(--k-space-2) 0; border: 0; background-color: transparent; color: var(--k-ink); font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-weight: var(--k-display-weight); font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.6vw, 1.375rem); line-height: 1.3; text-align: left; transition: color 160ms ease; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger:hover, .k-faq .k-faq-trigger:focus-visible { color: var(--k-accent-text); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon { position: relative; flex: 0 0 18px; height: 18px; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon::before, .k-faq .k-faq-icon::after { content: \"\"; position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 0; width: 18px; height: 2px; background-color: currentColor; transition: transform 220ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon::after { transform: rotate(90deg); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger[aria-expanded=\"true\"] .k-faq-icon::after { transform: rotate(0deg); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer { padding-bottom: var(--k-space-3); color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer p { max-width: 60ch; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer:not([hidden]) { animation: k-faq-open 260ms var(--k-ease); }\n@keyframes k-faq-open { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }\n@media (max-width: 860px) { .k-faq .k-faq-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }\n",
      "src/components/VisitUs.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport type { FormEvent as ReactFormEvent } from 'react';\nimport './VisitUs.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Visit us\",\n  \"text\": \"Find us in the heart of Bristol. Come in, see our bread, try our coffee, and enjoy the warmth of the shop.\",\n  \"button\": \"Come in\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\",\n  \"email\": \"orders@crumbandco.co.uk\",\n  \"location\": \"Bristol\",\n  \"note\": \"Sending opens your email app with the message ready to go.\",\n  \"doneNote\": \"Your email app should now open with the message ready to send.\"\n};\n\nexport function VisitUs() {\n  const [values, setValues] = useState({ name: '', email: '', message: '' });\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [state, setState] = useState('idle');\n  const update = (field: string, value: string) => setValues((current: any) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));\n  const submit = (event: ReactFormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    const next: Record<string, string> = {};\n    if (!values.name.trim()) next.name = 'Please add your name.';\n    if (!/^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/.test(values.email)) next.email = 'Please add a valid email address.';\n    if (values.message.trim().length < 10) next.message = 'Please write a short message of at least ten characters.';\n    setErrors(next);\n    if (Object.keys(next).length) return;\n    setState('busy');\n    window.setTimeout(() => {\n      if (DATA.email) {\n        const body = values.message + '\\n\\n' + values.name + ' (' + values.email + ')';\n        window.location.href = 'mailto:' + DATA.email + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(`Message from ${values.name}`) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(body);\n      }\n      setState('done');\n    }, 400);\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"visit-us\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-visit-us\" aria-labelledby=\"visit-us-title\" data-section=\"visit-us\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-visit-us-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-visit-us-intro\">\n          <h2 id=\"visit-us-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.text ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.text}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.email || DATA.location ? (\n            <dl className=\"k-visit-us-details\">\n              {DATA.email ? (\n                <div><dt>Email</dt><dd><a className=\"k-link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n              {DATA.location ?
