      "src/components/VisitUs.css": ".k-visit-us .k-visit-us-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-intro { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-details { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); margin: var(--k-space-2) 0 0; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-details dt { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-details dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-form { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field input, .k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); border-radius: calc(var(--k-radius-btn) / 2 + 2px); background-color: var(--k-surface); color: var(--k-ink); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field textarea { resize: vertical; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field input:hover, .k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field textarea:hover { border-color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field input:focus-visible, .k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--k-accent-text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--k-accent-soft); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field [aria-invalid=\"true\"] { border-color: #B42318; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-error { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-error::before { content: \"! \"; color: #D92D20; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-submit { justify-self: start; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-note { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--k-muted); }\n@media (max-width: 860px) { .k-visit-us .k-visit-us-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }\n",
      "src/components/Footer.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Footer.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Crumb & Co\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Bread. Coffee. Bristol\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"menu\",\n      \"href\": \"#menu\",\n      \"label\": \"Menu\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"shop\",\n      \"href\": \"#shop\",\n      \"label\": \"Shop\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"our-process\",\n      \"href\": \"#our-process\",\n      \"label\": \"Our process\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"the-team\",\n      \"href\": \"#the-team\",\n      \"label\": \"The team\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"faq\",\n      \"href\": \"#faq\",\n      \"label\": \"FAQ\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"visit-us\",\n      \"href\": \"#visit-us\",\n      \"label\": \"Visit us\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"email\": \"orders@crumbandco.co.uk\",\n  \"location\": \"Bristol\",\n  \"contactHref\": \"#visit-us\",\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"#visit-us\",\n    \"label\": \"Get in touch\"\n  },\n  \"privacy\": \"This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies. Fonts load from Google Fonts and photos from Unsplash, which receive your IP address to deliver them. If you write to us, your message is used only to reply.\"\n};\n\nexport function Footer() {\n  const [privacy, setPrivacy] = useState(false);\n  const year = new Date().getFullYear();\n  return (\n    <footer id=\"site-footer\" className=\"k-footer\" data-section=\"footer\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-footer__grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-footer__brand\">\n          <a className=\"k-footer__wordmark\" href=\"#site-main\">{DATA.brand}</a>\n          {DATA.tagline ? <p className=\"k-footer__tagline\">{DATA.tagline}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.cta ? <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-footer__cta\" href={DATA.cta.href}>{DATA.cta.label}</a> : null}\n        </div>\n        {DATA.links.length ? (\n          <nav className=\"k-footer__col\" aria-label=\"Footer\">\n            <p className=\"k-footer__label\">Explore</p>\n            <ul className=\"k-footer__links\">\n              {DATA.links.map((link: any) => (\n                <li key={link.id}><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={link.href}>{link.label}</a></li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          </nav>\n        ) : null}\n        <div className=\"k-footer__col\">\n          <p className=\"k-footer__label\">Contact</p>\n          <ul className=\"k-footer__links\">\n            {DATA.email ? <li><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></li> : null}\n            {DATA.location ? <li><span className=\"k-footer__plain\">{DATA.location}</span></li> : null}\n            {!DATA.email && DATA.contactHref ? <li><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={DATA.contactHref}>Send a message</a></li> : null}\n            {!DATA.email && !DATA.contactHref ? <li><span className=\"k-footer__plain\">Contact details coming from {DATA.brand} directly.</span></li> : null}\n          </ul>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"k-container k-footer__base\">\n        <p>\u00a9 {year} {DATA.brand}</p>\n        <div className=\"k-footer__base-links\">\n          <button onClick={() => setPrivacy(!privacy)} type=\"button\" className=\"k-footer__privacy-toggle\" aria-expanded={privacy} aria-controls=\"footer-privacy\">Privacy</button>\n          <a className=\"k-footer__link\" href=\"#site-main\">Back to top</a>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div id=\"footer-privacy\" className=\"k-container k-footer__privacy\" hidden={!privacy}>\n        <p>{DATA.privacy}</p>\n      </div>\n    </footer>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Footer;\n",

gl.viewport(0, 0, width, height);\n      }\n    };\n    const draw = () => {\n      resize();\n      gl.uniform2f(uR, canvas.width, canvas.height);\n      gl.uniform1f(uT, reduce ? 0 : }\n.k-hero .k-window__nav.is-active { background-color: var(--k-accent-soft); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-hero .k-window__main { display: grid; gap: 18px; padding: 20px; align-content: start; }\n.k-hero .k-window__title { font-weight: 600;       "src/components/Menu.tsx": "import { useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport type { KeyboardEvent as ReactKeyboardEvent } from 'react';\nimport { flushSync } from 'react-dom';\nimport './Menu.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"What We Bake\",\n  \"intro\": \"Find our best breads, pastries and coffee.\",\n  \"categories\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Breads\",\n      \"items\": [\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Sourdough Loaf\",\n          \"description\": \"A fresh, golden sourdough loaf with a crisp crust.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Cardamom Bun\",\n          \"description\": \"A soft, spiced bun with a warm, aromatic flavor.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Whole Wheat Bread\",\n          \"description\": \"A simple, wholesome bread with a nutty aroma.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        }\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Pastries\",\n      \"items\": [\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Croissant\",\n          \"description\": \"A flaky, buttery croissant with a golden crust.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Blueberry Muffin\",\n          \"description\": \"A moist, fluffy muffin with fresh blueberries.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Apple Strudel\",\n          \"description\": \"A delicate, flaky strudel with a sweet apple filling.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        }\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Coffee\",\n      \"items\": [\n        {\n          \"name\": \"House Coffee Beans\",\n          \"description\": \"A premium blend roasted in-house for a rich, bold cup.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Espresso\",\n          \"description\": \"A strong, velvety espresso with a rich, full flavor.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Latte\",\n          \"description\": \"A creamy latte with a smooth, velvety texture.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        }\n      ]\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Menu\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555507036-ab1f4038808a?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"Fresh croissants on a tray\",\n    \"w\": 1000,\n    \"h\": 1250\n  },\n  \"empty\": \"Ask Crumb & Co for today's menu.\",\n  \"askToday\": \"Ask us what's on today \u2014 write to orders@crumbandco.co.uk.\"\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function Menu() {\n  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);\n  const tabsRef = useRef<Array<HTMLButtonElement | null>>([]);\n  const select = (index: number, focus: boolean) => {\n    const count = DATA.categories.length;\n    const next = (index + count) % count;\n    const apply = () => setActive(next);\n    const doc: any = document;\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (doc.startViewTransition && !reduce) {\n      doc.startViewTransition(() => flushSync(apply));\n    } else {\n      apply();\n    }\n    if (focus) tabsRef.current[next]?.focus();\n  };\n  const onKey = (event: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, index: number) => {\n    const last = DATA.categories.length - 1;\n    const moves: Record<string, number> = { ArrowRight: index + 1, ArrowLeft: index - 1, Home: 0, End: last };\n    if (event.key in moves) {\n      event.preventDefault();\n      select(moves[event.key], true);\n    }\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"menu\" className=\"k-section k-menu\" aria-labelledby=\"menu-title\" data-section=\"menu\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-menu-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-menu-intro\">\n          <h2 id=\"menu-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n          <Media img={DATA.img} variant={3} mark={DATA.mark} className=\"k-menu-media k-settle\" />\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-menu-board\">\n          <div className=\"k-menu-tabs\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label={DATA.title}>\n            {DATA.categories.map((cat: any, i: number) => (\n              <button onClick={() => select(i, false)} onKeyDown={(event: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => onKey(event, i)} ref={(el: HTMLButtonElement | null) => { tabsRef.current[i] = el; }} key={i} type=\"button\" role=\"tab\" id={'menu-tab-' + i} aria-selected={active === i} aria-controls=\"menu-panel\" tabIndex={active === i ? 0 : -1} className=\"k-menu-tab\">{cat.name}</button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n          <div id=\"menu-panel\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby={'menu-tab-' + active} className=\"k-menu-panel\" tabIndex={0}>\n            {DATA.categories[active].items.length ? (\n            <ul className=\"k-menu-dishes\">\n              {DATA.categories[active].items.map((dish: any, i: number) => (\n                <li className=\"k-menu-dish\" key={i}>\n                  <div className=\"k-menu-dishrow\">\n                    <h3 className=\"k-menu-dishname\">{dish.name}</h3>\n                    {dish.price ? <span className=\"k-menu-leader\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> : null}\n                    {dish.price ? <span className=\"k-menu-price\">{dish.price}</span> : null}\n                  </div>\n                  {dish.description ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{dish.description}</p> : null}\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n            ) : (\n              <p className=\"k-lede k-menu-empty\">{DATA.askToday}</p>\n            )}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Menu;\n",
      "src/components/Menu.css": ".k-menu .k-menu-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.85fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-menu .k-menu-intro { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); position: sticky; top: calc(var(--k-header-h) + 24px); }\n.k-menu .k-menu-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; margin-top: var(--k-space-2); }\n.k-menu .k-menu-tabs { display: flex; }\n  .k-menu .k-menu-intro { position: static; }\n}\n",
      "src/components/Shop.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Shop.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Shop\",\n  \"intro\": \"Find our most loved items\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Sourdough loaf\",\n      \"description\": \"\u00a36 | A perfect daily staple\",\n      \"price\": \"\u00a36\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1486427944299-d1955d23e34d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"A cake on a stand\",\n        \"w\": 900,\n        \"h\": 1125\n      },\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:orders@crumbandco.co.uk?subject=Question%20about%20Sourdough%20loaf\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Cardamom bun\",\n      \"description\": \"\u00a33.50 | A sweet treat for any time\",\n      \"price\": \"\u00a33.50\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1509440159596-0249088772ff?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"Loaves of crusty bread\",\n        \"w\": 900,\n        \"h\": 1125\n      },\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:orders@crumbandco.co.uk?subject=Question%20about%20Cardamom%20bun\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"House coffee beans\",\n      \"description\": \"\u00a39 | Freshly roasted and ground\",\n      \"price\": \"\u00a39\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1495474472287-4d71bcdd2085?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"A cup of coffee on a wooden table\",\n        \"w\": 900,\n        \"h\": 1125\n      },\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:orders@crumbandco.co.uk?subject=Question%20about%20House%20coffee%20beans\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\"\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function Shop() {\n  const [added, setAdded] = useState('');\n  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');\n  const add = (item: any) => {\n    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kit-cart-add', { detail: { name: item.name, price: item.price || '' } }));\n    setAdded(item.name);\n    setStatus(item.name + ' added to cart.');\n    window.setTimeout(() => setAdded(''), 1600);\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"shop\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-shop\" aria-labelledby=\"shop-title\" data-section=\"shop\">\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"shop-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-shop-grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className=\"k-shop-card\" key={i} data-product={item.name}>\n              <div className=\"k-shop-reveal\">\n                <Media img={item.img} variant={(i % 3) + 1} mark={item.name.charAt(0)} className=\"k-shop-media k-settle\" />\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"k-shop-body\">\n                <div className=\"k-shop-row\">\n                  <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.name}</h3>\n                  {item.price ? <p className=\"k-shop-price\">{item.price}</p> : null}\n                </div>\n                {item.description ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.description}</p> : null}\n                <button onClick={() => add(item)} type=\"button\" className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-shop-add\" aria-label={'Add ' + item.name + ' to cart'}>{added === item.name ? 'Added' : 'Add to cart'}</button>\n              </div>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n        <p className=\"k-sr\" aria-live=\"polite\">{status}</p>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Shop;\n",
      "src/components/Shop.css": ".k-shop .k-shop-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px) clamp(20px, 3vw, 32px); }\n.k-shop .k-shop-card { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-body { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); justify-items: start; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--k-space-2); width: 100%; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-price { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-add { margin-top: var(--k-space-1); min-height: var(--k-tap); }\n.k-shop .k-shop-ask { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--k-tap); font-weight: 600; }\n",
      "src/components/OurProcess.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './OurProcess.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Our Process\",\n  \"intro\": \"Crafting each item with care and precision.\",\n  \"steps\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Start with dough\",\n      \"text\": \"Sourdough is fermented for days, ensuring a rich, tangy flavor.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Shape and bake\",\n      \"text\": \"Buns and loaves are shaped by hand and baked to perfection.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Roast beans\",\n      \"text\": \"Coffee beans are roasted fresh to bring out their full flavor.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Serve with care\",\n      \"text\": \"Each item is prepared and served with attention to detail.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1558961363-fa8fdf82db35?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"Freshly baked cookies\",\n    \"w\": 1000,\n    \"h\": 1250\n  }\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function OurProcess() {\n  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);\n  const listRef = useRef<HTMLOListElement | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const list = listRef.current;\n    if (!list || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;\n    const items = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-step]'));\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) setCurrent(Number((entry.target as HTMLElement).dataset.step || 0));\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -45% 0px' });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  const total = DATA.steps.length;\n  const progress = total > 1 ? current / (total - 1) : 1;\n  return (\n    <section id=\"our-process\" className=\"k-section k-our-process\" aria-labelledby=\"our-process-title\" data-section=\"our-process\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-our-process-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-our-process-pin\" data-motion=\"sticky-story\">\n          <div className=\"k-our-process-visual\">\n            <Media img={DATA.img} variant={3} mark={DATA.mark} className=\"k-our-process-media\" />\n            <div className=\"k-our-process-meter\">\n              <p className=\"k-our-process-counter\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                <span className=\"k-our-process-now\">{String(current + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span> / {String(total).padStart(2, '0')}\n              </p>\n              <svg className=\"k-our-process-line\" viewBox=\"0 0 100 4\" preserveAspectRatio=\"none\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                <line x1=\"0\" y1=\"2\" x2=\"100\" y2=\"2\" pathLength={1} className=\"k-our-process-track\" />\n                <line x1=\"0\" y1=\"2\" x2=\"100\" y2=\"2\" pathLength={1} className=\"k-our-process-fill\" style={{ strokeDashoffset: 1 - progress }} />\n              </svg>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-our-process-copy\">\n          <div className=\"k-head\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"our-process-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n          <ol className=\"k-our-process-list\" ref={listRef}>\n            {DATA.steps.map((step: any, i: number) => (\n              <li key={i} data-step={i} className=\"k-our-process-step\" aria-current={current === i ? 'step' : undefined}>\n                <span className=\"k-our-process-num\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n                <div className=\"k-our-process-text\">\n                  <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{step.title}</h3>\n                  {step.text ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{step.text}</p> : null}\n                </div>\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ol>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default OurProcess;\n",
      "src/components/OurProcess.css": ".k-our-process .k-our-process-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-pin { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--k-header-h) + 32px); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-visual { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; max-height: 70vh; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-meter { display: grid; gap: 10px; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-counter { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--k-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-now { color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-line { width: 100%; height: 4px; overflow: visible; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-track, .k-our-process .k-our-process-fill { stroke-width: 4; fill: none; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-track { stroke: var(--k-line); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-fill { stroke: var(--k-accent); stroke-dasharray: 1; transition: stroke-dashoffset 420ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-list { display: grid; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--k-space-2); min-height: 38vh; padding-block: var(--k-space-4); border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line); opacity: 0.42; transition: opacity 300ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-step[aria-current=\"step\"] { opacity: 1; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-num { font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--k-accent-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-text { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); align-content: start; }\n@media (max-width: 860px) {\n  .k-our-process .k-our-process-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }\n  .k-our-process .k-our-process-pin { position: static; }\n  .k-our-process .k-our-process-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; }\n  .k-our-process .k-our-process-step { min-height: 0; opacity: 1; }\n}\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .k-our-process .k-our-process-step { opacity: 1;       "src/components/TheTeam.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport './TheTeam.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"The Team\",\n  \"intro\": \"Meet the people who make \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\"\n};\n\nfunction useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const root = ref.current;\n    if (!root) return;\n    const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\"]'));\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (reduce || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {\n      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('is-visible'));\n      return;\n    }\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n          entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');\n          observer.unobserve(entry.target);\n        }\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.12 });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function TheTeam()     </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default TheTeam;\n",

      "src/components/Faq.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Faq.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Frequently Asked Questions\",\n  \"intro\": \"Here are answers to common questions about our bakery and coffee shop.\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Do you offer delivery?\",\n      \"a\": \"We currently do not offer delivery services.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Can I make a special order?\",\n      \"a\": \"We can accommodate special orders for a limited time.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"What are your opening hours?\",\n      \"a\": \"Our hours are not listed on the website.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"How do I place an order?\",\n      \"a\": \"Orders are confirmed by email at orders@crumbandco.co.uk.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"FAQ\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\"\n};\n\nexport function Faq() {\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(0);\n  return (\n    <section id=\"faq\" className=\"k-section k-faq\" aria-labelledby=\"faq-title\" data-section=\"faq\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-faq-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-head\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"faq-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-faq-list\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <div className=\"k-faq-item\" key={i}>\n              <h3 className=\"k-faq-q\">\n                <button onClick={() => setOpen(open === i ? -1 : i)} type=\"button\" id={'faq-q-' + i} aria-expanded={open === i} aria-controls={'faq-a-' + i} className=\"k-faq-trigger\">\n                  <span>{item.q}</span>\n                  <span className=\"k-faq-icon\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                </button>\n              </h3>\n              <div id={'faq-a-' + i} role=\"region\" aria-labelledby={'faq-q-' + i} className=\"k-faq-answer\" hidden={open !== i}>\n                <p>{item.a}</p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Faq;\n",
      "src/components/Faq.css": ".k-faq .k-faq-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-list { border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-q { font-size: inherit; font-weight: inherit; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--k-space-3); min-height: 64px; padding: var(--k-space-2) 0; border: 0; background-color: transparent; color: var(--k-ink); font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-weight: var(--k-display-weight); font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.6vw, 1.375rem); line-height: 1.3; text-align: left; transition: color 160ms ease; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger:hover, .k-faq .k-faq-trigger:focus-visible { color: var(--k-accent-text); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon { position: relative; flex: 0 0 18px; height: 18px; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon::before, .k-faq .k-faq-icon::after { content: \"\"; position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 0; width: 18px; height: 2px; background-color: currentColor; transition: transform 220ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon::after { transform: rotate(90deg); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger[aria-expanded=\"true\"] .k-faq-icon::after { transform: rotate(0deg); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer { padding-bottom: var(--k-space-3); color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer p { max-width: 60ch; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer:not([hidden]) { animation: k-faq-open 260ms var(--k-ease); }\n@keyframes k-faq-open { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }\n@media (max-width: 860px) { .k-faq .k-faq-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }\n",
      "src/components/VisitUs.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport type { FormEvent as ReactFormEvent } from 'react';\nimport './VisitUs.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Visit us\",\n  \"text\": \"Find us in the heart of Bristol. Come for the fresh bread and strong coffee.\",\n  \"button\": \"Come visit\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\",\n  \"email\": \"orders@crumbandco.co.uk\",\n  \"location\": \"Bristol\",\n  \"note\": \"Sending opens your email app with the message ready to go.\",\n  \"doneNote\": \"Your email app should now open with the message ready to send.\"\n};\n\nexport function VisitUs() {\n  const [values, setValues] = useState({ name: '', email: '', message: '' });\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [state, setState] = useState('idle');\n  const update = (field: string, value: string) => setValues((current: any) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));\n  const submit = (event: ReactFormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    const next: Record<string, string> = {};\n    if (!values.name.trim()) next.name = 'Please add your name.';\n    if (!/^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/.test(values.email)) next.email = 'Please add a valid email address.';\n    if (values.message.trim().length < 10) next.message = 'Please write a short message of at least ten characters.';\n    setErrors(next);\n    if (Object.keys(next).length) return;\n    setState('busy');\n    window.setTimeout(() => {\n      if (DATA.email) {\n        const body = values.message + '\\n\\n' + values.name + ' (' + values.email + ')';\n        window.location.href = 'mailto:' + DATA.email + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(`Message from ${values.name}`) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(body);\n      }\n      setState('done');\n    }, 400);\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"visit-us\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-visit-us\" aria-labelledby=\"visit-us-title\" data-section=\"visit-us\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-visit-us-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-visit-us-intro\">\n          <h2 id=\"visit-us-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.text ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.text}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.email || DATA.location ? (\n            <dl className=\"k-visit-us-details\">\n              {DATA.email ? (\n                <div><dt>Email</dt><dd><a className=\"k-link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n              {DATA.location ? (\n                <div><dt>Location</dt><dd>{DATA.location}</dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n            </dl>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n        <form className=\"k-visit-us-form\" noValidate onSubmit={submit} aria-describedby=\"visit-us-form-note\">\n          <div className=\"k-visit-us-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"visit-us-name\">Name</label>\n            <input id=\"visit-us-name\" name=\"name\" type=\"text\" autoComplete=\"name\" required value={values.name} aria-invalid={errors.name ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.name ? 'visit-us-name-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('name', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.name ? <p id=\"visit-us-name-error\" className=\"k-visit-us-error\">{errors.name}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-visit-us-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"visit-us-email\">Email</label>\n            <input id=\"visit-us-email\" name=\"email\" type=\"email\" autoComplete=\"email\" required value={values.email} aria-invalid={errors.email ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'visit-us-email-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('email', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.email ? <p id=\"visit-us-email-error\" className=\"k-visit-us-error\">{errors.email}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-visit-us-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"visit-us-message\">Message</label>\n            <textarea id=\"visit-us-message\" name=\"message\" rows={5} required value={values.message} aria-invalid={errors.message ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.message ? 'visit-us-message-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('message', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.message ? <p id=\"visit-us-message-error\" className=\"k-visit-us-error\">{errors.message}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <button type=\"submit\" className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-visit-us-submit\" aria-busy={state === 'busy'} disabled={state === 'busy'}>{state === 'busy' ? 'Preparing\u2026' : DATA.button}</button>\n          <p id=\"visit-us-form-note\" className=\"k-visit-us-note\" aria-live=\"polite\">{state === 'done' ? DATA.doneNote : DATA.note}</p>\n        </form>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default VisitUs;\n",
      "src/components/VisitUs.css": ".k-visit-us .k-visit-us-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-intro { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-details { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); margin: var(--k-space-2) 0 0; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-details dt { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-details dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-form { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field input, .k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); border-radius: calc(var(--k-radius-btn) / 2 + 2px); background-color: var(--k-surface); color: var(--k-ink); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field textarea { resize: vertical; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field input:hover, .k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field textarea:hover { border-color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field input:focus-visible, .k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--k-accent-text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--k-accent-soft); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field [aria-invalid=\"true\"] { border-color: #B42318; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-error { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-error::before { content: \"!     "code": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Crumb & Co\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"menu\",\n      \"href\": \"#menu\",\n      \"label\": \"Menu\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"our-process\",\n      \"href\": \"#our-process\",\n      \"label\": \"Our process\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"the-team\",\n      \"href\": \"#the-team\",\n      \"label\": \"The team\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"faq\",\n      \"href\": \"#faq\",\n      \"label\": \"FAQ\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"visit-us\",\n      \"href\": \"#visit-us\",\n      \"label\": \"Visit us\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"#shop\",\n    \"label\": \"Shop now\"\n  },\n  \"store\": true,\n  \"email\": \"orders@crumbandco.co.uk\",\n  \"currency\": \"\u00a3\",\n  \"checkoutNote\": \"Checkout is handled by email for now: email orders@crumbandco.co.uk with your list and we'll confirm availability and payment.\"\n};\n\nfunction parsePrice(value: string): number {\n  const n = parseFloat(String(value || '').replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''));\n  return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;\n}\n\nfunction useCart() {\n  const [lines, setLines] = useState<any[]>([]);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onAdd = (event: Event) => {\n      const detail = (event as CustomEvent).detail || {};\n      if (!detail.name) return;\n      setLines((current: any[]) => {\n        if (current.some((line: any) => line.name === detail.name)) {\n          return current.map((line: any) => (line.name === detail.name ? { ...line, qty: line.qty + 1 } : line));\n        }\n        return [...current, { name: detail.name, price: detail.price || '', qty: 1 }];\n      });\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('kit-cart-add', onAdd);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('kit-cart-add', onAdd);\n  }, []);\n  const remove = (name: string) => setLines((current: any[]) => current.filter((line: any) => line.name !== name));\n  return { lines, remove };\n}\n\nfunction cartTotal(lines: any[]) {\n  return lines.reduce((sum: number, line: any) => sum + parsePrice(line.price) * line.qty, 0);\n}\n\nfunction orderBody(lines: any[], currency: string) {\n  return lines.map((line: any) => line.qty + ' x ' + line.name + (line.price ? ' (' + line.price + ')' : '')).join('\\n')\n    + (currency ? '\\n\\nTotal: ' + currency + cartTotal(lines).toFixed(2) : '');\n}\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [tucked, setTucked] = useState(false);\n  const [active, setActive] = useState('');\n  const [cartOpen, setCartOpen] = useState(false);\n  const toggleRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);\n  const cartButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | useEffect(() => {\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');\n    let last = window.scrollY;\n    let pending = 0;\n    const settle = () => {\n      pending = 0;\n      const y = window.scrollY;\n      if (y > last + 4 && y > 120 && !reduce.matches) setTucked(true);\n      else if (y < last - 4 || y <= 120) setTucked(false);\n      last = y;\n    };\n    const window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n      if (pending) window.clearTimeout(pending);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;\n    const targets = DATA.links\n      .map((link: any) => document.getElementById(link.id))\n      .filter((el: HTMLElement | null) => Boolean(el)) as HTMLElement[];\n    if (!targets.length) return;\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) setActive(entry.target.id);\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -50% 0px' });\n    targets.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!open && !cartOpen) return;\n    const previous = document.body.style.overflow;\n    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';\n    if (open) firstLinkRef.current?.focus();\n    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {\n      if (event.key !== 'Escape') return;\n      if (open) {\n        setOpen(false);\n        toggleRef.current?.focus();\n      }\n      if (cartOpen) {\n        setCartOpen(false);\n        cartButtonRef.current?.focus();\n      }\n    };\n    const desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 900px)');\n    const onWide = () => {\n      if (desktop.matches) setOpen(false);\n    };\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n    desktop.addEventListener('change', onWide);\n    return () => {\n      document.body.style.overflow = previous;\n      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n      desktop.removeEventListener('change', onWide);\n    };\n  }, [open, cartOpen]);\n\n  const closeMenu = () => {\n    setOpen(false);\n    toggleRef.current?.focus();\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      <header id=\"header\" className={'k-header' + (tucked && !open && !cartOpen ? ' is-tucked' : '')} data-section=\"header\">\n        <div className=\"k-container k-header__bar\">\n          <a className=\"k-header__brand\" href=\"#site-main\">{DATA.brand}</a>\n          {DATA.links.length ? (\n            <nav className=\"k-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Primary\">\n              <ul className=\"k-header__links\">\n                {DATA.links.map((link: any) => (\n                  <li key={link.id}>\n                    <a className=\"k-header__link\" href={link.href} aria-current={active === link.id ? 'location' : undefined}>{link.label}</a>\n                  </li>\n                ))}\n              </ul>\n            </nav>\n          ) : null}\n          <div className=\"k-header__tools\">\n            {DATA.store ? (\n              <button onClick={() => setCartOpen(!cartOpen)} ref={cartButtonRef} type=\"button\" className=\"k-header__cart\" data-cart-count={count} aria-label={'Cart, ' + count + (count === 1 ? ' item' : ' items')} aria-expanded={cartOpen} aria-controls=\"site-cart-panel\">\n                <span>Cart</span>\n                <span className=\"k-header__count\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{count}</span>\n              </button>\n            ) : null}\n            {DATA.cta ? <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-header__cta\" href={DATA.cta.href}>{DATA.cta.label}</a> : null}\n            <button onClick={() => setOpen(true)} ref={toggleRef} type=\"button\" className=\"k-header__toggle\" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls=\"site-menu\" aria-label=\"Open menu\">\n              <span className=\"k-header__burger\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </header>\n      <div id=\"site-menu\" className={'k-header__drawer' + (open ? 'location' : undefined}>{link.label}</a>\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ul>\n        </nav>\n        {DATA.cta ? <a onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-header__drawer-cta\" href={DATA.cta.href}>{DATA.cta.label}</a> : null}\n        {DATA.email ? <a className=\"k-link k-header__drawer-mail\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a> : null}\n      </div>\n      {DATA.store ? (\n        <div id=\"site-cart-panel\" className={'k-header__cartpanel' + (cartOpen ? ' is-open' : '')} role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\" aria-label=\"Cart\" inert={!cartOpen}>\n          <div className=\"k-header__drawer-top\">\n            <p className=\"k-header__cart-title\">Your cart</p>\n            <button onClick={() => { setCartOpen(false); cartButtonRef.current?.focus(); }} type=\"button\" className=\"k-header__close\" aria-label=\"Close cart\">Close</button>\n          </div>\n          {cart.lines.length ? (\n            <ul className=\"k-header__lines\">\n              {cart.lines.map((line: any) => (\n                <li key={line.name} className=\"k-header__line\">\n                  <span>{line.qty} \u00d7 {line.name}</span>\n                  <span>{line.price}</span>\n                  <button onClick={() => cart.remove(line.name)} type=\"button\" className=\"k-header__remove\" aria-label={'Remove ' + line.name}>Remove</button>\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          ) : (\n            <p className=\"k-header__empty\">Your cart is empty. (\n            <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(`Order from ${DATA.brand}`) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(orderBody(cart.lines, DATA.currency))}>Email this order</a>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n      ) : null}\n    </>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Header;\n",

background-color: var(--k-surface-2); overflow: hidden; }\n.k-hero .k-window__meter span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background-color: var(--k-accent); }\n.k-hero .k-window__chart { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; height: 140px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--k-line); border-radius: 10px; }\n.k-hero .k-window__chart span { flex: 1; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; background-image: linear-gradient(to top, var(--k-accent), var(--k-accent-2)); opacity: 0.85; }\n.k-hero .k-window__caption { padding: 10px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line); font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--k-muted); }\n@media (max-width: 640px) {\n  .k-hero .k-window__body { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);       "src/components/Menu.tsx": "import { useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport type { KeyboardEvent as ReactKeyboardEvent } from 'react';\nimport { flushSync } from 'react-dom';\nimport './Menu.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Menu\",\n  \"intro\": \"Find what\u2019s fresh and ready to enjoy\",\n  \"categories\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Breads\",\n      \"items\": [\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Sourdough Loaf\",\n          \"description\": \"Hand-rafted with patience and care\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Cardamom Bun\",\n          \"description\": \"A warm, fragrant treat with a soft crumb\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Rye Bread\",\n          \"description\": \"Smoky and hearty, perfect for any time\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        }\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Pastries\",\n      \"items\": [\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Croissant\",\n          \"description\": \"Golden and flaky, freshly made each day\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Blueberry Muffin\",\n          \"description\": \"Light and fluffy with a burst of flavor\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Apple Tarte\",\n          \"description\": \"A delicate tart with a crisp crust\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        }\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Coffee\",\n      \"items\": [\n        {\n          \"name\": \"House Coffee Beans\",\n          \"description\": \"Roasted in-house for a bold and rich taste\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Espresso\",\n          \"description\": \"A strong, full-bodied cup made with care\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Latte\",\n          \"description\": \"A smooth blend of coffee and steamed milk\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        }\n      ]\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555507036-ab1f4038808a?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"Fresh croissants on a tray\",\n    \"w\": 1000,\n    \"h\": 1250\n  },\n  \"empty\": \"Ask Crumb & Co for today's menu.\",\n  \"askToday\": \"Ask us what's on today \u2014 write to orders@crumbandco.co.uk.\"\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function Menu() {\n  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);\n  const tabsRef = useRef<Array<HTMLButtonElement | null>>([]);\n  const select = (index: number, focus: boolean) => {\n    const count = DATA.categories.length;\n    const next = (index + count) % count;\n    const apply = () => setActive(next);\n    const doc: any = document;\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (doc.startViewTransition && !reduce) {\n      doc.startViewTransition(() => flushSync(apply));\n    } else {\n      apply();\n    }\n    if (focus) tabsRef.current[next]?.focus();\n  };\n  const onKey = (event: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, index: number) => {\n    const last = DATA.categories.length - 1;\n    const moves: Record<string, number> = { ArrowRight: index + 1, ArrowLeft: index - 1, Home: 0, End: last };\n    if (event.key in moves) {\n      event.preventDefault();\n      select(moves[event.key], true);\n    }\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"menu\" className=\"k-section k-menu\" aria-labelledby=\"menu-title\" data-section=\"menu\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-menu-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-menu-intro\">\n          <h2 id=\"menu-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n          <Media img={DATA.img} variant={3} mark={DATA.mark} className=\"k-menu-media k-settle\" />\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-menu-board\">\n          <div className=\"k-menu-tabs\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label={DATA.title}>\n            {DATA.categories.map((cat: any, i: number) => (\n              <button onClick={() => select(i, false)} onKeyDown={(event: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => onKey(event, i)} ref={(el: HTMLButtonElement | null) => { tabsRef.current[i] = el; }} key={i} type=\"button\" role=\"tab\" id={'menu-tab-' + i} aria-selected={active === i} aria-controls=\"menu-panel\" tabIndex={active === i ? 0 : -1} className=\"k-menu-tab\">{cat.name}</button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n          <div id=\"menu-panel\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby={'menu-tab-' + active} className=\"k-menu-panel\" tabIndex={0}>\n            {DATA.categories[active].items.length ? (\n            <ul className=\"k-menu-dishes\">\n              {DATA.categories[active].items.map((dish: any, i: number) => (\n                <li className=\"k-menu-dish\" key={i}>\n                  <div className=\"k-menu-dishrow\">\n                    <h3 className=\"k-menu-dishname\">{dish.name}</h3>\n                    {dish.price ? <span className=\"k-menu-leader\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> : null}\n                    {dish.price ? <span className=\"k-menu-price\">{dish.price}</span> : null}\n                  </div>\n                  {dish.description ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{dish.description}</p> : null}\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n            ) : (\n              <p className=\"k-lede k-menu-empty\">{DATA.askToday}</p>\n            )}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Menu;\n",
      "src/components/Menu.css": ".k-menu .k-menu-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.85fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-menu .k-menu-intro { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); position: sticky; top: calc(var(--k-header-h) + 24px); }\n.k-menu .k-menu-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; margin-top: var(--k-space-2); }\n.k-menu .k-menu-tabs { display: flex; }\n::view-transition-old(k-panel-menu), ::view-transition-new(k-panel-menu) { animation-duration: 240ms; }\n@media (max-width: 860px) {\n  .k-menu .k-menu-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }\n  .k-menu .k-menu-intro { position: static; }\n}\n",
      "src/components/Shop.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Shop.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Shop\",\n  \"intro\": \"Find what you love and take it home\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Sourdough loaf\",\n      \"description\": \"A perfect slice of tradition with a tangy, crusty texture\",\n      \"price\": \"\u00a36\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1486427944299-d1955d23e34d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"A cake on a stand\",\n        \"w\": 900,\n        \"h\": 1125\n      },\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:orders@crumbandco.co.uk?subject=Question%20about%20Sourdough%20loaf\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Cardamom bun\",\n      \"description\": \"A warm, spiced bun with a hint of sweetness\",\n      \"price\": \"\u00a33.50\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1509440159596-0249088772ff?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"Loaves of crusty bread\",\n        \"w\": 900,\n        \"h\": 1125\n      },\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:orders@crumbandco.co.uk?subject=Question%20about%20Cardamom%20bun\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"House coffee beans\",\n      \"description\": \"Roasted in-house for a rich, bold flavor\",\n      \"price\": \"\u00a39\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1495474472287-4d71bcdd2085?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"A cup of coffee on a wooden table\",\n        \"w\": 900,\n        \"h\": 1125\n      },\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:orders@crumbandco.co.uk?subject=Question%20about%20House%20coffee%20beans\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\"\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const root = ref.current;\n    if (!root) return;\n    const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\"]'));\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (reduce || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {\n      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('is-visible'));\n      return;\n    }\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n          entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');\n          observer.unobserve(entry.target);\n        }\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.12 });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Shop() {\n  const revealRef = useReveal<HTMLElement>();\n  const [added, setAdded] = useState('');\n  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');\n  const add = (item: any) => {\n    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kit-cart-add', { detail: { name: item.name, price: item.price || '' } }));\n    setAdded(item.name);\n    setStatus(item.name + ' added to cart.');\n    window.setTimeout(() => setAdded(''), 1600);\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"shop\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-shop\" aria-labelledby=\"shop-title\" data-section=\"shop\" ref={revealRef}>\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"shop-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-shop-grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className=\"k-shop-card\" key={i} data-product={item.name} data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\">\n              <Media img={item.img} variant={(i % 3) + 1} mark={item.name.charAt(0)} className=\"k-shop-media k-settle\" />\n              <div className=\"k-shop-body\">\n                <div className=\"k-shop-row\">\n                  <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.name}</h3>\n                  {item.price ? <p className=\"k-shop-price\">{item.price}</p> : null}\n                </div>\n                {item.description ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.description}</p> : null}\n                <button onClick={() => add(item)} type=\"button\" className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-shop-add\" aria-label={'Add ' + item.name + ' to cart'}>{added === item.name ? 'Added' : 'Add to cart'}</button>\n              </div>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n        <p className=\"k-sr\" aria-live=\"polite\">{status}</p>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Shop;\n",
      "src/components/Shop.css": ".k-shop .k-shop-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px) clamp(20px, 3vw, 32px); }\n.k-shop .k-shop-card { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-body { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); justify-items: start; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--k-space-2); width: 100%; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-price { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }\n.k-shop .k-shop-add { margin-top: var(--k-space-1); min-height: var(--k-tap); }\n.k-shop .k-shop-ask { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--k-tap); font-weight: 600; }\n",
      "src/components/OurProcess.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './OurProcess.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Our Process\",\n  \"intro\": \"From grain to cup, we craft with care.\",\n  \"steps\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Start with grain\",\n      \"text\": \"We source high-quality ingredients and begin with the foundation of our craft.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Shape and bake\",\n      \"text\": \"Our bakers shape each loaf and pastry with care, ensuring a perfect rise and texture.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Roast and brew\",\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Serve with pride\",\n      \"text\": \"We serve our creations with the same warmth and care that we put into every step of the process.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1558961363-fa8fdf82db35?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"Freshly baked cookies\",\n    \"w\": 1000,\n    \"h\": 1250\n  }\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function OurProcess() {\n  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);\n  const listRef = useRef<HTMLOListElement | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const list = listRef.current;\n    if (!list || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;\n    const items = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-step]'));\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) setCurrent(Number((entry.target as HTMLElement).dataset.step || 0));\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -45% 0px' });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  const total = DATA.steps.length;\n  const progress = total > 1 ? current / (total - 1) : 1;\n  return (\n    <section id=\"our-process\" className=\"k-section k-our-process\" aria-labelledby=\"our-process-title\" data-section=\"our-process\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-our-process-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-our-process-pin\" data-motion=\"sticky-story\">\n          <div className=\"k-our-process-visual\">\n            <Media img={DATA.img} variant={3} mark={DATA.mark} className=\"k-our-process-media\" />\n            <div className=\"k-our-process-meter\">\n              <p className=\"k-our-process-counter\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                <span className=\"k-our-process-now\">{String(current + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span> / {String(total).padStart(2, '0')}\n              </p>\n              <svg className=\"k-our-process-line\" viewBox=\"0 0 100 4\" preserveAspectRatio=\"none\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                <line x1=\"0\" y1=\"2\" x2=\"100\" y2=\"2\" pathLength={1} className=\"k-our-process-track\" />\n                <line x1=\"0\" y1=\"2\" x2=\"100\" y2=\"2\" pathLength={1} className=\"k-our-process-fill\" style={{ strokeDashoffset: 1 - progress }} />\n              </svg>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-our-process-copy\">\n          <div className=\"k-head\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"our-process-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n          <ol className=\"k-our-process-list\" ref={listRef}>\n            {DATA.steps.map((step: any, i: number) => (\n              <li key={i} data-step={i} className=\"k-our-process-step\" aria-current={current === i ? 'step' : undefined}>\n                <span className=\"k-our-process-num\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n                <div className=\"k-our-process-text\">\n                  <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{step.title}</h3>\n                  {step.text ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{step.text}</p> : null}\n                </div>\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ol>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default OurProcess;\n",
      "src/components/OurProcess.css": ".k-our-process .k-our-process-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-pin { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--k-header-h) + 32px); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-visual { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-media { width: 100%; color: var(--k-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-now { color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-line { width: 100%; height: 4px; overflow: visible; gap: var(--k-space-2); min-height: 38vh; padding-block: var(--k-space-4); border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line); opacity: 0.42; transition: opacity 300ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-step[aria-current=\"step\"] { opacity: 1; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-num { font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--k-accent-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-our-process .k-our-process-text { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); align-content: start; }\n@media (max-width: 860px) {\n  .k-our-process .k-our-process-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }\n  .k-our-process .k-our-process-pin { position: static;       "src/components/TheTeam.tsx": "import './TheTeam.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"The Team\",\n  \"intro\": \"Meet the people who make every loaf and cup special.\",\n  \"members\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"\",\n      \"role\": \"Head Baker\",\n      \"text\": \"Sarah has been crafting bread for over a decade.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"\",\n      \"role\": \"Barista\",\n      \"text\": \"James roasts and serves coffee with care.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"\",\n      \"role\": \"Shop Manager\",\n      \"text\": \"Emily ensures every customer feels welcome.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\"\n};\n\nexport function TheTeam() {\n  return (\n    <section id=\"the-team\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-the-team\" aria-labelledby=\"the-team-title\" data-section=\"the-team\">\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"the-team-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-the-team-list k-the-team-list--grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.members.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className=\"k-the-team-item\" key={i}>\n              <span className=\"k-the-team-index\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n              <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.name || item.role || item.title}</h3>\n              {item.name && item.role ? <p className=\"k-the-team-role\">{item.role}</p> : null}\n              {item.text ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.text}</p> : null}\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default TheTeam;\n",

      "src/components/Faq.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Faq.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Frequently Asked Questions\",\n  \"intro\": \"Here are answers to common questions about our bakery and coffee shop.\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Do you offer online ordering?\",\n      \"a\": \"We do not have an online checkout, but you can add items to your cart and confirm orders by email at orders@crumbandco.co.uk.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"What are your opening hours?\",\n      \"a\": \"We are open Monday to Saturday from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Can I bring my own coffee beans?\",\n      \"a\": \"Yes, you can bring your own coffee beans and enjoy them in our caf\u00e9.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"q\": \"Do you have any dietary restrictions?\",\n      \"a\": \"We offer a variety of options, and we can accommodate most dietary restrictions upon request.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"FAQ\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\"\n};\n\nexport function Faq() {\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(0);\n  return (\n    <section id=\"faq\" className=\"k-section k-faq\" aria-labelledby=\"faq-title\" data-section=\"faq\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-faq-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-head\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"faq-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-faq-list\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <div className=\"k-faq-item\" key={i}>\n              <h3 className=\"k-faq-q\">\n                <button onClick={() => setOpen(open === i ? -1 : i)} type=\"button\" id={'faq-q-' + i} aria-expanded={open === i} aria-controls={'faq-a-' + i} className=\"k-faq-trigger\">\n                  <span>{item.q}</span>\n                  <span className=\"k-faq-icon\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                </button>\n              </h3>\n              <div id={'faq-a-' + i} role=\"region\" aria-labelledby={'faq-q-' + i} className=\"k-faq-answer\" hidden={open !== i}>\n                <p>{item.a}</p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Faq;\n",
      "src/components/Faq.css": ".k-faq .k-faq-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-list { border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-q { font-size: inherit; font-weight: inherit; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--k-space-3); min-height: 64px; padding: var(--k-space-2) 0; border: 0; background-color: transparent; color: var(--k-ink); font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-weight: var(--k-display-weight); font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.6vw, 1.375rem); line-height: 1.3; text-align: left; transition: color 160ms ease; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger:hover, .k-faq .k-faq-trigger:focus-visible { color: var(--k-accent-text); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon { position: relative; flex: 0 0 18px; height: 18px; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon::before, .k-faq .k-faq-icon::after { content: \"\"; position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 0; width: 18px; height: 2px; background-color: currentColor; transition: transform 220ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-icon::after { transform: rotate(90deg); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-trigger[aria-expanded=\"true\"] .k-faq-icon::after { transform: rotate(0deg); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer { padding-bottom: var(--k-space-3); color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer p { max-width: 60ch; }\n.k-faq .k-faq-answer:not([hidden]) { animation: k-faq-open 260ms var(--k-ease); }\n@keyframes k-faq-open { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }\n@media (max-width: 860px) { .k-faq .k-faq-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }\n",
      "src/components/VisitUs.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport type { FormEvent as ReactFormEvent } from 'react';\nimport './VisitUs.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Visit us\",\n  \"text\": \"Find us on the corner of High Street and Broad Street. Drop by any day between 7am and 5pm.\",\n  \"button\": \"Come in\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"C\",\n  \"email\": \"orders@crumbandco.co.uk\",\n  \"location\": \"Bristol\",\n  \"note\": \"Sending opens your email app with the message ready to go.\",\n  \"doneNote\": \"Your email app should now open with the message ready to send.\"\n};\n\nexport function VisitUs() {\n  const [values, setValues] = useState({ name: '', email: '', message: '' });\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [state, setState] = useState('idle');\n  const update = (field: string, value: string) => setValues((current: any) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));\n  const submit = (event: ReactFormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    const next: Record<string, string> = {};\n    if (!values.name.trim()) next.name = 'Please add your name.';\n    if (!/^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/.test(values.email)) next.email = 'Please add a valid email address.';\n    if (values.message.trim().length < 10) next.message = 'Please write a short message of at least ten characters.';\n    setErrors(next);\n    if (Object.keys(next).length) return;\n    setState('busy');\n    window.setTimeout(() => {\n      if (DATA.email) {\n        const body = values.message + '\\n\\n' + values.name + ' (' + values.email + ')';\n        window.location.href = 'mailto:' + DATA.email + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(`Message from ${values.name}`) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(body);\n      }\n      setState('done');\n    }, 400);\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"visit-us\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-visit-us\" aria-labelledby=\"visit-us-title\" data-section=\"visit-us\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-visit-us-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-visit-us-intro\">\n          <h2 id=\"visit-us-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.text ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.text}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.email || DATA.location ? (\n            <dl className=\"k-visit-us-details\">\n              {DATA.email ? (\n                <div><dt>Email</dt><dd><a className=\"k-link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n              {DATA.location ? (\n                <div><dt>Location</dt><dd>{DATA.location}</dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n            </dl>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n        <form className=\"k-visit-us-form\" noValidate onSubmit={submit} aria-describedby=\"visit-us-form-note\">\n          <div className=\"k-visit-us-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"visit-us-name\">Name</label>\n            <input id=\"visit-us-name\" name=\"name\" type=\"text\" autoComplete=\"name\" required value={values.name} aria-invalid={errors.name ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.name ? 'visit-us-name-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('name', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.name ? <p id=\"visit-us-name-error\" className=\"k-visit-us-error\">{errors.name}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-visit-us-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"visit-us-email\">Email</label>\n            <input id=\"visit-us-email\" name=\"email\" type=\"email\" autoComplete=\"email\" required value={values.email} aria-invalid={errors.email ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'visit-us-email-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('email', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.email ? <p id=\"visit-us-email-error\" className=\"k-visit-us-error\">{errors.email}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-visit-us-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"visit-us-message\">Message</label>\n            <textarea id=\"visit-us-message\" name=\"message\" rows={5} required value={values.message} aria-invalid={errors.message ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.message ? 'visit-us-message-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('message', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.message ? <p id=\"visit-us-message-error\" className=\"k-visit-us-error\">{errors.message}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <button type=\"submit\" className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-visit-us-submit\" aria-busy={state === 'busy'} disabled={state === 'busy'}>{state === 'busy' ? 'Preparing\u2026' : DATA.button}</button>\n          <p id=\"visit-us-form-note\" className=\"k-visit-us-note\" aria-live=\"polite\">{state === 'done' ? DATA.doneNote : DATA.note}</p>\n        </form>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default VisitUs;\n",
      "src/components/VisitUs.css": ".k-visit-us .k-visit-us-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-intro { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-details { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); margin: var(--k-space-2) 0 0; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-details dt { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-details dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-form { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field input, .k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); border-radius: calc(var(--k-radius-btn) / 2 + 2px); background-color: var(--k-surface); color: var(--k-ink); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field textarea { resize: vertical; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field input:hover, .k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field textarea:hover { border-color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field input:focus-visible, .k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--k-accent-text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--k-accent-soft); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-field [aria-invalid=\"true\"] { border-color: #B42318; }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-error { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-visit-us .k-visit-us-error::before { content: \"!       "src/components/Footer.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Footer.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Crumb & Co\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Bread. Coffee.
