    "code": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Maya Chen\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"projects\",\n      \"href\": \"#projects\",\n      \"label\": \"Projects\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Get in touch\"\n  },\n  \"store\": false,\n  \"email\": \"\",\n  \"currency\": \"\",\n  \"checkoutNote\": \"Checkout is handled by email for now: send us your list and we'll confirm availability and payment.\"\n};\n\nfunction parsePrice(value: string): number {\n  const n = parseFloat(String(value || '').replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''));\n  return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;\n}\n\nfunction useCart() {\n  const [lines, setLines] = useState<any[]>([]);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onAdd = (event: Event) => {\n      const detail = (event as CustomEvent).detail || {};\n      if (!detail.name) return;\n      setLines((current: any[]) => {\n        if (current.some((line: any) => line.name === detail.name)) {\n          return current.map((line: any) => (line.name === detail.name ? { ...line, qty: line.qty + 1 } : line));\n        }\n        return [...current, { name: detail.name, price: detail.price || '', qty: 1 }];\n      });\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('kit-cart-add', onAdd);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('kit-cart-add', onAdd);\n  }, []);\n  const remove = (name: string) => setLines((current: any[]) => current.filter((line: any) => line.name !== name));\n  return { lines, remove };\n}\n\nfunction cartTotal(lines: any[]) {\n  return lines.reduce((sum: number, line: any) => sum + parsePrice(line.price) * line.qty, 0);\n}\n\nfunction orderBody(lines: any[], currency: string) {\n  return lines.map((line: any) => line.qty + ' x ' + line.name + (line.price ? ' (' + line.price + ')' : '')).join('\\n')\n    + (currency ? '\\n\\nTotal: ' + currency + cartTotal(lines).toFixed(2) : '');\n}\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [tucked, setTucked] = useState(false);\n  const [active, setActive] = useState('');\n  const [cartOpen, setCartOpen] = useState(false);\n  const toggleRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);\n  const cartButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);\n  const firstLinkRef = useRef<HTMLAnchorElement | null>(null);\n  const cart = useCart();\n  const count = cart.lines.reduce((sum: number, line: any) => sum + line.qty, 0);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');\n    let last = window.scrollY;\n    let pending = 0;\n    const settle = () => {\n      pending = 0;\n      const y = window.scrollY;\n      if (y > last + 4 && y > 120 && !reduce.matches) setTucked(true);\n      else if (y < last - 4 || y <= 120) setTucked(false);\n      last = y;\n    };\n    const onScroll = () => {\n      if (!pending) pending = window.setTimeout(settle, 80);\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });\n    return () => {\n      window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n      if (pending) window.clearTimeout(pending);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;\n    const targets = DATA.links\n      .map((link: any) => document.getElementById(link.id))\n      .filter((el: HTMLElement | null) => Boolean(el)) as HTMLElement[];\n    if (!targets.length) return;\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) setActive(entry.target.id);\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -50% 0px' });\n    targets.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!open && !cartOpen) return;\n    const previous = document.body.style.overflow;\n    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';\n    if (open) firstLinkRef.current?.focus();\n    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {\n      if (event.key !== 'Escape') return;\n      if (open) {\n        setOpen(false);\n        toggleRef.current?.focus();\n      }\n      if (cartOpen) {\n        setCartOpen(false);\n        cartButtonRef.current?.focus();\n      }\n    };\n    const desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 900px)');\n    const onWide = () => {\n      if (desktop.matches) setOpen(false);\n    };\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n    desktop.addEventListener('change', onWide);\n    return () => {\n      document.body.style.overflow = previous;\n      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n      desktop.removeEventListener('change', onWide);\n    };\n  }, [open, cartOpen]);\n\n  const closeMenu = () => {\n    setOpen(false);\n    toggleRef.current?.focus();\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      <header id=\"header\" className={'k-header' + (tucked && !open && !cartOpen ? ' is-tucked' : '')} data-section=\"header\">\n        <div className=\"k-container k-header__bar\">\n          <a className=\"k-header__brand\" href=\"#site-main\">{DATA.brand}</a>\n          {DATA.links.length ? (\n            <nav className=\"k-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Primary\">\n              <ul className=\"k-header__links\">\n                {DATA.links.map((link: any) => (\n                  <li key={link.id}>\n                    <a className=\"k-header__link\" href={link.href} aria-current={active === link.id ? 'location' : undefined}>{link.label}</a>\n                  </li>\n                ))}\n              </ul>\n            </nav>\n          ) : null}\n          <div className=\"k-header__tools\">\n            {DATA.store ? (\n              <button onClick={() => setCartOpen(!cartOpen)} ref={cartButtonRef} type=\"button\" className=\"k-header__cart\" data-cart-count={count} aria-label={'Cart, ' + count + (count === 1 ? ' item' : ' items')} aria-expanded={cartOpen} aria-controls=\"site-cart-panel\">\n                <span>Cart</span>\n                <span className=\"k-header__count\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{count}</span>\n              </button>\n            ) : null}\n            {DATA.cta ? <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-header__cta\" href={DATA.cta.href}>{DATA.cta.label}</a> : null}\n            <button onClick={() => setOpen(true)} ref={toggleRef} type=\"button\" className=\"k-header__toggle\" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls=\"site-menu\" aria-label=\"Open menu\">\n              <span className=\"k-header__burger\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </header>\n      <div id=\"site-menu\" className={'k-header__drawer' + (open ? ' is-open' : '')} role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\" aria-label=\"Site menu\" inert={!open}>\n        <div className=\"k-header__drawer-top\">\n          <span className=\"k-header__brand\">{DATA.brand}</span>\n          <button onClick={closeMenu} type=\"button\" className=\"k-header__close\" aria-label=\"Close menu\">Close</button>\n        </div>\n        <nav aria-label=\"Mobile\">\n          <ul className=\"k-header__drawer-links\">\n            {DATA.links.map((link: any, i: number) => (\n              <li key={link.id}>\n                <a ref={i === 0 ? firstLinkRef : undefined} onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className=\"k-header__drawer-link\" href={link.href} aria-current={active === link.id ? 'location' : undefined}>{link.label}</a>\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ul>\n        </nav>\n        {DATA.cta ? <a onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-header__drawer-cta\" href={DATA.cta.href}>{DATA.cta.label}</a> : null}\n        {DATA.email ? <a className=\"k-link k-header__drawer-mail\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a> : null}\n      </div>\n      {DATA.store ? (\n        <div id=\"site-cart-panel\" className={'k-header__cartpanel' + (cartOpen ? ' is-open' : '')} role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\" aria-label=\"Cart\" inert={!cartOpen}>\n          <div className=\"k-header__drawer-top\">\n            <p className=\"k-header__cart-title\">Your cart</p>\n            <button onClick={() => { setCartOpen(false); cartButtonRef.current?.focus(); }} type=\"button\" className=\"k-header__close\" aria-label=\"Close cart\">Close</button>\n          </div>\n          {cart.lines.length ? (\n            <ul className=\"k-header__lines\">\n              {cart.lines.map((line: any) => (\n                <li key={line.name} className=\"k-header__line\">\n                  <span>{line.qty} \u00d7 {line.name}</span>\n                  <span>{line.price}</span>\n                  <button onClick={() => cart.remove(line.name)} type=\"button\" className=\"k-header__remove\" aria-label={'Remove ' + line.name}>Remove</button>\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          ) : (\n            <p className=\"k-header__empty\">Your cart is empty. Add something you like and it will appear here.</p>\n          )}\n          {cart.lines.length && DATA.currency ? <p className=\"k-header__total\">Total {DATA.currency}{cartTotal(cart.lines).toFixed(2)}</p> : null}\n          <p className=\"k-header__note\">{DATA.checkoutNote}</p>\n          {cart.lines.length && DATA.email ? (\n            <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(`Order from ${DATA.brand}`) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(orderBody(cart.lines, DATA.currency))}>Email this order</a>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n      ) : null}\n    </>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Header;\n",

      "src/components/Hero.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Hero.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"headline\": \"Maya Chen Brand Designer\",\n  \"lede\": \"Projects include Fern Studio rebrand, Halo app identity, and Ostra packaging.\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Brand designer\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Hero\",\n  \"mark\": \"M\",\n  \"primary\": {\n    \"href\": \"#projects\",\n    \"label\": \"View Projects\"\n  },\n  \"secondary\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Contact Us\"\n  },\n  \"fact\": \"\",\n  \"style\": \"typographic\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1561070791-2526d30994b5?auto=format&fit=crop&w=2000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"Design sketches and colour swatches\",\n    \"w\": 2000,\n    \"h\": 860\n  },\n  \"shader\": false,\n  \"window\": {\n    \"title\": \"Maya Chen overview\",\n    \"labels\": [\n      \"Overview\",\n      \"Activity\",\n      \"Reports\"\n    ],\n    \"bars\": [\n      38,\n      52,\n      46,\n      64,\n      58,\n      72,\n      66,\n      84,\n      78,\n      90\n    ]\n  }\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction useMagnet<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const el = ref.current;\n    if (!el) return;\n    const fine = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (!fine || reduce) return;\n    const move = (event: PointerEvent) => {\n      if (event.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;\n      const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n      const x = ((event.clientX - box.left) / box.width - 0.5) * 16;\n      const y = ((event.clientY - box.top) / box.height - 0.5) * 12;\n      el.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + x.toFixed(1) + 'px, ' + y.toFixed(1) + 'px, 0)';\n    };\n    const leave = () => {\n      el.style.transform = '';\n    };\n    el.addEventListener('pointermove', move);\n    el.addEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    return () => {\n      el.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);\n      el.removeEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    };\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Hero() {\n  const magnetRef = useMagnet<HTMLAnchorElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"hero\" className=\"k-section k-hero k-hero--typographic\" aria-labelledby=\"hero-title\" data-section=\"hero\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-hero__inner\">\n        <div className=\"k-hero__copy\">\n          {DATA.tagline ? <p className=\"k-eyebrow k-rise-2\">{DATA.tagline}</p> : null}\n          <h1 id=\"hero-title\" className=\"k-display k-hero__title\" data-motion=\"text-in\">{DATA.headline}</h1>\n          <div className=\"k-hero__rule\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n          <div className=\"k-hero__row\">\n            <p className=\"k-lede k-hero__lede k-rise-2\">{DATA.lede}</p>\n            <div className=\"k-actions k-rise-3\">\n              <a ref={magnetRef} className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary\" href={DATA.primary.href}>{DATA.primary.label}</a>\n              <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-hero__ghost\" href={DATA.secondary.href}>{DATA.secondary.label}</a>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.fact ? <p className=\"k-hero__fact k-rise-3\">{DATA.fact}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        {DATA.img ? (\n          <div className=\"k-hero__strip k-depth-fast\">\n            <Media img={DATA.img} priority={true} variant={2} className=\"k-hero__stripmedia\" />\n          </div>\n        ) : null}\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Hero;\n",

      "src/components/Projects.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Projects.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Projects\",\n  \"intro\": \"Selected projects from Maya Chen.\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Fern Studio rebrand\",\n      \"caption\": \"A fresh identity for a creative agency.\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1558655146-9f40138edfeb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"A designer working at a desk\",\n        \"w\": 1000,\n        \"h\": 800\n      }\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Halo app identity\",\n      \"caption\": \"A cohesive visual system for a mobile application.\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1542744094-3a31f272c490?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"Brand design work laid out on a table\",\n        \"w\": 1000,\n        \"h\": 800\n      }\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Ostra packaging\",\n      \"caption\": \"A modern look for a product line.\",\n      \"img\": null\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"M\"\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const root = ref.current;\n    if (!root) return;\n    const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\"]'));\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (reduce || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {\n      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('is-visible'));\n      return;\n    }\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n          entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');\n          observer.unobserve(entry.target);\n        }\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.12 });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Projects() {\n  const revealRef = useReveal<HTMLElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"projects\" className=\"k-section k-projects\" aria-labelledby=\"projects-title\" data-section=\"projects\" ref={revealRef}>\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"projects-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-projects-grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className={'k-projects-cell' + (i === 0 ? ' k-projects-cell--lead' : '')} key={i} data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\">\n              <figure className=\"k-projects-figure\">\n                <Media img={item.img} variant={(i % 3) + 1} mark={item.title.charAt(0)} className=\"k-projects-media\" />\n                <figcaption className=\"k-projects-caption\">\n                  <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.title}</h3>\n                  {item.caption ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.caption}</p> : null}\n                </figcaption>\n              </figure>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Projects;\n",
      "src/components/Projects.css": ".k-projects .k-projects-figure { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); height: 100%; margin: 0; border-radius: var(--k-radius); }\n.k-projects .k-projects-caption { display: grid;       "src/components/Contact.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport type { FormEvent as ReactFormEvent } from 'react';\nimport './Contact.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Get in touch\",\n  \"text\": \"Schedule a call to discuss your brand needs. Send your project details for initial consultation.\",\n  \"button\": \"Book a call\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Contact\",\n  \"mark\": \"M\",\n  \"email\": \"\",\n  \"location\": \"\",\n  \"note\": \"This form isn't connected to a mailbox yet, so nothing is sent from here.\",\n  \"doneNote\": \"Thanks. This form isn't connected yet, so please reach us another way for now.\"\n};\n\nexport function Contact() {\n  const [values, setValues] = useState({ name: '', email: '', message: '' });\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [state, setState] = useState('idle');\n  const update = (field: string, value: string) => setValues((current: any) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));\n  const submit = (event: ReactFormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    const next: Record<string, string> = {};\n    if (!values.name.trim()) next.name = 'Please add your name.';\n    if (!/^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/.test(values.email)) next.email = 'Please add a valid email address.';\n    if (values.message.trim().length < 10) next.message = 'Please write a short message of at least ten characters.';\n    setErrors(next);\n    if (Object.keys(next).length) return;\n    setState('busy');\n    window.setTimeout(() => {\n      if (DATA.email) {\n        const body = values.message + '\\n\\n' + values.name + ' (' + values.email + ')';\n        window.location.href = 'mailto:' + DATA.email + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(`Message from ${values.name}`) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(body);\n      }\n      setState('done');\n    }, 400);\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"contact\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-contact\" aria-labelledby=\"contact-title\" data-section=\"contact\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-contact-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-contact-intro\">\n          <h2 id=\"contact-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.text ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.text}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.email || DATA.location ? (\n            <dl className=\"k-contact-details\">\n              {DATA.email ? (\n                <div><dt>Email</dt><dd><a className=\"k-link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n              {DATA.location ? (\n                <div><dt>Location</dt><dd>{DATA.location}</dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n            </dl>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n        <form className=\"k-contact-form\" noValidate onSubmit={submit} aria-describedby=\"contact-form-note\">\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-name\">Name</label>\n            <input id=\"contact-name\" name=\"name\" type=\"text\" autoComplete=\"name\" required value={values.name} aria-invalid={errors.name ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.name ? 'contact-name-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('name', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.name ? <p id=\"contact-name-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.name}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-email\">Email</label>\n            <input id=\"contact-email\" name=\"email\" type=\"email\" autoComplete=\"email\" required value={values.email} aria-invalid={errors.email ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'contact-email-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('email', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.email ? <p id=\"contact-email-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.email}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-message\">Message</label>\n            <textarea id=\"contact-message\" name=\"message\" rows={5} required value={values.message} aria-invalid={errors.message ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.message ? 'contact-message-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('message', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.message ? <p id=\"contact-message-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.message}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <button type=\"submit\" className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-contact-submit\" aria-busy={state === 'busy'} disabled={state === 'busy'}>{state === 'busy' ? 'Preparing\u2026' : DATA.button}</button>\n          <p id=\"contact-form-note\" className=\"k-contact-note\" aria-live=\"polite\">{state === 'done' ? DATA.doneNote : DATA.note}</p>\n        </form>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Contact;\n",
      "src/components/Contact.css": ".k-contact .k-contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-intro { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); margin: var(--k-space-2) 0 0; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details dt { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-form { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); border-radius: calc(var(--k-radius-btn) / 2 + 2px); background-color: var(--k-surface); color: var(--k-ink); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field textarea { resize: vertical; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input:hover, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea:hover { border-color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input:focus-visible, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--k-accent-text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--k-accent-soft); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field [aria-invalid=\"true\"] { border-color: #B42318; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-error { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-error::before { content: \"! \"; color: #D92D20; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-submit { justify-self: start; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-note { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--k-muted); }\n@media (max-width: 860px) { .k-contact .k-contact-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }\n",
      "src/components/Footer.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Footer.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Maya Chen\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Brand designer\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"projects\",\n      \"href\": \"#projects\",\n      \"label\": \"Projects\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"contact\",\n      \"href\": \"#contact\",\n      \"label\": \"Contact\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"email\": \"\",\n  \"location\": \"\",\n  \"contactHref\": \"#contact\",\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Get in touch\"\n  },\n  \"privacy\": \"This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies. Fonts load from Google Fonts and photos from Unsplash, which receive your IP address to deliver them. If you write to us, your message is used only to reply.\"\n};\n\nexport function Footer() {\n  const [privacy, setPrivacy] = useState(false);\n  const year = new Date().getFullYear();\n  return (\n    <footer id=\"site-footer\" className=\"k-footer\" data-section=\"footer\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-footer__grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-footer__brand\">\n          <a className=\"k-footer__wordmark\" href=\"#site-main\">{DATA.brand}</a>\n          {DATA.tagline ? <p className=\"k-footer__tagline\">{DATA.tagline}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.cta ? <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-footer__cta\" href={DATA.cta.href}>{DATA.cta.label}</a> : null}\n        </div>\n        {DATA.links.length ? (\n          <nav className=\"k-footer__col\" aria-label=\"Footer\">\n            <p className=\"k-footer__label\">Explore</p>\n            <ul className=\"k-footer__links\">\n              {DATA.links.map((link: any) => (\n                <li key={link.id}><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={link.href}>{link.label}</a></li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          </nav>\n        ) : null}\n        <div className=\"k-footer__col\">\n          <p className=\"k-footer__label\">Contact</p>\n          <ul className=\"k-footer__links\">\n            {DATA.email ? <li><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></li> : null}\n            {DATA.location ? <li><span className=\"k-footer__plain\">{DATA.location}</span></li> : null}\n            {!DATA.email && DATA.contactHref ? <li><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={DATA.contactHref}>Send a message</a></li> : null}\n            {!DATA.email && !DATA.contactHref ? <li><span className=\"k-footer__plain\">Contact details coming from {DATA.brand} directly.</span></li> : null}\n          </ul>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"k-container k-footer__base\">\n        <p>\u00a9 {year} {DATA.brand}</p>\n        <div className=\"k-footer__base-links\">\n          <button onClick={() => setPrivacy(!privacy)} type=\"button\" className=\"k-footer__privacy-toggle\" aria-expanded={privacy} aria-controls=\"footer-privacy\">Privacy</button>\n          <a className=\"k-footer__link\" href=\"#site-main\">Back to top</a>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div id=\"footer-privacy\" className=\"k-container k-footer__privacy\" hidden={!privacy}>\n        <p>{DATA.privacy}</p>\n      </div>\n    </footer>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Footer;\n",

    "code": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Saffron Table\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"menu\",\n      \"href\": \"#menu\",\n      \"label\": \"Menu\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"about\",\n      \"href\": \"#about\",\n      \"label\": \"About\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"private-dining\",\n      \"href\": \"#private-dining\",\n      \"label\": \"Private dining\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Get in touch\"\n  },\n  \"store\": false,\n  \"email\": \"\",\n  \"currency\": \"\",\n  \"checkoutNote\": \"Checkout is handled by email for now: send us your list and we'll confirm availability and payment.\"\n};\n\nfunction parsePrice(value: string): number {\n  const n = parseFloat(String(value || '').replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ''));\n  return isNaN(n) ? useEffect(() => {\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');\n    let last = window.scrollY;\n    let pending = 0;\n    const settle = () => {\n      pending = 0;\n      const y = window.scrollY;\n      if (y > last + 4 && y > 120 && !reduce.matches) setTucked(true);\n      else if (y < last - 4 || y <= 120) setTucked(false);\n      last = y;\n    };\n    const window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n      if (pending) window.clearTimeout(pending);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') cartButtonRef.current?.focus();\n      }\n    };\n    const desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 900px)');\n    const onWide = () => {\n      if (desktop.matches) setOpen(false);\n    };\n document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n      desktop.removeEventListener('change', onWide);\n    };\n  }, [open, cartOpen]);\n\n  const closeMenu = () => {\n    setOpen(false);\n    toggleRef.current?.focus();\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      <header id=\"header\" className={'k-header' + (tucked && !open && !cartOpen ?       "src/components/Hero.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Hero.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"headline\": \"Saffron Table Dehradun\",\n  \"lede\": \"Modern Indian restaurant with a focus on authentic flavors and refined dining experiences.\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Authentic Indian Dining\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Hero\",\n  \"mark\": \"S\",\n  \"primary\": {\n    \"href\": \"#menu\",\n    \"label\": \"Explore Menu\"\n  },\n  \"secondary\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Contact Us\"\n  },\n  \"fact\": \"Based in Dehradun\",\n  \"style\": \"fullbleed\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596797038530-2c107229654b?auto=format&fit=crop&w=2000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"Spiced Indian dishes in small bowls\",\n    \"w\": 2000,\n    \"h\": 1300\n  },\n  \"shader\": false,\n  \"window\": {\n    \"title\": \"Saffron Table overview\",\n    \"labels\": [\n      \"Overview\",\n      \"Activity\",\n      \"Reports\"\n    ],\n    \"bars\": [\n      38,\n      52,\n      46,\n      64,\n      58,\n      72,\n      66,\n      84,\n      78,\n      90\n    ]\n  }\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction useMagnet<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const el = ref.current;\n    if (!el) return;\n    const fine = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (!fine || reduce) return;\n    const move = (event: PointerEvent) => {\n      if (event.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;\n      const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n      const x = ((event.clientX - box.left) / box.width - 0.5) * 16;\n      const y = ((event.clientY - box.top) / box.height - 0.5) * 12;\n      el.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + x.toFixed(1) + 'px, ' + y.toFixed(1) + 'px, 0)';\n    };\n    const leave = () => {\n      el.style.transform = '';\n    };\n    el.addEventListener('pointermove', move);\n    el.addEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    return () => {\n      el.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);\n      el.removeEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    };\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Hero() {\n  const magnetRef = useMagnet<HTMLAnchorElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"hero\" className=\"k-section k-hero k-hero--fullbleed\" aria-labelledby=\"hero-title\" data-section=\"hero\">\n      <div className=\"k-hero__bg\">\n        <Media img={DATA.img} priority={true} variant={1} className=\"k-hero__bgmedia\" />\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"k-hero__shade\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n      <div className=\"k-container k-hero__inner\">\n        <div className=\"k-hero__copy\">\n          {DATA.tagline ? <p className=\"k-eyebrow k-hero__eyebrow k-rise-2\">{DATA.tagline}</p> : null}\n          <h1 id=\"hero-title\" className=\"k-display k-hero__title\" data-motion=\"text-in\">{DATA.headline}</h1>\n          <p className=\"k-lede k-hero__lede k-rise-2\">{DATA.lede}</p>\n          <div className=\"k-actions k-rise-3\">\n            <a ref={magnetRef} className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary\" href={DATA.primary.href}>{DATA.primary.label}</a>\n            <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-hero__ghost\" href={DATA.secondary.href}>{DATA.secondary.label}</a>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.fact ? <p className=\"k-hero__fact k-rise-3\">{DATA.fact}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Hero;\n",

      "src/components/Menu.tsx": "import { useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport type { KeyboardEvent as ReactKeyboardEvent } from 'react';\nimport { flushSync } from 'react-dom';\nimport './Menu.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Menu\",\n  \"intro\": \"Explore a selection of traditional and contemporary Indian dishes.\",\n  \"categories\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Starters\",\n      \"items\": [\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Punjabi Chana\",\n          \"description\": \"Spiced chickpeas with a hint of cumin and garlic.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Bhelpuri\",\n          \"description\": \"Crunchy puffed rice with tamarind chutney.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        }\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Main Courses\",\n      \"items\": [\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Butter Chicken\",\n          \"description\": \"Marinated chicken in a rich tomato-based sauce.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Mutton Korma\",\n          \"description\": \"Slow-cooked mutton in a fragrant coconut milk sauce.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        }\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Beverages\",\n      \"items\": [\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Lassi\",\n          \"description\": \"Creamy yogurt drink with a touch of cardamom.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        },\n        {\n          \"name\": \"Masala Chai\",\n          \"description\": \"Spiced tea with a hint of cinnamon and ginger.\",\n          \"price\": \"\"\n        }\n      ]\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"S\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1601050690597-df0568f70950?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"Freshly made samosas\",\n    \"w\": 1000,\n    \"h\": 1250\n  },\n  \"empty\": \"Ask Saffron Table for today's menu.\"\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function Menu() {\n  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);\n  const tabsRef = useRef<Array<HTMLButtonElement | null>>([]);\n  const select = (index: number, focus: boolean) => {\n    const count = DATA.categories.length;\n    const next = (index + count) % count;\n    const apply = () => setActive(next);\n    const doc: any = document;\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (doc.startViewTransition && !reduce) {\n      doc.startViewTransition(() => flushSync(apply));\n    } else {\n      apply();\n    }\n    if (focus) tabsRef.current[next]?.focus();\n  };\n  const onKey = (event: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, index: number) => {\n    const last = DATA.categories.length - 1;\n    const moves: Record<string, number> = { ArrowRight: index + 1, ArrowLeft: index - 1, Home: 0, End: last };\n    if (event.key in moves) {\n      event.preventDefault();\n      select(moves[event.key], true);\n    }\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"menu\" className=\"k-section k-menu\" aria-labelledby=\"menu-title\" data-section=\"menu\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-menu-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-menu-intro\">\n          <h2 id=\"menu-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n          <Media img={DATA.img} variant={3} mark={DATA.mark} className=\"k-menu-media k-settle\" />\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-menu-board\">\n          <div className=\"k-menu-tabs\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label={DATA.title}>\n            {DATA.categories.map((cat: any, i: number) => (\n              <button onClick={() => select(i, false)} onKeyDown={(event: ReactKeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => onKey(event, i)} ref={(el: HTMLButtonElement | null) => { tabsRef.current[i] = el; }} key={i} type=\"button\" role=\"tab\" id={'menu-tab-' + i} aria-selected={active === i} aria-controls=\"menu-panel\" tabIndex={active === i ? 0 : -1} className=\"k-menu-tab\">{cat.name}</button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n          <div id=\"menu-panel\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-labelledby={'menu-tab-' + active} className=\"k-menu-panel\" tabIndex={0}>\n            <ul className=\"k-menu-dishes\">\n              {DATA.categories[active].items.map((dish: any, i: number) => (\n                <li className=\"k-menu-dish\" key={i}>\n                  <div className=\"k-menu-dishrow\">\n                    <h3 className=\"k-menu-dishname\">{dish.name}</h3>\n                    {dish.price ? <span className=\"k-menu-leader\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> : null}\n                    {dish.price ? <span className=\"k-menu-price\">{dish.price}</span> : null}\n                  </div>\n                  {dish.description ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{dish.description}</p> : null}\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Menu;\n",

' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ?       "src/components/Contact.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport type { FormEvent as ReactFormEvent } from 'react';\nimport './Contact.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Contact Us\",\n  \"text\": \"Visit us at 123 Main Street, Dehradun.\",\n  \"button\": \"Come Visit\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Contact\",\n  \"mark\": \"S\",\n  \"email\": \"\",\n  \"location\": \"Dehradun\",\n  \"note\": \"This form isn't connected to a mailbox yet, so nothing is sent from here.\",\n  \"doneNote\": \"Thanks. This form isn't connected yet, so please reach us another way for now.\"\n};\n\nexport function Contact() {\n  const [values, setValues] = useState({ name: '', email: '', message: '' });\n  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n  const [state, setState] = useState('idle');\n  const update = (field: string, value: string) => setValues((current: any) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));\n  const submit = (event: ReactFormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    const next: Record<string, string> = {};\n    if (!values.name.trim()) next.name = 'Please add your name.';\n    if (!/^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/.test(values.email)) next.email = 'Please add a valid email address.';\n    if (values.message.trim().length < 10) next.message = 'Please write a short message of at least ten characters.';\n    setErrors(next);\n    if (Object.keys(next).length) return;\n    setState('busy');\n    window.setTimeout(() => {\n      if (DATA.email) {\n        const body = values.message + '\\n\\n' + values.name + ' (' + values.email + ')';\n        window.location.href = 'mailto:' + DATA.email + '?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(`Message from ${values.name}`) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(body);\n      }\n      setState('done');\n    }, 400);\n  };\n  return (\n    <section id=\"contact\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-contact\" aria-labelledby=\"contact-title\" data-section=\"contact\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-contact-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-contact-intro\">\n          <h2 id=\"contact-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          {DATA.text ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.text}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.email || DATA.location ? (\n            <dl className=\"k-contact-details\">\n              {DATA.email ? (\n                <div><dt>Email</dt><dd><a className=\"k-link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n              {DATA.location ? (\n                <div><dt>Location</dt><dd>{DATA.location}</dd></div>\n              ) : null}\n            </dl>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n        <form className=\"k-contact-form\" noValidate onSubmit={submit} aria-describedby=\"contact-form-note\">\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-name\">Name</label>\n            <input id=\"contact-name\" name=\"name\" type=\"text\" autoComplete=\"name\" required value={values.name} aria-invalid={errors.name ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.name ? 'contact-name-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('name', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.name ? <p id=\"contact-name-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.name}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-email\">Email</label>\n            <input id=\"contact-email\" name=\"email\" type=\"email\" autoComplete=\"email\" required value={values.email} aria-invalid={errors.email ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'contact-email-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('email', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.email ? <p id=\"contact-email-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.email}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"k-contact-field\">\n            <label htmlFor=\"contact-message\">Message</label>\n            <textarea id=\"contact-message\" name=\"message\" rows={5} required value={values.message} aria-invalid={errors.message ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.message ? 'contact-message-error' : undefined} onChange={(event) => update('message', event.target.value)} />\n            {errors.message ? <p id=\"contact-message-error\" className=\"k-contact-error\">{errors.message}</p> : null}\n          </div>\n          <button type=\"submit\" className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-contact-submit\" aria-busy={state === 'busy'} disabled={state === 'busy'}>{state === 'busy' ? 'Preparing\u2026' : DATA.button}</button>\n          <p id=\"contact-form-note\" className=\"k-contact-note\" aria-live=\"polite\">{state === 'done' ? DATA.doneNote : DATA.note}</p>\n        </form>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Contact;\n",
      "src/components/Contact.css": ".k-contact .k-contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-intro { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); margin: var(--k-space-2) 0 0; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details dt { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--k-muted); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-details dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-form { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-3); padding: clamp(20px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--k-line-strong); border-radius: calc(var(--k-radius-btn) / 2 + 2px); background-color: var(--k-surface); color: var(--k-ink); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field textarea { resize: vertical; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input:hover, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea:hover { border-color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field input:focus-visible, .k-contact .k-contact-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--k-accent-text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--k-accent-soft); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-field [aria-invalid=\"true\"] { border-color: #B42318; }\n.k-contact .k-contact-error { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-contact .k-contact-error::before { content: \"!       "src/components/Footer.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Footer.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Saffron Table\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Authentic Indian Dining\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"menu\",\n      \"href\": \"#menu\",\n      \"label\": \"Menu\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"about\",\n      \"href\": \"#about\",\n      \"label\": \"About\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"private-dining\",\n      \"href\": \"#private-dining\",\n      \"label\": \"Private dining\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"contact\",\n      \"href\": \"#contact\",\n      \"label\": \"Contact\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"email\": \"\",\n  \"location\": \"Dehradun\",\n  \"contactHref\": \"#contact\",\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"#contact\",\n    \"label\": \"Get in touch\"\n  },\n  \"privacy\": \"This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies. 0 : n;\n}\n\nfunction useCart() {\n  const [lines, setLines] = useState<any[]>([]);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onAdd = (event: Event) => {\n      const detail = (event as CustomEvent).detail || {};\n      if (!detail.name) return;\n      setLines((current: any[]) => {\n        if (current.some((line: any) => line.name === detail.name)) {\n          return current.map((line: any) => (line.name === detail.name ? { ...line, qty: line.qty + 1 } : line));\n        }\n        return [...current, { name: detail.name, price: detail.price || '', qty: 1 }];\n      });\n    };\n    window.addEventListener('kit-cart-add', onAdd);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('kit-cart-add', onAdd);\n  }, []);\n  const remove = (name: string) => setLines((current: any[]) => current.filter((line: any) => line.name !== name));\n  return { lines, remove };\n}\n\nfunction cartTotal(lines: any[]) {\n  return lines.reduce((sum: number, line: any) => sum + parsePrice(line.price) * line.qty, 0);\n}\n\nfunction orderBody(lines: any[], currency: string) {\n  return lines.map((line: any) => line.qty + ' x ' + line.name + (line.price ?  const y = window.scrollY;\n      if (y > last + 4 && y > 120 && !reduce.matches) setTucked(true);\n      else if (y < last - 4 || y <= 120) setTucked(false);\n      last = y;\n    };\n    const cartButtonRef.current?.focus();\n      }\n    };\n    const desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 900px)');\n    const onWide = () => {\n      if (desktop.matches) setOpen(false);\n    };\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n    desktop.addEventListener('change', onWide);\n    return () => {\n      document.body.style.overflow = previous;\n      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);\n      desktop.removeEventListener('change', onWide);\n    };\n  }, [open, cartOpen]);\n\n  const closeMenu = () => {\n    setOpen(false);\n    toggleRef.current?.focus();\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <>\n      <header id=\"header\" className={'k-header' + (tucked && !open && !cartOpen ? 'location' : undefined}>{link.label}</a>\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ul>\n        </nav>\n        {DATA.cta ? <a onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary k-header__drawer-cta\" href={DATA.cta.href}>{DATA.cta.label}</a> : null}\n        {DATA.email ? <a className=\"k-link k-header__drawer-mail\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a> : null}\n      </div>\n      {DATA.store ? (\n        <div id=\"site-cart-panel\" className={'k-header__cartpanel' + (cartOpen ?       "src/components/Hero.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Hero.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"headline\": \"Handmade ceramics from Lisbon\",\n  \"lede\": \"Discover unique pieces shaped by fire and hands\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Lisbon ceramics\",\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Hero\",\n  \"mark\": \"A\",\n  \"primary\": {\n    \"href\": \"#collection\",\n    \"label\": \"Explore collection\"\n  },\n  \"secondary\": {\n    \"href\": \"mailto:hello@asterkiln.com\",\n    \"label\": \"Contact us\"\n  },\n  \"fact\": \"Based in Lisbon\",\n  \"style\": \"split\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1578749556568-bc2c40e68b61?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"Glazed ceramic bowls and cups\",\n    \"w\": 1200,\n    \"h\": 1500\n  },\n  \"shader\": false,\n  \"window\": {\n    \"title\": \"Aster & Kiln overview\",\n    \"labels\": [\n      \"Overview\",\n      \"Activity\",\n      \"Reports\"\n    ],\n    \"bars\": [\n      38,\n      52,\n      46,\n      64,\n      58,\n      72,\n      66,\n      84,\n      78,\n      90\n    ]\n  }\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction useMagnet<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const el = ref.current;\n    if (!el) return;\n    const fine = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (!fine || reduce) return;\n    const move = (event: PointerEvent) => {\n      if (event.pointerType !== 'mouse') return;\n      const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n      const x = ((event.clientX - box.left) / box.width - 0.5) * 16;\n      const y = ((event.clientY - box.top) / box.height - 0.5) * 12;\n      el.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + x.toFixed(1) + 'px, ' + y.toFixed(1) + 'px, 0)';\n    };\n    const leave = () => {\n      el.style.transform = '';\n    };\n    el.addEventListener('pointermove', move);\n    el.addEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    return () => {\n      el.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);\n      el.removeEventListener('pointerleave', leave);\n    };\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Hero() {\n  const magnetRef = useMagnet<HTMLAnchorElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"hero\" className=\"k-section k-hero k-hero--split\" aria-labelledby=\"hero-title\" data-section=\"hero\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-hero__inner\">\n        <div className=\"k-hero__copy\">\n          {DATA.tagline ? <p className=\"k-eyebrow k-hero__eyebrow k-rise-2\">{DATA.tagline}</p> : null}\n          <h1 id=\"hero-title\" className=\"k-display k-hero__title\" data-motion=\"text-in\">{DATA.headline}</h1>\n          <p className=\"k-lede k-hero__lede k-rise-2\">{DATA.lede}</p>\n          <div className=\"k-actions k-rise-3\">\n            <a ref={magnetRef} className=\"k-btn k-btn--primary\" href={DATA.primary.href}>{DATA.primary.label}</a>\n            <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-hero__ghost\" href={DATA.secondary.href}>{DATA.secondary.label}</a>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.fact ? <p className=\"k-hero__fact k-rise-3\">{DATA.fact}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-hero__visual k-depth-slow\">\n          <Media img={DATA.img} priority={true} variant={1} mark={DATA.mark} className=\"k-hero__media\" />\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Hero;\n",

      "src/components/Collection.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Collection.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Collection\",\n  \"intro\": \"Explore our range of handmade ceramics crafted in Lisbon.\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Earthenware Vessels\",\n      \"description\": \"Simple forms shaped from natural clay.\",\n      \"img\": null,\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:hello@asterkiln.com?subject=Question%20about%20Earthenware%20Vessels\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Raku Ware\",\n      \"description\": \"Textured surfaces with a subtle earthy finish.\",\n      \"img\": null,\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:hello@asterkiln.com?subject=Question%20about%20Raku%20Ware\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Ceramic Plates\",\n      \"description\": \"Functional pieces with a matte, clay-like surface.\",\n      \"img\": null,\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:hello@asterkiln.com?subject=Question%20about%20Ceramic%20Plates\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Handbuilt Jars\",\n      \"description\": \"Unfinished edges and natural clay textures.\",\n      \"img\": null,\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:hello@asterkiln.com?subject=Question%20about%20Handbuilt%20Jars\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"A\"\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const root = ref.current;\n    if (!root) return;\n    const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\"]'));\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (reduce || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {\n      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('is-visible'));\n      return;\n    }\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n          entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');\n          observer.unobserve(entry.target);\n        }\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.12 });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Collection() {\n  const revealRef = useReveal<HTMLElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"collection\" className=\"k-section k-collection\" aria-labelledby=\"collection-title\" data-section=\"collection\" ref={revealRef}>\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"collection-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-collection-grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className=\"k-collection-card\" key={i} data-product={item.name} data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\">\n              <Media img={item.img} variant={(i % 3) + 1} mark={item.name.charAt(0)} className=\"k-collection-media k-settle\" />\n              <div className=\"k-collection-body\">\n                <div className=\"k-collection-row\">\n                  <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.name}</h3>\n                  {item.price ? <p className=\"k-collection-price\">{item.price}</p> : null}\n                </div>\n                {item.description ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.description}</p> : null}\n                <a className=\"k-link k-collection-ask\" href={item.ask}>Ask about this piece</a>\n              </div>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Collection;\n",
      "src/components/Collection.css": ".k-collection .k-collection-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px) clamp(20px, 3vw, 32px); }\n.k-collection .k-collection-card { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; }\n.k-collection .k-collection-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }\n.k-collection .k-collection-body { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); justify-items: start; }\n.k-collection .k-collection-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--k-space-2); width: 100%; }\n.k-collection .k-collection-price { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }\n.k-collection .k-collection-add { margin-top: var(--k-space-1); min-height: var(--k-tap); }\n.k-collection .k-collection-ask { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--k-tap); font-weight: 600; }\n",
      "src/components/GlazeStories.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './GlazeStories.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Glaze Stories\",\n  \"intro\": \"Learn about the colors and textures that define our ceramics\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"The science of color in glaze\",\n      \"excerpt\": \"Each glaze is a blend of minerals and oxides that create unique hues\",\n      \"tag\": \"Glaze chemistry\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1493106641515-6b5631de4bb9?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"A potter working at the studio bench\",\n        \"w\": 1200,\n        \"h\": 750\n      }\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"How glaze interacts with clay\",\n      \"excerpt\": \"The firing process transforms liquid glaze into a durable surface\",\n      \"tag\": \"Firing process\",\n      \"img\": null\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"The history of glaze techniques\",\n      \"excerpt\": \"Traditional methods have been refined over centuries of ceramic practice\",\n      \"tag\": \"Ceramic history\",\n      \"img\": null\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"A\"\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function GlazeStories() {\n  return (\n    <section id=\"glaze-stories\" className=\"k-section k-section--tint k-glaze-stories\" aria-labelledby=\"glaze-stories-title\" data-section=\"glaze-stories\">\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"glaze-stories-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-glaze-stories-grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className={'k-glaze-stories-cell' + (i === 0 ? ' k-glaze-stories-cell--lead' : '')} key={i}>\n              <article className={'k-glaze-stories-card'}>\n                {i === 0 ? <Media img={item.img} variant={2} mark={item.title.charAt(0)} className=\"k-glaze-stories-media\" /> : null}\n                <div className=\"k-glaze-stories-body\">\n                  {item.tag ? <p className=\"k-glaze-stories-tag\">{item.tag}</p> : null}\n                  <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.title}</h3>\n                  {item.excerpt ? <p className=\"k-glaze-stories-excerpt\">{item.excerpt}</p> : null}\n                </div>\n              </article>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default GlazeStories;\n",
      "src/components/GlazeStories.css": ".k-glaze-stories .k-glaze-stories-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-auto-rows: minmax(180px, auto); gap: clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 28px); }\n.k-glaze-stories .k-glaze-stories-cell--lead { grid-row: span 2; }\n.k-glaze-stories .k-glaze-stories-card { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; height: 100%; padding: clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 32px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-glaze-stories .k-glaze-stories-cell--lead .k-glaze-stories-card { background-color: var(--k-accent-soft); border-color: transparent; }\n.k-glaze-stories .k-glaze-stories-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; }\n.k-glaze-stories .k-glaze-stories-body { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); }\n.k-glaze-stories .k-glaze-stories-tag { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-glaze-stories .k-glaze-stories-excerpt { color: var(--k-ink); opacity: 0.86; }\n@media (max-width: 960px) { .k-glaze-stories .k-glaze-stories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }\n@media (max-width: 640px) { .k-glaze-stories .k-glaze-stories-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .k-glaze-stories .k-glaze-stories-cell--lead { grid-row: auto; } }\n",
      "src/components/CareGuide.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './CareGuide.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"How to Care for Your Ceramics\",\n  \"intro\": \"Keep your ceramics in good condition with simple steps\",\n  \"steps\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Avoid extreme temperatures\",\n      \"text\": \"Do not expose ceramics to sudden heat or cold. Let them adjust gradually to prevent cracking.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Use gentle cleaning\",\n      \"text\": \"Wipe surfaces with a soft cloth. Avoid abrasive cleaners or scrubbers that can scratch the surface.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Store with care\",\n      \"text\": \"Place ceramics in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. Use a tray or cushion to prevent chipping.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Handle with care\",\n      \"text\": \"Always lift ceramics by the base. Avoid dropping or hitting them against hard surfaces.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"Care guide\",\n  \"mark\": \"A\",\n  \"img\": {\n    \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1565193566173-7a0ee3dbe261?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80\",\n    \"alt\": \"Hands shaping clay on a pottery wheel\",\n    \"w\": 1000,\n    \"h\": 1250\n  }\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function CareGuide() {\n  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);\n  const listRef = useRef<HTMLOListElement | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const list = listRef.current;\n    if (!list || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;\n    const items = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-step]'));\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) setCurrent(Number((entry.target as HTMLElement).dataset.step || 0));\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -45% 0px' });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  const total = DATA.steps.length;\n  const progress = total > 1 ? current / (total - 1) : 1;\n  return (\n    <section id=\"care-guide\" className=\"k-section k-care-guide\" aria-labelledby=\"care-guide-title\" data-section=\"care-guide\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-care-guide-grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-care-guide-pin\" data-motion=\"sticky-story\">\n          <div className=\"k-care-guide-visual\">\n            <Media img={DATA.img} variant={3} mark={DATA.mark} className=\"k-care-guide-media\" />\n            <div className=\"k-care-guide-meter\">\n              <p className=\"k-care-guide-counter\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                <span className=\"k-care-guide-now\">{String(current + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span> / {String(total).padStart(2, '0')}\n              </p>\n              <svg className=\"k-care-guide-line\" viewBox=\"0 0 100 4\" preserveAspectRatio=\"none\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                <line x1=\"0\" y1=\"2\" x2=\"100\" y2=\"2\" pathLength={1} className=\"k-care-guide-track\" />\n                <line x1=\"0\" y1=\"2\" x2=\"100\" y2=\"2\" pathLength={1} className=\"k-care-guide-fill\" style={{ strokeDashoffset: 1 - progress }} />\n              </svg>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"k-care-guide-copy\">\n          <div className=\"k-head\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"care-guide-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n          <ol className=\"k-care-guide-list\" ref={listRef}>\n            {DATA.steps.map((step: any, i: number) => (\n              <li key={i} data-step={i} className=\"k-care-guide-step\" aria-current={current === i ? 'step' : undefined}>\n                <span className=\"k-care-guide-num\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n                <div className=\"k-care-guide-text\">\n                  <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{step.title}</h3>\n                  {step.text ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{step.text}</p> : null}\n                </div>\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ol>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default CareGuide;\n",
      "src/components/CareGuide.css": ".k-care-guide .k-care-guide-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr); gap: clamp(32px, 6vw, 96px); align-items: start; }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-pin { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--k-header-h) + 32px); }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-visual { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; max-height: 70vh; }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-meter { display: grid; gap: 10px; }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-counter { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--k-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-now { color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-line { width: 100%; height: 4px; overflow: visible; }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-track, .k-care-guide .k-care-guide-fill { stroke-width: 4; fill: none; }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-track { stroke: var(--k-line); }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-fill { stroke: var(--k-accent); stroke-dasharray: 1; transition: stroke-dashoffset 420ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-list { display: grid; }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--k-space-2); min-height: 38vh; padding-block: var(--k-space-4); border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line); opacity: 0.42; transition: opacity 300ms var(--k-ease); }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-step[aria-current=\"step\"] { opacity: 1; }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-num { font-family: var(--k-font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--k-accent-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }\n.k-care-guide .k-care-guide-text { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); align-content: start; }\n@media (max-width: 860px) {\n  .k-care-guide .k-care-guide-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }\n  .k-care-guide .k-care-guide-pin { position: static; }\n  .k-care-guide .k-care-guide-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; }\n  .k-care-guide .k-care-guide-step { min-height: 0; opacity: 1; }\n}\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .k-care-guide .k-care-guide-step { opacity: 1; } }\n",
      "src/components/StudioNotes.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './StudioNotes.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Studio Notes\",\n  \"intro\": \"Learn about the process and philosophy behind our ceramics\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Clay is shaped by hand\",\n      \"excerpt\": \"Each piece begins with a lump of clay molded by hand\",\n      \"tag\": \"Process\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1610701596007-11502861dcfa?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"Handmade ceramic vessels on a shelf\",\n        \"w\": 1200,\n        \"h\": 750\n      }\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Glazes are applied in layers\",\n      \"excerpt\": \"Multiple layers of glaze are fired to create depth and texture\",\n      \"tag\": \"Fire\",\n      \"img\": null\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Ceramics are fired in a kiln\",\n      \"excerpt\": \"Each piece is fired at high temperatures to harden and vitrify\",\n      \"tag\": \"Kiln\",\n      \"img\": null\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"A\"\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ?       "src/components/StudioNotes.css": ".k-studio-notes .k-studio-notes-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-auto-rows: minmax(180px, auto); gap: clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 28px); }\n.k-studio-notes .k-studio-notes-cell--lead { grid-row: span 2; }\n.k-studio-notes .k-studio-notes-card { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; height: 100%; padding: clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 32px); border: 1px solid var(--k-line); border-radius: var(--k-radius); background-color: var(--k-bg); color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-studio-notes .k-studio-notes-cell--lead .k-studio-notes-card { background-color: var(--k-accent-soft); border-color: transparent; }\n.k-studio-notes .k-studio-notes-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; }\n.k-studio-notes .k-studio-notes-body { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); }\n.k-studio-notes .k-studio-notes-tag { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--k-ink); }\n.k-studio-notes .k-studio-notes-excerpt { color: var(--k-ink); opacity: 0.86; }\n@media (max-width: 960px) { .k-studio-notes .k-studio-notes-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }\n@media (max-width: 640px) { .k-studio-notes .k-studio-notes-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .k-studio-notes .k-studio-notes-cell--lead { grid-row: auto; } }\n",
      "src/components/Footer.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Footer.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"brand\": \"Aster & Kiln\",\n  \"tagline\": \"Lisbon ceramics\",\n  \"links\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"collection\",\n      \"href\": \"#collection\",\n      \"label\": \"Collection\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"glaze-stories\",\n      \"href\": \"#glaze-stories\",\n      \"label\": \"Glaze stories\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"care-guide\",\n      \"href\": \"#care-guide\",\n      \"label\": \"Care guide\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"studio-notes\",\n      \"href\": \"#studio-notes\",\n      \"label\": \"Studio notes\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"email\": \"hello@asterkiln.com\",\n  \"location\": \"Lisbon\",\n  \"contactHref\": \"\",\n  \"cta\": {\n    \"href\": \"mailto:hello@asterkiln.com\",\n    \"label\": \"Get in touch\"\n  },\n  \"privacy\": \"This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies. Fonts load from Google Fonts and photos from Unsplash, which receive your IP address to deliver them. If you write to us, your message is used only to reply.\"\n};\n\nexport function Footer() {\n  const [privacy, setPrivacy] = useState(false);\n  const year = new Date().getFullYear();\n  return (\n    <footer id=\"site-footer\" className=\"k-footer\" data-section=\"footer\">\n      <div className=\"k-container k-footer__grid\">\n        <div className=\"k-footer__brand\">\n          <a className=\"k-footer__wordmark\" href=\"#site-main\">{DATA.brand}</a>\n          {DATA.tagline ? <p className=\"k-footer__tagline\">{DATA.tagline}</p> : null}\n          {DATA.cta ? <a className=\"k-btn k-btn--ghost k-footer__cta\" href={DATA.cta.href}>{DATA.cta.label}</a> : null}\n        </div>\n        {DATA.links.length ? (\n          <nav className=\"k-footer__col\" aria-label=\"Footer\">\n            <p className=\"k-footer__label\">Explore</p>\n            <ul className=\"k-footer__links\">\n              {DATA.links.map((link: any) => (\n                <li key={link.id}><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={link.href}>{link.label}</a></li>\n              ))}\n            </ul>\n          </nav>\n        ) : null}\n        <div className=\"k-footer__col\">\n          <p className=\"k-footer__label\">Contact</p>\n          <ul className=\"k-footer__links\">\n            {DATA.email ? <li><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={'mailto:' + DATA.email}>{DATA.email}</a></li> : null}\n            {DATA.location ? <li><span className=\"k-footer__plain\">{DATA.location}</span></li> : null}\n            {!DATA.email && DATA.contactHref ? <li><a className=\"k-footer__link\" href={DATA.contactHref}>Send a message</a></li> : null}\n            {!DATA.email && !DATA.contactHref ? <li><span className=\"k-footer__plain\">Contact details coming from {DATA.brand} directly.</span></li> : null}\n          </ul>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"k-container k-footer__base\">\n        <p>\u00a9 {year} {DATA.brand}</p>\n        <div className=\"k-footer__base-links\">\n          <button onClick={() => setPrivacy(!privacy)} type=\"button\" className=\"k-footer__privacy-toggle\" aria-expanded={privacy} aria-controls=\"footer-privacy\">Privacy</button>\n          <a className=\"k-footer__link\" href=\"#site-main\">Back to top</a>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div id=\"footer-privacy\" className=\"k-container k-footer__privacy\" hidden={!privacy}>\n        <p>{DATA.privacy}</p>\n      </div>\n    </footer>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Footer;\n",
      "src/components/Footer.css": ".k-footer { padding-block: clamp(56px, 8vw, 96px) 32px; background-color: var(--k-surface); color: var(--k-ink); border-top: 1px solid var(--k-line); }\n.k-footer .k-footer__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--k-space-6); }\n.k-footer .k-footer__brand { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; justify-items: start;
