      "src/components/Collection.tsx": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport './Collection.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Collection\",\n  \"intro\": \"Explore our range of handmade ceramics crafted in Lisbon.\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Earthen Vessels\",\n      \"description\": \"Simple forms shaped by hand, textured with clay and glaze.\",\n      \"img\": null,\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:hello@asterkiln.com?subject=Question%20about%20Earthen%20Vessels\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Terracotta Bowls\",\n      \"description\": \"Functional pieces with a natural, earthy finish.\",\n      \"img\": null,\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:hello@asterkiln.com?subject=Question%20about%20Terracotta%20Bowls\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Raku Ware\",\n      \"description\": \"Unique textures from the raku firing process.\",\n      \"img\": null,\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:hello@asterkiln.com?subject=Question%20about%20Raku%20Ware\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"name\": \"Handbuilt Cups\",\n      \"description\": \"Daily use pieces with a smooth, even glaze.\",\n      \"img\": null,\n      \"ask\": \"mailto:hello@asterkiln.com?subject=Question%20about%20Handbuilt%20Cups\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"A\"\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? ' ' + className : '')} data-variant={variant || 1}>\n      {mark ? <span className=\"k-art__mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{mark}</span> : null}\n      {img && !missing ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? 'sync' : 'async'} onError={() => setMissing(true)} />\n      ) : null}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {\n  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const root = ref.current;\n    if (!root) return;\n    const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\"]'));\n    const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n    if (reduce || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {\n      items.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('is-visible'));\n      return;\n    }\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {\n      entries.forEach((entry) => {\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n          entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');\n          observer.unobserve(entry.target);\n        }\n      });\n    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.12 });\n    items.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n  return ref;\n}\n\nexport function Collection() {\n  const revealRef = useReveal<HTMLElement>();\n  return (\n    <section id=\"collection\" className=\"k-section k-collection\" aria-labelledby=\"collection-title\" data-section=\"collection\" ref={revealRef}>\n      <div className=\"k-container\">\n        <div className=\"k-head k-head--split\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 id=\"collection-title\" className=\"k-h2\">{DATA.title}</h2>\n          </div>\n          {DATA.intro ? <p className=\"k-lede\">{DATA.intro}</p> : null}\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"k-collection-grid k-stagger\">\n          {DATA.items.map((item: any, i: number) => (\n            <li className=\"k-collection-card\" key={i} data-product={item.name} data-motion=\"scroll-reveal\">\n              <Media img={item.img} variant={(i % 3) + 1} mark={item.name.charAt(0)} className=\"k-collection-media k-settle\" />\n              <div className=\"k-collection-body\">\n                <div className=\"k-collection-row\">\n                  <h3 className=\"k-h3\">{item.name}</h3>\n                  {item.price ? <p className=\"k-collection-price\">{item.price}</p> : null}\n                </div>\n                {item.description ? <p className=\"k-muted\">{item.description}</p> : null}\n                <a className=\"k-link k-collection-ask\" href={item.ask}>Ask about this piece</a>\n              </div>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default Collection;\n",
      "src/components/Collection.css": ".k-collection .k-collection-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr)); gap: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px) clamp(20px, 3vw, 32px); }\n.k-collection .k-collection-card { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-2); align-content: start; }\n.k-collection .k-collection-media { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }\n.k-collection .k-collection-body { display: grid; gap: var(--k-space-1); justify-items: start; }\n.k-collection .k-collection-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--k-space-2); width: 100%; }\n.k-collection .k-collection-price { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }\n.k-collection .k-collection-add { margin-top: var(--k-space-1); min-height: var(--k-tap); }\n.k-collection .k-collection-ask { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--k-tap); font-weight: 600; }\n",
      "src/components/GlazeStories.tsx": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport './GlazeStories.css';\n\nconst DATA: any = {\n  \"title\": \"Glaze Stories\",\n  \"intro\": \"Learn about the colors and textures that make each piece unique.\",\n  \"items\": [\n    {\n      \"title\": \"The Science of Color\",\n      \"excerpt\": \"Each glaze is a blend of minerals and pigments that react during firing.\",\n      \"tag\": \"chemistry\",\n      \"img\": {\n        \"src\": \"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1493106641515-6b5631de4bb9?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80\",\n        \"alt\": \"A potter working at the studio bench\",\n        \"w\": 1200,\n        \"h\": 750\n      }\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Texture Through Fire\",\n      \"excerpt\": \"The firing process shapes the surface, creating varied finishes.\",\n      \"tag\": \"process\",\n      \"img\": null\n    },\n    {\n      \"title\": \"Natural Origins\",\n      \"excerpt\": \"Many glazes are derived from natural minerals and earth elements.\",\n      \"tag\": \"sustainability\",\n      \"img\": null\n    }\n  ],\n  \"eyebrow\": \"\",\n  \"mark\": \"A\"\n};\n\nfunction Media({ img, priority, variant, mark, className }: any) {\n  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);\n  return (\n    <div className={'k-media k-art' + (className ? (\n        <img alt={img.alt} src={img.src} width={img.w} height={img.h} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} fetchPriority={priority ? 'high' : 'auto'} decoding={priority ? `````markdown
# SiteAgent Motion Curriculum — Training Guide

## Files

- `siteagent_motion_sft_v1.jsonl` — 36 SFT trajectories.
- `siteagent_motion_eval_v1.jsonl` — 12 held-out motion prompts.
- `siteagent_motion_dataset_manifest.json` — hashes, counts, and validation metadata.

## Capability coverage

The training set contains six distinct capability families:

1. Scroll-triggered reveals using `IntersectionObserver`.
2. Parallax scrolling using passive scroll events + `requestAnimationFrame`.
3. Horizontal scroll storytelling using normal vertical progress and a sticky track, with **no wheel/touch hijacking**.
4. Sticky narrative layouts using CSS `position: sticky`.
5. Accessible text reveal on scroll with an unsplit accessible heading label.
6. Micro-interactions with hover/focus/pressed parity and short transform/color transitions.

Each family contains five positive examples across different visual domains, plus one repair trajectory targeting a common production failure. The data intentionally uses browser APIs and CSS rather than assuming GSAP or Framer Motion is installed.

## Important: do not train on this file alone

Use this as a **separate motion curriculum** mixed into the existing Qwen3 quality/replay data. Training exclusively on the motion set would increase catastrophic-forgetting and template-collapse risk.

A practical first experiment is to make motion examples roughly 10–20% of an SFT epoch while retaining the existing interaction, repair, full-site, component, accessibility, and 3D data. Keep sampling balanced by `category`, not by raw row count.

## Preflight

Run the repository's normal Qwen3 data checks on the motion file before merging:

```bash
python training/train_sft.py \
  --data siteagent_motion_sft_v1.jsonl \
  --preflight-only
```

The generated data contains no `<think>` or `<thought>` targets and every assistant turn emits exactly one tool action.

## Recommended integration

Do not copy held-out evaluation prompts into training.

Suggested pipeline:

```text
existing quality_candidate/train.jsonl
            +
siteagent_motion_sft_v1.jsonl
            ↓
family-aware / category-balanced mixer
            ↓
leakage check against:
  - react_ts_css_eval_set_combined.jsonl
  - full_website_benchmark.jsonl
  - siteagent_motion_eval_v1.jsonl
            ↓
Qwen3 tokenizer preflight
            ↓
scratch / continued Qwen3 SFT candidate
            ↓
motion behavioral benchmark
```

For an already-trained Qwen3 adapter, prefer a low-LR curriculum continuation only after confirming it is genuinely based on the correct Qwen3-4B weights. Keep replay examples in the same run.

## Motion behavioral acceptance tests

A motion model should not pass merely because the source contains strings such as `IntersectionObserver` or `position: sticky`. Run the generated site in Playwright and test behavior.

### Scroll reveal

- Element has readable content before JavaScript.
- Scrolling it into view changes its motion state.
- Observer disconnects / unobserves.
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` keeps content visible without movement.

### Parallax

- Scroll changes transform without React state updates per scroll tick.
- Listener is passive.
- Updates are RAF-throttled.
- RAF/listeners are cleaned up.
- No wheel/touch `preventDefault`.
- Reduced motion disables transform.

### Horizontal scroll

- Desktop scroll progresses the horizontal track.
- The page still uses normal browser vertical scrolling.
- No wheel/touch hijacking.
- At 375px, panels use native overflow or stack vertically.
- No body-level horizontal overflow.

### Sticky storytelling

- Sticky element remains pinned through the intended chapter range.
- No ancestor invalidates sticky with incompatible overflow.
- Mobile layout becomes normal document flow.

### Text reveal

- One coherent accessible heading name.
- Decorative split-word spans are hidden from assistive technologies.
- Reduced-motion mode shows the full headline instantly.

### Micro-interactions

- Hover behavior has keyboard-focus parity.
- Toggle state exposes `aria-pressed`/equivalent state.
- Animation uses transform/opacity/color instead of layout-heavy properties.
- Typical durations stay around 120–250 ms.
- No layout shift occurs on interaction.

## Library policy

Default to native CSS + browser APIs. If the user explicitly asks for GSAP/ScrollTrigger or Framer Motion:

1. call dependency inspection;
2. install the package through the controlled dependency manager;
3. generate library-specific code only after installation succeeds;
4. still implement reduced-motion behavior and cleanup;
5. never train examples that silently import an unverified package.

## Dataset validation result

# 2. Critical Issues to Fix Before More Model Training

## P0 — Base model identity is inconsistent

The exported `base-model/config.json` labels `_name_or_path` as `Qwen/Qwen3-4B` but declares `Qwen2ForCausalLM`, `model_type: qwen2`, hidden size 2048, 16 attention heads and 2 KV heads. This is not a sufficient Qwen3 identity.

The migration verifier currently checks mainly that `_name_or_path` contains `Qwen3`, so a relabeled older configuration can pass.

### Fix

Reject startup/training unless the base model fingerprint matches the expected Qwen3 architecture. At minimum verify:

- architecture class
- `model_type`
- hidden size
- intermediate size
- attention heads
- KV heads
- layer count
- tensor shapes in the model shards
- tokenizer/config compatibility
- model repository revision/hash

Store an immutable model fingerprint in `base-model/manifest.json`.

## P0 — Server still points at the legacy adapter path

`server/app.py` points `MODEL_PATH` at `my-react-agent-lora`, while the candidate Qwen3 adapter is under `models/qwen3-siteagent-r16-sft`.

Do not let the frontend claim `Qwen3-4B` from hardcoded Zustand defaults. `/api/status` must expose the model actually loaded, including base fingerprint and adapter fingerprint.

## P0 — Migration and benchmark orchestration uses mocks

The migration orchestrator calls context/base/site/comparison benchmark helpers with `mock=True` in several steps and Step J / Step M contain hardcoded metric dictionaries.

Mock mode is useful for CI contract tests, but it must never produce promotion evidence.

### Fix

Every benchmark report must include:

```json
{
  "provenance": "real",
  "model_sha256": "...",
  "adapter_sha256": "...",
  "dataset_sha256": "...",
  "git_commit": "...",
  "hardware": "...",
  "mock": false
}
```

Promotion must reject reports where `mock != false` or provenance is not `real`.

## P0 — Frontend validation can default to green

The agent store currently treats absent typecheck/build/lint values as `true`, and the completion summary also defaults absent code/build/preview values to true.

Use tri-state validation:

```text
unknown
passed
failed
```

Never render green for an absent value.

## P0 — Static lint fails open

If the static/acceptance checker throws, `run_static_lint` currently returns success with a warning.

For production verification this must fail closed:

```text
checker exception -> gate status unknown/failed -> aggregate not valid
```

## P0 — Browser runtime fallback can falsely pass

If Playwright is unavailable, the fallback only checks that returned HTML contains `<div id="root">`, then can report runtime success. That does not prove React mounted and does not detect console/page errors.

Production validation should require Playwright (or equivalent browser execution). A static root-container check should be reported as `runtime_unverified`, never `passed`.

## P1 — “5-gate” documentation and code differ

The documentation describes a separate contract/accessibility gate, but the current `ValidationResult` does not expose an independent contract/accessibility field; acceptance checks are folded into lint.

Either:

1. add `contract_passed` and `accessibility_passed`, or
2. rename the documentation to match the actual gate model.

## P1 — Project WebSocket migration remains hybrid

SSE remains in the generation path while a project WebSocket also exists.

Choose the WebSocket as authoritative and keep SSE only as a compatibility fallback until removal.

## P1 — Source-export generation is corruptible

The exported architecture/source markdown contains fence/code contamination inside the `server/app.py` section.

Fix the documentation generator by:

- using length-prefixed source blocks or escaped fences
- choosing a fence longer than any fence found in source
- storing a file SHA-256 next to each embedded section
- validating extracted source bytes against original file hashes
- failing export if round-trip reconstruction is not exact

# 3. Professional-Grade Website Model Improvements

The current project already has several strong ingredients: an explicit professional-site contract, interaction/accessibility requirements, responsive constraints, a visual judge, diversity evaluator, self-contained-code guards, full-site evaluation, 3D tooling, dynamic output budgets and a repair loop.

The next improvements should focus on **measured design quality**, not just more SFT rows.

## A. Fix the real Qwen3 foundation first

Do not add another large training run until authentic Qwen3-4B weights/config are installed and verified.

Then rerun:

1. real 6144/8192 benchmark
2. tokenizer preflight
3. real untouched Qwen3 baseline
4. scratch R16 SFT
5. real development benchmark
6. real 153-task benchmark
7. real full-site benchmark

## B. Balance layout archetypes

The diversity evaluator already detected hero collapse. Create balanced site trajectories across:

- split hero
- editorial asymmetric hero
- full-bleed image/visual hero
- bento hero
- terminal/data hero
- product-stage hero
- restrained centered hero

No archetype should dominate the training or promotion batch.

## C. Add design-planning supervision

Before file generation, condition the model on a compact structured design plan:

```json
{
  "artDirection": "editorial industrial",
  "heroArchetype": "split",
  "density": "airy",
  "typeScale": "display-heavy",
  "sectionRhythm": ["quiet", "dense", "immersive", "quiet"],
  "motion": ["text-reveal", "sticky-story"],
  "visualAnchor": "product-render",
  "mobileStrategy": "stack"
}
```

The plan should be generated/selected by deterministic orchestration where possible, not exposed as hidden reasoning.

## D. Evaluate behavioral and visual outcomes separately

A site can compile and still be poor.

Maintain independent scores for:

- correctness/build/runtime
- prompt fidelity
- interaction behavior
- responsive behavior
- accessibility
- visual composition
- motion quality
- performance
- diversity
- fallback/recovery dependency

## E. Penalize recovery dependence

A model that needs auto-scaffolding for every site is not stronger.

Track:

```text
model-native success rate
repair success rate
fallback-free completion rate
auto-scaffold usage rate
```

Lower fallback use should be better.

# 5. Motion Implementation Rules

## Scroll reveal

Default implementation:

- `IntersectionObserver`
- opacity/transform only
- `observer.unobserve()` or `disconnect()`
- content not permanently hidden before JS
- `prefers-reduced-motion`

## Parallax

Default implementation:

- passive scroll listener
- `requestAnimationFrame`
- CSS transform / custom property
- bounded translation
- no React `setState()` every scroll tick
- cleanup listener + RAF
- disabled/reduced on mobile and reduced-motion

Never use `wheel.preventDefault()` for ordinary parallax.

## Horizontal scroll sections

Desktop:

```text
normal vertical document scroll
→ section progress
→ sticky viewport
→ translate3d horizontal track
```

Do not hijack wheel or touch.

Mobile:

```text
native overflow-x:auto + scroll-snap
```

or stack vertically.

## Sticky storytelling

Use CSS `position: sticky`.

Validate that no ancestor invalidates sticky through incompatible overflow/transform/layout choices.

Keep semantic DOM order suitable for keyboard/screen-reader navigation.

## Text reveal

Use one accessible heading label and decorative split-word/line spans:

```tsx
<h1 aria-label="Full readable heading">
  <span aria-hidden="true">Full</span>
  ...
</h1>
```

Reduced motion shows full text immediately.

## Micro-interactions

Use:

- hover + focus-visible/focus-within parity
- `aria-pressed` / `aria-selected` for state
- transform/opacity/color/border
- short durations, typically 120–250 ms
- no layout shift

---

# 6. Motion Library Policy

Default to native browser/CSS implementations because the project runs on local constrained hardware and must not hallucinate packages.

Only use GSAP/ScrollTrigger or Framer Motion when:

1. dependency inspection confirms the package, or
2. the dependency manager successfully installs it.

Never train trajectories that silently import an unverified package.

If GSAP support is added, create **separate** library-specific trajectories rather than mixing them into native examples without labels.

---

# 7. Motion Validation & Benchmarking

Add `evaluation/motion_benchmark.py` and Playwright behavioral tests.

A regex/code-level judge is not sufficient because models can satisfy it by including strings without correct behavior.

## Runtime tests

### Scroll reveal

Measure an element before and after scrolling into view.

### Parallax

Verify transform changes across scroll positions and that no wheel/touch event is prevented.

### Horizontal scroll

Verify desktop track translation and mobile native overflow/scroll-snap.

### Sticky

Measure bounding-box position while the page progresses through the sticky range.

### Text reveal

Check accessible name, `aria-hidden` split spans, and reduced-motion visibility.

### Micro-interactions

Use mouse + keyboard focus and assert visual/state changes.

## Performance checks

Capture:

- page errors
- console errors
- long tasks if available
- layout shifts
- uncontrolled requestAnimationFrame loops
- listener cleanup
- body horizontal overflow
- mobile 375 px behavior

## 1. Project Overview & Architecture

Modern code generation benchmarks often focus on single-shot output: a model receives an instruction and outputs code. If the code has a missing import, a misnamed prop, or a failing edge case, it receives a score of 0.

Human engineers do not write code this way: they compile, read compiler errors and test assertions, diagnose the root cause, and iterate until all tests pass.

```
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │                       USER PROMPT                      │
       │    "Write a React TypeScript PinInputCode component"   │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │                   AGENT MODEL (3B)                     │
       │   1. <thought> (Plan & diagnose failure)               │
       │   2. <tool_call name="write_component">                │
       │        <tsx>...</tsx>                                  │
       │        <css>...</css>                                  │
       │      </tool_call>                                      │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                                   ▼
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │               AUTOMATED TEST HARNESS                   │
       │   1. TypeScript Compilation (tsc --noEmit)             │
       │   2. Live Vitest + Testing Library Test Runner         │
       └───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                                   │
                    ┌──────────────┴──────────────┐
                    │                             │
             [Tests Passed?]               [Tests Failed?]
                    │                             │
                   YES                            NO
                    │                             │
                    ▼                             ▼
       ┌─────────────────────────┐   ┌─────────────────────────┐
       │       <finish>          │   │      <observation>      │
       │  Verified completion!   │   │  Error trace & DOM dump │
       └─────────────────────────┘   └────────────┬────────────┘
                                                  │
                                                  └──► (Next Turn: Self-Correct)
```

---

## 2. Phase 1 — Foundations: Single-Shot vs. Agentic Loop

Initially, the project explored standard 1-shot Alpaca-style fine-tuning (`### Instruction: ... \n### Response: ...`).
- **Base Model**: `unsloth/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct`
- **Evaluation Benchmark**: 153 tasks (`react_ts_css_eval_set_combined.jsonl`) spanning forms, navigation, overlays, data tables, and custom hooks.

### The Problem with 1-Shot on 3B Models
A 3B model has high syntax capability but frequently trips on minor edge cases:
- Rendering `props.value` instead of `props.value || ""` (triggering uncontrolled input warnings).
- Forgetting an `aria-label="Digit 1"` attribute expected by `@testing-library/react`.
- Naming a prop `valueChange` when the test passes `onChange`.

In single-shot evaluation, these minor issues resulted in a **failed task**. Giving the model an interactive test loop with compiler feedback was necessary to unlock high pass rates.

---

## 3. Phase 2 — The Action Space Protocol: Why XML?

Standard function calling (JSON-based schemas like OpenAI Tools) failed consistently on 3B models:
- **JSON Escaping Hell**: Escaping double quotes, template literals (`` `${x}` ``), and multi-line strings inside JSON blocks caused frequent JSON parse crashes.
- **Context Waste**: JSON schema wrappers added 150+ tokens per turn of overhead.

### The XML Solution (`agent_protocol.py`)
We designed an XML tag-based action space:
```xml
<thought>
Explain reasoning, diagnose test failures, or formulate a plan.
</thought>
<tool_call name="write_component">
<tsx>
// Clean React + TypeScript code (no escaping needed)
</tsx>
<css>
/* Optional CSS / CSS module */
</css>
</tool_call>
```
When tests pass:
```xml
<finish>
Brief summary of the verified solution.
</finish>
```
The testing environment returns feedback via:
```xml
<observation status="failed">
[TSC]: Passed (0 errors)
[Vitest Test Failure]:
  × renders the correct number of digit inputs
    → Expected 4 inputs, found 0
</observation>
```

---

## 4. What Didn't Work: Failures, Bugs & Root Causes

During development, several critical failure modes were diagnosed and resolved:

### Bug 1: Unmasked Loss Dilution in SFT
- **Symptom**: The model was slow to learn self-correction logic and would often repeat test-runner phrases.
- **Root Cause**: `train_agent.py` was calling `SFTTrainer(dataset_text_field="text")` without token masking. Loss was computed across the entire conversation:
  - ~600 tokens of static `AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT`
  - User prompt
  - Large `<observation>` test output blocks (Vitest error stacks)
- **Impact**: On a 3B model with a small trajectory dataset, 70%+ of the gradient steps were wasted memorizing deterministic test-runner strings rather than learning code synthesis and error diagnosis.

---

### Bug 2: The "Hybrid" Non-Agent Dataset Contamination
- **Symptom**: When trained on `train_trajectories_hybrid.jsonl` (657 examples), the agent frequently output code directly inside `<finish>` without ever calling `write_component`.
- **Root Cause**: Upon inspection, 350 out of 657 examples (53.3%) in `train_trajectories_hybrid.jsonl` were legacy 3-message examples (`hybrid_ts_*`):
  ```xml
  <thought>
  I will write the TypeScript solution.
  </thought>
  <finish>
  ```typescript
  import path from "path";
  export default ...
  ```
  </finish>
  ```
- **Impact**: The model was rewarded for bypassing the test harness entirely. It treated `<finish>` as a markdown code block, directly violating the agentic tool-use protocol.

---

### Bug 3: Benchmark Eval Set Data Leakage
- **Symptom**: Suspiciously high 1-shot pass rates during initial evaluation.
- **Root Cause**: 164 of the 307 valid agent trajectories in `train_trajectories_hybrid.jsonl` had prompts identical to the 153 benchmark tasks in `react_ts_css_eval_set_combined.jsonl`.
- **Impact**: The evaluation was measuring memorization rather than true out-of-distribution reasoning and self-correction.

---

### Bug 4: TypeScript Duplicate Declaration Crash (`TS2440`)
- **Symptom**: During early STaR generation runs on `star_task_bank.jsonl`, **100% of tasks failed on Turn 1** with compiler errors like:
  ```
  TS2440: Import declaration conflicts with local declaration of 'PinInputCode'.
  Cannot redeclare block-scoped variable 'PinInputCode'.
  ```
- **Root Cause**:
  - `eval_custom.py` automatically generated component bindings:
    ```typescript
    import * as __Mod from './Component';
    const PinInputCode = (__Mod as any).PinInputCode ?? (__Mod as any).default;
    ```
  - Meanwhile, the test code written in `star_task_bank.jsonl` had top-level imports:
    ```typescript
    import { PinInputCode } from './Component';
    ```
  - When concatenated into `Component.test.tsx`, TypeScript crashed before running Vitest.
  - Because the model can only write `Component.tsx` and cannot edit `Component.test.tsx`, it became stuck in an unresolvable loop.

---

### Bug 5: Placeholder / Dummy Trajectory Harvesting
- **Symptom**: Harvested STaR files had tiny file sizes and missing code.
- **Root Cause**: `generate_star_trajectories.py` had placeholder rollout logic:
  ```python
  # Old code:
  history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": "// Verified implementation"})
  ```
  It was discarding the agent's actual generated TSX, CSS, and intermediate repair turns.

---

### Bug 6: `UnboundLocalError` Crash on Clean Passes
- **Symptom**: In the middle of an overnight 150-task STaR run, the pipeline crashed at Task #12 (`ProgressStepBar`) with:
  ```
  UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable 'regress_warn' where it is not associated with a value
  ```
- **Root Cause**: In `agent_loop.py`, `regress_warn` was defined only inside the test-failure `else:` block:
  ```python
  if passed:
      final_passed = True
  else:
      regress_warn = "..."
  # Later:
  if regress_warn and "</observation>" in obs: # <-- Crashed when passed=True!
  ```

---

## 5. What Worked: Systematic Fixes & Engineering Solutions

### Fix 1: Response-Only Loss Masking
In `train_agent.py`, we integrated Unsloth's response-only loss masking:
```python
from unsloth.chat_templates import train_on_responses_only

trainer = train_on_responses_only(
    trainer,
    instruction_part="<|im_start|>user\n",
    response_part="<|im_start|>assistant\n",
)
```
- **Result**: Tokens in the system prompt, user prompt, and `<observation>` blocks are assigned a label of `-100` (ignored by cross-entropy loss).
- **Benefit**: 100% of the model's limited 3B capacity is dedicated to generating high-quality `<thought>`, `<tool_call>`, and `<finish>` tokens.

---

### Fix 2: Universal Test Import Sanitization
In `eval_custom.py`, we introduced `strip_test_imports()`:
```python
def strip_test_imports(code: str) -> str:
    # 1. Strip import ... from './Component', 'vitest', '@testing-library/*', 'react'
    import_from_pattern = r'import\s+[\s\S]*?from\s*[\'"][^\'"]+[\'"];?'
    cleaned = re.sub(import_from_pattern, repl_from, code)
    # 2. Strip side-effect imports like import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
    side_pattern = r'import\s+[\'"][^\'"]+[\'"];?'
    return re.sub(side_pattern, repl_side, cleaned).strip()
```
And updated the test harness template to auto-inject standard bindings and React hooks:
```typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, act, renderHook, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { vi, describe, it, test, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';

import * as __Mod from './Component';

// Injected component bindings
const PinInputCode = (__Mod as any).PinInputCode ?? (__Mod as any).default;

// Sanitized test cases start here cleanly
describe('PinInputCode Component', () => { ... });
```
- **Result**: Eliminated `TS2440` duplicate declaration crashes across all test suites.

---

### Fix 3: Anti-Stuck Escalation & Regression Guarding
In `agent_loop.py`, we implemented dynamic sampling intervention:
- If the model generates identical TSX or repeats the exact same test failure:
  1. `stuck_turns` increments.
  2. Temperature escalates (`0.20` → `0.55` → `0.90`).
  3. Repetition penalty escalates (`1.05` → `1.15` → `1.30`).
  4. An explicit intervention note is injected into the next observation:
     `"[ANTI-STUCK INTERVENTION]: Your previous attempt repeated the same failure. Alter your implementation logic."`
- When code or error state changes, sampling immediately resets to base values.

---

### Fix 4: Protocol Guidelines Injection
In both `agent_protocol.py` and `agent_loop.py`, we codified three recurring UI component patterns:
1. **Prop Fallback Aliasing**:
   `const trendVal = props.trend ?? props.valueChange ?? props.change;`
   `const initial = props.initialValues ?? props.initialState ?? props.defaultValues ?? {};`
2. **Minimal Clean Logging Rule**:
   When asked to log an action (e.g. `dispatchLogged`), output `console.log(action)` with no prepended label strings.
3. **Imperative DOM Dynamic Container Pattern**:
   Imperative hooks (`useConfirm`, `useToast`) must dynamically create and mount a container `<div>` to `document.body` if no portal root is provided in JSX.

---

### Fix 5: Incremental Flushing & Pipeline Resumption
In `generate_star_trajectories.py`:
- **Immediate Disk Flush**: Every passing rollout is appended and flushed to `star_trajectories.jsonl` immediately. If a run is interrupted, no passing rollouts are lost.
- **Resume Flag (`--resume`)**: The script reads existing task IDs from `star_trajectories.jsonl` and automatically skips completed tasks.
- **Fixed `regress_warn`**: Initialized `regress_warn = ""` alongside `anti_stuck_note = ""` to prevent runtime variable errors.

---

## 8. Phase 5 — Clean Training Corpus & SFT Training

### Dataset Assembly via `build_clean_dataset()`
To prevent the model from unlearning earlier capabilities while eliminating leaked and corrupted examples, we ran `build_clean_dataset()` across both sources:

```
[Legacy train_trajectories_hybrid.jsonl (657)]  +  [Fresh star_trajectories.jsonl (102)]
                                     │
                                     ▼
                       build_clean_dataset() Filter
         ├── Rejects 350 non-agent examples (code in <finish>)
         ├── Rejects 164 eval-set duplicates (prevents benchmark leakage)
         └── Deduplicates 99 identical prompts
                                     │
                                     ▼
             train_trajectories_agentic.jsonl (146 Clean Trajectories)
```

### Final Dataset Verification

## 9. Phase 6 — Final Benchmark Evaluation & Results

The trained `my-react-agent-lora` was evaluated on the full held-out 153-task benchmark (`react_ts_css_eval_set_combined.jsonl`) via `agent_loop.py`, running for **16.17 hours** on the RTX 4050 GPU.

```powershell
python agent_loop.py --model my-react-agent-lora --eval-set react_ts_css_eval_set_combined.jsonl
```

### Headline Metrics

| Metric | Count | Rate |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1-Shot Pass Rate (Turn 1)** | 60 / 153 | **39.2%** |
| **Self-Corrected (Turn 2+)** | +18 / 153 | **+11.8%** |
| **Final Agentic Pass Rate** | **78 / 153** | **51.0%** |
| Failed (all 5 turns exhausted) | 75 / 153 | 49.0% |
| Average Turns Used (passing tasks) | — | 1.31 turns |

**Self-correction added +11.8 percentage points** on top of the base 1-shot rate — confirming that the agentic loop with live test feedback provides meaningful gains beyond a single-turn generation.

### Per-Category Breakdown

| Check Category | Description | Pass | 1-Shot | Self-Corrected |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `tsc_and_render` | TSC + render sanity | **30/42 (71%)** | 24 | 6 |
| `tsc_render_a11y` | TSC + render + accessibility | **3/4 (75%)** | 2 | 1 |
| `tsc_render_interact` | TSC + render + user interactions | 21/58 **(36%)** | 14 | 7 |
| `tsc_only` | TypeScript compilation only | 24/49 **(49%)** | 20 | 4 |

The model is strongest on static structure + render tasks (71%), and weakest on interactive UI tests (36%) that require correct state transitions, DOM event handling, and exact ARIA attribute targeting.

### Turns Distribution (Passed Tasks Only)

| Turns Used | Tasks |
| :--- | :--- |
| 1 turn (1-shot) | 60 |
| 2 turns | 12 |
| 3 turns | 5 |
| 4 turns | 1 |

### Failure Taxonomy (75 Failing Tasks)

After analyzing the final `<observation>` from each exhausted-turn failure:

| Root Cause Cluster | Count | Pct |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **TS: Unknown TSC failure** (complex multi-error TSC) | 33 | 44.0% |
| **TS: Undeclared identifier** (TS2304 — variable never declared) | 10 | 13.3% |
| **Test: Assertion failed** (wrong value / behavior) | 9 | 12.0% |
| **TS: Other parse/syntax** (TS1005, TS1109, TS1700, TS1701, etc.) | 8 | 10.7% |
| **Test: TypeError at runtime** (bad method call / null deref) | 4 | 5.3% |
| **Test: Element not found in DOM** (missing aria / testid) | 3 | 4.0% |
| **TS: Property does not exist** (TS2339) | 2 | 2.7% |
| Other isolated TS errors (TS2536, TS2315, TS2731, TS2345, etc.) | 6 | 8.0% |

### Failure Pattern Deep-Dive

**1. TS Unknown TSC Failure (33 tasks — biggest cluster)**
Dominant in `tsc_render_interact` (20/33) and `tsc_and_render` (7/33). The model generates syntactically plausible code that trips on multi-layered type errors it cannot resolve by turn 5. These include complex generic constraints on `DataTable`, `KanbanBoard`, `FormProvider`, and `FormWizard` where the component's internal state generics don't satisfy the test harness's type assertions.

**2. TS: Undeclared Identifier (10 tasks)**
The model references identifiers that were never declared in the same scope. Examples:
- `useQueryParams` references `parsedUrl`, `queryParamsToString`, `queryString` — none declared.
- `useCart` references cart state management variables from a non-existent import.
- `useConfirm` references `createPortal` without importing it.
Strategy: Use 3rd-party import rewriting to force model into self-contained code.

**3. Test Assertion Failures (9 tasks)**
The model's logic is close but produces wrong values. Examples:
- `useMediaQuery` returns `false` before `matchMedia` mock fires.
- `Slider` computes percentage incorrectly (off-by-one on boundary).
- `useIsMounted` returns stale ref value due to missing cleanup.
These are ideal targets for DPO pairs — the failing code vs. a corrected version.

**4. TS Parse/Syntax errors (8 tasks)**
TS1005 ("`;` expected") and TS1109 ("Expression expected") — the model generates truncated or malformed output, especially on complex hooks (`useUndo`, `useCart`, `useOnClickOutside`) where the code body is long enough to hit the `max_new_tokens=768` ceiling and gets cut off mid-statement.

## 11. Key Lessons Learned for 3B SLM Fine-Tuning


| Area | What Failed | What Succeeded |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Action Protocol** | JSON tool schemas (parse errors, escaping bugs). | Plain XML tags (`<thought>`, `<tool_call>`, `<finish>`). |
| **Loss Computation** | Unmasked loss across system prompts and observations. | `train_on_responses_only`: loss computed solely on assistant turns. |
| **Data Cleanliness** | Including non-agent prompt-response pairs in agentic corpus. | Strict trajectory validation: must call `write_component` and pass tests before `<finish>`. |
| **Eval Integrity** | Training on prompts from the eval benchmark. | Complete disjointness between training task banks and benchmark tasks. |
| **Test Harness** | Allowing tests to declare arbitrary top-level imports. | Centralized test import stripping (`strip_test_imports`) with global bindings injection. |
| **Sampling Strategy** | Fixed low temperature when model gets stuck in repetitive errors. | Dynamic Anti-Stuck escalation (raising temp & rep_penalty on repeated errors). |
| **Pipeline Reliability**| In-memory trajectory accumulation until script end. | Immediate incremental disk flushing + automatic `--resume` support. |

I'll also implement a scroll listener to trigger glassmorphism and subtle border illumination on scroll.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 15);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`sr-header${scrolled ? ' sr-header--scrolled' : ''}`} role=\"banner\">\n      <div className=\"sr-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"sr-header__logo\" aria-label=\"Savory Roots Catering Home\">\n className=\"sr-header__actions\">\n          <a href=\"mailto:events@savoryrootscatering.com\" className=\"sr-header__cta\">\n            Request Tasting\n          </a>\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            className=\"sr-header__toggle\"\n            aria-label=\"Toggle navigation menu\"\n            aria-expanded={menuOpen}\n            onClick={() => setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}\n          >\n            <span className=\"sr-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"sr-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"sr-header__bar\" />\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"sr-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#menus\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Seasonal Menus</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.sr-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(24, 28, 20, 0.92);\n  backdrop-filter: font-weight: 500;\n  transition: color 0.2s ease;\n}\n\n.sr-header__link:hover {\n  color: #84cc16;\n}\n\n.sr-header__actions {\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: vacuuming, surface sanitation, and waste sorting.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"step\": \"Phase 02\",\n    \"title\": \"Commercial Carpet Deep Extraction\",\n    \"tag\": \"Periodic\",\n    \"desc\": nodes?.forEach((node) => observer.observe(node));\n\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"sc-timeline\" id=\"services\" </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"ac-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#suites\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Private Villas</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n Notes of cassis, graphite, and violet.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"step\": \"Phase 02\",\n    \"title\": \"2023 Estate Old-Vine Chardonnay\",\n    \"tag\": \"94 Points\",\n    \"desc\": \"Native yeast fermentation with crisp brioche and green apple minerality.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"step\": \"Phase 03\",\n    \"title\": \"2022 Hillside Syrah\",\n    \"tag\": \"95 Points\",\n    \"desc\": \"Whole-cluster pressed with black peppercorn, blackberry, and smoked meat.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"step\": \"Phase 04\",\n    \"title\": \"Late Harvest Botrytis Semillon\",\n    \"tag\": \"Dessert\",\n    \"desc\": \"Golden nectar featuring candied apricot, wild honeycomb, and bright acidity.\"\n  }\n];\n\nexport function CurrentVintages() {\n  const trackRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n\n  React.useEffect(() => {\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(\n      (entries) => {\n        entries.forEach((entry) => {\n          if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n            entry.target.classList.add('is-revealed');\n          }\n        });\n      },\n      { threshold: 0.2 }\n    );\n\n    const nodes = trackRef.current?.querySelectorAll('.vp-timeline__node');\n    nodes?.forEach((node) => observer.observe(node));\n\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"vp-timeline\" id=\"vintages\" aria-labelledby=\"vp-timeline-title\">\n      <div className=\"vp-timeline__inner\">\n        <div className=\"vp-timeline__header\">\n          <p className=\"vp-timeline__eyebrow\">Sequential </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"pd-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#treatments\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Smile Treatments</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n ' sh-header--scrolled' : ''}`} role=\"banner\">\n      <div className=\"sh-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"sh-header__logo\" aria-label=\"Shield Harbor Marine Insurance Home\">\n </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"sh-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"cb-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#menu\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Daily Gluten-Free Menu</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n path=\"src/components/TelemetryEngines.tsx\">\nimport React from 'react';\nimport './TelemetryEngines.css';\n\ninterface Milestone {\n  step: string;\n  title: string;\n  tag: string;\n  desc: drops, socket retransmissions, and round-trip jitter directly inside the Linux socket layer.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"step\": \"Phase 02\",\n    \"title\": \"Distributed Trace Graph\",\n    \"tag\": \"Automatic\",\n    \"desc\": \"Autonomous trace reconstruction across microservices via kernel context propagation with zero application bytecode instrumentation.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"step\": \"Phase 03\",\n    \"title\": \"Security Anomaly Detection\",\n    \"tag\": \"Real-Time\",\n    \"desc\": \"Trap unauthorized execve syscalls, root privilege escalations, and suspicious outbound DNS queries Prometheus, Datadog, and Grafana pipelines seamlessly.\"\n  }\n];\n\nexport function TelemetryEngines() {\n  const trackRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n\n  React.useEffect(() => {\n    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(\n      (entries) => {\n        entries.forEach((entry) => {\n          if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n            entry.target.classList.add('is-revealed');\n          }\n        });\n      },\n      { threshold: 0.2 }\n    );\n\n    const nodes = trackRef.current?.querySelectorAll('.kt-timeline__node');\n    nodes?.forEach((node) => observer.observe(node));\n\n    return () => observer.disconnect();\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"kt-timeline\" id=\"engines\" aria-labelledby=\"kt-timeline-title\">\n      <div className=\"kt-timeline__inner\">\n        <div className=\"kt-timeline__header\">\n          <p className=\"kt-timeline__eyebrow\">Sequential Roadmap</p>\n          <h2 id=\"kt-timeline-title\" className=\"kt-timeline__title\">\n            Telemetry Engines\n          </h2>\n          <p className=\"kt-timeline__desc\">\n            Kernel-level eBPF packet tracing, zero-overhead Kubernetes container telemetry, and distributed latency profiling.\n          </p>\n        </div>\n\n        <div ref={trackRef} className=\"kt-timeline__track\">\n          <div className=\"kt-timeline__spine\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n          {MILESTONES.map((m) => (\n            <article key={m.title} className=\"kt-timeline__node\">\n              <div \"desc\": \"Compile bulletproof, strongly-typed client libraries directly from your validated contract specifications.\"\n  }\n];\n\nexport function TestSuites() {\n  const gridRef = </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"vh-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#vault\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Vault Highlights</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n No systemic side effects, anesthesia, or cognitive impairment.',\n      cadence: 'Daily 20-minute outpatient sessions over 6 weeks (36 total sessions)',\n      eligibility: 'Failed >= 2 antidepressant trials of adequate dose and duration',\n      physicianLead: 'Dr. Camille Laurent, MD (ABPN Board Certified Psychiatrist)',\n      clinicalCriteria: [\n        'FDA 510(k) Cleared Magstim Horizon System',\n        'Motor threshold localized via electromyography (EMG)',\n        'In-network covered by BCBS, Aetna, Cigna, Medicare Part B'\n      ]\n    },\n    psychiatry: {\n      id: 'psychiatry',\n      name: 'Adult Outpatient Psychiatry & Pharmacogenomics',\n      subtitle: 'Diagnostic Evaluation & DNA-Guided Medication Optimization',\n      description: 'Comprehensive 90-minute psychiatric evaluations integrating GeneSight pharmacogenomic swab testing to identify individualized CYP450 enzyme metabolism rates before psychotropic prescribing.',\n      cadence: 'Initial 90-min diagnostic + 30-min monthly titration reviews',\n      eligibility: 'Adults (18+) with generalized anxiety, MDD, bipolar II, or ADHD',\n      physicianLead: 'Dr. Aaron Meyer, MD (Harvard Fellow, ABPN Certified)',\n      clinicalCriteria: [\n        'GeneSight Psychotropic DNA Panel included in intake',\n        'Electronic prescribing of controlled substances (DEA EPCS Certified)',\n        'Quarterly metabolic and lab panels for lithium / atypical agents'\n      ]\n    },\n    iop: {\n      id: 'iop',\n      name: 'Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)',\n      subtitle: 'Structured Step-Down Group & Individual Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)',\n      description: 'Accredited by CARF, our IOP provides evidence-based stabilization for clients transitioning from residential care or needing higher frequency support than weekly therapy.',\n      cadence: '3 hours/day, 3 days/week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday)',\n      eligibility: 'Adults requiring intensive behavioral stabilization without 24hr inpatient risk',\n      physicianLead: 'Dr. Sarah Lin, PhD (Licensed Psychologist #PSY-29184)',\n      clinicalCriteria: [\n        'Full adherent DBT skills curriculum (Mindfulness, Distress Tolerance)',\n        'Weekly individual therapy + multi-family group modules',\n        '24/7 clinician skills-coaching line for enrolled clients'\n      ]\n    }\n  };\n\n  const current = modalities[activeTab] || modalities.tms;\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"solace-tabs\" id=\"modalities\">\n      <div className=\"solace-tabs__container\">\n        <div className=\"solace-tabs__header\">\n          <span className=\"solace-tabs__tag\">EVIDENCE-BASED CONTINUUM</span>\n          <h2 className=\"solace-tabs__title\">Clinical Treatment Modalities</h2>\n 'is-active' : ''}`}\n            onClick={() => setActiveTab('tms')}\n          >\n            Interventional TMS\n          </button>\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            role=\"tab\"\n            aria-selected={activeTab === 'psychiatry'}\n            className={`solace-tabs__btn ${activeTab === 'psychiatry' ? 'is-active' : ''}`}\n            onClick={() => setActiveTab('psychiatry')}\n          >\n            Psychiatry & Genomics\n          </button>\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            role=\"tab\"\n            aria-selected={activeTab === 'iop'}\n            className={`solace-tabs__btn ${activeTab === 'iop' ? 'is-active' : ''}`}\n            onClick={() => setActiveTab('iop')}\n          >\n            Intensive Outpatient (IOP)\n          </button>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"solace-tabs__panel\" role=\"tabpanel\">\n          <div className=\"solace-tabs__panel-top\">\n            <span className=\"solace-tabs__lead-doc\">{current.physicianLead}</span>\n            <h3 className=\"solace-tabs__panel-title\">{current.name}</h3>\n            <p className=\"solace-tabs__panel-sub\">{current.subtitle}</p>\n          </div>\n\n          <p Files: src/components/Header.tsx + src/components/Header.css"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "<thought>\nBuilding the Miso & Soul header. Ramen bars benefit from a dark, moody, restaurant-noir feel, so I'm using near-black background with a subtle red accent border that appears on scroll. The logo uses the Noto Serif JP heading font for an authentic Japanese typographic touch, while nav links stay in Inter for legibility.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 16);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`ms-header${scrolled ? ' ms-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"ms-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"ms-header__logo\">Miso &amp; Soul</a>\n        <nav className=\"ms-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"ms-header__link\">Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#menu\" className=\"ms-header__link\">Menu</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"ms-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n      </div>\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.ms-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(13, 13, 13, 0.9);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);\n  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.15);\n  transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease;\n}\n.ms-header--scrolled {\n  background: rgba(13, 13, 13, 0.98);\n  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);\n}\n.ms-header__inner {\n  max-width: 1180px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 2rem;\n  height: 70px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n}\n.ms-header__logo {\n  font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif;\n  font-size: 1.3rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  color: #f5f5f4;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  letter-spacing: 0.02em;\n}\n.ms-header__nav {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 2rem;\n}\n.ms-header__link {\n  color: #a8a29e;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  font-size: 0.88rem;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  letter-spacing: 0.04em;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  transition: color 0.2s;\n  position: relative;\n}\n.ms-header__link:hover { color: #dc2626; }\n@media (max-width: 700px) {\n  .ms-header__nav { gap: 1.1rem; }\n  .ms-header__logo { font-size: 1.1rem; }\n}\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Header.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Header.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Hero section: a full-width banner with a background image or gradient, the business tagline as an h1, a subheading, and a prominent CTA button. The tagline from the brief becomes the h1 in the Noto Serif JP font, and a single strong red CTA drives straight to the menu.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Hero.tsx\">\nimport React from 'react';\nimport './Hero.css';\n\nexport function Hero() {\n  return (\n    <section className=\"ms-hero\" id=\"hero\">\n      <div className=\"ms-hero__overlay\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n      <div className=\"ms-hero__content\">\n        <p className=\"ms-hero__eyebrow\">Sydney &middot; Est. Ramen Bar</p>\n        <h1 className=\"ms-hero__title\">Broth-first ramen,<br />made from scratch daily</h1>\n        <p className=\"ms-hero__subtitle\">\n          Every bowl starts with a broth simmered for up to 18 hours. No shortcuts,\n          no powders &mdash; just bones, time, and patience.\n        </p>\n        <a href=\"#menu\" className=\"ms-hero__cta\">View the Menu</a>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Hero.css\">\n.ms-hero {\n  position: relative;\n  min-height: 92vh;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: center;\n  overflow: hidden;\n  background:\n    linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(13,13,13,0.92) 0%, rgba(13,13,13,0.7) 55%, rgba(220,38,38,0.18) 100%),\n    url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1569718212165-3a8278d5f624?w=1600&q=80') center/cover no-repeat;\n}\n.ms-hero__overlay {\n  position: absolute;\n  inset: 0;\n  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 60%, rgba(220,38,38,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%);\n  pointer-events: none;\n}\n.ms-hero__content {\n  position: relative;\n  z-index: 1;\n  max-width: 720px;\n  padding: 2rem;\n  text-align: center;\n}\n.ms-hero__eyebrow {\n  font-size: 0.78rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  letter-spacing: 0.22em;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  color: #dc2626;\n  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;\n}\n.ms-hero__title {\n  font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif;\n  font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5.5vw, 4rem);\n  font-weight: 700;\n  color: #fafaf9;\n  line-height: 1.15;\n  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;\n}\n.ms-hero__subtitle {\n  font-size: 1.05rem;\n  color: #a8a29e;\n  line-height: 1.7;\n  margin: 0 auto 2.25rem;\n  max-width: 520px;\n}\n.ms-hero__cta {\n  display: inline-block;\n  padding: 0.85rem 2.1rem;\n  background: #dc2626;\n  color: #fafaf9;\n  border-radius: 6px;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  font-size: 0.95rem;\n  letter-spacing: 0.03em;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;\n}\n.ms-hero__cta:hover { background: #ef4444; Files: src/components/Menu.tsx + src/components/Menu.css\nWrite ONE <tool_call name=\"write_site\"> with exactly one .tsx file and one .css file for this section.\n</observation>"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "<thought>\nWith three menu categories in the brief (Ramen, Sides, Drinks), a tabbed interface keeps things scannable instead of one long scroll. Prices stay in the red accent color for quick visual scanning, and cards get a subtle red glow on hover to tie back to the header/hero palette.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Menu.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Menu.css';\n\ninterface MenuItem { name: string; price: string; description: string; }\ninterface MenuCategory { name: string; items: MenuItem[]; }\n\nconst MENU_DATA: MenuCategory[] = [\n  {\n    name: 'Ramen',\n    items: [\n      { name: 'Tonkotsu Classic', price: '$16', description: '18-hour pork bone broth, chashu, ajitama, nori' },\n      { name: 'Spicy Miso', price: '$17', description: 'Fermented miso broth, ground pork, chili oil, corn' },\n      { name: 'Shoyu Chicken', price: '$15', description: 'Clear soy broth, roast chicken, menma, scallion' },\n      { name: 'Vegan Shiitake', price: '$14', description: 'Shiitake-kombu broth, tofu, mushrooms, seasonal greens' },\n    ],\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'Sides',\n    items: [\n      { name: 'Karaage', price: '$9', description: 'Japanese fried chicken thigh, yuzu kosho mayo' },\n      { name: 'Gyoza (5pc)', price: '$8', description: 'Pan-seared pork dumplings, chili vinegar' },\n      { name: 'Steamed Bao (2pc)', price: '$7', description: 'Pork belly, hoisin, pickled cucumber' },\n    ],\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'Drinks',\n    items: [\n      { name: 'Ramune', price: '$4', description: 'Classic Japanese marble soda' },\n      { name: 'Asahi Draft', price: '$8', description: 'Japanese lager, 425ml' },\n      { name: 'Iced Genmaicha', price: '$5', description: 'Roasted brown rice green tea' },\n    ],\n  },\n];\n\nexport function Menu() {\n  const [active, setActive] = useState('Ramen');\n  const current = MENU_DATA.find(c => c.name === active) ?? MENU_DATA[0];\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"ms-menu\" id=\"menu\" aria-labelledby=\"ms-menu-heading\">\n      <div className=\"ms-menu__inner\">\n        <div className=\"ms-menu__header\">\n          <p className=\"ms-menu__eyebrow\">The Menu</p>\n          <h2 id=\"ms-menu-heading\" className=\"ms-menu__title\">Bowls Worth the Wait</h2>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"ms-menu__tabs\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Menu categories\">\n          {MENU_DATA.map(cat => (\n            <button\n              key={cat.name}\n              role=\"tab\"\n              aria-selected={active === cat.name}\n              className={`ms-menu__tab${active === cat.name ? ' ms-menu__tab--active' : ''}`}\n              onClick={() => setActive(cat.name)}\n            >\n              {cat.name}\n            </button>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"ms-menu__grid\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-label={current.name}>\n          {current.items.map(item => (\n            <article key={item.name} className=\"ms-menu__card\">\n              <div className=\"ms-menu__card-top\">\n                <h3 className=\"ms-menu__item-name\">{item.name}</h3>\n                <span className=\"ms-menu__item-price\">{item.price}</span>\n              </div>\n              <p className=\"ms-menu__item-desc\">{item.description}</p>\n            </article>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Menu.css\">\n.ms-menu {\n  padding: 6.5rem 2rem;\n  background: #141414;\n}\n.ms-menu__inner { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }\n.ms-menu__header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3rem; }\n.ms-menu__eyebrow {\n  font-size: 0.75rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  letter-spacing: 0.2em;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  color: #dc2626;\n  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;\n}\n.ms-menu__title {\n  font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif;\n  font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.8vw, 2.75rem);\n  color: #fafaf9;\n  margin: 0;\n}\n.ms-menu__tabs {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: center;\n  gap: 0.5rem;\n  margin-bottom: 3rem;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n}\n.ms-menu__tab {\n  padding: 0.55rem 1.4rem;\n  border: 2px solid #292524;\n  background: transparent;\n  color: #a8a29e;\n  border-radius: 2rem;\n  font-size: 0.88rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  transition: all 0.2s;\n}\n.ms-menu__tab:hover { border-color: #dc2626; color: #dc2626; }\n.ms-menu__tab--active { background: #dc2626; border-color: #dc2626; color: #fafaf9; }\n.ms-menu__grid {\n  display: grid;\n  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));\n  gap: 1.1rem;\n}\n.ms-menu__card {\n  background: #1c1917;\n  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  padding: 1.4rem;\n  transition: transform 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;\n}\n.ms-menu__card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgba(220,38,38,0.3); }\n.ms-menu__card-top {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  gap: 1rem;\n  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;\n}\n.ms-menu__item-name {\n  font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif;\n  font-size: 1.05rem;\n  color: #fafaf9;\n  margin: 0;\n}\n.ms-menu__item-price { font-weight: 700; color: #dc2626; white-space: nowrap; }\n.ms-menu__item-desc { font-size: 0.87rem; color: #78716c; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; }\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Menu.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Menu.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Footer section: a dark background footer with the business name, brief nav links, contact info (address, phone, email, hours), and a copyright notice. All rights reserved.</p>\n      </div>\n    </footer>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Footer.css\">\n.ms-footer {\n  background: #0a0a0a;\n  border-top: 1px solid rgba(220,38,38,0.2);\n  padding: 4.5rem 2rem 0;\n}\n.ms-footer__inner {\n  max-width: 1080px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  display: grid;\n  grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1.5fr;\n  gap: 3rem;\n  padding-bottom: 2.5rem;\n  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);\n}\n.ms-footer__logo {\n  font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif;\n  font-size: 1.3rem;\n  color: #dc2626;\n  margin: 0 0 0.5rem;\n}\n.ms-footer__tagline { font-size: 0.88rem; color: #57534e; margin: 0; max-width: 260px; line-height: 1.6; }\n.ms-footer__nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }\n.ms-footer__heading {\n  font-size: 0.7rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  letter-spacing: 0.14em;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  color: #dc2626;\n  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;\n}\n.ms-footer__link { color: #a8a29e; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.88rem; display: block; transition: color 0.2s; }\n.ms-footer__link:hover { color: #fafaf9; }\n.ms-footer__contact { font-style: normal; display: flex; flex-direction: column; Files: src/components/Header.tsx + src/components/Header.css"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "<thought>\nFor a developer conference the header should feel technical and confident: near-black background, a bold two-tone logo (name in white, year in the blue accent), and a single high-contrast 'Get Tickets' CTA since ticket conversion is the header's main job.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 12);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`ds-header${scrolled ? ' ds-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"ds-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"ds-header__logo\">DevSummit<span className=\"ds-header__year\">2025</span></a>\n        <nav className=\"ds-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#speakers\" className=\"ds-header__link\">Speakers</a>\n          <a href=\"#schedule\" className=\"ds-header__link\">Schedule</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"ds-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n        <a href=\"mailto:tickets@devsummit.io\" className=\"ds-header__cta\">Get Tickets</a>\n      </div>\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.ds-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(3, 7, 18, 0.85);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);\n  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15);\n  transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;\n}\n.ds-header--scrolled {\n  background: rgba(3, 7, 18, 0.97);\n  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);\n}\n.ds-header__inner {\n  max-width: 1240px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 2rem;\n  height: 68px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  gap: 1.5rem;\n}\n.ds-header__logo {\n  font-weight: 800;\n  font-size: 1.1rem;\n  color: #f8fafc;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  letter-spacing: -0.02em;\n}\n.ds-header__year { color: #2563eb; margin-left: 0.25rem; }\n.ds-header__nav { display: flex; gap: 1.75rem; align-items: center; }\n.ds-header__link {\n  color: #94a3b8;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  font-size: 0.9rem;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  transition: color 0.2s;\n}\n.ds-header__link:hover { color: #f8fafc; }\n.ds-header__cta {\n  padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;\n  background: #2563eb;\n  color: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 6px;\n  font-size: 0.85rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;\n}\n.ds-header__cta:hover { background: #3b82f6; ' bl-header--solid' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"bl-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"bl-header__logo\">BLANC STUDIO</a>\n        <nav className=\"bl-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"bl-header__link\">Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#products\" className=\"bl-header__link\">Collection</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"bl-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n      </div>\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.bl-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(250, 250, 249, 0.6);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);\n  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;\n  transition: background 0.3s, border-color 0.3s;\n}\n.bl-header--solid {\n  background: rgba(250, 250, 249, 0.96);\n  border-bottom-color: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.08);\n}\n.bl-header__inner {\n  max-width: 1200px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 2rem;\n  height: 84px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n}\n.bl-header__logo {\n  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;\n  font-size: 1.4rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  letter-spacing: 0.18em;\n  color: #1c1917;\n  text-decoration: none;\n}\n.bl-header__nav { display: flex; Nothing competes with the work shown further down the page.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  return (\n    <header className=\"mb-header\" role=\"banner\">\n      <div className=\"mb-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"mb-header__name\">Marcus Bell</a>\n        <nav className=\"mb-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#projects\" className=\"mb-header__link\">Projects</a>\n          <a href=\"#contact\" className=\"mb-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n      </div>\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.mb-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(12, 12, 12, 0.85);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);\n  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.12);\n}\n.mb-header__inner {\n  max-width: 980px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 2rem;\n  height: 66px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n}\n.mb-header__name {\n  font-weight: 700;\n  font-size: 1.05rem;\n  color: #f5f5f4;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  letter-spacing: -0.01em;\n}\n.mb-header__nav { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; }\n.mb-header__link {\n  padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem;\n  color: #a3a3a3;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  font-size: 0.88rem;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  border-radius: 6px;\n  transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s;\n}\n.mb-header__link:hover { color: #f97316; background: rgba(249,115,22,0.08); }\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Header.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Header.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Hero section: name/title intro with an animated typing role text that cycles through 3 roles using pure CSS, a short bio, and CTA buttons. Files: src/components/Hero.tsx + src/components/Hero.css\nWrite ONE <tool_call name=\"write_site\"> with exactly one .tsx file and one .css file for this section.\n</observation>"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "<thought>\nThe animated role text is built with a pure-CSS vertical-cycle animation: three role labels stacked in a fixed-height, overflow-hidden container, translated up on a keyframe loop with steps(1) so each role holds fully before the next appears (no third-party libraries needed). I kept the visible aria-label static for accessibility so screen readers get the full role list.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Hero.tsx\">\nimport React from 'react';\nimport './Hero.css';\n\nexport function Hero() {\n  return (\n    <section className=\"mb-hero\" id=\"hero\" aria-labelledby=\"mb-hero-name\">\n      <div className=\"mb-hero__inner\">\n        <p className=\"mb-hero__greeting\">Hi, I&apos;m</p>\n        <h1 id=\"mb-hero-name\" className=\"mb-hero__name\">Marcus Bell</h1>\n        <p className=\"mb-hero__roles\" aria-label=\"UX Designer, Product Strategist, Design Systems Lead\">\n          <span className=\"mb-hero__role-cycle\">\n            <span>UX Designer</span>\n            <span>Product Strategist</span>\n            <span>Design Systems Lead</span>\n          </span>\n        </p>\n        <p className=\"mb-hero__bio\">\n          I turn ambiguous product problems into clear, usable interfaces &mdash;\n          from early strategy through pixel-level execution.\n        </p>\n        <div className=\"mb-hero__actions\">\n          <a href=\"#projects\" className=\"mb-hero__btn mb-hero__btn--primary\">View Projects</a>\n          <a href=\"#contact\" className=\"mb-hero__btn mb-hero__btn--secondary\">Get in Touch</a>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Hero.css\">\n.mb-hero {\n  padding: 8rem 2rem 5.5rem;\n  background: #0c0c0c;\n  text-align: center;\n}\n.mb-hero__inner { max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; }\n.mb-hero__greeting {\n  font-size: 0.95rem;\n  color: #f97316;\n  margin: 0 0 0.5rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n.mb-hero__name {\n  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5.5vw, 3.75rem);\n  font-weight: 800;\n  color: #f5f5f4;\n  margin: 0 0 1rem;\n  letter-spacing: -0.03em;\n}\n.mb-hero__roles {\n  height: 1.8rem;\n  overflow: hidden;\n  margin: 0 0 1.75rem;\n}\n.mb-hero__role-cycle {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  animation: mb-cycle 6s steps(1) infinite;\n}\n.mb-hero__role-cycle span {\n  font-size: 1.2rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  color: #d4d4d4;\n  height: 1.8rem;\n  line-height: 1.8rem;\n}\n@keyframes mb-cycle {\n  0%, 30% { transform: translateY(0); }\n  33%, 63% { transform: translateY(-1.8rem); }\n  66%, 96% { transform: translateY(-3.6rem); }\n  100% { transform: translateY(0); }\n}\n.mb-hero__bio {\n  font-size: 1.02rem;\n  color: #737373;\n  line-height: 1.75;\n  margin: 0 auto 2.25rem;\n  max-width: 480px;\n}\n.mb-hero__actions { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }\n.mb-hero__btn {\n  padding: 0.75rem 1.6rem;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  font-size: 0.9rem;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  transition: all 0.2s;\n}\n.mb-hero__btn--primary { background: #f97316; color: #0c0c0c; }\n.mb-hero__btn--primary:hover { background: #fb923c; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(249,115,22,0.3); }\n.mb-hero__btn--secondary { background: transparent; color: #d4d4d4; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); }\n.mb-hero__btn--secondary:hover { border-color: #f97316; color: #f97316; }\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Hero.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Hero.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Projects section: all 4 case studies from the brief as large cards with project name, role, and outcome. margin: 0 auto; }\n.mb-projects__heading {\n  font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 3.2vw, 2.4rem);\n  font-weight: 800;\n  color: #f5f5f4;\n  margin: 0 0 2.75rem;\n  letter-spacing: -0.02em;\n}\n.mb-projects__list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }\n.mb-proj-card {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 1.75rem;\n  padding: 1.75rem 0;\n  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);\n  transition: padding-left 0.25s;\n}\n.mb-proj-card:hover { padding-left: 0.5rem; color: #a3a3a3; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0; max-width: 640px; }\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Projects.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Projects.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Contact section: a form-like layout with the email and social handle from the brief, styled like a call-to-action block. description: string; }\n\nconst SERVICES: Service[] = [\n  { name: 'Brand Identity', description: 'Logo systems, visual language, and brand guidelines built to scale.' },\n  { name: 'Web Design', description: 'Conversion-focused websites that still feel like art.' },\n  { name: 'Motion & Video', description: 'Launch films, product demos, and social-first motion design.' },\n  { name: 'Product Design', description: 'End-to-end UI/UX for apps and platforms, from wireframe to ship.' },\n];\n\nexport function Services() {\n  return (\n    <section className=\"pf-services\" id=\"services\" aria-labelledby=\"pf-services-heading\">\n      <div className=\"pf-services__inner\">\n        <h2 id=\"pf-services-heading\" className=\"pf-services__heading\">What We Do</h2>\n        <div className=\"pf-services__grid\">\n          {SERVICES.map((s, i) => (\n            <article key={s.name} className=\"pf-service-card\">\n              <span className=\"pf-service-card__num\">{String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>\n              <h3 className=\"pf-service-card__name\">{s.name}</h3>\n              <p className=\"pf-service-card__desc\">{s.description}</p>\n            </article>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Services.css\">\n.pf-services {\n  padding: 6.5rem 2rem;\n  background: #191919;\n  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);\n}\n.pf-services__inner { max-width: 1080px; {"task_id": "site_realestate_harbor_view", "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are an expert autonomous React, TypeScript, and CSS coding agent specialising in full-page website composition.\nYour objective is to build a complete, visually rich, multi-section website from a structured content brief, one section at a time.\n\nYou interact with an automated build environment using structured XML tags:\n\n1. <thought>\nExplain your plan for the current section, describe styling decisions, and acknowledge the content brief.\n</thought>\n\n2. <tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\n// Complete React + TypeScript component for this section\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n/* Required CSS \u2014 NEVER leave empty. Every section MUST have visual styles. */\n</file>\n</tool_call>\nWrites ONE section (one .tsx file + one .css file) per turn. The environment will confirm what was written and instruct you on the next section.\n\n3. <finish>\nBrief summary of all sections produced.\n</finish>\nCall this ONLY after the environment confirms all required sections are complete.\n\nOPERATING GUIDELINES:\n- Every turn: output <thought> first, then ONE <tool_call name=\"write_site\"> with exactly one .tsx and one .css <file> pair.\n- CSS is MANDATORY. Every section must have real visual rules (colors, typography, spacing, layout). Empty or placeholder CSS is a hard failure.\n- Use modern CSS: flexbox/grid for layout, CSS custom properties for design tokens, responsive units (rem/%, vw).\n- Write production-quality TypeScript. Keep all types inline \u2014 no third-party imports except react and react-dom.\n- Reconcile prompt and brief: Honor the content brief data (business name, tagline, tiers) while incorporating any specific interactive capabilities requested in the user prompt (e.g. dark/light mode toggle in Header, active category tabs in Features, annual/monthly billing toggle in Pricing, and next/prev carousel pagination in Testimonials).\n- Real Interactive State: For interactive sections (pricing toggles, tab filtering, carousels, mobile menus), write functional React state (`useState`, `useEffect`) rather than static unclickable elements.\n- Clean Iconography: Use clean inline SVGs or standard FontAwesome icon classes (e.g. `fa-solid fa-check`, `fa-solid fa-bolt`, `fa-solid fa-star`, `fa-brands fa-github`).\n- Do NOT output markdown code fences (```) around your <tool_call> tags.\n- Do NOT combine multiple sections into one turn \u2014 one section per tool_call
