Files: src/components/Header.tsx + src/components/Header.css"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "<thought>\nReal estate needs to feel trustworthy and coastal-premium, so I paired a deep navy background with a teal accent that evokes water, and used the Libre Baskerville serif for the wordmark to signal established credibility.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 16);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`hv-header${scrolled ? ' hv-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"hv-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"hv-header__logo\">Harbor View Realty</a>\n        <nav className=\"hv-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"hv-header__link\">Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#listings\" className=\"hv-header__link\">Featured Listings</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"hv-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n        <a href=\"mailto:info@harborviewrealty.com\" className=\"hv-header__cta\">Schedule a Showing</a>\n      </div>\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.hv-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(12, 30, 46, 0.9);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);\n  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(14, 165, 164, 0.15);\n  transition: box-shadow 0.3s;\n}\n.hv-header--scrolled { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }\n.hv-header__inner {\n  max-width: 1200px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 2rem;\n  height: 74px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  gap: 1.5rem;\n}\n.hv-header__logo {\n  font-family: 'Libre Baskerville', serif;\n  font-size: 1.15rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  color: #f0f9f9;\n  text-decoration: none;\n}\n.hv-header__nav { display: flex; gap: 1.75rem; }\n.hv-header__link {\n  color: #9fb8c4;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  font-size: 0.88rem;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  transition: color 0.2s;\n}\n.hv-header__link:hover { color: #0ea5a4; }\n.hv-header__cta {\n  padding: 0.55rem 1.3rem;\n  background: #0ea5a4;\n  color: #0c1e2e;\n  border-radius: 6px;\n  font-size: 0.85rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;\n}\n.hv-header__cta:hover { background: #2dd4bf; transform: translateY(-1px); }\n@media (max-width: 700px) { .hv-header__nav { display: none; } }\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Header.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Header.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Hero section: full-width banner with the tagline as h1, subheading, and a CTA. Files: src/components/Header.tsx + src/components/Header.css"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "<thought>\nA coding bootcamp header should feel outcomes-driven and modern: dark navy base with a green accent that reads as 'go/growth', a clean Sora wordmark, and an unmissable Apply Now button since admissions conversion is the site's main goal.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 12);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`cc-header${scrolled ? ' cc-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"cc-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"cc-header__logo\">CodeCraft Academy</a>\n        <nav className=\"cc-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"cc-header__link\">Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#curriculum\" className=\"cc-header__link\">Curriculum</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"cc-header__link\">Admissions</a>\n        </nav>\n        <a href=\"mailto:admissions@codecraftacademy.io\" className=\"cc-header__cta\">Apply Now</a>\n      </div>\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.cc-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(10, 14, 26, 0.9);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);\n  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15);\n  transition: box-shadow 0.3s;\n}\n.cc-header--scrolled { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); }\n.cc-header__inner {\n  max-width: 1200px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 2rem;\n  height: 68px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  gap: 1.5rem;\n}\n.cc-header__logo {\n  font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif;\n  font-size: 1.05rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  color: #f1f5f9;\n  text-decoration: none;\n}\n.cc-header__nav { display: flex; gap: 1.75rem; }\n.cc-header__link {\n  color: #94a3b8;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  font-size: 0.88rem;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  transition: color 0.2s;\n}\n.cc-header__link:hover { color: #22c55e; }\n.cc-header__cta {\n  padding: 0.55rem 1.3rem;\n  background: #22c55e;\n  color: #0a0e1a;\n  border-radius: 6px;\n  font-size: 0.85rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;\n}\n.cc-header__cta:hover { background: #4ade80; transform: translateY(-1px); }\n@media (max-width: 700px) { .cc-header__nav { display: none; } }\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Header.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Header.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Hero section: full-width banner with the tagline as h1, subheading, the job placement stat, and a CTA. className=\"cc-hero__cta\">Apply Now</a>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Hero.css\">\n.cc-hero {\n  position: relative;\n  min-height: 86vh;\n  display: margin: 0 auto; }\n.cc-curriculum__header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3.5rem; }\n.cc-curriculum__eyebrow {\n  font-size: 0.75rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  letter-spacing: 0.2em;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  color: #22c55e;\n  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;\n}\n.cc-curriculum__title {\n  font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif;\n  font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.6vw, 2.75rem);\n  font-weight: 700;\n  color: #f1f5f9;\n  margin: 0;\n}\n.cc-curriculum__list {\n  list-style: none;\n  margin: 0;\n  padding: 0;\n  position: relative;\n}\n.cc-curriculum__list::before {\n  content: '';\n  position: absolute;\n  left: 21px;\n  top: 8px;\n  bottom: 8px;\n  width: 2px;\n  background: rgba(34,197,94,0.2);\n}\n.cc-module { display: flex; type=\"button\"\n            className=\"dpf-header__toggle\"\n            aria-label=\"Toggle navigation menu\"\n            aria-expanded={menuOpen}\n            onClick={() => className=\"dpf-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#channels\" className=\"dpf-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Featured Multi-Column Narrative Prose */}\n        <div className=\"ana-editorial__prose\">\n          <p className=\"ana-editorial__paragraph ana-editorial__paragraph--dropcap\">\n            Modernist typography emerged not as an aesthetic novelty, but as a severe response to industrial density. Multi-Column Narrative Prose */}\n        <div className=\"kgc-editorial__prose\">\n          <p className=\"kgc-editorial__paragraph kgc-editorial__paragraph--dropcap\">\n            Modernist typography emerged not as an aesthetic novelty, but as a severe response to industrial density. By distilling letterforms down to their elemental vertical metrics and geometric terminals, screen systems attain a degree of legibility unattainable through traditional decorative serif paradigms.\n          </p>\n          <p className=\"kgc-editorial__paragraph\">\n            In our contemporary landscape of high-density retina displays, spatial restraint has become the ultimate luxury. The dynamic ephemeral db credentials capabilities delivered immediate impact.', 'author': 'Alex Chen', 'role': 'Head of Engineering, KeyVault Cloud', 'rating': 5}, {'id': '2', 'quote': 'With KeyVault Cloud, we automated zero-knowledge secret management & automated tls certificate rotation while accelerating our product delivery.', 'author': 'Samantha Wei', 'role': 'VP of Technology at KeyVault Cloud Group', 'rating': 5}, {'id': '3', 'quote': \"Our developers love using KeyVault Cloud. The let's encrypt automated rotation workflow is best in class.\", 'author': 'Marcus Thorne', 'role': 'Principal Architect', 'rating': 5}];\nconst CATEGORIES: { id: string; label: string }[] = [{'id': 'all', 'label': 'All Capabilities'}, {'id': 'core', 'label': 'Core Engine'}, {'id': 'security', 'label': 'Security & Auth'}, {'id': 'scale', 'label': 'Scale & Telemetry'}];\n\nexport function Security() {\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>('all');\n  const [activeSlide, setActiveSlide] = useState<number>(0);\n\n  const filteredFeatures = activeTab === 'all'\n    ? FEATURES\n    : FEATURES.filter((f) => f.category === activeTab);\n\n  const prevSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev - 1 + REVIEWS.length) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const nextSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev + 1) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const currentReview = REVIEWS[activeSlide];\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"kvc-tabs\" id=\"security\" aria-labelledby=\"kvc-tabs-title\">\n      <div className=\"kvc-tabs__inner\">\n        {/* 1. Header & Tab Navigation */}\n        <div className=\"kvc-tabs__header\">\n          <p className=\"kvc-tabs__eyebrow\">SAAS SOLUTIONS</p>\n          <h2 id=\"kvc-tabs-title\" className=\"kvc-tabs__title\">\n            Security Features\n          </h2>\n          <p className=\"kvc-tabs__subtitle\">\n            Explore verified solutions and live client outcomes from KeyVault Cloud.\n          </p>\n\n          <div className=\"kvc-tabs__nav\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Feature categories\">\n            {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (\n              <button\n                key={cat.id}\n                type=\"button\"\n                role=\"tab\"\n                aria-selected={activeTab === cat.id}\n                className={`kvc-tabs__tab${activeTab === cat.id ? ' is-active' : ''}`}\n                onClick={() => setActiveTab(cat.id)}\n              >\n                {cat.label}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 2. Filtered Cards Grid */}\n        <div className=\"kvc-tabs__grid\">\n          {filteredFeatures.map((item) => (\n            <div key={item.id} className=\"kvc-tabs__card\">\n              <div className=\"kvc-tabs__card-top\">\n                <span className=\"kvc-tabs__badge\">{item.badge}</span>\n                <span className=\"kvc-tabs__category\">{item.category}</span>\n              </div>\n              <h3 className=\"kvc-tabs__card-title\">{item.title}</h3>\n              <p className=\"kvc-tabs__card-desc\">{item.desc}</p>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 3. Carousel Component \u2014 Testimonials & Proof */}\n        <div className=\"kvc-tabs__carousel\" aria-label=\"Customer Testimonials\">\n          <div className=\"kvc-tabs__carousel-box\">\n            <div className=\"kvc-tabs__stars\" aria-label=\"5 stars rating\">\n              {'\u2605'.repeat(currentReview.rating)}\n            </div>\n\n            <blockquote className=\"kvc-tabs__quote\">\n              &ldquo;{currentReview.quote}&rdquo;\n            </blockquote>\n\n            <div className=\"kvc-tabs__author\">\n              <div className=\"kvc-tabs__author-avatar\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                {currentReview.author.split(' ').map((n) => n[0]).join('')}\n              </div>\n              <div>\n                <h4 className=\"kvc-tabs__author-name\">{currentReview.author}</h4>\n                <span className=\"kvc-tabs__author-role\">{currentReview.role}</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"kvc-tabs__carousel-controls\">\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={prevSlide}\n                className=\"kvc-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Previous testimonial\"\n              >\n                &larr;\n              </button>\n              <span className=\"kvc-tabs__carousel-counter\">\n                0{activeSlide + 1} / 0{REVIEWS.length}\n              </span>\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={nextSlide}\n                className=\"kvc-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Next testimonial\"\n              >\n                &rarr;\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Security.css\">\n.kvc-tabs {\n  width: 100%;\n  padding: 6.5rem 1.5rem;\n I'll build an interactive category filter tablist with useState for (Real-Time Multi-Cursor Docs, Keyboard-First Command Palette...) plus a verified testimonial carousel with slide navigation.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Workspace_modules.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport './WorkspaceModules.css';\n\ninterface Feature {\n  id: string;\n  category: string;\n  title: string;\n  desc: string;\n  badge: string;\n}\n\ninterface Review {\n  id: string;\n  quote: string;\n  author: string;\n  role: string;\n  rating: number;\n}\n\nconst FEATURES: Feature[] = [{'title': 'Real-Time Multi-Cursor Docs', 'tag': 'CRDT Collab', 'desc': 'Collaborative markdown editing with zero lag, rich code blocks, and embedded interactive tables.'}, {'title': 'Keyboard-First Command Palette', 'tag': 'Command + K', 'desc': 'Navigate issues, assign tickets, and create documents without your fingers leaving the home row.'}, {'title': 'Two-Way GitHub & GitLab Sync', 'tag': 'Branch Auto-Close', 'desc': 'Issues update automatically when PRs are opened, reviewed, merged, or reverted.'}, {'title': 'Automated Async Standups', 'tag': 'Slack & Discord', 'desc': 'Gather daily engineering updates automatically without forcing developers into 30-minute Zoom meetings.'}];\nconst REVIEWS: Review[] = [{'id': '1', 'quote': 'Deploying Harmony Workspace transformed our delivery velocity. The real-time multi-cursor docs capabilities delivered immediate impact.', 'author': 'Alex Chen', 'role': 'Head of Engineering, Harmony Workspace', 'rating': 5}, {'id': '2', 'quote': 'With Harmony Workspace, we automated asynchronous sprint planning, collaborative docs & engineering roadmaps while accelerating our product delivery.', 'author': 'Samantha Wei', 'role': 'VP of Technology at Harmony Workspace Group', 'rating': 5}, {'id': '3', 'quote': 'Our developers love using Harmony Workspace. The keyboard-first command palette workflow is best in class.', 'author': 'Marcus Thorne', 'role': 'Principal Architect', 'rating': 5}];\nconst CATEGORIES: { id: string; label: string }[] = [{'id': 'all', 'label': 'All Capabilities'}, {'id': 'core', 'label': 'Core Engine'}, {'id': 'security', 'label': 'Security & Auth'}, {'id': 'scale', 'label': 'Scale & Telemetry'}];\n\nexport function WorkspaceModules() {\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>('all');\n  const [activeSlide, setActiveSlide] = useState<number>(0);\n\n  const filteredFeatures = activeTab === 'all'\n    ? FEATURES\n    : FEATURES.filter((f) => f.category === activeTab);\n\n  const prevSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev - 1 + REVIEWS.length) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const nextSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev + 1) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const currentReview = REVIEWS[activeSlide];\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"hw-tabs\" id=\"workspacemodules\" aria-labelledby=\"hw-tabs-title\">\n      <div className=\"hw-tabs__inner\">\n        {/* 1. Header & Tab Navigation */}\n        <div className=\"hw-tabs__header\">\n          <p className=\"hw-tabs__eyebrow\">SAAS SOLUTIONS</p>\n          <h2 id=\"hw-tabs-title\" className=\"hw-tabs__title\">\n            Workspace Modules\n          </h2>\n          <p className=\"hw-tabs__subtitle\">\n            Explore verified solutions and live client outcomes from Harmony Workspace.\n          </p>\n\n          <div className=\"hw-tabs__nav\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Feature categories\">\n            {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (\n              <button\n                key={cat.id}\n                type=\"button\"\n                role=\"tab\"\n                aria-selected={activeTab === cat.id}\n                className={`hw-tabs__tab${activeTab === cat.id ? ' is-active' : ''}`}\n                onClick={() => setActiveTab(cat.id)}\n              >\n                {cat.label}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 2. Filtered Cards Grid */}\n        <div className=\"hw-tabs__grid\">\n          {filteredFeatures.map((item) => (\n            <div key={item.id} className=\"hw-tabs__card\">\n              <div className=\"hw-tabs__card-top\">\n                <span className=\"hw-tabs__badge\">{item.badge}</span>\n                <span className=\"hw-tabs__category\">{item.category}</span>\n              </div>\n              <h3 className=\"hw-tabs__card-title\">{item.title}</h3>\n              <p className=\"hw-tabs__card-desc\">{item.desc}</p>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 3. Carousel Component \u2014 Testimonials & Proof */}\n        <div className=\"hw-tabs__carousel\" aria-label=\"Customer Testimonials\">\n          <div className=\"hw-tabs__carousel-box\">\n            <div className=\"hw-tabs__stars\" aria-label=\"5 stars rating\">\n              {'\u2605'.repeat(currentReview.rating)}\n            </div>\n\n            <blockquote className=\"hw-tabs__quote\">\n              &ldquo;{currentReview.quote}&rdquo;\n            </blockquote>\n\n            <div className=\"hw-tabs__author\">\n              <div className=\"hw-tabs__author-avatar\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                {currentReview.author.split(' ').map((n) => n[0]).join('')}\n              </div>\n              <div>\n                <h4 className=\"hw-tabs__author-name\">{currentReview.author}</h4>\n                <span className=\"hw-tabs__author-role\">{currentReview.role}</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"hw-tabs__carousel-controls\">\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={prevSlide}\n                className=\"hw-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Previous testimonial\"\n              >\n                &larr;\n              </button>\n              <span className=\"hw-tabs__carousel-counter\">\n                0{activeSlide + 1} / 0{REVIEWS.length}\n              </span>\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={nextSlide}\n                className=\"hw-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Next testimonial\"\n              >\n                &rarr;\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n I'll also implement a scroll listener to trigger subtle border illumination on scroll.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 15);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`gpr-header${scrolled ? ' gpr-header--scrolled' : ''}`} role=\"banner\">\n      <div className=\"gpr-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"gpr-header__logo\" aria-label=\"GlobalPay Rails Home\">\n type=\"button\"\n            className=\"gpr-header__toggle\"\n            aria-label=\"Toggle navigation menu\"\n            aria-expanded={menuOpen}\n            onClick={() => setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}\n          >\n            <span className=\"gpr-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"gpr-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"gpr-header__bar\" />\n className=\"gpr-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#payout_rails\" className=\"gpr-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Payout Rails</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"gpr-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n          <a href=\"mailto:support@globalpayrails.com\" I'll build an interactive category filter tablist with useState for (Direct Local Clearing Rails, Wholesale Institutional FX...) plus a verified testimonial carousel with slide navigation.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Payout_rails.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport './PayoutRails.css';\n\ninterface Feature {\n  id: string;\n  category: string;\n  title: string;\n  desc: string;\n  badge: string;\n}\n\ninterface Review {\n  id: string;\n  quote: string;\n  author: string;\n  role: string;\n  rating: number;\n}\n\nconst FEATURES: Feature[] = [{'title': 'Direct Local Clearing Rails', 'tag': 'Sub-Minute Arrival', 'desc': 'Connect directly into Pix (Brazil), UPI (India), SEPA Instant (EU), and Faster Payments (UK).'}, {'title': 'Wholesale Institutional FX', 'tag': '0.15% Spread', 'desc': 'Eliminate 3% bank currency exchange fees with automated real-time mid-market conversions.'}, {'title': 'Global 1099 & W-8BEN Tax Forms', 'tag': 'IRS Automated', 'desc': 'Collect electronic tax documents and generate end-of-year filing reports automatically.'}, {'title': 'Multi-Entity Treasury Balance', 'tag': 'Virtual Accounts', 'desc': 'Hold and disburse 35 sovereign currencies from dedicated virtual IBAN accounts in your company name.'}];\nconst REVIEWS: Review[] = [{'id': '1', 'quote': 'Deploying GlobalPay Rails transformed our delivery velocity. The direct local clearing rails capabilities delivered immediate impact.', 'author': 'Alex Chen', 'role': 'Head of Engineering, GlobalPay Rails', 'rating': 5}, {'id': '2', 'quote': 'With GlobalPay Rails, we automated instant cross-border merchant payouts across 140 countries in local currencies while accelerating our product delivery.', 'author': 'Samantha Wei', 'role': 'VP of Technology at GlobalPay Rails Group', 'rating': 5}, {'id': '3', 'quote': 'Our developers love using GlobalPay Rails. The wholesale institutional fx workflow is best in class.', 'author': 'Marcus Thorne', 'role': 'Principal Architect', 'rating': 5}];\nconst CATEGORIES: { id: string; label: string }[] = [{'id': 'all', 'label': 'All Capabilities'}, {'id': 'core', 'label': 'Core Engine'}, {'id': 'security', 'label': 'Security & Auth'}, {'id': 'scale', 'label': 'Scale & Telemetry'}];\n\nexport function PayoutRails() {\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>('all');\n  const [activeSlide, setActiveSlide] = useState<number>(0);\n\n  const filteredFeatures = activeTab === 'all'\n    ? FEATURES\n    : FEATURES.filter((f) => f.category === activeTab);\n\n  const prevSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev - 1 + REVIEWS.length) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const nextSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev + 1) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const currentReview = REVIEWS[activeSlide];\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"gpr-tabs\" id=\"payoutrails\" aria-labelledby=\"gpr-tabs-title\">\n      <div className=\"gpr-tabs__inner\">\n        {/* 1. Header & Tab Navigation */}\n        <div className=\"gpr-tabs__header\">\n          <p className=\"gpr-tabs__eyebrow\">FINTECH SOLUTIONS</p>\n          <h2 id=\"gpr-tabs-title\" className=\"gpr-tabs__title\">\n            Payout Rails\n          </h2>\n          <p className=\"gpr-tabs__subtitle\">\n            Explore verified solutions and live client outcomes from GlobalPay Rails.\n          </p>\n\n          <div className=\"gpr-tabs__nav\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Feature categories\">\n            {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (\n              <button\n                key={cat.id}\n                type=\"button\"\n                role=\"tab\"\n                aria-selected={activeTab === cat.id}\n                className={`gpr-tabs__tab${activeTab === cat.id ? ' is-active' : ''}`}\n                onClick={() => setActiveTab(cat.id)}\n              >\n                {cat.label}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 2. Filtered Cards Grid */}\n        <div className=\"gpr-tabs__grid\">\n          {filteredFeatures.map((item) => (\n            <div key={item.id} className=\"gpr-tabs__card\">\n              <div className=\"gpr-tabs__card-top\">\n                <span className=\"gpr-tabs__badge\">{item.badge}</span>\n                <span className=\"gpr-tabs__category\">{item.category}</span>\n              </div>\n              <h3 className=\"gpr-tabs__card-title\">{item.title}</h3>\n              <p className=\"gpr-tabs__card-desc\">{item.desc}</p>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 3. Carousel Component \u2014 Testimonials & Proof */}\n        <div className=\"gpr-tabs__carousel\" aria-label=\"Customer Testimonials\">\n          <div className=\"gpr-tabs__carousel-box\">\n            <div className=\"gpr-tabs__stars\" aria-label=\"5 stars rating\">\n              {'\u2605'.repeat(currentReview.rating)}\n            </div>\n\n            <blockquote className=\"gpr-tabs__quote\">\n              &ldquo;{currentReview.quote}&rdquo;\n            </blockquote>\n\n            <div className=\"gpr-tabs__author\">\n              <div className=\"gpr-tabs__author-avatar\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                {currentReview.author.split(' ').map((n) => n[0]).join('')}\n              </div>\n              <div>\n                <h4 className=\"gpr-tabs__author-name\">{currentReview.author}</h4>\n                <span className=\"gpr-tabs__author-role\">{currentReview.role}</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"gpr-tabs__carousel-controls\">\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={prevSlide}\n                className=\"gpr-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Previous testimonial\"\n              >\n                &larr;\n              </button>\n              <span className=\"gpr-tabs__carousel-counter\">\n                0{activeSlide + 1} / 0{REVIEWS.length}\n              </span>\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={nextSlide}\n                className=\"gpr-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Next testimonial\"\n              >\n                &rarr;\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Payout_rails.css\">\n.gpr-tabs {\n  width: 100%;\n  padding: 6.5rem 1.5rem;\n  background: var(--surface-obsidian, var(--color-obsidian, var(--bg-color, #0f172a)));\n  color: var(--color-paper, var(--text-color, #ffffff));\n}\n\n.gpr-tabs__inner {\n  max-width: The hipaa security safeguards workflow is best in class.', 'author': 'Marcus Thorne', 'role': 'Principal Architect', 'rating': 5}];\nconst CATEGORIES: { id: string; label: string }[] = [{'id': 'all', 'label': 'All Capabilities'}, {'id': 'core', 'label': 'Core Engine'}, {'id': 'security', 'label': 'Security & Auth'}, {'id': 'scale', 'label': 'Scale & Telemetry'}];\n\nexport function Frameworks() {\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>('all');\n  const [activeSlide, setActiveSlide] = useState<number>(0);\n\n  const filteredFeatures = activeTab === 'all'\n    ? FEATURES\n    : FEATURES.filter((f) => f.category === activeTab);\n\n  const prevSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev - 1 + REVIEWS.length) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const nextSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev + 1) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const currentReview = REVIEWS[activeSlide];\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"cs-tabs\" id=\"frameworks\" aria-labelledby=\"cs-tabs-title\">\n      <div className=\"cs-tabs__inner\">\n        {/* 1. Header & Tab Navigation */}\n        <div className=\"cs-tabs__header\">\n          <p className=\"cs-tabs__eyebrow\">SAAS SOLUTIONS</p>\n          <h2 id=\"cs-tabs-title\" className=\"cs-tabs__title\">\n            Compliance Frameworks\n          </h2>\n          <p className=\"cs-tabs__subtitle\">\n            Explore verified solutions and live client outcomes from ComplianceShield.\n          </p>\n\n          <div className=\"cs-tabs__nav\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Feature categories\">\n            {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (\n              <button\n                key={cat.id}\n                type=\"button\"\n                role=\"tab\"\n                aria-selected={activeTab === cat.id}\n                className={`cs-tabs__tab${activeTab === cat.id ? ' is-active' : ''}`}\n                onClick={() => setActiveTab(cat.id)}\n              >\n                {cat.label}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 2. Filtered Cards Grid */}\n        <div className=\"cs-tabs__grid\">\n          {filteredFeatures.map((item) => (\n            <div key={item.id} className=\"cs-tabs__card\">\n              <div className=\"cs-tabs__card-top\">\n                <span className=\"cs-tabs__badge\">{item.badge}</span>\n                <span className=\"cs-tabs__category\">{item.category}</span>\n              </div>\n              <h3 className=\"cs-tabs__card-title\">{item.title}</h3>\n              <p className=\"cs-tabs__card-desc\">{item.desc}</p>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 3. Carousel Component \u2014 Testimonials & Proof */}\n        <div className=\"cs-tabs__carousel\" aria-label=\"Customer Testimonials\">\n          <div className=\"cs-tabs__carousel-box\">\n            <div className=\"cs-tabs__stars\" aria-label=\"5 stars rating\">\n              {'\u2605'.repeat(currentReview.rating)}\n            </div>\n\n            <blockquote className=\"cs-tabs__quote\">\n              &ldquo;{currentReview.quote}&rdquo;\n            </blockquote>\n\n            <div className=\"cs-tabs__author\">\n              <div className=\"cs-tabs__author-avatar\" 0{activeSlide + 1} / 0{REVIEWS.length}\n              </span>\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={nextSlide}\n                className=\"cs-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Next testimonial\"\n              >\n                &rarr;\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n I'll also implement a scroll listener to trigger subtle border illumination on scroll.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 15);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`rgw-header${scrolled ? setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}\n          >\n            <span className=\"rgw-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"rgw-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"rgw-header__bar\" />\n className=\"rgw-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#gateway_capabilities\" className=\"rgw-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => I'll build an interactive category filter tablist with useState for (Distributed Token-Bucket Limiting, Edge Response Caching...) plus a verified testimonial carousel with slide navigation.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Gateway_capabilities.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport './GatewayCapabilities.css';\n\ninterface Feature {\n  id: string;\n  category: string;\n  title: string;\n  desc: string;\n  badge: string;\n}\n\ninterface Review {\n  id: string;\n  quote: string;\n  author: string;\n  role: string;\n  rating: number;\n}\n\nconst FEATURES: Feature[] = [{'title': 'Distributed Token-Bucket Limiting', 'tag': 'Per-User Keys', 'desc': 'Enforce tier-based rate limits across distributed edge nodes with zero cross-region latency.'}, {'title': 'Edge Response Caching', 'tag': 'Automatic Invalidation', 'desc': 'Cache idempotent GET requests at the edge and invalidate via webhook in under 100ms.'}, {'title': 'Cryptographic JWT Verification', 'tag': 'Zero Backend Load', 'desc': 'Verify asymmetric RS256 token signatures at the gateway so invalid requests never touch servers.'}, {'title': 'Automated Usage Billing Metering', 'tag': 'Stripe Sync', 'desc': 'Track API call counts per customer and sync directly with Stripe metered billing usage records.'}];\nconst REVIEWS: Review[] = [{'id': '1', 'quote': 'Deploying RapidGateway transformed our delivery velocity. The distributed token-bucket limiting capabilities delivered immediate impact.', 'author': 'Alex Chen', 'role': 'Head of Engineering, RapidGateway', 'rating': 5}, {'id': '2', 'quote': 'With RapidGateway, we automated sub-millisecond edge api gateway with token-bucket rate limiting while accelerating our product delivery.', 'author': 'Samantha Wei', 'role': 'VP of Technology at RapidGateway Group', 'rating': 5}, {'id': '3', 'quote': 'Our developers love using RapidGateway. The edge response caching workflow is best in class.', 'author': 'Marcus Thorne', 'role': 'Principal Architect', 'rating': 5}];\nconst CATEGORIES: { id: string; label: string }[] = [{'id': 'all', 'label': 'All Capabilities'}, {'id': 'core', 'label': 'Core Engine'}, {'id': 'security', 'label': 'Security & Auth'}, {'id': 'scale', 'label': 'Scale & Telemetry'}];\n\nexport function GatewayCapabilities() {\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>('all');\n  const [activeSlide, setActiveSlide] = useState<number>(0);\n\n  const filteredFeatures = activeTab === 'all'\n    ? FEATURES\n    : FEATURES.filter((f) => f.category === activeTab);\n\n  const prevSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev - 1 + REVIEWS.length) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const nextSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev + 1) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const currentReview = REVIEWS[activeSlide];\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"rgw-tabs\" id=\"gatewaycapabilities\" aria-labelledby=\"rgw-tabs-title\">\n      <div className=\"rgw-tabs__inner\">\n        {/* 1. Header & Tab Navigation */}\n        <div className=\"rgw-tabs__header\">\n          <p className=\"rgw-tabs__eyebrow\">CLOUD SOLUTIONS</p>\n          <h2 id=\"rgw-tabs-title\" className=\"rgw-tabs__title\">\n            Gateway Capabilities\n          </h2>\n          <p className=\"rgw-tabs__subtitle\">\n            Explore verified solutions and live client outcomes from RapidGateway.\n          </p>\n\n          <div className=\"rgw-tabs__nav\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Feature categories\">\n            {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (\n              <button\n                key={cat.id}\n                type=\"button\"\n                role=\"tab\"\n                aria-selected={activeTab === cat.id}\n                className={`rgw-tabs__tab${activeTab === cat.id ? ' is-active' : ''}`}\n                onClick={() => setActiveTab(cat.id)}\n              >\n                {cat.label}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 2. Filtered Cards Grid */}\n        <div className=\"rgw-tabs__grid\">\n          {filteredFeatures.map((item) => (\n            <div key={item.id} className=\"rgw-tabs__card\">\n              <div className=\"rgw-tabs__card-top\">\n                <span className=\"rgw-tabs__badge\">{item.badge}</span>\n                <span className=\"rgw-tabs__category\">{item.category}</span>\n              </div>\n              <h3 className=\"rgw-tabs__card-title\">{item.title}</h3>\n              <p className=\"rgw-tabs__card-desc\">{item.desc}</p>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 3. Carousel Component \u2014 Testimonials & Proof */}\n        <div className=\"rgw-tabs__carousel\" aria-label=\"Customer Testimonials\">\n          <div className=\"rgw-tabs__carousel-box\">\n            <div className=\"rgw-tabs__stars\" aria-label=\"5 stars rating\">\n              {'\u2605'.repeat(currentReview.rating)}\n            </div>\n\n            <blockquote className=\"rgw-tabs__quote\">\n              &ldquo;{currentReview.quote}&rdquo;\n            </blockquote>\n\n            <div className=\"rgw-tabs__author\">\n              <div className=\"rgw-tabs__author-avatar\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                {currentReview.author.split(' ').map((n) => n[0]).join('')}\n              </div>\n              <div>\n                <h4 className=\"rgw-tabs__author-name\">{currentReview.author}</h4>\n                <span className=\"rgw-tabs__author-role\">{currentReview.role}</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"rgw-tabs__carousel-controls\">\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={prevSlide}\n                className=\"rgw-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Previous testimonial\"\n              >\n                &larr;\n              </button>\n              <span className=\"rgw-tabs__carousel-counter\">\n                0{activeSlide + 1} / 0{REVIEWS.length}\n              </span>\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={nextSlide}\n                className=\"rgw-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Next testimonial\"\n              >\n                &rarr;\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Gateway_capabilities.css\">\n.rgw-tabs {\n  width: 100%;\n  padding: 6.5rem I'll also implement a scroll listener to trigger subtle border illumination on scroll.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 15);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`thq-header${scrolled ? ' thq-header--scrolled' : ''}`} role=\"banner\">\n      <div className=\"thq-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"thq-header__logo\" aria-label=\"ToggleHQ Control Home\">\n type=\"button\"\n            className=\"thq-header__toggle\"\n            aria-label=\"Toggle navigation menu\"\n            aria-expanded={menuOpen}\n            onClick={() => setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}\n          >\n            <span className=\"thq-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"thq-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"thq-header__bar\" />\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"thq-header__mobile-menu\" role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"thq-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#release_controls\" className=\"thq-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Release Controls</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"thq-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n          <a href=\"mailto:support@togglehq.dev\" className=\"thq-header__mobile-cta\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Create Free Flag</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file I'll build an interactive category filter tablist with useState for (Sub-Millisecond Local Flag Eval, Targeted User Segmentation...) plus a verified testimonial carousel with slide navigation.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Release_controls.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport './ReleaseControls.css';\n\ninterface Feature {\n  id: string;\n  category: string;\n  title: string;\n  desc: string;\n  badge: string;\n}\n\ninterface Review {\n  id: string;\n  quote: string;\n  author: string;\n  role: string;\n  rating: number;\n}\n\nconst FEATURES: Feature[] = [{'title': 'Sub-Millisecond Local Flag Eval', 'tag': 'Streaming Sync', 'desc': 'Flags evaluate in-memory in your application runtime with streaming updates over server-sent events.'}, {'title': 'Targeted User Segmentation', 'tag': 'Attribute Based', 'desc': 'Target features based on email domain, subscription tier, beta opt-in, or geographical location.'}, {'title': 'Automatic Metric Circuit Breaker', 'tag': 'Crash Protection', 'desc': 'Automatically turn off a new feature flag if application crash rates spike by more than 0.2%.'}, {'title': 'Audit Logs & Approval Workflows', 'tag': 'Dual-Approval', 'desc': 'Require peer review and manager sign-off before toggling critical infrastructure flags in production.'}];\nconst REVIEWS: Review[] = [{'id': '1', 'quote': 'Deploying ToggleHQ Control transformed our delivery velocity. The sub-millisecond local flag eval capabilities delivered immediate impact.', 'author': 'Alex Chen', 'role': 'Head of Engineering, ToggleHQ Control', 'rating': 5}, {'id': '2', 'quote': 'With ToggleHQ Control, we automated real-time feature flagging, canary releases & instant kill-switches while accelerating our product delivery.', 'author': 'Samantha Wei', 'role': 'VP of Technology at ToggleHQ Control Group', 'rating': 5}, {'id': '3', 'quote': 'Our developers love using ToggleHQ Control. The targeted user segmentation workflow is best in class.', 'author': 'Marcus Thorne', 'role': 'Principal Architect', 'rating': 5}];\nconst CATEGORIES: { id: string; label: string }[] = [{'id': 'all', 'label': 'All Capabilities'}, {'id': 'core', 'label': 'Core Engine'}, {'id': 'security', 'label': 'Security & Auth'}, {'id': 'scale', 'label': 'Scale & Telemetry'}];\n\nexport function ReleaseControls() {\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>('all');\n  const [activeSlide, setActiveSlide] = useState<number>(0);\n\n  const filteredFeatures = activeTab === 'all'\n    ? FEATURES\n    : FEATURES.filter((f) => f.category === activeTab);\n\n  const prevSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev - 1 + REVIEWS.length) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const nextSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev + 1) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const currentReview = REVIEWS[activeSlide];\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"thq-tabs\" id=\"releasecontrols\" aria-labelledby=\"thq-tabs-title\">\n      <div className=\"thq-tabs__inner\">\n        {/* 1. Header & Tab Navigation */}\n        <div className=\"thq-tabs__header\">\n          <p className=\"thq-tabs__eyebrow\">DEVOPS SOLUTIONS</p>\n          <h2 id=\"thq-tabs-title\" className=\"thq-tabs__title\">\n            Release Controls\n          </h2>\n          <p className=\"thq-tabs__subtitle\">\n            Explore verified solutions and live client outcomes from ToggleHQ Control.\n          </p>\n\n          <div className=\"thq-tabs__nav\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Feature categories\">\n            {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (\n              <button\n                key={cat.id}\n                type=\"button\"\n                role=\"tab\"\n                aria-selected={activeTab === cat.id}\n                className={`thq-tabs__tab${activeTab === cat.id ? ' is-active' : ''}`}\n                onClick={() => setActiveTab(cat.id)}\n              >\n                {cat.label}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 2. Filtered Cards Grid */}\n        <div className=\"thq-tabs__grid\">\n          {filteredFeatures.map((item) => (\n            <div key={item.id} className=\"thq-tabs__card\">\n              <div className=\"thq-tabs__card-top\">\n                <span className=\"thq-tabs__badge\">{item.badge}</span>\n                <span className=\"thq-tabs__category\">{item.category}</span>\n              </div>\n              <h3 className=\"thq-tabs__card-title\">{item.title}</h3>\n              <p className=\"thq-tabs__card-desc\">{item.desc}</p>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 3. Carousel Component \u2014 Testimonials & Proof */}\n        <div className=\"thq-tabs__carousel\" aria-label=\"Customer Testimonials\">\n          <div className=\"thq-tabs__carousel-box\">\n            <div className=\"thq-tabs__stars\" aria-label=\"5 stars rating\">\n              {'\u2605'.repeat(currentReview.rating)}\n            </div>\n\n            <blockquote className=\"thq-tabs__quote\">\n              &ldquo;{currentReview.quote}&rdquo;\n            </blockquote>\n\n            <div className=\"thq-tabs__author\">\n              <div className=\"thq-tabs__author-avatar\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                {currentReview.author.split(' ').map((n) => n[0]).join('')}\n              </div>\n              <div>\n                <h4 className=\"thq-tabs__author-name\">{currentReview.author}</h4>\n                <span className=\"thq-tabs__author-role\">{currentReview.role}</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"thq-tabs__carousel-controls\">\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={prevSlide}\n                className=\"thq-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Previous testimonial\"\n              >\n                &larr;\n              </button>\n              <span className=\"thq-tabs__carousel-counter\">\n                0{activeSlide + 1} / 0{REVIEWS.length}\n              </span>\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={nextSlide}\n                className=\"thq-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Next testimonial\"\n              >\n                &rarr;\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Release_controls.css\">\n.thq-tabs {\n  width: 100%;\n  padding: 6.5rem 1.5rem;\n  background: var(--surface-obsidian, var(--color-obsidian, var(--bg-color, #0f172a)));\n  color: var(--color-paper, var(--text-color, #ffffff));\n}\n\n.thq-tabs__inner {\n  max-width: I'll also implement a scroll listener to trigger subtle border illumination on scroll.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 15);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`bcb-header${scrolled ? ' bcb-header--scrolled' : ''}`} role=\"banner\">\n      <div className=\"bcb-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"bcb-header__logo\" aria-label=\"BillCraft Billing Home\">\n href=\"#billing\" className=\"bcb-header__link\">Billing Capabilities</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"bcb-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n\n        <div className=\"bcb-header__actions\">\n          <a href=\"mailto:billing@billcraft.finance\" className=\"bcb-header__cta\">\n            Automate Billing\n          </a>\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            className=\"bcb-header__toggle\"\n            aria-label=\"Toggle navigation menu\"\n            aria-expanded={menuOpen}\n            onClick={() => setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}\n          >\n            <span className=\"bcb-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"bcb-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"bcb-header__bar\" />\n className=\"bcb-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#billing\" className=\"bcb-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Billing Capabilities</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"bcb-header__mobile-link\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n          <a href=\"mailto:billing@billcraft.finance\" className=\"bcb-header__mobile-cta\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Automate Billing</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file I'll build an interactive category filter tablist with useState for (Smart Dunning & Card Recovery, Global EU VAT & US Sales Tax...) plus a verified testimonial carousel with slide navigation.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Billing.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Billing.css';\n\ninterface Feature {\n  id: string;\n  category: string;\n  title: string;\n  desc: string;\n  badge: string;\n}\n\ninterface Review {\n  id: string;\n  quote: string;\n  author: string;\n  role: string;\n  rating: number;\n}\n\nconst FEATURES: Feature[] = [{'title': 'Smart Dunning & Card Recovery', 'tag': 'Recovers 68% Churn', 'desc': 'Automatically retries failed credit cards using smart machine learning schedules before canceling accounts.'}, {'title': 'Global EU VAT & US Sales Tax', 'tag': 'VIES Verified', 'desc': 'Real-time tax calculation and reverse-charge VAT validation based on customer billing country.'}, {'title': 'Tiered & Overage Usage Pricing', 'tag': 'Automated Metering', 'desc': 'Bill customers automatically for API calls, compute gigabytes, or active seats each billing cycle.'}, {'title': 'Branded Self-Serve Customer Portal', 'tag': 'Zero Support Tickets', 'desc': 'Let customers update credit cards, download PDF invoices, and upgrade plans independently.'}];\nconst REVIEWS: Review[] = [{'id': '1', 'quote': 'Deploying BillCraft Billing transformed our delivery velocity. The smart dunning & card recovery capabilities delivered immediate impact.', 'author': 'Alex Chen', 'role': 'Head of Engineering, BillCraft Billing', 'rating': 5}, {'id': '2', 'quote': 'With BillCraft Billing, we automated automated saas subscription billing & global vat / sales tax compliance while accelerating our product delivery.', 'author': 'Samantha Wei', 'role': 'VP of Technology at BillCraft Billing Group', 'rating': 5}, {'id': '3', 'quote': 'Our developers love using BillCraft Billing. The global eu vat & us sales tax workflow is best in class.', 'author': 'Marcus Thorne', 'role': 'Principal Architect', 'rating': 5}];\nconst CATEGORIES: { id: string; label: string }[] = [{'id': 'all', 'label': 'All Capabilities'}, {'id': 'core', 'label': 'Core Engine'}, {'id': 'security', 'label': 'Security & Auth'}, {'id': 'scale', 'label': 'Scale & Telemetry'}];\n\nexport function Billing() {\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>('all');\n  const [activeSlide, setActiveSlide] = useState<number>(0);\n\n  const filteredFeatures = activeTab === 'all'\n    ? FEATURES\n    : FEATURES.filter((f) => f.category === activeTab);\n\n  const prevSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev - 1 + REVIEWS.length) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const nextSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev + 1) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const currentReview = REVIEWS[activeSlide];\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"bcb-tabs\" id=\"billing\" aria-labelledby=\"bcb-tabs-title\">\n      <div className=\"bcb-tabs__inner\">\n        {/* 1. Header & Tab Navigation */}\n        <div className=\"bcb-tabs__header\">\n          <p className=\"bcb-tabs__eyebrow\">FINTECH SOLUTIONS</p>\n          <h2 id=\"bcb-tabs-title\" className=\"bcb-tabs__title\">\n            Billing Capabilities\n          </h2>\n          <p className=\"bcb-tabs__subtitle\">\n            Explore verified solutions and live client outcomes from BillCraft Billing.\n          </p>\n\n          <div className=\"bcb-tabs__nav\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Feature categories\">\n            {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (\n              <button\n                key={cat.id}\n                type=\"button\"\n                role=\"tab\"\n                aria-selected={activeTab === cat.id}\n                className={`bcb-tabs__tab${activeTab === cat.id ? ' is-active' : ''}`}\n                onClick={() => setActiveTab(cat.id)}\n              >\n                {cat.label}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 2. Filtered Cards Grid */}\n        <div className=\"bcb-tabs__grid\">\n          {filteredFeatures.map((item) => (\n            <div key={item.id} className=\"bcb-tabs__card\">\n              <div className=\"bcb-tabs__card-top\">\n                <span className=\"bcb-tabs__badge\">{item.badge}</span>\n                <span className=\"bcb-tabs__category\">{item.category}</span>\n              </div>\n              <h3 className=\"bcb-tabs__card-title\">{item.title}</h3>\n              <p className=\"bcb-tabs__card-desc\">{item.desc}</p>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 3. Carousel Component \u2014 Testimonials & Proof */}\n        <div className=\"bcb-tabs__carousel\" aria-label=\"Customer Testimonials\">\n          <div className=\"bcb-tabs__carousel-box\">\n            <div className=\"bcb-tabs__stars\" aria-label=\"5 stars rating\">\n              {'\u2605'.repeat(currentReview.rating)}\n            </div>\n\n            <blockquote className=\"bcb-tabs__quote\">\n              &ldquo;{currentReview.quote}&rdquo;\n            </blockquote>\n\n            <div className=\"bcb-tabs__author\">\n              <div className=\"bcb-tabs__author-avatar\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n                {currentReview.author.split(' ').map((n) => n[0]).join('')}\n              </div>\n              <div>\n                <h4 className=\"bcb-tabs__author-name\">{currentReview.author}</h4>\n                <span className=\"bcb-tabs__author-role\">{currentReview.role}</span>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"bcb-tabs__carousel-controls\">\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={prevSlide}\n                className=\"bcb-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Previous testimonial\"\n              >\n                &larr;\n              </button>\n              <span className=\"bcb-tabs__carousel-counter\">\n                0{activeSlide + 1} / 0{REVIEWS.length}\n              </span>\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={nextSlide}\n                className=\"bcb-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Next testimonial\"\n              >\n                &rarr;\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Billing.css\">\n.bcb-tabs {\n  width: 100%;\n  padding: 6.5rem 1.5rem;\n  background: var(--surface-obsidian, var(--color-obsidian, var(--bg-color, #0f172a)));\n  color: var(--color-paper, var(--text-color, #ffffff));\n}\n\n.bcb-tabs__inner {\n  max-width: The ai semantic visual search workflow is best in class.', 'author': 'Marcus Thorne', 'role': 'Principal Architect', 'rating': 5}];\nconst CATEGORIES: { id: string; label: string }[] = [{'id': 'all', 'label': 'All Capabilities'}, {'id': 'core', 'label': 'Core Engine'}, {'id': 'security', 'label': 'Security & Auth'}, {'id': 'scale', 'label': 'Scale & Telemetry'}];\n\nexport function AssetTools() {\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>('all');\n  const [activeSlide, setActiveSlide] = useState<number>(0);\n\n  const filteredFeatures = activeTab === 'all'\n    ? FEATURES\n    : FEATURES.filter((f) => f.category === activeTab);\n\n  const prevSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev - 1 + REVIEWS.length) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const nextSlide = () => {\n    setActiveSlide((prev) => (prev + 1) % REVIEWS.length);\n  };\n\n  const currentReview = REVIEWS[activeSlide];\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"pvd-tabs\" id=\"assettools\" aria-labelledby=\"pvd-tabs-title\">\n      <div className=\"pvd-tabs__inner\">\n        {/* 1. Header & Tab Navigation */}\n        <div className=\"pvd-tabs__header\">\n          <p className=\"pvd-tabs__eyebrow\">SAAS SOLUTIONS</p>\n          <h2 id=\"pvd-tabs-title\" className=\"pvd-tabs__title\">\n            Asset Tools\n          </h2>\n          <p className=\"pvd-tabs__subtitle\">\n            Explore verified solutions and live client outcomes from PixelVault DAM.\n          </p>\n\n          <div className=\"pvd-tabs__nav\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Feature categories\">\n            {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (\n              <button\n                key={cat.id}\n                type=\"button\"\n                role=\"tab\"\n                aria-selected={activeTab === cat.id}\n                className={`pvd-tabs__tab${activeTab === cat.id ? ' is-active' : ''}`}\n                onClick={() => setActiveTab(cat.id)}\n              >\n                {cat.label}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 2. Filtered Cards Grid */}\n        <div className=\"pvd-tabs__grid\">\n          {filteredFeatures.map((item) => (\n            <div key={item.id} className=\"pvd-tabs__card\">\n              <div className=\"pvd-tabs__card-top\">\n                <span className=\"pvd-tabs__badge\">{item.badge}</span>\n                <span className=\"pvd-tabs__category\">{item.category}</span>\n              </div>\n              <h3 className=\"pvd-tabs__card-title\">{item.title}</h3>\n              <p className=\"pvd-tabs__card-desc\">{item.desc}</p>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 3. Carousel Component \u2014 Testimonials & Proof */}\n        <div className=\"pvd-tabs__carousel\" aria-label=\"Customer Testimonials\">\n          <div className=\"pvd-tabs__carousel-box\">\n            <div className=\"pvd-tabs__stars\" aria-label=\"5 stars rating\">\n              {'\u2605'.repeat(currentReview.rating)}\n            </div>\n\n            <blockquote className=\"pvd-tabs__quote\">\n              &ldquo;{currentReview.quote}&rdquo;\n            </blockquote>\n\n            <div className=\"pvd-tabs__author\">\n              <div        <div className=\"pvd-tabs__carousel-controls\">\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={prevSlide}\n                className=\"pvd-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Previous testimonial\"\n              >\n                &larr;\n              </button>\n              <span className=\"pvd-tabs__carousel-counter\">\n                0{activeSlide + 1} / 0{REVIEWS.length}\n              </span>\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={nextSlide}\n                className=\"pvd-tabs__carousel-btn\"\n                aria-label=\"Next testimonial\"\n              >\n                &rarr;\n              </button>\n    />\n      <div className=\"pw-meter__bar\">\n        <div className={`pw-meter__fill score-${score}`} style={{ width: `${(score / 4) * 100}%` }} />\n      </div>\n      <span `````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
generate_site_trajectories_batch5.py - Batch 5 of Gold-Standard Site Trajectories (50 Modern Real-World Domains).

Generates 50 complete, multi-turn, full-website trajectories adhering strictly to
the ChatML schema and XML tool-calling protocol defined in agent_protocol.py.
Integrates layout archetyping (grid, timeline, tabs, split_hero, editorial, bento),
domain-specific authentic copy, and scoped modern CSS.

Outputs:
  site_trajectories_batch5.jsonl
  data/site_trajectories_batch5.jsonl
"""

import json
import os
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# Ensure UTF-8 console output
if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR / "agent"))

from agent_protocol import SITE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT
from site_brief import LayoutArchetype, select_layout_archetype, _LAYOUT_ARCHETYPE_GUIDELINES, _MOTION_VOCABULARY


def obs_ok(files, next_instruction):
    lines = ['<observation status="ok">']
    lines.append("[Files accepted]:")
    for p in files:
        lines.append(f"  ✓ {p}")
    lines.append(f"\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: {next_instruction}")
    lines.append('Write ONE <tool_call name="write_site"> with exactly one .tsx file and one .css file for this section.')
    lines.append("</observation>")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def obs_done(files):
    lines = ['<observation status="complete">']
    lines.append("[SITE BUILD COMPLETE]: All required sections have been written successfully.")
    lines.append("[Files written in this session]:")
    for p in files:
        lines.append(f"  ✓ {p}")
    lines.append("Output a <finish> tag with a brief summary of the site you built.")
    lines.append("</observation>")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def write_site(tsx_path, tsx_code, css_path, css_code):
    return (
        f'<tool_call name="write_site">\n'
        f'<file path="{tsx_path}">\n{tsx_code}\n</file>\n'
        f'<file path="{css_path}">\n{css_code}\n</file>\n'
        f'</tool_call>'
    )


def thought(text):
    return f"<thought>\n{text}\n</thought>"


def finish(text):
    return f"<finish>\n{text}\n</finish>"

# Guarantee 100% unique accents across all domains
_seen_accents = set()
for _i, _d in enumerate(DOMAINS):
    _acc = _d["accent"]
    if _acc in _seen_accents:
        _r = int(_acc[1:3], 16)
        _g = int(_acc[3:5], 16)
        _b = int(_acc[5:7], 16)
        _r = min(255, max(0, _r + ((_i * 7) % 23) - 10))
        _g = min(255, max(0, _g + ((_i * 11) % 23) - 10))
        _b = min(255, max(0, _b + ((_i * 13) % 23) - 10))
        _d["accent"] = f"#{_r:02x}{_g:02x}{_b:02x}"
    _seen_accents.add(_d["accent"])

def build_brief_xml(d, layout_archetype="grid"):
    items_xml = []
    for item in d["items"]:
        items_xml.append(f'  <item name="{item["title"]}" tag="{item["tag"]}" description="{item["desc"]}" />')
    items_str = "\n".join(items_xml)
    guidelines = _LAYOUT_ARCHETYPE_GUIDELINES.get(layout_archetype, "")
    motion_obj = _MOTION_VOCABULARY.get(layout_archetype, "")
    motion_guidelines = motion_obj.get("guidelines", str(motion_obj)) if isinstance(motion_obj, dict) else str(motion_obj)

    return f"""<content_brief>
  <business_name>{d["name"]}</business_name>
  <tagline>{d["tagline"]}</tagline>
  <business_type>{d["type"]}</business_type>
  <layout_archetype>{layout_archetype}</layout_archetype>
  <layout_guidelines>{guidelines}</layout_guidelines>
  <motion_guidelines>{motion_guidelines}</motion_guidelines>
  <primary_color>{d["primary"]}</primary_color>
  <accent_color>{d["accent"]}</accent_color>
  <font_heading>{d["heading_font"]}</font_heading>
  <font_body>{d["body_font"]}</font_body>
  <sections>header, hero, {d["section_id"]}, footer</sections>
{items_str}
  <contact>
    <address>{d["contact"]["address"]}</address>
    <phone>{d["contact"]["phone"]}</phone>
    <email>{d["contact"]["email"]}</email>
    <hours>{d["contact"]["hours"]}</hours>
  </contact>
</content_brief>"""


def make_hero_code(p, d, layout_archetype):
    accent_r = int(d['accent'][1:3], 16)
    accent_g = int(d['accent'][3:5], 16)
    accent_b = int(d['accent'][5:7], 16)

    if layout_archetype == "bento":
        t2_user = (
            f"Write the Hero section: high-tech centered banner with tagline as h1, ambient radial glow, "

        )
        t2_thought = (
            f"Header was approved. Now I'll create the Hero section for {d['name']} using the Bento high-tech layout. "
            f"The headline will render the tagline in {d['heading_font']} typography. "
            f"I'll add radial ambient glowing backdrops using {d['accent']} at 16% opacity, supporting copy, "
            f"a primary '{d['cta']}' button, secondary link to #{d['section_id']}, and a live metric highlights strip."
        )
        t2_tsx = f"""import React from 'react';
import './Hero.css';

export function Hero() {{

    <section className="{p}-hero {p}-hero--bento" id="hero" aria-labelledby="{p}-hero-title">
      <div className="{p}-hero__glow" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="{p}-hero__inner">
        <div className="{p}-hero__badge">
          <span className="{p}-hero__badge-pulse" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>{d['name']} · Verified</span>
        </div>

        <h1 id="{p}-hero-title" className="{p}-hero__title">
          {d['tagline']}
        </h1>

        <p className="{p}-hero__subtitle">
          {d['hero_sub']}
        </p>

        <div className="{p}-hero__actions">
          <a href="mailto:{d['contact']['email']}" className="{p}-hero__btn-primary">
            {d['cta']}
          </a>
          <a href="#{d['section_id']}" className="{p}-hero__btn-secondary">
            Explore {d['section_name']}
          </a>
        </div>

        <div className="{p}-hero__metrics" role="group" aria-label="Key Highlights">
          <div className="{p}-hero__metric">
            <span className="{p}-hero__metric-value">99.9%</span>
            <span className="{p}-hero__metric-label">Reliability Index</span>
          </div>
          <div className="{p}-hero__metric">
            <span className="{p}-hero__metric-value">24/7</span>
            <span className="{p}-hero__metric-label">Dedicated Support</span>
          </div>
          <div className="{p}-hero__metric">
            <span className="{p}-hero__metric-value">5.0★</span>
            <span className="{p}-hero__metric-label">Client Trust Score</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}}
"""
        t2_css = f""".{p}-hero {{
  position: relative;
  min-height: 86vh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: {d['primary']};
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 5rem 2rem;
}}

.{p}-hero__glow {{
  position: absolute;
  top: 10%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 750px;
  height: 500px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba({accent_r}, {accent_g}, {accent_b}, 0.16) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
  filter: blur(24px);
}}

.{p}-hero__inner {{
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  max-width: 880px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
}}

.{p}-hero__badge {{
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 1rem;
  background: rgba({accent_r}, {accent_g}, {accent_b}, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba({accent_r}, {accent_g}, {accent_b}, 0.22);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: #e4e4e7;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}}

.{p}-hero__badge-pulse {{
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: {d['accent']};
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px {d['accent']};
}}

.{p}-hero__title {{
  font-family: '{d['heading_font']}', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5.5vw, 4.2rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #fafafa;
  line-height: 1.12;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
}}

.{p}-hero__subtitle {{
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  color: #a1a1aa;
  line-height: 1.7;
  max-width: 640px;
  margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
}}

.{p}-hero__actions {{
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}}

.{p}-hero__btn-primary {{
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

    elif layout_archetype == "timeline":
        t3_user = (
            f"Write the {d['section_name']} section using a sequential timeline track layout: vertical milestone spine line, "
            f"step numbers, node markers, and chronological cards. Files: src/components/{sec_ts_name}.tsx + src/components/{sec_ts_name}.css"
        )
        t3_thought = (
            f"Now creating the core content component '{sec_ts_name}' for {d['name']} with the Timeline layout archetype. "
            f"I'll render the {len(d['items'])} items sequentially along a vertical milestone track with step indicators, "
            f"node connectors, and detailed descriptive cards."
        )
        milestones = [
            {"step": f"Phase 0{idx+1}", "title": it["title"], "tag": it["tag"], "desc": it["desc"]}
            for idx, it in enumerate(d["items"])
        ]
        milestones_json = json.dumps(milestones, indent=2)

        t3_tsx = f"""import React from 'react';
import './{sec_ts_name}.css';

interface Milestone {{
  step: string;
  title: string;
  tag: string;
  desc: string;
}}

const MILESTONES: Milestone[] = {milestones_json};

export function {sec_ts_name}() {{
  const trackRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {{
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {{
        entries.forEach((entry) => {{
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {{
            entry.target.classList.add('is-revealed');
          }}
        }});
      }},
      {{ threshold: 0.2 }}
    );

    const nodes = trackRef.current?.querySelectorAll('.{p}-timeline__node');
    nodes?.forEach((node) => observer.observe(node));

    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }}, []);

  return (
    <section className="{p}-timeline" id="{d['section_id']}" aria-labelledby="{p}-timeline-title">
      <div className="{p}-timeline__inner">
        <div className="{p}-timeline__header">
          <p className="{p}-timeline__eyebrow">Sequential Roadmap</p>
          <h2 id="{p}-timeline-title" className="{p}-timeline__title">
            {d['section_name']}
          </h2>
          <p className="{p}-timeline__desc">
            {catalog_desc}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div ref={{trackRef}} className="{p}-timeline__track">
          <div className="{p}-timeline__spine" aria-hidden="true" />
          {{MILESTONES.map((m) => (
            <article key={{m.title}} className="{p}-timeline__node">
              <div className="{p}-timeline__marker" aria-hidden="true">
                <span className="{p}-timeline__dot" />
              </div>
              <div className="{p}-timeline__card">
                <div className="{p}-timeline__card-top">
                  <span className="{p}-timeline__step">{{m.step}}</span>
                  <span className="{p}-timeline__tag">{{m.tag}}</span>
                </div>
                <h3 className="{p}-timeline__card-title">{{m.title}}</h3>
                <p className="{p}-timeline__card-desc">{{m.desc}}</p>
              </div>
            </article>
          ))}}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}}
"""

    else:  # grid

        )
        t3_tsx = f"""import React from 'react';
import './{sec_ts_name}.css';

interface Item {{
  title: string;
  tag: string;
  desc: string;
}}

const ITEMS: Item[] = {items_json};

export function {sec_ts_name}() {{
  const gridRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {{
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {{
        entries.forEach((entry) => {{
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {{
            entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
          }}
        }});
      }},
      {{ threshold: 0.15 }}
    );

    const cards = gridRef.current?.querySelectorAll('.{p}-card');
    cards?.forEach((card) => observer.observe(card));

    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }}, []);

  return (
    <section className="{p}-catalog" id="{d['section_id']}" aria-labelledby="{p}-catalog-title">
      <div className="{p}-catalog__inner">
        <div className="{p}-catalog__header">
          <p className="{p}-catalog__eyebrow">Featured Highlights</p>
          <h2 id="{p}-catalog-title" className="{p}-catalog__title">
            {d['section_name']}
          </h2>
          <p className="{p}-catalog__desc">
            {catalog_desc}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div ref={{gridRef}} className="{p}-catalog__grid">
          {{ITEMS.map((item, idx) => (
            <article key={{item.title}} className="{p}-card" style={{{{ transitionDelay: `${{idx * 60}}ms` }}}}>
              <div className="{p}-card__top">
                <span className="{p}-card__index">0{{idx + 1}}</span>
                <span className="{p}-card__tag">{{item.tag}}</span>
              </div>
              <h3 className="{p}-card__title">{{item.title}}</h3>
              <p className="{p}-card__desc">{{item.desc}}</p>
            </article>
          ))}}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}}
"""

def build_trajectory(d):
    target_arch = d.get("layout_archetype", "grid")
    prompt_seed = f"Build a complete website with layout: {target_arch} for {d['name']}. Business type: {d['type']}."
    layout_archetype = select_layout_archetype(prompt_seed, business_type=d["type"], business_name=d["name"])
    brief_xml = build_brief_xml(d, layout_archetype=layout_archetype)
    p = d["prefix"]

    # ── Turn 1: Header ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    initial_user = (
        f"Build a complete website for the following brief with layout: {layout_archetype}.\n\n"
        f"{brief_xml}\n\n"
        "You will build the site ONE SECTION AT A TIME. Start with the first section now.\n\n"
        f"FIRST SECTION REQUIRED: Write the Header section: a sticky navigation bar with the business name/logo on the left, "
        f"navigation links (Home, {d['section_name']}, Contact) on the right, plus '{d['cta']}' CTA button. "
        "Files: src/components/Header.tsx + src/components/Header.css"
    )

    t1_thought = thought(
        f"I'll start by crafting the Header for {d['name']}. "
        f"It needs to reflect the {d['type']} brand identity: deep background ({d['primary']}) with crisp contrast, "
        f"the elegant {d['heading_font']} typography for the wordmark, and the signature {d['accent']} accent for the CTA button. "
        "I'll also implement a scroll listener to trigger glassmorphism and subtle border illumination on scroll."
    )

    t1_tsx = f"""import React, {{ useState, useEffect }} from 'react';
import './Header.css';

export function Header() {{
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {{
    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 15);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {{ passive: true }});
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
  }}, []);

  return (
    <header className={{`{p}-header${{scrolled ? ' {p}-header--scrolled' : ''}}`}} role="banner">
      <div className="{p}-header__inner">
        <a href="#" className="{p}-header__logo" aria-label="{d['name']} Home">
          {d['name']}
        </a>

        <nav className="{p}-header__nav" aria-label="Main Navigation">
          <a href="#hero" className="{p}-header__link">Home</a>
          <a href="#{d['section_id']}" className="{p}-header__link">{d['section_name']}</a>
          <a href="#footer" className="{p}-header__link">Contact</a>
        </nav>

        <div className="{p}-header__actions">
          <a href="mailto:{d['contact']['email']}" className="{p}-header__cta">
            {d['cta']}
          </a>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="{p}-header__toggle"
            aria-label="Toggle navigation menu"
            aria-expanded={{menuOpen}}
            onClick={{() => setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}}
          >
            <span className="{p}-header__bar" />
            <span className="{p}-header__bar" />
            <span className="{p}-header__bar" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {{menuOpen && (
        <div className="{p}-header__mobile-menu">
          <a href="#hero" onClick={{() => setMenuOpen(false)}}>Home</a>
          <a href="#{d['section_id']}" onClick={{() => setMenuOpen(false)}}>{d['section_name']}</a>
          <a href="#footer" onClick={{() => setMenuOpen(false)}}>Contact</a>
        </div>
      )}}
    </header>
  );
}}
"""

    t1_css = f""".{p}-header {{
  position: sticky;

@media (max-width: 768px) {{
  .{p}-header__nav {{ display: none; }}
  .{p}-header__toggle {{ display: flex; }}
}}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {{
  .{p}-header,
  .{p}-header__cta,
  .{p}-header__link {{
    transition: none !important;
    transform: none !important;
    animation: none !important;
  }}
}}
"""

    t1_action = write_site("src/components/Header.tsx", t1_tsx, "src/components/Header.css", t1_css)

    # ── Turn 2: Hero (Branches on layout_archetype) ─────────────────────────────
    t2_user_str, t2_thought_str, t2_tsx, t2_css = make_hero_code(p, d, layout_archetype)
    t2_user = obs_ok(["src/components/Header.tsx", "src/components/Header.css"], t2_user_str)
    t2_thought = thought(t2_thought_str)
    t2_action = write_site("src/components/Hero.tsx", t2_tsx, "src/components/Hero.css", t2_css)

    # ── Turn 3: Main Content Section (Branches on layout_archetype) ─────────────
    sec_ts_name = d["section_name"].replace(" ", "").replace("&", "")
    t3_user_str, t3_thought_str, t3_tsx, t3_css = make_turn3_code(p, d, layout_archetype)
    t3_user = obs_ok(["src/components/Hero.tsx", "src/components/Hero.css"], t3_user_str)
    t3_thought = thought(t3_thought_str)
    t3_action = write_site(f"src/components/{sec_ts_name}.tsx", t3_tsx, f"src/components/{sec_ts_name}.css", t3_css)

    # ── Turn 4: Footer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    t4_user = obs_ok(
        [f"src/components/{sec_ts_name}.tsx", f"src/components/{sec_ts_name}.css"],
        "Write the Footer section: dark footer with business name, address, phone, email, hours, and copyright. "
