`````markdown
# SiteAgent (ReactAgent SLM)

> **A local website builder powered by a small language model.**
> Describe a site in plain English; SiteAgent plans it, writes it as a React + TypeScript project,
> builds it, checks it in a real browser (types, build, accessibility, motion, runtime) and shows a
> live preview you can inspect and edit. Built on `Qwen/Qwen3-4B`; runs on your own machine —
> an NVIDIA/AMD GPU, an Apple Silicon Mac, or just a CPU.

---

## Quick start

**You need:** Python 3.10–3.13, [Node.js 18+](https://nodejs.org), Git, ~15 GB of free disk
(8 GB is the model). A GPU is optional.

```bash
git clone <this-repo-url> siteagent
cd siteagent
```

**1. Install** (creates `.venv`, picks the right PyTorch for your hardware, builds the UI,
downloads Qwen3-4B, then runs a health check):

```bash
# macOS / Linux / Git Bash
bash scripts/setup.sh
```

```bat
:: Windows (Command Prompt or PowerShell)
scripts\setup.bat
```

Options: `--cpu` (force CPU), `--skip-model` (download later with `python slm.py download`),
`--base Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B` (smaller model for low-memory machines),
`--adapter USER/REPO` (also download a fine-tuned native adapter).

**2. Run the workbench** at <http://127.0.0.1:5000>:

```bash
bash scripts/run_web_ui.sh          # macOS / Linux / Git Bash
scripts\run_web_ui.bat              # Windows
```

**3. Check your setup at any time:**

```bash
python slm.py doctor
```

It prints your hardware profile (GPU, memory, backend, context length) and every missing piece
with the command that fixes it. The top bar of the workbench shows the model's state:
amber **Loading model** while it loads, green **Ready** when you can send a prompt.

### Hardware

The model loader (`agent/hardware.py`) detects your machine and picks the backend, precision and
context length automatically:

| Machine | How the model runs | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| NVIDIA GPU, 6 GB+ VRAM | 4-bit (Unsloth or bitsandbytes) on the GPU | Developed on a 6 GB RTX 4050. ~25 tokens/s. |
| NVIDIA GPU, 8 GB+ without 4-bit libraries | float16 on the GPU | Used automatically if Unsloth/bitsandbytes can't install. |
| AMD GPU (Linux, ROCm) | Transformers on the GPU | Unsloth is NVIDIA-only. |
| Apple Silicon (M1+), 16 GB+ | float16 on Metal | |
| CPU only, 12 GB+ RAM | bfloat16 on the CPU | Works; a few tokens/s. Kit mode stays usable. |
| Less memory | use `--base Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B` | Kit mode only (the native adapter needs Qwen3-4B). |

Override anything with environment variables: `SLM_DEVICE=cuda|mps|cpu`,
`SLM_BACKEND=unsloth|transformers`, `SLM_LOAD_IN_4BIT=0|1`, `SLM_CONTEXT_LENGTH=8192`,
`MODEL_PATH=<model or adapter folder>`.

### Two ways to build a site

* **Design kit (default, fast — about 1–2 minutes per site).** The model writes each section's
  copy as JSON and the design kit (`agent/site_kit/`) renders accessible, token-driven React/CSS:
  12 contrast-checked art directions, vetted photography, menus, galleries, carts, FAQs, forms,
  a native motion system, favicons and OpenGraph tags.
* **Native (the model writes the code — about 20–40 minutes per site on a 6 GB GPU).** A
  fine-tuned LoRA adapter writes every section's React component and CSS itself; the kit only
  plans the site and supplies shared design tokens. Each section is accepted only if it
  typechecks, keeps the approved copy exactly and keeps every behaviour the design system requires;
  otherwise the kit renders that section. On held-out business types the adapter's sections were
  accepted 92% of the time vs 6% for the untuned model — see
  [docs/NATIVE_SECTION_TRAINING.md](docs/NATIVE_SECTION_TRAINING.md).
  Choose it per request in the composer (*Advanced → Site code written by → The model*), or start
  with `scripts/run_web_ui.sh --native`. It needs an adapter in `models/`: download one with
  `python slm.py download --adapter USER/REPO`, or train your own (below).

### Website requests

Describe the audience, content, visual style and interactions you want. An inline
`Sections: a, b, c` or `Include: a, b, c` list is followed exactly. Products, prices, projects,
testimonials and contact details appear only when you supply them — the site never invents them.

### Training your own adapter

```bash
python scripts/build_native_section_data.py generate --per-family 5   # copy from the base model (GPU, ~2 h)
python scripts/build_native_section_data.py assemble                   # train/validation rows
python training/train_native_sections.py                               # QLoRA, ~4-5 h on a 6 GB GPU
python scripts/eval_native_sections.py --model models/<adapter> --out runs/eval.json
python scripts/publish_adapter.py models/<adapter> --repo YOUR_NAME/siteagent-native-qwen3-4b  # share it
```

Training needs an NVIDIA GPU with Unsloth (`pip install -r requirements-gpu.txt`).

### Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Top bar stays **Loading model** | Check the server console; run `python slm.py doctor`. |
| CUDA out of memory | Close other GPU apps, or `SLM_CONTEXT_LENGTH=4096`, or `SLM_DEVICE=cpu`. |
| `bitsandbytes`/`unsloth` failed to install | Fine — the loader falls back to float16 Transformers (needs ~8 GB VRAM). |
| Preview shows "build failed" | The panel shows the error; fix the file in the Code tab or click *Rebuild preview*. |
| Browser checks skipped | `python -m playwright install chromium` |
| Blank workbench page | `cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build` |

## 🎯 Key Features & Capabilities

### 1. Autonomous Multi-Turn Self-Correction Loop
- **Turn 1 Best-of-2 Sampling**: Samples two distinct candidates on Turn 1 with cached evaluation reuse to maximize 1-shot accuracy without doubling multi-turn costs.
- **Strict Protocol Enforcement**: Uses XML tool-calling syntax (`<tool_call name="write_component">`, `<tool_call name="write_site">`, `<finish>`) with ChatML formatting.
- **Intelligent Observation Pruning**: Automatically extracts primary TypeScript compiler errors, strips verbose stack traces, and provides actionable compiler feedback to the model.
- **Anti-Stuck Escalation**: Detects repetitive error cycles across turns and escalates temperature / repetition penalty to break out of local minima.

### 2. Full-Website & Component Scaffolding
- **Multi-Turn Site Architecture**: Generates cohesive 4-to-6 section websites (Header, Hero, Services, Interactive Widgets, Pricing Calculator, Testimonials, Footer).
- **Domain-Specific Visual Systems**: Tailors color palettes, typography tokens (Cinzel, Space Grotesk, Outfit, Playfair), and glassmorphism styling across 15+ business verticals.
- **Automatic Vite Preview**: Instantly scaffolds `package.json`, `vite.config.ts`, and `index.html` to run hot-reloading dev servers directly in the browser iframe.

### 3. High-Performance Evaluation Harness
- **153 Disjoint Held-Out Tasks**: Covers 4 strict verification variants: `tsc_only`, `tsc_and_render`, `tsc_render_a11y`, and `tsc_render_interact`.
- **Fast Batch Mode**: Runs the complete test suite in 10–15 seconds via parallelized Vitest processes.
- **Zero-Overlap Guarantee**: Enforces compile-time and run-time checks preventing any train/eval data contamination.

---

## 🧠 Model & LoRA Configuration

**Default model:** the workbench runs the **base `Qwen/Qwen3-4B` model** (design kit mode). The native
section adapter (`models/qwen3-siteagent-native-sections-r16-v2`, trained with
`training/train_native_sections.py`) is loaded with `MODEL_PATH` / `scripts/run_web_ui.sh --native`.
Older candidate adapters under `models/` are unpromoted experiments.
`my-react-agent-lora/` holds the historical Qwen2.5 adapter and is not loaded by default.

The QLoRA training profile used for Qwen3 candidates:

| Hyperparameter | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Base Model** | `Qwen/Qwen3-4B` | 4B-parameter base model in `./base-model` |
| **LoRA Rank (`r`)** | `16` | Adapter rank |
| **LoRA Alpha (`alpha`)** | `16` | Scaling factor $\alpha / r = 1.0$ |
| **Target Modules** | `q_proj`, `k_proj`, `v_proj`, `o_proj`, `gate_proj`, `up_proj`, `down_proj` | All 7 attention & MLP projections |
| **LoRA Dropout** | `0.0` | 0.0 for Unsloth fast kernel patching |
| **Precision** | `4-bit NF4` (QLoRA) | Fits in 6GB VRAM (RTX 4050 Laptop GPU) |
| **Max Sequence Length** | `8192` tokens | Thread-safe generation window |
| **Rank Sweep Options** | `r in [8, 16, 32, 64]` | Configurable in `training/train_sft.py --rank` |

## 🛠️ Unified CLI Reference (`slm.py`)

The root CLI provides a unified interface across all workflows:

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `python slm.py pipeline` | Full end-to-end training pipeline (merge → validate → train SFT) |
| `python slm.py setup` | Install everything for this machine (`--cpu`, `--skip-model`, `--adapter`) |
| `python slm.py doctor` | Check hardware, dependencies and models; print fixes |
| `python slm.py download` | Download Qwen3-4B (`--base`, `--adapter USER/REPO`) |
| `python slm.py serve` | Launch web UI workbench on `http://127.0.0.1:5000` |
| `python slm.py train` | Run QLoRA SFT training (`training/train_sft.py`) |
| `python slm.py train-dpo` | Run Direct Preference Optimization (`training/train_dpo.py`) |
| `python slm.py evaluate` | Run Vitest + jsdom benchmark evaluation suite |
| `python slm.py agent` | Run autonomous agent loop interactively or with `--mock` |
| `python slm.py dataset merge` | Merge all trajectory sources into `data/training_data.jsonl` |
| `python slm.py dataset validate` | Validate trajectories through live tsc and Vitest compilers |
| `python slm.py generate site` | Generate site trajectory batches (`--batch 1|2|3|4|5|interactive|all`) |
`````

`````markdown
## Phase 3 — Fix the training-data template homogeneity (the real design-quality root cause)

This is new since the last audit and is the biggest lever on "why does
everything look the same." Across ~220 site trajectories, one skeleton
repeats near-verbatim 100+ times: the filler line *"Carefully curated
offerings tailored to provide exceptional quality and reliability,"* the
`__ambient` radial-glow hero div, the `{BusinessName} Official` pulsing
badge, and the `0{idx+1}` card index badge — reused identically across
totally unrelated industries.

1. **Deduplicate the template at the source.** In whichever generator
   produced this batch (`generate_site_trajectories_batch4.py`,
   `_batch5.py`, and siblings), find wherever these four snippets are
   emitted and confirm whether they're literally copy-pasted per domain
   entry or generated by one shared helper function applied to every domain.
   If it's a shared helper, that's the actual bug — the helper needs to
   *vary* structure per domain, not just swap the color token.
2. **Write real per-domain structural variation**, not just per-domain
   colors: at minimum, vary (a) the hero's supporting visual element (not
   every hero needs a radial ambient glow — try a split-image layout, a
   stat strip, a diagonal divider for some domains), (b) the card grid shape
   (not always 2×2 — try a horizontal scroll strip, an asymmetric
   masonry, a numbered list for others), (c) drop the generic filler
   description sentence and replace it with domain-specific copy — if a
   generation script is auto-filling this sentence as a default, remove the
   default and require real copy per domain entry.
3. **Regenerate a fresh trajectory batch** using the fixed generator and
   spot-check for the four patterns above — they should now vary, not repeat.
4. This is naturally where the de-cliché pass belongs too — while touching
   this generator, grep for and rewrite any remaining instances of
   "elevate," "seamless," "effortless," "empower," "unlock," "cutting-edge"
   in the copy these generators produce.
5. **Don't retrain until this is done.** Fine-tuning on a corpus that still
   has the duplicated skeleton just re-teaches the same generic output with
   extra steps.

**Verify:**
```bash
grep -c "Carefully curated offerings tailored to provide exceptional quality and reliability" <new-batch-file>
grep -c "__ambient" <new-batch-file>
grep -c "0{idx + 1}" <new-batch-file>
```
All three counts should be near-zero (a few coincidental matches are fine;
100+ identical repeats is the bug). Then spot-check 5 random trajectories
from the new batch across different domains and confirm their hero layout,
card grid shape, and description copy are visibly different from each other,
not just recolored.

**[v2] Optional but recommended — replace pure spot-checking with a
measurable signal.** Human spot-checking 5 trajectories is a reasonable
smoke test but doesn't scale and is exactly the kind of "looks fine to me"
judgment this plan is otherwise trying to eliminate. If an eval/benchmark
harness already exists in the repo (there's a fine-tuning/eval pipeline
referenced elsewhere in this codebase), before regenerating the batch:
1. Compute a simple template-similarity metric across the *old* batch (e.g.
   n-gram/Jaccard overlap of hero-section markup across trajectories from
   different domains, or a count of shared multi-word phrases above some
   length threshold).
2. Regenerate the batch per steps 1–4 above.
3. Recompute the same metric on the *new* batch and confirm it dropped
   substantially, not just that your 5 spot-checked samples happened to look
   different. This gives you an objective before/after number instead of
   relying entirely on manual review.

## Phase 6 — Workbench UI redesign (Claude/ChatGPT-style chat)

This is the largest phase. Land it after Phases 1–5 so the UI has real
signals (visual score, per-section plan, auto-recovery flags) to display.

### 6.1 Layout
- Centered message column (~680–760px max-width), generous vertical rhythm.
- Collapsible left sidebar for session history (business name + last-message
  time, not code-editor chrome).
- No permanent fixed-width right pane — code/preview/terminal become a
  slide-over panel or bottom sheet opened on demand.
- Prompt input pinned to the bottom of the message column, auto-growing
  textarea.

### 6.2 Message rendering
- User turns: plain text block with light background tint, not a heavy
  speech-bubble.
- Assistant turns: render the post-generation summary as real typeset
  markdown (actual heading sizes, spacing, bullet lists) instead of inline
  `<p style="...">` tags per line.
- Streaming reveal of the summary text as it arrives over SSE.
- File-touched chips and diff/preview action buttons as a quiet footer row.
- The visual-score badge from Phase 2 and the auto-recovery flag from Phase 5
  surfaced inline on the relevant assistant turn.

### 6.3 Visual language
- Warmer, more neutral palette (soft off-white or muted warm-gray dark mode,
  one restrained accent) instead of the current dark-indigo dev-tool look.
  Build an actual light mode, not just imply one.
- Fix `--text-3` to at least 4.5:1 contrast against whichever base color you
  land on — check the specific hex pair with a contrast calculator, don't
  eyeball it. **[v2] Confirmed current value is `#6b7280`, not the `#9ca3af`
  a prior changelog claimed — check this pair's actual contrast ratio before
  assuming it already meets AA.**
- Real type scale (5–6 defined steps) instead of ad hoc `11px/11.5px/12px`
  values scattered through the stylesheet.

### 6.4 Accessibility (do this as part of the redesign, not after)
- `aria-label` on every icon-only control.
- `<label>` on every form input.
- `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` + focus trap on any modal/slide-over.
- Check every text/background pairing you introduce against WCAG AA.
- Real responsive breakpoints — the centered-column layout should make this
  much simpler than the old fixed three-pane layout, since side panels
  become overlays instead of permanent flex children.

### 6.5 Robustness
- SSE reconnect-with-backoff: on `es.onerror`, poll a lightweight
  `/api/task/<id>/status` once; if the task is still active server-side,
  reopen the `EventSource` and show "Reconnecting…" instead of declaring the
  generation dead. A generation can run 20–40 minutes — a transient network
  blip should not silently truncate progress visibility. **[v2] Confirmed
  the current `es.onerror` handler just closes the connection and gives up
  (`es.close(); _setGenerating(false); finishProgress();`) — there is no
  reconnect logic today despite a prior claim of exponential backoff.**
- Replace native blocking `confirm()` calls with the redesign's own modal
  component. **[v2] Confirmed 4 native `confirm(...)` calls still exist in
  `web_ui_static/index.html`, and no `showConfirmModal` (or equivalent)
  function exists anywhere in the source yet — this needs to be built, not
  just wired up.**
- Persist sidebar state, active theme, and last-opened panel to
  `localStorage`.

**Verify (this is where the last two rounds failed — check the actual file, not the summary):**
```bash
grep -c "aria-label=" web_ui_static/index.html          # should be roughly one per interactive icon control
grep -n -- "--text-3:" web_ui_static/index.html         # confirm the hex value, then check its contrast ratio yourself
grep -c "@media" web_ui_static/index.html               # should be several, not one
grep -n "onerror" web_ui_static/index.html              # confirm it reopens an EventSource, not just closes+idles
grep -c "confirm(" web_ui_static/index.html             # native confirm() calls should now be zero
grep -n "showConfirmModal" web_ui_static/index.html     # [v2] must exist and be called from the sites where confirm() used to be — confirms the replacement was actually built, not just deleted
```
Load the app at 1280px, 1024px, and 768px and visually confirm the layout
holds. Kill network for ~10 seconds mid-generation and confirm the UI shows
a reconnecting state and resumes, rather than going idle.

## Suggested order and why

1. **Phase 0** first, including the git baseline and the instruction to
   distrust narrative-only documentation — without these, every later
   Verify step is checking against an unreliable starting point.
2. **Phase 1** next — it's the original reported bug, it's small, and it's
   testable in isolation.
3. **Phase 2** next — cheap, and Phase 5's quality depends on having a real
   quality signal to react to. Scope it to the sub-items confirmed still
   missing (see the Phase 2 status note) rather than redoing what's already
   there.
4. **Phase 3** before any retraining — this is the actual root cause of
   generic-looking output; skipping it means Phases 4–5 are polishing a
   corpus that's still fundamentally repetitive.
5. **Phase 4** and **Phase 5** together — both depend on Phase 1's captured
   per-section descriptions and are independent of the UI work.
6. **Phase 6** last, and largest — land 6.1–6.2 (layout/message rendering)
   first since 6.3–6.5 are easiest to verify once the new structure exists.

At the end of each phase, re-run that phase's Verify block yourself before
telling the agent to proceed — that's the only thing that would have caught
the last two rounds of unimplemented changelogs before they shipped.
`````

`````python
"""Fail closed before GPU training unless the native development suite passes."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

from training.preflight import sha256


def require_native_completion(report_path, expected_model_dir=None):
    path = Path(report_path)
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError(f'Native completion gate missing: {path}; run scripts/native_site_gate.py first')
    report = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    if report.get('provenance') != 'live_model_native_development_gate' or report.get('passed') is not True:
        raise ValueError('Native completion gate has not passed live evaluation')
    if report.get('repair_count') != 0 or report.get('fallback_count') != 0:
        raise ValueError('Native gate cannot include repairs or fallbacks')
    from scripts.native_site_gate import ROOT, PIPELINE_SOURCES
    sources = report.get('pipeline_sources', {})
    if set(sources) != set(PIPELINE_SOURCES) or any(sha256(ROOT / name) != value for name, value in sources.items()):
        raise ValueError('Native gate missing current generation pipeline fingerprints; rerun it')
    cases = report.get('cases', [])
    if len(cases) != 3 or {c.get('domain') for c in cases} != {'portfolio', 'store', 'unfamiliar'}:
        raise ValueError('Native gate requires portfolio, store, and unfamiliar-topic sites')
    model = Path(report['model'])
    if expected_model_dir is not None and model.resolve() != Path(expected_model_dir).resolve():
        raise ValueError('Native gate was run on a different model than the training initialization')
    if report.get('adapter_sha256') and sha256(model / 'adapter_model.safetensors') != report['adapter_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Native gate adapter fingerprint mismatch')
    identity = report.get('model_files', {})
    if not identity or not any(name.endswith('.safetensors') for name in identity):
        raise ValueError('Native model identity missing')
    for name, fingerprint in identity.items():
        if Path(name).name != name or not (model / name).is_file() or sha256(model / name) != fingerprint:
            raise ValueError('Native model fingerprint mismatch')
    for case in cases:
        if case.get('passed') is not True or case.get('errors'):
            raise ValueError('Native case failed')
        if case.get('stop_reason') != 'tool_complete':
            raise ValueError('Native output was not complete')
        if not all(case.get('compilation', {}).get(name, {}).get('passed') is True for name in ('typescript', 'build')):
            raise ValueError('Native compilation evidence missing')
        browser = case.get('browser', [])
        if len(browser) != 3 or {v.get('viewport') for v in browser} != {'desktop', 'mobile', 'reduced_motion'} or not all(v.get('passed') is True for v in browser):
            raise ValueError('Native browser evidence missing or failed')
        folder = path.parent / case['domain']
        if not (folder / 'response.txt').is_file() or not all((folder / f'{view}.png').is_file() for view in ('desktop', 'mobile', 'reduced_motion')):
            raise ValueError('Native artifacts missing')
        artifacts = case.get('artifacts', {})
        required = {'response.txt', 'src/components/Main.tsx', 'src/components/Main.css', 'desktop.png', 'mobile.png', 'reduced_motion.png'}
        if not required.issubset(artifacts):
            raise ValueError('Native artifact fingerprints missing')
        for relative, fingerprint in artifacts.items():
            artifact = (folder / relative).resolve()
            if folder.resolve() not in artifact.parents or not artifact.is_file() or sha256(artifact) != fingerprint:
                raise ValueError('Native artifact fingerprint mismatch')
    return {'path': str(path.resolve()), 'sha256': sha256(path), 'adapter_sha256': report['adapter_sha256']}
`````

- **Fence**: 5 backticks
- **Description**: Cryptographic benchmark provenance attestation and non-mock verification.

`````python
"""
training/provenance.py - Cryptographic Benchmark Provenance & Integrity Attestation

Generates and validates provenance records for benchmark reports:
{
  "provenance": "real",
  "model_sha256": "...",
  "adapter_sha256": "...",
  "dataset_sha256": "...",
  "git_commit": "...",
  "hardware": "...",
  "mock": false
}

Enforces:
- Real model execution vs mock harness tagging
- Cryptographic SHA-256 verification of models, adapters, and datasets
- Fail-closed rejection of mock or unverified reports at the promotion gate
"""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import subprocess
import time
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def _compute_file_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    if not path.is_file():
        return "none"
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def _get_git_commit() -> str:
    """Gets the current git commit hash."""
    try:
        res = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
            cwd=str(ROOT),
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=3,
        )
        if res.returncode == 0 and res.stdout.strip():
            return res.stdout.strip()
    except Exception:
        pass

    head_file = ROOT / ".git" / "HEAD"
    if head_file.is_file():
        try:
            content = head_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
            if content.startswith("ref: "):
                ref_path = ROOT / ".git" / content[5:].strip()
                if ref_path.is_file():
                    return ref_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
            return content
        except Exception:
            pass

    return "unknown_commit"


def _get_hardware_description() -> str:
    """Returns local GPU/CPU hardware description."""
    try:
        import torch
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            dev_name = torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)
            props = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0)
            total_gib = round(props.total_memory / (1024**3), 2)
            return f"NVIDIA {dev_name} ({total_gib} GiB VRAM, CUDA {torch.version.cuda})"
    except Exception:
        pass
    
    cpu_arch = platform.processor() or platform.machine()
    return f"CPU: {cpu_arch} ({platform.system()} {platform.release()})"


def generate_provenance_record(
    mock: bool = False,
    model_path: Optional[str] = None,
    adapter_path: Optional[str] = None,
    dataset_path: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Constructs the canonical provenance metadata block required for benchmark reports.
    """
    # 1. Base model SHA256
    model_sha256 = "unknown"
    resolved_model = Path(model_path) if model_path else (ROOT / "base-model")
    if not resolved_model.is_absolute():
        resolved_model = ROOT / resolved_model

    # A PEFT adapter directory identifies the adapter, not the loaded base.
    adapter_config = resolved_model / "adapter_config.json"
    if adapter_config.is_file():
        if adapter_path is None:
            adapter_path = str(resolved_model)
        config = json.loads(adapter_config.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        base_path = config.get("base_model_name_or_path")
        if not base_path:
            raise ValueError("Adapter provenance requires base_model_name_or_path")
        resolved_model = Path(base_path)
        if not resolved_model.is_absolute():
            resolved_model = ROOT / resolved_model

    if resolved_model.is_dir():
        manifest_path = resolved_model / "manifest.json"
        if manifest_path.is_file():
            try:
                m = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                model_sha256 = m.get("immutable_fingerprint_sha256") or m.get("sha256") or "unknown"
            except Exception:
                pass
        if model_sha256 == "unknown":
            cfg_path = resolved_model / "config.json"
            if cfg_path.is_file():
                model_sha256 = _compute_file_sha256(cfg_path)
    elif resolved_model.is_file():
        model_sha256 = _compute_file_sha256(resolved_model)

    # 2. Adapter SHA256
    adapter_sha256 = "none"
    if adapter_path:
        resolved_adapter = Path(adapter_path)
        if not resolved_adapter.is_absolute():
            resolved_adapter = ROOT / resolved_adapter
        if resolved_adapter.is_dir():
            weights = resolved_adapter / "adapter_model.safetensors"
            if weights.is_file():
                adapter_sha256 = _compute_file_sha256(weights)
            else:
                tm = resolved_adapter / "training_manifest.json"
                if tm.is_file():
                    adapter_sha256 = _compute_file_sha256(tm)
        elif resolved_adapter.is_file():
            adapter_sha256 = _compute_file_sha256(resolved_adapter)

    # 3. Dataset SHA256
    dataset_sha256 = "none"
    if dataset_path:
        resolved_data = Path(dataset_path)
        if not resolved_data.is_absolute():
            resolved_data = ROOT / resolved_data
        if resolved_data.is_file():
            dataset_sha256 = _compute_file_sha256(resolved_data)

    return {
        "provenance": "real" if not mock else "synthetic_mock",
        "model_sha256": model_sha256,
        "adapter_sha256": adapter_sha256,
        "dataset_sha256": dataset_sha256,
        "git_commit": _get_git_commit(),
        "hardware": _get_hardware_description(),
        "mock": bool(mock),
    }


def validate_benchmark_provenance(report: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]:
    """
    Validates that a benchmark report contains genuine provenance attestation.
    Returns (is_valid, list_of_errors).
    """
    errors: List[str] = []
    
    prov = report.get("provenance")
    if not prov:
        errors.append("Benchmark report is missing mandatory 'provenance' field.")
    elif prov != "real":
        errors.append(f"Benchmark report provenance is '{prov}' (must be 'real' for promotion).")

    is_mock = report.get("mock", report.get("is_mock", True))
    if is_mock is not False:
        errors.append(f"Benchmark report has mock={is_mock} (must be False for promotion).")

    for key in ["model_sha256", "dataset_sha256", "git_commit", "hardware"]:
        val = report.get(key)
        if not val or val == "unknown":
            errors.append(f"Benchmark report has missing or invalid '{key}'.")
        elif key.endswith("sha256") and not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", str(val)):
            errors.append(f"Benchmark report has invalid SHA-256 '{key}'.")
    adapter_sha = report.get("adapter_sha256")
    if adapter_sha not in (None, "none") and not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", str(adapter_sha)):
        errors.append("Benchmark report has invalid SHA-256 'adapter_sha256'.")

    return (len(errors) == 0, errors)
`````

`````python
"""Admit the separately scored Forma scroll revision as immutable training evidence."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import copy
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from agent.site_prompt import SITE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT
from data_pipeline.reviewed_site_examples import validate_reviewed_site_rows
from evaluation.human_visual_review import RUBRIC_AXES
from scripts.build_diverse_curriculum import envelope
from training.preflight import encode_row, sha256

SOURCE = ROOT / 'data/diverse_reference/source/forma_scroll_v2'
VERIFICATION = ROOT / 'runs/diverse_reference_review/forma_scroll_v2/verification.json'
BANK = ROOT / 'data/reviewed_full_sites/evidence/forma_scroll_v2'
TARGET = ROOT / 'data/reviewed_full_sites/forma_scroll_v2.jsonl'
SECTIONS = ('Hero', 'Collection', 'Contact')
REQUESTS = (
    'Build the Forma navigation and editorial hero with warm stone, clay, a large serif headline '
    '"Less object. More presence.", and dimensional CSS blocks. Link #work and #contact. '
    'The sculpture must shift subtly with scroll, remove listeners on cleanup, and remain static under reduced motion.',
    'Build #work with Quiet Column, The Space Between, and Low Horizon sculptural CSS illustrations. '
    'All, Objects, and Studies filters must change visible items with aria-pressed and focus styling. '
    'Stagger the cards into view on scroll; make them immediately visible under reduced motion and clean up the observer.',
    'Build #contact as an honest fictional studio footer. Include a back-to-top link to #intro; do not fabricate contact details.',
)


def immutable_copy(source: Path, destination: Path) -> None:
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if destination.exists():
        if sha256(destination) != sha256(source):
            raise ValueError(f'Immutable reviewed evidence differs: {destination}')
        return
    shutil.copy2(source, destination)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--human-scores', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    with args.human_scores.open(encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as handle:
        scores = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
    if len(scores) != 1 or scores[0].get('site_id') != 'forma_scroll_v2':
        raise ValueError('Score file must contain exactly the Forma scroll v2 review')
    score = scores[0]
    if score.get('approved', '').strip().lower() != 'yes' or not score.get('reviewer_id', '').strip():
        raise ValueError('Explicit approval and reviewer ID are required')
    values = {axis: float(score[axis]) for axis in RUBRIC_AXES}
    if any(value < 3 or value > 5 for value in values.values()) or sum(values.values()) / len(values) < 4:
        raise ValueError('Every rubric score must be at least 3 and mean at least 4')
    verification = json.loads(VERIFICATION.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    if verification.get('passed') is not True or any(not item['passed'] for item in verification['interactions']):
        raise ValueError('Revision browser validation is incomplete')
    for filename, digest in verification['source_files'].items():
        if sha256(SOURCE / filename) != digest:
            raise ValueError(f'Source changed since browser validation: {filename}')

    immutable_copy(args.human_scores, BANK / 'human_scores.csv')
    immutable_copy(VERIFICATION, BANK / 'verification.json')
    for filename in verification['source_files']:
        immutable_copy(SOURCE / filename, BANK / 'source' / filename)
    evidence = {}
    for mode, capture in verification['browser_evidence']['captures'].items():
        archived = {key: value for key, value in capture.items() if key not in ('screenshot', 'scroll_video')}
        for kind in ('screenshot', 'scroll_video'):
            original = Path(capture[kind])
            destination = BANK / 'captures' / original.name
            immutable_copy(original, destination)
            archived[kind] = str(destination)
            archived[kind + '_sha256'] = sha256(destination)
        evidence[mode] = archived

    review = {'reviewer_id': score['reviewer_id'].strip(), 'rubric_scores': values,
              'notes': score.get('notes', ''), 'review_type': 'human_visual',
              'review_form_sha256': sha256(BANK / 'human_scores.csv'),
              'review_form': str(BANK / 'human_scores.csv')}
    meta = {'family_id': 'original_diverse_forma', 'domain': 'portfolio',
            'source': str((BANK / 'source').relative_to(ROOT)),
            'license': 'MIT (repository LICENSE)',
            'source_files': verification['source_files'],
            'validation': {'typecheck': True, 'build': True, 'runtime': True, 'interaction': True},
            'browser_evidence': evidence,
            'provenance': {'author': 'Codex', 'origin': 'authored Forma revision; not a native model result',
                           'supersedes': 'diverse_forma_hero and diverse_forma_collection only for this site version'},
            'visual_review': review, 'admission_status': 'reviewed'}

    from tokenizers import Tokenizer
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    encoder = Tokenizer.from_file(str(ROOT / 'base-model/tokenizer.json'))
    native = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(ROOT / 'base-model', local_files_only=True)
    history = [{'role': 'system', 'content': SITE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT}]
    rows = []
    for section, request in zip(SECTIONS, REQUESTS):
        tsx = (BANK / 'source' / f'{section}.tsx').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        css = (BANK / 'source' / f'{section}.css').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        user = ('Build the complete Forma object-design portfolio, one section at a time in the order '
                'Hero, Collection, Contact. The host supplies border-box sizing, body margin 0, Arial, '
                'and reduced-motion-aware anchor scrolling. ' + request + ' Write only '
                f'src/components/{section}.tsx and {section}.css with a paired CSS import and named plus default export.')
        history.extend(({'role': 'user', 'content': user},
                        {'role': 'assistant', 'content': envelope(section, tsx, css)}))
        row = {**copy.deepcopy(meta), 'task_id': f'diverse_forma_scroll_v2_{section.lower()}',
               'category': 'full_site', 'messages': copy.deepcopy(history)}
        row['native_encoded_tokens'] = len(encode_row(row, encoder, 8192, chat_tokenizer=native)['input_ids'])
        rows.append(row)

    section = 'Collection'
    tsx = (BANK / 'source' / 'Collection.tsx').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    css = (BANK / 'source' / 'Collection.css').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    good, bad = 'setFilter(item)', 'setFiltre(item)'
    if good not in tsx:
        raise ValueError('Repair injection target is missing')
    broken = tsx.replace(good, bad, 1)
    probe = BANK / 'repair_probe'
    probe.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (probe / f'{section}.tsx').write_text(broken, encoding='utf-8')
    (probe / f'{section}.css').write_text(css, encoding='utf-8')
    (probe / 'globals.d.ts').write_text("declare module '*.css';", encoding='utf-8')
    command = ['node', str(ROOT / 'node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc'), '--noEmit', '--jsx', 'react-jsx',
               '--module', 'ESNext', '--moduleResolution', 'bundler', '--target', 'ES2020',
               '--lib', 'ES2020,DOM', '--skipLibCheck', '--allowSyntheticDefaultImports',
               str(probe / f'{section}.tsx'), str(probe / 'globals.d.ts')]
    failed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    if failed.returncode == 0:
        raise ValueError('Injected repair fault unexpectedly typechecks')
    diagnostic = (failed.stdout + failed.stderr).replace(str(probe), 'src/components').replace(str(ROOT), '[workspace]')
    (probe / 'diagnostic.txt').write_text(diagnostic, encoding='utf-8')
    (probe / 'before.tsx.txt').write_text(broken, encoding='utf-8')
    (probe / f'{section}.tsx').write_text(tsx, encoding='utf-8')
    fixed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    if fixed.returncode:
        raise ValueError('Correct repair does not typecheck')
    repair = {**copy.deepcopy(meta), 'task_id': 'diverse_forma_scroll_v2_repair',
              'category': 'repair',
              'repair_diagnostics': {'origin': 'authored fault injection; actual compiler output',
                                     'before': broken, 'compiler': diagnostic, 'after_typecheck': True},
              'messages': [{'role': 'system', 'content': SITE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
                           {'role': 'user', 'content': 'Repair this Forma Collection component without changing its appearance or behavior. '
                            'Return the complete corrected TSX and unchanged paired CSS.\nCurrent src/components/Collection.tsx:\n'
                            + broken + '\nCurrent CSS:\n' + css + '\nObserved compiler diagnostic:\n' + diagnostic},
                           {'role': 'assistant', 'content': envelope(section, tsx, css)}]}
    repair['native_encoded_tokens'] = len(encode_row(repair, encoder, 8192, chat_tokenizer=native)['input_ids'])
    rows.append(repair)
    errors = validate_reviewed_site_rows(rows, [])
    if errors:
        raise ValueError('\n'.join(errors))
    rendered = ''.join(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n' for row in rows)
    TARGET.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if TARGET.exists() and TARGET.read_text(encoding='utf-8') != rendered:
        raise ValueError(f'Immutable reviewed dataset differs: {TARGET}')
    TARGET.write_text(rendered, encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'rows': len(rows), 'mean_score': sum(values.values()) / len(values),
                      'reviewer': review['reviewer_id'], 'max_tokens': max(row['native_encoded_tokens'] for row in rows),
                      'dataset_sha256': sha256(TARGET), 'path': str(TARGET)}, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
`````

`````python
"""Measure website-domain coverage and review provenance before adding training rows."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

DOMAINS = (
    "ecommerce", "portfolio", "editorial", "arts", "civic", "events",
    "education", "hospitality", "healthcare", "dashboard", "saas", "other",
)


def read_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in handle if line.strip()]


def audit(train_path: Path, motion_path: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    rows = read_rows(train_path)
    domain_counts: Counter[str] = Counter()
    family_domains: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
    missing = Counter()
    visual_terms = Counter()
    for row in rows:
        messages = row.get("messages") or []
        user_text = "\n".join(str(m.get("content", "")) for m in messages if m.get("role") == "user")
        match = re.search(r"<business_type>\s*([^<]+)\s*</business_type>", user_text, re.I)
        domain = match.group(1).strip().lower() if match else "untagged"
        domain_counts[domain] += 1
        family = str(row.get("family_id") or row.get("source_task_id") or row.get("task_id") or "unknown")
        family_domains[family].add(domain)
        for field in ("source", "license", "validation", "visual_review"):
            if not row.get(field):
                missing[field] += 1
        for term in ("3d", "webgl", "three.js", "parallax", "scroll reveal", "text reveal"):
            if term in user_text.lower():
                visual_terms[term] += 1
    report = {
        "dataset": str(train_path.resolve()), "rows": len(rows),
        "family_count": len(family_domains), "business_type_counts": dict(sorted(domain_counts.items())),
        "business_type_family_counts": {
            domain: sum(domain in domains for domains in family_domains.values()) for domain in DOMAINS
        },
        "target_family_gaps_at_five": {
            domain: max(0, 5 - sum(domain in domains for domains in family_domains.values())) for domain in DOMAINS
        },
        "motion_and_3d_prompt_counts": dict(visual_terms),
        "missing_explicit_review_metadata": dict(missing),
        "motion_curriculum_rows": len(read_rows(motion_path)) if motion_path and motion_path.is_file() else None,
        "eligible_for_new_reviewed_training": all(missing[field] == 0 for field in ("source", "license", "validation", "visual_review")),
    }
    return report


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--train", type=Path, default=Path("data/quality_v3/train.jsonl"))
    parser.add_argument("--motion", type=Path, default=Path("data/siteagent_motion_sft_v1.jsonl"))
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=Path("runs/p1_training_coverage.json"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = audit(args.train, args.motion)
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
`````

`````python
"""Audit serialized training targets against actual Qwen3 inference prefixes."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--data', default='data/full_site_training/train.jsonl')
    parser.add_argument('--output', default='runs/qwen3_non_thinking_format_audit.json')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    from tokenizers import Tokenizer
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    from agent.agent_protocol import format_chatml
    from training.preflight import read_jsonl, encode_row, sha256
    native = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(ROOT / 'base-model', local_files_only=True)
    encoder = Tokenizer.from_file(str(ROOT / 'base-model/tokenizer.json'))
    rows = read_jsonl(args.data)
    changed, mismatches, encoding_errors = [], [], []
    max_tokens = 0
    for row in rows:
        messages = row['messages']
        old = format_chatml(messages, False, tokenizer=encoder)
        new = format_chatml(messages, False, tokenizer=native)
        prefix = format_chatml(messages[:-1], True, tokenizer=native)
        if old != new:
            changed.append(row.get('task_id'))
        if not new.startswith(prefix):
            mismatches.append(row.get('task_id'))
        try:
            encoded = encode_row(row, encoder, 8192, chat_tokenizer=native)
            max_tokens = max(max_tokens, len(encoded['input_ids']))
        except ValueError as exc:
            encoding_errors.append({'task_id': row.get('task_id'), 'error': str(exc)})
    report = {'dataset': args.data, 'dataset_sha256': sha256(args.data), 'rows': len(rows),
        'legacy_native_different_count': len(changed), 'fixed_prefix_mismatches': mismatches,
        'encoding_errors': encoding_errors, 'max_native_tokens': max_tokens,
        'inference_suffix': prefix[-60:], 'training_target_policy': 'final assistant content and EOS; prompt including empty think prefix masked',
        'passed': not mismatches and not encoding_errors}
    path = Path(args.output)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
`````

`````python
"""Create an A/B capture package and assemble actual reviewer responses.

Inputs are browser captures from scripts/capture_visual_review.py. Review forms
contain no model identity. A private map is kept outside the review package.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import secrets
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from evaluation.human_visual_review import RUBRIC_AXES, validate_human_review

HOLDOUT = ROOT / "data/eval/visual_holdout_v1.jsonl"
CAPTURE_MODES = ("desktop", "mobile", "reduced_motion")


def read_cases() -> list[dict]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in HOLDOUT.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]


def file_sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def source_capture(source_dir: Path) -> dict:
    info = json.loads((source_dir / "evidence.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    captures = info.get("captures") or {}
    for mode in CAPTURE_MODES:
        for artifact in ("screenshot", "scroll_video"):
            if not Path(str((captures.get(mode) or {}).get(artifact, ""))).is_file():
                raise ValueError(f"Missing {mode} {artifact} in {source_dir}")
    return captures


def prepare(source_root: Path, package_root: Path, private_mapping: Path, reviewers: list[str]) -> None:
    if package_root.exists() or private_mapping.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Review package or private mapping already exists; choose a new destination")
    cases = read_cases()
    if len(cases) != 30 or len({case["domain"] for case in cases}) != 12:
        raise ValueError("Visual holdout must contain 30 distinct cases across 12 domains")
    package_root.mkdir(parents=True)
    private_mapping.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    mapping = {"holdout_sha256": file_sha(HOLDOUT), "cases": {}}
    public_rows = []
    for case in cases:
        task = case["task_id"]
        sources = {role: source_capture(source_root / task / role) for role in ("candidate", "baseline")}
        candidate_label = "A" if secrets.randbits(1) == 0 else "B"
        mapping["cases"][task] = {"candidate_label": candidate_label, "domain": case["domain"]}
        for label, role in ((candidate_label, "candidate"), ("B" if candidate_label == "A" else "A", "baseline")):
            dest = package_root / task / label
            dest.mkdir(parents=True)
            for mode in CAPTURE_MODES:
                for artifact in ("screenshot", "scroll_video"):
                    original = Path(sources[role][mode][artifact])
                    shutil.copy2(original, dest / f"{mode}_{artifact}{original.suffix}")
        public_rows.append({"task_id": task, "domain": case["domain"], "prompt": case["prompt"]})
    (package_root / "cases.json").write_text(json.dumps(public_rows, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    private_mapping.write_text(json.dumps(mapping, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    fields = ["task_id", "domain", "pairwise_winner"] + [f"{label}_{axis}" for label in ("A", "B") for axis in RUBRIC_AXES] + ["review_notes"]
    for reviewer in reviewers:
        form = package_root / f"review_form_{reviewer}.csv"
        with form.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fields)
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows({"task_id": row["task_id"], "domain": row["domain"]} for row in public_rows)
    print(json.dumps({"public_package": str(package_root), "private_mapping": str(private_mapping), "sites": len(cases), "reviewers": reviewers}, indent=2))


def assemble(package_root: Path, private_mapping: Path, adapter_sha: str, forms: list[Path], report_path: Path) -> None:
    mapping = json.loads(private_mapping.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    site_reviews = []
    for form in forms:
        reviewer = form.stem.removeprefix("review_form_")
        with form.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
            for row in csv.DictReader(handle):
                task = row["task_id"]
                if task not in mapping["cases"]:
                    raise ValueError(f"Unknown review task {task}")
                scores = {label: {axis: int(row[f"{label}_{axis}"]) for axis in RUBRIC_AXES} for label in ("A", "B")}
                evidence = {}
                for label in ("A", "B"):
                    evidence[label] = {}
                    for mode in CAPTURE_MODES:
                        side = package_root / task / label
                        evidence[label][mode] = {
                            artifact: str(next(side.glob(f"{mode}_{artifact}.*")).resolve())
                            for artifact in ("screenshot", "scroll_video")
                        }
                site_reviews.append({
                    "task_id": task, "domain": mapping["cases"][task]["domain"],
                    "reviewer_id": reviewer, "candidate_label": mapping["cases"][task]["candidate_label"],
                    "pairwise_winner": row["pairwise_winner"], "rubric_scores": scores,
                    "review_notes": row.get("review_notes", ""), "evidence": evidence,
                })
    report = {
        "review_type": "blinded_pairwise_human", "candidate_adapter_sha256": adapter_sha,
        "blinding_manifest_sha256": file_sha(private_mapping), "holdout_sha256": mapping["holdout_sha256"],
        "site_reviews": site_reviews,
    }
    errors = validate_human_review(report, adapter_sha)
    if errors:
        raise ValueError("Review incomplete or failed: " + "; ".join(errors[:12]))
    report_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Validated human review report: {report_path}")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    p = sub.add_parser("prepare")
    p.add_argument("source_root", type=Path)
    p.add_argument("package_root", type=Path)
    p.add_argument("private_mapping", type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--reviewer", action="append", required=True)
    a = sub.add_parser("assemble")
    a.add_argument("package_root", type=Path)
    a.add_argument("private_mapping", type=Path)
    a.add_argument("adapter_sha")
    a.add_argument("report_path", type=Path)
`````

`````python
"""Build observed JSX and stylesheet repair turns from an approved shop reference."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from agent.site_prompt import SITE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT
from agent.style_ingest import check_css_selector_coverage, check_css_syntactic_completeness
from data_pipeline.reviewed_site_examples import validate_reviewed_site_rows
from scripts.build_diverse_curriculum import envelope
from training.preflight import encode_row, sha256

TARGET = ROOT / 'data/reviewed_full_sites/contract_repairs_v1.jsonl'
EVIDENCE = ROOT / 'data/reviewed_full_sites/evidence/contract_repairs_v1/paperkite'


def typecheck(tsx: str, css: str, name: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    path = EVIDENCE / name
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (path / 'Shop.tsx').write_text(tsx, encoding='utf-8')
    (path / 'Shop.css').write_text(css, encoding='utf-8')
    (path / 'globals.d.ts').write_text("declare module '*.css';", encoding='utf-8')
    command = ['node', str(ROOT / 'node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc'), '--noEmit', '--jsx', 'react-jsx',
               '--module', 'ESNext', '--moduleResolution', 'bundler', '--target', 'ES2020',
               '--lib', 'ES2020,DOM', '--skipLibCheck', '--allowSyntheticDefaultImports',
               str(path / 'Shop.tsx'), str(path / 'globals.d.ts')]
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    return result.returncode == 0, (result.stdout + result.stderr).replace(str(path), 'src/components')


def main() -> None:
    if TARGET.exists():
        raise ValueError(f'Immutable reviewed repair dataset already exists: {TARGET}')
    original_rows = [json.loads(line) for line in (ROOT / 'data/reviewed_full_sites/diverse_v1.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
    approved = next(row for row in original_rows if row['task_id'] == 'diverse_paperkite_shop')
    source = ROOT / approved['source']
    tsx = (source / 'Shop.tsx').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    css = (source / 'Shop.css').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    if sha256(source / 'Shop.tsx') != approved['source_files']['Shop.tsx'] or sha256(source / 'Shop.css') != approved['source_files']['Shop.css']:
        raise ValueError('Approved source changed')
    from tokenizers import Tokenizer
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    encoder = Tokenizer.from_file(str(ROOT / 'base-model/tokenizer.json'))
    native = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(ROOT / 'base-model', local_files_only=True)
    meta = {key: copy.deepcopy(approved[key]) for key in ('family_id', 'domain', 'source', 'license',
            'source_files', 'validation', 'browser_evidence', 'visual_review', 'provenance')}
    meta['provenance']['repair_source'] = 'fault injection into the exact human-scored Paperkite source'
    meta['admission_status'] = 'reviewed'
    rows = []

    good_expression = "{count===1?'print':'prints'}"
    bad_expression = "{count===1?'print'?'print':'prints'}"
    if tsx.count(good_expression) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Expected cart expression is missing or ambiguous')
    broken_tsx = tsx.replace(good_expression, bad_expression, 1)
    broken_passes, diagnostic = typecheck(broken_tsx, css, 'jsx_conditional')
    fixed_passes, _ = typecheck(tsx, css, 'jsx_conditional_fixed')
    if broken_passes or not fixed_passes or 'error TS' not in diagnostic:
        raise ValueError('JSX conditional repair lacks an observed compiler failure and clean fix')
    (EVIDENCE / 'jsx_conditional' / 'diagnostic.txt').write_text(diagnostic, encoding='utf-8')
    jsx_row = {**copy.deepcopy(meta), 'task_id': 'reviewed_paperkite_jsx_conditional_repair',
               'category': 'repair',
               'repair_diagnostics': {'origin': 'fault injection; actual TypeScript diagnostic',
                                      'before_tsx': broken_tsx, 'compiler': diagnostic,
                                      'after_typecheck': True},
               'messages': [{'role': 'system', 'content': SITE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
                            {'role': 'user', 'content': 'Fix the invalid nested conditional in the Paperkite shop. '
                             'Keep the visible store and cart behavior unchanged. Return the full Shop.tsx and paired CSS.\n'
                             'Current Shop.tsx:\n' + broken_tsx + '\nCurrent Shop.css:\n' + css +
                             '\nObserved compiler output:\n' + diagnostic},
                            {'role': 'assistant', 'content': envelope('Shop', tsx, css)}]}
    jsx_row['native_encoded_tokens'] = len(encode_row(jsx_row, encoder, 8192, chat_tokenizer=native)['input_ids'])
    rows.append(jsx_row)

    bad_css, count = re.subn(r'\.kite-demo-note\{[^}]*\}', '', css, count=1)
    if count != 1:
        raise ValueError('CSS fault injection target is missing')
    static_tsx = re.sub(r'className=\{`[^`]*`\}', '', tsx)
    broken_coverage, missing = check_css_selector_coverage(static_tsx, bad_css)
    fixed_coverage, _ = check_css_selector_coverage(static_tsx, css)
    syntax_valid, syntax_errors = check_css_syntactic_completeness(bad_css)
    if broken_coverage or 'kite-demo-note' not in missing or not fixed_coverage or not syntax_valid:
        raise ValueError(f'CSS selector repair is not observable: {missing}, {syntax_errors}')
    diagnostic = f'Missing CSS selectors for classes used in Shop.tsx: {missing}'
    css_folder = EVIDENCE / 'missing_css_selector'
    css_folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (css_folder / 'before.css').write_text(bad_css, encoding='utf-8')
    (css_folder / 'diagnostic.txt').write_text(diagnostic, encoding='utf-8')
    css_row = {**copy.deepcopy(meta), 'task_id': 'reviewed_paperkite_css_selector_repair',
               'category': 'repair',
               'repair_diagnostics': {'origin': 'fault injection; actual CSS selector validator diagnostic',
                                      'before_css': bad_css, 'validator': diagnostic,
                                      'after_selector_coverage': True},
               'messages': [{'role': 'system', 'content': SITE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
                            {'role': 'user', 'content': 'Fix the missing paired CSS selector without changing '
                             'the Paperkite shop markup, cart, or styling elsewhere. Return full Shop.tsx and Shop.css.\n'
                             'Current Shop.tsx:\n' + tsx + '\nCurrent Shop.css:\n' + bad_css +
                             '\nObserved validator output:\n' + diagnostic},
                            {'role': 'assistant', 'content': envelope('Shop', tsx, css)}]}
    css_row['native_encoded_tokens'] = len(encode_row(css_row, encoder, 8192, chat_tokenizer=native)['input_ids'])
    rows.append(css_row)
    errors = validate_reviewed_site_rows(rows, [])
    if errors:
        raise ValueError('\n'.join(errors))
    TARGET.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    TARGET.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n' for row in rows), encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'rows': len(rows), 'max_tokens': max(row['native_encoded_tokens'] for row in rows),
                      'dataset_sha256': sha256(TARGET), 'path': str(TARGET)}, indent=2))
`````

`````python
    'paperkite': ('paperkite', ('Hero', 'Shop', 'About'),

    'quiethours': ('quiethours', ('Hero', 'Guide', 'Journal'),

                        'working category filters, scroll-linked parallax and staggered reveals, and a fictional '
                        'contact footer without fabricated details. Support reduced motion and responsive layout.'),
    'paperkite': ('An illustrated demo print shop with original CSS poster artwork, Sunroom $24, Blue Hour $28, '
                  'Soft Landing $24, a working additive bag with visible count and total, and an Empty bag action. '
                  'State that no orders, payments, or shipping are processed. Make navigation and mobile layout work.'),
    'quiethours': ('A calm soundwalk journal with CSS moon and layered hills, scroll parallax and guide reveals, '
                   'a labelled 400-character journal form with nonempty validation, Save and Clear actions, and '
                   'an in-memory-only note disclosure. No tracking or microphone. Support reduced motion and mobile.'),
}
OUTPUT = ROOT / 'runs/flattened_reviewed_sites'
BANK = ROOT / 'data/reviewed_full_sites/evidence/flattened_v1'
TARGET = ROOT / 'data/reviewed_full_sites/flattened_v1.jsonl'


@contextmanager
def serving(directory: Path):
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), partial(SilentHandler, directory=str(directory)))
    thread = Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    try:
        yield f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}'
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
        thread.join(timeout=5)


def flatten(site: str, sections: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[str, str]:
    source = ROOT / 'data/diverse_reference/source' / site
    hooks = {'useState', 'useEffect', 'useRef'}
    used = {hook for section in sections for hook in hooks
            if re.search(r'\b' + hook + r'\b', (source / f'{section}.tsx').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
    react_import = 'import React' + (',{' + ','.join(sorted(used)) + '}' if used else '') + " from 'react';"
    parts = [react_import, "import './Main.css';"]
    for section in sections:
        text = (source / f'{section}.tsx').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        lines = [line for line in text.splitlines()
                 if not line.startswith('import ') and not line.startswith('export default ')]
        parts.append('\n'.join(lines))
    wrapper = ("export function Main(){return <><a className=\"reference-skip\" href=\"#reference-main\">"
               "Skip to content</a><main id=\"reference-main\">"
               + ''.join(f'<{section}/>' for section in sections)
               + '</main></>;}\nexport default Main;')
    parts.append(wrapper)
    original_main_css = (ROOT / 'runs/diverse_reference_review' / site / 'src/components/Main.css').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    css = '\n'.join([original_main_css] + [(source / f'{section}.css').read_text(encoding='utf-8') for section in sections])
    return '\n\n'.join(parts) + '\n', css


def pixel_equivalence(original_url: str, flattened_url: str, folder: Path) -> dict:
    results = {}
    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        try:
            for mode, width in (('desktop', 1280), ('mobile', 390)):
                images = []
                dom = []
                for label, url in (('original', original_url), ('flattened', flattened_url)):
                    page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': width, 'height': 900}, reduced_motion='reduce')
                    page.goto(url, wait_until='networkidle')
                    page.wait_for_timeout(600)
                    dom.append(page.locator('#reference-main').evaluate('(element) => element.outerHTML'))
                    filename = folder / f'{mode}_{label}.png'
                    page.screenshot(path=str(filename), full_page=True)
                    images.append(Image.open(filename).convert('RGBA'))
                    page.close()
                difference = ImageChops.difference(images[0], images[1])
                same_pixels = images[0].size == images[1].size and difference.getbbox() is None
                results[mode] = {'dom_identical': dom[0] == dom[1], 'pixels_identical': same_pixels,
                                 'original_screenshot': str(folder / f'{mode}_original.png'),
                                 'flattened_screenshot': str(folder / f'{mode}_flattened.png')}
        finally:
            browser.close()
    return results


def forma_interactions(url: str) -> list[dict]:
    results = []
    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        try:
            for mode, width, reduced in (('desktop', 1280, False), ('mobile', 390, False),
                                         ('reduced_motion', 390, True)):
                page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': width, 'height': 900},
                                        reduced_motion='reduce' if reduced else 'no-preference')
                errors = []
                page.on('pageerror', lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
                page.goto(url, wait_until='networkidle')
                page.get_by_role('button', name='Studies', exact=True).click()
                one = page.locator('.forma-grid article').count() == 1
                page.get_by_role('button', name='All', exact=True).click()
                all_items = page.locator('.forma-grid article').count() == 3
                no_overflow = not page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth + 2')
                results.append({'mode': mode, 'checks': {'filter_one': one, 'filter_all': all_items,
                                                        'no_overflow': no_overflow, 'no_runtime_errors': not errors},
                                'errors': errors, 'passed': one and all_items and no_overflow and not errors})
                page.close()
        finally:
            browser.close()
    return results


def main() -> None:

        verification = {'site': site, 'source_sha256': {f'Main.{ext}': sha256(source_bank / f'Main.{ext}')

        (output / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(verification, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
        row = {'task_id': f'flattened_{site}_main', 'family_id': approved['family_id'],
               'domain': domain, 'source': str(source_bank.relative_to(ROOT)),

               'source_files': verification['source_sha256'],

               'visual_review': {**approved['visual_review'],

               'admission_status': 'reviewed_visual_equivalent', 'category': 'full_site',
`````

`````python
"""Capture review evidence for one running site without assigning a quality score."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright


def capture(url: str, output_dir: Path) -> dict:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    evidence = {"url": url, "captures": {}}
    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        try:
            for name, width, height, reduced in (
                ("desktop", 1280, 900, False),
                ("mobile", 390, 844, False),
                ("reduced_motion", 390, 844, True),
            ):
                context = browser.new_context(
                    viewport={"width": width, "height": height},
                    reduced_motion="reduce" if reduced else "no-preference",
                    record_video_dir=str(output_dir),
                    record_video_size={"width": width, "height": height},
                )
                page = context.new_page()
                errors = []
                page.on("pageerror", lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
                page.on("console", lambda message: errors.append(message.text) if message.type == "error" else None)
                page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=20000)
                page.wait_for_timeout(500)
                # Trigger below-fold reveal observers before the full-page
                # overview; otherwise valid sections can appear as blank gaps.
                for fraction in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0):
                    page.evaluate("fraction => window.scrollTo(0, (document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight) * fraction)", fraction)
                    page.wait_for_timeout(650)
                page.evaluate("window.scrollTo(0, 0)")
                page.wait_for_timeout(650)
                screenshot = output_dir / f"{name}_screenshot.png"
                page.screenshot(path=str(screenshot), full_page=True)
                for fraction in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0):
                    page.evaluate("fraction => window.scrollTo(0, (document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight) * fraction)", fraction)
                    page.wait_for_timeout(350)
                video = page.video
                page.close()
                context.close()
                video_path = output_dir / f"{name}_scroll_video.webm"
                if video:
                    Path(video.path()).replace(video_path)
                evidence["captures"][name] = {
                    "screenshot": str(screenshot.resolve()),
                    "scroll_video": str(video_path.resolve()),
                    "viewport": {"width": width, "height": height},
                    "reduced_motion": reduced,
                    "browser_errors": errors,
                }
        finally:
            browser.close()
    (output_dir / "evidence.json").write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return evidence


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("url")
    parser.add_argument("output_dir", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(capture(args.url, args.output_dir), indent=2))
`````
