`````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
scripts/generate_architecture_and_source.py - Corruption-Proof Architecture & Source Exporter.

Generates docs/architecture_and_source.md with:
1. Dynamic fence length sizing: max(5, max_backticks + 1) to eliminate fence contamination.
2. Cryptographic SHA-256 checksums embedded next to each file section.
3. Automated round-trip extraction and verification against original file bytes.
4. Fail-closed execution: Exits with code 1 if round-trip reconstruction is not 100% byte-exact.
"""

import hashlib
import os
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DOCS_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "docs"
ARCH_MD = DOCS_DIR / "architecture.md"
SOURCE_MD = DOCS_DIR / "source.md"
OUT_MD = DOCS_DIR / "architecture_and_source.md"

LANG_MAP = {
    ".py": "python",
    ".ts": "tsx",
    ".tsx": "tsx",
    ".js": "javascript",
    ".mjs": "javascript",
    ".cjs": "javascript",
    ".json": "json",
    ".jsonl": "json",
    ".html": "html",
    ".css": "css",
    ".md": "markdown",
    ".sh": "bash",
    ".bat": "bat",
    ".yml": "yaml",
    ".yaml": "yaml",
    ".toml": "toml",
    ".txt": "text",
}


def get_language(filename: str) -> str:
    ext = Path(filename).suffix.lower()
    return LANG_MAP.get(ext, "text")


def compute_fence(text: str) -> Tuple[str, int]:
    """Finds max run of backticks and chooses a strictly longer fence of at least 5 backticks."""
    matches = [len(m.group(0)) for m in re.finditer(r"`+", text)]
    max_bt = max(matches) if matches else 0
    fence_len = max(5, max_bt + 1)
    return "`" * fence_len, fence_len


def parse_source_catalog(source_md_path: Path) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    """Parses module entries from docs/source.md table."""
    pattern = re.compile(
        r"^\|\s*`([^`]+)`\s*\|\s*([^|]+)\|\s*([^|]+)\|\s*([^|]+)\|\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)\s*\|"
    )
    entries = []
    if not source_md_path.exists():
        return entries

    with open(source_md_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            m = pattern.match(line.strip())
            if m:
                entries.append({
                    "name": m.group(1).strip(),
                    "lines": m.group(2).strip(),
                    "size": m.group(3).strip(),
                    "description": m.group(4).strip(),
                    "link": m.group(6).strip(),
                })
    return entries


def extract_sections_from_existing_doc(existing_doc_path: Path) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
    """Extracts existing embedded files from existing architecture_and_source.md as historical fallback."""
    sections = {}
    if not existing_doc_path.exists():
        return sections

    content = existing_doc_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    header_pattern = re.compile(
        r"####\s+`([^`]+)`\r?\n\r?\n"
        r"- \*\*Path\*\*:\s*`([^`]+)`\r?\n"
        r"- \*\*Lines\*\*:\s*([^\r\n]+)\r?\n"
        r"(?:- \*\*Fence\*\*:\s*[^\r\n]+\r?\n)?"
        r"- \*\*Description\*\*:\s*([^\r\n]+)\r?\n\r?\n"
        r"(`{4,})([a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)\r?\n"
        r"(.*?)\r?\n\5(?:\r?\n\r?\n---|\Z)",
        re.DOTALL,
    )

    for m in header_pattern.finditer(content):
        rel_name = m.group(1).strip()
        path_link = m.group(2).strip()
        desc = m.group(4).strip()
        body = m.group(7)
        sections[rel_name] = {
            "path_link": path_link,
            "description": desc,
            "content": body,
        }
    return sections


def generate_architecture_and_source():
    print("[SourceExport] Starting corruption-proof documentation export...")

    if not ARCH_MD.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing {ARCH_MD}")

    arch_text = ARCH_MD.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    # Take architecture content up to directory tree end / separator
    if "## 3. Complete Source Code of Every File" in arch_text:
        arch_section = arch_text.split("## 3. Complete Source Code of Every File")[0].strip()
    elif "> [!NOTE]\n> For the exhaustive verbatim source code" in arch_text:
        arch_section = arch_text.split("> [!NOTE]\n> For the exhaustive verbatim source code")[0].strip()
    else:
        arch_section = arch_text.strip()

    catalog = parse_source_catalog(SOURCE_MD)
    print(f"[SourceExport] Loaded {len(catalog)} catalog entries from {SOURCE_MD.name}")

    historical_sections = extract_sections_from_existing_doc(OUT_MD)
    print(f"[SourceExport] Loaded {len(historical_sections)} fallback sections from existing export")

    embedded_blocks: List[str] = []
    processed_count = 0
    disk_verified_count = 0

    for item in catalog:
        rel_path = item["name"]
        desc = item["description"]
        link = item["link"]

        # Resolve path on disk
        disk_path = ROOT_DIR / rel_path
        if not disk_path.exists():
            # Try path from link: file:///C:/Users/AYUSH/Documents/slm/...
            norm_link = re.sub(r"^file:///[A-Za-z]:/Users/AYUSH/Documents/slm/", "", link, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            if (ROOT_DIR / norm_link).exists():
                disk_path = ROOT_DIR / norm_link

        if disk_path.exists() and disk_path.is_file():
            raw_bytes = disk_path.read_bytes()
            text_content = raw_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            sha256_hex = hashlib.sha256(raw_bytes).hexdigest()
            byte_size = len(raw_bytes)
            line_count = len(text_content.splitlines())
            has_trailing_nl = text_content.endswith("\n")
            is_from_disk = True
            norm_rel_path = disk_path.relative_to(ROOT_DIR).as_posix()
        elif rel_path in historical_sections:
            hist = historical_sections[rel_path]
            text_content = hist["content"]
            raw_bytes = text_content.encode("utf-8")
            sha256_hex = hashlib.sha256(raw_bytes).hexdigest()
            byte_size = len(raw_bytes)
            line_count = len(text_content.splitlines())
            has_trailing_nl = text_content.endswith("\n")
            is_from_disk = False
            norm_rel_path = rel_path
        else:
            print(f"[SourceExport] WARNING: Skipping missing file {rel_path}")
            continue

        lang = get_language(norm_rel_path)
        fence, fence_len = compute_fence(text_content)

        # Ensure newline separation before closing fence
        body_with_nl = text_content if text_content.endswith("\n") else (text_content + "\n")

        block = (
            f"#### `{norm_rel_path}`\n\n"
            f"- **Path**: `file:///C:/Users/AYUSH/Documents/slm/{norm_rel_path}`\n"
            f"- **Lines**: {line_count:,} | **Size**: {byte_size:,} bytes | **SHA-256**: `{sha256_hex}` | **Newline**: `{has_trailing_nl}`\n"
            f"- **Fence**: {fence_len} backticks\n"
            f"- **Description**: {desc}\n\n"
            f"{fence}{lang}\n"
            f"{body_with_nl}"
            f"{fence}\n\n"
            f"---\n"
        )
        embedded_blocks.append(block)
        processed_count += 1
        if is_from_disk:
            disk_verified_count += 1

    print(f"[SourceExport] Assembled {processed_count} files ({disk_verified_count} directly from active disk)")

    # Construct final document
    header_section = (
        arch_section.rstrip()
        + "\n\n---\n\n"
        + "## 3. Complete Source Code of Every File\n\n"
        + "Every line of source code across all project files is provided below verbatim without truncation.\n"
        + "All embedded source blocks are protected with dynamic-length fences exceeding any backtick sequence inside the source.\n"
        + "Each section records an authoritative SHA-256 checksum validated via automated round-trip extraction.\n\n"
        + "---\n\n"
    )

    full_document = header_section + "\n".join(embedded_blocks)

    # ── Strict Round-Trip Validation ──────────────────────────────────────────
    print("[SourceExport] Executing strict round-trip extraction and SHA-256 validation...")
    section_pattern = re.compile(
        r"####\s+`([^`]+)`\n\n"
        r"- \*\*Path\*\*:\s*`file:///C:/Users/AYUSH/Documents/slm/([^`]+)`\n"
        r"- \*\*Lines\*\*:\s*([0-9,]+)\s*\|\s*\*\*Size\*\*:\s*([0-9,]+)\s*bytes\s*\|\s*\*\*SHA-256\*\*:\s*`([0-9a-f]{64})`\s*\|\s*\*\*Newline\*\*:\s*`(True|False)`\n"
        r"- \*\*Fence\*\*:\s*(\d+)\s*backticks\n"
        r"- \*\*Description\*\*:\s*([^\n]+)\n\n"
        r"(`{5,})([a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)\n"
        r"(.*?)\n\9\n\n---",
        re.DOTALL,
    )

    matches = list(section_pattern.finditer(full_document))
    if len(matches) != processed_count:
        print(f"[SourceExport] ERROR: Extraction count mismatch! Expected {processed_count}, extracted {len(matches)}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    for m in matches:
        file_name = m.group(1)
        rel_disk_path = m.group(2)
        expected_size = int(m.group(4).replace(",", ""))
        expected_sha = m.group(5)
        has_nl = m.group(6) == "True"
        fence_len = int(m.group(7))
        description = m.group(8)
        extracted_fence = m.group(9)
        lang = m.group(10)
        body = m.group(11)

        if len(extracted_fence) != fence_len:
            print(f"[SourceExport] ERROR: Fence length mismatch for {file_name}: expected {fence_len}, got {len(extracted_fence)}", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)

        # Reconstruct exact source text
        reconstructed_text = (body + "\n") if has_nl else body
        reconstructed_bytes = reconstructed_text.encode("utf-8")
        computed_sha = hashlib.sha256(reconstructed_bytes).hexdigest()

        if computed_sha != expected_sha:
            print(f"[SourceExport] ERROR: SHA-256 mismatch for {file_name}!", file=sys.stderr)
            print(f"  Expected: {expected_sha}", file=sys.stderr)
            print(f"  Computed: {computed_sha}", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)

        if len(reconstructed_bytes) != expected_size:
            print(f"[SourceExport] ERROR: Byte size mismatch for {file_name} (expected {expected_size}, got {len(reconstructed_bytes)})", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)

        # If file exists on disk, assert 100% byte equality with file on disk
        target_file = ROOT_DIR / rel_disk_path
        if target_file.exists() and target_file.is_file():
            actual_disk_bytes = target_file.read_bytes()
            if reconstructed_bytes != actual_disk_bytes:
                print(f"[SourceExport] ERROR: Reconstructed bytes differ from disk for {rel_disk_path}!", file=sys.stderr)
                sys.exit(1)

    print(f"[SourceExport] [OK] 100% of {len(matches)} files passed round-trip reconstruction and SHA-256 verification!")

    # Verify server/app.py specifically
    app_matches = [m for m in matches if "server/app.py" in m.group(2) or m.group(1) == "server/app.py" or m.group(1) == "app.py"]
    if not app_matches:
        print("[SourceExport] ERROR: server/app.py section was not found in export!", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    app_disk_bytes = (ROOT_DIR / "server" / "app.py").read_bytes()
    app_extracted = (app_matches[0].group(11) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    if app_extracted != app_disk_bytes:
        print("[SourceExport] ERROR: server/app.py extracted bytes do not match server/app.py on disk!", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f"[SourceExport] [OK] server/app.py verified uncontaminated and byte-exact ({len(app_disk_bytes):,} bytes)")

    # Atomic write to disk preserving exact raw newlines
    tmp_out = OUT_MD.with_suffix(".tmp")
    with open(tmp_out, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        f.write(full_document)

    if OUT_MD.exists():
        OUT_MD.unlink()
    tmp_out.rename(OUT_MD)

    total_lines = len(full_document.splitlines())
    total_bytes = len(full_document.encode("utf-8"))
    print(f"[SourceExport] Successfully generated {OUT_MD.name} ({total_lines:,} lines, {total_bytes:,} bytes)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    generate_architecture_and_source()
`````

`````python
def assemble(path, files):
    for name, source in files.items():
        target = path / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(source, encoding='utf-8')
    (path / 'package.json').write_text('{"type":"module"}', encoding='utf-8')

    (path / 'src/main.tsx').write_text("import React from 'react';import{createRoot}from'react-dom/client';import Main from './components/Main';createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<Main/>);", encoding='utf-8')
    (path / 'src/globals.d.ts').write_text("declare module '*.css';", encoding='utf-8')
    (path / 'vite.config.mjs').write_text("import{defineConfig}from'vite';import react from'@vitejs/plugin-react';export default defineConfig({plugins:[react()]});", encoding='utf-8')
    commands = {
        'typescript': ['node', str(ROOT / 'node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc'), '--noEmit', '--jsx', 'react-jsx', '--module', 'ESNext', '--moduleResolution', 'bundler', '--target', 'ES2020', '--lib', 'ES2020,DOM', '--skipLibCheck', '--allowSyntheticDefaultImports', 'src/main.tsx', 'src/globals.d.ts'],
        'build': ['node', str(ROOT / 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build'],
    }
    results = {}
    for name, command in commands.items():
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=path, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
        results[name] = {'passed': result.returncode == 0, 'output': result.stdout + result.stderr}
    return results


def verify_interactions(page, domain):
    """Test requested state, not merely any text change after one click."""
    if domain == 'store':
        def count():
            text = page.locator('#cart').inner_text() if page.locator('#cart').count() else ''
            patterns = (r'cart(?:\s+item)?(?:\s+count)?\s*[:(]?\s*(\d+)',
                        r'items?(?:\s+count)?\s*[:(]?\s*(\d+)', r'(\d+)\s+items?\b')
            match = next((match for pattern in patterns if (match := re.search(pattern,text,re.I))),None)
            return int(match.group(1)) if match else None
        buttons = page.get_by_role('button',name=re.compile(r'add\b.*\bto cart',re.I))
        counts = [count()]
        if buttons.count() != 2 or counts[0] != 0:
            return {'passed':False,'counts':counts,'reason':'Two add controls and visible initial cart count 0 required'}
        for index in (0,1,0):
            buttons.nth(index).click();page.wait_for_timeout(50);counts.append(count())
        return {'passed':counts==[0,1,2,3],'counts':counts}
    if domain == 'unfamiliar':
        boxes = page.get_by_role('checkbox',name='Record the habitat',exact=True)
        if boxes.count()!=1:
            return {'passed':False,'reason':'One checkbox with exact requested accessible name required'}
        states=[boxes.first.is_checked()]
        boxes.first.click();states.append(boxes.first.is_checked())
        boxes.first.click();states.append(boxes.first.is_checked())
        return {'passed':states[0]!=states[1] and states[0]==states[2],'states':states}
    return {'passed':True,'status':'not_requested'}

    from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

        'store': ('Threadleaf', 'Notebook', '$12', 'Pencil', '$3', 'Demo only'),

    url = f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}'
    results = []

                    page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': width, 'height': 900}, reduced_motion='reduce' if reduced else 'no-preference')
                    errors = []

                    navigation = all(page.locator(f'nav a[href="#{section}"]').count() >= 1 for section in ids)

                    overflow = page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth + 2')

                                    'interaction_evidence':behavior,
                                    'navigation_passed': navigation, 'content_passed': content,
                                    'horizontal_overflow': overflow, 'interaction_passed': interaction,
                                    'browser_errors': errors,
                                    'passed': visible and navigation and content and not overflow and interaction and not errors})
                    page.close()
            finally:
                browser.close()
    finally:
        process.terminate()

    return results

    parser.add_argument('--seconds', type=float, default=240)

    args = parser.parse_args()

    from training.preflight import sha256

    identity_files = sorted(model_dir.glob('*.safetensors')) + [model_dir / 'tokenizer_config.json']
    identity_files += [p for p in (model_dir / 'config.json', model_dir / 'adapter_config.json') if p.exists()]
    adapter_file = model_dir / 'adapter_model.safetensors'
    report = {'provenance': 'live_model_native_development_gate', 'model': str(model_dir),
        'adapter_sha256': sha256(adapter_file) if adapter_file.exists() else None,
        'model_files': {p.name: sha256(p) for p in identity_files},
        'pipeline_sources': pipeline_sources, 'seed': 42,
        'repair_count': 0, 'fallback_count': 0, 'cases': [], 'passed': False}
    for index, (domain, title, brief, ids) in enumerate(CASES):
        if args.domain and domain != args.domain:
            continue
        torch.manual_seed(42 + index)
        path = output / domain
        path.mkdir()
        runner.generation_log_dir = path / 'turns'
        prompt = (f'Build a small complete single-page website: {brief} '
            f'Use one self-contained component Main in src/components/Main.tsx plus Main.css. '
            f'Include exactly three visible sections with ids {", ".join(ids)} and a navigation link to each. '
            'Export named and default Main. Use ONLY scoped plain CSS: define every class you use. '
            'No fonts, images, external URLs, SVG, libraries, or Tailwind. Keep content short and accurate. '
            'Responsive layout, readable dark text on light backgrounds, focus indicators. '
            'Keep all source under 1500 tokens total. Close both files and the tool call.\n'
            + section_output_contract('Main'))
        response = runner.generate_turn(index, [{'role': 'system', 'content': SITE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT}, {'role': 'user', 'content': prompt}], 'Main', max_new_tokens=args.tokens, max_time_seconds=args.seconds, temperature=.25)
        (path / 'response.txt').write_text(response, encoding='utf-8')
        action = parse_agent_output(response).action
        pairs = getattr(action, 'files', [])
        files = dict(pairs)
        expected = {'src/components/Main.tsx', 'src/components/Main.css'}
        errors = site_envelope_errors(response)
        if set(files) != expected or len(pairs) != 2:
            errors.append('Expected exactly Main.tsx and Main.css')
        tsx, css = files.get('src/components/Main.tsx', ''), files.get('src/components/Main.css', '')
        if not tsx.strip() or not css.strip():
            errors.append('Empty source or CSS')
        if not re.search(r'''import\s*["']\./Main\.css["']''', tsx):
            errors.append('Paired CSS is not imported by Main.tsx')
        coverage, missing = check_css_selector_coverage(tsx, css)
        if not coverage:
            errors.append(f'Missing CSS: {missing}')
        syntax, css_errors = check_css_syntactic_completeness(css)
        errors.extend(css_errors)
        item = {'domain': domain, 'title': title, 'errors': errors, 'stop_reason': runner.last_generation_diagnostics['stop_reason'], 'generated_tokens': runner.last_generation_tokens, 'passed': False}
        if set(files) == expected:
            try:
                item['compilation'] = assemble(path, files)
                if item['compilation']['build']['passed']:
                    item['browser'] = browser_check(path, domain, ids)
                item['passed'] = not errors and all(c['passed'] for c in item['compilation'].values()) and bool(item.get('browser')) and all(c['passed'] for c in item['browser'])
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')
        report['cases'].append(item)
        item['artifacts'] = {file.relative_to(path).as_posix(): sha256(file)
            for file in path.rglob('*') if file.is_file() and (file.suffix in ('.png', '.tsx', '.css') or file.name == 'response.txt')}
        report['passed'] = len(report['cases']) == len(CASES) and all(c['passed'] for c in report['cases'])
        (output / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
        print(json.dumps(item), flush=True)
    return 0 if report['passed'] else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
`````

`````python
"""Correct the full-site request text while preserving pixel-verified source and review."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from data_pipeline.reviewed_site_examples import validate_reviewed_site_rows
from scripts.build_flattened_reviewed_sites import BRIEFS
from training.preflight import encode_row, sha256

SOURCE = ROOT / 'data/reviewed_full_sites/flattened_v1.jsonl'
TARGET = ROOT / 'data/reviewed_full_sites/flattened_v2.jsonl'
SOURCE_SHA256 = '43e558204644b8457d3fd416c8dbffdf1bbd375f0a2393278407417a07f6d0e2'


def main() -> None:
    if sha256(SOURCE) != SOURCE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Source dataset changed; review the correction before applying it')
    if TARGET.exists():
        raise ValueError(f'Corrected dataset already exists: {TARGET}')
    from tokenizers import Tokenizer
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    encoder = Tokenizer.from_file(str(ROOT / 'base-model/tokenizer.json'))
    native = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(ROOT / 'base-model', local_files_only=True)
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in SOURCE.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
    for row in rows:
        site = row['task_id'].removeprefix('flattened_').removesuffix('_main')
        if site not in BRIEFS:
            raise ValueError(f'Unexpected source task {row["task_id"]}')
        report = json.loads(Path(row['provenance']['pixel_equivalence_report']).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if not report['passed'] or not all(mode['dom_identical'] and mode['pixels_identical']
                                           for mode in report['pixel_equivalence'].values()):
            raise ValueError(f'Pixel equivalence is not established for {site}')
        row['messages'][1]['content'] = (
            f'Build the complete {site.replace("_", " ")} website as one self-contained React Main component '
            'and paired Main.css. Include all sections, navigation, visual composition, and working interactions. '
            'Return exactly src/components/Main.tsx and Main.css with named and default Main exports. '
            + BRIEFS[site])
        row['provenance']['prompt_revision'] = 'v2: removed conflicting section-only instruction; source and rendering unchanged'
        row['native_encoded_tokens'] = len(encode_row(row, encoder, 8192, chat_tokenizer=native)['input_ids'])
    errors = validate_reviewed_site_rows(rows, [])
    if errors:
        raise ValueError('\n'.join(errors))
    TARGET.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n' for row in rows), encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'rows': len(rows), 'max_tokens': max(row['native_encoded_tokens'] for row in rows),
                      'dataset_sha256': sha256(TARGET), 'path': str(TARGET)}, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
`````

`````python
"""Create an auditable SFT input from the admitted quality and motion pools.

This does not assign human-review metadata to historical rows. Reviewed full-site
examples are admitted separately after their real browser and reviewer evidence exists.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SOURCES = (
    ROOT / "data/quality_v3/train.jsonl",
    ROOT / "data/siteagent_motion_sft_v1.jsonl",
)
VALIDATION = ROOT / "data/quality_candidate/validation.jsonl"
OUTPUT = ROOT / "data/full_site_training/train.jsonl"
MANIFEST = ROOT / "data/full_site_training/manifest.json"


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def read_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]


def main() -> None:
    rows: list[dict] = []
    source_summary = []
    families: set[str] = set()
    task_ids: set[str] = set()
    for source in SOURCES:
        source_rows = read_jsonl(source)
        for row in source_rows:
            family = str(row.get("family_id") or "")
            task = str(row.get("task_id") or "")
            if not family or not task or not row.get("messages"):
                raise ValueError(f"Missing family, task, or messages in {source}")
            if task in task_ids:
                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate task_id: {task}")
            task_ids.add(task)
            families.add(family)
            rows.append(row)
        source_summary.append({"path": str(source.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": sha256(source), "rows": len(source_rows)})
    heldout = read_jsonl(VALIDATION)
    heldout_families = {str(row.get("family_id")) for row in heldout}
    if families & heldout_families:
        raise ValueError(f"Train/validation family overlap: {sorted(families & heldout_families)[:5]}")
    OUTPUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OUTPUT.write_text("".join(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n" for row in rows), encoding="utf-8")
    manifest = {
        "status": "unreviewed_candidate_training_input",
        "output": str(OUTPUT.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "sha256": sha256(OUTPUT),
        "rows": len(rows),
        "families": len(families),
        "validation_path": str(VALIDATION.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "validation_sha256": sha256(VALIDATION),
        "validation_rows": len(heldout),
        "family_overlap": 0,
        "sources": source_summary,
        "human_visual_review": "not performed",
    }
    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
`````

`````python
def normalize(row):
 from agent.agent_protocol import AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT
 from agent.site_prompt import SITE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT
 result=copy.deepcopy(row)
 site=any('write_site' in m['content'] for m in row['messages'] if m['role']=='assistant')
 system=SITE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT if site else AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT
 previous=result['messages'][0]['content'] if result['messages'][0]['role']=='system' else ''
 if result['messages'][0]['role']=='system':result['messages'][0]['content']=system
 else:result['messages'].insert(0,{'role':'system','content':system})
 result['prompt_alignment']={'protocol':'site' if site else 'component','previous_system_sha256':hashlib.sha256(previous.encode()).hexdigest(),'current_system_sha256':hashlib.sha256(system.encode()).hexdigest()}
 return result


def site_contract_errors(row):
 """Conservatively exclude historical targets that contradict the new contract."""
 from agent.agent_protocol import parse_agent_output
 from agent.style_ingest import check_css_selector_coverage
 errors=[]
 for message in row['messages']:
  if message['role']!='assistant':continue
  files=dict(getattr(parse_agent_output(message['content']).action,'files',[]))
  for path,source in files.items():
   if not path.endswith('.tsx'):continue
   css_path=Path(path).with_suffix('.css').as_posix()
   css=files.get(css_path,'')
   if not css.strip():errors.append(f'{path}: missing paired stylesheet')
   if not re.search(r'''import\s*["']\./'''+re.escape(Path(css_path).name)+r'''["']''',source):
    errors.append(f'{path}: missing paired CSS import')
   # Dynamic class fragments need runtime evidence; don't mistake the static
   # prefix of foo-${value} for a literal class named foo-.
   static_source=re.sub(r'\S*\$\{[^}]*\}\S*', '', source)
   valid,missing=check_css_selector_coverage(static_source,css,allow_tailwind=True)
   if not valid:errors.append(f'{path}: stylesheet contract gaps: {missing}')
 return errors


def main():
 parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
 parser.add_argument('--draft',action='store_true',help='Prepare historical rows only for CPU preflight; not ready for training')

 parser.add_argument('--reviewed',type=Path,action='append',help='Reviewed JSONL; repeat to combine independently scored evidence sets')
 args=parser.parse_args()
 from tokenizers import Tokenizer

 original=ROOT/'data/full_site_training/train.jsonl';validation=ROOT/'data/quality_candidate/validation.jsonl'
 exclusions=[]
 def accepted(path,split):
  kept=[]
  for row in read_jsonl(path):

   else:kept.append(normalize(row))

 rows=accepted(original,'train');heldout=accepted(validation,'validation')
 sources={str(original.relative_to(ROOT)):sha256(original)}
 if not args.draft:

  reviewed=[row for path in reviewed_paths for row in read_jsonl(path)]
`````

`````python
"""Index original full-site references for human review without assigning scores."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
CAPTURES = ROOT / "runs/reviewed_source_candidates"
SITES = {
    "margin": ("editorial_workspace", "editorial", "Original fictional writing workspace"),
    "fieldwork": ("analytics_platform", "dashboard", "Original fictional analytics platform"),
    "parallax": ("dimensional_consultancy", "agency", "Original fictional design consultancy"),
}


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def main() -> None:
    typecheck = subprocess.run(
        ["node", str(ROOT / "node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc"), "--noEmit", "--jsx", "react-jsx", "--moduleResolution", "bundler",
         "--module", "esnext", "--target", "es2020", "--lib", "DOM,ES2020",
         "--allowSyntheticDefaultImports", "--skipLibCheck",
         *[str(ROOT / "examples/reference-curriculum" / name / "main.tsx") for name in SITES]],
        cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    if typecheck.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError("Reference sites failed TypeScript: " + typecheck.stdout + typecheck.stderr)
    from data_pipeline.build_reference_curriculum import source_hash
    queue = []
    for name, (family, domain, description) in SITES.items():
        source = ROOT / "data/premium_reference/source" / name
        preview = ROOT / "examples/reference-curriculum" / name
        evidence_file = CAPTURES / name / "evidence.json"
        verification_file = ROOT / "data/premium_reference/verification" / f"{name}.json"
        evidence = json.loads(evidence_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        verification = json.loads(verification_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if not verification.get("passed"):
            raise ValueError(f"Prior interaction verification failed for {name}")
        if verification.get("source_sha256") != source_hash(name):
            raise ValueError(f"Interaction verification is stale for {name}")
        if any(capture.get("browser_errors") for capture in evidence["captures"].values()):
            raise ValueError(f"Browser capture has errors for {name}")
        if not (CAPTURES / name / "dist/index.html").is_file():
            raise ValueError(f"Production build is missing for {name}")
        queue.append({
            "site_id": name, "family_id": f"reference_{family}", "domain": domain,
            "description": description, "source": str(source.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "source_files": {p.relative_to(source).as_posix(): sha256(p) for p in source.rglob("*") if p.is_file()},
            "license": "MIT (repository LICENSE)",
            "preview": str(preview.relative_to(ROOT)),
            "validation": {
                "typecheck": True, "production_build": True, "browser_console_errors": 0,
                "interaction_verification": str(verification_file.relative_to(ROOT)),
                "interaction_verification_date": verification.get("checked_on"),
            },
            "browser_evidence": evidence["captures"],
            "human_visual_review": None,
            "admission_status": "awaiting_independent_human_review",
        })
    output = CAPTURES / "queue.json"
    output.write_text(json.dumps(queue, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"review_queue": str(output), "sites": len(queue), "admitted_training_sites": 0}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
`````

`````python
import argparse
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--model', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--tokens', type=int, default=1200)
    parser.add_argument('--seconds', type=float, default=180)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    from agent.agent import AgentModelRunner, SITE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, parse_agent_output
    from training.preflight import sha256
    runner = AgentModelRunner(args.model, max_seq_length=8192)
    output = Path(args.output)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    runner.generation_log_dir = output / 'turns'
    prompt = ('Build only Hero for a ceramic artist portfolio named Claylight. '
        'Use a warm ivory background and terracotta type, a heading Claylight, '
        'one sentence about handmade vessels, and a View work anchor to #work. '
        'Return exactly src/components/Hero.tsx and src/components/Hero.css in one '
        'write_site call. Import ./Hero.css. Export named Hero and default Hero. '
        'Use compact, complete plain CSS; no images or libraries. Keep this simple section under 600 tokens.')
    history = [{'role': 'system', 'content': SITE_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
               {'role': 'user', 'content': prompt}]
    response = runner.generate_turn(0, history, 'Hero', max_new_tokens=args.tokens,
        max_time_seconds=args.seconds, temperature=.25)
    turn = parse_agent_output(response)
    files = getattr(turn.action, 'files', [])
    paths = [p for p, _ in files]
    report = dict(runner.last_generation_diagnostics)
    weights = Path(args.model) / 'adapter_model.safetensors'
    report.update(adapter_sha256=sha256(weights) if weights.is_file() else None,
        parsed_action=type(turn.action).__name__, paths=paths,
        envelope_complete='</tool_call>' in response,
        css_missing='src/components/Hero.css' not in paths,
        css_import_missing=not re.search(r'''import\s*["']\./Hero\.css["']''', dict(files).get('src/components/Hero.tsx', '')),
        section_mismatch=bool(paths) and any(Path(p).stem != 'Hero' for p in paths),
        native_pair_complete=set(paths) == {'src/components/Hero.tsx', 'src/components/Hero.css'}
            and '</tool_call>' in response)
    (output / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    (output / 'response.txt').write_text(response, encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k not in ('prompt', 'raw_output')}, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
`````

`````python
"""Record an early-stopped live site probe without inventing a completed benchmark."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--site", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--adapter", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--task-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    screenshot = args.site / "screenshot.webp"
    adapter_file = args.adapter / "adapter_model.safetensors"
    if not screenshot.is_file() or not adapter_file.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError("The rendered screenshot and adapter are required")
    components = list((args.site / "src/components").glob("*.tsx"))
    fallbacks = [str(path.relative_to(args.site)) for path in components if 'data-fallback="true"' in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")]
    if not fallbacks:
        raise ValueError("No fallback sections found; this early-failure summary does not apply")
    report = {
        "report_type": "live_probe_early_failure",
        "completed_benchmark": False,
        "task_id": args.task_id,
        "recorded_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "adapter_sha256": sha256(adapter_file),
        "site_dir": str(args.site.resolve()),
        "fallback_sections": fallbacks,
        "screenshot": str(screenshot.resolve()),
        "screenshot_sha256": sha256(screenshot),
        "native_gate": "failed",
        "reason": "Generated site includes fallback sections with unavailable content; the browser screenshot shows unusable output.",
        "outcome_scorecards": {
            "model_native": {"status": "evaluated_partial", "passed": False, "fallback_section_count": len(fallbacks)},
            "deterministic_repair": {"status": "not_fully_evaluated", "passed": None},
            "model_repair": {"status": "interrupted_after_native_failure", "passed": None},
            "final_rendered_site": {"status": "partial_screenshot_only", "passed": False},
        },
    }
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"output": str(args.output), "fallback_sections": len(fallbacks), "native_gate": "failed"}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
`````

`````python
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright


def main() -> None:
    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        try:
            mobile = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844})
            mobile.goto("http://127.0.0.1:5000", wait_until="networkidle")

            mobile.keyboard.press("Escape")
            assert mobile.locator("aside").count() == 0
            assert mobile.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth + 2")
            mobile.close()

            desktop = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 800})
            desktop.route("**/api/projects", lambda route: route.fulfill(
                status=200, content_type="application/json",
                body='[{"session_id":"example-session","title":"Museum site","timestamp":"2026-09-23 21:22:28","mode":"site"}]',
            ))
            desktop.goto("http://127.0.0.1:5000", wait_until="networkidle")
            desktop.get_by_text("Help me describe my website").click()
            desktop.get_by_label("Topic or business").fill("Independent bookshop")
            desktop.get_by_label("Pages or sections").fill("Home, catalog, events")
            desktop.get_by_role("button", name="Add details to prompt").click()
            desktop.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('#composer-textarea')?.value.includes('Independent bookshop')")
            assert "Independent bookshop" in desktop.locator("textarea").input_value()
            assert "Home, catalog, events" in desktop.locator("textarea").input_value()
            row = desktop.locator("#sidebar-project-item-example-session")
            assert row.is_visible()
            assert row.locator("button").first.count() == 1 and "Museum site" in row.locator("button").first.inner_text()
            assert "Just now" not in row.inner_text()
            assert row.locator("time").get_attribute("title") != "Update time unavailable"
            desktop.close()
        finally:
            browser.close()
    print("P1 workbench browser smoke check passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
`````

`````python
from scripts.capture_visual_review import capture
from training.preflight import sha256


def main():
 source=ROOT/'data/diverse_reference/source/forma_scroll_v2'
 output=ROOT/'runs/diverse_reference_review/forma_scroll_v2';output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 files={f'src/components/{p.name}':p.read_text(encoding='utf-8') for p in source.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
 original=ROOT/'runs/diverse_reference_review/forma/src/components'
 for name in ('Main.tsx','Main.css'):files[f'src/components/{name}']=(original/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 compilation=assemble(output,files)
 if not all(c['passed'] for c in compilation.values()):raise ValueError(compilation)
 server=ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),partial(SilentHandler,directory=str(output/'dist')))
 thread=Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start();url=f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}'
 try:
  behavior=interactions(url,'forma')
  from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
  timeline=[]
  with sync_playwright() as p:
   browser=p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
   for reduced in (False,True):

    page.goto(url,wait_until='networkidle')
    before=page.locator('.forma-grid article').first.evaluate('(e)=>getComputedStyle(e).opacity')
    initial=page.locator('.forma-stage').evaluate('(e)=>getComputedStyle(e).transform')
    page.locator('.forma-grid article').first.scroll_into_view_if_needed();page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    after=page.locator('.forma-grid article').first.evaluate('(e)=>getComputedStyle(e).opacity')
    final=page.locator('.forma-stage').evaluate('(e)=>getComputedStyle(e).transform')
    passed=(float(before)==1 and float(after)==1 and initial==final) if reduced else (float(before)==0 and float(after)==1 and initial!=final)
    timeline.append({'reduced_motion':reduced,'opacity_before':before,'opacity_after':after,'stage_before':initial,'stage_after':final,'passed':passed})
    page.close()
   browser.close()
  evidence=capture(url,output/'captures')
 finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(timeout=5)
 report={'source_files':{p.name:sha256(p) for p in source.iterdir() if p.is_file()},'compilation':compilation,'interactions':behavior,'motion_timeline':timeline,'browser_evidence':evidence,'passed':all(c['passed'] for c in behavior+timeline),'human_visual_review':None,'admission_status':'new_revision_awaiting_review'}
 (output/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
 print(json.dumps({'passed':report['passed'],'motion_timeline':timeline,'output':str(output)},indent=2))
`````

`````python
import json

import numpy as np
import pytest
from safetensors.numpy import save_file

from agent.base_model_fingerprint import (
    IncompatibleBaseModelError,
    qwen3_tensor_shape_errors,
    verify_lora_adapter_compatibility,
)


def test_lora_adapter_shape_guard_rejects_relabelled_weights(tmp_path):
    base = tmp_path / "base"
    adapter = tmp_path / "adapter"
    base.mkdir()
    adapter.mkdir()
    (base / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "model_type": "qwen3", "architectures": ["Qwen3ForCausalLM"],
        "hidden_size": 8, "intermediate_size": 12,
        "num_attention_heads": 4, "num_key_value_heads": 2, "head_dim": 2,
    }), encoding="utf-8")
    (adapter / "adapter_config.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"base_model_name_or_path": str(base)}), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    key = "base_model.model.model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.lora_A.weight"
    weights = adapter / "adapter_model.safetensors"
    save_file({key: np.zeros((2, 8), dtype=np.float32)}, str(weights))
    verify_lora_adapter_compatibility(adapter, base)

    save_file({key: np.zeros((2, 7), dtype=np.float32)}, str(weights))
    with pytest.raises(IncompatibleBaseModelError, match="Qwen3 expects 8"):
        verify_lora_adapter_compatibility(adapter, base)


def test_base_shape_guard_detects_config_only_relabel():
    config = {
        "hidden_size": 8, "intermediate_size": 12, "vocab_size": 20,
        "num_attention_heads": 4, "num_key_value_heads": 2, "head_dim": 2,
    }
    shapes = {
        "model.embed_tokens.weight": [20, 7],
        "model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.bias": [8],
    }
    errors = qwen3_tensor_shape_errors(config, shapes)
    assert any("embed_tokens" in error for error in errors)
    assert any("q_norm" in error for error in errors)
    assert any("attention bias" in error for error in errors)
`````

`````python
Test suite for auto-scaffolding reform and post-assembly Qwen rewrite loop.

   - fake pricing ($29/mo, $79/mo)
   - fake frequency tags (10Hz – 48kHz)
   - fake materials (Hand-lathed brass, aerospace billet aluminum)
   - fake legal metrics (98% Win Rate)
   - generic placeholder buttons (Explore {item} ->)
2. Minimal scaffold includes data-fallback="true".
3. The freeform loop never writes fallback scaffolds: a stuck section is reported as blocked.
4. The design kit never blocks: unusable model output becomes honest fallback copy ("repaired").
"""
import re
import pytest

from unittest.mock import MagicMock

from agent.project_validator import ValidationResult, InteractionValidationResult, VisualValidationResult

    _, tsx, _, css = auto_scaffold_section(
        "header",
        custom_instr="a sticky navigation bar with a responsive mobile drawer toggle",
    )
    assert '<header id="header"' in tsx
    assert 'aria-label="Primary navigation"' in tsx
    assert 'aria-expanded={open}' in tsx
    assert "a sticky navigation bar" not in tsx
    assert "ApexCloud" not in tsx
    assert ".sa-header__menu-button" in css


def test_auto_scaffold_produces_minimal_deterministic_scaffold_without_hallucinations():
    """Verify auto_scaffold_section does NOT invent pricing, metrics, materials, or buttons."""
    tsx_name, tsx_code, css_name, css_code = auto_scaffold_section(
        "features",
        style_spec=None,
        custom_instr="Write the features section highlighting core product capabilities.",
    )

    assert "Features.tsx" in tsx_name
    assert "export function Features" in tsx_code
    assert 'data-fallback="true"' in tsx_code
    assert "Features.css" in css_name

    # Prohibited hallucinated strings
    forbidden_tokens = [
        "$29/mo", "$79/mo", "$199/mo",
        "10Hz – 48kHz", "12Hz – 42kHz", "8Hz – 52kHz",
        "Hand-lathed brass", "obsidian damping baffle", "aerospace billet aluminum",
        "98% Win Rate", "140+ Trials", "AmLaw 100",
        "Explore Features", "Explore Features →", "Explore Features &rarr;",
        "sa-field__label",
    ]
    for token in forbidden_tokens:
        assert token not in tsx_code, f"Found forbidden fabricated token '{token}' in fallback scaffold!"

    tsx_name, tsx_code, css_name, css_code = auto_scaffold_section(
        "products",
        style_spec=None,

    assert 'data-fallback="true"' in tsx_code
    assert "Aura Monolith" in tsx_code
    assert "Aura Sphere" in tsx_code

    assert "Explore Aura Monolith" not in tsx_code
    assert "Explore Aura Sphere" not in tsx_code
`````

`````python
"""
tests/test_benchmark_provenance.py - Tests for Benchmark Provenance Attestation & Promotion Gating

Verifies:
1. Benchmark reports contain the required provenance metadata schema:
   {
     "provenance": "real",
     "model_sha256": "...",
     "adapter_sha256": "...",
     "dataset_sha256": "...",
     "git_commit": "...",
     "hardware": "...",
     "mock": false
   }
2. Mock benchmarks generate "provenance": "synthetic_mock", "mock": True.
3. Promotion gate strictly rejects candidate reports when mock=True.
4. Promotion gate strictly rejects candidate reports when provenance is not "real".
5. Real benchmark evidence is eligible for promotion consideration.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import pytest

from training.provenance import (
    generate_provenance_record,
    validate_benchmark_provenance,
)
from training.methodology import evaluate_promotion_gate

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def test_real_provenance_record_generation():
    """Verify generate_provenance_record creates schema-compliant real record."""
    rec = generate_provenance_record(
        mock=False,
        model_path=str(ROOT / "base-model"),
        adapter_path=str(ROOT / "models" / "qwen3-siteagent-r16-sft"),
    )
    assert rec["provenance"] == "real"
    assert rec["mock"] is False
    assert len(rec["model_sha256"]) == 64
    assert len(rec["adapter_sha256"]) == 64
    assert rec["git_commit"] != "unknown_commit"
    assert "hardware" in rec and len(rec["hardware"]) > 0


def test_mock_provenance_record_generation():
    """Verify mock benchmark record is explicitly tagged as mock."""
    rec = generate_provenance_record(
        mock=True,
        model_path=str(ROOT / "base-model"),
    )
    assert rec["provenance"] == "synthetic_mock"
    assert rec["mock"] is True


def test_promotion_gate_rejects_mock_candidate():
    """Verify promotion gate strictly rejects any candidate where mock != false."""
    candidate_metrics = {
        "overall_pass_rate": 0.55,
        "typecheck_pass_rate": 0.90,
        "category_pass_rates": {
            "tsc_render_interact": 0.45,
        },
        "mock": True,
        "provenance": "synthetic_mock",
        "site_benchmark_metrics": {
            "composite_score_mean": 0.85,
            "production_build_rate": 0.95,
            "runtime_pass_rate": 0.90,
            "section_completion_rate": 0.92,
            "mock": True,
        }
    }
    baseline_metrics = {
        "overall_pass_rate": 0.50,
        "typecheck_pass_rate": 0.80,
        "category_pass_rates": {
            "tsc_render_interact": 0.35,
        }
    }

    promo = evaluate_promotion_gate(
        candidate_metrics=candidate_metrics,
        baseline_metrics=baseline_metrics,
    )
    assert promo.is_eligible is False
    assert any("mock" in f.lower() for f in promo.blocking_failures)
`````

`````python
def test_design_plan_schema_and_json_serialization():
    """Verify that DesignPlan matches the exact JSON schema specified in Section 3.C."""
    plan = DesignPlan(
        artDirection="editorial industrial",
        heroArchetype="split",
        density="airy",
        typeScale="display-heavy",
        sectionRhythm=["quiet", "dense", "immersive", "quiet"],
        motion=["text-reveal", "sticky-story"],
        visualAnchor="product-render",
        mobileStrategy="stack",
    )

    d = plan.to_dict()
    assert d["artDirection"] == "editorial industrial"
    assert d["heroArchetype"] == "split"
    assert d["density"] == "airy"
    assert d["typeScale"] == "display-heavy"
    assert d["sectionRhythm"] == ["quiet", "dense", "immersive", "quiet"]
    assert d["motion"] == ["text-reveal", "sticky-story"]
    assert d["visualAnchor"] == "product-render"
    assert d["mobileStrategy"] == "stack"

    # Verify JSON serialization round-trip
    compact_json = plan.to_compact_json()
    parsed = json.loads(compact_json)
    assert parsed == d

    # Verify deserialization
    reconstructed = DesignPlan.from_dict(parsed)
    assert reconstructed.to_dict() == d

    """Verify formatting of the design plan prompt conditioning block."""
    plan = DesignPlan(

        heroArchetype="bento",

    )

    assert '"heroArchetype": "bento"' in prompt_str
    assert '"artDirection": "technical precision"' in prompt_str


def test_deterministic_design_plan_archetype_balancing():
    """Verify that synthesize_design_plan cycles evenly across all 7 archetypes."""
    plans = [synthesize_design_plan(domain="saas", task_index=i) for i in range(21)]
    archetypes = [p.heroArchetype for p in plans]

    # Every one of the 7 canonical archetypes must appear exactly 3 times in 21 tasks
    counts = {arch: archetypes.count(arch) for arch in CANONICAL_HERO_ARCHETYPES}
    for arch in CANONICAL_HERO_ARCHETYPES:
        assert counts[arch] == 3, f"Archetype {arch} count expected 3, got {counts[arch]}"

    # No archetype dominates the batch (max ratio = 1/7 ~= 14.3% << 80%)
    for arch, cnt in counts.items():
        ratio = cnt / len(plans)
        assert ratio < 0.20, f"Archetype {arch} ratio {ratio:.1%} exceeds 20%"


def test_deterministic_design_plan_domain_customization():
`````

`````python
    })
`````

`````python
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

from agent.project_validator import ValidationResult
from server.app import verify_and_repair_project


def test_project_repair_rejects_marker_only_fallback_rewrite(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    header = tmp_path / "src/components/Header.tsx"
    header.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    source = (
        "import './Header.css';\n"
        "export default function Header() { return <header id=\"header\" "
        "data-fallback=\"true\">Home</header>; }\n"
    )
    header.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
    (header.parent / "Header.css").write_text(".header { display: block; }\n", encoding="utf-8")
    failed = ValidationResult(
        typecheck_passed=True, build_passed=True, lint_passed=True,
        contract_passed=False, accessibility_passed=True, runtime_passed=True,
        preview_running=True, errors=["[Fallback Error] src/components/Header.tsx: unfinished"],
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr("server.app._validate_workspace", lambda *args, **kwargs: failed)
    runner = MagicMock()
    runner.generate_turn.return_value = (
        '<tool_call name="write_site"><file path="src/components/Header.tsx">'
        + source.replace('data-fallback="true"', 'data-fallback="false"')
        + '</file></tool_call>'
    )
    result = verify_and_repair_project(
        workspace=tmp_path, runner=runner, original_prompt="Build a site",
        files_dict={"src/components/Header.tsx": source,
                    "src/components/Header.css": ".header { display: block; }\n"},
        sections=["header"], max_attempts=1, run_visual_check=False,
    )
    assert result.repair_attempts == 1
    assert 'data-fallback="true"' in header.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
`````

`````python
def test_gate_accepts_complete_evidence_then_rejects_changed_artifact(tmp_path):
    from scripts.native_site_gate import ROOT, PIPELINE_SOURCES
    from training.preflight import sha256
    model = tmp_path / 'model'
    model.mkdir()
    weights = model / 'adapter_model.safetensors'
    weights.write_bytes(b'unit test model identity')
    report = {'provenance': 'live_model_native_development_gate', 'passed': True,
              'repair_count': 0, 'fallback_count': 0, 'model': str(model),
              'adapter_sha256': sha256(weights), 'cases': [],
              'model_files': {weights.name: sha256(weights)},
              'pipeline_sources': {name: sha256(ROOT / name) for name in PIPELINE_SOURCES}}
    for domain in ('portfolio', 'store', 'unfamiliar'):
        folder = tmp_path / domain
        artifacts = {}
        for name in ('response.txt', 'src/components/Main.tsx', 'src/components/Main.css',
                     'desktop.png', 'mobile.png', 'reduced_motion.png'):
            file = folder / name
            file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            file.write_text('synthetic unit fixture', encoding='utf-8')
            artifacts[name] = sha256(file)
        report['cases'].append({'domain': domain, 'passed': True, 'errors': [],
            'stop_reason': 'tool_complete', 'artifacts': artifacts,
            'compilation': {key: {'passed': True} for key in ('typescript', 'build')},
            'browser': [{'viewport': key, 'passed': True} for key in ('desktop', 'mobile', 'reduced_motion')]})
    path = tmp_path / 'report.json'
    path.write_text(json.dumps(report), encoding='utf-8')
    assert require_native_completion(path)['sha256'] == sha256(path)
    assert require_native_completion(path, expected_model_dir=model)['sha256'] == sha256(path)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='different model'):
        require_native_completion(path, expected_model_dir=tmp_path / 'other-model')
    (tmp_path / 'store/src/components/Main.css').write_text('changed', encoding='utf-8')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='fingerprint mismatch'):
        require_native_completion(path)
`````

`````python
"""Regression tests using the actual local Qwen3 template, not a ChatML mock."""
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from tokenizers import Tokenizer

from agent.agent_protocol import format_chatml
from training.preflight import encode_row

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


@pytest.fixture(scope='module')
def native():
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    if not (ROOT / 'base-model/tokenizer_config.json').exists():
        pytest.skip('Local Qwen3 tokenizer not installed')
    return AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(ROOT / 'base-model', local_files_only=True)


def test_actual_template_target_continues_inference_and_masks_prefix(native):
    rust = Tokenizer.from_file(str(ROOT / 'base-model/tokenizer.json'))
    messages = [
        {'role': 'system', 'content': 'Build sites.'},
        {'role': 'user', 'content': 'Start'},
        {'role': 'assistant', 'content': '<finish>Previous</finish>'},
        {'role': 'user', 'content': 'Now finish'},
        {'role': 'assistant', 'content': '<finish>Complete</finish>'},
    ]
    prefix = format_chatml(messages[:-1], True, tokenizer=native)
    completed = format_chatml(messages, False, tokenizer=native)
    assert prefix.endswith('<think>\n\n</think>\n\n')
    assert completed == prefix + messages[-1]['content'] + '<|im_end|>\n'
    encoded = encode_row({'messages': messages}, rust, 8192, chat_tokenizer=native)
    assert encoded['input_ids'] == native(completed, add_special_tokens=False)['input_ids']
    target = rust.decode([v for v in encoded['labels'] if v != -100], skip_special_tokens=False)
    assert target == '<finish>Complete</finish><|im_end|>'
    assert encoded['labels'][:len(native(prefix, add_special_tokens=False)['input_ids'])] == [-100] * len(native(prefix, add_special_tokens=False)['input_ids'])


def test_legacy_encoding_is_demonstrably_different(native):
    rust = Tokenizer.from_file(str(ROOT / 'base-model/tokenizer.json'))
    messages = [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Start'}, {'role': 'assistant', 'content': '<finish>Done</finish>'}]
    assert format_chatml(messages, False, tokenizer=rust) != format_chatml(messages, False, tokenizer=native)
`````

`````python
    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "_loaded_model_info", None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "_model_status", "loading")
    pending = server.app.test_client().get("/api/status").get_json()
    assert pending["model_loaded"] is False

    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "_runner", SimpleNamespace(model_path="base-model"))

    loaded = server.app.test_client().get("/api/status").get_json()
    assert loaded["model_loaded"] is True
    assert loaded["model_name"] == "actual-base"
    assert loaded["base_fingerprint"] == "basehash"
`````

`````python
def test_blinded_review_package_hides_model_identity(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch):
    holdout = tmp_path / "holdout.jsonl"
    cases = [{"task_id": f"case-{i}", "domain": f"domain-{i % 12}", "prompt": f"Build site {i}"} for i in range(30)]
    holdout.write_text("".join(json.dumps(case) + "\n" for case in cases), encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setattr(blinded_visual_review, "HOLDOUT", holdout)
    source = tmp_path / "source"
    for case in cases:
        for role in ("candidate", "baseline"):
            root = source / case["task_id"] / role
            root.mkdir(parents=True)
            captures = {}
            for mode in ("desktop", "mobile", "reduced_motion"):
                screenshot = root / f"{mode}.png"
                video = root / f"{mode}.webm"
                screenshot.write_bytes(f"{case['task_id']} {role} {mode} screenshot".encode())
                video.write_bytes(f"{case['task_id']} {role} {mode} video".encode())
                captures[mode] = {"screenshot": str(screenshot), "scroll_video": str(video)}
            (root / "evidence.json").write_text(json.dumps({"captures": captures}), encoding="utf-8")
    package = tmp_path / "public"
    private = tmp_path / "private.json"

    assert private.is_file()

    mapping = json.loads(private.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["cases"]
    forms = []
    for reviewer in ("r1", "r2"):
        form = package / f"review_form_{reviewer}.csv"
        with form.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
            reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
            fields = reader.fieldnames
            rows = list(reader)
        for row in rows:
            row["pairwise_winner"] = mapping[row["task_id"]]["candidate_label"]
            for key in fields:
                if key.startswith(("A_", "B_")):
                    row[key] = "3"
        with form.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fields)
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(rows)
        forms.append(form)
    report = tmp_path / "review_report.json"
    blinded_visual_review.assemble(package, private, "adapter-sha", forms, report)
    assert len(json.loads(report.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["site_reviews"]) == 60

    assert len(cases) == len({row["task_id"] for row in cases}) == 30
    assert len({row["domain"] for row in cases}) == 12
    check_benchmark_disjointness(str(train), str(holdout))
`````

`````python
def test_independent_evaluation_axes_are_computed(base_valid_files):
    """Verify that all 10 independent outcome axes are calculated and exposed."""
    scorer = SiteBenchmarkScorer()
    spec = {
        "name": "PlatformApp",
        "domain": "saas",
        "title": "Computational Platform",
        "required_sections": ["hero", "features"],
    }

    score = scorer.evaluate_site(spec, base_valid_files, turn_logs=[
        {"turn": 1, "action": "write_site", "section": "hero"},
        {"turn": 2, "action": "write_site", "section": "features"},
    ])

    assert isinstance(score, SiteBenchmarkScore)
    assert len(score.independent_scores) == 10

    for axis in INDEPENDENT_EVALUATION_AXES:
        assert axis in score.independent_scores, f"Axis {axis} missing from independent_scores"
        val = score.independent_scores[axis]
        assert 0.0 <= val <= 1.0, f"Axis {axis} value {val} out of [0.0, 1.0]"

    # Verify individual axes on high-quality site
    assert score.independent_scores["correctness_build_runtime"] >= 0.80
    assert score.independent_scores["motion_quality"] >= 0.85
    assert score.independent_scores["fallback_recovery_dependency"] == 1.0
    assert score.independent_scores["accessibility"] >= 0.70


def test_motion_quality_scoring(base_valid_files):
    """Verify that score_motion_quality awards points for transitions, hover, keyframes, and reduced motion."""
    scorer = SiteBenchmarkScorer()
    m_score, details = scorer.score_motion_quality(base_valid_files)

    assert details["has_transitions"] is True
    assert details["has_hover_states"] is True
    assert details["has_keyframes"] is True
    assert details["has_reduced_motion"] is True
    assert details["uses_transforms"] is True
    assert m_score >= 0.90


def test_recovery_metrics_and_penalty_for_auto_scaffolding(base_valid_files):
    """Verify Section 3.E: Tracking recovery metrics and penalizing auto-scaffold reliance."""
    scorer = SiteBenchmarkScorer()
    spec = {
        "name": "PlatformApp",
        "domain": "saas",
        "required_sections": ["hero", "features"],
    }

    # Case 1: Model-native generation (0 auto-scaffold)
    native_score = scorer.evaluate_site(spec, base_valid_files, turn_logs=[
        {"turn": 1, "action": "write_site", "section": "hero"},
        {"turn": 2, "action": "write_site", "section": "features"},
    ])

    assert native_score.recovery_metrics["auto_scaffold_usage_rate"] == 0.0
    assert native_score.recovery_metrics["model_native_success_rate"] == 1.0
    assert native_score.recovery_metrics["fallback_free_completion_rate"] == 1.0
    assert native_score.auto_scaffold_usage_rate == 0.0
    # No live workspace was supplied, so the pass gate stays closed even for a
    # model-native run; recovery metrics are still computed.
    assert native_score.passed is False

    # Case 2: Self-repair generation (Turn 1 error, Turn 2 model fixed natively)
    repaired_score = scorer.evaluate_site(spec, base_valid_files, turn_logs=[
        {"turn": 1, "action": "write_site_no_css", "section": "hero"},
        {"turn": 2, "action": "write_site", "section": "hero"},
        {"turn": 3, "action": "write_site", "section": "features"},
    ])

    assert repaired_score.recovery_metrics["auto_scaffold_usage_rate"] == 0.0
    assert repaired_score.recovery_metrics["repair_success_rate"] == 1.0
    assert repaired_score.auto_scaffold_usage_rate == 0.0
    assert repaired_score.passed is False  # fail-closed without a live workspace

    # Case 3: Recovery-dependent generation (50% auto-scaffolded)
    scaffolded_score = scorer.evaluate_site(spec, base_valid_files, turn_logs=[
        {"turn": 1, "action": "write_site", "section": "hero"},
        {"turn": 2, "action": "write_site_auto_guarantee", "section": "features", "auto_recovered": True},
    ])

    assert scaffolded_score.recovery_metrics["auto_scaffold_usage_rate"] == 0.50
    assert scaffolded_score.auto_scaffold_usage_rate == 0.50
    assert scaffolded_score.recovery_metrics["fallback_free_completion_rate"] == 0.0

    # Verify composite score penalty
    # 50% auto-scaffold penalty = 0.50 * 0.40 = 0.20 deduction
    assert scaffolded_score.composite_score < native_score.composite_score
    diff = native_score.composite_score - scaffolded_score.composite_score
    assert diff >= 0.18, f"Expected recovery penalty >= 0.18, got {diff:.4f}"

    # Verify fallback dependency score drops
    assert scaffolded_score.independent_scores["fallback_recovery_dependency"] < native_score.independent_scores["fallback_recovery_dependency"]


def test_excessive_auto_scaffold_fails_pass_gate(base_valid_files):
    """Verify that a site with >50% auto-scaffold usage is rejected by the pass gate."""
    scorer = SiteBenchmarkScorer()
    spec = {
        "name": "PlatformApp",
        "domain": "saas",
        "required_sections": ["hero", "features", "pricing"],
    }

    # 2 out of 3 sections auto-scaffolded (66.7% > 50%)
    excessive_score = scorer.evaluate_site(spec, base_valid_files, turn_logs=[
        {"turn": 1, "action": "write_site", "section": "hero"},
        {"turn": 2, "action": "write_site_auto_guarantee", "section": "features", "auto_recovered": True},
        {"turn": 3, "action": "write_site_auto_guarantee", "section": "pricing", "auto_recovered": True},
    ])

    assert excessive_score.passed is False
    assert any("Excessive auto-scaffolding dependence" in err for err in excessive_score.errors)


def test_aggregate_site_benchmark_scores_includes_axes_and_recovery(base_valid_files):
    """Verify aggregate_site_benchmark_scores aggregates independent axes and recovery metrics."""
    scorer = SiteBenchmarkScorer()
    spec = {"name": "Site", "domain": "saas", "required_sections": ["hero", "features"]}

    s1 = scorer.evaluate_site(spec, base_valid_files, turn_logs=[
        {"turn": 1, "action": "write_site", "section": "hero"},
        {"turn": 2, "action": "write_site", "section": "features"},
    ])
    s2 = scorer.evaluate_site(spec, base_valid_files, turn_logs=[
        {"turn": 1, "action": "write_site", "section": "hero"},
        {"turn": 2, "action": "write_site_auto_guarantee", "section": "features", "auto_recovered": True},
    ])

    agg = aggregate_site_benchmark_scores([s1, s2])

    assert "independent_evaluation_axes_means" in agg
    assert "recovery_metrics_summary" in agg

    axes_means = agg["independent_evaluation_axes_means"]
    for axis in INDEPENDENT_EVALUATION_AXES:
        assert axis in axes_means

    rec_sum = agg["recovery_metrics_summary"]
    for metric in RECOVERY_METRICS:
        assert metric in rec_sum

    assert rec_sum["auto_scaffold_usage_rate"] == 0.25  # (0.0 + 0.50) / 2
    assert rec_sum["fallback_free_completion_rate"] == 0.50  # 1 of 2 sites had 0 scaffolding


def test_evaluate_promotion_gate_blocks_excessive_auto_scaffold_candidate():
    """Verify that model promotion rejects candidates with >25% auto-scaffolding."""
    candidate_metrics = {
        "pass_rate": 0.85,
        "typecheck_pass_rate": 0.95,
        "category_pass_rates": {"interaction": 0.80},
        "site_benchmark_metrics": {
            "composite_score_mean": 0.82,
            "production_build_rate": 0.90,
            "runtime_pass_rate": 0.90,
            "section_completion_rate": 0.90,
            "site_diversity_score": 0.75,
            "recovery_metrics_summary": {
                "auto_scaffold_usage_rate": 0.35,  # 35% > 25% threshold
                "fallback_free_completion_rate": 0.40,
            },
        },
    }

    result = evaluate_promotion_gate(candidate_metrics)
    assert result.is_eligible is False
    assert any("auto-scaffold usage rate 35.0% exceeds promotion threshold" in f for f in result.blocking_failures)
`````

`````python
import json
from types import SimpleNamespace

from agent.agent_protocol import site_envelope_errors
from agent.dependency_manager import DependencyManager
from server.app import _scaffold_site_vite_runner


def test_site_scaffold_preserves_dependencies_and_declares_approved_imports(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "package.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"dependencies": {"lucide-react": "^0.475.0"}, "scripts": {"test": "echo ok"}}),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    files = {"src/components/Hero.tsx": "import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber'; export default function Hero(){ return <Canvas /> }"}
    _scaffold_site_vite_runner(tmp_path, "Example", files)
    manifest = json.loads((tmp_path / "package.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert manifest["dependencies"]["lucide-react"] == "^0.475.0"
    assert manifest["dependencies"]["@react-three/fiber"]
    assert manifest["scripts"]["test"] == "echo ok"


def test_failed_package_install_does_not_claim_dependency(tmp_path):
    class FailedExecutor:
        def execute(self, **_kwargs):
            return SimpleNamespace(success=False, returncode=1, stdout="", stderr="install failed")

    manager = DependencyManager(tmp_path, executor=FailedExecutor())
    result = manager.install_package("lucide-react")
    assert not result["success"]
    assert "lucide-react" not in manager.get_dependencies()["all"]


def test_live_write_rejects_incomplete_and_naked_file_tags():
    assert site_envelope_errors('<tool_call name="write_site"><file path="x.tsx">oops</file>')
    assert site_envelope_errors('<file path="x.tsx">oops</file>')
    assert site_envelope_errors('{"action": "write_site", "arguments": {')
    assert not site_envelope_errors('<tool_call name="write_site"><file path="x.tsx">ok</file></tool_call>')
`````

`````python
"""
tests/test_site_state_model.py - Test Suite for Authoritative Site State Model:
1. Three separate concepts:
   - section_completion (e.g. 6 / 6)
   - project_validation (passed / failed)
   - generation_quality (native / repaired / fallback)
2. Final passed formula:
   final_passed = (
       generation_complete
       and validation.passed
       and interaction_validation.passed
       and visual_validation.passed
   )
3. Never: 6 / 6 sections => final_passed

def test_six_of_six_does_not_equal_final_passed_when_validation_fails():
    """Confirms that having all sections complete (6/6) fails closed if validation fails."""
    sections_completed = 6
    sections_planned = 6
    generation_complete = (sections_completed == sections_planned)

    broken_val = ValidationResult(
        typecheck_passed=False,
        build_passed=False,
        lint_passed=True,
        contract_passed=True,
        accessibility_passed=True,
        motion_passed=True,
        runtime_passed=False,
        preview_running=False,
        errors=["TS2304: Cannot find name 'badIdentifier'"],
    )
    int_val = InteractionValidationResult(passed=False, status="failed")
    vis_val = VisualValidationResult(passed=False, status="failed")

    final_passed = bool(
        generation_complete
        and broken_val.passed
        and int_val.passed
        and vis_val.passed
    )

    assert generation_complete is True
    assert broken_val.passed is False
    assert final_passed is False, "6/6 sections MUST NOT equate to final_passed when validation fails!"

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "turn_logs,auto_recovered,expected_quality",
    [
        (
            [
                {"turn": 1, "action": "write_site_ok", "section": "header"},
                {"turn": 2, "action": "write_site_ok", "section": "hero"},
            ],
            [],
            "native",
        ),
        (
            [
                {"turn": 1, "action": "write_site_no_css", "section": "header"},
                {"turn": 2, "action": "write_site_ok", "section": "header"},
                {"turn": 3, "action": "write_site_ok", "section": "hero"},
            ],
            [],
            "repaired",
        ),
        (
            [
                {"turn": 1, "action": "write_site_tsc_error", "section": "header"},
                {"turn": 2, "action": "write_site_ok", "section": "header"},
            ],
            [],
            "repaired",
        ),
        (
            [
                {"turn": 1, "action": "write_site_ok", "section": "header"},
                {"turn": 2, "action": "write_site_auto_guarantee", "section": "footer", "auto_recovered": True},
            ],
            ["footer"],
            "fallback",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_generation_quality_classification(turn_logs, auto_recovered, expected_quality):
    """Verifies generation_quality is accurately classified as native, repaired, or fallback."""
    repair_actions = {
        "write_site_section_mismatch",
        "write_site_no_css",
        "write_site_style_violation",
        "write_site_tsc_error",
        "write_site_empty",
    }
    has_fallback = len(auto_recovered) > 0 or any(entry.get("auto_recovered") for entry in turn_logs)
    has_repairs = any(entry.get("action") in repair_actions for entry in turn_logs)

    if has_fallback:
        quality = "fallback"
    elif has_repairs:
        quality = "repaired"
    else:
        quality = "native"

    assert quality == expected_quality
`````

`````python
"""
test_structural_gate.py - Unit tests for the structural quality gate in the WriteSiteAction pipeline.

Verifies:
1. validate_structural_quality is called before writing to disk (gate is active).
2. Native sections with violations trigger a model rewrite request (not a disk write).
3. Native sections rejected at the retry cap remain blocked.
4. Missing native sections never become silent fallback completions.
5. Sections with no structural violations pass straight through to disk write.
6. turn_logs contain the correct action codes for each gate outcome.
"""
import pytest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
from subprocess import CompletedProcess

from agent.agent import run_site_agent_on_example
from agent.style_ingest import validate_structural_quality


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. validate_structural_quality – smoke test: detects truncated CSS braces
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_validate_structural_quality_detects_unbalanced_css_braces():
    """Structural validator must flag unbalanced CSS braces."""
    files = [
        ("src/components/Hero.tsx", "export function Hero() { return <section></section>; }"),
        ("src/components/Hero.css", ".hero { color: red;\n/* unclosed */"),  # missing closing }
    ]
    violations = validate_structural_quality(files, section_name="hero")
    assert len(violations) > 0
    # The validator emits "Unclosed block" for an unbalanced CSS brace
    assert any(
        "unclosed" in v.lower() or "unbalanced" in v.lower() or "brace" in v.lower()
        for v in violations
    ), f"Expected unclosed-block / unbalanced-brace violation, got: {violations}"


def test_validate_structural_quality_clean_files_produce_no_violations():

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Gate integration: native sections with violations → rewrite request
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_structural_gate_requests_rewrite_for_native_section_with_violations(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """
    When the model emits a structurally violating section and the cap is NOT hit,
    the pipeline must request a rewrite (no disk write) and log
    action='write_site_structural_violation'.
    """
    # Bad CSS: opens two rule blocks but never closes the second one.
    # The first block is complete so has_real_css() passes; the unclosed
    # second block triggers the structural validator.
    bad_tsx = (
        "import React from 'react';\n"
        "import './Hero.css';\n"
        "export function Hero() { return <section className=\"hero\"><h1>Title</h1></section>; }\n"
    )
    bad_css = (
        ".hero {\n"
        "  padding: 4rem 2rem;\n"
        "  background: #000;\n"
        "  color: #fff;\n"
        "}\n"  # closed — passes has_real_css
        ".hero__inner {\n"  # opened but never closed — structural violation
        "  display: flex;\n"
    )

    # Turn 1: emit the violating section
    # Turn 2+: emit nothing (force model to "fail" again — gate will report violation again)
    call_count = [0]

    def mock_generate(**kwargs):
        call_count[0] += 1
        if call_count[0] == 1:
            return (
                '<tool_call name="write_site">\n'
                '<file path="src/components/Hero.tsx">\n'
                f'{bad_tsx}\n'
                '</file>\n'
                '<file path="src/components/Hero.css">\n'
                f'{bad_css}\n'
                '</file>\n'
                '</tool_call>'
            )
        # Subsequent: no action → will eventually trigger fallback scaffold
        return "Thinking: I cannot fix this."

    mock_runner = MagicMock()
    mock_runner.generate_turn = mock_generate

    # Monkeypatch TSC to pass so the violation comes purely from structural gate
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "agent.agent.run_command",
        lambda *args, **kwargs: CompletedProcess(args=args[0], returncode=0, stdout="", stderr=""),
    )

    res = run_site_agent_on_example(
        orig_idx=20,
        prompt="Build a hero section",
        project_name="HeroTest",
        brief_xml="",
        sections=["hero"],
        runner=mock_runner,
        workspace_root=tmp_path,
        max_turns=3,
    )

    # The structural gate must have fired at least once on that native section
    structural_logs = [
        e for e in res["turn_logs"]
        if e.get("action") in ("write_site_structural_violation", "write_site_parser_error")
    ]
    assert len(structural_logs) >= 1, (
        "Expected at least one structural gate log entry; "
        f"turn_logs were: {res['turn_logs']}"
    )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
`````
