`````python
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_structural_gate_never_invents_fallback_completion(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """
    A model that never emits accepted code must not get fallback completion credit.
    """
    # Model always fails to emit any tool call → triggers auto-scaffold fallback
    mock_runner = MagicMock()
    mock_runner.generate_turn.return_value = "Thinking: cannot do this."

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "agent.agent.run_command",
        lambda *args, **kwargs: CompletedProcess(args=args[0], returncode=0, stdout="", stderr=""),
    )

    # Inject a structural violation into the auto_scaffold output so the gate fires
    original_auto_scaffold = None
    import agent.agent as agent_module

    real_auto_scaffold = agent_module.auto_scaffold_section

    def patched_auto_scaffold(section_name, style_spec=None, custom_instr=""):
        t_name, t_code, c_name, c_code = real_auto_scaffold(section_name, style_spec, custom_instr)
        # Deliberately break the CSS to trigger the structural gate
        c_code_broken = c_code + "\n.unclosed-rule { color: red;\n"  # missing }
        return t_name, t_code, c_name, c_code_broken

    monkeypatch.setattr(agent_module, "auto_scaffold_section", patched_auto_scaffold)

    res = run_site_agent_on_example(
        orig_idx=22,
        prompt="Build a contact section",
        project_name="ContactTest",
        brief_xml="",
        sections=["contact"],
        runner=mock_runner,
        workspace_root=tmp_path,
        max_turns=3,
    )

    assert res["sections_completed"] == 0
    assert res["generation_complete"] is False
    assert res["blocked_sections"]
    assert not res["files"]
    assert not any(e.get("action") == "write_site_fallback" for e in res["turn_logs"])
`````

`````python
"""Small, curated photographic asset resolver for briefs that request imagery.

The resolver never substitutes diagrams, icons, or unrelated image-search results
for photographs. Sites may use these URLs directly and retain the credit metadata.
"""

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple
from urllib.parse import urlparse


@dataclass
class AssetSpec:
    """First-class media decision used by layout planning and rendering."""
    id: str
    purpose: str
    source: str
    src: str
    attribution: Optional[str]
    width: int
    height: int
    aspect_ratio: float
    focal_point: Optional[Tuple[float, float]]
    alt: str
    eager: bool = False

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        value = asdict(self)
        value["aspectRatio"] = value.pop("aspect_ratio")
        value["focalPoint"] = value.pop("focal_point")
        return value


def build_asset_manifest(brief: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Resolve media intentionally, reserving geometry for every image."""
    resolved = resolve_site_images(brief)
    assets: List[AssetSpec] = []
    hero = (resolved.get("images") or {}).get("hero")
    if hero:
        assets.append(AssetSpec("hero", "hero", "stock", hero["url"], hero.get("credit"), 1200, 800, 1.5, None, hero["alt"], True))
    for index, image in enumerate((resolved.get("images") or {}).get("items", [])):
        assets.append(AssetSpec(f"editorial-{index+1}", "editorial", "stock", image["url"], image.get("credit"), 1200, 800, 1.5, None, image["alt"]))
    return {"assets": [asset.to_dict() for asset in assets], "media_decision": "photography" if assets else resolved.get("media_decision", "none"),
            "media_expectation": resolved.get("media_expectation", "")}


_PHOTO_ROWS = [
    ("1558494949-ef010cbdcc31", "Server racks in a modern datacenter", "cloud server datacenter saas"),
    ("1551288049-bebda4e38f71", "Analytics dashboard on a computer screen", "analytics dashboard telemetry saas"),

    ("1517248135467-4c7edcad34c4", "Restaurant interior", "restaurant dining hospitality"),
    ("1497366754035-f200968a6e72", "Modern office interior", "business finance office"),

    ("1506744038136-46273834b3fb", "Mountain landscape", "travel landscape nature"),

_STOCK_PHOTO_CURATED_CATALOG: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [
    {
        "url": f"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-{photo_id}?w=1200&q=80",
        "alt": alt,
        "title": alt,
        "credit": "Photo via Unsplash",
        "source": "Unsplash",
        "tags": tags.split(),
    }
    for photo_id, alt, tags in _PHOTO_ROWS
]


def _is_valid_photograph(candidate: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    url = str(candidate.get("url", ""))
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    if parsed.scheme != "https" or parsed.hostname not in {"images.unsplash.com", "images.pexels.com"}:
        return False
    if re.search(r"\.(?:svg|gif|pdf)(?:$|\?)", parsed.path, re.I):
        return False
    description = " ".join(str(candidate.get(key, "")) for key in ("alt", "title", "source"))
    if re.search(r"\b(?:diagram|chart|flowchart|graph|scan|whitepaper|document|icon|vector|illustration|schematic)\b", description, re.I):
        return False
    width, height = candidate.get("width"), candidate.get("height")
    if width is not None and height is not None:
        try:
            width, height = int(width), int(height)
            if min(width, height) < 300 or max(width, height) / min(width, height) > 5:
                return False
        except (TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
            return False
    return bool(candidate.get("alt"))


def _map_to_concrete_photo_query(title: str, biz_type: str = "general") -> Tuple[str, List[str]]:
    text = title.lower()
    rules = [
        ({"cloud_saas", "saas", "technology"}, r"security|governance|vault", "cybersecurity operations center server room"),
        ({"cloud_saas", "saas", "technology"}, r"trac|telemetry|predict|analytic|alert", "data analytics dashboard"),
        ({"cloud_saas", "saas", "technology"}, r"pipelin|scal|distributed|cloud", "cloud server infrastructure"),
        ({"cloud_saas", "saas", "technology"}, r"code|developer|automation", "software engineer coding workspace"),
        ({"architecture", "realestate"}, r"sustain|passive", "sustainable modern green architecture building"),
        ({"architecture", "realestate"}, r"material|stone|wood", "minimalist natural stone and wood architecture interior"),
        ({"coffee_shop", "coffee"}, r"sourc|harvest|lot", "artisan coffee farmer harvest fresh cherries"),
        ({"coffee_shop", "coffee"}, r"pour|brew|barista", "artisan cafe barista"),
        ({"legal", "law"}, r"litigation|practice|counsel", "prestigious corporate law firm library books"),
        ({"finance", "fintech"}, r"wealth|advisory|finance", "financial district modern corporate towers skyline"),
    ]
    for domains, pattern, query in rules:
        if biz_type in domains and re.search(pattern, text):
            return query, [biz_type.replace("_", " ") + " photography"]
    defaults = {
        "cloud_saas": "cloud server infrastructure",
        "saas": "software coding workspace",
        "architecture": "modern architecture building",
        "coffee_shop": "artisan cafe barista",
        "legal": "corporate law firm library books",
        "finance": "financial district modern corporate towers skyline",
        "coffee": "artisan coffee cafe",
        "restaurant": "restaurant dining room",
        "healthcare": "healthcare clinic",
    }
    # Unknown subjects retain their own words. Inventing a workplace query turns
    # an uncovered product or topic into an unrelated but technically valid photo.
    query = defaults.get(biz_type, title.strip())
    return query, []


def _resolve_curated_stock_photo(query: str, biz_type: str = "general", used_urls: Optional[Set[str]] = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    used_urls = used_urls or set()
    words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", query.lower()))
    domain_words = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", biz_type.lower()))
    ranked = sorted(
        _STOCK_PHOTO_CURATED_CATALOG,
        key=lambda photo: len((words | domain_words) & set(photo["tags"])),
        reverse=True,
    )
    relevant_words = (words | domain_words) - {"general", "ecommerce", "photography", "editorial", "professional", "minimal", "design"}
    return next((dict(photo) for photo in ranked
                 if relevant_words.intersection(photo["tags"])
                 and photo["url"] not in used_urls and _is_valid_photograph(photo)), None)


def fetch_single_image(query: str, biz_type: str = "general", used_urls: Optional[Set[str]] = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    concrete_query, _ = _map_to_concrete_photo_query(query, biz_type)
    return _resolve_curated_stock_photo(concrete_query, biz_type, used_urls)


def resolve_site_images(brief: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    biz_type = str(brief.get("archetype") or brief.get("business_type") or "general")
    used: Set[str] = set()
    hero = brief.get("hero") or {}
    business_name = str(brief.get("business_name", ""))
    if business_name.strip().lower() == "my business":
        business_name = ""  # the planner's placeholder is not a subject ("business" would match office stock)
    hero_query = str((hero.get("title") if isinstance(hero, dict) else "") or business_name)
    hero_photo = fetch_single_image(hero_query, biz_type, used)
    if hero_photo:
        used.add(hero_photo["url"])
    features = brief.get("features") or []
    items = features.get("items", []) if isinstance(features, dict) else features
    item_photos = []
    for item in items if isinstance(items, list) else []:
        title = item.get("title", "") if isinstance(item, dict) else str(item)
        photo = fetch_single_image(title, biz_type, used)
        if photo:
            item_photos.append(photo)
            used.add(photo["url"])
    prompt = str(brief.get("source_prompt") or (brief.get("requirement_manifest") or {}).get("source_prompt") or "")
    has_photos = bool(hero_photo or item_photos)
    illustration_requested = bool(re.search(r"\b(?:illustrations?|drawn|drawings?)\b", prompt, re.I))
    decision = "photography" if has_photos else ("illustration" if illustration_requested else "none")
    expectation = ("Use a clearly drawn illustration relevant to the requested subject; no curated photo matches."
                   if decision == "illustration" else ("No relevant curated photograph is available. Do not substitute an unrelated photo." if not has_photos else ""))
    return {**brief, "images": {"hero": hero_photo, "items": item_photos},
            "media_decision": decision, "media_expectation": expectation}
`````

`````python
"""
agent/design_plan.py - Deterministic Structured Design-Planning Supervision.

Implements Section 3.C of the Professional-Grade Website Model Improvements:
Conditioning the model on a compact structured design plan prior to file generation:
{
  "artDirection": "editorial industrial",
  "heroArchetype": "split",
  "density": "airy",
  "typeScale": "display-heavy",
  "sectionRhythm": ["quiet", "dense", "immersive", "quiet"],
  "motion": ["text-reveal", "sticky-story"],
  "visualAnchor": "product-render",
  "mobileStrategy": "stack"
}

The design plan is synthesized by deterministic orchestration to ensure perfectly
balanced archetype trajectories across training, benchmarking, and execution batches,
without reliance on hidden chain-of-thought or non-deterministic token reasoning.
"""

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
import hashlib
import json
import re
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from agent.design_director import plan_design_direction, DesignGenome, genome_history_from_brief


CANONICAL_HERO_ARCHETYPES = [
    "split",
    "editorial_asymmetric",
    "full_bleed_visual",
    "bento",
    "terminal_data",
    "product_stage",
    "restrained_centered",
]

# Genome fields that duplicate (and used to contradict) the brief's design system,
# or the plan's own heroArchetype / density / topology fields.
_BRIEF_OWNED_GENOME_FIELDS = {"palette", "display_font", "body_font", "theme_mode",
                              "hero", "density", "section_archetypes"}

VALID_DENSITIES = ["airy", "compact", "balanced", "dense"]
VALID_TYPE_SCALES = ["display-heavy", "typographic-contrast", "editorial-serif", "technical-mono", "balanced-clean"]
VALID_MOBILE_STRATEGIES = ["stack", "scroll-snap", "drawer-collapse", "tab-switch"]
VALID_TOPOLOGIES = {"quiet", "dense", "immersive", "interactive", "impact", "structured",
                    "asymmetric", "bento-asymmetric", "split", "sticky-deck", "editorial",
                    "horizontal-collection", "wide-cta", "product-stage", "three-column-grid"}


@dataclass
class DesignPlan:
    """Compact structured design plan conditioning site generation."""
    artDirection: str
    heroArchetype: str
    density: str
    typeScale: str
    sectionRhythm: List[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: ["quiet", "dense", "immersive", "quiet"])
    motion: List[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: ["text-reveal", "sticky-story"])
    visualAnchor: str = "product-render"
    mobileStrategy: str = "stack"
    topology: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    designGenome: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Converts design plan to exact camelCase JSON dictionary."""
        return {
            "artDirection": self.artDirection,
            "heroArchetype": self.heroArchetype,
            "density": self.density,
            "typeScale": self.typeScale,
            "sectionRhythm": self.sectionRhythm,
            "motion": self.motion,
            "visualAnchor": self.visualAnchor,
            "mobileStrategy": self.mobileStrategy,
            "topology": self.topology,
            "designGenome": self.designGenome,
        }

    def to_compact_json(self) -> str:
        """Emits compact single-line or clean multi-line JSON."""
        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), separators=(",", ": "))

    def align_with_brief(self, media_available: bool = True) -> "DesignPlan":
        """Make the plan agree with the content brief, which owns the visual system.

        The genome's palette names, fonts and light/dark mode are dropped: the
        brief's design system (colours, fonts, CSS variables) is the only source,
        and it is what the preview's index.html actually loads. When the brief has
        no usable photography, photo-led anchors become typographic ones.
        """
        if isinstance(self.designGenome, dict):
            self.designGenome = {key: value for key, value in self.designGenome.items()
                                 if key not in _BRIEF_OWNED_GENOME_FIELDS}
            if not media_available and self.designGenome.get("media_personality") == "photography":
                self.designGenome["media_personality"] = "typographic"
        if not media_available and "photo" in self.visualAnchor:
            self.visualAnchor = "typographic-composition"
        return self

    def to_prompt_block(self) -> str:
        """Formats the design plan as a high-visibility conditioning block."""
        plan_json = json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=2)
        return (
            "=== STRUCTURED DESIGN PLAN ===\n"
            "Follow this plan for layout, hero composition, rhythm, density and motion. "
            "Colours, fonts and light/dark mode come only from the design system in the Content Brief:\n"
            f"{plan_json}\n"
            "==============================\n"
        )

    def to_layout_xml(self) -> str:
        """Serialize the layout contract used by generators and validators."""
        import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
        root = ET.Element("layout", {"archetype": self.heroArchetype, "density": self.density})
        topology = ET.SubElement(root, "topology")
        for item in self.topology:
            ET.SubElement(topology, "section", {"archetype": item})
        return ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode", short_empty_elements=True)

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "DesignPlan":
        """Instantiates DesignPlan, rejecting malformed plans instead of silently repairing them."""
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise ValueError("design plan must be an object")
        required = {"artDirection", "heroArchetype", "density", "typeScale", "sectionRhythm", "motion", "visualAnchor", "mobileStrategy", "topology", "designGenome"}
        missing = required - set(data)
        if missing:
            raise ValueError("design plan missing fields: " + ", ".join(sorted(missing)))
        hero = data.get("heroArchetype", "split")
        if hero not in CANONICAL_HERO_ARCHETYPES:

        if data.get("density") not in VALID_DENSITIES or data.get("typeScale") not in VALID_TYPE_SCALES or data.get("mobileStrategy") not in VALID_MOBILE_STRATEGIES:
            raise ValueError("invalid design plan enum")
        if not isinstance(data.get("sectionRhythm"), list) or not isinstance(data.get("motion"), list) or not isinstance(data.get("topology"), list):
            raise ValueError("sectionRhythm, motion, and topology must be arrays")
        unknown = set(data["topology"]) - VALID_TOPOLOGIES

        density = data.get("density", "airy")
        type_scale = data.get("typeScale", "display-heavy")
        mobile = data.get("mobileStrategy", "stack")
        if density not in VALID_DENSITIES:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid density: {density}")
        if type_scale not in VALID_TYPE_SCALES:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid typeScale: {type_scale}")
        if mobile not in VALID_MOBILE_STRATEGIES:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid mobileStrategy: {mobile}")
        topology = data.get("topology", [])
        if not isinstance(topology, list) or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in topology):
            raise ValueError("Invalid topology")
        return cls(
            artDirection=data.get("artDirection", "editorial industrial"),
            heroArchetype=hero,
            density=density,
            typeScale=type_scale,
            sectionRhythm=data.get("sectionRhythm", ["quiet", "dense", "immersive", "quiet"]),
            motion=data.get("motion", ["text-reveal", "sticky-story"]),

    "bento": "bento",

}


_TECH_DOMAINS = {"saas", "fintech", "developer", "dashboard", "agency"}
_PRODUCT_STAGE_DOMAINS = {"ecommerce", "architecture", "coffee"}


def prompt_design_seed(prompt: str) -> int:
    """Stable per-request seed; 0 for an empty prompt."""
    text = " ".join((prompt or "").lower().split())
    if not text:
        return 0
    return int(hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8], 16)


def synthesize_design_plan(
    prompt_spec: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    domain: str = "general",
    task_index: int = 0,
) -> DesignPlan:
    """
    Deterministically synthesizes a compact structured design plan.
    
    Guarantees:
    1. Perfect layout archetype balance across tasks (round-robin cycle across 7 archetypes).
    2. Authentic domain-appropriate art direction and rhythm.
    3. Respects explicit user overrides if present in prompt_spec.
    """
    spec = prompt_spec or {}
    dom = (spec.get("domain") or domain or "general").lower().strip()
    
    # 1. Determine hero archetype:
    # Check for explicit request in prompt/spec
    raw_prompt = (spec.get("prompt") or spec.get("title") or spec.get("description") or "").lower()
    selected_archetype: Optional[str] = None
    
    explicit_archetype = spec.get("heroArchetype")
    if explicit_archetype in CANONICAL_HERO_ARCHETYPES:
        selected_archetype = explicit_archetype
    elif re.search(r"\bbento\b", raw_prompt):
        selected_archetype = "bento"
    elif re.search(r"\b(?:terminal|cli)\b", raw_prompt) or (re.search(r"\bdeveloper\b", raw_prompt) and re.search(r"\bcode\b", raw_prompt)):
        selected_archetype = "terminal_data"
    elif re.search(r"\b(?:product stage|plinth|pedestal)\b", raw_prompt):
        selected_archetype = "product_stage"
    elif re.search(r"\b(?:full[- ]bleed|cinematic|photography|photographic)\b", raw_prompt):
        selected_archetype = "full_bleed_visual"
    elif re.search(r"\b(?:editorial|magazine)\b", raw_prompt):
        selected_archetype = "editorial_asymmetric"
    elif re.search(r"\bcentered (?:hero|layout|composition)\b", raw_prompt):
        selected_archetype = "restrained_centered"
    elif re.search(r"\bsplit(?:[- ]screen| layout| hero| composition)\b", raw_prompt):
        selected_archetype = "split"
    elif spec.get("layoutArchetype") in _LAYOUT_TO_HERO_ARCHETYPE:
        # Keep the hero consistent with the content brief's layout archetype.
        selected_archetype = _LAYOUT_TO_HERO_ARCHETYPE[spec["layoutArchetype"]]

    # Seed from the request itself so different prompts get different plans even
    # when every caller passes task_index=0 (the workbench does). An empty prompt
    # keeps plain task_index round-robin for batch balancing.
    seed = task_index + prompt_design_seed(raw_prompt)

    # If no explicit keyword, balance systematically using the seed
    if not selected_archetype:
        # Round-robin across the archetypes that suit the domain: a terminal or
        # product-render stage is wrong for a bakery or a law firm.
        pool = list(CANONICAL_HERO_ARCHETYPES)
        if dom not in _TECH_DOMAINS:
            pool.remove("terminal_data")
            if dom not in _PRODUCT_STAGE_DOMAINS:
                pool.remove("product_stage")
        selected_archetype = pool[seed % len(pool)]

    # 2. Select domain art direction & rhythm preset
    domain_presets = _DOMAIN_ART_DIRECTIONS.get(dom)
    if not domain_presets:
        # Match fuzzy domain
        matched_key = next((k for k in _DOMAIN_ART_DIRECTIONS if k in dom or dom in k), None)
        domain_presets = _DOMAIN_ART_DIRECTIONS.get(matched_key, [_DEFAULT_PRESET])
    
    preset_idx = seed % len(domain_presets)
    preset = domain_presets[preset_idx]

    # 3. Synchronize visual anchor with hero archetype
    anchor = preset.get("visualAnchor", "product-render")
    if selected_archetype == "terminal_data":
        anchor = "data-terminal"
    elif selected_archetype == "product_stage":
        anchor = "3d-stage"
    elif selected_archetype == "full_bleed_visual":
        anchor = "photography-bleed"
    elif selected_archetype == "bento":
        anchor = "interactive-canvas"

    direction = plan_design_direction({**spec, "business_type": dom}, recent=genome_history_from_brief(spec), task_index=seed)
    topology = list(spec.get("topology") or direction["section_rhythm"])
    # Planner-level diversity constraints: topology, not implementation, owns
    # the anti-template rules.
    if topology.count("three-column-grid") > 1:
        topology = [item for idx, item in enumerate(topology) if item != "three-column-grid" or idx == topology.index(item)]
    if not any(item in topology for item in ("asymmetric", "bento-asymmetric", "split", "sticky-deck")):
        topology.insert(0, "asymmetric")
    if not any(item in topology for item in ("editorial", "sticky-deck", "horizontal-collection", "wide-cta")):
        topology.append("wide-cta")

    return DesignPlan(
        artDirection=spec.get("artDirection") or preset.get("artDirection", "editorial industrial"),
        heroArchetype=selected_archetype,
        density=spec.get("density") or preset.get("density", "airy"),
        typeScale=spec.get("typeScale") or preset.get("typeScale", "display-heavy"),
        sectionRhythm=spec.get("sectionRhythm") or preset.get("sectionRhythm", ["quiet", "dense", "immersive", "quiet"]),
        motion=spec.get("motion") or preset.get("motion", ["text-reveal", "sticky-story"]),
        visualAnchor=anchor,
        mobileStrategy=spec.get("mobileStrategy") or preset.get("mobileStrategy", "stack"),
        topology=topology,
        designGenome=direction["genome"],
    )
`````

`````python
def _repair_common_interaction_patterns(content: str, section_name: str, original_prompt: str) -> str:

        content = content.replace(
            "document.querySelector('.lightbox')?.classList.add('active');",
            "const selected = projects.find(project => project.id === id); "
            "if (selected) window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('site-open-lightbox', { detail: selected }));",
        )
    if "lightbox" in section and "site-open-lightbox" not in content:
        signature = re.search(
            r'(export\s+default\s+function\s+\w+)\(\s*\{\s*project\s*\}\s*:\s*\{\s*project\s*:\s*any\s*\}\s*\)\s*\{',
            content,
        )
        if signature:
            listener = (
                "\n  const [project, setProject] = React.useState<any>(null);\n"
                "  React.useEffect(() => {\n"
                "    const open = (event: Event) => setProject((event as CustomEvent).detail);\n"
                "    const close = (event: KeyboardEvent) => { if (event.key === 'Escape') setProject(null); };\n"
                "    window.addEventListener('site-open-lightbox', open);\n"
                "    window.addEventListener('keydown', close);\n"

            )
            content = content[:signature.start()] + signature.group(1) + "() {" + listener + content[signature.end():]
            content = content.replace("setActive(false)", "setProject(null)")
            returns = list(re.finditer(r'\breturn\s*\(', content))
            if returns:

def is_substantive_fallback_rewrite(before: str, after: str) -> bool:
    """Reject a fallback rewrite that only clears its status marker or formatting."""
    if not re.search(r'data-fallback\s*=\s*["\']true["\']', before):
        return True
    marker = r'data-fallback\s*=\s*["\'](?:true|false)["\']'
    old_body = re.sub(r'\s+', '', re.sub(marker, '', before))
    new_body = re.sub(r'\s+', '', re.sub(marker, '', after))
    return SequenceMatcher(None, old_body, new_body).ratio() < 0.95

    return normalized


def remove_unresolved_section_links(files: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Render links to absent in-page targets as text, preserving their content."""
    source_files = {path: source for path, source in files.items() if path.endswith((".tsx", ".jsx", ".html"))}
    ids = {"site-main"}
    for source in source_files.values():
        ids.update(re.findall(r'\bid\s*=\s*["\']([A-Za-z][\w-]*)["\']', source))

    changed: dict[str, str] = {}
    anchor_pattern = re.compile(
        r'<a\b(?P<attrs>[^>]*\bhref\s*=\s*["\']#(?P<target>[A-Za-z][\w-]*)["\'][^>]*)>'
        r'(?P<body>.*?)</a>', re.S | re.I,
    )
    for path, source in source_files.items():
        if not path.endswith((".tsx", ".jsx")):
            continue

        def strip_dead_link(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
            attrs = match.group("attrs")
            if match.group("target") in ids or re.search(r'\bonClick\s*=', attrs):
                return match.group(0)
            # A home/top link may use the familiar route name even when the
            # declared landing section is hero. Preserve its navigation intent.
            if (match.group("target") == "home" and "hero" in ids
                    and re.fullmatch(r'\s*(?:Home|Back to home)\s*', match.group("body"), re.I)):
                return re.sub(r'(\bhref\s*=\s*["\'])#home(["\'])',
                              r'\1#hero\2', match.group(0), count=1)
            attrs = re.sub(r'\s*href\s*=\s*["\']#[A-Za-z][\w-]*["\']', '', attrs, count=1)
            return f'<span{attrs}>{match.group("body")}</span>'

        repaired = anchor_pattern.sub(strip_dead_link, source)
        if repaired != source:
            changed[path] = repaired
    return changed
`````

`````python
"""Recognize generated Tailwind utilities before preparing a Vite site."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Mapping


_STANDALONE = {
    "absolute", "block", "contents", "fixed", "flex", "grid", "hidden",
    "inline", "inline-block", "inline-flex", "relative", "sticky",
    "italic", "uppercase", "lowercase", "truncate", "underline", "border",
    "antialiased", "container", "sr-only", "not-sr-only",
}
_PREFIXES = (
    "bg-", "text-", "border-", "rounded-", "px-", "py-", "pt-", "pb-",
    "pl-", "pr-", "p-", "mx-", "my-", "mt-", "mb-", "ml-", "mr-",
    "m-", "gap-", "gap-x-", "gap-y-", "grid-cols-", "max-w-", "min-w-",
    "max-h-", "min-h-", "w-", "h-", "font-", "tracking-", "leading-",
    "shadow-", "duration-", "opacity-", "z-", "top-", "bottom-", "left-",
    "right-", "items-", "justify-", "self-", "overflow-", "transition-",
    "backdrop-", "space-x-", "space-y-", "flex-", "basis-", "grow-",
    "shrink-", "cursor-", "select-", "ring-", "outline-", "animate-",
    "divide-", "inset-", "min-h-", "min-w-", "from-", "to-", "via-",
)
_VARIANTS = {"sm", "md", "lg", "xl", "2xl", "hover", "focus", "focus-visible", "active", "dark", "group-hover", "disabled"}


def is_tailwind_utility(token: str) -> bool:
    """Recognize common utility syntax without treating BEM names as utilities."""
    pieces = token.split(":")
    if len(pieces) > 1 and not all(part in _VARIANTS for part in pieces[:-1]):
        return False
    base = pieces[-1].lstrip("!-")
    return base in _STANDALONE or any(base.startswith(prefix) for prefix in _PREFIXES)


def site_uses_tailwind(files: Mapping[str, str], minimum: int = 3) -> bool:
    """Require several utility tokens so a single class does not switch styling modes."""
    found: set[str] = set()
    for path, source in files.items():
        if not path.endswith((".tsx", ".jsx")):
            continue
        for match in re.finditer(r'className\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']', source):
            for token in match.group(1).split():
                if is_tailwind_utility(token):
                    found.add(token)
                    if len(found) >= minimum:
                        return True
    return False
`````

`````python
"""Grounded, functional storefront fallback for disconnected generated shop sections."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from typing import Any


def _category_for_name(name: str) -> str:
    """Use a broad product grouping when no catalog category was supplied."""
    lower = name.lower()
    groups = (
        (r"\b(?:runner|napkin|tablecloth|placemat|towel)\b", "Linens"),
        (r"\b(?:vase|candle|holder|planter|mirror|frame)\b", "Decor"),
        (r"\b(?:shirt|jacket|dress|sweater|trouser|jeans)\b", "Apparel"),
        (r"\b(?:shoe|boot|sneaker|sandal)\b", "Footwear"),
        (r"\b(?:book|journal|notebook)\b", "Books & stationery"),
    )
    return next((category for pattern, category in groups if re.search(pattern, lower)), "Other products")


def ground_shop_brief(brief: dict[str, Any], prompt: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Recover explicit catalog facts when an earlier brief omitted them."""
    grounded = dict(brief)
    if not grounded.get("products"):
        catalog = re.search(r"\b(?:products|catalog|items)\s*:\s*([^\n.]+)", prompt, re.I)
        products: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        if catalog:
            for part in re.split(r",\s*(?:and\s+)?|\s+and\s+", catalog.group(1)):
                item = re.sub(r"^and\s+", "", part.strip(), flags=re.I)
                match = re.fullmatch(r"([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9 '&-]{1,60}?)\s+(?:at|for|[-–:])\s*(\$\d+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)", item)
                if match:
                    products.append({"name": match.group(1).strip(), "price": match.group(2)})
        grounded["products"] = products
    if re.search(r"\bwarm cream\b", prompt, re.I):
        grounded["background_color"] = "#f6f1e7"
    if re.search(r"\bforest green\b", prompt, re.I):
        grounded["primary_color"] = "#203b2b"
    return grounded

type CartItem = { id: string; name: string; price: number; category: string; quantity: number };
const money = (value: number) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }).format(value);

function readCart(): CartItem[] {

    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed as CartItem[] : [];
  } catch { return []; }

export function Cart() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<CartItem[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = () => setItems(readCart());
    sync();
    window.addEventListener('site-cart-updated', sync);
    window.addEventListener('storage', sync);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener('site-cart-updated', sync); window.removeEventListener('storage', sync); };
  }, []);

  const writeCart = (next: CartItem[]) => {
    setItems(next);
    try { localStorage.setItem('site-cart', JSON.stringify(next)); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('site-cart-updated'));
  };
  const changeQuantity = (id: string, amount: number) =>
    writeCart(items.map((item) => item.id === id ? { ...item, quantity: Math.max(1, item.quantity + amount) } : item));
  const remove = (id: string) => writeCart(items.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
  const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0);

  return <section id="cart" className="site-cart" data-repaired="shop-contract">

}

export default Cart;
`````

`````python
"""
evaluation/motion_benchmark.py - Playwright Behavioral & Performance Motion Benchmark.

Implements Section 7 of SiteAgent_Updated_Audit_and_Motion_Plan.md:
"A regex/code-level judge is not sufficient because models can satisfy it by including
strings without correct behavior."

Executes real browser behavioral and performance tests across the 6 motion families:
1. Scroll reveal: Measure element before and after scrolling into view.
2. Parallax: Verify transform changes across scroll positions and that no wheel/touch
   event is prevented.
3. Horizontal scroll: Verify desktop track translation and mobile native overflow/scroll-snap.
4. Sticky storytelling: Measure bounding-box position while page progresses through sticky range.
5. Text reveal: Check accessible name, aria-hidden split spans, and reduced-motion visibility.
6. Micro-interactions: Use mouse + keyboard focus and assert visual/state changes.

Performance & Health checks:
- page errors
- console errors
- long tasks if available
- layout shifts (CLS)
- uncontrolled requestAnimationFrame loops
- listener cleanup / passive event listeners
- body horizontal overflow (desktop)
- mobile 375 px behavior
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple, Union
import urllib.request

logger = logging.getLogger("motion_benchmark")

# Playwright availability check
try:
    from playwright.sync_api import (
        Browser,
        BrowserContext,
        ElementHandle,
        Page,
        sync_playwright,
    )
    _PLAYWRIGHT_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    _PLAYWRIGHT_AVAILABLE = False
    Page = Any  # type: ignore


# Motion families
MOTION_FAMILIES = [
    "scroll_reveal",
    "parallax",
    "horizontal_scroll",
    "sticky_story",
    "text_reveal",
    "micro_interaction",
]


@dataclass
class MotionBehavioralResult:
    """Result of an individual behavioral motion test."""
    motion_type: str
    passed: bool
    score: float = 0.0  # 0.0 to 1.0
    selector: Optional[str] = None
    metrics: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    errors: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    warnings: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "motion_type": self.motion_type,
            "passed": self.passed,
            "score": round(self.score, 4),
            "selector": self.selector,
            "metrics": self.metrics,
            "errors": self.errors,
            "warnings": self.warnings,
        }


@dataclass
class MotionPerformanceResult:
    """Result of runtime performance and health checks."""
    passed: bool
    score: float = 1.0  # 0.0 to 1.0
    page_errors: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    console_errors: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    mobile_scroll_width: int = 0

    warnings: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {

            "long_tasks_count": self.long_tasks_count,
            "cumulative_layout_shift": round(self.cumulative_layout_shift, 4),
            "uncontrolled_raf": self.uncontrolled_raf,
            "idle_raf_rate_per_sec": round(self.idle_raf_rate_per_sec, 2),
            "listener_cleanup_verified": self.listener_cleanup_verified,
            "body_horizontal_overflow_desktop": self.body_horizontal_overflow_desktop,
            "body_horizontal_overflow_mobile_375": self.body_horizontal_overflow_mobile_375,
            "desktop_scroll_width": self.desktop_scroll_width,
            "desktop_viewport_width": self.desktop_viewport_width,

@dataclass
class MotionBenchmarkReport:
    """Comprehensive report across behavioral and performance checks."""
    passed: bool
    composite_score: float  # 0.0 to 1.0
    behavioral_score: float  # 0.0 to 1.0
    performance_score: float  # 0.0 to 1.0
    behavioral_results: Dict[str, MotionBehavioralResult] = field(default_factory=dict)
    performance_result: Optional[MotionPerformanceResult] = None
`````
